faa.t: n. 美国联邦航空管理局（缩写）

e.en: The {FAA} grounded the airline pending a safety review.
e.zh: 在安全审查期间,联邦航空管理局停飞了这家航空公司。

e.en: Drone pilots must register with the {FAA} before flying.
e.zh: 无人机操作员飞行前必须在联邦航空局登记。

fab.t:
adj. 极好的（fabulous 缩写）
n. 芯片制造厂

e.en: That new ramen place is absolutely {fab}.
e.zh: 那家新开的拉面店简直棒呆了。

e.en: The chip {fab} in Taiwan ships millions of wafers monthly.
e.zh: 台湾的那家芯片厂每月出货数百万片晶圆。

fabian.t:
n. 费边（人名）
adj. 费边派的（渐进改良）

e.en: He took a {Fabian} approach, wearing down the opposition slowly.
e.zh: 他采取了费边式策略,慢慢消耗对手。

e.en: The {Fabian} Society pushed gradual social reforms in Britain.
e.zh: 费边社在英国推动渐进式的社会改革。

e.en: The tortoise and the hare is a classic {fable}.
e.zh: 《龟兔赛跑》是一则经典寓言。

e.en: Grandma told us a bedtime {fable} about a clever fox.
e.zh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个关于聪明狐狸的睡前寓言。

e.en: They searched for the {fabled} city of gold for years.
e.zh: 他们多年来一直在寻找那座传说中的黄金之城。

e.en: The chef's {fabled} dumplings draw long lines every weekend.
e.zh: 那位厨师传奇的饺子每个周末都排起长队。

fabliau.t: n. 中世纪法国韵文滑稽故事

e.en: Each {fabliau} pokes fun at clergy or cheating spouses.
e.zh: 每则法布利欧都在讽刺神职人员或不忠的配偶。

e.en: The medieval {fabliau} entertained audiences with bawdy humor.
e.zh: 中世纪的法布利欧用粗俗幽默逗乐观众。

e.en: Old French {fabliaux} mocked greedy monks and gullible husbands.
e.zh: 古法语的法布利欧讽刺贪婪的修士和好骗的丈夫。

e.en: Scholars study {fabliaux} to understand medieval street humor.
e.zh: 学者研究法布利欧以了解中世纪街头幽默。

e.en: This shirt is made from a soft cotton {fabric}.
e.zh: 这件衬衫是用柔软的棉布做的。

e.en: Trust forms the {fabric} of any healthy community.
e.zh: 信任是任何健康社区的根基。

e.en: The factory can {fabricate} steel parts to exact specs.
e.zh: 这家工厂能按精确规格制造钢制零件。

e.en: He tried to {fabricate} an alibi, but no one believed him.
e.zh: 他试图编造一个不在场证明,但没人相信。

fabricated.t:
v. 捏造/制造（过去式）
adj. 捏造的；人造的

e.en: The journalist {fabricated} quotes and lost her job.
e.zh: 那位记者编造了引语,因此丢了工作。

e.en: Each panel is {fabricated} from recycled aluminum sheets.
e.zh: 每块面板都是用回收铝板制成的。

fabricates.t: v. 捏造；制造（第三人称单数）

e.en: The startup {fabricates} custom circuit boards on demand.
e.zh: 这家初创公司按需定制生产电路板。

e.en: He often {fabricates} stories to impress strangers at parties.
e.zh: 他经常在派对上编故事来打动陌生人。

fabricating.t: v. 捏造；制造（现在分词）

e.en: The plant is {fabricating} solar panels around the clock.
e.zh: 这家工厂正二十四小时不停地生产太阳能板。

e.en: She was caught {fabricating} data in her research paper.
e.zh: 她被发现在论文中伪造数据。

e.en: The whole story turned out to be a {fabrication}.
e.zh: 整个故事原来都是编造出来的。

e.en: Chip {fabrication} requires extremely clean facilities.
e.zh: 芯片制造需要极其洁净的厂房。

e.en: His résumé was full of {fabrications} about past jobs.
e.zh: 他的简历里充斥着关于过往工作的虚构内容。

e.en: Modern {fabrications} of carbon fiber are lighter than ever.
e.zh: 现代的碳纤维制品比以往任何时候都更轻。

e.en: The {fabricator} welded the steel beams for the new bridge.
e.zh: 那位金属加工师为新桥焊接了钢梁。

e.en: Police called the witness a {fabricator} of false stories.
e.zh: 警方称这位证人是编造谎言的人。

e.en: The store sells silk and cotton {fabrics} at low prices.
e.zh: 这家店以低价出售丝绸和棉布料。

e.en: Trust holds the {fabrics} of society together.
e.zh: 信任把社会的结构紧紧维系在一起。

e.en: Children often {fabulate} stories about imaginary friends.
e.zh: 孩子们常常编造关于想象朋友的故事。

e.en: Some witnesses {fabulate} when they cannot remember clearly.
e.zh: 有些目击者在记不清时会凭空编造。

e.en: He {fabulated} an excuse to avoid the meeting.
e.zh: 他编了个借口来逃避会议。

e.en: The novelist {fabulated} an entire world from scratch.
e.zh: 那位小说家从零开始虚构出一整个世界。

fabulates.t: v. fabulate 的第三人称单数

e.en: She {fabulates} wild adventures whenever guests visit.
e.zh: 每当有客人来访,她就编造离奇的冒险故事。

e.en: The author {fabulates} freely in his magical-realist novels.
e.zh: 这位作家在他的魔幻现实主义小说中尽情虚构。

e.en: The child kept {fabulating} excuses for missing homework.
e.zh: 那个孩子不停地编造没写作业的借口。

e.en: She enjoys {fabulating} bedtime stories for her kids.
e.zh: 她喜欢为孩子们编睡前故事。

e.en: The memoir blurs memory and {fabulation} on every page.
e.zh: 这本回忆录每一页都模糊了记忆与虚构。

e.en: His testimony was dismissed as pure {fabulation}.
e.zh: 他的证词被当作纯粹的编造而驳回。

e.en: Her novels are imaginative {fabulations} of historical events.
e.zh: 她的小说是对历史事件富有想象力的虚构。

e.en: The court rejected his {fabulations} as unreliable evidence.
e.zh: 法庭以不可信为由驳回了他的编造。

e.en: Aesop is the most famous {fabulist} in Western literature.
e.zh: 伊索是西方文学中最著名的寓言作家。

e.en: Critics called the politician a shameless {fabulist}.
e.zh: 评论家称这位政客是无耻的造谣者。

fabulous.t: adj. 极好的，绝妙的；传说的

e.en: We had a {fabulous} weekend at the beach.
e.zh: 我们在海边度过了一个超棒的周末。

e.en: She wore a {fabulous} dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一条非常华丽的礼服去参加晚会。

fabulously.t: adv. 极好地；难以置信地

e.en: The startup founder became {fabulously} rich overnight.
e.zh: 那位创业者一夜之间变得极其富有。

e.en: The cake turned out {fabulously} despite my mistakes.
e.zh: 尽管我出了几次错,蛋糕还是做得超棒。

facade.t: n. 建筑正面；表面、假象

e.en: The building's marble {facade} was restored last year.
e.zh: 这栋楼的大理石外墙去年被修复了。

e.en: His cheerful {facade} hid years of quiet sadness.
e.zh: 他开朗的外表掩盖了多年的暗自悲伤。

face.t:
n. 脸；表面
v. 面对；面向

e.en: She washed her {face} and brushed her teeth.
e.zh: 她洗了脸又刷了牙。

e.en: Startups must {face} fierce competition in the first year.
e.zh: 创业公司在第一年必须面对激烈的竞争。

face-to-face.t:
adj. 面对面的
adv. 当面地

e.en: We finally met {face-to-face} after months of video calls.
e.zh: 经过数月视频通话后,我们终于面对面见了。

e.en: Difficult conversations are best handled {face-to-face}.
e.zh: 棘手的谈话最好当面进行。

faced.t:
v. 面对（过去式）
adj. 带…面的

e.en: She {faced} the audience and began her speech.
e.zh: 她面向观众,开始了演讲。

e.en: The team {faced} many setbacks before succeeding.
e.zh: 团队在成功之前经历了许多挫折。

facedown.t:
adv. 脸朝下地
n. 当面对峙

e.en: He lay {facedown} on the couch after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后,他面朝下趴在沙发上。

e.en: Place the cards {facedown} on the table.
e.zh: 把牌正面朝下放在桌上。

faceless.t: adj. 面目模糊的；无名无姓的

e.en: Online trolls hide behind {faceless} usernames.
e.zh: 网络喷子们躲在没有面孔的用户名背后。

e.en: Big corporations can feel cold and {faceless}.
e.zh: 大公司可能让人感觉冷漠又毫无人情味。

e.en: The old café got a stylish {facelift} last summer.
e.zh: 那家旧咖啡馆去年夏天改头换面了一番。

e.en: The website needs a serious {facelift} to attract users.
e.zh: 这个网站需要彻底改版才能吸引用户。

e.en: The phone's cracked {faceplate} costs forty dollars to replace.
e.zh: 手机破裂的面板更换要花四十美元。

e.en: He swapped the controller's {faceplate} for a custom design.
e.zh: 他把手柄的面板换成了定制款式。

faces.t:
n. 脸（复数）
v. 面对（第三人称单数）

e.en: The crowd had thousands of unfamiliar {faces}.
e.zh: 人群中有成千上万张陌生的面孔。

e.en: Every founder {faces} doubt at some point.
e.zh: 每位创业者都会在某个时刻面临怀疑。

e.en: Privacy is just one {facet} of online safety.
e.zh: 隐私只是网络安全的一个方面。

e.en: Each {facet} of the diamond catches the light beautifully.
e.zh: 钻石的每一个切面都漂亮地反射出光芒。

e.en: The author's {facete} remarks delighted the dinner guests.
e.zh: 作者诙谐的妙语让晚宴的客人们十分开心。

e.en: She offered a {facete} reply to the awkward question.
e.zh: 她对那个尴尬的问题给了一个风趣的回答。

faceted.t: adj. 有刻面的；多方面的

e.en: She wore a beautifully {faceted} crystal pendant.
e.zh: 她戴着一条切面精美的水晶吊坠。

e.en: Climate change is a deeply {faceted} global problem.
e.zh: 气候变化是一个错综复杂的全球性问题。

facetious.t: adj. 爱开玩笑的；不严肃的

e.en: Don't be {facetious} — this is a serious meeting.
e.zh: 别开玩笑了,这是一个严肃的会议。

e.en: His {facetious} tone offended several team members.
e.zh: 他那种戏谑的口吻冒犯了好几位同事。

e.en: He {facetiously} suggested we cancel all the meetings forever.
e.zh: 他开玩笑地建议我们永远取消所有会议。

e.en: She replied {facetiously} when asked about her cooking skills.
e.zh: 被问到厨艺时,她半开玩笑地回答了。

facial.t:
adj. 面部的
n. 面部护理

e.en: The app uses {facial} recognition to unlock your phone.
e.zh: 这款应用通过面部识别来解锁手机。

e.en: She booked a relaxing {facial} at the spa.
e.zh: 她在水疗中心预约了一次放松的面部护理。

facially.t: adv. 在面部上；从面部看

e.en: The twins are {facially} identical but very different in personality.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎面貌完全相同,但性格大相径庭。

e.en: The argument is {facially} convincing but flawed underneath.
e.zh: 这个论点表面上很有说服力,但内里有漏洞。

e.en: Many spas offer {facials} as a relaxing weekend treat.
e.zh: 许多水疗中心提供面部护理作为周末放松项目。

e.en: Regular {facials} can help keep your skin healthy.
e.zh: 定期做面部护理有助于保持皮肤健康。

facile.t:
adj. 轻率的；肤浅的
adj. 容易做到的

e.en: That's a {facile} explanation for a complex problem.
e.zh: 对于这么复杂的问题,这种解释太肤浅了。

e.en: Avoid {facile} comparisons between the two countries.
e.zh: 避免对这两个国家做过于简单的比较。

e.en: This tool helps {facilitate} smoother team collaboration.
e.zh: 这个工具有助于促进团队更顺畅的协作。

e.en: Good translators {facilitate} understanding between cultures.
e.zh: 优秀的译者能促进不同文化之间的理解。

e.en: The new platform {facilitated} remote work during the pandemic.
e.zh: 这个新平台在疫情期间促进了远程办公。

e.en: She {facilitated} the workshop with great patience.
e.zh: 她非常耐心地主持了那场研讨会。

facilitates.t: v. 促进（第三人称单数）

e.en: This app {facilitates} payments between friends.
e.zh: 这款应用方便朋友之间相互转账。

e.en: Open communication {facilitates} trust within the team.
e.zh: 开放的沟通有助于在团队内部建立信任。

e.en: She is {facilitating} the design review meeting today.
e.zh: 她今天负责主持设计评审会议。

e.en: The bridge plays a key role in {facilitating} trade.
e.zh: 这座桥在促进贸易方面发挥着关键作用。

e.en: Skilled {facilitation} kept the workshop on track.
e.zh: 熟练的引导让研讨会顺利进行。

e.en: The agency provides {facilitation} for cross-border deals.
e.zh: 该机构为跨境交易提供协调服务。

e.en: The consultant ran several {facilitations} for our leadership team.
e.zh: 那位顾问为我们的领导团队主持了几次研讨引导。

e.en: Trade {facilitations} between the two countries boosted exports.
e.zh: 两国之间的贸易便利化措施促进了出口。

e.en: A good manager takes a {facilitative} rather than controlling approach.
e.zh: 好的管理者采取的是辅助式而非控制式的方式。

e.en: Therapy works best in a warm, {facilitative} environment.
e.zh: 心理治疗在温暖且具支持性的环境中效果最好。

e.en: The {facilitator} kept the brainstorm focused and lively.
e.zh: 那位引导员让头脑风暴既聚焦又生动。

e.en: A skilled {facilitator} can defuse tense team conflicts.
e.zh: 一位熟练的引导者能化解紧张的团队冲突。

e.en: The campus has excellent sports {facilities} for students.
e.zh: 这所校园为学生提供了优秀的体育设施。

e.en: Modern hospitals need updated medical {facilities}.
e.zh: 现代医院需要更新的医疗设施。

facility.t:
n. 设施；场所
n. 能力；才能

e.en: The new research {facility} opens downtown next month.
e.zh: 新的研究中心下个月在市中心开放。

e.en: She handles spreadsheets with surprising {facility}.
e.zh: 她处理电子表格的能力出人意料地娴熟。

facing.t:
v. 面对（进行时）
n. 饰面；贴面

e.en: Our balcony is {facing} the ocean and gets great sunsets.
e.zh: 我们的阳台朝海,日落景色非常棒。

e.en: Many small businesses are {facing} rising costs this year.
e.zh: 许多小企业今年正面临成本上升的压力。

e.en: The museum displayed an exact {facsimile} of the ancient map.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了那张古地图的精确复制品。

e.en: The painting is a {facsimile}, not the original masterpiece.
e.zh: 这幅画是复制品,不是原版杰作。

e.en: Libraries often keep {facsimiles} of rare manuscripts.
e.zh: 图书馆通常会保存珍稀手稿的复制本。

e.en: These designer bags are convincing {facsimiles} of the originals.
e.zh: 这些设计师手袋是仿真度极高的复制品。

e.en: The {fact} that she lied surprised everyone.
e.zh: 她撒谎这一事实让所有人都感到惊讶。

e.en: Always check the {fact} before sharing news online.
e.zh: 在网上分享新闻前一定要核实事实。

e.en: A small {faction} within the party opposed the reform.
e.zh: 党内一小撮派系反对这项改革。

e.en: The rebel {faction} announced a ceasefire yesterday.
e.zh: 那个反叛派别昨天宣布停火。

e.en: {Factional} disputes paralyzed the government for months.
e.zh: 派系之间的争斗让政府瘫痪了数月。

e.en: The party suffered from deep {factional} infighting.
e.zh: 该政党饱受深层派系内斗的困扰。

factionalism.t: n. 派系斗争；宗派主义

e.en: {Factionalism} weakened the party before the election.
e.zh: 派系主义在大选前削弱了该党的力量。

e.en: Office {factionalism} can destroy team morale quickly.
e.zh: 办公室里的派系斗争会迅速摧毁团队士气。

e.en: Rival {factions} fought for control of the council.
e.zh: 敌对派系争夺议会的控制权。

e.en: The fandom split into {factions} over the new ending.
e.zh: 粉丝群因新结局而分裂成几个派别。

factious.t: adj. 爱搞派系的；分裂的

e.en: The {factious} senators blocked every reform attempt.
e.zh: 那些好搞派系斗争的参议员阻挠了每一次改革尝试。

e.en: A {factious} mood took over the once-friendly forum.
e.zh: 原本友好的论坛被一股拉帮结派的氛围笼罩。

e.en: The product's {factitious} reviews fooled many shoppers.
e.zh: 该产品虚假的评论欺骗了许多购物者。

e.en: Critics dismissed the outrage as {factitious} and staged.
e.zh: 评论人士认为那种愤怒是人为制造和摆拍的。

factoid.t: n. 趣味小知识；小道消息

e.en: He shared a fun {factoid} about octopus brains at dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时他分享了一个关于章鱼大脑的有趣小知识。

e.en: Social media spreads every {factoid} faster than real news.
e.zh: 社交媒体传播每一条小道消息都比真新闻快。

factor.t:
n. 因素；要素
v. 分解（数学）

e.en: Price is a major {factor} in our buying decision.
e.zh: 价格是我们购买决策中的一个重要因素。

e.en: You need to {factor} taxes into the final cost.
e.zh: 你得把税款也计入最终成本。

e.en: This polynomial is easily {factorable} into two binomials.
e.zh: 这个多项式很容易分解成两个二项式。

e.en: Not every quadratic equation is {factorable} over integers.
e.zh: 并非每个二次方程都能在整数范围内分解。

e.en: The {factorial} of five equals one hundred and twenty.
e.zh: 五的阶乘等于一百二十。

e.en: Computers calculate large {factorial} numbers in milliseconds.
e.zh: 计算机能在毫秒内算出很大的阶乘数。

e.en: Many {factories} have moved overseas to cut costs.
e.zh: 许多工厂为了削减成本搬到了海外。

e.en: The town's old {factories} were converted into apartments.
e.zh: 小镇上的旧工厂被改造成了公寓。

factoring.t:
n. 因式分解
n. 保理（金融）

e.en: She is {factoring} commute time into her job choice.
e.zh: 她在选工作时把通勤时间也考虑进去了。

e.en: The lesson covered {factoring} polynomials step by step.
e.zh: 这堂课一步步讲了多项式的因式分解。

e.en: Prime {factorization} breaks a number into prime building blocks.
e.zh: 质因数分解把一个数拆成质数的乘积。

e.en: The algorithm performs {factorization} of large integers quickly.
e.zh: 该算法能快速对大整数进行因数分解。

e.en: Several {factors} contributed to the project's delay.
e.zh: 多个因素导致了该项目的延误。

e.en: The {factors} of twelve are one, two, three, four, six, twelve.
e.zh: 十二的因数有一、二、三、四、六和十二。

e.en: The car {factory} produces a thousand vehicles every day.
e.zh: 这家汽车厂每天生产一千辆车。

e.en: Reset the phone to its {factory} settings to fix the bug.
e.zh: 把手机恢复出厂设置以修复这个问题。

e.en: He works as a {factotum} at the small hotel downtown.
e.zh: 他在市中心的小旅馆当杂务工。

e.en: Every startup needs a {factotum} who can do everything.
e.zh: 每家初创公司都需要一个什么都会做的杂务能手。

e.en: Please stick to the {facts} when writing the report.
e.zh: 写报告时请只陈述事实。

e.en: Check your {facts} before posting on social media.
e.zh: 在社交媒体上发帖前先核实你的信息。

factsheet.t: n. 资料简介；情况说明

e.en: Download the {factsheet} for a quick product overview.
e.zh: 下载这份资料表可快速了解产品概况。

e.en: Each fund publishes a monthly {factsheet} for investors.
e.zh: 每只基金每月都会发布一份给投资者的资料表。

factual.t: adj. 真实的；基于事实的

e.en: The article contains several {factual} errors about the event.
e.zh: 这篇文章对该事件有几处事实性错误。

e.en: Reporters must keep their stories {factual} and unbiased.
e.zh: 记者必须让报道做到真实且无偏见。

e.en: Editors check the {factuality} of every claim before publishing.
e.zh: 编辑在发表前会核实每条陈述的真实性。

e.en: AI models are improving in {factuality} but still hallucinate.
e.zh: AI 模型在事实准确性上在进步,但仍会出现幻觉。

e.en: The post is {factually} wrong and should be corrected.
e.zh: 这条帖子在事实上是错的,应该更正。

e.en: She answered the question {factually}, without any emotion.
e.zh: 她照实回答了问题,没有掺杂任何情绪。

facultative.t: adj. 任意的；兼性的（生物）

e.en: Attendance at the workshop is {facultative}, not mandatory.
e.zh: 参加这个研讨会是自愿的,不是强制的。

e.en: Some bacteria are {facultative} and survive with or without oxygen.
e.zh: 有些细菌是兼性的,有氧无氧都能生存。

e.en: At ninety, she still has all her mental {faculties}.
e.zh: 九十岁了,她的各种心智能力依然健全。

e.en: The university's science {faculties} share a new research building.
e.zh: 该大学的几个理科院系共用一栋新研究楼。

faculty.t:
n. (大学) 院系；全体教员
n. 天赋；能力

e.en: She joined the {faculty} of medicine last September.
e.zh: 她去年九月加入了医学院的教职。

e.en: He has a remarkable {faculty} for learning languages.
e.zh: 他在学语言方面有惊人的天赋。

fad.t: n. 一时的风尚；短暂热潮

e.en: Bubble tea was just a {fad} a decade ago.
e.zh: 十年前珍珠奶茶只是一阵风潮。

e.en: Avoid every diet {fad} and stick to balanced meals.
e.zh: 别追那些一阵风的减肥潮,坚持均衡饮食就好。

faddish.t: adj. 赶时髦的；流行一时的

e.en: The cafe serves {faddish} drinks that change every month.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆每月都换一批跟风的潮流饮品。

e.en: His advice avoids {faddish} buzzwords and stays practical.
e.zh: 他的建议避开赶时髦的流行词,始终很实用。

faddy.t: adj. 挑剔的；爱赶时髦的

e.en: My toddler is a {faddy} eater who refuses vegetables.
e.zh: 我家小孩挑食得很,死活不吃蔬菜。

e.en: She gets bored quickly and is rather {faddy} about hobbies.
e.zh: 她容易厌倦,对爱好挺三分钟热度的。

fade.t:
v. 褪色；淡出
v. 逐渐消失

e.en: Black T-shirts {fade} after many washes in hot water.
e.zh: 黑色T恤用热水洗多了会褪色。

e.en: The barber gave him a clean {fade} on the sides.
e.zh: 理发师给他两边剪了一个干净的渐变发型。

fadeaway.t:
n. 后仰跳投（篮球）
n. 逐渐消失

e.en: His signature move is a {fadeaway} jumper from the corner.
e.zh: 他的招牌动作是从底角后仰跳投。

e.en: The song ends with a slow {fadeaway} into silence.
e.zh: 这首歌以缓缓淡出至寂静作结。

e.en: He wore an old pair of {faded} blue jeans.
e.zh: 他穿着一条褪了色的旧蓝牛仔裤。

e.en: Her memories of childhood have {faded} over the years.
e.zh: 多年过去,她对童年的记忆已经淡去。

fades.t: v. 褪色（第三人称单数）

e.en: The screen slowly {fades} to black at the ending.
e.zh: 屏幕在结尾处缓缓淡出至黑屏。

e.en: Excitement quickly {fades} once the novelty wears off.
e.zh: 新鲜劲一过,兴奋感很快就消退了。

e.en: Sunlight is {fading} the curtains by the window.
e.zh: 阳光把窗边的窗帘晒得褪色了。

e.en: Hopes of a comeback are quickly {fading} this season.
e.zh: 本赛季东山再起的希望正在迅速消失。

e.en: We listened to live {fado} in a small Lisbon bar.
e.zh: 我们在里斯本的一家小酒吧听了现场法多音乐。

e.en: Traditional {fado} expresses longing and Portuguese melancholy.
e.zh: 传统的法多音乐表达着思念与葡萄牙式的忧愁。

e.en: The lab tested water samples for {faecal} contamination.
e.zh: 实验室检测了水样是否受粪便污染。

e.en: Doctors analyse {faecal} matter to diagnose gut problems.
e.zh: 医生通过分析粪便来诊断肠道问题。

e.en: The novel is set in a magical {faerie} kingdom.
e.zh: 这本小说的背景设定在一个魔法仙境王国。

e.en: Children love stories about a tiny {faerie} with wings.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢关于带翅膀的小仙子的故事。

faery.t: n. 仙境；小精灵（faerie 变体）

e.en: She painted a delicate {faery} dancing on a flower.
e.zh: 她画了一只在花朵上起舞的小精灵。

e.en: Old Irish legends describe a hidden {faery} world.
e.zh: 古老的爱尔兰传说描绘了一个隐秘的精灵世界。

faff.t: v. 瞎忙活；磨蹭（英式口语）

e.en: Stop the {faff} and just book the tickets online.
e.zh: 别瞎折腾了,直接在网上订票就行。

e.en: Setting up the printer was a real {faff}.
e.zh: 装这台打印机真是麻烦得要命。

fag.t:
n. 苦差事
n. 香烟（英式俚语）

e.en: Carrying all those boxes upstairs was a real {fag}.
e.zh: 把那些箱子全搬上楼真是件累活。

e.en: He stepped outside the pub to smoke a {fag}.
e.zh: 他走到酒吧外面抽了根烟。

faggot.t:
n. 一捆柴
n. 男同性恋者（冒犯语）

e.en: He gathered a {faggot} of dry sticks for the fire.
e.zh: 他捡了一捆干树枝来生火。

e.en: Traditional British {faggot} dishes are made with minced pork.
e.zh: 传统的英式肉丸菜肴是用猪肉末做的。

faggy.t: adj. 疲惫的；烟味重的（俚语）

e.en: He dismissed the outfit as too {faggy} for his taste.
e.zh: 他觉得这身打扮太娘了,不合他的口味。

e.en: The slang word {faggy} is offensive and best avoided.
e.zh: "faggy" 这个俚语带有冒犯性,最好别用。

fagin.t: n. 费金（教唆犯，源自《雾都孤儿》）

e.en: The gang leader acted like a modern {fagin} exploiting kids.
e.zh: 那个团伙头目就像现代版的费金,利用小孩子作案。

e.en: Dickens created the unforgettable villain {fagin} in Oliver Twist.
e.zh: 狄更斯在《雾都孤儿》中塑造了令人难忘的反派费金。

e.en: She tossed another {fagot} of branches onto the bonfire.
e.zh: 她又把一捆树枝扔进了篝火。

e.en: Villagers tied each {fagot} tightly with rough twine.
e.zh: 村民们用粗绳把每一捆柴紧紧捆好。

fahrenheit.t:
adj. 华氏温标的
n. 华氏度

e.en: Water boils at 212 degrees {fahrenheit} at sea level.
e.zh: 水在海平面上沸点为华氏 212 度。

e.en: Americans usually report temperatures in {fahrenheit}, not Celsius.
e.zh: 美国人报温度通常用华氏度,而不是摄氏度。

e.en: The museum displays colorful {faience} pottery from ancient Egypt.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自古埃及的彩色釉陶。

e.en: She collects antique French {faience} plates from flea markets.
e.zh: 她在跳蚤市场收集古老的法国釉陶盘。

fail.t:
v. 失败；未通过
n. 不及格

e.en: Don't be afraid to {fail} when learning something new.
e.zh: 学新东西时别怕失败。

e.en: The brakes can {fail} if you don't service the car.
e.zh: 如果不保养车辆,刹车可能会失灵。

fail-safe.t: adj. 故障安全的；万无一失的

e.en: The reactor has a {fail-safe} system that shuts it down.
e.zh: 反应堆配有一套故障自动关闭的安全系统。

e.en: Always keep a {fail-safe} backup of your important files.
e.zh: 重要文件一定要留一份万无一失的备份。

e.en: The startup {failed} after running out of cash last year.
e.zh: 那家初创公司去年因为资金断裂倒闭了。

e.en: He {failed} the driving test on his first attempt.
e.zh: 他第一次考驾照没通过。

failing.t:
n. 缺点；弱点
prep. 如果没有

e.en: His main {failing} is that he never admits mistakes.
e.zh: 他最大的毛病就是从不认错。

e.en: The student is {failing} math and needs a tutor.
e.zh: 那个学生数学快不及格了,需要请家教。

e.en: Her wedding gown was sewn from cream silk {faille}.
e.zh: 她的婚纱是用奶白色丝罗缎缝制的。

e.en: The designer chose {faille} for its elegant ribbed texture.
e.zh: 设计师选用罗缎,正是看中它优雅的横纹质感。

fails.t: v. 失败（fail 的第三人称单数）

e.en: If the upload {fails}, just refresh the page and retry.
e.zh: 如果上传失败,刷新页面重试一下就行。

e.en: She never {fails} to call her mother on Sunday.
e.zh: 她每个星期天都从不忘记给妈妈打电话。

failsafe.t: adj. 故障安全的（fail-safe 变体）

e.en: The app has a {failsafe} that auto-saves your work.
e.zh: 这款应用设有自动保存的安全保障机制。

e.en: Engineers designed a {failsafe} mode for the elevator.
e.zh: 工程师为电梯设计了一种安全保护模式。

e.en: Hard drive {failure} caused us to lose a week of work.
e.zh: 硬盘故障让我们丢了一周的工作成果。

e.en: Don't see the rejection as a personal {failure}.
e.zh: 别把这次被拒看作个人的失败。

e.en: Early {failures} taught the team how to ship faster.
e.zh: 早期的几次失败让团队学会了如何更快地交付产品。

e.en: Repeated server {failures} frustrated users all weekend.
e.zh: 服务器反复宕机让用户整个周末都很恼火。

e.en: I would {fain} stay longer, but the train leaves soon.
e.zh: 我倒乐意多待一会儿,可火车马上就开了。

e.en: He was {fain} to accept any help offered.
e.zh: 他乐于接受任何提供给他的帮助。

faint.t:
adj. 微弱的；模糊的
v. 晕倒

e.en: There was a {faint} smell of coffee in the kitchen.
e.zh: 厨房里飘着一丝淡淡的咖啡香。

e.en: She nearly {faint} at the sight of blood.
e.zh: 看到血她差点晕了过去。

fainted.t: v. 晕倒（faint 的过去式）

e.en: He {fainted} from the heat during the marathon.
e.zh: 他在马拉松途中因高温昏倒了。

e.en: Several fans {fainted} when the pop star appeared onstage.
e.zh: 那位流行歌星一登台,好几个粉丝当场晕了过去。

e.en: This roller coaster is not for the {fainthearted}.
e.zh: 这台过山车可不是给胆小者玩的。

e.en: Starting your own business is no job for the {fainthearted}.
e.zh: 自己创业可不是胆小怕事的人能干的活。

fainting.t:
n. 晕厥
adj. 将要昏倒的

e.en: The hot weather left several runners {fainting} near the finish line.
e.zh: 炎热的天气让好几位选手在终点附近昏倒。

e.en: She felt {fainting} spells after skipping breakfast all week.
e.zh: 整周不吃早餐后,她出现了头晕欲倒的症状。

e.en: The music played {faintly} from the apartment upstairs.
e.zh: 楼上公寓隐约传来音乐声。

e.en: He smiled {faintly} when he heard the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息时,他淡淡地笑了一下。

e.en: The {faintness} of the signal made the call drop repeatedly.
e.zh: 信号微弱导致通话不断中断。

e.en: She felt a sudden {faintness} and sat down on the bench.
e.zh: 她突然感到一阵眩晕,便坐到了长椅上。

faints.t: v. 晕倒（faint 的第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {faints} at the sight of blood.
e.zh: 他一看到血就会晕倒。

e.en: The patient {faints} whenever standing up too quickly.
e.zh: 这位病人每次站得太快都会晕过去。

fair.t:
adj. 公平的；相当的
n. 集市；博览会

e.en: The referee made a {fair} call despite the crowd's reaction.
e.zh: 尽管观众有意见,裁判还是做出了公正的判罚。

e.en: We took the kids to the county {fair} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们带孩子去了县里的集市。

fairbanks.t: n. 费尔班克斯（阿拉斯加城市；姓氏）

e.en: Winter temperatures in {Fairbanks} often drop below minus forty.
e.zh: 费尔班克斯的冬季气温常常降到零下四十度以下。

e.en: We flew to {Fairbanks} to see the northern lights.
e.zh: 我们飞到费尔班克斯去看北极光。

e.en: {Fairchild} Semiconductor played a key role in Silicon Valley's history.
e.zh: 仙童半导体在硅谷历史上扮演了关键角色。

e.en: Morgan {Fairchild} was a popular television actress in the 1980s.
e.zh: 摩根·费尔柴尔德是1980年代很受欢迎的电视女演员。

faire.t: n. 复古集市（多用于 Renaissance faire）

e.en: We dressed in costumes for the Renaissance {faire} downtown.
e.zh: 我们穿着戏服去市中心参加文艺复兴主题集市。

e.en: The medieval {faire} featured jousting and live music.
e.zh: 中世纪主题集市上有马上长枪比武和现场音乐。

fairfax.t: n. 费尔法克斯（姓氏/地名）

e.en: She rented an apartment in {Fairfax} County last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天她在费尔法克斯县租了一套公寓。

e.en: The meeting was held at the {Fairfax} courthouse downtown.
e.zh: 会议在市中心的费尔法克斯法院举行。

fairfield.t: n. 费尔菲尔德（姓氏/地名）

e.en: The company opened a new office in {Fairfield} last month.
e.zh: 公司上个月在费尔菲尔德开设了新办公室。

e.en: {Fairfield} University is located in southern Connecticut.
e.zh: 费尔菲尔德大学位于康涅狄格州南部。

fairground.t: n. 露天集市；游乐场地

e.en: The {fairground} was packed with families on opening day.
e.zh: 开幕日那天游乐场挤满了一家家来玩的人。

e.en: They set up the concert stage at the old {fairground}.
e.zh: 他们在旧的露天集市场地搭起了演唱会舞台。

e.en: The children believed {fairies} lived at the bottom of the garden.
e.zh: 孩子们相信花园尽头住着仙女。

e.en: The book is full of pictures of {fairies} and dragons.
e.zh: 这本书里满是仙女和巨龙的插图。

fairing.t: n. 整流罩（车辆/飞机外壳）

e.en: The motorcycle's {fairing} cracked in the minor accident.
e.zh: 那辆摩托车的整流罩在小事故中裂开了。

e.en: The new aerodynamic {fairing} reduced fuel consumption significantly.
e.zh: 新的空气动力学整流罩大幅降低了油耗。

e.en: He earns a {fairish} salary as a freelance designer.
e.zh: 作为自由设计师,他的收入还算不错。

e.en: There's a {fairish} chance of rain this afternoon.
e.zh: 今天下午下雨的可能性还挺大的。

e.en: The teacher tries to treat all students {fairly}.
e.zh: 这位老师努力公平地对待每一位学生。

e.en: The new restaurant is {fairly} popular with younger customers.
e.zh: 这家新餐厅在年轻顾客中相当受欢迎。

e.en: In {fairness}, the manager wasn't told about the change.
e.zh: 说句公道话,经理并没有被告知这个变动。

e.en: Employees demanded greater {fairness} in the promotion process.
e.zh: 员工们要求晋升流程更加公平。

fairnesses.t: n. 公平（fairness 的复数，罕用）

e.en: The judges weighed competing {fairnesses} when designing the new rules.
e.zh: 法官们在制定新规则时权衡了不同的公平观念。

e.en: Different cultures define {fairnesses} in very different ways.
e.zh: 不同文化对公平的定义大相径庭。

e.en: Local {fairs} attract thousands of visitors every summer.
e.zh: 当地的集市每年夏天都吸引成千上万的游客。

e.en: Tech {fairs} are great places to network with recruiters.
e.zh: 科技展会是结识招聘人员的好地方。

e.en: His drive landed right in the middle of the {fairway}.
e.zh: 他的开球正好落在球道中央。

e.en: The {fairway} was wet after the morning rain.
e.zh: 清晨的雨过后,球道变得很湿。

fairweather.t: adj. 只能共富贵的；顺境时的

e.en: He turned out to be a {fairweather} friend after I lost my job.
e.zh: 我失业后,他原来只是个酒肉朋友。

e.en: Many {fairweather} fans abandoned the team after the losing season.
e.zh: 球队赛季失利后,许多见风使舵的球迷都弃之而去。

e.en: My daughter dressed up as a {fairy} for Halloween.
e.zh: 我女儿万圣节打扮成了一位仙女。

e.en: He told the children a {fairy} story before bed.
e.zh: 睡前他给孩子们讲了一个童话故事。

e.en: The snow-covered village looked like a {fairyland} at night.
e.zh: 夜晚白雪覆盖的村庄看上去就像仙境一般。

e.en: The theme park's castle felt like stepping into {fairyland}.
e.zh: 主题公园的城堡让人仿佛走进了童话仙境。

fairytale.t:
n. 童话故事
adj. 童话般的

e.en: Their wedding was like something out of a {fairytale}.
e.zh: 他们的婚礼就像童话故事里的场景。

e.en: She read her son a {fairytale} every night before bed.
e.zh: 她每晚睡前都给儿子讲一个童话故事。

fait.t: n. 既成事实（多用于 fait accompli）

e.en: The merger was presented to shareholders as a {fait} accompli.
e.zh: 这次合并是作为既成事实呈现给股东的。

e.en: By the time we arrived, the decision was a {fait} accompli.
e.zh: 等我们到的时候,决定已经是既成事实了。

e.en: I have complete {faith} in your ability to handle this project.
e.zh: 我对你处理好这个项目的能力充满信心。

e.en: Her religious {faith} helped her through difficult times.
e.zh: 她的宗教信仰帮助她度过了艰难的时光。

e.en: He remained {faithful} to his wife throughout their marriage.
e.zh: 他在整段婚姻中始终对妻子忠诚。

e.en: The movie is a {faithful} adaptation of the original novel.
e.zh: 这部电影是原著小说的忠实改编。

e.en: She has served the company {faithfully} for thirty years.
e.zh: 她已忠心耿耿地为公司服务了三十年。

e.en: The translator rendered the poem {faithfully} into English.
e.zh: 译者忠实地把这首诗翻译成了英文。

e.en: The dog's {faithfulness} touched everyone in the family.
e.zh: 那条狗的忠诚打动了全家人。

e.en: Critics praised the film's {faithfulness} to the source material.
e.zh: 评论界称赞这部电影忠实于原著。

e.en: The novel tells the story of a {faithless} husband and his regrets.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位不忠丈夫和他的悔恨。

e.en: A {faithless} elector voted against the state's chosen candidate.
e.zh: 一位失信的选举人没有投给本州指定的候选人。

e.en: His {faithlessness} eventually destroyed the marriage.
e.zh: 他的不忠最终毁掉了这段婚姻。

e.en: The party expelled the senator for his {faithlessness} to its principles.
e.zh: 党派因这位参议员背离原则而将他开除。

fake.t:
adj. 假的；伪造的
v. 伪造；假装

e.en: The handbag turned out to be a {fake} from a street market.
e.zh: 那个手提包原来是街边市场买的假货。

e.en: Don't {fake} a smile if you're not really happy.
e.zh: 如果你并不开心,就别强装笑脸。

faked.t:
adj. 伪造的
v. fake 的过去式

e.en: He {faked} an injury to get out of practice.
e.zh: 他装病装伤,好不去训练。

e.en: Investigators discovered the documents had been {faked}.
e.zh: 调查人员发现这些文件是伪造的。

e.en: Everyone in the office knew he was a {faker}.
e.zh: 办公室里所有人都知道他是个装模作样的人。

e.en: The jeweler exposed the gem as a {faker} within seconds.
e.zh: 珠宝商几秒钟就识破那颗宝石是赝品。

e.en: The documentary exposed the {fakery} behind reality TV shows.
e.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了真人秀节目背后的造假。

e.en: Critics dismissed his apology as pure {fakery}.
e.zh: 评论人士斥责他的道歉纯属做戏。

faking.t: v. 伪造；假装（fake 的现在分词）

e.en: Stop {faking} sick — I know you want to skip school.
e.zh: 别再装病了,我知道你只是想逃课。

e.en: He admitted to {faking} the test results to please his boss.
e.zh: 他承认为了讨好老板而伪造了测试结果。

e.en: The {fakir} sat motionless on a bed of nails for hours.
e.zh: 那位苦行僧在钉床上一动不动地坐了好几个小时。

e.en: Travelers in old India often wrote about meeting a {fakir}.
e.zh: 早年游历印度的旅人常常记述遇见苦行僧的经历。

falafel.t: n. 法拉费（中东炸豆丸）

e.en: I ordered a {falafel} wrap with extra hummus for lunch.
e.zh: 我午餐点了一份炸鹰嘴豆饼卷,加了双份鹰嘴豆泥。

e.en: This street vendor makes the best {falafel} in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 这家街边摊做的炸鹰嘴豆饼是附近最好吃的。

falangist.t: n. 长枪党党员（西班牙）

e.en: The {Falangist} movement supported Franco during the Spanish Civil War.
e.zh: 长枪党运动在西班牙内战期间支持佛朗哥。

e.en: Her grandfather was a former {Falangist} who later renounced the party.
e.zh: 她祖父曾是长枪党人,后来公开退党。

e.en: The trained {falcon} returned to its handler's gloved arm.
e.zh: 训练有素的猎鹰飞回了驯鹰人戴着手套的手臂上。

e.en: SpaceX launched another {Falcon} 9 rocket this morning.
e.zh: SpaceX今早又发射了一枚猎鹰9号火箭。

e.en: The {falconer} whistled and the bird returned instantly.
e.zh: 驯鹰人吹了一声口哨,鹰立刻飞了回来。

e.en: She trained for years to become a licensed {falconer}.
e.zh: 她训练了多年才成为一名持证的驯鹰人。

e.en: {Falconry} has been practiced in Central Asia for thousands of years.
e.zh: 驯鹰术在中亚已经流传了数千年。

e.en: He took up {falconry} as a hobby after retiring.
e.zh: 退休后他把驯鹰术当作了一项爱好。

falcons.t: n. falcon 的复数；猎鹰队

e.en: The Atlanta {Falcons} lost a close game on Sunday.
e.zh: 亚特兰大猎鹰队在周日的比赛中以微弱差距落败。

e.en: Peregrine {falcons} can dive at over two hundred miles per hour.
e.zh: 游隼俯冲时速可超过两百英里。

falkirk.t: n. 福尔柯克（苏格兰城市）

e.en: The {Falkirk} Wheel is an engineering marvel in Scotland.
e.zh: 福尔柯克轮是苏格兰一项工程奇迹。

e.en: They drove from Edinburgh to {Falkirk} in under an hour.
e.zh: 他们从爱丁堡开车到福尔柯克用了不到一小时。

e.en: A British task force sailed to defend the {Falkland} Islands in 1982.
e.zh: 1982年英国特遣舰队出航保卫福克兰群岛。

e.en: Penguins are a common sight along the {Falkland} coastline.
e.zh: 在福克兰群岛海岸线上,企鹅是常见的景象。

e.en: The {Falklands} War lasted just over two months.
e.zh: 福克兰群岛战争只持续了两个多月。

e.en: Tourism to the {Falklands} has grown steadily in recent years.
e.zh: 近年来,前往福克兰群岛的旅游业稳步增长。

fall.t:
v. 掉落；下降
n. 秋天；跌落

e.en: Be careful not to {fall} on the wet floor.
e.zh: 小心别在湿地板上摔倒。

e.en: The leaves turn bright red every {fall}.
e.zh: 每到秋天,树叶都会变成鲜红色。

e.en: His argument is full of logical {fallacies}.
e.zh: 他的论证里充满了逻辑谬误。

e.en: The book exposes common {fallacies} about healthy eating.
e.zh: 这本书揭穿了关于健康饮食的常见误区。

e.en: The lawyer dismissed the witness's {fallacious} reasoning.
e.zh: 律师驳回了证人那站不住脚的推理。

e.en: It is {fallacious} to assume correlation always implies causation.
e.zh: 认为相关性必然意味着因果关系是错误的。

e.en: It's a common {fallacy} that lightning never strikes twice.
e.zh: 认为闪电不会两次击中同一地方是个常见的谬误。

e.en: The sunk-cost {fallacy} keeps people in bad investments.
e.zh: 沉没成本谬误让人们继续坚守在糟糕的投资上。

e.en: The app uses cached data as a {fallback} when offline.
e.zh: 离线时,这个应用会使用缓存数据作为备选方案。

e.en: Always have a {fallback} plan in case the deal falls through.
e.zh: 万一交易告吹,一定要有备用方案。

fallen.t:
adj. 坠落的；阵亡的
v. fall 的过去分词

e.en: A {fallen} tree blocked the entire road after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后一棵倒下的树挡住了整条路。

e.en: He helped the {fallen} runner back to her feet.
e.zh: 他扶起了那位摔倒的跑步者。

e.en: The skier was a heavy {faller} during today's race.
e.zh: 那位滑雪者在今天的比赛中摔得很厉害。

e.en: Tech stocks were the biggest {faller} on the market today.
e.zh: 科技股是今天市场上跌幅最大的板块。

e.en: The judge admitted the {fallibility} of human memory in court.
e.zh: 法官在法庭上承认了人类记忆的不可靠性。

e.en: Good scientists accept the {fallibility} of their own theories.
e.zh: 优秀的科学家会承认自己理论可能出错。

e.en: Even experts are {fallible} when predicting the stock market.
e.zh: 即使是专家在预测股市时也会出错。

e.en: Spell-check is useful but still {fallible} with proper nouns.
e.zh: 拼写检查很有用,但对专有名词仍可能出错。

falling.t:
v. 下降（fall 的现在分词）
adj. 下落的

e.en: Snow was {falling} gently outside the cabin window.
e.zh: 雪花在小屋窗外轻轻飘落。

e.en: Housing prices have been {falling} for three months straight.
e.zh: 房价已经连续三个月下跌。

e.en: The doctor explained how the {fallopian} tubes function during ovulation.
e.zh: 医生解释了输卵管在排卵期的作用。

e.en: She had surgery to repair a blocked {fallopian} tube.
e.zh: 她做了手术来修复堵塞的输卵管。

fallout.t: n. 负面后果；放射性尘埃

e.en: The political {fallout} from the scandal lasted for years.
e.zh: 这场丑闻的政治余波持续了好几年。

e.en: Residents feared radioactive {fallout} after the reactor leak.
e.zh: 反应堆泄漏后居民担心放射性尘埃。

e.en: Farmers leave fields {fallow} to restore soil nutrients.
e.zh: 农民让土地休耕以恢复土壤养分。

e.en: After a {fallow} period, the artist returned with new work.
e.zh: 经过一段沉寂期后,这位艺术家带着新作回归。

falls.t:
n. 瀑布
v. fall 的第三人称单数

e.en: Niagara {Falls} attracts millions of tourists every year.
e.zh: 尼亚加拉瀑布每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: My birthday {falls} on a Saturday this year.
e.zh: 今年我的生日恰好在星期六。

e.en: We sailed into {Falmouth} harbour just before sunset.
e.zh: 我们在日落前驶入了法尔茅斯港。

e.en: {Falmouth} is a charming coastal town in Cornwall.
e.zh: 法尔茅斯是康沃尔郡一座迷人的海滨小镇。

false.t: adj. 假的；错误的；虚伪的

e.en: The rumor turned out to be completely {false}.
e.zh: 那个传言最终被证实完全是假的。

e.en: Please mark each statement as true or {false}.
e.zh: 请将每个陈述标为对或错。

e.en: The article was full of {falsehood} and misleading claims.
e.zh: 那篇文章充满了谎言和误导性说法。

e.en: He was caught spreading {falsehood} about his coworker.
e.zh: 他被发现在散布关于同事的谎言。

e.en: He was {falsely} accused of stealing from the office.
e.zh: 他被冤枉说从办公室偷东西。

e.en: The product was {falsely} advertised as completely organic.
e.zh: 该产品被虚假宣传为完全有机。

e.en: You could sense the {falseness} in her cheerful smile.
e.zh: 你能感觉到她那灿烂笑容中的虚伪。

e.en: The {falseness} of his promises became obvious over time.
e.zh: 他承诺的虚假随着时间推移变得显而易见。

e.en: The singer hit a stunning {falsetto} note in the chorus.
e.zh: 歌手在副歌中飙出了惊艳的假音。

e.en: He sang the high parts in a clear {falsetto}.
e.zh: 他用清亮的假声唱高音部分。

falsifiable.t: adj. 可证伪的；可被推翻的

e.en: A scientific theory must be {falsifiable} through experiment.
e.zh: 科学理论必须能通过实验被证伪。

e.en: Vague predictions are not {falsifiable} and lack scientific value.
e.zh: 模糊的预测无法被证伪,缺乏科学价值。

falsification.t:
n. 证伪；篡改
n. 伪造行为

e.en: He was fired for {falsification} of company financial records.
e.zh: 他因伪造公司财务记录而被解雇。

e.en: Popper argued that {falsification} defines real science.
e.zh: 波普尔认为可证伪性定义了真正的科学。

e.en: From a {falsificationist} view, untestable claims aren't science.
e.zh: 从证伪主义角度看,无法检验的主张不算科学。

e.en: She took a strict {falsificationist} approach to evaluating theories.
e.zh: 她以严格的证伪主义方法评估理论。

falsified.t:
v. falsify 过去式
adj. 伪造的

e.en: The scientist {falsified} data to get the grant approved.
e.zh: 那位科学家伪造数据以获得资助批准。

e.en: New evidence has {falsified} the long-held hypothesis.
e.zh: 新证据推翻了那个长期被接受的假设。

falsify.t:
v. 伪造；篡改
v. 证伪

e.en: It's a serious crime to {falsify} medical records.
e.zh: 伪造病历是一项严重的犯罪。

e.en: One counterexample is enough to {falsify} the claim.
e.zh: 一个反例就足以推翻这个说法。

e.en: The {falsity} of his alibi was easy to prove.
e.zh: 他不在场证明的虚假性很容易被证明。

e.en: Researchers exposed the {falsity} of the viral health claim.
e.zh: 研究人员揭穿了那则疯传的健康说法的虚假性。

falstaff.t: n. 福斯塔夫（莎剧人物）

e.en: {Falstaff} remains one of Shakespeare's most beloved comic characters.
e.zh: 福斯塔夫仍是莎士比亚笔下最受喜爱的喜剧人物之一。

e.en: The actor played {Falstaff} with warmth and wicked humor.
e.zh: 演员把福斯塔夫演得亲切又狡黠幽默。

falter.t:
v. 动摇；踌躇
v. 蹒跚；结巴

e.en: Her voice began to {falter} as she read the letter.
e.zh: 读那封信时她的声音开始颤抖。

e.en: Sales started to {falter} after the new competitor arrived.
e.zh: 新竞争对手出现后销售开始疲软。

e.en: He {faltered} for a moment before answering the question.
e.zh: 他在回答问题前迟疑了一下。

e.en: The economy {faltered} during the second quarter of the year.
e.zh: 经济在今年第二季度出现疲软。

e.en: She spoke in a {faltering} voice during the eulogy.
e.zh: 她在悼词中用颤抖的声音说话。

e.en: The startup is making {faltering} progress in a tough market.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在艰难市场中进展缓慢。

e.en: He spoke {falteringly} about the loss of his mother.
e.zh: 他断断续续地谈起母亲的去世。

e.en: The child read the passage {falteringly} but with effort.
e.zh: 那孩子结结巴巴但很努力地读完了那段。

falters.t: v. falter 第三人称单数

e.en: Her confidence rarely {falters}, even under intense pressure.
e.zh: 即使在巨大压力下,她的信心也很少动摇。

e.en: The engine {falters} whenever I drive uphill.
e.zh: 每当我开上坡,发动机就会熄火打颤。

fam.t: n. 家人／好兄弟（family 的俚语缩写）

e.en: What's up, {fam}? Long time no see!
e.zh: 咋样啊兄弟?好久不见!

e.en: Going to the concert with the {fam} tonight.
e.zh: 今晚跟一家人去看演唱会。

e.en: She rose to {fame} after her viral TikTok video.
e.zh: 她因一条爆红的 TikTok 视频成名。

e.en: Sudden {fame} can be overwhelming for young actors.
e.zh: 突如其来的名气对年轻演员来说可能令人难以承受。

e.en: The chef is {famed} for his innovative seafood dishes.
e.zh: 这位厨师以创新的海鲜料理而闻名。

e.en: Kyoto is {famed} for its beautiful cherry blossoms.
e.zh: 京都以美丽的樱花而闻名。

familia.t: n. 家庭；家族 (拉丁／西语)

e.en: In Spanish, {familia} means family and includes close relatives.
e.zh: 西班牙语中 familia 意为家庭,包括近亲。

e.en: La Sagrada {Familia} is Barcelona's most famous landmark.
e.zh: 圣家堂是巴塞罗那最著名的地标。

e.en: The disease has a strong {familial} component in our research.
e.zh: 在我们的研究中,这种疾病有很强的家族遗传成分。

e.en: She values {familial} bonds above career achievements.
e.zh: 她把家庭纽带看得比事业成就更重要。

e.en: His face looked oddly {familiar} but I couldn't place him.
e.zh: 他的脸看着莫名眼熟,但我想不起在哪见过。

e.en: Are you {familiar} with how this software works?
e.zh: 你熟悉这个软件的运作方式吗?

familiarisation.t: n. 熟悉；适应 (英式拼写)

e.en: New hires get a week of {familiarisation} with our systems.
e.zh: 新员工有一周时间熟悉我们的系统。

e.en: Pilot {familiarisation} flights are required before solo trips.
e.zh: 飞行员独飞前必须完成熟悉飞行训练。

familiarise.t: v. 使熟悉；使了解 (英式拼写)

e.en: Please {familiarise} yourself with the safety procedures before starting.
e.zh: 开始前请先熟悉一下安全规程。

e.en: The tutorial helps you {familiarise} with the new interface.
e.zh: 教程能帮你熟悉新版界面。

e.en: She {familiarised} herself with the building before her first day.
e.zh: 她在上班第一天前先熟悉了一下办公楼。

e.en: He {familiarised} the team with the updated workflow.
e.zh: 他让团队熟悉了更新后的工作流程。

familiarises.t: v. familiarise 第三人称单数

e.en: This course {familiarises} students with basic coding concepts.
e.zh: 这门课让学生熟悉基本的编程概念。

e.en: The handbook {familiarises} new staff with company policies.
e.zh: 这本手册让新员工熟悉公司政策。

e.en: I'm {familiarising} myself with the codebase this week.
e.zh: 我这周在熟悉这个代码库。

e.en: The orientation focuses on {familiarising} interns with daily routines.
e.zh: 入职培训重点是让实习生熟悉日常工作流程。

familiarity.t:
n. 熟悉；通晓
n. 亲近；随便

e.en: His {familiarity} with the city helped us find shortcuts.
e.zh: 他对这座城市的熟悉帮我们找到了捷径。

e.en: {Familiarity} with Excel is required for this role.
e.zh: 这个职位要求熟悉 Excel。

e.en: The driver completed a track {familiarization} lap before qualifying.
e.zh: 那位车手在排位赛前完成了一圈熟悉赛道的练习。

e.en: Each soldier underwent weapon {familiarization} during basic training.
e.zh: 每名士兵在新兵训练期间都接受了武器熟悉训练。

e.en: Please {familiarize} yourself with the new dashboard layout.
e.zh: 请熟悉一下新的仪表盘布局。

e.en: Reading the docs will {familiarize} you with the API.
e.zh: 读一下文档能让你熟悉这个 API。

e.en: He quickly {familiarized} himself with the team's coding style.
e.zh: 他很快就熟悉了团队的编码风格。

e.en: The guide {familiarized} tourists with local customs and etiquette.
e.zh: 导游让游客熟悉了当地的风俗礼仪。

familiarizes.t: v. familiarize 第三人称单数

e.en: Chapter one {familiarizes} readers with key economic terms.
e.zh: 第一章让读者熟悉了关键的经济术语。

e.en: The onboarding video {familiarizes} new users with the app.
e.zh: 入门视频让新用户熟悉这款应用。

e.en: I'm {familiarizing} myself with the React framework this month.
e.zh: 我这个月在熟悉 React 框架。

e.en: The workshop focuses on {familiarizing} teachers with new tools.
e.zh: 研讨会的重点是让教师熟悉新工具。

e.en: He greeted the waiter {familiarly}, like an old friend.
e.zh: 他像老朋友似的亲切地跟服务员打招呼。

e.en: The dish, {familiarly} known as hot pot, is widely loved.
e.zh: 这道菜俗称火锅,广受喜爱。

e.en: Many {families} gather for dinner during the holidays.
e.zh: 许多家庭在节日里聚在一起吃晚餐。

e.en: Different language {families} share common ancestral roots.
e.zh: 不同的语系拥有共同的祖先根源。

family.t:
n. 家庭；家人
n. 家族；族类

e.en: My whole {family} is coming over for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我全家都要来吃晚饭。

e.en: Lions belong to the cat {family}.
e.zh: 狮子属于猫科动物。

e.en: The drought caused a devastating {famine} across the region.
e.zh: 干旱在该地区引发了毁灭性的饥荒。

e.en: Aid workers rushed food to areas hit by {famine}.
e.zh: 救援人员紧急将食物送往饥荒地区。

e.en: Long marches in the desert can {famish} even seasoned soldiers.
e.zh: 沙漠中的长途行军连老兵都会饿坏。

e.en: Don't {famish} yourself trying to lose weight quickly.
e.zh: 不要为了快速减肥把自己饿坏。

e.en: I'm absolutely {famished} after skipping lunch today.
e.zh: 今天没吃午饭,我现在饿得不行了。

e.en: The hikers arrived at camp tired and {famished}.
e.zh: 徒步者们到达营地时又累又饿。

e.en: She became {famous} after her cooking videos went viral.
e.zh: 她的烹饪视频走红后她就出名了。

e.en: Paris is {famous} for its cafes and museums.
e.zh: 巴黎以咖啡馆和博物馆闻名。

e.en: Steve Jobs {famously} wore the same outfit every day.
e.zh: 众所周知，乔布斯每天都穿同样的衣服。

e.en: The two coworkers got along {famously} from day one.
e.zh: 那两个同事从第一天起就相处得非常融洽。

fan.t:
n. 粉丝；爱好者
n. 风扇

e.en: I'm a huge {fan} of her latest album.
e.zh: 我是她最新专辑的超级粉丝。

e.en: Please turn on the ceiling {fan}, it's hot.
e.zh: 请打开吊扇，太热了。

e.en: My brother is a total fitness {fanatic}.
e.zh: 我哥是个十足的健身狂。

e.en: The website was hacked by a religious {fanatic}.
e.zh: 该网站被一名宗教狂热分子黑掉了。

e.en: He has a {fanatical} devotion to his football team.
e.zh: 他对自己支持的足球队狂热痴迷。

e.en: The startup is {fanatical} about customer service.
e.zh: 那家创业公司极度重视客户服务。

e.en: She trains {fanatically} for the marathon every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上为马拉松狂热地训练。

e.en: Fans cheered {fanatically} when the band took the stage.
e.zh: 乐队登台时，粉丝们狂热地欢呼。

e.en: Online {fanaticism} can quickly turn into harassment.
e.zh: 网络上的狂热很容易演变成骚扰。

e.en: The book examines the roots of political {fanaticism}.
e.zh: 这本书探讨政治狂热的根源。

e.en: K-pop {fanatics} camped outside the venue overnight.
e.zh: K-pop狂热粉丝们在场馆外通宵排队。

e.en: A small group of {fanatics} disrupted the peaceful protest.
e.zh: 一小群狂热分子扰乱了和平抗议活动。

fancied.t:
adj. 想象的；虚构的
v. fancy 过去式

e.en: She always {fancied} herself a great singer.
e.zh: 她一直自认为是个出色的歌手。

e.en: I {fancied} a coffee, so I stopped at the cafe.
e.zh: 我想喝杯咖啡，就在那家咖啡馆停了下来。

fancier.t:
n. 爱好者；玩家
adj. 更花哨 (fancy 比较级)

e.en: This restaurant is much {fancier} than I expected.
e.zh: 这家餐厅比我想象中高档得多。

e.en: He's a serious pigeon {fancier} who breeds champions.
e.zh: 他是个严肃的鸽子爱好者，专门培育冠军鸽。

fancies.t:
n. 爱好；幻想
v. fancy 第三人称单数

e.en: She {fancies} the new guy in marketing.
e.zh: 她喜欢上了市场部新来的那个男生。

e.en: He indulges his {fancies} by collecting vintage watches.
e.zh: 他通过收藏古董手表来满足自己的喜好。

fanciful.t: adj. 异想天开的；奇特的

e.en: The novel features a {fanciful} world of talking animals.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了一个会说话的动物的奇幻世界。

e.en: Her plans sound {fanciful} but rarely become reality.
e.zh: 她的计划听起来异想天开，但很少能实现。

fancifully.t: adv. 异想天开地；别出心裁地

e.en: The cake was {fancifully} decorated with sugar flowers.
e.zh: 蛋糕上奇思妙想地装饰着糖花。

e.en: He {fancifully} described the trip as a magical adventure.
e.zh: 他异想天开地把这次旅行描绘成一场魔法冒险。

fancy.t:
adj. 花哨的；奢华的
v. 想要；喜欢

e.en: Do you {fancy} going out for dinner tonight?
e.zh: 今晚想出去吃饭吗？

e.en: They got married in a {fancy} hotel downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市中心一家豪华酒店举行了婚礼。

fancying.t: v. fancy 的现在分词；想要、喜欢

e.en: I was {fancying} a pizza, so I ordered one.
e.zh: 我当时想吃披萨，就点了一个。

e.en: She kept {fancying} her chances of winning the lottery.
e.zh: 她一直幻想自己能中彩票。

fandango.t: n. 凡丹戈舞（西班牙双人舞）

e.en: The dancers performed a lively Spanish {fandango}.
e.zh: 舞者们表演了一段欢快的西班牙凡丹戈舞。

e.en: Booking flights turned into a complete {fandango}.
e.zh: 订机票完全变成了一场折腾。

e.en: The Marvel {fandom} reacts to every trailer instantly.
e.zh: 漫威粉丝群体对每一支预告片都立刻有反应。

e.en: She found her best friends through K-pop {fandom}.
e.zh: 她通过K-pop粉丝圈结识了最好的朋友。

fanfare.t: n. 嘹亮的号角声；大张旗鼓的宣传

e.en: The new iPhone launched with massive {fanfare}.
e.zh: 新款iPhone在盛大宣传中发布。

e.en: Trumpets played a royal {fanfare} as the queen arrived.
e.zh: 女王到达时，号角奏响皇家礼乐。

e.en: The vampire bared a single sharp {fang}.
e.zh: 那个吸血鬼露出一颗尖利的獠牙。

e.en: The snake's {fang} broke off during the attack.
e.zh: 那条蛇在攻击中折断了一颗毒牙。

e.en: A {fanged} creature appeared in the horror game.
e.zh: 一只长着尖牙的怪物出现在恐怖游戏里。

e.en: The {fanged} mask scared the trick-or-treaters.
e.zh: 那张带尖牙的面具吓到了来要糖的孩子们。

e.en: Sunlight streamed through the antique {fanlight} above the door.
e.zh: 阳光透过门上方那扇古董扇形窗洒了进来。

e.en: The Georgian house features an elegant arched {fanlight}.
e.zh: 这栋乔治式房屋有一扇优雅的拱形扇形窗。

fanned.t: v. fan 的过去式；扇动、煽起

e.en: She {fanned} herself with a magazine in the heat.
e.zh: 她在酷热中用杂志给自己扇风。

e.en: The wind {fanned} the flames into a wildfire.
e.zh: 大风把火苗扇成了一场野火。

e.en: He carries his phone in a {fanny} pack while jogging.
e.zh: 他慢跑时把手机装在腰包里。

e.en: Stop sitting on your {fanny} and help with the dishes.
e.zh: 别坐着不动了，过来帮忙洗碗。

fanon.t: n. 主教披肩（宗教用语）

e.en: Many ship pairings exist only in {fanon}, not canon.
e.zh: 许多CP配对只存在于同人设定里，并非官方设定。

e.en: Tumblr {fanon} often contradicts the original storyline.
e.zh: Tumblr上的同人设定经常和原版剧情相矛盾。

e.en: Taylor Swift's {fans} bought out tickets in minutes.
e.zh: 霉霉的粉丝几分钟内就把票抢光了。

e.en: Both ceiling {fans} stopped working during the heatwave.
e.zh: 两台吊扇都在热浪中坏掉了。

e.en: A {fantail} pigeon strutted across the garden path.
e.zh: 一只扇尾鸽神气地走过花园小径。

e.en: The peacock spread its glorious {fantail} of feathers.
e.zh: 孔雀展开了华丽的扇形尾羽。

e.en: The pianist closed with a Chopin {fantasia}.
e.zh: 钢琴家以肖邦的一首幻想曲作为压轴。

e.en: Disney's {fantasia} pairs classical music with animation.
e.zh: 迪士尼的《幻想曲》将古典音乐与动画相结合。

fantasies.t: n. fantasy 的复数；幻想、空想

e.en: His childhood {fantasies} involved exploring distant planets.
e.zh: 他童年的幻想都是去探索遥远的星球。

e.en: The novel explores the dark {fantasies} of its narrator.
e.zh: 这部小说探索了叙述者内心的阴暗幻想。

fantasise.t: v. 幻想、空想（英式拼法）

e.en: Many people {fantasise} about quitting their jobs and travelling.
e.zh: 很多人幻想辞掉工作去旅行。

e.en: Don't just {fantasise} about success, work for it.
e.zh: 别只是幻想成功，要为之努力。

fantasist.t: n. 爱空想的人；奇幻作品作者

e.en: The con artist was a skilled {fantasist} with a charming smile.
e.zh: 那个骗子是个面带迷人微笑的高明编谎者。

e.en: Tolkien remains the most beloved {fantasist} of the twentieth century.
e.zh: 托尔金仍是二十世纪最受喜爱的奇幻作家。

e.en: I often {fantasize} about living by the ocean.
e.zh: 我常常幻想能住在海边。

e.en: Teenagers {fantasize} about meeting their favorite celebrities.
e.zh: 青少年们幻想着能见到自己喜欢的明星。

fantasized.t: v. fantasize 的过去式；幻想

e.en: As a kid I {fantasized} about becoming an astronaut.
e.zh: 小时候我幻想过当宇航员。

e.en: She {fantasized} about a quiet cottage in the countryside.
e.zh: 她幻想着乡间一栋安静的小屋。

fantastic.t:
adj. 极好的、棒极了
adj. 奇异的、难以置信的

e.en: The new Netflix series is absolutely {fantastic}.
e.zh: 网飞这部新剧简直棒极了。

e.en: We had a {fantastic} time at the beach yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天我们在海边玩得非常开心。

e.en: The film features {fantastical} creatures and floating islands.
e.zh: 这部电影里有奇幻的生物和漂浮的岛屿。

e.en: His {fantastical} stories kept the children spellbound.
e.zh: 他那些奇幻的故事让孩子们听得入了迷。

e.en: The startup grew {fantastically} fast in its first year.
e.zh: 这家创业公司第一年增长得惊人地快。

e.en: She's {fantastically} talented at picking up new languages.
e.zh: 她在学新语言方面有惊人的天赋。

e.en: My favorite genre is epic {fantasy} like Lord of the Rings.
e.zh: 我最爱的题材是《指环王》那样的史诗奇幻。

e.en: Winning the lottery is a common {fantasy}.
e.zh: 中彩票是大家常有的幻想。

fantasyland.t: n. 幻想世界；不切实际之境

e.en: Anyone expecting overnight success is living in {fantasyland}.
e.zh: 指望一夜成功的人都生活在幻想之中。

e.en: The kids couldn't wait to visit {fantasyland} at Disney.
e.zh: 孩子们迫不及待想去迪士尼的幻想世界游玩。

e.en: She publishes a monthly {fanzine} about indie horror films.
e.zh: 她每月出版一本独立恐怖电影的粉丝杂志。

e.en: Old punk {fanzine} issues now sell for hundreds online.
e.zh: 老朋克粉丝杂志现在网上能卖到几百块。

fao.t: n. 联合国粮农组织（缩写）

e.en: The {FAO} reported rising global food prices this quarter.
e.zh: 联合国粮农组织报告称本季度全球粮价上涨。

e.en: Address the parcel {FAO} the marketing director.
e.zh: 包裹请注明由市场总监本人收。

far.t:
adv. 远；遥远地
adj. 遥远的

e.en: How {far} is the nearest subway station from here?
e.zh: 最近的地铁站离这儿有多远？

e.en: This year's harvest is {far} better than last year's.
e.zh: 今年的收成比去年好得多。

e.en: The new privacy law has {far-reaching} consequences for tech companies.
e.zh: 新的隐私法对科技公司影响深远。

e.en: AI will bring {far-reaching} changes to education.
e.zh: 人工智能将给教育带来深远的变革。

faraday.t: n. 法拉第（物理学家；电容单位）

e.en: Phones are blocked inside a {Faraday} cage.
e.zh: 手机信号在法拉第笼内会被屏蔽。

e.en: {Faraday} discovered the principle of electromagnetic induction.
e.zh: 法拉第发现了电磁感应原理。

e.en: She dreams of moving to a {faraway} tropical island.
e.zh: 她梦想搬去一座遥远的热带岛屿。

e.en: He had a {faraway} look in his eyes during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时他眼神里透着一种心不在焉的恍惚。

e.en: The whole election turned into a complete {farce}.
e.zh: 整场选举变成了一场彻底的闹剧。

e.en: The play is a hilarious {farce} about mistaken identities.
e.zh: 这部剧是一出关于身份错认的搞笑闹剧。

e.en: Shakespeare wrote both tragedies and lighthearted {farces}.
e.zh: 莎士比亚既写悲剧也写轻松的闹剧。

e.en: These corporate apologies are just public relations {farces}.
e.zh: 这些企业道歉不过是公关闹剧而已。

farcical.t: adj. 荒唐可笑的；闹剧般的

e.en: The trial became {farcical} when the lawyer fell asleep.
e.zh: 律师睡着后，整场审判变得荒唐可笑。

e.en: Their attempt to fix the bug was almost {farcical}.
e.zh: 他们修复那个bug的尝试几乎成了闹剧。

fare.t:
n. 车费、票价
v. 进展、过活

e.en: The taxi {fare} to the airport was surprisingly cheap.
e.zh: 打车到机场的车费便宜得出乎意料。

e.en: How did the team {fare} in yesterday's tournament?
e.zh: 球队在昨天的比赛中表现如何？

e.en: My cousin lives in {Fareham}, near Portsmouth.
e.zh: 我表弟住在朴次茅斯附近的费勒姆。

e.en: The train to {Fareham} leaves every half hour.
e.zh: 开往费勒姆的火车每半小时一班。

fares.t: n. fare 的复数；车费、票价

e.en: Subway {fares} are going up again next month.
e.zh: 地铁票价下个月又要涨了。

e.en: Discounted {fares} are available for students and seniors.
e.zh: 学生和老人可享受优惠票价。

farewell.t:
int. 再见
n. 告别

e.en: The team threw a small {farewell} party for their manager.
e.zh: 团队为经理办了一个小小的欢送会。

e.en: She waved {farewell} as the train pulled away.
e.zh: 火车开动时她挥手告别。

e.en: The captain said his {farewells} before boarding the ship.
e.zh: 船长在登船前一一道别。

e.en: Graduation day is full of tearful {farewells} and hugs.
e.zh: 毕业日满是含泪的告别和拥抱。

farfetched.t: adj. 牵强的；不大可信的

e.en: His excuse for being late sounded completely {farfetched}.
e.zh: 他迟到的借口听起来太牵强了。

e.en: The plot of that movie is a bit {farfetched}.
e.zh: 那部电影的情节有点离谱。

e.en: We stopped for lunch in {Faringdon} on our way west.
e.zh: 我们西行途中在法林登停下来吃午饭。

e.en: {Faringdon} is a small market town in Oxfordshire.
e.zh: 法林登是牛津郡的一个小集镇。

farm.t:
n. 农场
v. 耕种；饲养

e.en: My grandparents own a small {farm} in the countryside.
e.zh: 我的祖父母在乡下有一个小农场。

e.en: The company runs a server {farm} outside the city.
e.zh: 这家公司在城外运营着一个服务器集群。

farmed.t:
adj. 养殖的、人工饲养的
v. farm 的过去式

e.en: This salmon was {farmed} responsibly in Norway.
e.zh: 这条三文鱼是在挪威以可持续方式养殖的。

e.en: Her family has {farmed} this land for generations.
e.zh: 她家世代在这片土地上耕作。

e.en: The {farmer} woke up before sunrise to feed the cows.
e.zh: 农夫天没亮就起来喂牛。

e.en: I bought fresh tomatoes from a local {farmer} yesterday.
e.zh: 我昨天从当地农户那里买了新鲜番茄。

e.en: Local {farmers} sell produce at the weekend market.
e.zh: 当地农户在周末集市上卖农产品。

e.en: The drought has hit {farmers} across the region hard.
e.zh: 干旱重创了该地区的农民。

e.en: He worked as a {farmhand} during summer break.
e.zh: 他暑假期间在农场打零工。

e.en: The ranch hired another {farmhand} to help with harvest.
e.zh: 牧场又雇了一个农场工人帮忙收割。

e.en: They renovated an old stone {farmhouse} in Tuscany.
e.zh: 他们翻新了托斯卡纳一栋古老的石砌农舍。

e.en: The {farmhouse} kitchen smelled of fresh bread.
e.zh: 农舍的厨房里飘着新鲜面包的香味。

e.en: Organic {farming} has become more popular in recent years.
e.zh: 近年来有机农业越来越受欢迎。

e.en: He gave up a city job for {farming} full time.
e.zh: 他放弃了城里的工作,全职务农。

e.en: The report compares different {farmings} across Asia.
e.zh: 这份报告比较了亚洲各地不同的耕作方式。

e.en: Traditional {farmings} are slowly disappearing in this region.
e.zh: 传统的农耕方式在该地区正逐渐消失。

e.en: Acres of {farmland} stretch out beyond the highway.
e.zh: 高速公路外延伸着大片农田。

e.en: Rising sea levels threaten coastal {farmland}.
e.zh: 海平面上升威胁着沿海农田。

e.en: The flood destroyed thousands of hectares of {farmlands}.
e.zh: 洪水摧毁了数千公顷的农田。

e.en: Vast {farmlands} surround the small village.
e.zh: 广阔的农田环绕着这个小村庄。

farms.t:
n. 农场（复数）
v. 耕种

e.en: Many small {farms} struggle to compete with big agribusiness.
e.zh: 许多小农场难以与大型农业公司竞争。

e.en: Wind {farms} now dot the hills along the coast.
e.zh: 风力发电场如今点缀在沿海的群山之间。

farmstead.t: n. 农庄；农舍及附属土地

e.en: The old {farmstead} has been in the family for centuries.
e.zh: 这座古老的农庄已经在这个家族传了几个世纪。

e.en: A small chapel stood next to the {farmstead}.
e.zh: 一座小教堂矗立在农庄旁边。

e.en: Each {farmworker} earns a fair wage on this organic farm.
e.zh: 在这个有机农场,每个农场工人都拿到合理的工资。

e.en: The documentary follows a migrant {farmworker} for a year.
e.zh: 这部纪录片跟拍了一名外来农场工人一年。

e.en: Chickens scratched around in the muddy {farmyard}.
e.zh: 鸡在泥泞的农家院子里到处刨食。

e.en: The kids loved playing in the {farmyard} after school.
e.zh: 孩子们放学后喜欢在农家院子里玩。

farnborough.t: n. 法恩伯勒（英国地名）

e.en: The {Farnborough} Airshow attracts aviation fans every two years.
e.zh: 范堡罗航展每两年吸引一次航空迷。

e.en: She grew up in {Farnborough}, just south of London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦南部的范堡罗长大。

e.en: {Farnham} is known for its charming Georgian architecture.
e.zh: 法纳姆以其迷人的乔治王朝风格建筑闻名。

e.en: We took a day trip to {Farnham} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们去法纳姆一日游。

e.en: Our flight to {Faro} lands in the early afternoon.
e.zh: 我们飞往法鲁的航班在下午早些时候降落。

e.en: He lost a fortune playing {faro} in old Western saloons.
e.zh: 他在西部老酒馆玩法罗牌输掉了一大笔钱。

e.en: The article was a {farrago} of half-truths and rumors.
e.zh: 这篇文章是一堆半真半假的话和谣言的大杂烩。

e.en: His speech turned into a {farrago} of unrelated ideas.
e.zh: 他的演讲变成了一堆毫不相干的想法的杂烩。

e.en: The {farrier} carefully fitted new shoes on the horse.
e.zh: 蹄铁匠仔细地给马钉上新蹄铁。

e.en: Becoming a skilled {farrier} takes years of training.
e.zh: 成为熟练的钉蹄匠需要多年的训练。

farrow.t:
v. (母猪) 产仔
n. 一窝小猪

e.en: The sow is expected to {farrow} a large litter this spring.
e.zh: 这头母猪预计今年春天会产下一大窝小猪。

e.en: The farmer prepared a clean pen for the {farrow}.
e.zh: 农夫为这窝仔猪准备了干净的猪圈。

farsi.t: n. 波斯语（伊朗官方语言）

e.en: She learned {Farsi} to read classical Persian poetry.
e.zh: 她学波斯语是为了读古典波斯诗歌。

e.en: Many people in Iran speak {Farsi} as their first language.
e.zh: 伊朗很多人以波斯语为母语。

e.en: The {farside} of the moon was first photographed in 1959.
e.zh: 月球背面在1959年被首次拍摄到。

e.en: China landed a probe on the {farside} of the moon.
e.zh: 中国在月球背面着陆了一个探测器。

farsighted.t:
adj. 有远见的
adj. 远视的

e.en: My grandfather is {farsighted} and needs reading glasses.
e.zh: 我爷爷是远视眼,需要戴老花镜。

e.en: She made a {farsighted} investment that paid off years later.
e.zh: 她做了一项有远见的投资,多年后获得了回报。

e.en: {Farsightedness} often becomes more noticeable after age forty.
e.zh: 远视通常在四十岁后变得更明显。

e.en: His {farsightedness} as a leader saved the company.
e.zh: 他作为领导者的远见拯救了公司。

e.en: The kids giggled when someone let out a loud {fart}.
e.zh: 有人放了个响屁,孩子们都笑了。

e.en: Beans tend to make people {fart} more than usual.
e.zh: 豆子往往会让人比平时放更多屁。

farther.t:
adv. 更远地
adj. 更远的

e.en: The next gas station is {farther} down the highway.
e.zh: 下一个加油站在高速公路更远处。

e.en: We hiked {farther} into the forest than planned.
e.zh: 我们徒步进入森林的距离比计划的更远。

farthest.t:
adv. 最远地
adj. 最远的

e.en: Pluto is one of the {farthest} known objects in our solar system.
e.zh: 冥王星是我们太阳系中已知最远的天体之一。

e.en: He threw the ball the {farthest} of anyone on the team.
e.zh: 他把球扔得比队里任何人都远。

e.en: In old England, a {farthing} was worth a quarter of a penny.
e.zh: 在旧时英国,一法寻值四分之一便士。

e.en: The beggar didn't have a single {farthing} to his name.
e.zh: 那个乞丐身上一个铜板都没有。

e.en: The dog kept {farting} during the entire car ride.
e.zh: 那只狗一路坐车都在放屁。

e.en: Everyone laughed at the {farting} sound effect in the movie.
e.zh: 电影里的放屁音效让大家都笑了。

fascia.t:
n. 筋膜（解剖）
n. 面板；饰板

e.en: Foam rolling helps loosen tight {fascia} after workouts.
e.zh: 用泡沫轴有助于放松锻炼后紧绷的筋膜。

e.en: The shop's wooden {fascia} gives it a vintage charm.
e.zh: 店铺的木制门楣招牌带着复古的魅力。

e.en: The therapist used {fascial} release to ease his back pain.
e.zh: 治疗师用筋膜松解法缓解了他的背痛。

e.en: Chronic tension can cause {fascial} restrictions in the body.
e.zh: 慢性紧张会导致体内筋膜受限。

fascicle.t:
n. 神经/肌纤维束
n. (书的) 分册

e.en: Each muscle is made up of bundles called a {fascicle}.
e.zh: 每块肌肉都由称为肌束的一束束组成。

e.en: The first {fascicle} of the encyclopedia was published in 1751.
e.zh: 该百科全书的第一分册于1751年出版。

e.en: Plantar {fasciitis} causes sharp heel pain in the morning.
e.zh: 足底筋膜炎会让人早上脚后跟剧痛。

e.en: Runners are especially prone to plantar {fasciitis}.
e.zh: 跑步者特别容易得足底筋膜炎。

e.en: Black holes continue to {fascinate} scientists worldwide.
e.zh: 黑洞持续吸引着全世界科学家的兴趣。

e.en: Magic tricks always {fascinate} young children.
e.zh: 魔术总能让小孩子着迷。

e.en: She was {fascinated} by the documentary on deep sea creatures.
e.zh: 她被那部关于深海生物的纪录片深深吸引。

e.en: The toddler watched the fish, completely {fascinated}.
e.zh: 那小孩看着鱼,完全入了迷。

fascinates.t: v. 使着迷（第三人称单数）

e.en: The history of ancient Egypt {fascinates} her endlessly.
e.zh: 古埃及的历史让她着迷不已。

e.en: What really {fascinates} me is how birds navigate so accurately.
e.zh: 真正让我着迷的是鸟类如何准确导航。

e.en: The book offers a {fascinating} look at urban wildlife.
e.zh: 这本书对城市野生动物进行了有趣的探究。

e.en: I had a {fascinating} conversation with a retired astronaut.
e.zh: 我和一位退休宇航员进行了一次引人入胜的对话。

e.en: The lecture was {fascinatingly} detailed and well-researched.
e.zh: 这场讲座细节丰富,研究扎实,引人入胜。

e.en: {Fascinatingly}, octopuses can solve puzzles to get food.
e.zh: 令人着迷的是,章鱼能解开谜题以获取食物。

e.en: Her {fascination} with space began in childhood.
e.zh: 她对太空的着迷始于童年。

e.en: The world's {fascination} with AI keeps growing every year.
e.zh: 全世界对人工智能的兴趣每年都在增长。

e.en: His childhood {fascinations} included dinosaurs and trains.
e.zh: 他童年的兴趣包括恐龙和火车。

e.en: We all have our own little {fascinations} and hobbies.
e.zh: 我们每个人都有自己的小爱好和兴趣。

e.en: The novel warns about the dangers of rising {fascism}.
e.zh: 这部小说警示了法西斯主义抬头的危险。

e.en: Many countries fought against {fascism} during World War II.
e.zh: 许多国家在二战期间与法西斯主义作斗争。

fascist.t:
n. 法西斯分子
adj. 法西斯的

e.en: The {fascist} regime censored newspapers and silenced critics.
e.zh: 那个法西斯政权审查报纸,压制批评者。

e.en: He wrote a powerful book exposing {fascist} propaganda.
e.zh: 他写了一本有力揭露法西斯宣传的书。

e.en: Critics described the new policy as {fascistic} in nature.
e.zh: 批评者称这项新政策本质上具有法西斯色彩。

e.en: The film depicts a {fascistic} dystopia of the near future.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了一个近未来的法西斯式反乌托邦。

fashion.t:
n. 时尚；潮流
v. 制作；塑造

e.en: Paris {fashion} week showcases next season's hottest trends.
e.zh: 巴黎时装周展示下一季最热门的潮流。

e.en: He completed the project in a methodical {fashion}.
e.zh: 他以有条不紊的方式完成了这个项目。

e.en: Bucket hats have become {fashionable} again this summer.
e.zh: 渔夫帽今年夏天又流行起来了。

e.en: Plant-based diets are increasingly {fashionable} among young people.
e.zh: 植物性饮食在年轻人中越来越流行。

e.en: She arrived {fashionably} late to the party.
e.zh: 她赶时髦地姗姗来迟出席派对。

e.en: The café was {fashionably} decorated with vintage furniture.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆用复古家具装饰得很时髦。

e.en: The artist {fashioned} a sculpture from scrap metal.
e.zh: 那位艺术家用废金属做出了一座雕塑。

e.en: My grandmother prefers old-{fashioned} recipes from her childhood.
e.zh: 我奶奶更喜欢她童年时的老式食谱。

e.en: She is {fashioning} a necklace from old coins.
e.zh: 她正在用旧硬币做一条项链。

e.en: He spent hours {fashioning} a speech for the wedding.
e.zh: 他花了好几个小时打磨这篇婚礼致辞。

e.en: My sister is a true {fashionista} who follows every trend.
e.zh: 我姐姐是个紧跟潮流的时尚达人。

e.en: The {fashionista} posted her outfit photos on Instagram daily.
e.zh: 那位时尚达人每天在Instagram上晒穿搭。

fashions.t:
n. 款式；时尚（复数）
v. 塑造；制作

e.en: Summer {fashions} this year lean toward bright pastels.
e.zh: 今年的夏季流行款偏向明亮的粉彩色。

e.en: The carpenter {fashions} chairs from reclaimed oak.
e.zh: 那位木匠用回收的橡木打造椅子。

faso.t: n. 法索（多见于 Burkina Faso 布基纳法索）

e.en: Burkina {Faso} is a landlocked country in West Africa.
e.zh: 布基纳法索是西非一个内陆国家。

e.en: Many cyclists train in Burkina {Faso} during winter months.
e.zh: 许多自行车手冬天在布基纳法索训练。

fast.t:
adj. 快速的
adv. 迅速地；牢固地

e.en: This new laptop is incredibly {fast} when editing video.
e.zh: 这台新笔记本剪辑视频时速度飞快。

e.en: Muslims {fast} from sunrise to sunset during Ramadan.
e.zh: 穆斯林在斋月期间从日出到日落禁食。

fastback.t: n. 快背式汽车（车顶到车尾呈斜线）

e.en: He restored a 1968 Mustang {fastback} in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里翻新了一辆1968款野马快背车。

e.en: The {fastback} design gives the car a sleek silhouette.
e.zh: 快背式车身让这辆车线条更流畅。

e.en: The pitcher's {fastball} clocked in at ninety-eight miles per hour.
e.zh: 那位投手的快速球时速达到了98英里。

e.en: He swung early and missed the high {fastball}.
e.zh: 他挥棒太早,没打中那个高位快速球。

e.en: Please {fasten} your seatbelt before takeoff.
e.zh: 请在起飞前系好安全带。

e.en: She tried to {fasten} the tiny clasp on her bracelet.
e.zh: 她试着扣上手链上那个小小的扣环。

fastened.t: v. 扣紧；固定（fasten 的过去式）

e.en: He {fastened} the gate so the dog couldn't escape.
e.zh: 他把大门闩好,免得狗跑出去。

e.en: The painting was {fastened} to the wall with heavy bolts.
e.zh: 那幅画用粗螺栓牢牢固定在墙上。

e.en: This jacket uses a magnetic {fastener} instead of buttons.
e.zh: 这件外套用磁性扣件代替了纽扣。

e.en: The plastic {fastener} on my bag finally broke.
e.zh: 我包上的塑料扣件终于坏了。

fastening.t:
n. 扣件；紧固装置
v. 扣紧（进行时）

e.en: She was {fastening} the baby into the car seat.
e.zh: 她正把宝宝固定在儿童安全座椅上。

e.en: The {fastening} on this dress is hard to reach.
e.zh: 这条裙子的扣合处很难够到。

fastens.t: v. 扣紧；固定（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {fastens} his helmet before starting the bike.
e.zh: 他每次骑车前都会系好头盔。

e.en: This bracelet {fastens} with a simple magnetic clasp.
e.zh: 这条手链用一个简单的磁扣扣合。

e.en: 5G makes mobile downloads much {faster} than before.
e.zh: 5G让手机下载比以前快得多。

e.en: Could you walk a little {faster}? We're late.
e.zh: 你能走快点吗?我们要迟到了。

e.en: She is the {fastest} runner on our school team.
e.zh: 她是我们校队跑得最快的人。

e.en: This is the {fastest} way to get to the airport.
e.zh: 这是去机场最快的路线。

fastidious.t: adj. 挑剔的；一丝不苟的

e.en: He is {fastidious} about keeping his desk perfectly organized.
e.zh: 他对保持桌面整洁井井有条十分讲究。

e.en: She's a {fastidious} editor who catches every typo.
e.zh: 她是个一丝不苟的编辑,每个错字都逃不过她的眼睛。

fastidiously.t: adv. 挑剔地；一丝不苟地

e.en: The chef {fastidiously} arranged each garnish on the plate.
e.zh: 厨师一丝不苟地把每样配菜摆在盘子上。

e.en: He {fastidiously} reviewed the contract before signing anything.
e.zh: 他在签字前细致入微地审阅了合同。

e.en: Her {fastidiousness} about cleanliness drives her roommates crazy.
e.zh: 她对卫生的过分讲究快把室友逼疯了。

e.en: The watchmaker's {fastidiousness} is evident in every detail.
e.zh: 制表师的精益求精体现在每一个细节里。

fasting.t:
n. 禁食；断食
v. 禁食（进行时）

e.en: Intermittent {fasting} has become popular for weight loss.
e.zh: 间歇性断食因减肥效果而流行起来。

e.en: You should avoid heavy exercise while {fasting}.
e.zh: 禁食期间应避免剧烈运动。

fastness.t: n. 牢固；（颜色）不褪色性

e.en: The bandits retreated to their mountain {fastness} after the raid.
e.zh: 劫匪袭击之后撤回了他们的山中要塞。

e.en: This dye is tested for color {fastness} after many washes.
e.zh: 这种染料经过多次水洗仍能保持色牢度。

fat.t:
n. 脂肪
adj. 肥胖的

e.en: Avocados are rich in healthy {fat} and fiber.
e.zh: 牛油果富含健康脂肪和膳食纤维。

e.en: The cat got really {fat} during the winter.
e.zh: 那只猫一个冬天下来变得很胖。

fatah.t: n. 法塔赫（巴勒斯坦政治组织）

e.en: {Fatah} is one of the largest Palestinian political factions.
e.zh: 法塔赫是巴勒斯坦最大的政治派别之一。

e.en: The talks involved both {Fatah} and Hamas representatives.
e.zh: 会谈中有法塔赫和哈马斯双方的代表。

e.en: Drunk driving can lead to a {fatal} accident.
e.zh: 酒驾可能导致致命的事故。

e.en: Ignoring that warning sign was a {fatal} mistake.
e.zh: 忽视那个警示标志是个致命的错误。

e.en: His {fatalism} kept him from even trying to change things.
e.zh: 他的宿命论让他连尝试改变都不愿意。

e.en: There's a quiet {fatalism} running through her latest novel.
e.zh: 她最新的小说里贯穿着一种淡淡的宿命感。

e.en: He's a {fatalist} who believes everything happens for a reason.
e.zh: 他是个宿命论者,相信一切自有定数。

e.en: Don't be such a {fatalist}; you can still fix this.
e.zh: 别这么认命,你还能补救的。

e.en: She has a {fatalistic} attitude toward office politics.
e.zh: 她对办公室政治抱着一种听天由命的态度。

e.en: His {fatalistic} view of climate change worries his friends.
e.zh: 他对气候变化听天由命的态度让朋友们很担心。

fatalities.t: n. 死亡人数；遇难者（复数）

e.en: The earthquake caused dozens of {fatalities} in the region.
e.zh: 这场地震在该地区造成数十人死亡。

e.en: Seatbelt laws have significantly reduced traffic {fatalities}.
e.zh: 安全带法规显著减少了交通死亡人数。

fatality.t: n. （事故等造成的）死亡；遇难者

e.en: Police confirmed one {fatality} in last night's crash.
e.zh: 警方确认昨晚的车祸中有一人死亡。

e.en: The disease has a low {fatality} rate among children.
e.zh: 这种疾病在儿童中的致死率较低。

e.en: The pedestrian was {fatally} injured by a speeding car.
e.zh: 那名行人被一辆超速车辆撞成致命伤。

e.en: His plan was {fatally} flawed from the start.
e.zh: 他的计划从一开始就有致命缺陷。

e.en: Grandma seasons her greens with a piece of {fatback}.
e.zh: 奶奶在炖青菜时会加一块猪背肥肉调味。

e.en: Southern recipes often call for smoked {fatback}.
e.zh: 美国南方菜常常需要用熏过的猪背肥肉。

e.en: Voters will decide the {fate} of the new law.
e.zh: 选民将决定这项新法的命运。

e.en: She believes {fate} brought them together at that café.
e.zh: 她相信是缘分让他们在那家咖啡馆相遇。

e.en: They were {fated} to meet on that rainy afternoon.
e.zh: 他们注定要在那个雨天的下午相遇。

e.en: The project seemed {fated} to fail from the beginning.
e.zh: 这个项目似乎从一开始就注定要失败。

e.en: That {fateful} email changed the course of her career.
e.zh: 那封决定命运的邮件改变了她的职业轨迹。

e.en: On that {fateful} day, the company announced layoffs.
e.zh: 在那决定命运的一天,公司宣布了裁员。

fatefully.t: adv. 决定性地；宿命般地

e.en: He {fatefully} chose to take the later flight home.
e.zh: 他鬼使神差地选择了搭乘较晚的航班回家。

e.en: The two leaders {fatefully} met at the Geneva summit.
e.zh: 两位领导人在日内瓦峰会上具有历史意义地会面了。

fates.t: n. 命运（复数）；命运女神

e.en: The {fates} of both companies depend on this merger.
e.zh: 两家公司的命运都系于这次合并。

e.en: In Greek myth, the three {Fates} spin the thread of life.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,三位命运女神纺织生命之线。

e.en: Don't be such a {fathead} and admit you were wrong.
e.zh: 别这么蠢,承认你错了吧。

e.en: That {fathead} forgot to back up the entire database.
e.zh: 那个蠢货忘了备份整个数据库。

father.t:
n. 父亲
v. 做父亲；创立

e.en: My {father} taught me how to ride a bike.
e.zh: 我爸爸教我怎么骑自行车。

e.en: Steve Jobs is often called the {father} of the smartphone.
e.zh: 乔布斯常被称为智能手机之父。

e.en: My {father-in-law} loves cooking elaborate Sunday dinners.
e.zh: 我公公很喜欢做精致的周日大餐。

e.en: Her {father-in-law} gave them a generous wedding gift.
e.zh: 她的岳父送了他们一份很丰厚的结婚礼物。

father-in-laws.t: n. 岳父/公公（非规范复数）

e.en: Both {father-in-laws} attended the family barbecue last weekend.
e.zh: 两位岳父上周末都来参加了家庭烧烤。

e.en: Many {father-in-laws} struggle to bond with new sons-in-law.
e.zh: 许多岳父都很难和新女婿打成一片。

fatherhood.t: n. 父亲身份；为父之道

e.en: {Fatherhood} completely changed his outlook on work-life balance.
e.zh: 为人父彻底改变了他对工作与生活平衡的看法。

e.en: He's still adjusting to the demands of {fatherhood}.
e.zh: 他还在适应当父亲带来的种种责任。

fathering.t: v. 生育；承担父责（进行时）

e.en: He takes {fathering} seriously and reads to his kids every night.
e.zh: 他很重视为父之道,每晚都给孩子们读书。

e.en: Modern {fathering} involves much more than financial support.
e.zh: 现代父亲的角色远远不止经济上的供养。

e.en: After thirty years abroad, he returned to his {fatherland}.
e.zh: 在国外住了三十年后,他回到了祖国。

e.en: The anthem celebrates the beauty of the {fatherland}.
e.zh: 这首国歌歌颂了祖国的壮美。

e.en: The charity supports {fatherless} children in rural communities.
e.zh: 该慈善机构帮助农村地区没有父亲的孩子。

e.en: Growing up {fatherless} shaped much of her early writing.
e.zh: 在没有父亲的环境中长大深深影响了她早期的写作。

fatherly.t: adj. 慈父般的；父亲似的

e.en: My boss gave me some {fatherly} advice about saving money.
e.zh: 我老板像父亲一样给了我一些存钱的建议。

e.en: He spoke to the trainees in a warm, {fatherly} tone.
e.zh: 他用一种温暖、慈父般的语气对实习生说话。

fathers.t:
n. 父亲们（复数）
v. 生育（第三人称单数）

e.en: Many {fathers} now share parenting duties equally with mothers.
e.zh: 如今很多父亲都和母亲平等分担育儿责任。

e.en: The Founding {Fathers} drafted the Constitution in 1787.
e.zh: 美国国父们于1787年起草了宪法。

fathom.t:
v. 理解；弄清
n. 英寻（水深单位）

e.en: I can't {fathom} why he quit such a great job.
e.zh: 我实在想不通他为什么辞掉那么好的工作。

e.en: It's hard to {fathom} the scale of the universe.
e.zh: 宇宙的尺度让人难以理解。

fathomless.t: adj. 深不可测的；难以理解的

e.en: She stared into his {fathomless} dark eyes.
e.zh: 她凝视着他那深不见底的黑眼睛。

e.en: The ocean trench seemed absolutely {fathomless}.
e.zh: 那道海沟看起来深不可测。

e.en: Doctors measure muscle {fatigability} to diagnose certain disorders.
e.zh: 医生通过测量肌肉易疲劳性来诊断某些疾病。

e.en: High {fatigability} is a common symptom of long COVID.
e.zh: 易疲劳是新冠后遗症的常见症状之一。

fatigue.t:
n. 疲劳；劳累
v. 使疲劳

e.en: Chronic {fatigue} has made it hard for her to work.
e.zh: 慢性疲劳让她很难正常工作。

e.en: Engineers check the bridge for metal {fatigue} every year.
e.zh: 工程师每年都会检查这座桥的金属疲劳情况。

e.en: After the long flight, she felt completely {fatigued}.
e.zh: 经过那趟长途飞行,她感到精疲力竭。

e.en: The {fatigued} soldiers collapsed onto their bunks.
e.zh: 疲惫不堪的士兵们瘫倒在各自的床铺上。

e.en: The soldiers wore green {fatigues} during the training exercise.
e.zh: 士兵们在训练时穿着绿色作训服。

e.en: Constant travel {fatigues} even the most experienced flight attendants.
e.zh: 频繁出差连最资深的空乘也会累垮。

fatiguing.t: adj. 令人疲惫的；累人的

e.en: The long commute is {fatiguing} after a full workday.
e.zh: 上了一整天班后，长途通勤特别累人。

e.en: Reading dense legal text can be mentally {fatiguing}.
e.zh: 阅读晦涩的法律文本会让人精神疲惫。

e.en: The doctor warned him about the {fatness} around his waist.
e.zh: 医生警告他注意腰部的肥胖。

e.en: She admired the {fatness} of the ripe peaches at the market.
e.zh: 她欣赏市场上熟桃饱满的样子。

e.en: Avocados contain healthy {fats} that support heart health.
e.zh: 牛油果含有有益心脏健康的脂肪。

e.en: The recipe calls for melting the {fats} before mixing.
e.zh: 这道食谱要求先把油脂融化再搅拌。

e.en: Kids cruelly called him {fatso} throughout middle school.
e.zh: 整个中学期间孩子们都残忍地叫他胖子。

e.en: Don't call your brother {fatso}—it's hurtful.
e.zh: 别叫你弟弟胖子，这很伤人。

fatted.t: v. 养肥（fat 的过去式）

e.en: They killed the {fatted} calf to celebrate his return.
e.zh: 他们宰了肥牛犊来庆祝他归来。

e.en: The farmer sold the {fatted} pigs at market.
e.zh: 农夫把养肥的猪拿到市场上卖。

e.en: Farmers {fatten} cattle on grain before slaughter.
e.zh: 农民在屠宰前用谷物把牛养肥。

e.en: Grandma always tries to {fatten} me up at dinner.
e.zh: 奶奶总是在晚餐时想把我喂胖。

fattened.t: v. 养肥（fatten 的过去式）

e.en: The geese were {fattened} for the holiday feast.
e.zh: 那些鹅被养肥准备过节宴席。

e.en: He {fattened} his savings account over five years.
e.zh: 五年来他把存款账户养得很厚实。

fattening.t:
adj. 增肥的
v. 正在育肥

e.en: Fried foods are notoriously {fattening} and unhealthy.
e.zh: 油炸食品出了名地易胖又不健康。

e.en: She avoids {fattening} desserts during the week.
e.zh: 她平日里都避开容易让人发胖的甜点。

fatter.t: adj. 更胖的（fat 的比较级）

e.en: My cat has gotten {fatter} since winter started.
e.zh: 入冬以来我家猫变得更胖了。

e.en: The wallet looks {fatter} after payday.
e.zh: 发薪日过后钱包看起来鼓多了。

fatty.t:
adj. 含脂肪的；油腻的
n. 胖子

e.en: Salmon is rich in {fatty} acids good for the brain.
e.zh: 三文鱼富含对大脑有益的脂肪酸。

e.en: He trimmed the {fatty} edges off the steak.
e.zh: 他把牛排上肥腻的边缘修掉了。

e.en: The {fatuity} of his argument shocked the panel.
e.zh: 他论点的愚蠢让评审小组震惊。

e.en: She laughed at the {fatuity} of celebrity gossip.
e.zh: 她对名人八卦的无聊浅薄一笑置之。

e.en: The CEO made a {fatuous} comment about employee morale.
e.zh: 那位CEO对员工士气发表了愚蠢的评论。

e.en: His {fatuous} grin annoyed everyone in the meeting.
e.zh: 他那傻乎乎的笑容惹恼了会上每个人。

e.en: He {fatuously} insisted he'd never been wrong before.
e.zh: 他愚蠢地坚称自己从未犯过错。

e.en: She smiled {fatuously} at the celebrity's lame joke.
e.zh: 她对那位名人无聊的笑话傻笑了一下。

e.en: The cleric issued a {fatwa} condemning the violence.
e.zh: 那位教士发布了一项谴责暴力的教令。

e.en: The controversial book prompted a {fatwa} against its author.
e.zh: 那本争议性的书引发了针对作者的教令。

e.en: The kitchen {faucet} has been leaking for weeks.
e.zh: 厨房的水龙头已经漏了好几个星期了。

e.en: Turn off the {faucet} when brushing your teeth.
e.zh: 刷牙时请关掉水龙头。

e.en: The knight's armor included steel {faulds} protecting his hips.
e.zh: 骑士的盔甲包括保护臀部的钢制腿裙。

e.en: Museum curators carefully restored the medieval {faulds}.
e.zh: 博物馆策展人仔细修复了那副中世纪的腿裙甲。

e.en: {Faulkner} won the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1949.
e.zh: 福克纳于1949年获得了诺贝尔文学奖。

e.en: Many Southern writers cite {Faulkner} as a major influence.
e.zh: 许多南方作家都视福克纳为重要的影响来源。

fault.t:
n. 过错；缺点
n. 断层

e.en: The accident wasn't entirely my {fault}.
e.zh: 那次事故并不完全是我的错。

e.en: Engineers detected a {fault} in the cooling system.
e.zh: 工程师在冷却系统中检测到一个故障。

e.en: Critics {faulted} the film for its weak ending.
e.zh: 评论家批评这部电影结尾薄弱。

e.en: The pipeline {faulted} during last night's pressure test.
e.zh: 管道在昨晚的压力测试中出了故障。

e.en: Nobody enjoys working with a constant {faultfinder}.
e.zh: 没人喜欢和一个总是挑刺的人共事。

e.en: Her boss is a notorious {faultfinder} on every project.
e.zh: 她老板在每个项目里都是出了名的爱挑毛病。

e.en: Geologists study {faulting} patterns to predict earthquakes.
e.zh: 地质学家研究断层模式来预测地震。

e.en: She kept {faulting} him for things beyond his control.
e.zh: 她一直为一些他无法控制的事指责他。

faultless.t: adj. 完美的；无可挑剔的

e.en: Her presentation was absolutely {faultless} from start to finish.
e.zh: 她的演讲从头到尾完美无瑕。

e.en: The chef delivered a {faultless} seven-course meal.
e.zh: 那位厨师完美呈现了七道菜的全餐。

e.en: She performed the difficult sonata {faultlessly}.
e.zh: 她无可挑剔地演奏了那首艰难的奏鸣曲。

e.en: The waiter served the wine {faultlessly}.
e.zh: 那位侍者无可挑剔地侍酒。

e.en: Everyone has {faults}, even the people we admire.
e.zh: 每个人都有缺点，连我们崇拜的人也不例外。

e.en: California sits atop several active geological {faults}.
e.zh: 加州坐落在几条活跃的地质断层之上。

faulty.t: adj. 有缺陷的；出故障的

e.en: The recall affects cars with {faulty} airbag sensors.
e.zh: 此次召回涉及安全气囊传感器有缺陷的汽车。

e.en: His argument relies on {faulty} assumptions about the data.
e.zh: 他的论点依赖于对数据的错误假设。

faun.t: n. 罗马神话中的农牧神

e.en: A mischievous {faun} appeared in the enchanted forest.
e.zh: 一个调皮的羊男出现在魔法森林里。

e.en: The painting depicts a {faun} playing pan pipes.
e.zh: 那幅画描绘了一个吹排笛的羊男。

e.en: Australia's {fauna} includes kangaroos, koalas, and platypuses.
e.zh: 澳大利亚的动物群包括袋鼠、考拉和鸭嘴兽。

e.en: The reserve protects rare {fauna} from poachers.
e.zh: 该保护区保护稀有动物免受偷猎者侵害。

e.en: The island shows distinct {faunal} differences from the mainland.
e.zh: 这座岛屿与大陆呈现出明显的动物群差异。

e.en: Researchers documented {faunal} changes after the wildfire.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了野火后动物群的变化。

faust.t: n. 浮士德（歌德作品主角）

e.en: Goethe's {Faust} explores the price of unlimited knowledge.
e.zh: 歌德的《浮士德》探讨了无限知识的代价。

e.en: The opera company is staging {Faust} this season.
e.zh: 歌剧公司本季将上演《浮士德》。

faustian.t: adj. 浮士德式的；出卖灵魂的

e.en: He made a {Faustian} bargain for fame and fortune.
e.zh: 他为名利做了一笔浮士德式的交易。

e.en: The startup's deal with the tech giant felt {Faustian}.
e.zh: 那家初创公司与科技巨头的协议像是浮士德式的交易。

e.en: Marlowe's {Faustus} sells his soul for forbidden knowledge.
e.zh: 马洛笔下的浮士德为禁忌之知出卖灵魂。

e.en: We read Doctor {Faustus} in our Renaissance drama class.
e.zh: 我们在文艺复兴戏剧课上读了《浮士德博士》。

e.en: {Fauvism} broke from tradition with its bold, wild colors.
e.zh: 野兽派以大胆狂野的色彩打破了传统。

e.en: Matisse was a leading figure of {Fauvism}.
e.zh: 马蒂斯是野兽派的领军人物。

fave.t:
n. 最爱（favorite 的口语缩略）
adj. 最喜欢的

e.en: This coffee shop is my {fave} spot for studying.
e.zh: 这家咖啡店是我学习的最爱之处。

e.en: Drop your {fave} song from this album in the comments.
e.zh: 在评论里留下这张专辑里你最爱的歌。

e.en: The documentary follows a family living in a Rio {favela}.
e.zh: 这部纪录片跟拍了一户住在里约贫民窟的家庭。

e.en: Tourists are warned not to wander into the {favela} alone.
e.zh: 游客被警告不要独自走进贫民窟。

faversham.t: n. 费弗舍姆（英国地名）

e.en: {Faversham} is a charming market town in Kent.
e.zh: 费弗舍姆是肯特郡一座迷人的集市小镇。

e.en: We stopped in {Faversham} to visit the old brewery.
e.zh: 我们在费弗舍姆停下来参观了那家老酿酒厂。

favor.t:
n. 帮忙；好感
v. 赞成；偏爱

e.en: Could you do me a quick {favor} this afternoon?
e.zh: 今天下午能帮我一个小忙吗？

e.en: Most voters {favor} stricter privacy laws online.
e.zh: 大多数选民支持更严格的网络隐私法。

e.en: The startup received {favorable} reviews from early users.
e.zh: 这家初创公司获得了早期用户的好评。

e.en: Weather conditions look {favorable} for tomorrow's launch.
e.zh: 明天发射的天气条件看起来有利。

e.en: Her proposal compares {favorably} to last year's plan.
e.zh: 她的提案与去年的计划相比更胜一筹。

e.en: The board responded {favorably} to the merger idea.
e.zh: 董事会对合并提议反应良好。

e.en: She's the {favored} candidate for the promotion.
e.zh: 她是这次晋升的热门人选。

e.en: My grandmother always {favored} homemade gifts over store-bought ones.
e.zh: 我祖母总是更喜欢手工礼物胜过买的。

e.en: The new policy is {favoring} small businesses over corporations.
e.zh: 新政策正在偏向小企业而非大公司。

e.en: He walked slowly, {favoring} his injured knee.
e.zh: 他慢慢地走，护着受伤的膝盖。

favorite.t:
n. 最爱；喜爱之物
adj. 最喜欢的

e.en: Pizza is my {favorite} food on movie nights.
e.zh: 披萨是我电影之夜最爱的食物。

e.en: Save the page as a browser {favorite} for quick access.
e.zh: 把这个页面存为浏览器收藏夹方便快速访问。

favorites.t: n. 收藏夹；喜爱之物（复数）

e.en: I added the article to my {favorites} for later reading.
e.zh: 我把这篇文章加到收藏夹以便稍后阅读。

e.en: Chocolate cookies are family {favorites} at every gathering.
e.zh: 巧克力曲奇是每次家庭聚会上的最爱。

e.en: Employees complained about the manager's blatant {favoritism}.
e.zh: 员工抱怨经理公然偏袒某些人。

e.en: Good teachers avoid showing {favoritism} toward any student.
e.zh: 好老师会避免对任何学生表现出偏爱。

favors.t:
n. 帮忙（复数）
v. 偏爱

e.en: Wedding guests received small {favors} as they left.
e.zh: 婚礼宾客离场时收到了小礼物。

e.en: The new tax code clearly {favors} wealthy households.
e.zh: 新税法明显偏袒富裕家庭。

favour.t:
n. 帮忙；好感（英式拼写）
v. 赞成

e.en: Could you do me a {favour} and lock up?
e.zh: 能帮我个忙锁好门吗？

e.en: The committee voted in {favour} of the new policy.
e.zh: 委员会投票赞成新政策。

e.en: The deal is on remarkably {favourable} terms for buyers.
e.zh: 这笔交易对买家来说条件相当优惠。

e.en: She made a {favourable} impression at the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试中留下了良好印象。

e.en: His novel was reviewed {favourably} in major newspapers.
e.zh: 他的小说在各大报上获得好评。

e.en: The location compares {favourably} with central London prices.
e.zh: 这里的地段相比伦敦市中心的价格更划算。

favoured.t: adj. 受青睐的（英式拼写）

e.en: He was the {favoured} child in his large family.
e.zh: 在他庞大的家庭里他是最受宠的孩子。

e.en: London has long {favoured} financial services over manufacturing.
e.zh: 伦敦长期以来更青睐金融服务业而非制造业。

favouring.t: v. 偏爱（英式拼写，现在分词）

e.en: The referee was accused of {favouring} the home team.
e.zh: 那位裁判被指责偏袒主队。

e.en: She limped slightly, {favouring} her sore ankle.
e.zh: 她略微跛行，护着酸痛的脚踝。

favourite.t:
adj. 最喜爱的
n. 最爱之物

e.en: Tea with milk is my absolute {favourite} drink.
e.zh: 奶茶是我最爱的饮品。

e.en: Bookmark this site as a {favourite} on your phone.
e.zh: 把这个网站收藏到你手机的收藏夹里。

e.en: This song is one of my all-time {favourites}.
e.zh: 这首歌是我一直以来最喜欢的之一。

e.en: Save the article to your {favourites} for later reading.
e.zh: 把这篇文章存到收藏夹以便稍后阅读。

e.en: The manager was accused of {favouritism} toward his nephew.
e.zh: 那位经理被指控偏袒自己的侄子。

e.en: Good teachers avoid any hint of {favouritism} in class.
e.zh: 好老师在课堂上会避免任何偏心的迹象。

favours.t:
n. 恩惠
v. 偏爱；支持

e.en: She often {favours} bright colors over neutral tones.
e.zh: 她通常更喜欢明亮的颜色而不是中性色。

e.en: He asked his neighbor for a few small {favours}.
e.zh: 他请邻居帮了几个小忙。

e.en: The {Fawley} refinery sits on the Solent coast.
e.zh: 福利炼油厂坐落在索伦特海岸。

e.en: They drove past {Fawley} on the way to Southampton.
e.zh: 他们在去南安普顿的路上经过了福利。

fawn.t:
n. 幼鹿；浅黄褐色
v. 摇尾乞怜

e.en: A young {fawn} stood quietly at the edge of the meadow.
e.zh: 一只小鹿静静地站在草地边缘。

e.en: She painted the walls a soft {fawn} color.
e.zh: 她把墙刷成了柔和的浅黄褐色。

e.en: The reporters wrote a {fawning} profile of the celebrity.
e.zh: 记者们写了一篇对那位名人极尽奉承的人物报道。

e.en: His {fawning} behavior toward the boss annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 他对老板的谄媚行为让所有人都很反感。

fax.t:
n. 传真
v. 发传真

e.en: Some clinics still send prescriptions by {fax}.
e.zh: 一些诊所仍然通过传真发送处方。

e.en: Please {fax} the signed contract to our office today.
e.zh: 请今天把签好的合同传真到我们办公室。

faxed.t: v. 发了传真（fax 的过去式）

e.en: She {faxed} the documents to the lawyer this morning.
e.zh: 她今天上午把文件传真给律师了。

e.en: The hospital {faxed} the test results to my doctor.
e.zh: 医院把化验结果传真给了我的医生。

faxes.t:
n. 传真（复数）
v. 发传真

e.en: Our office still receives a few {faxes} every week.
e.zh: 我们办公室每周仍然会收到几份传真。

e.en: He {faxes} the order forms to the supplier each Friday.
e.zh: 他每周五都把订单传真给供应商。

e.en: I'm {faxing} the paperwork to the insurance company now.
e.zh: 我现在正在把文件传真给保险公司。

e.en: {Faxing} feels outdated compared to sending a quick email.
e.zh: 和发邮件相比,传真显得很过时。

e.en: The old poem describes a woodland {fay} dancing at dusk.
e.zh: 那首古老的诗描绘了一只林中仙子在黄昏起舞。

e.en: In folklore, a {fay} could grant wishes to the kind-hearted.
e.zh: 在民间传说中,仙子能为善良的人实现愿望。

e.en: The loud crowd didn't {faze} the experienced speaker at all.
e.zh: 喧闹的人群一点也没让这位经验丰富的演讲者慌乱。

e.en: Tough questions never {faze} her during interviews.
e.zh: 面试时再难的问题也从不会让她乱了阵脚。

e.en: The {FBI} arrested two suspects in the cyberfraud case.
e.zh: 联邦调查局在这起网络诈骗案中逮捕了两名嫌疑人。

e.en: She dreams of becoming an {FBI} agent after graduation.
e.zh: 她梦想毕业后成为一名联邦调查局探员。

fca.t: n. 英国金融行为监管局

e.en: The {FCA} fined the bank for misleading customers.
e.zh: 金融行为监管局因银行误导客户而对其处以罚款。

e.en: All UK brokers must be registered with the {FCA}.
e.zh: 所有英国经纪商都必须在金融行为监管局注册。

fda.t: n. 美国食品药品监督管理局

e.en: The {FDA} approved the new diabetes drug last week.
e.zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局上周批准了这款新的糖尿病药物。

e.en: This supplement has not been evaluated by the {FDA}.
e.zh: 这款补充剂尚未经过美国食药监局的评估。

fddi.t: n. 光纤分布式数据接口

e.en: Old campus networks once relied on {FDDI} fiber rings.
e.zh: 早期的校园网曾依赖光纤分布式数据接口环网。

e.en: {FDDI} was eventually replaced by gigabit Ethernet.
