e.zh: 光纤分布式数据接口最终被千兆以太网取代。

fdp.t: n. 德国自由民主党缩写

e.en: The {FDP} lost several seats in the recent German election.
e.zh: 自由民主党在最近的德国选举中失去了几个席位。

e.en: Coalition talks with the {FDP} dragged on for weeks.
e.zh: 与自由民主党的联合执政谈判持续了数周。

fdr.t: n. 富兰克林·罗斯福的缩写

e.en: {FDR} led America through the Great Depression and World War II.
e.zh: 罗斯福带领美国渡过了大萧条和二战。

e.en: The New Deal was one of {FDR}'s most lasting legacies.
e.zh: 新政是罗斯福留下的最持久的遗产之一。

e.en: The knight swore {fealty} to his king before battle.
e.zh: 骑士在出征前向国王宣誓效忠。

e.en: Senators pledged their {fealty} to the new party leader.
e.zh: 参议员们向新的政党领袖宣誓效忠。

fear.t:
n. 恐惧；害怕
v. 担心；畏惧

e.en: Many people {fear} public speaking more than spiders.
e.zh: 许多人害怕当众演讲胜过害怕蜘蛛。

e.en: A sudden {fear} gripped her as the lights went out.
e.zh: 灯一灭,一阵突如其来的恐惧攫住了她。

e.en: As a child, she {feared} thunderstorms more than anything.
e.zh: 小时候,她最害怕的就是雷暴天气。

e.en: The villagers {feared} the consequences of speaking out.
e.zh: 村民们害怕公开表态会带来后果。

e.en: The dog gave a {fearful} glance at the vacuum cleaner.
e.zh: 那只狗朝吸尘器投去了惊恐的一瞥。

e.en: Many investors are {fearful} about the next recession.
e.zh: 许多投资者对下一轮经济衰退感到忧心忡忡。

e.en: She peered {fearfully} around the dark corner of the hallway.
e.zh: 她惊恐地朝走廊昏暗的转角处张望。

e.en: He approached the growling dog {fearfully} but kindly.
e.zh: 他害怕又温和地靠近那只狂吠的狗。

e.en: Her {fearfulness} around strangers gradually faded with therapy.
e.zh: 通过治疗,她对陌生人的恐惧感逐渐消退了。

e.en: The puppy's {fearfulness} made socialization training essential.
e.zh: 小狗的胆怯使得社交训练变得必不可少。

e.en: {Fearing} another storm, residents stocked up on supplies.
e.zh: 由于担心又有风暴,居民们储备了大量物资。

e.en: She left early, {fearing} the traffic would get worse.
e.zh: 她担心交通会更堵,于是提早出发了。

e.en: The {fearless} reporter went straight into the war zone.
e.zh: 这位无所畏惧的记者直接进入了战区。

e.en: She was a {fearless} skater from the age of five.
e.zh: 她从五岁起就是个天不怕地不怕的滑冰小孩。

e.en: He spoke {fearlessly} against corruption at the town hall.
e.zh: 他在市政厅会议上无所畏惧地抨击腐败。

e.en: The lifeguard dove {fearlessly} into the rough waves.
e.zh: 救生员毫无畏惧地跃入汹涌的海浪中。

e.en: Her {fearlessness} on stage inspired younger performers.
e.zh: 她在舞台上的无所畏惧激励着年轻的表演者。

e.en: The pilot's {fearlessness} earned him a medal of honor.
e.zh: 那位飞行员的无畏精神为他赢得了荣誉勋章。

fears.t:
n. 恐惧（复数）
v. 害怕

e.en: She finally faced her childhood {fears} during therapy.
e.zh: 她在心理治疗中终于直面了童年的恐惧。

e.en: He {fears} that the project may miss its deadline.
e.zh: 他担心这个项目可能会赶不上截止日期。

fearsome.t: adj. 可怕的；令人畏惧的

e.en: The dragon in the film had a truly {fearsome} roar.
e.zh: 电影里那条龙的吼声真是骇人。

e.en: She earned a {fearsome} reputation as a tough negotiator.
e.zh: 她作为强硬的谈判者赢得了令人生畏的名声。

fearsomely.t: adv. 可怕地；令人畏惧地

e.en: The wind howled {fearsomely} through the empty streets.
e.zh: 狂风在空荡的街道上骇人地呼啸着。

e.en: The boss frowned {fearsomely} at the late report.
e.zh: 老板看着迟交的报告,皱眉皱得吓人。

e.en: The team is studying the {feasibility} of a remote-only office.
e.zh: 团队正在研究全员远程办公的可行性。

e.en: A {feasibility} report will be ready by next quarter.
e.zh: 可行性报告将在下个季度完成。

e.en: Launching the app by June seems entirely {feasible} now.
e.zh: 现在看来在六月前发布这款应用是完全可行的。

e.en: Solar power is a {feasible} option for most rural homes.
e.zh: 对大多数乡村住宅而言,太阳能是一个可行的选择。

e.en: We can't {feasibly} finish the redesign in just two weeks.
e.zh: 我们根本不可能在短短两周内完成重新设计。

e.en: This budget can {feasibly} cover travel and lodging only.
e.zh: 这笔预算实际上只够覆盖交通和住宿。

feast.t:
n. 盛宴；节日
v. 尽情享用

e.en: Thanksgiving dinner is always a huge family {feast}.
e.zh: 感恩节晚餐总是一场盛大的家庭宴席。

e.en: Tourists {feast} on fresh seafood along the harbor.
e.zh: 游客们沿着港口大快朵颐地享用新鲜海鲜。

feasting.t: v. 尽情享用；大吃大喝

e.en: Guests were still {feasting} long after midnight.
e.zh: 过了午夜很久,客人们还在尽情饱餐。

e.en: The villagers spent the holiday {feasting} and dancing.
e.zh: 村民们整个节日都在大吃大喝、载歌载舞。

feasts.t:
n. 盛宴（复数）
v. 大吃大喝

e.en: Medieval kings hosted lavish {feasts} in their great halls.
e.zh: 中世纪的国王在大殿中举办奢华的盛宴。

e.en: She {feasts} on books during every summer vacation.
e.zh: 每个暑假她都会尽情享受阅读的乐趣。

e.en: Climbing Everest solo is an incredible {feat} of endurance.
e.zh: 独自攀登珠峰是一项令人难以置信的耐力壮举。

e.en: Finishing the marathon was no small {feat} for her.
e.zh: 完成马拉松对她来说可不是件小事。

e.en: A bright red {feather} drifted down from the tree.
e.zh: 一根鲜红的羽毛从树上飘落下来。

e.en: The pillow is as light as a {feather}.
e.zh: 这个枕头轻得像一根羽毛。

featherbed.t:
v. 娇养；过度保护
n. 羽毛床垫

e.en: Grandma covered the bed with a soft {featherbed} every winter.
e.zh: 奶奶每年冬天都给床铺上一床柔软的羽毛褥子。

e.en: Critics warned the policy would {featherbed} struggling industries.
e.zh: 批评者警告说这项政策会过度庇护陷入困境的行业。

e.en: The hat was decorated with brightly {feathered} plumes.
e.zh: 那顶帽子装饰着色彩鲜艳的羽毛。

e.en: Many dinosaurs were {feathered}, scientists now believe.
e.zh: 科学家现在认为许多恐龙是有羽毛的。

feedthrough.t: n. 馈通（电气穿心连接器）

e.en: The vacuum chamber needs an electrical {feedthrough} for the sensor cable.
e.zh: 真空腔需要一个电气贯通件来连接传感器电缆。

e.en: Engineers sealed the {feedthrough} to prevent gas leaks.
e.zh: 工程师密封了贯通件以防止气体泄漏。

feel.t:
v. 感觉；觉得
n. 手感；感觉

e.en: I {feel} much better after a good night's sleep.
e.zh: 睡了一个好觉后我感觉好多了。

e.en: This sweater has a really soft {feel} to it.
e.zh: 这件毛衣摸起来手感非常柔软。

e.en: He sent out a {feeler} to see if she was interested.
e.zh: 他试探了一下,看她是否有兴趣。

e.en: The insect waved its {feeler} as it explored the leaf.
e.zh: 昆虫一边探索叶子一边挥动着触角。

feeling.t:
n. 感觉；情绪
v. 感觉（现在分词）

e.en: I have a {feeling} something is going to go wrong today.
e.zh: 我有种预感,今天会有什么事不对劲。

e.en: She lost all {feeling} in her left arm temporarily.
e.zh: 她左臂暂时完全失去了知觉。

e.en: She spoke {feelingly} about losing her childhood home.
e.zh: 她动情地谈起失去童年故居的事。

e.en: He read the poem {feelingly} at his grandmother's funeral.
e.zh: 他在祖母的葬礼上深情地朗诵了那首诗。

e.en: He's not very good at expressing his {feelings}.
e.zh: 他不太擅长表达自己的感受。

e.en: I didn't mean to hurt your {feelings}.
e.zh: 我不是故意要伤你的感情。

feels.t:
v. 感觉（第三人称单数）
n. 感受（口语）

e.en: It {feels} colder outside than the thermometer says.
e.zh: 外面感觉比温度计显示的还要冷。

e.en: She {feels} more confident after the promotion.
e.zh: 升职后她感觉更自信了。

e.en: University tuition {fees} have risen sharply this decade.
e.zh: 近十年大学学费大幅上涨。

e.en: The bank charges hidden {fees} on foreign transactions.
e.zh: 银行对境外交易收取隐藏费用。

feet.t: n. 脚（foot 的复数）；英尺

e.en: My {feet} are killing me after walking all day.
e.zh: 走了一整天,我的脚痛死了。

e.en: The waterfall is over two hundred {feet} tall.
e.zh: 那个瀑布有两百多英尺高。

e.en: Don't {feign} surprise—you knew about the party already.
e.zh: 别装作惊讶——你早就知道这个派对了。

e.en: He tried to {feign} illness to skip the meeting.
e.zh: 他想装病来逃避那个会议。

feigned.t:
adj. 假装的
v. 假装（过去式）

e.en: She {feigned} interest in his long story about cars.
e.zh: 她对他那个关于汽车的长故事假装感兴趣。

e.en: His {feigned} ignorance didn't fool the detective.
e.zh: 他装作不知情并没能骗过那个侦探。

e.en: He's just {feigning} a headache to get out of dinner.
e.zh: 他只是装头痛好不去吃晚饭。

e.en: The cat is {feigning} sleep but watching the bird closely.
e.zh: 那只猫在装睡,其实正紧盯着小鸟。

feigns.t: v. 假装（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {feigns} surprise whenever his sister mentions the broken vase.
e.zh: 每当姐姐提起那只摔碎的花瓶，他都装出惊讶的样子。

e.en: The cat {feigns} sleep until the bird lands nearby.
e.zh: 那只猫装睡，直到小鸟落在附近。

feint.t:
n. 佯攻；虚晃
v. 作假动作

e.en: The boxer threw a quick {feint} before landing the punch.
e.zh: 拳击手先做了一个假动作，然后挥出重拳。

e.en: She made a {feint} to the left and ran right past him.
e.zh: 她向左虚晃一下，便从他右侧跑了过去。

e.en: The puppy's {feistiness} makes training a real challenge.
e.zh: 这只小狗活泼好斗，训练起来真不容易。

e.en: I admire her {feistiness} in standing up to unfair bosses.
e.zh: 我很佩服她敢于对抗不公上司的那股泼辣劲。

e.en: My grandmother is still {feisty} at ninety years old.
e.zh: 我外婆九十岁了还是那么有活力、不服输。

e.en: The {feisty} kitten attacked every shoelace in the house.
e.zh: 那只活泼好斗的小猫咪攻击家里每一根鞋带。

e.en: Granite contains quartz, mica, and pink {feldspar} crystals.
e.zh: 花岗岩中含有石英、云母和粉红色的长石晶体。

e.en: The geologist identified the mineral as potassium {feldspar}.
e.zh: 地质学家鉴定这种矿物是钾长石。

e.en: The principal will {felicitate} the winners at tomorrow's assembly.
e.zh: 校长将在明天的集会上向获奖者表示祝贺。

e.en: We gathered to {felicitate} the couple on their golden anniversary.
e.zh: 我们聚在一起祝贺这对夫妇金婚纪念。

e.en: Her speech contained several {felicitous} turns of phrase.
e.zh: 她的演讲里有几句话措辞得当、令人称道。

e.en: The timing of the announcement was particularly {felicitous}.
e.zh: 这则公告发布的时机恰到好处。

e.en: The author {felicitously} blends humor with serious commentary.
e.zh: 这位作者巧妙地将幽默与严肃评论融为一体。

e.en: The new logo fits {felicitously} with the brand's vintage feel.
e.zh: 新标志与品牌的复古感非常契合。

e.en: The poem captures the quiet {felicity} of family life.
e.zh: 这首诗捕捉到了家庭生活中那份宁静的幸福。

e.en: She translates with remarkable {felicity} of expression.
e.zh: 她的翻译措辞十分贴切优美。

feline.t:
adj. 猫科的
n. 猫科动物

e.en: The {feline} stretched lazily across the sunny windowsill.
e.zh: 那只猫懒洋洋地伸展身体趴在洒满阳光的窗台上。

e.en: She moves with a {feline} grace on the dance floor.
e.zh: 她在舞池里步态优雅，像猫一样轻盈。

felixstowe.t: n. 费利克斯托（英国港口城市）

e.en: Container ships unload daily at the port of {Felixstowe}.
e.zh: 集装箱货船每天在费利克斯托港卸货。

e.en: We took the kids to {Felixstowe} beach last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们带孩子去了费利克斯托海滩。

fell.t:
v. fall 的过去式；砍倒
adj. 凶猛的（文）

e.en: She {fell} off her bike but wasn't seriously hurt.
e.zh: 她从自行车上摔了下来，不过伤得不重。

e.en: Stock prices {fell} sharply after the earnings report.
e.zh: 财报发布后股价大幅下跌。

e.en: That {fella} at the counter ordered three coffees to go.
e.zh: 柜台那位老兄点了三杯外带咖啡。

e.en: He's a decent {fella} once you get to know him.
e.zh: 等你熟悉他之后会发现，他其实是个不错的家伙。

e.en: The {fellah} worked the irrigated fields along the Nile.
e.zh: 那位埃及农夫在尼罗河沿岸的灌溉田里劳作。

e.en: Each {fellah} relied on the annual flood for his harvest.
e.zh: 每个埃及农民都靠每年的洪水来确保收成。

e.en: The biology lecture briefly mentioned how some bats {fellate} their mates.
e.zh: 生物课上简短提到某些蝙蝠会对配偶进行口交行为。

e.en: Researchers documented bonobos who {fellate} as a form of bonding.
e.zh: 研究人员记录到倭黑猩猩通过口交行为进行联结。

e.en: The clinic's pamphlet discussed safer practices including {fellatio}.
e.zh: 诊所的小册子介绍了包括口交在内的安全性行为方式。

e.en: Sex education classes now address {fellatio} and consent openly.
e.zh: 如今的性教育课程会公开讨论口交与同意问题。

e.en: Loggers {felled} the old oak with a single chainsaw.
e.zh: 伐木工人用一台电锯就把那棵老橡树放倒了。

e.en: A sudden flu {felled} half the office last week.
e.zh: 上周一场突如其来的流感放倒了办公室一半的人。

e.en: The old {feller} next door still mows his own lawn.
e.zh: 隔壁那位老先生现在还自己修剪草坪。

e.en: The tree {feller} carefully checked which way it would drop.
e.zh: 伐木工人仔细查看这棵树会朝哪个方向倒下。

e.en: Illegal {felling} of rainforest trees continues despite new laws.
e.zh: 尽管出台了新法，雨林树木的非法砍伐仍在继续。

e.en: The storm is {felling} branches all across the neighborhood.
e.zh: 这场风暴把整个社区的树枝都吹断了。

fellow.t:
n. 家伙；同伴；研究员
adj. 同类的

e.en: Please greet your {fellow} students before the meeting starts.
e.zh: 会议开始前请向你的同学们打个招呼。

e.en: She became a research {fellow} at Cambridge last year.
e.zh: 她去年成为剑桥大学的一名研究员。

e.en: The two {fellows} argued loudly about last night's match.
e.zh: 那两个家伙就昨晚的比赛大声争论起来。

e.en: Junior {fellows} at the institute receive a yearly stipend.
e.zh: 该研究所的初级研究员每年都能领到津贴。

e.en: She won a research {fellowship} to study abroad in Berlin.
e.zh: 她获得了一项研究奖学金，可以去柏林留学。

e.en: The hikers enjoyed the warm {fellowship} around the campfire.
e.zh: 徒步者们围着篝火享受着温暖的友谊。

e.en: The convicted {felon} served eight years in state prison.
e.zh: 那名重罪犯在州监狱服刑了八年。

e.en: Many states bar a {felon} from voting after release.
e.zh: 许多州在重罪犯释放后仍禁止其投票。

felonious.t: adj. 重罪的；穷凶极恶的

e.en: Police charged him with {felonious} assault on the officer.
e.zh: 警方以重罪袭警罪起诉了他。

e.en: The report distinguished {felonious} acts from minor misdemeanors.
e.zh: 报告把重罪行为与轻微违法行为区分开来。

e.en: Tax fraud at this scale is treated as a {felony}.
e.zh: 如此规模的税务欺诈会被视为重罪处理。

e.en: He pleaded guilty to one count of {felony} burglary.
e.zh: 他对一项重罪入室盗窃的指控认罪。

felt.t:
v. feel 的过去式
n. 毛毡

e.en: I {felt} a sudden chill when the door swung open.
e.zh: 门突然打开的时候我感到一阵寒意。

e.en: She glued green {felt} to the bottom of the box.
e.zh: 她在盒子底部粘上了一层绿色的毛毡。

felted.t:
adj. 毡化的
v. 使成毡（过去式）

e.en: My wool sweater accidentally got {felted} in the hot wash.
e.zh: 我的羊毛衫不小心被热水洗成了毡状。

e.en: She made a {felted} bag from leftover yarn scraps.
e.zh: 她用剩下的毛线碎料做了一个毡化的包。

feltham.t: n. 费尔瑟姆（伦敦地名）

e.en: The train from Waterloo stops at {Feltham} every twenty minutes.
e.zh: 从滑铁卢出发的火车每二十分钟在费勒姆停一次。

e.en: My cousin grew up in {Feltham}, west of London.
e.zh: 我表弟在伦敦西边的费勒姆长大。

female.t:
n. 女性；雌性
adj. 女性的；雌的

e.en: The {female} lion does most of the hunting for the pride.
e.zh: 母狮承担了狮群中大部分的狩猎工作。

e.en: More than half of medical students today are {female}.
e.zh: 如今医学院学生中有一半以上是女性。

e.en: The novel explores {femaleness} as more than biology alone.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨的女性身份远不止于生物学层面。

e.en: Her artwork celebrates {femaleness} across different cultures and eras.
e.zh: 她的艺术作品赞颂跨越不同文化和时代的女性特质。

females.t: n. 女性；雌性动物（female 的复数）

e.en: In this species, {females} are larger than the males.
e.zh: 在这个物种中，雌性比雄性体型更大。

e.en: The clinic offers free screenings for {females} over forty.
e.zh: 该诊所为四十岁以上的女性提供免费筛查。

feminazi.t: n. 极端女权主义者（贬义）

e.en: Online trolls lazily label any outspoken woman a {feminazi}.
e.zh: 网络喷子动不动就把直言不讳的女性贴上女权纳粹的标签。

e.en: The slur {feminazi} is meant to silence rather than debate.
e.zh: "女权纳粹"这种侮辱性词汇是为了让人闭嘴，而非辩论。

feminine.t:
adj. 女性的；阴柔的
n. 阴性（语法）

e.en: She prefers soft, {feminine} colors like blush and lavender.
e.zh: 她喜欢腮红粉和薰衣草紫这类柔和的女性化色调。

e.en: In French, the word "table" is grammatically {feminine}.
e.zh: 在法语中，"桌子"这个词在语法上是阴性的。

e.en: The magazine challenges narrow definitions of {femininity}.
e.zh: 这本杂志挑战了对女性气质的狭隘定义。

e.en: She embraces both strength and {femininity} in her style.
e.zh: 她在自己的风格中兼具力量感和女性气质。

feminism.t: n. 女权主义；女性主义

e.en: Modern {feminism} addresses race, class, and gender together.
e.zh: 当代女权主义同时关注种族、阶级和性别问题。

e.en: Her dissertation traces the history of {feminism} since 1960.
e.zh: 她的博士论文梳理了1960年以来女权主义的发展历史。

feminist.t:
n. 女权主义者
adj. 女权主义的

e.en: She runs a popular {feminist} podcast about workplace inequality.
e.zh: 她经营着一档广受欢迎的女权主义播客，讨论职场不平等问题。

e.en: The book offers a {feminist} reading of classic fairy tales.
e.zh: 这本书从女权主义视角重新解读了经典童话故事。

e.en: Early {feminists} fought hard for women's right to vote.
e.zh: 早期的女权主义者们为争取女性投票权进行了艰苦斗争。

e.en: Many {feminists} today campaign against the gender pay gap.
e.zh: 如今许多女权主义者积极反对性别薪酬差距。

e.en: Researchers studied the {feminization} of the teaching profession.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了教师职业的女性化趋势。

e.en: Pollutants caused gradual {feminization} of fish in the river.
e.zh: 污染物导致河中鱼类逐渐出现雌性化现象。

feminize.t: v. 使女性化；使变得阴柔

e.en: Designers chose softer fonts to {feminize} the brand's image.
e.zh: 设计师选用更柔和的字体来让品牌形象更具女性化色彩。

e.en: Hormone therapy can gradually {feminize} certain physical features.
e.zh: 激素治疗可以逐渐让某些身体特征更趋向女性化。

feminized.t:
adj. 被女性化的
v. feminize 的过去式

e.en: The marketing team {feminized} the packaging with pastel colors.
e.zh: 市场团队用粉彩色让包装更具女性化风格。

e.en: Critics argued the film {feminized} the historical warrior unfairly.
e.zh: 评论家认为这部电影不恰当地把那位历史武士女性化了。

femme.t:
n. 女性化的人（尤指女同性恋中扮演女性角色者）
adj. 娇柔的

e.en: The film noir features a classic {femme} fatale character.
e.zh: 这部黑色电影刻画了一位经典的蛇蝎美人形象。

e.en: She identifies as {femme} and dresses accordingly each day.
e.zh: 她认同自己是阴柔型同性恋者，每天的穿着也相应如此。

e.en: The doctor checked her {femoral} pulse during the exam.
e.zh: 医生检查时为她触诊了股动脉的脉搏。

e.en: Surgeons access the heart through the {femoral} artery sometimes.
e.zh: 外科医生有时会通过股动脉进入心脏进行手术。

femoris.t: adj. 股的（解剖学拉丁语）

e.en: Sprinters often strain the biceps {femoris} during fast starts.
e.zh: 短跑运动员在猛冲起跑时常常拉伤股二头肌。

e.en: The rectus {femoris} helps you lift your knee while walking.
e.zh: 股直肌在你走路时帮助抬起膝盖。

e.en: A {femtosecond} laser can etch patterns on a single cell.
e.zh: 飞秒激光可以在单个细胞上刻出图案。

e.en: Scientists captured the reaction in just one {femtosecond}.
e.zh: 科学家们只用一飞秒就捕捉到了这个反应过程。

e.en: He broke his {femur} during a serious skiing accident.
e.zh: 他在一次严重的滑雪事故中摔断了股骨。

e.en: The {femur} is the longest bone in the human body.
e.zh: 股骨是人体内最长的一块骨头。

e.en: Wild birds nest in the reedy {fen} every spring.
e.zh: 每年春天野鸟都会在芦苇丛生的沼泽地里筑巢。

e.en: The village sits on the edge of a vast {fen}.
e.zh: 这个村庄坐落在一片广阔沼泽地的边缘。

fence.t:
n. 围栏；栅栏
v. 围起；击剑

e.en: We're building a wooden {fence} around the back garden.
e.zh: 我们正在后花园四周搭一道木栅栏。

e.en: The dog jumped the {fence} and ran down the street.
e.zh: 那只狗跳过栅栏，沿着街道跑掉了。

fenced.t:
adj. 被围起的
v. fence 的过去式

e.en: The farmer {fenced} off the meadow to keep cattle in.
e.zh: 农夫把草地围了起来，防止牛跑出去。

e.en: Their backyard is fully {fenced}, so the puppy stays safe.
e.zh: 他们的后院围得严严实实，小狗待在里面很安全。

e.en: The Olympic {fencer} trained six hours every single day.
e.zh: 那位奥运击剑选手每天都要训练六个小时。

e.en: She's the top-ranked {fencer} on the university team.
e.zh: 她是大学击剑队里排名第一的选手。

fencerow.t: n. 篱笆沿线的带状地

e.en: Wild raspberries grow thick along the old {fencerow}.
e.zh: 野生覆盆子沿着那条旧篱笆边长得密密麻麻。

e.en: Birds use the {fencerow} as cover between open fields.
e.zh: 鸟儿把这条树篱当作开阔田地之间的掩护。

fences.t:
n. 围栏（复数）
v. 围起（第三人称单数）

e.en: The neighbors built tall wooden {fences} around their backyards.
e.zh: 邻居们在自家后院围起了高高的木栅栏。

e.en: He often {fences} with critics on social media.
e.zh: 他经常在社交媒体上与批评者唇枪舌剑。

fencing.t: n. 击剑运动；围栏材料

e.en: She started {fencing} lessons after watching the Olympics.
e.zh: 看完奥运会后她开始上击剑课。

e.en: The contractor installed new {fencing} along the property line.
e.zh: 承包商沿着地界安装了新的围栏。

fend.t: v. 抵挡；照料（常用 fend off / fend for）

e.en: After college, you have to {fend} for yourself.
e.zh: 大学毕业后你得自己照顾自己。

e.en: She used an umbrella to {fend} off the rain.
e.zh: 她用伞挡住了雨水。

fender.t: n. 挡泥板；（车辆）保险杠

e.en: The crash left a deep dent in the front {fender}.
e.zh: 那次撞车在前挡泥板上留下了一个深凹痕。

e.en: He plays a vintage {fender} guitar on stage.
e.zh: 他在台上弹一把老式的芬达吉他。

fenestration.t: n. 开窗（建筑）；开窗术（医学）

e.en: The architect praised the building's elegant {fenestration}.
e.zh: 建筑师称赞这栋楼优雅的窗户布局。

e.en: Surgeons performed a {fenestration} to relieve the pressure.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了开窗术以减轻压力。

fenian.t: n. 芬尼亚会成员（爱尔兰独立运动）

e.en: The novel describes the {fenian} uprising of the 1860s.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了十九世纪六十年代的芬尼亚起义。

e.en: He studied {fenian} history at Trinity College Dublin.
e.zh: 他在都柏林三一学院研究芬尼亚运动史。

e.en: Migratory birds gather on the East Anglian {fenland} each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天候鸟都聚集在东英吉利的沼泽地。

e.en: The {fenland} was drained to create farmland centuries ago.
e.zh: 几个世纪前那片沼泽地被排干用作农田。

e.en: Roasted {fennel} adds a sweet, licorice flavor to the dish.
e.zh: 烤茴香给这道菜增添了甘甜的甘草香味。

e.en: She chopped {fennel} bulbs for the salad.
e.zh: 她把茴香球茎切碎做沙拉。

e.en: The path wound through cold, {fenny} ground.
e.zh: 小路蜿蜒穿过湿冷的沼泽地带。

e.en: Mist rose from the {fenny} fields at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分雾气从沼泽田地升起。

fentanyl.t: n. 芬太尼（强效镇痛药/毒品）

e.en: Doctors prescribe {fentanyl} only for severe chronic pain.
e.zh: 医生只给严重慢性疼痛患者开芬太尼。

e.en: The city is fighting a deadly {fentanyl} epidemic.
e.zh: 该市正在应对致命的芬太尼疫情。

e.en: Collectors prize antique {fenton} glass for its iridescent finish.
e.zh: 收藏家珍视古董芬顿玻璃那虹彩般的光泽。

e.en: The {fenton} reaction generates hydroxyl radicals from peroxide.
e.zh: 芬顿反应可由过氧化物生成羟自由基。

e.en: Indian curries often use {fenugreek} seeds for a maple-like aroma.
e.zh: 印度咖喱常用葫芦巴籽来增添类似枫糖的香气。

e.en: She added a teaspoon of ground {fenugreek} to the stew.
e.zh: 她在炖菜里加了一茶匙葫芦巴粉。

e.en: Shoppers crowded the {fenwick} department store on Boxing Day.
e.zh: 节礼日那天购物者挤满了芬威克百货公司。

e.en: He grew up in a small town near {fenwick} Island.
e.zh: 他在芬威克岛附近的小镇长大。

e.en: Granny said she was waitin' {fer} the bus.
e.zh: 奶奶说她正在等公交车。

e.en: He drawled, "What're ya lookin' {fer}, partner?"
e.zh: 他慢吞吞地说:"伙计,你在找什么呢?"

feral.t: adj. 野生的；（原驯养后）野化的

e.en: The shelter rescues {feral} cats from the city streets.
e.zh: 这家收容所从市区街道救助流浪野猫。

e.en: His hair grew long and {feral} during the trip.
e.zh: 旅途中他的头发长得又长又乱。

fermanagh.t: n. 弗马纳（北爱尔兰郡名）

e.en: They spent the weekend fishing in County {fermanagh}.
e.zh: 他们在弗马纳郡度过了一个钓鱼的周末。

e.en: {fermanagh} is famous for its lakes and green hills.
e.zh: 弗马纳郡以湖泊和青山闻名。

e.en: Hold the final note on the {fermata} until I cue you.
e.zh: 在延长记号上保持最后一个音直到我示意。

e.en: The conductor extended the {fermata} for dramatic effect.
e.zh: 指挥家拉长延长音以营造戏剧效果。

ferment.t:
v. 发酵
n. 骚动；发酵剂

e.en: Brewers let the wort {ferment} for about two weeks.
e.zh: 酿酒师让麦汁发酵大约两周。

e.en: The country was in political {ferment} before the election.
e.zh: 大选前这个国家处于政治动荡之中。

e.en: Yeast drives the {fermentation} that turns sugar into alcohol.
e.zh: 酵母推动发酵过程,把糖转化为酒精。

e.en: Long {fermentation} gives sourdough its tangy flavor.
e.zh: 长时间发酵让酸种面包带有独特的酸香。

feathering.t:
n. 羽饰；羽化效果
v. 使变羽状

e.en: The artist used {feathering} to soften the edges of the portrait.
e.zh: 画家用羽化手法柔化了肖像的边缘。

e.en: The peacock was slowly {feathering} out its colorful tail.
e.zh: 那只孔雀正缓缓展开它五彩缤纷的尾羽。

e.en: Newly hatched chicks are mostly {featherless} and pink.
e.zh: 刚孵出的雏鸟几乎没有羽毛,粉嘟嘟的。

e.en: Plato joked that humans were {featherless} bipeds.
e.zh: 柏拉图打趣说人类是没有羽毛的两足动物。

e.en: The parrot's bright {feathers} attracted everyone's attention.
e.zh: 那只鹦鹉鲜艳的羽毛吸引了所有人的目光。

e.en: Don't ruffle his {feathers} by criticizing his cooking.
e.zh: 别批评他的厨艺,免得惹他不高兴。

featherweight.t:
n. 轻量级（拳击）
adj. 极轻的

e.en: He won the {featherweight} title at last year's championship.
e.zh: 他在去年的锦标赛上赢得了羽量级冠军。

e.en: The new laptop is a {featherweight} at just one kilogram.
e.zh: 这款新笔记本电脑只有一公斤,轻如鸿毛。

e.en: Light, {feathery} snowflakes settled gently on her coat.
e.zh: 轻盈如羽的雪花轻轻落在她的外套上。

e.en: Dill has delicate, {feathery} green leaves.
e.zh: 莳萝有着细腻、羽毛般的绿叶。

e.en: The acrobats performed amazing {feats} of balance and strength.
e.zh: 杂技演员们表演了平衡与力量的惊人技艺。

e.en: Modern engineering {feats} include the world's tallest skyscrapers.
e.zh: 现代工程的伟大成就包括世界上最高的摩天大楼。

feature.t:
n. 特色、功能
v. 以…为特色

e.en: The new phone has a great low-light camera {feature}.
e.zh: 这款新手机有一个出色的低光拍摄功能。

e.en: The magazine will {feature} her work in next month's issue.
e.zh: 杂志将在下个月的一期中重点介绍她的作品。

e.en: Her startup was {featured} on the front page of TechCrunch.
e.zh: 她的创业公司被刊登在 TechCrunch 的头版。

e.en: The album {featured} guest vocals from three famous artists.
e.zh: 这张专辑邀请了三位知名艺人献唱。

e.en: The desert stretched out, flat and {featureless}, for miles.
e.zh: 沙漠延绵数英里,平坦无垠,毫无特征。

e.en: The early prototype had a plain, {featureless} white interface.
e.zh: 早期原型的界面是一片纯白,毫无特色。

e.en: This phone {features} a much better camera than last year's model.
e.zh: 这款手机配备了比去年款好得多的摄像头。

e.en: The app's new {features} include dark mode and offline support.
e.zh: 该应用的新功能包括深色模式和离线支持。

e.en: They released a song {featuring} a popular rapper.
e.zh: 他们发行了一首有知名说唱歌手参与的歌曲。

e.en: The exhibition is {featuring} works by young local artists.
e.zh: 该展览正在展出本地年轻艺术家的作品。

e.en: The meeting is scheduled for {Feb} 14th.
e.zh: 会议定于二月十四日举行。

e.en: My passport expires in {Feb} next year.
e.zh: 我的护照明年二月到期。

e.en: The child became {febrile} after the long flight.
e.zh: 那个孩子在长途飞行后开始发烧。

e.en: There was a {febrile} excitement in the newsroom before the announcement.
e.zh: 宣布消息前,新闻编辑室里弥漫着一种狂热的兴奋。

e.en: The last few {Februaries} have been unusually warm here.
e.zh: 过去几个二月这里都异常温暖。

e.en: She remembered the cold {Februaries} of her childhood.
e.zh: 她记得童年时那些寒冷的二月。

e.en: My birthday is in {February}, right after Valentine's Day.
e.zh: 我的生日在二月,就在情人节之后。

e.en: {February} usually has only 28 days.
e.zh: 二月通常只有二十八天。

e.en: The lab tested the water for {fecal} bacteria.
e.zh: 实验室检测了水中的粪便细菌。

e.en: Doctors ordered a {fecal} sample to diagnose the infection.
e.zh: 医生要求采集粪便样本来诊断感染。

e.en: Dog {feces} on the sidewalk is a common complaint here.
e.zh: 人行道上的狗粪是这里常见的投诉。

e.en: The trail was littered with animal {feces}.
e.zh: 小路上散落着动物粪便。

feckless.t: adj. 无能的；不负责任的

e.en: His {feckless} younger brother kept losing every job he got.
e.zh: 他那个不中用的弟弟每份工作都做不长。

e.en: The novel mocks the {feckless} aristocrats of the era.
e.zh: 这部小说嘲讽了那个时代无能的贵族。

e.en: Voters were tired of the government's {fecklessness} on housing.
e.zh: 选民们厌倦了政府在住房问题上的无所作为。

e.en: His {fecklessness} with money eventually cost him the business.
e.zh: 他在金钱上的不负责任最终让他失去了生意。

e.en: The valley's {fecund} soil produces three harvests a year.
e.zh: 这片山谷肥沃的土壤一年能收成三次。

e.en: She has a remarkably {fecund} imagination for storytelling.
e.zh: 她在讲故事方面有着异常丰富的想象力。

e.en: The {fecundity} of rabbits makes them hard to control.
e.zh: 兔子的繁殖力使它们难以控制。

e.en: Critics praised the artist's astonishing creative {fecundity}.
e.zh: 评论家盛赞这位艺术家惊人的创作多产。

fed.t:
n. 美联储（Federal Reserve）
v. feed 的过去式

e.en: I already {fed} the cat this morning.
e.zh: 我今早已经喂过猫了。

e.en: The {Fed} raised interest rates again last week.
e.zh: 美联储上周再次加息。

fedayeen.t: n. 敢死队（阿拉伯武装人员）

e.en: Reports mentioned {fedayeen} fighters operating along the border.
e.zh: 报道提到敢死队战士在边境一带活动。

e.en: The documentary traces the history of the {fedayeen} movement.
e.zh: 这部纪录片追溯了敢死队运动的历史。

federal.t: adj. 联邦的；中央政府的

e.en: She works for a {federal} agency in Washington.
e.zh: 她在华盛顿一家联邦机构工作。

e.en: {Federal} law overrides state law in this matter.
e.zh: 在此事上联邦法律高于州法律。

e.en: The professor teaches a course on American {federalism}.
e.zh: 这位教授开设了一门美国联邦制的课程。

e.en: Debates over {federalism} shaped the early republic.
e.zh: 关于联邦制的争论塑造了早期共和国。

federalist.t:
n. 联邦主义者
adj. 联邦主义的

e.en: He wrote a passionate {federalist} essay defending the constitution.
e.zh: 他写了一篇热情的联邦主义文章捍卫宪法。

e.en: The {Federalist} Papers are still studied in law schools today.
e.zh: 《联邦党人文集》至今仍是法学院的研读教材。

e.en: The {federalization} of healthcare remains a controversial proposal.
e.zh: 医疗保健的联邦化至今仍是个有争议的提案。

e.en: Critics opposed the {federalization} of local police forces.
e.zh: 批评者反对将地方警察纳入联邦管辖。

federalize.t: v. 使联邦化；划归联邦管辖

e.en: The governor asked the president to {federalize} the National Guard.
e.zh: 州长请求总统将国民警卫队纳入联邦指挥。

e.en: Some lawmakers want to {federalize} election standards across states.
e.zh: 一些议员希望将各州的选举标准统一到联邦层面。

federally.t: adv. 由联邦政府；在联邦层面

e.en: This program is {federally} funded but locally run.
e.zh: 该项目由联邦拨款,但由地方运营。

e.en: Marijuana is still {federally} illegal in the United States.
e.zh: 在美国大麻在联邦层面仍属非法。

e.en: Several small republics decided to {federate} for mutual defense.
e.zh: 几个小共和国决定结成联邦以共同防御。

e.en: The platform lets independent servers {federate} into one network.
e.zh: 该平台让独立服务器联合成一个网络。

e.en: Mastodon is a {federated} social network without a central owner.
e.zh: Mastodon 是一个没有中心所有者的联邦式社交网络。

e.en: The {federated} states share defense and currency policy.
e.zh: 这些联邦成员国共享国防和货币政策。

e.en: Russia is officially called the Russian {Federation}.
e.zh: 俄罗斯的正式名称是俄罗斯联邦。

e.en: The teachers' {federation} called for a nationwide strike.
e.zh: 教师联合会呼吁全国罢工。

e.en: Brazil's official name is the {Federative} Republic of Brazil.
e.zh: 巴西的正式国名是巴西联邦共和国。

e.en: The country adopted a {federative} system after the war.
e.zh: 该国在战后采纳了联邦制。

fedora.t: n. 软呢帽；Linux 发行版名

e.en: He wore a black {fedora} tilted to one side.
e.zh: 他歪戴着一顶黑色软呢帽。

e.en: The detective in the film never took off his {fedora}.
e.zh: 片中的侦探从不摘下他的软呢帽。

e.en: There's a small {fee} for using the parking lot.
e.zh: 使用停车场需要支付一笔小额费用。

e.en: The lawyer charges a flat {fee} for the consultation.
e.zh: 这位律师对咨询收取固定费用。

e.en: Her grandfather has grown {feeble} in recent months.
e.zh: 她的祖父最近几个月变得虚弱了。

e.en: He gave a {feeble} excuse for being late again.
e.zh: 他又一次为迟到找了个站不住脚的借口。

e.en: The {feebleness} of his voice worried everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他声音的虚弱让屋里所有人都担心。

e.en: Critics pointed out the {feebleness} of the government's response.
e.zh: 批评人士指出政府反应的软弱无力。

e.en: The patient waved {feebly} from the hospital bed.
e.zh: 病人在病床上无力地挥了挥手。

e.en: He protested {feebly} but eventually agreed.
e.zh: 他无力地抗议了一下,但最终还是同意了。

feed.t:
n. 信息流（社交/RSS）
v. 喂养；输入

e.en: Don't forget to {feed} the dog before you leave.
e.zh: 出门前别忘了喂狗。

e.en: I keep scrolling my Instagram {feed} when I'm bored.
e.zh: 无聊时我就一直刷我的 Instagram 信息流。

e.en: Please send me your {feedback} on the draft by Friday.
e.zh: 请在周五前把你对草稿的反馈发给我。

e.en: The microphone produced a loud {feedback} squeal.
e.zh: 麦克风发出了刺耳的啸叫声。

e.en: The team gathered all the user {feedbacks} into a single report.
e.zh: 团队把所有用户反馈整理成一份报告。

e.en: Climate {feedbacks} can amplify small temperature changes.
e.zh: 气候反馈机制会放大微小的温度变化。

feeder.t: n. 进给装置；支线；喂食者

e.en: Squirrels keep raiding the bird {feeder} in our yard.
e.zh: 松鼠老来抢我家院子里的喂鸟器。

e.en: This road is a {feeder} to the main highway.
e.zh: 这条路是通向主高速的支路。

feeding.t:
n. 喂养；进料
v. feed 的现在分词

e.en: The baby is {feeding} every two hours right now.
e.zh: 宝宝现在每两小时就要喂一次。

e.en: Night {feeding} is exhausting for new parents.
e.zh: 夜间喂奶对新手父母来说很累人。

e.en: Cattle spend their final months at a {feedlot} before slaughter.
e.zh: 牛在屠宰前的最后几个月会待在饲养场里。

e.en: Environmentalists criticize the runoff from large {feedlot} operations.
e.zh: 环保人士批评大型饲养场的污水排放。

feeds.t: n. feed 的复数；多条信息流

e.en: She {feeds} the chickens every morning before breakfast.
e.zh: 她每天早餐前都会喂鸡。

e.en: I follow several news {feeds} on my phone.
e.zh: 我手机上订阅了好几个新闻源。

e.en: The refinery uses crude oil as its main {feedstock}.
e.zh: 这家炼油厂以原油为主要原料。

e.en: Recycled plastic can serve as {feedstock} for new products.
e.zh: 回收塑料可以作为新产品的原料。

e.en: Corn is the most common {feedstuff} for American livestock.
e.zh: 玉米是美国牲畜最常用的饲料。

e.en: Rising grain prices pushed up {feedstuff} costs for farmers.
e.zh: 粮价上涨推高了农民的饲料成本。

e.en: Tall {fescue} grows well in cool, shady yards.
e.zh: 高羊茅在凉爽多荫的院子里长势很好。

e.en: He reseeded the lawn with a hardy {fescue} blend.
e.zh: 他用一种耐用的羊茅草混种重新铺了草坪。

fess.t: v. 坦白，承认（俚语，常作 fess up）

e.en: Come on, just {fess} up about who ate the cake.
e.zh: 得了,谁吃了蛋糕就老实交代吧。

e.en: He finally decided to {fess} up to his boss.
e.zh: 他最终决定向老板坦白这件事。

e.en: Last weekend's food {fest} drew a record crowd.
e.zh: 上周末的美食节吸引了创纪录的人潮。

e.en: The reunion turned into a four-hour gossip {fest}.
e.zh: 这场聚会最后变成了一场长达四小时的八卦大会。

e.en: The square was decorated in full {festal} colors.
e.zh: 广场被装点上节日的缤纷色彩。

e.en: A {festal} mood filled the village on midsummer's eve.
e.zh: 仲夏夜的村庄洋溢着节庆的气氛。

fester.t:
v. 化脓，溃烂
v. (怨恨等) 郁积恶化

e.en: Don't let small disagreements {fester} into bigger conflicts.
e.zh: 别让小分歧积累成更大的冲突。

e.en: The wound began to {fester} after a few days.
e.zh: 几天后伤口开始化脓。

festering.t: adj. 化脓的；日益恶化的

e.en: Years of {festering} resentment finally exploded at the meeting.
e.zh: 积压多年的怨气终于在会议上爆发了。

e.en: The doctor cleaned the {festering} cut on his leg.
e.zh: 医生清理了他腿上化脓的伤口。

festival.t:
n. 节日，庆典
n. 音乐节，电影节

e.en: They drove all night to reach the music {festival}.
e.zh: 他们开了一整夜车去赶那场音乐节。

e.en: The lantern {festival} lights up the whole old town.
e.zh: 灯笼节把整座老城都照亮了。

festivals.t: n. festival 的复数：节日，庆典

e.en: Summer {festivals} bring tourists from all over the world.
e.zh: 夏季的各种节庆吸引着来自世界各地的游客。

e.en: Many religious {festivals} are celebrated with family meals.
e.zh: 许多宗教节日都是通过家庭聚餐来庆祝的。

e.en: The office had a {festive} atmosphere on Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 周五下午办公室里洋溢着节日般的气氛。

e.en: She wore a {festive} red dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条喜庆的红色裙子去参加派对。

e.en: The streets were {festively} lit for the New Year.
e.zh: 为迎接新年,街道被装点得喜气洋洋。

e.en: She {festively} wrapped each gift in gold paper.
e.zh: 她用金色包装纸把每份礼物都包得喜气洋洋。

festivity.t:
n. 欢庆，喜庆气氛
n. 庆祝活动

e.en: There was an air of {festivity} throughout the village.
e.zh: 整个村庄都弥漫着一股节庆的氛围。

e.en: The wedding {festivity} lasted well into the night.
e.zh: 婚礼的庆祝活动一直持续到深夜。

festoon.t:
v. 用花彩装饰
n. 花彩，彩带

e.en: Volunteers {festoon} the hall with paper flowers each spring.
e.zh: 志愿者们每年春天都会用纸花装点礼堂。

e.en: A long {festoon} of lights hung above the patio.
e.zh: 露台上方挂着一长串彩灯。

festschrift.t: n. 纪念文集（致敬学者的论文集）

e.en: His students published a {festschrift} for his eightieth birthday.
e.zh: 他的学生们为他八十岁生日出版了一本纪念文集。

e.en: The {festschrift} collected essays from her former colleagues.
e.zh: 这本纪念文集收录了她昔日同事们的论文。

feta.t: n. 菲达奶酪（希腊羊奶奶酪）

e.en: She crumbled some {feta} over the Greek salad.
e.zh: 她在希腊沙拉上撒了一些菲达奶酪碎。

e.en: Authentic {feta} is made from sheep's milk.
e.zh: 正宗的菲达奶酪是用绵羊奶制成的。

e.en: The doctor monitored the {fetal} heartbeat carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细监测着胎儿的心跳。

e.en: He curled up in a {fetal} position on the couch.
e.zh: 他蜷缩成胎儿的姿势躺在沙发上。

fetch.t:
v. 获取，拉取（数据/请求）
v. 去拿来

e.en: Could you {fetch} my glasses from the kitchen?
e.zh: 你能从厨房帮我拿一下眼镜吗?

e.en: The app uses {fetch} to load data from the server.
e.zh: 这个应用通过 fetch 从服务器加载数据。

fetched.t: v. fetch 的过去式：已取来，已获取

e.en: The painting {fetched} two million dollars at auction.
e.zh: 那幅画在拍卖会上拍出了两百万美元。

e.en: She {fetched} a glass of water for the guest.
e.zh: 她给客人端来了一杯水。

fetches.t: v. fetch 的三单：获取，拉取

e.en: The browser {fetches} fresh data every five seconds.
e.zh: 浏览器每五秒钟获取一次最新数据。

e.en: His old guitar still {fetches} a high price online.
e.zh: 他那把旧吉他在网上仍能卖出高价。

fetching.t:
adj. 迷人的，吸引人的
v. 正在获取

e.en: She looked quite {fetching} in her new coat.
e.zh: 她穿着新外套显得相当迷人。

e.en: The script is {fetching} user data from the API.
e.zh: 这段脚本正在从 API 获取用户数据。

e.en: She smiled {fetchingly} at the camera during the shoot.
e.zh: 拍摄时她对着镜头嫣然一笑,十分动人。

e.en: The puppy tilted its head {fetchingly} at the visitors.
e.zh: 小狗朝来访者歪着脑袋,样子萌得让人心化。

fete.t:
n. 庆典，盛会
v. 设宴款待，隆重庆祝

e.en: The village will {fete} the team after their championship.
e.zh: 村里将在球队夺冠后为他们举行庆祝活动。

e.en: The summer {fete} raised funds for the local school.
e.zh: 夏季庆典为当地学校筹集了资金。

fetes.t:
n. fete 的复数：庆典
v. 设宴款待

e.en: Small church {fetes} are still common in English villages.
e.zh: 小型的教堂集市在英国乡村依然常见。

e.en: The city {fetes} its returning Olympic champions every four years.
e.zh: 这座城市每四年都会盛情迎接归来的奥运冠军。

e.en: A {fetid} smell rose from the neglected drain.
e.zh: 一股恶臭从那条无人清理的下水道里升起。

e.en: They waded through the {fetid} swamp at dawn.
e.zh: 他们在黎明时分蹚过那片臭气熏天的沼泽。

fetish.t:
n. 恋物癖
n. 盲目崇拜的事物

e.en: He has a strange {fetish} for vintage typewriters.
e.zh: 他对老式打字机有一种奇怪的痴迷。

e.en: Some cultures view certain objects as a sacred {fetish}.
e.zh: 一些文化把某些物品视为神圣的灵物。

e.en: The book critiques modern consumer {fetishism}.
e.zh: 这本书批判了现代消费主义的拜物心态。

e.en: Marx wrote extensively about commodity {fetishism}.
e.zh: 马克思曾大量论述商品拜物教这一概念。

fetishist.t: n. 恋物癖者；盲目崇拜者

e.en: He's a self-confessed coffee {fetishist} who owns six grinders.
e.zh: 他自称是个咖啡狂热爱好者,家里有六台磨豆机。

e.en: The novel's narrator turns out to be a shoe {fetishist}.
e.zh: 小说的叙述者原来是个对鞋子有特殊癖好的人。

fetishistic.t: adj. 恋物癖的；盲目崇拜的

e.en: Critics called the film's gun shots {fetishistic} and excessive.
e.zh: 影评人称这部电影对枪械的特写过于迷恋且过头。

e.en: He has an almost {fetishistic} attachment to his old notebooks.
e.zh: 他对自己的旧笔记本几乎有一种近乎痴迷的依恋。

fetishization.t: n. 把某物变为崇拜对象；恋物化

e.en: The article criticizes the {fetishization} of long working hours.
e.zh: 这篇文章批判了对长时间工作的盲目崇拜。

e.en: Pop culture's {fetishization} of youth shapes advertising trends.
e.zh: 流行文化对年轻的过度崇拜影响着广告潮流。

fetishize.t: v. 将…视为崇拜对象，过度迷恋

e.en: Tech bros tend to {fetishize} hustle culture.
e.zh: 科技圈的小哥们往往把奋斗文化奉为信条。

e.en: We shouldn't {fetishize} suffering as a path to success.
e.zh: 我们不该把吃苦当作通往成功的必经之路来盲目推崇。

fetishized.t: v. fetishize 的过去式/分词：被过度迷恋的

e.en: Hollywood has long {fetishized} the lone genius narrative.
e.zh: 好莱坞长期以来都对孤独天才的叙事津津乐道、过度推崇。

e.en: The brand {fetishized} minimalism to the point of parody.
e.zh: 这个品牌对极简主义的痴迷已经到了荒谬的地步。

e.en: The horse injured its {fetlock} during the race.
e.zh: 那匹马在比赛中弄伤了球节。

e.en: The vet gently examined the pony's swollen {fetlock}.
e.zh: 兽医轻轻检查了小马肿胀的球节。

fetter.t:
v. 束缚，限制
n. 脚镣，桎梏

e.en: Heavy regulations can {fetter} small businesses.
e.zh: 繁重的监管会束缚小型企业的发展。

e.en: He felt the routine {fetter} his creativity.
e.zh: 他觉得这种例行公事束缚了自己的创造力。

e.en: The prisoners were {fettered} and led across the courtyard.
e.zh: 囚犯们被戴上脚镣,被押着穿过院子。

e.en: She felt {fettered} by her parents' high expectations.
e.zh: 她觉得父母过高的期望束缚住了自己。

fettes.t: (罕用) 多为人名/校名 Fettes

e.en: He attended {Fettes} College before going to Oxford.
e.zh: 他先是就读于费蒂斯公学,之后才进入牛津。

e.en: {Fettes} alumni include several well-known politicians.
e.zh: 费蒂斯公学的校友中有几位著名政治人物。

fettle.t: n. 状态，情况（多用 in fine fettle）

e.en: After the holiday, he was in fine {fettle} again.
e.zh: 度完假后,他又恢复了良好的状态。

e.en: The old car is still in surprisingly good {fettle}.
e.zh: 这辆老车的状态还出奇地好。

e.en: We ordered creamy {fettuccine} alfredo at the trattoria.
e.zh: 我们在那家小餐馆点了奶油香浓的奶油培根宽面。

e.en: Homemade {fettuccine} tastes much better than dried pasta.
e.zh: 自制的宽面条比干意面好吃得多。

e.en: The ultrasound clearly showed the {fetus} moving.
e.zh: 超声波清楚地显示出胎儿在活动。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {fetus} throughout the pregnancy.
e.zh: 医生在整个孕期都持续监测胎儿的状况。

feu.t: n. (苏格兰) 永久租地权

e.en: The Scottish landlord granted the tenant a perpetual {feu}.
e.zh: 那位苏格兰地主授予租户一份永久封地权。

e.en: Old records show the {feu} was paid in silver coins.
e.zh: 旧档案显示该封地租金以银币支付。

feud.t:
n. 长期争斗，宿怨
v. 长期不和

e.en: The two families have been locked in a bitter {feud} for decades.
e.zh: 这两个家族几十年来一直陷于激烈的世仇。

e.en: Their public {feud} on social media entertained millions of fans.
e.zh: 他们在社交媒体上的公开骂战娱乐了数百万粉丝。

feudal.t: adj. 封建的，封建制度的

e.en: The {feudal} system tied peasants to the land they worked.
e.zh: 封建制度把农民束缚在他们耕作的土地上。

e.en: Critics say the company culture feels almost {feudal}.
e.zh: 批评者说这家公司的文化几乎像封建制一样。

feudalism.t: n. 封建制度，封建主义

e.en: European {feudalism} gradually declined after the Black Death.
e.zh: 欧洲封建制度在黑死病之后逐渐衰落。

e.en: The textbook explains how {feudalism} shaped medieval society.
e.zh: 这本教科书解释了封建制度如何塑造了中世纪社会。

e.en: The {feuding} neighbors finally agreed to a truce.
e.zh: 那对结怨的邻居终于同意停战。

e.en: Two {feuding} tech giants are competing for the same market.
e.zh: 两家结怨的科技巨头正在争夺同一个市场。

fever.t:
n. 发烧，发热
n. 狂热，热潮

e.en: The child has a high {fever} and needs rest.
e.zh: 那孩子发高烧,需要休息。

e.en: World Cup {fever} swept across the entire country.
e.zh: 世界杯热潮席卷了整个国家。

fevered.t: adj. 发烧的；狂热的，激动的

e.en: She made {fevered} preparations the night before the launch.
e.zh: 她在发布前夜进行了狂热的准备。

e.en: His {fevered} brow worried the doctor on call.
e.zh: 他发烫的额头让值班医生很担心。

e.en: Many people take {feverfew} to help prevent migraines.
e.zh: 许多人服用小白菊来帮助预防偏头痛。

e.en: She grows {feverfew} in her herb garden every summer.
e.zh: 她每年夏天都在草药园里种小白菊。

feverish.t:
adj. 发烧的
adj. 狂热的，紧张兴奋的

e.en: The patient felt {feverish} and complained of chills.
e.zh: 病人感到发烧,还说自己发冷。

e.en: Engineers worked at a {feverish} pace before the deadline.
e.zh: 工程师们在截止日前以狂热的速度工作。

feverishly.t: adv. 狂热地，紧张忙碌地

e.en: She typed {feverishly} to finish the report on time.
e.zh: 她疯狂地打字以便按时完成报告。

e.en: Volunteers worked {feverishly} to clear the flood debris.
e.zh: 志愿者们拼命工作以清理洪水残骸。

fevers.t: n. fever 的复数：发烧，热潮

e.en: High {fevers} in infants always require medical attention.
e.zh: 婴儿高烧总是需要就医。

e.en: Tropical {fevers} like dengue spread quickly during the rainy season.
e.zh: 像登革热这样的热带热病在雨季迅速传播。

few.t:
adj. 很少的，不多的
pron. 少数

e.en: Only a {few} students showed up for the early lecture.
e.zh: 只有少数几个学生来听早课。

e.en: I have a {few} questions before we sign the contract.
e.zh: 在签合同前我有几个问题想问。

fewer.t: adj. 更少的（few 的比较级）

e.en: This year we hired {fewer} interns than last summer.
e.zh: 今年我们招的实习生比去年夏天少。

e.en: Eating {fewer} processed foods can improve your health.
e.zh: 少吃加工食品可以改善你的健康。

fermented.t:
adj. 发酵的
v. fermented 的过去式

e.en: Korean cuisine relies heavily on {fermented} vegetables like kimchi.
e.zh: 韩国料理大量使用泡菜等发酵蔬菜。

e.en: The grapes have already {fermented} into a young wine.
e.zh: 葡萄已经发酵成新酒了。

e.en: The brewery installed a stainless-steel {fermenter} last month.
e.zh: 上个月酒厂安装了一个不锈钢发酵罐。

e.en: Lab technicians monitor each {fermenter} around the clock.
e.zh: 实验员二十四小时监控每个发酵罐。

fermenting.t:
v. 发酵中
adj. 正在发酵的

e.en: A jar of cabbage is {fermenting} on the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 一罐卷心菜正在厨房台面上发酵。

e.en: Resentment had been {fermenting} among the staff for months.
e.zh: 员工中的不满情绪已经酝酿了好几个月。

e.en: Every electron is a {fermion} that obeys the Pauli exclusion principle.
e.zh: 每个电子都是遵循泡利不相容原理的费米子。

e.en: Physicists detected a new type of {fermion} in the experiment.
e.zh: 物理学家在实验中探测到了一种新型费米子。

e.en: A delicate {fern} grew in the shady corner of the garden.
e.zh: 花园阴凉的角落里长着一株娇嫩的蕨类植物。

e.en: She hung a Boston {fern} in the bathroom window.
e.zh: 她在浴室窗边挂了一盆波士顿蕨。

e.en: They hiked along the cool, {ferny} forest path.
e.zh: 他们沿着凉爽、长满蕨类的林间小径徒步。

e.en: The tea has a delicate, {ferny} aroma.
e.zh: 这种茶有一股淡雅的蕨叶清香。

e.en: The startup faced {ferocious} competition from larger rivals.
e.zh: 这家初创公司面临来自大公司激烈的竞争。

e.en: A {ferocious} storm knocked out power across the region.
e.zh: 一场猛烈的风暴使整个地区断电。

e.en: The two boxers fought {ferociously} in the final round.
e.zh: 两位拳击手在最后一回合凶猛地对打。

e.en: She defended her thesis {ferociously} against every objection.
e.zh: 她针对每一个质疑都激烈地捍卫自己的论文。

ferocities.t: n. ferocity 的复数，凶残之举

e.en: The documentary chronicled the {ferocities} of the civil war.
e.zh: 这部纪录片记录了内战中的种种暴行。

e.en: Historians cataloged the {ferocities} committed during the siege.
e.zh: 历史学家记录了围城期间发生的暴行。

e.en: The hurricane struck the coast with shocking {ferocity}.
e.zh: 飓风以惊人的猛烈程度袭击了海岸。

e.en: She argued her point with surprising {ferocity}.
e.zh: 她以出人意料的激烈态度阐述自己的观点。

ferranti.t: n. 弗兰蒂（英国电子公司/姓氏）

e.en: The {ferranti} Mark 1 was an early commercial computer.
e.zh: 费伦蒂一号是早期的商用计算机之一。

e.en: Engineers studied the {ferranti} effect on long transmission lines.
e.zh: 工程师们研究了长输电线路上的费伦蒂效应。

ferrara.t: n. 费拉拉（意大利城市）

e.en: Renaissance dukes turned {ferrara} into a center of art.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的公爵把费拉拉变成了艺术中心。

e.en: We cycled through the medieval streets of {ferrara}.
e.zh: 我们骑车穿过费拉拉的中世纪街道。

e.en: He saved for years to buy a vintage {ferrari}.
e.zh: 他攒了多年的钱买了一辆老款法拉利。

e.en: A red {ferrari} roared past us on the highway.
e.zh: 一辆红色法拉利在高速公路上呼啸而过。

ferrero.t: n. 费列罗（巧克力品牌）

e.en: She unwrapped a golden {ferrero} chocolate after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后她剥开一颗金色的费列罗巧克力。

e.en: {ferrero} reported record sales during the holiday season.
e.zh: 费列罗在假日季实现了创纪录的销售额。

ferret.t:
n. 雪貂
v. 搜出；查出

e.en: My niece keeps a pet {ferret} in her bedroom.
e.zh: 我侄女在卧室里养了一只宠物雪貂。

e.en: Investigators tried to {ferret} out the source of the leak.
e.zh: 调查人员试图查出泄密的源头。

e.en: The narrow {ferrete} ribbon was used to bind old documents.
e.zh: 那条窄窄的丝带用来装订旧文件。

e.en: She trimmed the bonnet with a strip of {ferrete}.
e.zh: 她用一条窄丝带装饰那顶帽子。

e.en: {ferric} chloride is often used to etch circuit boards.
e.zh: 氯化铁常用于蚀刻电路板。

e.en: The water's reddish tint comes from dissolved {ferric} compounds.
e.zh: 水的红色色调来自溶解的三价铁化合物。

e.en: Kathleen {ferrier} remains a beloved English contralto.
e.zh: 凯瑟琳·费里尔至今仍是备受喜爱的英国女低音。

e.en: The local {ferrier} trimmed the horse's hooves carefully.
e.zh: 当地的钉蹄匠仔细地修剪马蹄。

ferries.t:
n. ferry 的复数，渡轮
v. 摆渡

e.en: Several {ferries} cross the harbor every hour.
e.zh: 每小时都有几班渡轮穿越港口。

e.en: A driver {ferries} commuters between the station and the office.
e.zh: 一位司机在车站和办公室之间接送通勤者。

ferris.t: n. 费里斯（姓氏；摩天轮 Ferris wheel）

e.en: The kids begged for another ride on the {ferris} wheel.
e.zh: 孩子们央求着再坐一次摩天轮。

e.en: A giant {ferris} wheel dominates the London skyline.
e.zh: 一座巨大的摩天轮主宰着伦敦的天际线。

e.en: Her doctor checked her {ferritin} levels for signs of anemia.
e.zh: 医生检查了她的铁蛋白水平以排查贫血。

e.en: Low {ferritin} can cause fatigue and hair loss.
e.zh: 铁蛋白偏低会引起疲劳和脱发。

e.en: Iron, nickel, and cobalt are common {ferromagnetic} metals.
e.zh: 铁、镍和钴都是常见的铁磁性金属。

e.en: The hard drive stores data on a {ferromagnetic} surface.
e.zh: 硬盘把数据存储在铁磁性表面上。

e.en: Recyclers separate {ferrous} metals using powerful magnets.
e.zh: 回收商利用强磁铁分拣含铁金属。

e.en: Tap water sometimes contains traces of {ferrous} iron.
e.zh: 自来水中有时含有微量的亚铁。

e.en: The metal {ferrule} on his cane was scratched and dented.
e.zh: 他手杖上的金属箍已经划痕累累、凹凸不平。

e.en: A loose {ferrule} caused the brush bristles to fall out.
e.zh: 金属箍松动导致刷毛脱落了。

ferry.t:
n. 渡轮；渡口
v. 摆渡；运送

e.en: We took the morning {ferry} across the bay.
e.zh: 我们坐早班渡船穿过海湾。

e.en: Volunteers {ferry} supplies to the flooded village daily.
e.zh: 志愿者每天把物资运送到受灾的村庄。

e.en: An old wooden {ferryboat} still crosses the river each summer.
e.zh: 每年夏天一艘老旧的木制渡船仍在河上往返。

e.en: The {ferryboat} blew its horn as it left the dock.
e.zh: 渡船离开码头时鸣响了汽笛。

e.en: Two {ferryboats} shuttle tourists between the islands.
e.zh: 两艘渡船在岛屿之间接送游客。

e.en: Old photographs show {ferryboats} crowding the harbor.
e.zh: 老照片显示当时港口里挤满了渡船。

e.en: The {ferryman} rowed travelers across the misty river.
e.zh: 船夫划着小船把旅人渡过雾气弥漫的河流。

e.en: In the legend, the {ferryman} demands a coin for passage.
e.zh: 传说中那位船夫要收一枚硬币才肯渡人过河。

e.en: The valley's {fertile} soil produces excellent wine grapes.
e.zh: 这片山谷肥沃的土壤出产优质的酿酒葡萄。

e.en: Childhood reading gave her a {fertile} imagination.
e.zh: 童年的阅读让她有了丰富的想象力。

fertilisation.t: n. 受精；施肥（英式拼写）

e.en: Bees play a vital role in the {fertilisation} of flowers.
e.zh: 蜜蜂在花的授粉过程中起着至关重要的作用。

e.en: In vitro {fertilisation} has helped many couples conceive.
e.zh: 体外受精已经帮助许多夫妇成功怀孕。

fertilise.t: v. 使受精；施肥（英式拼写）

e.en: Gardeners {fertilise} their roses every spring.
e.zh: 园丁每年春天都给玫瑰施肥。

e.en: Pollen from the male flower must {fertilise} the female one.
e.zh: 雄花的花粉必须给雌花授粉。

fertilised.t: adj. 已受精的；已施肥的

e.en: The egg was {fertilised} in the lab last week.
e.zh: 那枚卵子上周在实验室里完成了受精。

e.en: Farmers {fertilised} the fields before the spring rains.
e.zh: 农民在春雨来临前给田地施了肥。

e.en: He spread organic {fertiliser} across the vegetable patch.
e.zh: 他在菜地里撒了一层有机肥料。

e.en: Too much {fertiliser} can actually harm young plants.
e.zh: 肥料用得太多反而会伤害幼苗。

e.en: The country's {fertility} rate has fallen to a historic low.
e.zh: 该国的生育率已跌至历史最低点。

e.en: Crop rotation helps maintain soil {fertility} over time.
e.zh: 轮作有助于长期保持土壤的肥力。

e.en: In vitro {fertilization} gave them their first child.
e.zh: 体外受精让他们迎来了第一个孩子。

e.en: Bees play a key role in the {fertilization} of flowers.
e.zh: 蜜蜂在花朵授粉过程中起着关键作用。

e.en: Remember to {fertilize} the lawn every six weeks.
e.zh: 记得每六周给草坪施一次肥。

e.en: Pollen from one flower can {fertilize} another nearby.
e.zh: 一朵花的花粉可以使附近的另一朵花受精。

fertilized.t: adj. 已受精的；已施肥的

e.en: She {fertilized} the tomato plants with compost tea.
e.zh: 她用堆肥茶给番茄苗施了肥。

e.en: Only one sperm successfully {fertilized} the egg.
e.zh: 只有一个精子成功使卵子受精。

e.en: Rising {fertilizer} prices are squeezing small farmers.
e.zh: 化肥价格上涨让小农户压力很大。

e.en: Coffee grounds make a surprisingly good {fertilizer}.
e.zh: 咖啡渣其实是一种很不错的肥料。

e.en: He spent the morning {fertilizing} the rose bushes.
e.zh: 他一上午都在给玫瑰花丛施肥。

e.en: Bees are essential for {fertilizing} most fruit crops.
e.zh: 蜜蜂对大多数果树的授粉至关重要。

e.en: She is a {fervent} supporter of animal rights.
e.zh: 她是动物权益的热情拥护者。

e.en: His {fervent} prayers echoed through the empty chapel.
e.zh: 他热切的祷告在空荡的小教堂里回响。

e.en: Fans {fervently} hoped their team would reach the final.
e.zh: 球迷们热切地希望自己的球队能打进决赛。

e.en: He {fervently} denied any involvement in the scandal.
e.zh: 他强烈否认与这起丑闻有任何关联。

e.en: The candidate gave a {fervid} speech to the crowd.
e.zh: 候选人对人群发表了一场充满激情的演讲。

e.en: Her {fervid} imagination filled the diary with wild stories.
e.zh: 她炽热的想象力把日记填满了天马行空的故事。

e.en: The startup pitched its idea with religious {fervor}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司以近乎狂热的劲头推销自己的想法。

e.en: Election night brought out unusual political {fervor}.
e.zh: 大选之夜激起了异乎寻常的政治热情。

fervour.t: n. 热情；激情（英式拼写）

e.en: The crowd cheered with patriotic {fervour}.
e.zh: 人群带着爱国热情欢呼起来。

e.en: She defended her thesis with surprising {fervour}.
e.zh: 她以出人意料的热情为自己的论文辩护。

fewest.t: adj. 最少的（few 的最高级）

e.en: The team with the {fewest} mistakes will win the trophy.
e.zh: 失误最少的队伍将赢得奖杯。

e.en: Choose the route with the {fewest} traffic lights.
e.zh: 选择红绿灯最少的那条路线。

e.en: The actress has a {fey} charm that audiences love.
e.zh: 那位女演员有一种观众喜爱的飘渺魅力。

e.en: His paintings depict {fey} creatures from old folktales.
e.zh: 他的画描绘了古老民间故事中的精灵生物。

feynman.t: n. 费曼（物理学家姓氏）

e.en: Richard {Feynman} won the Nobel Prize for quantum electrodynamics.
e.zh: 理查德·费曼因量子电动力学获得了诺贝尔奖。

e.en: The {Feynman} lectures remain essential reading for physics students.
e.zh: 费曼讲义至今仍是物理学生必读的经典。

e.en: The old man wore a red {fez} to the festival.
e.zh: 那位老人戴着一顶红色土耳其毡帽去参加节日。

e.en: Tourists often buy a {fez} as a souvenir from Morocco.
e.zh: 游客常从摩洛哥买一顶费兹帽作为纪念品。

e.en: The cardiologist measured {FFR} to assess the artery blockage.
e.zh: 心脏科医生测量血流储备分数来评估动脉阻塞。

e.en: An {FFR} value below 0.80 usually indicates significant stenosis.
e.zh: 血流储备分数低于0.80通常表示明显狭窄。

e.en: The power plant installed an {FGD} unit to remove sulfur dioxide.
e.zh: 该电厂安装了烟气脱硫装置来去除二氧化硫。

e.en: Modern {FGD} systems can capture over 95 percent of emissions.
e.zh: 现代脱硫系统可以捕集超过百分之九十五的排放。

e.en: The clinic was funded through the local {FHSA} budget.
e.zh: 那家诊所的资金来自当地家庭健康服务局的预算。

e.en: Doctors had to register with the {FHSA} before practicing.
e.zh: 医生在执业前必须向家庭健康服务局注册。

e.en: The {FIA} announced new safety regulations for next season.
e.zh: 国际汽联宣布了下赛季的新安全规则。

e.en: Drivers must be licensed by the {FIA} to compete in Formula One.
e.zh: 车手必须持有国际汽联颁发的执照才能参加一级方程式比赛。

e.en: Her {fiance} surprised her with a trip to Paris.
e.zh: 她的未婚夫给了她一个去巴黎旅行的惊喜。

e.en: My {fiance} and I are planning a small autumn wedding.
e.zh: 我和未婚夫正在筹备一场小型的秋季婚礼。

e.en: He introduced his {fiancee} to his parents over dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚餐时把未婚妻介绍给了父母。

e.en: His {fiancee} works as a pediatric nurse downtown.
e.zh: 他的未婚妻在市中心当儿科护士。

fianna.t: n. 爱尔兰传说中的武士团

e.en: Irish legends describe the {Fianna} as elite warrior bands.
e.zh: 爱尔兰传说把芬尼亚描述为精锐战士团。

e.en: The {Fianna} were led by the heroic Finn MacCool.
e.zh: 芬尼亚战士团由英雄芬恩·麦库尔率领。

e.en: The product launch turned into a complete {fiasco}.
e.zh: 那场产品发布会变成了一场彻底的惨败。

e.en: Their attempt to cook a Thanksgiving turkey was a {fiasco}.
e.zh: 他们尝试烤感恩节火鸡的结果是一场闹剧。

fiat.t: n. 法令；菲亚特（汽车品牌）

e.en: The new policy was imposed by executive {fiat}.
e.zh: 新政策是由行政命令强制推行的。

e.en: Most modern currencies are {fiat} money backed only by trust.
e.zh: 大多数现代货币都是仅靠信用支撑的法定货币。

fib.t:
n. 小谎
v. 撒小谎

e.en: The kid told a small {fib} about finishing his homework.
e.zh: 那孩子撒了个小谎说作业做完了。

e.en: Don't {fib} to your dentist about flossing every day.
e.zh: 别对你的牙医撒谎说你每天都用牙线。

e.en: Eating more {fiber} helps keep your digestion healthy.
e.zh: 多吃膳食纤维有助于保持消化系统健康。

e.en: Our neighborhood finally got high-speed {fiber} internet.
e.zh: 我们小区终于通了高速光纤网络。

e.en: The shelves are made from inexpensive {fiberboard}.
e.zh: 这些架子是用便宜的纤维板做的。

e.en: Cheap furniture often uses {fiberboard} instead of solid wood.
e.zh: 便宜的家具常用纤维板代替实木。

e.en: The boat hull is built from durable {fiberglass}.
e.zh: 这艘船的船体是用耐用的玻璃纤维制成的。

e.en: Wear gloves when handling {fiberglass} insulation.
e.zh: 处理玻璃纤维保温材料时要戴手套。

e.en: Cotton {fibers} make the fabric soft and breathable.
e.zh: 棉纤维让这种布料柔软透气。

e.en: Forensic experts found suspicious {fibers} on the victim's coat.
e.zh: 法医专家在死者外套上发现了可疑的纤维。

fibre.t: n. 纤维（fiber 的英式拼写）

e.en: British nutritionists recommend more {fibre} in daily meals.
e.zh: 英国营养师建议日常饮食中摄入更多纤维。

e.en: The new {fibre} broadband reaches a thousand megabits per second.
e.zh: 新的光纤宽带速度达到每秒一千兆比特。

e.en: The wardrobe is constructed from medium density {fibreboard}.
e.zh: 这个衣柜是用中密度纤维板制成的。

e.en: Builders used {fibreboard} panels to insulate the attic.
e.zh: 建筑工人用纤维板隔热阁楼。

fibreglass.t: n. 玻璃纤维（英式拼写）

e.en: The surfboard has a glossy {fibreglass} coating.
e.zh: 这块冲浪板有一层光亮的玻璃纤维涂层。

e.en: Loft insulation often uses rolls of pink {fibreglass}.
e.zh: 阁楼保温常使用一卷卷的粉色玻璃纤维。

fibres.t: n. 纤维（英式拼写复数）

e.en: Natural {fibres} like wool and linen breathe better than polyester.
e.zh: 羊毛和亚麻等天然纤维比聚酯纤维更透气。

e.en: Optical {fibres} carry data as pulses of light.
e.zh: 光纤以光脉冲的形式传输数据。

e.en: Each muscle {fibril} contracts to produce movement.
e.zh: 每根肌原纤维通过收缩产生动作。

e.en: Scientists imaged a single collagen {fibril} under the microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在显微镜下拍摄了一根胶原原纤维。

e.en: Atrial {fibrillation} increases the risk of stroke.
e.zh: 心房颤动会增加中风的风险。

e.en: The defibrillator can stop dangerous ventricular {fibrillation}.
e.zh: 除颤器可以制止危险的心室颤动。

e.en: {Fibrin} forms a mesh that helps blood clots stabilize.
e.zh: 纤维蛋白形成网状结构帮助血凝块稳定。

e.en: The wound's scab is largely made of dried {fibrin}.
e.zh: 伤口的痂主要由干燥的纤维蛋白构成。

e.en: The lab measured her {fibrinogen} levels before surgery.
e.zh: 实验室在手术前检测了她的纤维蛋白原水平。

e.en: Low {fibrinogen} can lead to excessive bleeding.
e.zh: 纤维蛋白原过低可能导致出血不止。

e.en: Doctors gave a {fibrinolytic} drug to dissolve the clot quickly.
e.zh: 医生使用了纤溶药物以快速溶解血栓。

e.en: The body's own {fibrinolytic} system breaks down old clots.
e.zh: 人体自身的纤溶系统会分解陈旧的血栓。

e.en: Each {fibroblast} produces collagen to repair damaged tissue.
e.zh: 每个成纤维细胞都会产生胶原蛋白以修复受损组织。

e.en: Skincare ads often boast about boosting {fibroblast} activity.
e.zh: 护肤品广告常吹嘘能促进成纤维细胞活性。

e.en: Many women experience {fibrocystic} breast changes after thirty.
e.zh: 许多女性在三十岁后会出现纤维囊性乳腺变化。

e.en: The doctor confirmed the lump was {fibrocystic} and benign.
e.zh: 医生确认这个肿块是纤维囊性的良性病变。

fibroid.t:
n. 子宫肌瘤
adj. 纤维状的

e.en: The ultrasound revealed a small {fibroid} in her uterus.
e.zh: 超声检查显示她的子宫里有一个小肌瘤。

e.en: Most {fibroid} tumors are noncancerous and grow slowly.
e.zh: 大多数纤维瘤是良性的,生长缓慢。

e.en: People with {fibromyalgia} often suffer chronic muscle pain.
e.zh: 纤维肌痛患者常常承受慢性肌肉疼痛。

e.en: There is no single test that diagnoses {fibromyalgia} definitively.
e.zh: 目前没有一种检查可以明确诊断纤维肌痛。

e.en: Long-term inflammation can lead to liver {fibrosis}.
e.zh: 长期炎症可能导致肝纤维化。

e.en: Cystic {fibrosis} affects the lungs and digestive system.
e.zh: 囊性纤维化会影响肺部和消化系统。

e.en: The biopsy showed {fibrotic} scarring throughout the lung.
e.zh: 活检显示整个肺部都有纤维化瘢痕。

e.en: Chronic injury often leaves {fibrotic} tissue behind.
e.zh: 慢性损伤常会留下纤维化的组织。

fibrous.t: adj. 纤维状的；含纤维的

e.en: Celery has a tough, {fibrous} stem that needs peeling.
e.zh: 芹菜有坚韧多纤维的茎,需要去皮。

e.en: Tendons are made of strong {fibrous} connective tissue.
e.zh: 肌腱由强韧的纤维结缔组织构成。

e.en: He fractured his {fibula} during the soccer match.
e.zh: 他在足球比赛中折断了腓骨。

e.en: The {fibula} runs alongside the larger tibia in the lower leg.
e.zh: 腓骨在小腿中与较粗的胫骨并排走行。

e.en: The surgeon repaired the torn {fibular} ligament.
e.zh: 外科医生修复了撕裂的腓骨韧带。

e.en: A {fibular} stress fracture can sideline runners for weeks.
e.zh: 腓骨应力性骨折可能让跑者停训数周。

e.en: The farmer's little {fice} barked at every passing stranger.
e.zh: 农夫那条小杂种狗对每个路过的陌生人都狂吠。

e.en: Country folks often kept a {fice} to chase off rats.
e.zh: 乡下人常养一条小杂种狗来赶老鼠。

e.en: The weather in spring is famously {fickle} and unpredictable.
e.zh: 春天的天气出了名的多变莫测。

e.en: Pop fans can be {fickle} and quickly move on.
e.zh: 流行音乐迷喜新厌旧，很快就转移兴趣。

e.en: The {fickleness} of voters surprised the campaign team.
e.zh: 选民的善变令竞选团队感到意外。

e.en: He complained about the {fickleness} of the stock market.
e.zh: 他抱怨股市变幻无常。

e.en: She mostly reads science {fiction} on her commute.
e.zh: 她通勤时主要看科幻小说。

e.en: The story turned out to be pure {fiction}.
e.zh: 那个故事原来纯属虚构。

e.en: Sherlock Holmes is a famous {fictional} detective.
e.zh: 福尔摩斯是一位著名的虚构侦探。

e.en: The movie is set in a {fictional} town in Maine.
e.zh: 电影背景设在缅因州一个虚构的小镇。

e.en: The film is a {fictionalization} of real events from the war.
e.zh: 这部电影是对战争真实事件的虚构改编。

e.en: Critics objected to the heavy {fictionalization} of her life story.
e.zh: 评论家反对她的生平故事被大幅虚构化。

e.en: The author chose to {fictionalize} her grandmother's escape.
e.zh: 作者选择把祖母的逃亡经历改编成小说。

e.en: Documentaries shouldn't {fictionalize} key historical facts.
e.zh: 纪录片不应虚构关键的历史事实。

fictionalized.t: adj. 经过小说化处理的

e.en: The series is a {fictionalized} account of the royal family.
e.zh: 该剧是对王室生活的虚构改编。

e.en: He {fictionalized} his childhood for the novel.
e.zh: 他将自己的童年虚构化写进了小说。

e.en: The town is {fictionally} renamed to protect residents' privacy.
e.zh: 为保护居民隐私，小镇在书中被虚构改名。

e.en: Some events are {fictionally} dramatized for the screen.
e.zh: 有些事件为了影视效果被虚构化处理。

e.en: He opened the account under a {fictitious} name.
e.zh: 他用一个虚假的名字开了账户。

e.en: The address she gave turned out to be {fictitious}.
e.zh: 她给的地址原来是编造的。

e.en: The novel blurs the line between real and {fictive} worlds.
e.zh: 这部小说模糊了现实与虚构世界的界限。

e.en: Anthropologists study {fictive} kinship in many cultures.
e.zh: 人类学家研究许多文化中的拟制亲属关系。

ficus.t: n. 榕属植物；无花果树

e.en: My {ficus} dropped half its leaves after I moved it.
e.zh: 我移动榕树之后它掉了一半的叶子。

e.en: A tall {ficus} sits in the corner of the office lobby.
e.zh: 办公室大堂角落里立着一棵高大的榕树。

fiddle.t:
n. 小提琴
v. 摆弄；瞎折腾

e.en: Stop trying to {fiddle} with the volume knob.
e.zh: 别再瞎摆弄音量旋钮了。

e.en: Grandpa can still play the {fiddle} at parties.
e.zh: 爷爷在聚会上还能拉小提琴。

fiddled.t: v. 摆弄；瞎搞（fiddle 的过去式）

e.en: She {fiddled} nervously with her phone during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时她紧张地摆弄着手机。

e.en: The accountant {fiddled} the books to hide losses.
e.zh: 会计篡改账目以掩盖亏损。

e.en: We sautéed fresh {fiddlehead} ferns with garlic and butter.
e.zh: 我们用蒜和黄油煎炒新鲜的蕨菜嫩芽。

e.en: The chef garnished the dish with a curly {fiddlehead}.
e.zh: 厨师用一颗卷曲的蕨菜嫩芽点缀这道菜。

fiddler.t: n. 小提琴手；爱瞎摆弄的人

e.en: A street {fiddler} played near the cafe entrance.
e.zh: 一位街头小提琴手在咖啡馆门口演奏。

e.en: The wedding band's {fiddler} stole the show.
e.zh: 婚礼乐队的小提琴手抢尽了风头。

e.en: Several {fiddlers} gathered for the weekly folk session.
e.zh: 几位小提琴手聚在一起参加每周的民谣演奏。

e.en: The {fiddlers} tuned up before the barn dance began.
e.zh: 乡村舞会开始前，小提琴手们都在调音。

fiddles.t:
n. 小提琴（复数）
v. 摆弄（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {fiddles} with his pen whenever he's thinking.
e.zh: 他思考时总爱摆弄手里的笔。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {fiddles} from Ireland.
e.zh: 这家店出售来自爱尔兰的手工小提琴。

fiddling.t:
v. 摆弄；瞎折腾
adj. 琐碎的

e.en: Stop {fiddling} with the thermostat — it's fine.
e.zh: 别再瞎调温控器了，它好好的。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {fiddling} with code.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在捣鼓代码。

fiddly.t: adj. 需精细操作的；麻烦的

e.en: Assembling the watch is a {fiddly} job.
e.zh: 组装手表是件费手又繁琐的活。

e.en: The buttons on this jacket are really {fiddly}.
e.zh: 这件外套的扣子真的很难扣。

fide.t: adj. 诚信的（拉丁语，多用于 bona fide）

e.en: He's a bona {fide} expert in machine learning.
e.zh: 他是机器学习领域真正的专家。

e.en: The certificate proves she's a bona {fide} graduate.
e.zh: 证书证明她是真正的毕业生。

fidelity.t: n. 忠诚；保真度（音视频）

e.en: The headphones reproduce music with stunning {fidelity}.
e.zh: 这副耳机能极其高保真地还原音乐。

e.en: He valued loyalty and {fidelity} above all else.
e.zh: 他把忠诚与信守看得高于一切。

fidget.t:
v. 烦躁不安；小动作不停
n. 坐立不安的人

e.en: Try not to {fidget} during the photo shoot.
e.zh: 拍照时尽量不要乱动。

e.en: Kids often {fidget} when they're bored in class.
e.zh: 孩子们上课无聊时常会坐立不安。

fidgeting.t: v. 烦躁不安；不停小动作

e.en: He kept {fidgeting} with his ring throughout the meeting.
e.zh: 整场会议他都在摆弄手上的戒指。

e.en: Her constant {fidgeting} distracted everyone in the row.
e.zh: 她不停的小动作让整排人都分心了。

fidgety.t: adj. 坐立不安的；好动的

e.en: The toddler grew {fidgety} after sitting for an hour.
e.zh: 小孩坐了一个小时后变得焦躁不安。

e.en: I get {fidgety} when I drink too much coffee.
e.zh: 咖啡喝多了我就会坐不住。

e.en: She named her golden retriever {Fido}.
e.zh: 她给金毛犬取名叫菲多。

e.en: In old cartoons the family dog is often called {Fido}.
e.zh: 老动画片里家里的狗常常叫菲多。

fiduciary.t:
n. 受托人
adj. 受托的；信托的

e.en: Financial advisers have a {fiduciary} duty to their clients.
e.zh: 理财顾问对客户负有受托义务。

e.en: Board members must act in a {fiduciary} capacity.
e.zh: 董事会成员必须以受托人身份行事。

e.en: "{Fie} on such cowardly behavior!" the old knight cried.
e.zh: "这种懦弱的行为真可耻！"老骑士喊道。

e.en: The Shakespearean character muttered "{fie}" under her breath.
e.zh: 那个莎剧角色低声嘟囔着"呸"。

e.en: The lord granted his loyal knight a small {fief}.
e.zh: 领主把一小块封地赐给了他忠诚的骑士。

e.en: That department has become his personal {fief}.
e.zh: 那个部门已经成了他的私人领地。

fiefdom.t: n. 封地；个人势力范围

e.en: The manager runs the marketing team like his own {fiefdom}.
e.zh: 那位经理把市场团队管成了他的私人领地。

e.en: Each warlord controlled a small {fiefdom} in the region.
e.zh: 每个军阀都在那片地区控制着一小块领地。

field.t:
n. 字段（表单、数据库）；领域
n. 田野；场地

e.en: The soccer {field} was muddy after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后足球场一片泥泞。

e.en: She's a leading expert in the {field} of robotics.
e.zh: 她是机器人领域的顶尖专家。

e.en: The {fielder} caught the ball just before the wall.
e.zh: 外野手在撞墙前一刻接住了球。

e.en: He's the most reliable {fielder} on the team.
e.zh: 他是队里最可靠的守备球员。

e.en: A {fieldfare} landed on the fence and pecked at berries.
e.zh: 一只田鸫落在篱笆上啄食浆果。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a flock of {fieldfare} in winter.
e.zh: 观鸟者在冬天看到一群田鸫。

e.en: The team practices indoors at the campus {fieldhouse}.
e.zh: 球队在校园室内体育馆进行室内训练。

e.en: Fans packed the {fieldhouse} for the championship game.
e.zh: 球迷挤满了室内体育馆观看冠军赛。

fielding.t:
n. 守场（棒、板球）
n. 菲尔丁（姓氏）

e.en: The shortstop's {fielding} saved several runs that inning.
e.zh: 游击手的守备在那个半局里救下了好几分。

e.en: She's been {fielding} questions from reporters all morning.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在应付记者的提问。

fields.t: n. 字段（复数）；领域；田野

e.en: Golden wheat {fields} stretched to the horizon.
e.zh: 金黄的麦田一直延伸到地平线。

e.en: The form has several required {fields} to fill in.
e.zh: 表单上有几个必填的字段。

e.en: The cottage had a chimney built of rough {fieldstone}.
e.zh: 小屋有一座用粗糙原石砌成的烟囱。

e.en: They used local {fieldstone} for the garden wall.
e.zh: 他们用本地的原石建造花园围墙。

fieldwork.t: n. 田野调查；实地工作

e.en: Her PhD involved months of {fieldwork} in rural Kenya.
e.zh: 她的博士研究包括在肯尼亚乡村进行数月的田野调查。

e.en: Geology students do {fieldwork} every summer.
e.zh: 地质学专业的学生每年夏天都要进行野外实习。

fieldworker.t: n. 田野调查员；实地工作者

e.en: The {fieldworker} interviewed dozens of villagers about the project.
e.zh: 田野调查员就这个项目采访了数十位村民。

e.en: Each {fieldworker} reports findings back to the lead researcher.
e.zh: 每位田野调查员都把发现汇报给首席研究员。

e.en: My brother is a complete coffee {fiend}.
e.zh: 我哥哥是个不折不扣的咖啡狂。

e.en: The killer was described as a heartless {fiend}.
e.zh: 凶手被描述为一个冷血的恶魔。

e.en: The puzzle was so {fiendish} that no one solved it.
e.zh: 这道题极其刁钻，没人能解出来。

e.en: He came up with a {fiendish} plan to win the bet.
e.zh: 他想出了一个极其阴险的计划来赢这场赌局。

e.en: The exam was {fiendishly} difficult this year.
e.zh: 今年的考试难得令人发指。

e.en: The villain grinned {fiendishly} as the trap closed.
e.zh: 陷阱合上时，反派阴险地咧嘴笑了。

e.en: My kids are absolute sugar {fiends} on Halloween.
e.zh: 我家孩子在万圣节简直是糖果狂魔。

e.en: The fantasy novel was full of demons and {fiends}.
e.zh: 这部奇幻小说里满是恶魔与魔怪。

e.en: There's {fierce} competition between the two startups.
e.zh: 两家初创公司之间竞争激烈。

e.en: A {fierce} dog guarded the junkyard gate.
e.zh: 一只凶猛的狗守着废品场的大门。

e.en: She defended her thesis {fiercely} against the panel.
e.zh: 她在评审面前激烈地为论文辩护。

e.en: The two teams competed {fiercely} for the trophy.
e.zh: 两队为奖杯展开了激烈的角逐。

e.en: The {fierceness} of the storm caught everyone off guard.
e.zh: 风暴的猛烈程度让所有人措手不及。

e.en: She argued with a {fierceness} no one expected.
e.zh: 她以出人意料的猛烈劲头展开辩论。

e.en: The senator gave a {fiery} speech against the bill.
e.zh: 那位参议员发表了反对该法案的激烈演讲。

e.en: The sunset painted the sky a {fiery} orange.
e.zh: 夕阳把天空染成了火红的橙色。

fiesta.t: n. 节日庆典（源自西语）

e.en: The whole town joined the summer {fiesta} downtown.
e.zh: 全镇人都参加了市中心的夏日庆典。

e.en: They threw a backyard {fiesta} for her birthday.
e.zh: 他们在后院为她办了一场欢乐派对庆生。

e.en: The toddler counted, "three, four, {fif}…" and giggled.
e.zh: 那个小孩数着"三、四、五……"咯咯笑起来。

e.en: In her notebook she scribbled "{fif}" instead of fifth.
e.zh: 她在笔记本上把"第五"草草写成了"fif"。

fifa.t: n. 国际足联；FIFA 游戏

e.en: My cousin plays {FIFA} online almost every night.
e.zh: 我表弟几乎每晚都在网上玩FIFA足球游戏。

e.en: {FIFA} announced the host cities for the next World Cup.
e.zh: 国际足联公布了下届世界杯的主办城市。

e.en: A boy played a wooden {fife} during the parade.
e.zh: 游行队伍中一个男孩吹着木制横笛。

e.en: The marching band featured a drum and {fife} corps.
e.zh: 行进乐队中有一支鼓笛队。

e.en: My little sister just turned {fifteen} last weekend.
e.zh: 我妹妹上周末刚满十五岁。

e.en: The meeting starts in {fifteen} minutes, so hurry up.
e.zh: 会议十五分钟后开始,快点吧。

fifteenth.t: num. 第十五；十五分之一

e.en: Today is her {fifteenth} birthday party at the park.
e.zh: 今天是她在公园举办的十五岁生日派对。

e.en: He finished in {fifteenth} place in the marathon.
e.zh: 他在马拉松比赛中获得第十五名。

e.en: This is my {fifth} cup of coffee today.
e.zh: 这是我今天的第五杯咖啡了。

e.en: She lives on the {fifth} floor of the building.
e.zh: 她住在这栋楼的五楼。

e.en: {Fifthly}, we must address the budget concerns directly.
e.zh: 第五点,我们必须直接解决预算问题。

e.en: And {fifthly}, please remember to lock the door.
e.zh: 第五,请记得锁门。

e.en: Three {fifths} of the students passed the final exam.
e.zh: 五分之三的学生通过了期末考试。

e.en: Cut the pizza into {fifths} for everyone.
e.zh: 把披萨切成五等份给大家分。

fiftieth.t: num. 第五十；五十分之一

e.en: They celebrated their {fiftieth} wedding anniversary last month.
e.zh: 他们上个月庆祝了金婚五十周年纪念。

e.en: This is the company's {fiftieth} anniversary year.
e.zh: 今年是公司成立五十周年。

e.en: The jacket costs about {fifty} dollars online.
e.zh: 这件夹克在网上大约卖五十美元。

e.en: More than {fifty} people showed up to the protest.
e.zh: 超过五十人参加了那场抗议。

e.en: I love spreading {fig} jam on warm toast.
e.zh: 我喜欢把无花果酱涂在热吐司上。

e.en: There's a beautiful {fig} tree in our backyard.
e.zh: 我们后院有一棵漂亮的无花果树。

figaro.t: n. 费加罗（人名，歌剧角色）

e.en: The opera house is staging {Figaro} again next season.
e.zh: 歌剧院下个演出季将再次上演《费加罗》。

e.en: He hummed an aria from {Figaro} all morning.
e.zh: 他整个早上都在哼《费加罗》里的咏叹调。

e.en: Don't {fight} with your brother over the remote.
e.zh: 别为了遥控器跟你弟弟吵架。

e.en: The boxing {fight} ended in the third round.
e.zh: 那场拳击比赛在第三回合就结束了。

e.en: The team staged an amazing {fightback} in the second half.
e.zh: 球队在下半场上演了精彩的反击。

e.en: Her political {fightback} surprised everyone in the party.
e.zh: 她在政界的反击让党内所有人都感到意外。

e.en: She's a real {fighter} who never gives up easily.
e.zh: 她是个真正的斗士,从不轻易放弃。

e.en: The {fighter} jet roared across the sky overhead.
e.zh: 那架战斗机在头顶呼啸而过。

fighters.t: n. fighter 的复数；斗士；战斗机

e.en: Several {fighters} trained at the gym every morning.
e.zh: 几位拳手每天早上都在那家拳馆训练。

e.en: Firefighters and {fighters} for justice deserve our respect.
e.zh: 消防员和为正义而战的人都值得我们尊敬。

fighting.t:
n. 打斗；作战
adj. 好斗的

e.en: The two kids were {fighting} over a toy car.
e.zh: 两个小孩在为一辆玩具车打架。

e.en: Doctors are still {fighting} to save his life.
e.zh: 医生们仍在努力抢救他的生命。

e.en: Reports describe constant {fightings} along the disputed border.
e.zh: 报道描述争议边境地区持续发生交火。

e.en: Historians documented many small {fightings} during that period.
e.zh: 历史学家记录了那段时期的许多小规模冲突。

e.en: He always {fights} hard for what he believes in.
e.zh: 他总是为自己的信念努力抗争。

e.en: The couple had several loud {fights} last week.
e.zh: 这对情侣上周大吵了好几次。

e.en: That ghost was just a {figment} of your imagination.
e.zh: 那个鬼只是你想象出来的幻觉。

e.en: The whole conspiracy is a {figment}, not reality.
e.zh: 整个阴谋纯属虚构,并非事实。

e.en: Fresh {figs} are in season at the farmers market.
e.zh: 农夫市集上现在正是新鲜无花果的季节。

e.en: She packed dried {figs} for the long hike.
e.zh: 她为长途徒步带了一些无花果干。

figural.t: adj. 人物形象的；具象的

e.en: The artist is famous for her {figural} sculptures.
e.zh: 这位艺术家以她的人物雕塑闻名。

e.en: The museum displays both abstract and {figural} paintings.
e.zh: 博物馆同时展出抽象画和具象人物画。

e.en: The painting's {figuration} reveals the artist's emotional state.
e.zh: 这幅画的具象表现揭示了艺术家的情绪状态。

e.en: Modern dance often rejects traditional {figuration} of the body.
e.zh: 现代舞常常拒绝对身体的传统具象表现。

e.en: Don't take it literally — that was a {figurative} expression.
e.zh: 别从字面理解,那只是一种比喻说法。

e.en: He's drowning in work, in the {figurative} sense.
e.zh: 他被工作淹没了,这是一种比喻说法。

e.en: I {figuratively} died of embarrassment during the speech.
e.zh: 演讲时我尴尬得简直要死,这是个比喻。

e.en: She was {figuratively} on top of the world.
e.zh: 她那时简直像站在世界之巅,这是个比喻。

figure.t:
n. 数字；人物；身材
v. 认为；算出

e.en: I can't {figure} out how to fix this bug.
e.zh: 我搞不懂怎么修复这个 bug。

e.en: The sales {figure} this quarter exceeded all expectations.
e.zh: 本季度的销售数字超出了所有人的预期。

figured.t: v. figure 的过去式；想出；有图案的

e.en: She finally {figured} out the password to the account.
e.zh: 她终于弄明白了那个账号的密码。

e.en: I {figured} you'd want coffee, so I brought some.
e.zh: 我猜你会想喝咖啡,就带了一些过来。

e.en: The chairman is just a {figurehead} with no real power.
e.zh: 董事长只是个挂名领导,没有实权。

e.en: The carved {figurehead} on the old ship was beautiful.
e.zh: 那艘老船的船首雕像非常漂亮。

figures.t: n. figure 的复数；数字；人物

e.en: The latest sales {figures} show strong holiday growth.
e.zh: 最新的销售数据显示假日期间增长强劲。

e.en: He {figures} prominently in the company's history.
e.zh: 他在公司的历史上占据重要地位。

e.en: She collects tiny porcelain {figurine} animals from Japan.
e.zh: 她收藏来自日本的小瓷器动物雕像。

e.en: A delicate ballerina {figurine} sat on the shelf.
e.zh: 架子上摆着一尊精致的芭蕾舞女小雕像。

figuring.t: v. figure 的 ing 形式；思考；估算

e.en: I'm still {figuring} out how this new app works.
e.zh: 我还在摸索这个新应用怎么用。

e.en: She spent hours {figuring} out the puzzle alone.
e.zh: 她独自花了好几个小时琢磨那个谜题。

e.en: We're planning a honeymoon trip to {Fiji} next summer.
e.zh: 我们打算明年夏天去斐济度蜜月。

e.en: {Fiji} is famous for its stunning coral reefs.
e.zh: 斐济以其令人惊叹的珊瑚礁而闻名。

fijian.t:
adj. 斐济的
n. 斐济人

e.en: Our resort had a wonderful {Fijian} chef from Suva.
e.zh: 我们的度假村有一位来自苏瓦的优秀斐济厨师。

e.en: He learned a few {Fijian} phrases before the trip.
e.zh: 他出发前学了几句斐济语。

fil.t: n. 线；丝（法语借词，罕用）

e.en: The currency abbreviation {fil} appears in old Bahraini coins.
e.zh: 货币缩写 fil 出现在旧的巴林硬币上。

e.en: One dinar equals one thousand {fil} in Iraq.
e.zh: 在伊拉克,一第纳尔等于一千费尔。

e.en: The light bulb's {filament} burned out last night.
e.zh: 灯泡的灯丝昨晚烧坏了。

e.en: My 3D printer ran out of {filament} mid-print.
e.zh: 我的 3D 打印机打印到一半耗材就用完了。

e.en: Astronomers studied the {filamentary} structures of the distant nebula.
e.zh: 天文学家研究了远处星云的丝状结构。

e.en: The fabric had a delicate {filamentary} texture.
e.zh: 这种布料有一种精细的丝状质感。

e.en: Some {filamentous} algae were growing on the pond's surface.
e.zh: 池塘表面长着一些丝状藻类。

e.en: The bacteria formed long {filamentous} chains under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下,这些细菌形成了长长的丝状链。

e.en: Mosquitoes can transmit {filariasis} in tropical regions.
e.zh: 在热带地区,蚊子可以传播丝虫病。

e.en: The clinic offers free screening for {filariasis} every month.
e.zh: 诊所每月都提供免费的丝虫病筛查。

e.en: She added crushed {filbert} nuts to the chocolate cake.
e.zh: 她在巧克力蛋糕里加了碾碎的榛子。

e.en: Oregon farms produce most of America's {filbert} crops.
e.zh: 俄勒冈州的农场生产美国大部分的榛子。

e.en: Don't {filch} cookies from the jar before dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭前别从罐子里偷拿饼干。

e.en: He tried to {filch} a pen from the office supplies.
e.zh: 他想从办公用品里顺一支笔走。

file.t:
n. 文件；档案
v. 提交；归档

e.en: Please save the {file} before closing the program.
e.zh: 关闭程序前请先保存文件。

e.en: You need to {file} your taxes before April fifteenth.
e.zh: 你得在四月十五日前报税。

filed.t: v. file 的过去式；归档；提交

e.en: She {filed} a complaint with the customer service team.
e.zh: 她向客服团队提交了一份投诉。

e.en: The documents were {filed} alphabetically in the cabinet.
e.zh: 文件按字母顺序归档在柜子里。

e.en: Please rename the {filename} to something more descriptive.
e.zh: 请把文件名改成更有描述性的名字。

e.en: The {filename} extension tells you the file type.
e.zh: 文件名的后缀告诉你这是什么类型的文件。

e.en: Every {filer} must submit returns by the April deadline.
e.zh: 每位报税人必须在四月截止日期前提交报税表。

e.en: As a first-time {filer}, she needed extra guidance.
e.zh: 作为首次报税的人,她需要额外的指导。

e.en: I accidentally deleted some important {files} from my laptop.
e.zh: 我不小心把笔记本上的一些重要文件删了。

e.en: She {files} her reports every Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 她每周五下午都会提交报告。

e.en: I ordered the {filet} mignon medium rare for dinner.
e.zh: 我晚餐点了一份五分熟的菲力牛排。

e.en: The chef will {filet} the salmon at your table.
e.zh: 厨师会在你的餐桌旁给三文鱼去骨切片。

e.en: In Chinese culture, {filial} piety remains very important.
e.zh: 在中国文化中,孝道仍然非常重要。

e.en: He showed great {filial} devotion to his aging parents.
e.zh: 他对年迈的父母表现出极大的孝心。

e.en: The court verified the child's {filiation} through DNA testing.
e.zh: 法院通过 DNA 检测核实了这个孩子的亲子关系。

e.en: Scholars trace the {filiation} of the manuscripts carefully.
e.zh: 学者们仔细追溯这些手稿的传承关系。

filibuster.t: n./v. 冗长辩论（阻挠议事）

e.en: Senators used a {filibuster} to delay the controversial vote.
e.zh: 参议员们用冗长辩论来拖延这次有争议的投票。

e.en: He plans to {filibuster} the bill until midnight.
e.zh: 他打算用冗长发言阻挠这项法案到午夜。

e.en: The earrings featured delicate silver {filigree} work from India.
e.zh: 这对耳环采用了来自印度的精致银丝细工。

e.en: Frost made a beautiful {filigree} pattern on the window.
e.zh: 霜在窗户上勾出了美丽的花丝图案。

filing.t:
n. 归档；申报
v. file 的 ing 形式

e.en: I spent all morning {filing} old paperwork in the office.
e.zh: 我整个上午都在办公室归档旧文件。

e.en: The company's tax {filing} is due next Monday.
e.zh: 公司的纳税申报下周一到期。

e.en: The court {filings} are public records anyone can access.
e.zh: 法庭文件是任何人都可以查阅的公开记录。

e.en: Investors carefully reviewed the company's annual {filings}.
e.zh: 投资者仔细审阅了公司的年度申报文件。

filipino.t:
n. 菲律宾人
adj. 菲律宾的

e.en: My new coworker is a {Filipino} software engineer from Manila.
e.zh: 我的新同事是一位来自马尼拉的菲律宾软件工程师。

e.en: This restaurant serves authentic {Filipino} adobo and lumpia.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应正宗的菲律宾炖肉和春卷。

fill.t:
v. 填满；充满
n. 填充物

e.en: Please {fill} the bottle with cold water before leaving.
e.zh: 出门前请把瓶子装满冷水。

e.en: The new manager will {fill} the position next month.
e.zh: 新经理下个月将接任这个职位。

fille.t: n. 女孩；女儿（法语借词）

e.en: In French class we learned that {fille} means daughter or girl.
e.zh: 法语课上我们学到 fille 意为女儿或女孩。

e.en: She named her café La Petite {Fille} after her grandmother.
e.zh: 她以祖母的名字将咖啡馆命名为 La Petite Fille。

filled.t: v. fill 的过去式；装满的

e.en: The stadium was {filled} with cheering fans last night.
e.zh: 昨晚体育场里挤满了欢呼的球迷。

e.en: She {filled} out the application form in five minutes.
e.zh: 她五分钟就填完了申请表。

e.en: That episode felt like pure {filler} with no real plot.
e.zh: 那一集感觉纯粹是凑数,没有实质剧情。

e.en: The dentist used a white {filler} to repair my tooth.
e.zh: 牙医用白色填充料修补了我的牙齿。

fillet.t:
n. 里脊肉；鱼片
v. 剔骨

e.en: He grilled a salmon {fillet} with lemon and butter.
e.zh: 他用柠檬和黄油烤了一块三文鱼柳。

e.en: Could you {fillet} this fish for me, please?
e.zh: 请帮我把这条鱼剔骨切片好吗?

filling.t:
n. 填料；馅料
adj. 耐饱的

e.en: This soup is surprisingly {filling} for so few calories.
e.zh: 这汤热量这么低却出乎意料地饱腹。

e.en: The bakery is famous for its chocolate cream {filling}.
e.zh: 这家面包店以巧克力奶油夹心闻名。

find.t:
v. 找到；发现
n. 发现物

e.en: I can't {find} my keys anywhere in the apartment.
e.zh: 我在公寓里到处都找不到我的钥匙。

e.en: Many users {find} the new interface much easier to use.
e.zh: 许多用户觉得新界面要好用得多。

e.en: Use the file {finder} to search across all your folders.
e.zh: 使用文件查找器可以在所有文件夹中搜索。

e.en: The lucky {finder} returned the lost wallet to its owner.
e.zh: 幸运的拾得者把丢失的钱包还给了失主。

finderscope.t: n. (望远镜上的) 寻星镜

e.en: Align the {finderscope} with the main telescope before observing stars.
e.zh: 在观测星空前先把寻星镜与主望远镜对齐。

e.en: A red-dot {finderscope} makes locating bright planets much easier.
e.zh: 红点寻星镜让寻找明亮行星变得容易许多。

e.en: The team is still {finding} bugs two weeks after launch.
e.zh: 团队在发布两周后仍在不断发现漏洞。

e.en: One key {finding} from the study surprised every researcher involved.
e.zh: 研究中的一项关键发现让每位参与的研究人员都感到惊讶。

findings.t: n. 研究结果；调查结论

e.en: The committee published its {findings} in a detailed final report.
e.zh: 委员会在一份详尽的终报中公布了调查结果。

e.en: Recent {findings} suggest sleep affects long-term memory more than expected.
e.zh: 近期研究结果表明睡眠对长期记忆的影响超出预期。

e.en: {Findlay}, Ohio is home to several major tire manufacturers.
e.zh: 俄亥俄州的芬德利是多家大型轮胎制造商的所在地。

e.en: Professor {Findlay} will give the keynote speech tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 芬德利教授将于明早发表主旨演讲。

finds.t:
v. 找到（find 第三人称单数）
n. 发现物

e.en: She always {finds} the best deals on vintage clothing online.
e.zh: 她总能在网上淘到最划算的复古服装。

e.en: Archaeologists displayed their latest {finds} from the desert excavation.
e.zh: 考古学家展出了他们在沙漠发掘中的最新发现。

fine.t:
adj. 好的；精细的
n. 罚款

e.en: Don't worry, everything will be {fine} by tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 别担心，到明天早上一切都会没事的。

e.en: The driver had to pay a heavy {fine} for speeding.
e.zh: 司机因超速被处以高额罚款。

fined.t: v. 被罚款（fine 的过去式）

e.en: He was {fined} two hundred dollars for parking illegally.
e.zh: 他因违章停车被罚了两百美元。

e.en: The company was {fined} heavily for polluting the local river.
e.zh: 该公司因污染当地河流被处以重罚。

e.en: Chop the garlic {finely} before adding it to the pan.
e.zh: 把大蒜切碎后再放入锅中。

e.en: She wore a {finely} embroidered silk scarf to the gala.
e.zh: 她戴着一条做工精细的绣花丝巾出席晚会。

e.en: The {fineness} of the gold determines its market value.
e.zh: 黄金的成色决定了它的市场价值。

e.en: Critics admired the {fineness} of detail in her watercolor paintings.
e.zh: 评论家赞赏她水彩画中细节的精致。

e.en: Guests arrived in their wedding {finery}, sparkling under the lights.
e.zh: 宾客们身着华丽的婚礼盛装到场，在灯光下熠熠生辉。

e.en: The queen appeared in full royal {finery} for the ceremony.
e.zh: 女王身着全套王室盛装出席了典礼。

fines.t:
n. 罚款（复数）
v. 处以罚款

e.en: Late library {fines} can really add up over a year.
e.zh: 图书馆的逾期罚款一年下来可不少。

e.en: The city raised parking {fines} to discourage downtown congestion.
e.zh: 市政府提高了停车罚款以缓解市中心拥堵。

finesse.t:
n. 手腕；巧妙手段
v. 巧妙处理

e.en: She handled the awkward situation with remarkable {finesse} and grace.
e.zh: 她以非凡的手腕和优雅化解了那个尴尬局面。

e.en: It takes real {finesse} to negotiate a deal like that.
e.zh: 谈成那样的交易需要真正的技巧。

finfish.t: n. 有鳍鱼类（区别于贝类）

e.en: The market sells fresh {finfish} alongside shrimp and oysters.
e.zh: 市场出售新鲜的有鳍鱼，旁边还有虾和牡蛎。

e.en: Sustainable {finfish} farming is growing rapidly in coastal regions.
e.zh: 可持续的有鳍鱼养殖业在沿海地区迅速发展。

e.en: The Wi-Fi app {Fing} scans every device on your network.
e.zh: Wi-Fi 应用 Fing 会扫描你网络上的每一台设备。

e.en: Use {Fing} to quickly identify unknown devices connected to home Wi-Fi.
e.zh: 用 Fing 可以快速识别连接家庭 Wi-Fi 的陌生设备。

finger.t:
n. 手指
v. 用手指触碰

e.en: She cut her {finger} while slicing onions for dinner.
e.zh: 她在切洋葱做晚饭时切到了手指。

e.en: Don't {finger} the artwork; oil from skin damages the paint.
e.zh: 不要用手摸画作，皮肤上的油会损坏颜料。

e.en: The guitar's rosewood {fingerboard} feels smooth under my fingertips.
e.zh: 吉他的玫瑰木指板在指尖下摸起来很顺滑。

e.en: Skateboarders practice tricks on a tiny {fingerboard} during lunch.
e.zh: 滑板爱好者午休时在小小的手指滑板上练习花式动作。

e.en: The pianist's left-hand {fingering} needs more practice for that passage.
e.zh: 钢琴家左手的指法在那段乐句上还需多加练习。

e.en: She kept {fingering} the locket nervously during the long interview.
e.zh: 在漫长的面试中她不停紧张地摩挲着那枚吊坠。

fingerless.t: adj. 无指的（如无指手套）

e.en: He wore {fingerless} gloves while typing in the chilly office.
e.zh: 他在阴冷的办公室里戴着露指手套打字。

e.en: Cyclists often prefer {fingerless} gloves for better grip and control.
e.zh: 骑行者常喜欢戴露指手套，以获得更好的抓握和控制感。

e.en: Roasted {fingerling} potatoes go perfectly with grilled salmon and herbs.
e.zh: 烤手指土豆配烤三文鱼和香草非常合适。

e.en: The hatchery released thousands of trout {fingerling} into the stream.
e.zh: 孵化场向溪流中放养了数千条鳟鱼幼鱼。

e.en: She broke a {fingernail} trying to open the stuck jar.
e.zh: 她在试图拧开卡住的罐子时弄断了一片指甲。

e.en: A clean {fingernail} suggests good personal hygiene during a job interview.
e.zh: 在求职面试中干净的指甲显示出良好的个人卫生习惯。

e.en: She paints her {fingernails} a different color every single week.
e.zh: 她每周都给自己的指甲涂上不同的颜色。

e.en: Stop biting your {fingernails}; it's a hard habit to break.
e.zh: 别再咬指甲了，这是个很难改掉的习惯。

fingerprint.t:
n. 指纹
v. 采集指纹

e.en: Unlock your phone with a quick {fingerprint} scan instead of a password.
e.zh: 用一次指纹扫描就能解锁手机，无需输入密码。

e.en: Police lifted a clear {fingerprint} from the broken window frame.
e.zh: 警察从破损的窗框上提取到了一枚清晰的指纹。

fingerprinting.t: n. 指纹识别（含浏览器指纹追踪）

e.en: Browser {fingerprinting} can track users even without any cookies enabled.
e.zh: 浏览器指纹技术即使在未启用任何 cookie 的情况下也能追踪用户。

e.en: DNA {fingerprinting} helped solve the cold case after twenty years.
e.zh: DNA指纹鉴定帮助二十年后侦破了那起悬案。

e.en: My {fingers} feel numb after typing for six straight hours.
e.zh: 连续打字六个小时后我的手指都麻了。

e.en: Cross your {fingers} that the interview goes really well today.
e.zh: 祈祷今天的面试一切顺利吧。

e.en: With smartphones, the world is right at your {fingertip}.
e.zh: 有了智能手机，整个世界都在你的指尖之上。

e.en: A drop of blood appeared on her {fingertip} from the needle.
e.zh: 针扎过后她的指尖冒出一滴血。

e.en: A brass {finial} sits atop each post of the antique bed.
e.zh: 那张古董床的每根床柱顶端都有一个黄铜饰顶。

e.en: The church spire is crowned with a gilded {finial} cross.
e.zh: 教堂尖顶的最高处装饰着一个镀金的十字饰顶。

finicky.t: adj. 挑剔的；过分讲究的

e.en: My cat is so {finicky} she rejects most expensive food brands.
e.zh: 我的猫挑食得很，大多数昂贵品牌的猫粮都不吃。

e.en: The old printer is {finicky} about which paper sizes it accepts.
e.zh: 那台旧打印机对纸张尺寸非常挑剔。

e.en: The city is {fining} drivers who block the new bike lanes.
e.zh: 市政府正在对堵塞新自行车道的司机处以罚款。

e.en: Winemakers use egg whites for {fining} red wine before bottling.
e.zh: 酿酒师在装瓶前用蛋清来澄清红葡萄酒。

e.en: The word {finis} appeared on the last page of the manuscript.
e.zh: 手稿的最后一页上写着 finis 一词，意为终结。

e.en: She wrote {finis} at the bottom and closed her notebook.
e.zh: 她在最下方写下 finis，然后合上了笔记本。

finish.t:
v. 完成；结束
n. 结尾；表面处理

e.en: I need to {finish} this report before the meeting at three.
e.zh: 我得在三点会议前完成这份报告。

e.en: The table has a beautiful matte {finish} that resists scratches.
e.zh: 这张桌子有漂亮的哑光表面处理，不易刮花。

finished.t:
adj. 已完成的
v. 完成（过去式）

e.en: She {finished} her marathon in just under four hours.
e.zh: 她以略低于四小时的成绩完成了马拉松。

e.en: The {finished} product looks much better than the early prototype.
e.zh: 成品看起来比早期原型好得多。

e.en: He's a strong {finisher} who closes deals in the final quarter.
e.zh: 他是一位收尾能力很强的人，总能在最后一节谈成交易。

e.en: Every {finisher} of the marathon received a custom medal today.
e.zh: 今天每一位完成马拉松的选手都获得了一枚定制奖牌。

finishes.t:
v. 完成（第三人称单数）
n. 饰面（复数）

e.en: The cabinet is available in three different wood {finishes}.
e.zh: 这款橱柜有三种不同的木质饰面可选。

e.en: She always {finishes} her homework before watching any television shows.
e.zh: 她总是先做完作业才看电视节目。

finishing.t: n. 收尾工作；饰面加工

e.en: I'm {finishing} the last chapter of the novel tonight.
