e.zh: 我今晚要把小说的最后一章读完。

e.en: Adding fresh herbs is the perfect {finishing} touch to pasta.
e.zh: 撒上新鲜香草是意面最完美的点睛之笔。

e.en: Our planet has only a {finite} supply of fresh water.
e.zh: 地球上的淡水储量是有限的。

e.en: Remember that your time and energy are both {finite} resources.
e.zh: 记住，你的时间和精力都是有限的资源。

e.en: Philosophers often reflect on the {finitude} of human existence.
e.zh: 哲学家们常常思考人类存在的有限性。

e.en: Illness made him keenly aware of his own {finitude}.
e.zh: 疾病让他深刻意识到自身生命的有限。

e.en: Nobody trusts a {fink} who reports coworkers to the boss.
e.zh: 没人会信任一个向老板告同事密的小人。

e.en: Don't {fink} on your friends just to save yourself trouble.
e.zh: 别为了让自己少惹麻烦就出卖朋友。

e.en: {Finland} regularly tops the global rankings for happiness and education.
e.zh: 芬兰在全球幸福感和教育排名中常年名列前茅。

e.en: Winters in {Finland} are long, dark, and surprisingly beautiful.
e.zh: 芬兰的冬天漫长、黑暗，却出奇地美丽。

e.en: Every {Finn} I've met speaks excellent English and perfect Swedish.
e.zh: 我遇到的每个芬兰人英语都说得很棒，瑞典语也很标准。

e.en: My friend {Finn} just moved to Helsinki for a new job.
e.zh: 我朋友芬恩刚搬到赫尔辛基去做一份新工作。

finnan.t: n. 熏黑线鳕（一种熏鱼）

e.en: Grandma served smoked {finnan} haddock for breakfast every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 奶奶每个星期天早上都用熏黑线鳕做早餐。

e.en: Authentic {finnan} haddie comes from the small Scottish fishing village.
e.zh: 正宗的烟熏黑线鳕产自苏格兰那个小渔村。

finned.t: adj. 带鳍的；有散热片的

e.en: The diver photographed a beautifully {finned} angelfish near the coral.
e.zh: 潜水员在珊瑚旁拍到了一条鳍翅美丽的神仙鱼。

e.en: Vintage cars from the fifties often had dramatically {finned} rear ends.
e.zh: 五十年代的老爷车常常带有夸张的尾翼造型。

finnish.t:
adj. 芬兰的
n. 芬兰语

e.en: Learning {Finnish} grammar is notoriously difficult for English speakers.
e.zh: 对说英语的人来说，学习芬兰语语法是出了名的难。

e.en: We tried a traditional {Finnish} sauna during our trip last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天旅行时我们体验了一次传统的芬兰桑拿。

e.en: The aquarium showcased many {finny} creatures from the deep sea.
e.zh: 水族馆展示了许多来自深海的有鳍生物。

e.en: Children love watching the {finny} fish dart around the tank.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢看那些有鳍的鱼在水缸里穿梭。

fino.t: n. 菲诺（一种干雪利酒）

e.en: He ordered a chilled glass of {fino} sherry before dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚餐前点了一杯冰镇的菲诺雪利酒。

e.en: The {fino} pairs beautifully with salted almonds and olives.
e.zh: 菲诺雪利酒与咸杏仁和橄榄搭配极佳。

fillings.t: n. 填充物；（牙齿）补牙材料

e.en: The dentist said I need two new {fillings} this year.
e.zh: 牙医说我今年需要补两颗牙。

e.en: Customers can choose from twelve different sandwich {fillings}.
e.zh: 顾客可以从十二种不同的三明治馅料中挑选。

fillip.t:
n. 刺激；激励
v. 激励

e.en: The tax cut gave a welcome {fillip} to small businesses.
e.zh: 减税给小企业带来了一剂受欢迎的强心针。

e.en: Her promotion was a real {fillip} to team morale.
e.zh: 她的升职大大鼓舞了团队的士气。

fills.t: v. 填满；装满（fill 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The smell of fresh bread {fills} the entire kitchen.
e.zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫整个厨房。

e.en: He {fills} his car with gas every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 他每周日早上都给车加油。

e.en: The young {filly} won her first race at Ascot.
e.zh: 那匹年轻的小母马在阿斯科特赢得了她的首场比赛。

e.en: He bought a chestnut {filly} at the spring auction.
e.zh: 他在春季拍卖会上买下了一匹栗色小母马。

film.t:
n. 电影；薄膜
v. 拍摄

e.en: We watched a fantastic French {film} on the plane.
e.zh: 我们在飞机上看了一部很棒的法国电影。

e.en: A thin {film} of dust covered the old piano.
e.zh: 老钢琴上覆盖着一层薄薄的灰尘。

e.en: The young {film-maker} won an award at Sundance.
e.zh: 那位年轻的电影制作人在圣丹斯电影节获奖。

e.en: As an independent {film-maker}, she funds her own projects.
e.zh: 作为独立电影人,她自筹资金拍摄自己的项目。

e.en: Streaming platforms have changed how {film-makers} reach audiences.
e.zh: 流媒体平台改变了电影人接触观众的方式。

e.en: Several Asian {film-makers} were honored at the festival.
e.zh: 几位亚洲电影制作人在电影节上获得表彰。

filmed.t: v. 拍摄（film 的过去式）

e.en: The wedding was {filmed} by a professional drone operator.
e.zh: 婚礼由一位专业的无人机操作员拍摄。

e.en: They {filmed} the entire trilogy back-to-back in New Zealand.
e.zh: 他们在新西兰连续拍摄了整个三部曲。

e.en: The wildlife {filmer} spent six months in the Arctic.
e.zh: 那位野生动物摄影师在北极待了六个月。

e.en: Every wedding needs a skilled {filmer} and photographer.
e.zh: 每场婚礼都需要一位熟练的摄像师和摄影师。

e.en: The novel has a {filmic} quality that begs adaptation.
e.zh: 这部小说有种电影般的质感,很值得改编。

e.en: He uses a {filmic} preset to grade his videos.
e.zh: 他使用电影感预设来调色自己的视频。

filming.t:
v. 拍摄中
n. 摄制

e.en: They are {filming} the new season in Iceland.
e.zh: 他们正在冰岛拍摄新一季。

e.en: {Filming} drones over the airport is strictly prohibited.
e.zh: 严禁在机场上空使用无人机拍摄。

e.en: The documentary {filmmaker} interviewed survivors for three years.
e.zh: 这位纪录片导演用三年时间采访了幸存者。

e.en: She became a respected {filmmaker} after her debut feature.
e.zh: 她凭借处女作长片成为了备受尊敬的电影人。

e.en: Modern {filmmaking} relies heavily on digital cameras and software.
e.zh: 现代电影制作高度依赖数字摄影机和软件。

e.en: He teaches independent {filmmaking} at the local film school.
e.zh: 他在当地电影学院教授独立电影制作。

e.en: Her {filmography} includes thirty films across four decades.
e.zh: 她的电影作品集涵盖了四十年间的三十部影片。

e.en: The actor's {filmography} on IMDb keeps growing each year.
e.zh: 这位演员在 IMDb 上的作品列表每年都在增加。

films.t:
n. 电影（复数）
v. 拍摄

e.en: Pixar {films} appeal to both children and adults.
e.zh: 皮克斯的电影老少咸宜。

e.en: He {films} short clips for his travel YouTube channel.
e.zh: 他为自己的旅行 YouTube 频道拍摄短片。

e.en: Our teacher showed us a {filmstrip} about ancient Egypt.
e.zh: 老师给我们放了一段关于古埃及的胶片影带。

e.en: The app displays photos as a horizontal {filmstrip} below.
e.zh: 这个应用程序在下方以水平胶片条形式展示照片。

filmy.t: adj. 薄膜般的；轻薄透明的

e.en: She wore a {filmy} silk dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一条轻薄如纱的丝绸连衣裙出席晚会。

e.en: A {filmy} layer of grease coated the kitchen window.
e.zh: 厨房窗户上覆盖着一层薄薄的油渍。

e.en: The baklava is made with delicate layers of {filo} pastry.
e.zh: 果仁蜜饼是用层层薄如纸的酥皮制成的。

e.en: Brush each sheet of {filo} with melted butter.
e.zh: 在每张薄酥皮上刷上融化的黄油。

filofax.t: n. 活页记事本（品牌名）

e.en: My mom still keeps her contacts in a leather {filofax}.
e.zh: 我妈妈仍然把联系人记在皮质活页记事本里。

e.en: He pulled out his {filofax} to check next week's schedule.
e.zh: 他拿出活页记事本查看下周的日程。

filter.t:
v. 过滤；筛选
n. 滤镜；筛选器

e.en: You can {filter} search results by date and price.
e.zh: 你可以按日期和价格筛选搜索结果。

e.en: Replace the air {filter} in your car every year.
e.zh: 每年都要更换汽车的空气滤清器。

filtered.t:
adj. 过滤过的
v. 过滤（过去式）

e.en: The app automatically {filtered} out spam and promotional emails.
e.zh: 该应用自动过滤掉了垃圾邮件和推广邮件。

e.en: Sunlight {filtered} through the leaves onto the forest floor.
e.zh: 阳光透过树叶洒在森林地面上。

filtering.t:
n. 过滤；筛选
v. 筛选中

e.en: The new system is {filtering} thousands of comments per second.
e.zh: 新系统每秒能过滤数千条评论。

e.en: Email {filtering} keeps your inbox clean and organized.
e.zh: 邮件过滤功能让你的收件箱保持整洁有序。

e.en: Instagram {filters} can completely transform an ordinary photo.
e.zh: Instagram 滤镜能彻底改变一张普通照片。

e.en: This dashboard {filters} the data based on your selections.
e.zh: 这个仪表盘会根据你的选择筛选数据。

e.en: The abandoned house was covered in {filth} and cobwebs.
e.zh: 那栋废弃的房子布满了污垢和蜘蛛网。

e.en: She refused to listen to such {filth} on the radio.
e.zh: 她拒绝在收音机上听这种污言秽语。

e.en: His sneakers were absolutely {filthy} after the hike.
e.zh: 远足之后他的运动鞋脏得不成样子。

e.en: The CEO got {filthy} rich from his tech startup.
e.zh: 那位 CEO 靠他的科技创业公司赚得盆满钵满。

e.en: The {filtration} system removes 99% of bacteria from tap water.
e.zh: 这套过滤系统能去除自来水中 99% 的细菌。

e.en: Coffee enthusiasts debate which {filtration} method tastes best.
e.zh: 咖啡爱好者争论哪种过滤方式口感最好。

e.en: The biology textbook briefly mentioned the term {fimbra}.
e.zh: 生物课本简略地提到了 fimbra 这个术语。

e.en: Researchers studied the {fimbra} structure under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下研究 fimbra 的结构。

e.en: The shark's dorsal {fin} cut through the calm water.
e.zh: 鲨鱼的背鳍划破了平静的水面。

e.en: He bought a new {fin} for his surfboard online.
e.zh: 他在网上为冲浪板买了一个新尾鳍。

e.en: Parking on the sidewalk is a {finable} offense in Singapore.
e.zh: 在新加坡,把车停在人行道上是会被罚款的违规行为。

e.en: Littering in this park is a {finable} offense.
e.zh: 在这个公园乱扔垃圾会被处以罚款。

finagle.t: v. 哄骗弄到；耍手段得到

e.en: He managed to {finagle} a free upgrade to business class.
e.zh: 他设法骗到了一次免费的商务舱升级。

e.en: She tried to {finagle} her way out of the meeting.
e.zh: 她想方设法地试图躲掉那次会议。

final.t:
adj. 最终的；最后的
n. 决赛；期末考

e.en: The judge's decision is {final} and cannot be appealed.
e.zh: 法官的裁决是最终的,不可上诉。

e.en: I just submitted the {final} draft of my essay.
e.zh: 我刚刚提交了论文的最终稿。

e.en: The series {finale} drew over twenty million viewers worldwide.
e.zh: 这部剧的大结局吸引了全球两千多万观众。

e.en: Fireworks lit the sky during the concert's grand {finale}.
e.zh: 音乐会的盛大尾声中,烟花照亮了夜空。

finalise.t: v. 定稿；最终确定（英式拼写）

e.en: We need to {finalise} the contract before Friday's deadline.
e.zh: 我们需要在周五截止日期前敲定合同。

e.en: Let's {finalise} the guest list this weekend.
e.zh: 我们这个周末把宾客名单定下来吧。

e.en: She was the only Asian {finalist} in the competition.
e.zh: 她是这场比赛中唯一的亚洲决赛选手。

e.en: Each {finalist} received a cash prize and a trophy.
e.zh: 每位决赛选手都获得了奖金和奖杯。

e.en: His tone carried a {finality} that ended the discussion.
e.zh: 他的语气带着一种不容置疑的决断,终止了讨论。

e.en: There's a strange {finality} to closing a childhood home.
e.zh: 关闭儿时的家有一种奇异的尘埃落定感。

e.en: The {finalization} of the merger is expected next quarter.
e.zh: 合并预计将在下个季度完成最终敲定。

e.en: We're awaiting {finalization} of the budget before hiring.
e.zh: 我们在等待预算最终确定后再进行招聘。

e.en: Please {finalize} your travel plans by the end of June.
e.zh: 请在六月底前确定你的出行计划。

e.en: The two companies will {finalize} the deal next week.
e.zh: 两家公司下周将敲定这笔交易。

finalized.t:
adj. 已定稿的
v. 最终确定（过去式）

e.en: The wedding venue was {finalized} after months of searching.
e.zh: 经过数月的寻找,婚礼场地终于敲定了。

e.en: Once the design is {finalized}, production will begin immediately.
e.zh: 设计一旦定稿,生产就会立即开始。

e.en: After three hours of waiting, the train {finally} arrived.
e.zh: 等了三个小时,火车终于到了。

e.en: And {finally}, I'd like to thank my parents for everything.
e.zh: 最后,我想感谢父母为我所做的一切。

e.en: The tennis {finals} will be broadcast live on Sunday.
e.zh: 网球决赛将于周日现场直播。

e.en: Most students stay up late studying during {finals} week.
e.zh: 大多数学生在期末考试周都熬夜复习。

finance.t:
n. 金融；财务
v. 提供资金

e.en: She works in {finance} at a major investment bank.
e.zh: 她在一家大型投资银行的金融部门工作。

e.en: The government will {finance} the new high-speed rail project.
e.zh: 政府将为新的高速铁路项目提供资金。

e.en: The startup was {financed} by three Silicon Valley investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司由三位硅谷投资人提供资金。

e.en: He {financed} his college education with student loans.
e.zh: 他靠学生贷款支付了大学学费。

e.en: After the divorce, she had to manage her own {finances}.
e.zh: 离婚后,她不得不自己打理财务。

e.en: The company's {finances} have improved significantly this quarter.
e.zh: 公司的财务状况本季度有了显著改善。

e.en: Many young people seek {financial} advice on TikTok now.
e.zh: 现在很多年轻人在 TikTok 上寻求理财建议。

e.en: The 2008 {financial} crisis affected millions of households.
e.zh: 2008 年的金融危机影响了数百万个家庭。

financially.t: adv. 财务上；在财政方面

e.en: The startup is finally {financially} stable after three tough years.
e.zh: 经过三年艰难时期，这家初创公司终于在财务上稳定下来。

e.en: He depends on his parents {financially} while in graduate school.
e.zh: 读研期间他在经济上依赖父母。

e.en: A wealthy {financier} bought the struggling newspaper last month.
e.zh: 上个月一位富有的金融家收购了那家陷入困境的报社。

e.en: The {financier} backed several tech startups in Silicon Valley.
e.zh: 这位金融家投资了硅谷的几家科技初创公司。

e.en: The company secured {financing} for its new factory abroad.
e.zh: 公司为其海外新工厂获得了融资。

e.en: Many car dealers offer {financing} options at zero interest.
e.zh: 许多汽车经销商提供零利息的分期付款方案。

finca.t: n. 庄园；乡间别墅（西语）

e.en: They spent the weekend at a coffee {finca} in Colombia.
e.zh: 他们在哥伦比亚的一座咖啡庄园度过了周末。

e.en: The old {finca} has been converted into a boutique hotel.
e.zh: 那座古老的庄园已被改建为精品酒店。

e.en: A bright yellow {finch} landed on the bird feeder this morning.
e.zh: 今早一只亮黄色的雀鸟落在喂鸟器上。

e.en: Darwin studied each {finch} carefully on the Galápagos Islands.
e.zh: 达尔文在加拉帕戈斯群岛仔细研究每一种雀类。

e.en: She grew up in {Finchley}, a quiet suburb of north London.
e.zh: 她在芬奇利长大，那是伦敦北部一个安静的郊区。

e.en: The train to {Finchley} leaves every ten minutes from King's Cross.
e.zh: 开往芬奇利的列车每十分钟从国王十字车站发出一班。

finsbury.t: n. 芬斯伯里（伦敦地名）

e.en: She rented a small flat near {Finsbury} Park last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天她在芬斯伯里公园附近租了一间小公寓。

e.en: The new café in {Finsbury} has become a local favorite.
e.zh: 芬斯伯里那家新咖啡馆已成为当地人的最爱。

e.en: We sailed through a stunning Norwegian {fiord} at sunrise.
e.zh: 我们在日出时分驶过一条壮丽的挪威峡湾。

e.en: The {fiord} was carved by glaciers thousands of years ago.
e.zh: 这条峡湾是数千年前由冰川雕刻而成的。

e.en: They decorated a tall {fir} tree for Christmas this year.
e.zh: 今年他们装饰了一棵高大的冷杉树过圣诞节。

e.en: The forest was filled with the scent of {fir} needles.
e.zh: 森林里弥漫着冷杉针叶的清香。

fire.t:
n. 火；火灾
v. 开火；解雇

e.en: We sat around the {fire} sharing ghost stories all night.
e.zh: 我们围坐在火堆旁讲了一整夜鬼故事。

e.en: The manager had to {fire} two employees for repeated misconduct.
e.zh: 经理不得不解雇两名屡次违规的员工。

e.en: Owning a {firearm} requires a strict background check here.
e.zh: 在这里持有枪支需要经过严格的背景审查。

e.en: The officer secured the {firearm} before entering the building.
e.zh: 警官在进入大楼前先把枪锁好。

e.en: The new law restricts the sale of {firearms} to minors.
e.zh: 新法律限制向未成年人出售枪支。

e.en: All {firearms} must be stored safely in a locked cabinet.
e.zh: 所有枪支必须安全地存放在上锁的柜子里。

e.en: The antique iron {fireback} protected the chimney from intense heat.
e.zh: 那块古董铁制炉壁板保护着烟囱免受高温损坏。

e.en: She bought a decorative {fireback} for the old stone fireplace.
e.zh: 她为那座旧石壁炉买了一块装饰性的炉壁板。

e.en: A massive {fireball} lit up the sky after the explosion.
e.zh: 爆炸后一团巨大的火球照亮了天空。

e.en: The pitcher threw a {fireball} that struck out the batter.
e.zh: 投手投出一记火球三振了击球手。

e.en: We use {Firebase} to handle authentication in our mobile app.
e.zh: 我们使用 Firebase 来处理移动应用中的身份验证。

e.en: The team deployed the new feature using {Firebase} cloud functions.
e.zh: 团队使用 Firebase 云函数部署了这个新功能。

e.en: He restored a vintage Pontiac {Firebird} in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里修复了一辆老式庞蒂亚克火鸟跑车。

e.en: The {Firebird} ballet remains one of Stravinsky's most famous works.
e.zh: 《火鸟》芭蕾舞剧仍是斯特拉文斯基最著名的作品之一。

e.en: A {fireboat} sprayed water onto the burning warehouse from the harbor.
e.zh: 一艘消防船从港口向燃烧的仓库喷水。

e.en: The harbor's new {fireboat} can pump thousands of gallons per minute.
e.zh: 港口新配备的消防船每分钟可抽水数千加仑。

firebomb.t:
n. 燃烧弹
v. 投掷燃烧弹

e.en: Protesters threw a {firebomb} at the abandoned government building.
e.zh: 抗议者向废弃的政府大楼投掷了一枚燃烧弹。

e.en: The cafe was destroyed by a {firebomb} late last night.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆昨晚深夜被一枚燃烧弹摧毁了。

e.en: The {firebombing} of the city left thousands of residents homeless.
e.zh: 那次对城市的燃烧弹轰炸使数千名居民无家可归。

e.en: Investigators are still searching for clues after the warehouse {firebombing}.
e.zh: 调查人员仍在仓库燃烧弹袭击后寻找线索。

e.en: The engineer shoveled coal into the locomotive's {firebox}.
e.zh: 工程师把煤铲进机车的火箱里。

e.en: You should clean the stove's {firebox} before each winter season.
e.zh: 每个冬季来临前你应该清理炉子的火箱。

firebrand.t: n. 煽动者；燃烧的木柴

e.en: The young {firebrand} delivered a passionate speech against corruption.
e.zh: 那位年轻的煽动者发表了慷慨激昂的反腐演讲。

e.en: He earned a reputation as a political {firebrand} during college.
e.zh: 他在大学期间就赢得了政治激进分子的名声。

e.en: Crews bulldozed a wide {firebreak} to halt the spreading wildfire.
e.zh: 工作人员用推土机开辟出宽阔的防火带以阻止野火蔓延。

e.en: The {firebreak} along the ridge saved several mountain homes.
e.zh: 山脊上的那条防火带保住了好几座山间住宅。

e.en: He lit a {firecracker} that startled everyone in the courtyard.
e.zh: 他点燃了一枚鞭炮,把院子里的人都吓了一跳。

e.en: Children sold {firecracker} packs near the temple during the festival.
e.zh: 节日期间孩子们在寺庙附近卖一包包鞭炮。

fired.t: v. 开火；解雇（fire 过去式）

e.en: She got {fired} after missing three important client meetings.
e.zh: 她因错过三次重要客户会议而被解雇了。

e.en: The hunter {fired} his rifle into the air as a warning.
e.zh: 猎人朝天开了一枪以示警告。

e.en: The soldiers were caught in a brutal {firefight} near the border.
e.zh: 士兵们在边境附近陷入了一场激烈的交火。

e.en: A brief {firefight} broke out between rival gangs downtown.
e.zh: 市中心两个敌对帮派之间爆发了短暂的交火。

e.en: The brave {firefighter} rescued a child from the burning apartment.
e.zh: 那位勇敢的消防员从燃烧的公寓里救出了一个孩子。

e.en: Becoming a {firefighter} requires intense physical and mental training.
e.zh: 成为一名消防员需要艰苦的体能和心理训练。

e.en: Dozens of {firefighters} battled the blaze for over six hours.
e.zh: 数十名消防员奋战了六个多小时扑灭这场大火。

e.en: Local {firefighters} visited the school to teach fire safety.
e.zh: 当地消防员到学校去教授消防安全知识。

e.en: Modern {firefighting} relies on advanced equipment and rigorous teamwork.
e.zh: 现代消防工作依赖先进的设备和严密的团队合作。

e.en: She enrolled in a {firefighting} course right after high school.
e.zh: 她高中一毕业就报名参加了消防培训课程。

e.en: A single {firefly} blinked softly in the warm summer air.
e.zh: 一只萤火虫在温暖的夏夜里轻轻闪烁。

e.en: The kids chased every {firefly} they spotted in the meadow.
e.zh: 孩子们追逐着草地上发现的每一只萤火虫。

e.en: Place a sturdy {fireguard} in front of the hearth for safety.
e.zh: 在壁炉前放一个结实的防火栏以确保安全。

e.en: The old {fireguard} kept the children away from hot embers.
e.zh: 那个旧防火栏让孩子们远离了滚烫的余烬。

e.en: Information from the conference came at me like a {firehose}.
e.zh: 会议上的信息扑面而来,简直像高压水枪一样。

e.en: The {firehose} burst and soaked everyone standing nearby.
e.zh: 消防水带爆裂了,把附近站着的人都浇湿了。

e.en: The old {firehouse} was converted into a trendy art gallery.
e.zh: 那座老消防站被改造成了一家时尚的艺术画廊。

e.en: Children toured the {firehouse} and slid down the brass pole.
e.zh: 孩子们参观了消防站,还顺着铜杆滑下来。

e.en: Their faces glowed warmly in the flickering {firelight}.
e.zh: 他们的脸庞在摇曳的火光中泛着温暖的光晕。

e.en: She read the old letters by {firelight} late into the evening.
e.zh: 她借着火光读那些旧信,一直读到深夜。

e.en: Use a small {firelighter} to start the camping stove quickly.
e.zh: 用一小块引火物可以迅速点燃野营炉。

e.en: He lit a {firelighter} under the kindling to start the blaze.
e.zh: 他在引火柴下点燃了一块引火物来生火。

e.en: The brave {fireman} carried the elderly woman down the ladder.
e.zh: 勇敢的消防员把那位老太太顺着梯子背了下来。

e.en: As a child, he dreamed of becoming a {fireman} someday.
e.zh: 小时候,他梦想着有朝一日成为一名消防员。

e.en: We curled up by the {fireplace} with hot chocolate and books.
e.zh: 我们窝在壁炉旁,喝着热巧克力看书。

e.en: The cabin's stone {fireplace} was the heart of every winter gathering.
e.zh: 小木屋的石砌壁炉是每次冬日聚会的中心。

e.en: Most rooms in the historic mansion still have working {fireplaces}.
e.zh: 这座历史悠久的豪宅里大多数房间仍有可用的壁炉。

e.en: Modern {fireplaces} often run on gas instead of burning wood.
e.zh: 现代壁炉通常用燃气而不是烧木头。

e.en: Don't park next to that {fireplug} or you'll get a ticket.
e.zh: 别把车停在那个消防栓旁边,否则会被开罚单。

e.en: A dog stopped to sniff every {fireplug} on the street.
e.zh: 一只狗停下来嗅遍了街上每一个消防栓。

e.en: The new tank battalion adds significant {firepower} to the army.
e.zh: 新的坦克营为军队增添了强大的火力。

e.en: Their startup gained {firepower} after the latest funding round closed.
e.zh: 那家创业公司在最新一轮融资完成后实力大增。

e.en: Important documents should be kept in a {fireproof} safe.
e.zh: 重要文件应当存放在防火保险柜里。

e.en: The new building uses {fireproof} materials throughout the structure.
e.zh: 这栋新楼整体结构都使用了防火材料。

fires.t:
n. 火；火灾（复数）
v. 开火；解雇

e.en: Wildfires and forest {fires} have intensified across the western states.
e.zh: 野火和森林大火在西部各州愈演愈烈。

e.en: The boss often {fires} questions at his team during meetings.
e.zh: 老板经常在会议上向团队连珠炮似地发问。

e.en: They enjoyed a quiet evening of {fireside} conversation and tea.
e.zh: 他们在炉边闲谈喝茶,度过了一个宁静的夜晚。

e.en: The president gave a {fireside} chat to reassure the nation.
e.zh: 总统发表了一次炉边谈话以安抚国民。

e.en: He bought new {Firestone} tires before the long road trip.
e.zh: 他在长途自驾旅行前换上了新的火石牌轮胎。

e.en: Ancient travelers carried a {firestone} to spark their campfires.
e.zh: 古代旅人随身携带火石用来点燃营火。

e.en: His controversial tweet sparked a {firestorm} of online criticism.
e.zh: 他那条争议性的推文引发了网上的猛烈批评浪潮。

e.en: The bombing created a {firestorm} that engulfed the entire city.
e.zh: 那次轰炸引发了吞噬整座城市的火灾风暴。

firetrap.t: n. 易起火且难逃生的建筑

e.en: That cluttered old warehouse is a complete {firetrap} now.
e.zh: 那座堆满杂物的旧仓库现在简直就是个火灾陷阱。

e.en: Inspectors closed the building after declaring it a dangerous {firetrap}.
e.zh: 检查员宣布该楼为危险的火灾陷阱后将其关闭。

e.en: A bright red {firetruck} raced down the street with sirens blaring.
e.zh: 一辆鲜红的消防车鸣笛飞驰过街道。

e.en: My toddler points excitedly at every {firetruck} we pass.
e.zh: 我的小孩每次看到消防车都会兴奋地指着。

e.en: Our company's {firewall} blocks suspicious traffic from unknown servers.
e.zh: 我们公司的防火墙会拦截来自不明服务器的可疑流量。

e.en: Configure the {firewall} to allow connections only on port 443.
e.zh: 将防火墙配置为只允许 443 端口的连接。

e.en: Modern enterprises rely on multiple layers of {firewalls} for security.
e.zh: 现代企业依赖多层防火墙来保障安全。

e.en: Hackers found ways to bypass the older {firewalls} last year.
e.zh: 去年黑客找到了绕过那些旧防火墙的办法。

e.en: The old miners called cheap whiskey {firewater} for good reason.
e.zh: 老矿工们把劣质威士忌叫做"火水",这是有道理的。

e.en: He poured a shot of {firewater} and grimaced at the burn.
e.zh: 他倒了一杯烈酒,被那股辣劲呛得直皱眉。

fireweed.t: n. 柳兰（火灾后常生植物）

e.en: Bright pink {fireweed} blooms quickly across recently burned forests.
e.zh: 鲜艳的粉色柳兰在新近烧过的森林里迅速绽放。

e.en: Bees love the tall stalks of {fireweed} growing along the trail.
e.zh: 蜜蜂喜爱沿着小径生长的高大柳兰花茎。

e.en: He chopped a stack of {firewood} before the snowstorm arrived.
e.zh: 他在暴风雪来临前劈好了一堆柴火。

e.en: We need more {firewood} to keep the cabin warm tonight.
e.zh: 我们需要更多柴火来让小木屋今晚保持温暖。

e.en: A single {firework} lit up the entire night sky beautifully.
e.zh: 一发烟花把整个夜空照得绚丽多彩。

e.en: The grand finale {firework} drew gasps from the entire crowd.
e.zh: 压轴的那发烟花引得全场观众惊叹连连。

e.en: We watched the New Year {fireworks} from the rooftop terrace.
e.zh: 我们在屋顶露台上观看了新年烟花表演。

e.en: There were real {fireworks} between the two candidates during the debate.
e.zh: 两位候选人在辩论中真是火药味十足。

e.en: The CEO is {firing} underperforming managers across several departments.
e.zh: 首席执行官正在解雇多个部门里业绩不佳的经理。

e.en: Soldiers heard {firing} coming from across the valley at dawn.
e.zh: 士兵们在黎明时分听到山谷对面传来枪声。

firm.t:
n. 公司
adj. 坚定的；结实的

e.en: She gave a {firm} handshake at the interview.
e.zh: 面试时她握手很有力。

e.en: He joined a small law {firm} after graduation.
e.zh: 他毕业后加入了一家小型律师事务所。

e.en: Stars glittered across the night {firmament}.
e.zh: 繁星在夜空中闪烁。

e.en: She is a rising star in the literary {firmament}.
e.zh: 她是文坛冉冉升起的新星。

firmed.t: v. firm 的过去式；使坚固

e.en: The jelly {firmed} up after an hour in the fridge.
e.zh: 果冻在冰箱里放了一小时后凝固了。

e.en: Prices {firmed} as demand grew stronger.
e.zh: 随着需求增强,价格趋于坚挺。

firming.t: v. firm 的现在分词；使变硬

e.en: The cream is great for {firming} the skin.
e.zh: 这款面霜很适合紧致肌肤。

e.en: Housing prices are slowly {firming} again.
e.zh: 房价正在慢慢回稳。

e.en: She {firmly} believes in equal pay for all.
e.zh: 她坚信人人都应同工同酬。

e.en: Hold the railing {firmly} as you climb.
e.zh: 上楼时请紧紧抓住扶手。

e.en: Check the avocado for {firmness} before buying it.
e.zh: 买牛油果前先按一下检查软硬。

e.en: She spoke with quiet {firmness} that ended the debate.
e.zh: 她语气平静而坚定,结束了这场争论。

e.en: The mattress comes in three different {firmnesses}.
e.zh: 这款床垫提供三种不同的软硬度。

e.en: Cheese varies widely in its {firmnesses} and flavors.
e.zh: 奶酪的硬度和风味差异很大。

firms.t:
n. 公司（复数）
v. 使坚固

e.en: Several tech {firms} are hiring engineers this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度多家科技公司正在招聘工程师。

e.en: The biggest accounting {firms} dominate the industry.
e.zh: 几家最大的会计师事务所主导着这个行业。

firmware.t: n. 固件（硬件中内置的软件）

e.en: Update the router's {firmware} to fix the bug.
e.zh: 更新路由器固件以修复这个问题。

e.en: The new {firmware} adds support for faster charging.
e.zh: 新固件增加了对快速充电的支持。

first.t:
adj. 第一的；首个的
adv. 首先

e.en: She was the {first} to arrive at the meeting.
e.zh: 她是第一个到达会议的人。

e.en: Always put safety {first} on the construction site.
e.zh: 在工地上,安全永远是第一位的。

first-aid.t:
adj. 急救的
n. 急救

e.en: Every classroom should have a {first-aid} kit nearby.
e.zh: 每间教室附近都应配备急救箱。

e.en: He took a {first-aid} course before the hike.
e.zh: 徒步前他参加了急救课程。

first-floor.t: adj. 一楼的（英式指二楼）

e.en: The cafe is on the {first-floor} of the building.
e.zh: 咖啡馆位于这栋楼的一楼。

e.en: Their office moved to a {first-floor} suite last month.
e.zh: 他们的办公室上个月搬到了一楼套间。

e.en: The hotel offers {first-rate} service and clean rooms.
e.zh: 这家酒店提供一流的服务和干净的房间。

e.en: She did a {first-rate} job leading the project.
e.zh: 她把项目带得非常出色。

firstborn.t:
n. 长子；头胎
adj. 头生的

e.en: Their {firstborn} just started kindergarten this fall.
e.zh: 他们的长子今年秋天刚上幼儿园。

e.en: In some cultures, the {firstborn} inherits the family business.
e.zh: 在某些文化中,长子继承家族生意。

firsthand.t:
adj. 第一手的
adv. 直接地

e.en: She has {firsthand} experience working in rural clinics.
e.zh: 她有在乡村诊所工作的第一手经验。

e.en: I heard the news {firsthand} from the manager.
e.zh: 我直接从经理那里听到了这个消息。

e.en: {Firstly}, I'd like to thank everyone for coming.
e.zh: 首先,我想感谢大家的到来。

e.en: {Firstly}, check whether the cable is properly plugged in.
e.zh: 首先,检查一下电缆是否插好了。

firsts.t: n. 第一名；头等品（复数）

e.en: This trip was full of {firsts} for the kids.
e.zh: 这次旅行对孩子们来说充满了各种第一次。

e.en: She racked up several {firsts} in her swimming career.
e.zh: 她在游泳生涯中创下了多项第一。

e.en: Boats sailed quietly into the wide {firth} at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时,船只静静地驶入宽阔的海湾。

e.en: We drove along the {firth} on our way north.
e.zh: 我们沿着海湾向北行驶。

e.en: Linguists sometimes cite the {fis} phenomenon in child speech studies.
e.zh: 语言学家在儿童语音研究中有时会引用 fis 现象。

e.en: The toddler said {fis} but rejected the adult's pronunciation.
e.zh: 那个幼儿说出 fis,却不接受大人的发音。

e.en: The company posted strong results for the {fiscal} year.
e.zh: 公司公布了强劲的财年业绩。

e.en: Voters demanded greater {fiscal} responsibility from the government.
e.zh: 选民要求政府承担更多的财政责任。

e.en: The mayor promised to govern {fiscally} responsibly.
e.zh: 市长承诺在财政上负责任地施政。

e.en: The new policy is {fiscally} sound and easy to implement.
e.zh: 新政策在财政上是合理的,也易于实施。

fish.t:
n. 鱼
v. 钓鱼；捕鱼

e.en: We had grilled {fish} and salad for dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚餐吃了烤鱼和沙拉。

e.en: My uncle loves to {fish} on weekends.
e.zh: 我叔叔喜欢在周末钓鱼。

e.en: The river is {fishable} again after years of cleanup.
e.zh: 经过多年治理,这条河又可以钓鱼了。

e.en: Only a few stretches of the lake are still {fishable}.
e.zh: 湖中只剩下几段水域还能钓鱼。

e.en: He almost choked on a tiny {fishbone}.
e.zh: 他差点被一根小鱼刺卡住。

e.en: The team drew a {fishbone} diagram to analyze the problem.
e.zh: 团队画了一张鱼骨图来分析问题。

e.en: A goldfish swam in circles inside the small {fishbowl}.
e.zh: 一条金鱼在小鱼缸里转圈游。

e.en: Celebrities live in a {fishbowl} where privacy is rare.
e.zh: 明星生活在金鱼缸里,几乎没有隐私。

e.en: She {fished} her keys out of her bag.
e.zh: 她从包里掏出了钥匙。

e.en: We {fished} all morning but caught nothing.
e.zh: 我们钓了一整个上午却一无所获。

e.en: The old {fisher} mended his nets by the dock.
e.zh: 那位老渔夫在码头边修补渔网。

e.en: A {fisher} darted across the snowy forest path.
e.zh: 一只渔貂飞快地穿过雪地中的林间小路。

e.en: Local {fisherfolk} protested the new fishing regulations.
e.zh: 当地渔民抗议新的捕鱼法规。

e.en: The village {fisherfolk} head out before sunrise.
e.zh: 村里的渔民们日出前就出海了。

e.en: The {fisherman} returned to shore with a full net.
e.zh: 渔夫满网而归,回到了岸边。

e.en: My grandfather was a {fisherman} for over forty years.
e.zh: 我祖父当了四十多年的渔夫。

e.en: Local {fishermen} worry about declining fish stocks.
e.zh: 当地渔民担心鱼类资源不断减少。

e.en: The {fishermen} unloaded their catch at the harbor.
e.zh: 渔民们在港口卸下了渔获。

e.en: The {fisherwoman} steered her boat through the morning mist.
e.zh: 那位女渔夫驾船穿过清晨的薄雾。

e.en: She became the first {fisherwoman} to lead the cooperative.
e.zh: 她成为该合作社首位女渔民负责人。

e.en: The salmon {fishery} closed early due to low stocks.
e.zh: 由于鱼群数量少,这处三文鱼渔场提前关闭了。

e.en: Sustainable {fishery} practices help protect ocean ecosystems.
e.zh: 可持续渔业管理有助于保护海洋生态。

fishes.t:
n. fish 的复数
v. 捕鱼（三单）

e.en: The aquarium displays tropical {fishes} from many regions.
e.zh: 水族馆展示了来自许多地区的热带鱼。

e.en: My dad {fishes} every Saturday morning at the lake.
e.zh: 我爸爸每周六早上都去湖边钓鱼。

e.en: The {fishfinder} showed a large school below the boat.
e.zh: 探鱼器显示船下有一大群鱼。

e.en: Modern {fishfinder} screens use sonar and GPS together.
e.zh: 现代探鱼器屏幕同时使用声呐和 GPS。

fishguard.t: n. 菲什加德（英国地名）

e.en: We caught the ferry from {Fishguard} to Ireland.
e.zh: 我们从菲什加德搭乘渡轮去爱尔兰。

e.en: {Fishguard} is a small port town in west Wales.
e.zh: 菲什加德是威尔士西部的一个小港口城镇。

e.en: He carefully baited the {fishhook} with a worm.
e.zh: 他小心地把一只虫子挂上鱼钩。

e.en: A rusty {fishhook} was tangled in the seaweed.
e.zh: 一枚生锈的鱼钩缠在海藻里。

fishing.t:
n. 钓鱼；捕鱼
v. fish 的现在分词

e.en: We went {fishing} at the lake last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们去湖边钓鱼了。

e.en: Be careful of {fishing} emails asking for your password.
e.zh: 小心那些索要密码的钓鱼邮件。

e.en: The estate's private {fishings} attract anglers from abroad.
e.zh: 该庄园的私人渔场吸引了来自海外的钓客。

e.en: Rights to the river {fishings} have been disputed for years.
e.zh: 这条河的捕鱼权多年来一直存在争议。

e.en: The submarine had a sleek, {fishlike} shape.
e.zh: 这艘潜艇有着光滑的鱼形外观。

e.en: His eyes had a strange, {fishlike} stare.
e.zh: 他的眼神带着一种奇怪的鱼一般的呆滞。

e.en: The local {fishman} delivers fresh catch every morning.
e.zh: 当地的鱼贩每天早上送来新鲜渔获。

e.en: We bought scallops from the {fishman} at the market.
e.zh: 我们从市场上的鱼贩那里买了扇贝。

e.en: The farm uses {fishmeal} as protein in its feed.
e.zh: 该农场用鱼粉作为饲料中的蛋白质来源。

e.en: {Fishmeal} prices rose sharply due to poor catches.
e.zh: 由于捕捞量差,鱼粉价格大幅上涨。

e.en: The {fishmonger} cleaned and filleted the salmon for me.
e.zh: 鱼贩帮我把那条三文鱼清理并切成了鱼片。

e.en: Our local {fishmonger} sources seafood from small boats.
e.zh: 我们当地的鱼贩从小渔船采购海鲜。

e.en: She paired the dress with sheer {fishnet} stockings.
e.zh: 她把这条裙子搭配了一双透明的渔网袜。

e.en: The {fishnet} dried in the sun on the dock.
e.zh: 渔网在码头上晒太阳风干。

e.en: Koi swam slowly around the garden {fishpond}.
e.zh: 锦鲤在花园的鱼池里慢慢游动。

e.en: He built a small {fishpond} behind the house.
e.zh: 他在房子后面建了一个小鱼池。

fishtail.t:
n. 鱼尾
v. (车辆) 尾部打滑

e.en: The car began to {fishtail} on the icy road.
e.zh: 汽车在结冰的路上开始打滑摆尾。

e.en: She wore an elegant {fishtail} gown to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一件优雅的鱼尾礼服出席晚会。

e.en: He shouted like a {fishwife} when his team lost.
e.zh: 球队输球时他像泼妇一样大喊大叫。

e.en: The {fishwife} hawked her morning catch loudly.
e.zh: 卖鱼妇大声叫卖着早晨的渔获。

e.en: Something about his story sounds {fishy} to me.
e.zh: 他讲的故事让我觉得有点可疑。

e.en: The kitchen had a strong {fishy} smell.
e.zh: 厨房里有一股很重的鱼腥味。

fissile.t: adj. 可裂变的；易分裂的

e.en: Uranium-235 is a {fissile} material used in reactors.
e.zh: 铀-235 是反应堆中使用的可裂变材料。

e.en: Treaties aim to limit production of {fissile} substances worldwide.
e.zh: 多项条约旨在限制全球可裂变物质的生产。

e.en: Nuclear {fission} releases huge amounts of energy.
e.zh: 核裂变会释放出巨大的能量。

e.en: The cell undergoes {fission} to produce two daughter cells.
e.zh: 细胞通过分裂产生两个子细胞。

e.en: Inspectors check facilities that handle {fissionable} materials.
e.zh: 检查员会检查处理可裂变材料的设施。

e.en: Only certain isotopes are {fissionable} under normal conditions.
e.zh: 在正常条件下,只有某些同位素是可裂变的。

fissiparous.t: adj. 分裂繁殖的；易分裂的

e.en: The party became {fissiparous} after losing the election.
e.zh: 那个政党在败选后变得四分五裂。

e.en: Online communities are often {fissiparous} when leadership is weak.
e.zh: 领导无力时,网络社群往往容易分裂。

fissure.t:
n. 裂缝、裂隙
v. 使开裂

e.en: A deep {fissure} opened in the rock after the earthquake.
e.zh: 地震后岩石上裂开了一道深深的裂缝。

e.en: The scandal exposed a {fissure} within the ruling party.
e.zh: 丑闻暴露了执政党内部的裂痕。

e.en: The {fissured} cliff face looked dangerous to climb.
e.zh: 那布满裂缝的崖壁看起来很难攀登。

e.en: Years of drought left the soil dry and {fissured}.
e.zh: 多年干旱使土壤干裂开缝。

e.en: Tiny {fissures} appeared on the old painting's surface.
e.zh: 旧画的表面出现了细小的裂纹。

e.en: The crisis revealed deep {fissures} in the alliance.
e.zh: 这场危机暴露了联盟内部的深层裂痕。

fist.t:
n. 拳头
v. 用拳打

e.en: He clenched his {fist} in frustration.
e.zh: 他沮丧地握紧了拳头。

e.en: The protesters raised a {fist} into the air.
e.zh: 抗议者们高高举起拳头。

e.en: She {fisted} her hands and waited for the news.
e.zh: 她紧握双拳等待消息。

e.en: He {fisted} the table when the verdict was read.
e.zh: 判决宣读时他猛地一拳砸在桌上。

e.en: A {fistfight} broke out between two fans at the bar.
e.zh: 两名球迷在酒吧里打了起来。

e.en: The argument quickly turned into an ugly {fistfight}.
e.zh: 那场争执很快演变成一场难看的拳斗。

e.en: She grabbed a {fistful} of popcorn from the bowl.
e.zh: 她从碗里抓了一把爆米花。

e.en: He pulled a {fistful} of cash from his pocket.
e.zh: 他从口袋里掏出一把现金。

e.en: The drunken pair settled the matter with {fisticuff}.
e.zh: 那对醉汉用拳头解决了争端。

e.en: He learned a bit of {fisticuff} growing up on the streets.
e.zh: 他在街头长大,学了点拳脚功夫。

e.en: The doctor recommended surgery to close the {fistula}.
e.zh: 医生建议做手术关闭瘘管。

e.en: A dental {fistula} can signal an underlying infection.
e.zh: 牙瘘可能预示着潜在的感染。

fit.t:
adj. 合适的；健康的
v. 适合、安装

e.en: These jeans don't {fit} me anymore.
e.zh: 这条牛仔裤我穿不下了。

e.en: You need to be very {fit} to run a marathon.
e.zh: 跑马拉松需要身体非常健壮。

e.en: The painter used a fine {fitch} for detailed work.
e.zh: 画家用一支细毛笔刷处理细节。

e.en: Her grandmother kept an old {fitch} fur stole.
e.zh: 她奶奶留着一条旧的臭鼬毛披肩。

fitful.t: adj. 断断续续的；不稳定的

e.en: He had a {fitful} sleep before the big interview.
e.zh: 重要面试前,他睡得断断续续。

e.en: Progress on the project has been {fitful} at best.
e.zh: 项目进展时断时续,最多算勉强。

e.en: The baby slept {fitfully} through the night.
e.zh: 宝宝整夜睡得不安稳。

e.en: The candle flickered {fitfully} in the draft.
e.zh: 烛光在风中一阵阵摇曳。

e.en: The kitchen comes with all the standard {fitment} included.
e.zh: 厨房配备了所有标准家具配件。

e.en: Bathroom {fitment} should match the overall style.
e.zh: 浴室配件应当与整体风格相搭。

e.en: She tracks her {fitness} with a smartwatch.
e.zh: 她用智能手表记录健身情况。

e.en: The committee questioned his {fitness} for the role.
e.zh: 委员会质疑他是否胜任该职位。

fitnesses.t: n. 健身（fitness 复数，罕用）

e.en: The algorithm evaluates the {fitnesses} of different solutions.
e.zh: 算法会评估不同解决方案的适应度。

e.en: Genetic models compare the {fitnesses} of competing traits.
e.zh: 遗传模型会比较各种性状的适应度。

fits.t:
v. 适合（fit 三单）
n. 发作、阵发

e.en: This dress {fits} her perfectly.
e.zh: 这条裙子她穿着特别合身。

e.en: The toddler threw several {fits} at the supermarket.
e.zh: 那个小孩在超市里发了好几次脾气。

e.en: The carpenter {fitted} the new shelves yesterday.
e.zh: 木匠昨天装好了新书架。

e.en: She wore a {fitted} black dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条修身的黑裙子去参加聚会。

e.en: After three months of training, he feels much {fitter}.
e.zh: 训练三个月后,他感觉身体强健多了。

e.en: A {fitter} came to install the new boiler.
e.zh: 一位安装工人来装新锅炉。

fitting.t:
adj. 合适的
n. 配件、试衣

e.en: It seems {fitting} to thank the volunteers publicly.
e.zh: 公开感谢志愿者似乎很合适。

e.en: She booked a {fitting} for her wedding dress.
e.zh: 她预约了婚纱试衣。

e.en: {Fittingly}, the award went to the most dedicated player.
e.zh: 恰如其分地,奖项颁给了最投入的球员。

e.en: The ceremony ended {fittingly} with a moment of silence.
e.zh: 仪式以一分钟默哀恰当地结束。

e.en: The meeting starts at {five} sharp.
e.zh: 会议五点整开始。

e.en: My daughter just turned {five} last week.
e.zh: 我女儿上周刚满五岁。

e.en: Online sales grew {fivefold} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间网购销量增长了五倍。

e.en: The app saw a {fivefold} increase in downloads.
e.zh: 该应用的下载量增长了五倍。

e.en: The candy used to cost just {fivepence} a piece.
e.zh: 这种糖以前一颗才五便士。

e.en: He dropped a {fivepence} coin into the charity box.
e.zh: 他往慈善箱里投了一枚五便士硬币。

fiver.t: n. 五英镑（或五美元）钞票

e.en: Can you lend me a {fiver} until tomorrow?
e.zh: 能借我五块钱到明天吗?

e.en: The taxi ride cost just over a {fiver}.
e.zh: 打车花了刚过五英镑。

fix.t:
v. 修复、解决；固定
n. 解决办法

e.en: Can you {fix} the broken zipper on my jacket?
e.zh: 你能修一下我夹克上坏掉的拉链吗?

e.en: The latest update should {fix} the login bug.
e.zh: 最新的更新应该能修复登录漏洞。

fixable.t: adj. 可修复的；可固定的

e.en: Don't worry, the leaky tap is easily {fixable}.
e.zh: 别担心,漏水的水龙头很容易修。

e.en: Most of these bugs are {fixable} within a day.
e.zh: 这些漏洞大多一天之内就能修复。

fixate.t: v. 注视；专注于；使固定

e.en: Try not to {fixate} on one negative review.
e.zh: 别老是纠结于某一条差评。

e.en: Cats often {fixate} on moving lights.
e.zh: 猫常常会盯着移动的光点不放。

fixated.t: adj. 执着的、过分专注的

e.en: He's totally {fixated} on getting into Harvard.
e.zh: 他一心扑在考进哈佛上。

e.en: The toddler stayed {fixated} on the spinning fan.
e.zh: 那个幼儿目不转睛地盯着旋转的风扇。

e.en: Her {fixation} with clean rooms borders on obsession.
e.zh: 她对房间整洁的执着近乎强迫症。

e.en: Society's {fixation} on youth is exhausting.
e.zh: 社会对年轻的痴迷让人疲惫。

e.en: Spray a {fixative} on your charcoal sketch to preserve it.
e.zh: 在炭笔素描上喷一层定影剂以保存画面。

e.en: The perfumer added a natural {fixative} to the blend.
e.zh: 调香师在配方中加了一种天然定香剂。

e.en: The surgeon attached an external {fixator} to stabilize the bone.
e.zh: 外科医生装上外部固定器以稳定骨头。

e.en: The {fixator} will stay on his leg for six weeks.
e.zh: 那个固定器要在他腿上戴六周。

e.en: The plumber finally {fixed} the leak this morning.
e.zh: 水管工今天早上终于修好了漏水。

e.en: The mortgage has a {fixed} interest rate for five years.
e.zh: 这笔房贷有五年的固定利率。

e.en: She stared {fixedly} at the screen, ignoring everyone.
e.zh: 她目不转睛地盯着屏幕,无视所有人。

e.en: The cat watched the bird {fixedly} through the window.
e.zh: 那只猫透过窗户死死盯着那只鸟。

fixer.t: n. 解决问题的人；掮客

e.en: Every campaign has a quiet {fixer} working behind the scenes.
e.zh: 每场竞选背后都有个低调的能手在打点。

e.en: He's known as the studio's go-to {fixer}.
e.zh: 他是公司里出了名的救火队长。

fixes.t: v./n. 修复（fix 复数/三单）

e.en: This patch {fixes} several critical security issues.
e.zh: 这个补丁修复了几个严重的安全问题。

e.en: The new release includes dozens of bug {fixes}.
e.zh: 新版本包含了数十项漏洞修复。

e.en: He's {fixing} dinner while the kids do homework.
e.zh: 孩子们写作业时,他在准备晚饭。

e.en: The mechanic is {fixing} the brakes right now.
e.zh: 修理工正在修刹车。

e.en: The {fixity} of his beliefs surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他信念的坚定不移令所有人惊讶。

e.en: There's no {fixity} in modern job markets anymore.
e.zh: 如今的就业市场已无任何稳定性可言。

fixture.t:
n. 固定装置；固定物
n. 赛事；定期活动

e.en: Sunday brunch has become a {fixture} in our family.
e.zh: 周日早午餐已成为我们家的固定节目。

e.en: The plumber replaced the old bathroom {fixture}.
e.zh: 水管工换掉了浴室里那个旧装置。

fixtures.t:
n. 固定装置（复数）
n. 赛程安排

e.en: All light {fixtures} in the apartment were upgraded.
e.zh: 公寓里所有灯具都升级了。

e.en: The Premier League {fixtures} were released today.
e.zh: 英超联赛赛程今天公布了。

fiz.t: n. 嘶嘶声（fizz 的变体，罕用）

e.en: The soda lost its {fiz} after sitting open all night.
e.zh: 汽水放了一夜,气都跑光了。

e.en: You could hear the gentle {fiz} of the champagne.
e.zh: 你能听到香槟轻轻冒泡的声音。

fizz.t:
n. 气泡声；汽水
v. 发出嘶嘶声

e.en: Open the bottle slowly so the {fizz} doesn't spray out.
e.zh: 慢慢开瓶,免得气泡喷出来。

e.en: This cola has lost all its {fizz}.
e.zh: 这瓶可乐已经完全没气了。

fizzing.t:
v. 冒泡；发出嘶嘶声
adj. 起泡的

e.en: The tablet was {fizzing} loudly in the glass of water.
e.zh: 那药片在水杯里嘶嘶地冒着泡。

e.en: She was {fizzing} with excitement after the audition.
e.zh: 试镜结束后她兴奋得不得了。

fizzle.t:
v. 以失败告终；虎头蛇尾
n. 失败

e.en: The protest movement began to {fizzle} after a few weeks.
e.zh: 抗议运动几周后就渐渐没了声息。

e.en: Don't let your New Year's plans {fizzle} out.
e.zh: 别让你的新年计划无疾而终。

fizzy.t: adj. 含气泡的；汽水类的

e.en: I prefer {fizzy} water over still.
e.zh: 比起平水,我更喜欢气泡水。

e.en: Kids love {fizzy} drinks despite the sugar.
e.zh: 虽然糖分高,孩子们还是爱喝汽水。

e.en: The cruise sailed slowly through a Norwegian {fjord}.
e.zh: 游轮缓缓驶过挪威的一条峡湾。

e.en: Sheer cliffs rose on both sides of the {fjord}.
e.zh: 峡湾两侧矗立着陡峭的悬崖。

e.en: He's been working out to lose the {flab} around his waist.
e.zh: 他一直在健身,想甩掉腰间的赘肉。

e.en: A few months of running burned off most of the {flab}.
e.zh: 跑步几个月就甩掉了大部分赘肉。

flabbergast.t: v. 使大吃一惊；使目瞪口呆

e.en: The plot twist will totally {flabbergast} viewers.
e.zh: 这个剧情反转会让观众目瞪口呆。

e.en: His rude reply seemed designed to {flabbergast} the panel.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的回答仿佛就是要让评委瞠目结舌。

flabbergasted.t: adj. 目瞪口呆的；大为震惊的

e.en: I was {flabbergasted} when I saw the final bill.
e.zh: 看到最后的账单时我惊呆了。

e.en: She stood {flabbergasted} as he proposed in public.
e.zh: 他当众求婚时,她惊得说不出话。

e.en: His arms had grown {flabby} after months without exercise.
e.zh: 几个月没锻炼，他的胳膊变得松弛了。

e.en: The manager gave a {flabby} excuse for missing the deadline.
e.zh: 经理为错过截止日期给出了一个无力的借口。

e.en: The balloon hung {flaccid} after losing most of its air.
e.zh: 气球漏气后软塌塌地垂着。

e.en: Critics called the film's plot {flaccid} and uninspired.
e.zh: 评论家称这部电影的情节软弱无力且缺乏新意。

flack.t:
n. 宣传员；公关
n. 批评（= flak）

e.en: The company hired a {flack} to handle bad press.
e.zh: 公司雇了一名公关来应对负面新闻。

e.en: She got a lot of {flack} for her controversial tweet.
e.zh: 她那条争议推文招来了不少批评。

flag.t:
n. 旗帜
v. 标记；做标注

e.en: Please {flag} this email so I can review it later.
e.zh: 请把这封邮件标记一下，方便我稍后查看。

e.en: The national {flag} was raised at sunrise.
e.zh: 国旗在日出时升起。

e.en: Bacteria use tiny {flagella} to swim through liquid.
e.zh: 细菌用细小的鞭毛在液体中游动。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {flagella} whipped back and forth rapidly.
e.zh: 显微镜下，那些鞭毛快速地来回摆动。

flagellate.t:
v. 鞭打；鞭笞
adj. 有鞭毛的

e.en: Some monks used to {flagellate} themselves as penance.
e.zh: 过去有些修道士会鞭打自己以示忏悔。

e.en: The single-celled {flagellate} moved using its long tail.
e.zh: 这种单细胞鞭毛虫靠长尾巴移动。

e.en: The painting depicts the {flagellation} of a saint.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了一位圣人受鞭刑的场景。

e.en: Public {flagellation} was once used as criminal punishment.
e.zh: 公开鞭刑曾被用作刑罚。

flagged.t:
v. 已被标记；被标注
adj. 铺石的

e.en: The moderator {flagged} the post for review.
e.zh: 版主将该帖子标记以待审查。

e.en: Her energy {flagged} after the third hour of hiking.
e.zh: 徒步三小时后，她的体力开始下降。

flagging.t:
adj. 衰退的；减弱的
n. 标记；铺石

e.en: Coffee helped revive my {flagging} attention during the lecture.
e.zh: 咖啡让我在讲座中下降的注意力重新振作起来。

e.en: The team's {flagging} morale worried the new coach.
e.zh: 团队日渐低落的士气让新教练很担心。

flaggy.t: adj. 像旗的；松软下垂的（罕用）

e.en: The path was paved with {flaggy} stones from the local quarry.
e.zh: 小路用当地采石场的扁石板铺成。

e.en: They climbed across the {flaggy} outcrop along the coast.
e.zh: 他们沿着海岸爬过那片片状岩石。

e.en: The innkeeper filled a large {flagon} with ale.
e.zh: 店主把一只大酒壶装满了麦酒。

e.en: A silver {flagon} stood at the center of the table.
e.zh: 桌子中央摆着一只银制大酒壶。

e.en: The school flag flapped at the top of the {flagpole}.
e.zh: 校旗在旗杆顶端飘扬。

e.en: Let's run it up the {flagpole} and see what people think.
e.zh: 我们先抛出来试试，看看大家的反应。

flagrant.t: adj. 公然的；明目张胆的

e.en: The referee called a {flagrant} foul on the forward.
e.zh: 裁判判罚前锋一次恶意犯规。

e.en: It was a {flagrant} violation of company policy.
e.zh: 这是对公司规定的公然违反。

flagrantly.t: adv. 公然地；明目张胆地

e.en: He {flagrantly} ignored the warning signs at the construction site.
e.zh: 他公然无视工地上的警示牌。

e.en: The official {flagrantly} broke the rules he was meant to enforce.
e.zh: 那名官员公然违反了他本该执行的规定。

flags.t:
n. 旗帜（复数）
v. 标记；标注

e.en: Colorful {flags} lined the streets during the festival.
e.zh: 节日期间，五彩旗帜在街道两旁飘扬。

e.en: The system {flags} suspicious transactions automatically.
e.zh: 系统会自动标记可疑交易。

e.en: The {flagship} store opened on Fifth Avenue last week.
e.zh: 旗舰店上周在第五大道开业。

e.en: This phone is the company's new {flagship} model.
e.zh: 这款手机是公司最新的旗舰机型。

e.en: A tall {flagstaff} stood in front of the embassy.
e.zh: 大使馆前竖着一根高高的旗杆。

e.en: Workers repainted the wooden {flagstaff} every spring.
e.zh: 工人们每年春天都会重新粉刷木制旗杆。

e.en: His putt rolled past the {flagstick} into the rough.
e.zh: 他的推杆滚过旗杆，落进了长草区。

e.en: The caddie removed the {flagstick} before the next putt.
e.zh: 球童在下一次推杆前拔掉了旗杆。

e.en: The garden path was made of weathered {flagstone}.
e.zh: 花园小径由风化的石板铺成。

e.en: Each {flagstone} fit neatly into the patio design.
e.zh: 每块石板都完美契合露台的设计。

flail.t:
v. 乱挥；胡乱摆动
n. 连枷

e.en: The toddler began to {flail} his arms in frustration.
e.zh: 那个小孩气得乱挥胳膊。

e.en: Don't just {flail} around — make a clear plan first.
e.zh: 别瞎忙活，先订个清晰的计划。

e.en: The swimmer was {flailing} wildly in the deep water.
e.zh: 那个游泳者在深水中拼命乱扑腾。

e.en: The startup is {flailing} after losing its biggest client.
e.zh: 那家初创公司失去最大客户后陷入了挣扎。

flair.t:
n. 天赋；天分
n. 风格；品味

e.en: She has a real {flair} for graphic design.
e.zh: 她在平面设计方面很有天赋。

e.en: The chef adds his own {flair} to every dish.
e.zh: 这位厨师为每道菜都加入了自己的特色。

flak.t:
n. 强烈批评；抨击
n. 高射炮火

e.en: The CEO took a lot of {flak} for the layoffs.
e.zh: 首席执行官因裁员而饱受批评。

e.en: Pilots wore heavy vests to protect against {flak}.
e.zh: 飞行员穿着厚重的防护服以抵御高射炮火。

flake.t:
n. 薄片；碎片
v. 剥落

e.en: A single snow {flake} landed on her glove.
e.zh: 一片雪花落在她的手套上。

e.en: Don't invite him — he's a total {flake}.
e.zh: 别叫他了，他特别不靠谱。

flaked.t:
v. 剥落；成薄片脱落
adj. 片状的

e.en: The old paint {flaked} off the wooden door.
e.zh: 木门上的旧漆剥落了下来。

e.en: He {flaked} on dinner again at the last minute.
e.zh: 他又在最后一刻放了晚餐的鸽子。

flakiness.t: n. 易剥落；（代码）不稳定

e.en: The {flakiness} of the croissant impressed every customer.
e.zh: 羊角面包的酥脆层次让每位顾客都赞不绝口。

e.en: His {flakiness} cost him several friendships.
e.zh: 他的不靠谱让他失去了几位朋友。

e.en: The wallpaper was {flaking} off in the damp corner.
e.zh: 潮湿的角落里墙纸正在剥落。

e.en: Use moisturizer to prevent your skin from {flaking}.
e.zh: 使用润肤霜可以防止皮肤起皮。

flaky.t:
adj. (测试、系统) 不稳定的；偶发失败的
adj. 片状的

e.en: The pie crust turned out beautifully {flaky}.
e.zh: 派皮烤得层次酥脆，非常漂亮。

e.en: My internet connection has been really {flaky} today.
e.zh: 我的网络今天一直时好时坏。

e.en: His outfit's {flamboyance} drew stares from across the room.
e.zh: 他那身浮夸的装扮引来了满屋子的目光。

e.en: The singer is known for the {flamboyance} of her stage shows.
e.zh: 这位歌手以舞台表演的华丽炫目而闻名。

flamboyant.t: adj. 华丽的；浮夸张扬的

e.en: He wore a {flamboyant} pink suit to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着一身浮夸的粉色西装出席婚礼。

e.en: Her {flamboyant} personality lit up every party.
e.zh: 她张扬的个性点亮了每一场聚会。

e.en: He dressed {flamboyantly} for every red carpet event.
e.zh: 他每次走红毯都打扮得十分张扬。

e.en: She {flamboyantly} waved to the crowd from the balcony.
e.zh: 她在阳台上夸张地向人群挥手。

flame.t:
n. 火焰
v. 网上谩骂；开喷

e.en: A small {flame} flickered at the end of the candle.
e.zh: 蜡烛末端跳动着一小簇火苗。

e.en: Online trolls love to {flame} strangers in comment sections.
e.zh: 网络喷子喜欢在评论区攻击陌生人。

flamenco.t: n. 弗拉明戈（西班牙舞蹈、音乐）

e.en: We watched a passionate {flamenco} performance in Seville.
e.zh: 我们在塞维利亚观看了一场充满激情的弗拉门戈表演。

e.en: She has been studying {flamenco} dance for five years.
e.zh: 她学习弗拉门戈舞已经五年了。

flameout.t: n. (发动机) 熄火；彻底失败

e.en: The engine suffered a sudden {flameout} mid-flight.
e.zh: 飞机引擎在飞行中突然熄火。

e.en: His career ended in a spectacular {flameout}.
e.zh: 他的职业生涯以惨烈的失败告终。

e.en: Firefighters wear {flameproof} suits when entering burning buildings.
e.zh: 消防员进入燃烧的建筑时会穿防火服。

e.en: This dish is made from {flameproof} ceramic.
e.zh: 这只盘子是用耐火陶瓷制成的。

flames.t:
n. 火焰（复数）
v. 燃烧；谩骂

e.en: The {flames} quickly spread across the dry grassland.
e.zh: 火焰迅速蔓延过干燥的草原。

e.en: By the time we arrived, the cabin was already in {flames}.
e.zh: 我们到达时，小屋已经着火了。

flaming.t:
adj. 燃烧的；火红的
n. 网上谩骂

e.en: The sky turned a {flaming} orange at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时天空变成了火红的橙色。

e.en: A {flaming} torch lit the entrance to the cave.
e.zh: 一支燃烧的火把照亮了洞穴入口。

e.en: A pink {flamingo} stood on one leg in the shallow water.
e.zh: 一只粉红色的火烈鸟单腿站在浅水中。

e.en: The zoo's {flamingo} exhibit was the kids' favorite.
e.zh: 动物园的火烈鸟展区是孩子们的最爱。

e.en: The lab tested the fabric's {flammability} before approval.
e.zh: 实验室在批准前测试了这种面料的可燃性。

e.en: Children's pajamas must meet strict {flammability} standards.
e.zh: 儿童睡衣必须符合严格的可燃性标准。

e.en: Keep {flammable} liquids away from the stove.
e.zh: 请将易燃液体远离炉灶。

e.en: This warning label means the contents are highly {flammable}.
e.zh: 这个警示标签表示内容物高度易燃。

e.en: She ordered caramel {flan} for dessert.
e.zh: 她点了焦糖布丁作为甜点。

e.en: My grandmother's {flan} recipe has been passed down for generations.
e.zh: 奶奶的布丁配方已经传承了好几代。

flanders.t: n. 佛兰德斯（欧洲地区名）

e.en: The poppies of {Flanders} became a symbol of remembrance.
e.zh: 佛兰德斯的罂粟花成为了纪念的象征。

e.en: He spent the summer cycling through the towns of {Flanders}.
e.zh: 他整个夏天都在佛兰德斯的小镇间骑行。

e.en: Tighten the bolts around the pipe {flange} evenly.
e.zh: 请均匀拧紧管道法兰周围的螺栓。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the cracked {flange} on the engine.
e.zh: 机械师更换了引擎上那只破裂的凸缘。

flanged.t: adj. 带法兰的；带凸缘的

e.en: The plumber installed a {flanged} pipe under the sink.
e.zh: 水管工在水槽下方安装了一根带法兰的管道。

e.en: Train wheels are {flanged} to keep them on the rails.
e.zh: 火车轮带凸缘以保持在轨道上。

flank.t:
n. 侧面；腰窝肉
v. 位于…侧面

e.en: Two bodyguards walked on either {flank} of the senator.
e.zh: 两名保镖分别走在参议员的两侧。

e.en: The army moved to {flank} the enemy from the north.
e.zh: 军队从北面包抄敌军的侧翼。

flanker.t: n. 侧翼球员；侧翼部队

e.en: The {flanker} made a key tackle near the try line.
e.zh: 侧翼前锋在达阵线附近完成了一次关键抢断。

e.en: Their fastest player started as left {flanker}.
e.zh: 他们最快的球员以左边锋的身份首发。

e.en: Two stone lions stood {flanking} the entrance.
e.zh: 两只石狮分立在入口两侧。

e.en: The general ordered a {flanking} attack at dawn.
e.zh: 将军下令在黎明发起侧翼攻击。

e.en: He wore a cozy {flannel} shirt on the camping trip.
e.zh: 他在露营时穿了一件舒适的法兰绒衬衫。

e.en: The bed was made up with soft {flannel} sheets.
e.zh: 床上铺着柔软的法兰绒床单。

e.en: Babies often sleep in {flannelette} pajamas during winter.
e.zh: 宝宝们冬天常穿棉绒睡衣睡觉。

e.en: She bought {flannelette} sheets to stay warm at night.
e.zh: 她买了棉绒床单以保暖过夜。

flap.t:
v. 拍动；扇动
n. 翻盖；襟翼

e.en: The bird began to {flap} its wings frantically.
e.zh: 那只鸟开始疯狂地拍打翅膀。

e.en: Lift the {flap} of the envelope to read the message.
e.zh: 掀开信封的封口就能读到信息。

e.en: He ordered a stack of {flapjack} with maple syrup.
e.zh: 他点了一摞配枫糖浆的煎饼。

e.en: I packed an oat {flapjack} for my afternoon snack.
e.zh: 我带了一块燕麦能量棒当下午茶。

flapped.t: v. flap 的过去式；拍动过

e.en: The bird {flapped} its wings and soared away.
e.zh: 那只鸟拍了拍翅膀飞走了。

e.en: The flag {flapped} loudly in the strong wind.
e.zh: 旗子在大风中啪啪作响。

e.en: She dressed as a 1920s {flapper} for the party.
e.zh: 她打扮成20年代的摩登女郎去参加派对。

e.en: The toilet {flapper} needs replacing because water keeps running.
e.zh: 马桶的橡皮塞要换了,水一直在流。

e.en: The tent was {flapping} noisily all through the night.
e.zh: 帐篷整夜哗啦啦地响个不停。

e.en: Stop {flapping} your arms and listen calmly to me.
e.zh: 别再挥舞手臂了,冷静听我说。

flaps.t:
n. 襟翼；翻盖
v. 拍动

e.en: The pilot lowered the {flaps} before landing the plane.
e.zh: 飞行员在着陆前放下了襟翼。

e.en: The dog's ears {flaps} when it shakes its head.
e.zh: 那只狗摇头时耳朵会扑扇。

flare.t:
n. 闪光；信号弹
v. 闪耀；突发

e.en: The driver lit a road {flare} after the crash.
e.zh: 司机在车祸后点燃了一根路边信号弹。

e.en: Tempers can {flare} during a heated debate online.
e.zh: 网上激烈辩论时,火气很容易爆发。

e.en: Her nostrils {flared} when she heard the rude comment.
e.zh: 听到那句无礼的话,她气得鼻孔都张开了。

e.en: She wore {flared} jeans straight out of the seventies.
e.zh: 她穿着一条七十年代风格的喇叭牛仔裤。

e.en: The candle was {flaring} brightly in the drafty room.
e.zh: 蜡烛在透风的房间里忽明忽暗地燃烧。

e.en: His eczema kept {flaring} up during exam season.
e.zh: 考试季他的湿疹老是反复发作。

flash.t:
n. 闪光；瞬间
v. 闪烁；闪现

e.en: Turn off the {flash} when taking photos in museums.
e.zh: 在博物馆拍照时请关掉闪光灯。

e.en: The whole video went viral in a {flash} online.
e.zh: 那段视频在网上瞬间就火了。

e.en: The movie opens with a {flashback} to her childhood.
e.zh: 电影以她童年的闪回片段开场。

e.en: That song gave me a sudden {flashback} to college.
e.zh: 那首歌让我突然回想起大学时光。

e.en: Veterans often experience painful {flashbacks} of combat scenes.
e.zh: 老兵常会闪回到痛苦的战斗场景。

e.en: The novel uses {flashbacks} to reveal the hero's backstory.
e.zh: 这本小说用闪回手法揭示主角的过往。

e.en: The old camera used a disposable {flashbulb} for each shot.
e.zh: 那台老相机每拍一张都得换一个闪光灯泡。

e.en: Most people have a {flashbulb} memory of that day.
e.zh: 大多数人对那一天都有极其鲜明的记忆。

e.en: She studies vocabulary using a {flashcard} app on her phone.
e.zh: 她用手机上的单词卡应用背单词。

e.en: Each {flashcard} has the word on one side.
e.zh: 每张抽认卡的一面写着单词。

e.en: A warning light {flashed} on the car's dashboard.
e.zh: 车的仪表盘上闪起了一盏警示灯。

e.en: She {flashed} him a quick smile across the room.
e.zh: 她隔着房间对他飞快地笑了一下。

e.en: Police arrested a {flasher} who exposed himself in the park.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了一名在公园里暴露下体的露阴狂。

e.en: The hazard {flasher} on the truck blinked steadily.
e.zh: 卡车的危险警示灯稳定地闪烁着。

flashes.t:
n. 闪光（复数）
v. 闪烁

e.en: Lightning {flashes} lit up the entire night sky.
e.zh: 闪电一道接一道照亮了整个夜空。

e.en: She gets sudden {flashes} of inspiration while showering.
e.zh: 她洗澡时常会突然冒出灵感。

e.en: His outfit's {flashiness} drew stares from everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他那身花哨的打扮引得满屋子的人盯着看。

e.en: I prefer simple design over the {flashiness} of luxury logos.
e.zh: 比起奢侈品logo的浮夸,我更喜欢简洁的设计。

flashing.t:
adj. 闪烁的
n. 防水板

e.en: A police car came past with its lights {flashing}.
e.zh: 一辆警车闪着灯开了过去。

e.en: The router has been {flashing} red for an hour.
e.zh: 路由器已经闪红灯一个小时了。

e.en: Keep a {flashlight} handy in case the power fails.
e.zh: 备一支手电筒,以防停电。

e.en: My phone's {flashlight} died right when I needed it.
e.zh: 我手机的手电筒偏偏在我要用时没电了。

e.en: He plays the cowardly {flashman} in the historical novel series.
e.zh: 他在那套历史小说中扮演那位懦弱的弗拉什曼。

e.en: My grandfather loved every {flashman} book on his shelf.
e.zh: 我爷爷书架上的每一本《弗拉什曼》他都喜欢。

e.en: The border town remains a potential {flashpoint} for conflict.
e.zh: 那座边境小镇仍是潜在的冲突爆发点。

e.en: Housing costs have become a political {flashpoint} this year.
e.zh: 住房成本已成为今年的政治引爆点。

flashy.t: adj. 花哨的；华而不实的

e.en: He drives a {flashy} red sports car around town.
e.zh: 他开着一辆招摇的红色跑车在城里转。

e.en: The website looks {flashy} but loads really slowly.
e.zh: 那个网站看起来很炫,但加载非常慢。

e.en: She poured hot tea from her thermos {flask}.
e.zh: 她从保温瓶里倒出热茶。

e.en: The chemist measured acid into a glass {flask}.
e.zh: 化学家把酸液量入一个玻璃烧瓶里。

e.en: The lab shelf was lined with empty glass {flasks}.
e.zh: 实验室的架子上排满了空玻璃瓶。

e.en: Hikers filled their {flasks} with coffee before sunrise.
e.zh: 徒步者们在日出前把保温瓶灌满了咖啡。

flat.t:
adj. 平的；单调的
n. 公寓

e.en: My phone battery is completely {flat} again.
e.zh: 我的手机电池又彻底没电了。

e.en: She rents a small {flat} near the subway station.
e.zh: 她在地铁站附近租了一间小公寓。

flatbed.t: n. 平板卡车；平板扫描仪

e.en: The {flatbed} truck hauled steel beams to the site.
e.zh: 那辆平板卡车把钢梁运到了工地。

e.en: I scanned the old photos on a {flatbed} scanner.
e.zh: 我用平板扫描仪扫描了那些老照片。

e.en: Settlers floated downriver on a wooden {flatboat} long ago.
e.zh: 很久以前,移民们乘木制平底船顺流而下。

e.en: The museum displays a replica {flatboat} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着一艘19世纪平底船的复制品。

e.en: We dipped warm {flatbread} into the spicy hummus.
e.zh: 我们用温热的薄饼蘸辣味鹰嘴豆泥吃。

e.en: The chef bakes fresh {flatbread} in a stone oven.
e.zh: 主厨在石窑里现烤薄饼。

e.en: The {flatcar} carried lumber across the entire country.
e.zh: 那节平板车把木材运过了整个国家。

e.en: Workers loaded steel pipes onto a railroad {flatcar}.
e.zh: 工人把钢管装上一节铁路平板车。

e.en: Plaice is a popular {flatfish} on European menus.
e.zh: 鲽鱼是欧洲菜单上常见的一种比目鱼。

e.en: A {flatfish} hides on the seabed by changing colors.
e.zh: 比目鱼通过变色藏在海底。

e.en: You'll need a {flathead} screwdriver for this old hinge.
e.zh: 修这个旧合页需要一把一字螺丝刀。

e.en: We grilled fresh {flathead} fillets at the beach barbecue.
e.zh: 我们在海滩烧烤上烤了新鲜的牛尾鱼柳。

e.en: Grandma still uses an old cast-iron {flatiron} as decoration.
e.zh: 奶奶仍把那个旧铸铁熨斗当装饰品摆着。

e.en: She straightens her hair with a ceramic {flatiron} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上用陶瓷直发夹拉直头发。

e.en: The endless {flatland} stretched all the way to the horizon.
e.zh: 无边的平原一直延伸到地平线。

e.en: Mountain folks sometimes joke about people from the {flatland}.
e.zh: 山里人有时会调侃来自平原地区的人。

e.en: As a {flatlander}, he struggled with the steep mountain trails.
e.zh: 作为一个平原来的人,他在陡峭的山路上很吃力。

e.en: The locals called every tourist a clueless {flatlander}.
e.zh: 当地人把每个游客都叫作不懂行的外乡人。

e.en: She rents a tiny {flatlet} above the corner bakery.
e.zh: 她在街角面包店楼上租了一间小套房。

e.en: The basement was converted into a self-contained {flatlet}.
e.zh: 地下室被改造成了一间独立的小公寓。

e.en: He {flatly} refused to discuss the matter any further.
e.zh: 他断然拒绝再讨论这件事。

e.en: She delivered the bad news {flatly}, without any emotion.
e.zh: 她平淡地说出了坏消息,毫无情绪。

e.en: My new {flatmate} keeps leaving dishes in the sink.
e.zh: 我的新室友老把碗碟堆在水池里。

e.en: I'm looking for a quiet {flatmate} to share rent.
e.zh: 我在找一个安静的室友合租。

e.en: The {flatness} of the prairie surprised the visiting tourists.
e.zh: 草原的平坦让来访的游客感到惊讶。

e.en: Critics complained about the emotional {flatness} of his performance.
e.zh: 评论家抱怨他的表演缺乏情感起伏。

flatout.t: adv. 全力地；直截了当地

e.en: She drove {flatout} to catch the last evening train.
e.zh: 她全速狂奔,只为赶上末班晚车。

e.en: He told me {flatout} that the deal was dead.
e.zh: 他直截了当地告诉我那笔交易黄了。

e.en: She wore comfortable {flats} for the long city walk.
e.zh: 长途逛街时,她穿了一双舒适的平底鞋。

e.en: Many young couples rent {flats} in the new development.
e.zh: 许多年轻夫妇在新楼盘里租公寓。

flatscreen.t:
n. 平板显示器
adj. 平面屏幕的

e.en: They mounted a huge {flatscreen} TV above the fireplace.
e.zh: 他们在壁炉上方装了一台大平板电视。

e.en: My old computer monitor finally died, so I bought a {flatscreen}.
e.zh: 我那台旧显示器终于坏了,我就买了一台平板的。

e.en: Use a rolling pin to {flatten} the dough evenly.
e.zh: 用擀面杖把面团擀平。

e.en: Aggressive measures helped the city {flatten} the infection curve.
e.zh: 强力措施帮助这座城市压平了感染曲线。

flattened.t:
adj. 被压平的
v. flatten 的过去式

e.en: The storm {flattened} dozens of houses along the coast.
e.zh: 风暴把沿岸几十座房屋夷为平地。

e.en: She {flattened} the cardboard boxes before recycling them.
e.zh: 她把纸箱压扁后才拿去回收。

flattening.t:
v. 正在压平
n. 扁平化

e.en: The bulldozer was {flattening} the lot for new construction.
e.zh: 推土机正在平整这块新建工地的地。

e.en: Wages have been {flattening} despite rising company profits.
e.zh: 尽管公司利润上涨,工资却一直停滞不前。

flatter.t:
v. 奉承，讨好
adj. 更平坦的

e.en: Don't try to {flatter} me into lending you money.
e.zh: 别想用奉承话让我借钱给你。

e.en: This dress is far {flatter} on her than mine.
e.zh: 这条裙子穿在她身上比穿我身上好看多了。

flattered.t:
adj. 感到荣幸的
v. flatter 的过去式

e.en: I'm truly {flattered} that you remembered my birthday.
e.zh: 你居然记得我的生日,我真的很感动。

e.en: She felt {flattered} by his unexpected job offer.
e.zh: 他突如其来的工作邀约让她受宠若惊。

e.en: Beware the {flatterer} who praises every idea you have.
e.zh: 小心那些对你每个想法都吹捧的马屁精。

e.en: He's a known {flatterer} who only seeks personal advantage.
e.zh: 他是出了名的奉承者,只图个人好处。

e.en: Her empty {flatteries} no longer impressed the experienced manager.
e.zh: 她那些空洞的奉承再也打动不了这位老练的经理。

e.en: He saw through their {flatteries} and refused to sign.
e.zh: 他看穿了他们的恭维话,拒绝签字。

flattering.t: adj. 奉承的；显得好看的

e.en: That haircut is really {flattering} on your face shape.
e.zh: 那个发型很衬你的脸型。

e.en: She made several {flattering} remarks about my new project.
e.zh: 她对我的新项目说了几句溢美之词。

flatteringly.t: adv. 奉承地；显得好看地

e.en: The article spoke {flatteringly} of the young inventor's vision.
e.zh: 那篇文章对这位年轻发明家的远见赞誉有加。

e.en: The lighting fell {flatteringly} on her face during filming.
e.zh: 拍摄时灯光打在她脸上特别显气色。

flatters.t: v. 奉承（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {flatters} the boss before asking for a raise.
e.zh: 他总是先奉承老板再开口要求加薪。

e.en: That dress really {flatters} your figure.
e.zh: 那条裙子非常衬你的身材。

e.en: Empty {flattery} won't get you a promotion here.
e.zh: 空洞的奉承在这里换不来升职。

e.en: She saw through his obvious {flattery} immediately.
e.zh: 她一眼就看穿了他露骨的奉承。

e.en: The bread came out {flattish} because the yeast was old.
e.zh: 因为酵母过期了,面包烤出来有点扁。

e.en: We hiked across a {flattish} stretch of moorland.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿过一片相对平坦的荒原。

e.en: Beans often cause {flatulence} in sensitive stomachs.
e.zh: 豆类常常让肠胃敏感的人胀气。

e.en: The doctor recommended diet changes to reduce {flatulence}.
e.zh: 医生建议改变饮食以缓解胀气。

e.en: Eating too quickly can leave you feeling {flatulent}.
e.zh: 吃得太快会让人觉得胀气。

e.en: Some dairy products make him {flatulent} and uncomfortable.
e.zh: 有些乳制品会让他胀气难受。

e.en: Please set the {flatware} on the right side of each plate.
e.zh: 请把餐具摆在每个盘子的右侧。

e.en: We bought a new set of stainless steel {flatware}.
e.zh: 我们买了一套新的不锈钢餐具。

e.en: The biology class studied a {flatworm} under the microscope.
e.zh: 生物课上同学们用显微镜观察一条扁虫。

e.en: A planarian is a common type of freshwater {flatworm}.
e.zh: 涡虫是一种常见的淡水扁形虫。

e.en: Madame Bovary made {Flaubert} a household name in France.
e.zh: 《包法利夫人》让福楼拜在法国家喻户晓。

e.en: Many writers cite {Flaubert} as a master of style.
e.zh: 许多作家都把福楼拜尊为文体大师。

e.en: Don't {flaunt} your wealth in front of struggling friends.
e.zh: 别在生活拮据的朋友面前炫耀财富。

e.en: She loves to {flaunt} her designer handbags on Instagram.
e.zh: 她喜欢在 Instagram 上炫耀她的名牌包。

flaunting.t:
v. 正在炫耀
adj. 招摇的

e.en: He kept {flaunting} his new car around the neighborhood.
e.zh: 他不停地在街坊邻居面前炫耀他的新车。

e.en: Her {flaunting} of the rules annoyed the whole team.
e.zh: 她对规则的公然蔑视让整个团队都反感。

e.en: The actress wore a {flaunty} red gown to the premiere.
e.zh: 那位女演员穿着一件招摇的红礼服出席首映礼。

e.en: His {flaunty} style turns heads wherever he goes.
e.zh: 他张扬的风格走到哪儿都引人注目。

e.en: The orchestra hired a young {flautist} from Vienna.
e.zh: 乐团聘请了一位来自维也纳的年轻长笛演奏家。

e.en: She trained for years to become a professional {flautist}.
e.zh: 她苦练多年才成为一名专业的长笛演奏家。

flavonoid.t: n. 类黄酮（一种植物化合物）

e.en: Dark chocolate contains a {flavonoid} that may help heart health.
e.zh: 黑巧克力含有一种可能有益心脏健康的类黄酮。

e.en: Berries are rich in {flavonoid} compounds.
e.zh: 浆果富含类黄酮化合物。

flavor.t:
n. 味道，风味
v. 调味

e.en: This ice cream has a strong vanilla {flavor}.
e.zh: 这款冰淇淋有浓郁的香草味。

e.en: A pinch of salt really brings out the {flavor}.
e.zh: 一小撮盐真的能把味道提出来。

e.en: I prefer lemon-{flavored} sparkling water in summer.
e.zh: 夏天我更喜欢柠檬味的气泡水。

e.en: The chef {flavored} the soup with fresh herbs.
e.zh: 厨师用新鲜香草为汤调味。

e.en: The slow-cooked stew was incredibly {flavorful}.
e.zh: 这道慢炖的炖菜味道极其浓郁。

e.en: Fresh tomatoes make the sauce so much more {flavorful}.
e.zh: 新鲜番茄让酱汁的味道丰富多了。

flavoring.t:
n. 调味料
v. 正在调味

e.en: Add a teaspoon of vanilla {flavoring} to the batter.
e.zh: 在面糊里加一茶匙香草调味料。

e.en: This drink uses only natural {flavoring}, no additives.
e.zh: 这款饮料只用天然调味剂,不含添加剂。

e.en: The microwaved leftovers tasted dry and {flavorless}.
e.zh: 微波加热的剩菜又干又没味道。

e.en: Plain tofu is almost {flavorless} on its own.
e.zh: 原味豆腐本身几乎没什么味道。

flavors.t:
n. 味道（复数）
v. 调味

e.en: The shop offers over thirty ice cream {flavors}.
e.zh: 这家店提供三十多种冰淇淋口味。

e.en: Garlic and ginger {flavors} the entire dish beautifully.
e.zh: 大蒜和姜把整道菜的味道提得恰到好处。

flavour.t:
n. 味道（英式拼写）
v. 调味

e.en: The curry has a wonderful smoky {flavour}.
e.zh: 这道咖喱有一种很棒的烟熏味。

e.en: Slow cooking really develops the {flavour} of the meat.
e.zh: 慢炖能真正激发出肉的风味。

e.en: She bought some mint-{flavoured} chewing gum.
e.zh: 她买了一些薄荷味的口香糖。

e.en: The barista {flavoured} my latte with hazelnut syrup.
e.zh: 咖啡师用榛果糖浆给我的拿铁调味。

e.en: Use real vanilla pods instead of artificial {flavouring}.
e.zh: 用真正的香草荚,别用人工香料。

e.en: A little lemon zest works as a natural {flavouring}.
e.zh: 一点柠檬皮屑可以当作天然调味料。

e.en: This restaurant blends Asian and European {flavours} skillfully.
e.zh: 这家餐厅巧妙地融合了亚洲和欧洲的风味。

e.en: The new yogurt line comes in six fruit {flavours}.
e.zh: 这款新酸奶推出了六种水果口味。

e.en: Grandma's tomato sauce is always {flavoursome} and rich.
e.zh: 奶奶做的番茄酱总是味道浓郁醇厚。

e.en: The roast chicken came out moist and {flavoursome}.
e.zh: 烤鸡出炉时肉质鲜嫩、味道十足。

e.en: There's one small {flaw} in your argument.
e.zh: 你的论证中有一个小漏洞。

e.en: The diamond has a tiny {flaw} near the edge.
e.zh: 这颗钻石边缘有一个微小的瑕疵。

flawed.t: adj. 有瑕疵的，有缺陷的

e.en: The study's methodology was deeply {flawed}.
e.zh: 这项研究的方法论存在严重缺陷。

e.en: Even great heroes can be {flawed} characters.
e.zh: 即便是伟大的英雄也可能是有缺点的人物。

e.en: Her makeup looked absolutely {flawless} in the photos.
e.zh: 她在照片里的妆容看起来完美无瑕。

e.en: The pianist gave a {flawless} performance of the concerto.
e.zh: 那位钢琴家完美无瑕地演奏了这首协奏曲。

e.en: The new software runs {flawlessly} on older laptops.
e.zh: 这款新软件在旧笔记本上也能完美运行。

e.en: She delivered the speech {flawlessly} without notes.
e.zh: 她不看讲稿就完美地发表了演讲。

e.en: Every product has minor {flaws} you can learn to live with.
e.zh: 每件产品都有些小缺点,你可以慢慢接受。

e.en: The report exposed serious {flaws} in airport security.
e.zh: 那份报告揭露了机场安保的严重漏洞。

e.en: Linen is woven from the fibers of the {flax} plant.
e.zh: 亚麻布是用亚麻植物的纤维织成的。

e.en: Farmers harvest {flax} for both fiber and seeds.
e.zh: 农民种植亚麻既取纤维也取种子。

flaxen.t: adj. 亚麻色的；浅黄色的

e.en: The little girl had {flaxen} hair that shone in the sun.
e.zh: 小女孩有一头在阳光下闪闪发亮的浅黄色头发。

e.en: He brushed the {flaxen} mane of his golden horse.
e.zh: 他梳理着金色骏马的浅黄色鬃毛。

e.en: Different {flaxes} produce fibers of varying quality.
e.zh: 不同品种的亚麻产出的纤维质量各异。

e.en: The botanist catalogued several wild {flaxes} found in the region.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了该地区发现的几种野生亚麻。

e.en: I sprinkle ground {flaxseed} on my morning oatmeal.
e.zh: 我会在早餐燕麦片上撒一些亚麻籽粉。

e.en: {Flaxseed} is a great plant source of omega-3.
e.zh: 亚麻籽是 omega-3 很好的植物来源。

e.en: The critic threatened to {flay} the film in his review.
e.zh: 那位影评人扬言要在评论中把这部电影批得体无完肤。

e.en: Hunters used to {flay} animals to harvest their hides.
e.zh: 过去猎人会剥下动物的皮毛来取兽皮。

flayed.t:
adj. 被剥皮的
v. flay 的过去式

e.en: The coach {flayed} the team after the embarrassing loss.
e.zh: 那场难堪的失利之后,教练把球队狠狠骂了一顿。

e.en: Reviewers {flayed} the novel for its shallow characters.
e.zh: 评论家因小说人物肤浅而对其大加抨击。

e.en: The dog kept scratching because of a single {flea}.
e.zh: 那只狗一直挠痒,只因为身上有一只跳蚤。

e.en: We found great vintage records at the {flea} market.
e.zh: 我们在跳蚤市场淘到了不少好的复古唱片。

fleabag.t: n. 廉价破旧的旅馆；邋遢的人

e.en: They stayed in a cheap {fleabag} motel near the highway.
e.zh: 他们在公路边一家又脏又破的小汽车旅馆将就了一晚。

e.en: He apologized for booking such a {fleabag} hotel.
e.zh: 他为订了这么一家肮脏破旧的酒店而道歉。

e.en: Our cat picked up {fleas} from the neighbor's yard.
e.zh: 我们家的猫从邻居院子里招了一身跳蚤。

e.en: This shampoo is supposed to kill {fleas} on contact.
e.zh: 这款洗剂据说一接触就能杀死跳蚤。

fleck.t:
n. 小斑点；微粒
v. 使布满斑点

e.en: There's a {fleck} of paint on your sleeve.
e.zh: 你袖子上有一小点油漆。

e.en: His green eyes had a tiny {fleck} of gold.
e.zh: 他绿色的眼睛里有一点金色的斑点。

fled.t: v. flee 的过去式：逃离

e.en: The family {fled} the country during the war.
e.zh: 那家人在战争期间逃离了那个国家。

e.en: The thief {fled} on a bicycle when the alarm rang.
e.zh: 警报响起时,小偷骑着自行车逃走了。

fledge.t: v. (雏鸟) 长羽；养大到能飞

e.en: Baby robins {fledge} about two weeks after hatching.
e.zh: 知更鸟雏鸟孵化约两周后就会长出飞羽离巢。

e.en: The chicks will {fledge} before the end of summer.
e.zh: 夏末之前这些雏鸟就会羽翼丰满飞离巢。

fledged.t: adj. 羽翼已丰的；成熟的

e.en: She is now a fully {fledged} software engineer.
e.zh: 她现在已经是一名成熟的软件工程师了。

e.en: The young eagles {fledged} and left the nest in July.
e.zh: 小鹰七月时羽翼丰满,离开了鸟巢。

fledgeling.t: n. 刚会飞的雏鸟；新手

e.en: The {fledgeling} startup raised its first round of funding.
e.zh: 那家初创公司刚刚完成了第一轮融资。

e.en: A {fledgeling} sparrow hopped clumsily across the lawn.
e.zh: 一只刚学飞的麻雀笨拙地跳过草坪。

e.en: The biologist watched the eaglets {fledging} from a hidden blind.
e.zh: 生物学家从隐蔽棚中观察雏鹰长出飞羽离巢。

e.en: Heavy rain delayed the {fledging} of the young swallows.
e.zh: 大雨推迟了小燕子离巢飞翔的时间。

fledgling.t:
n. 新手；初出茅庐者
adj. 初创的

e.en: Her {fledgling} business grew rapidly during the pandemic.
e.zh: 她刚起步的小生意在疫情期间迅速发展。

e.en: A {fledgling} fell from the tree and chirped helplessly.
e.zh: 一只雏鸟从树上掉下来,无助地叫着。

e.en: Thousands had to {flee} their homes when the river flooded.
e.zh: 河水泛滥时,成千上万的人不得不逃离家园。

e.en: Wild deer {flee} at the slightest sound.
e.zh: 野鹿一有风吹草动就会逃走。

fleece.t:
n. 羊毛；抓绒衣料
v. 敲诈

e.en: I always pack a warm {fleece} for camping trips.
e.zh: 露营时我总会带上一件暖和的抓绒衣。

e.en: The shepherd carefully sheared the {fleece} from each sheep.
e.zh: 牧羊人小心地从每只羊身上剪下羊毛。

e.en: Tourists complained about being {fleecing} by taxi drivers.
e.zh: 游客抱怨被出租车司机敲竹杠。

e.en: That dealer is famous for {fleecing} first-time car buyers.
e.zh: 那个经销商出了名的爱宰首次买车的人。

fleecy.t: adj. 像羊毛般柔软的；绒毛状的

e.en: She wrapped the baby in a soft, {fleecy} blanket.
e.zh: 她用一条柔软的绒毛毯子把宝宝裹起来。

e.en: {Fleecy} white clouds drifted across the summer sky.
e.zh: 一团团绒毛般的白云飘过夏日的天空。

fleeing.t: v. 逃离（flee 的现在分词）

e.en: Refugees {fleeing} the conflict crossed the border at dawn.
e.zh: 逃离冲突的难民在拂晓时分越过了边境。

e.en: The suspect was caught while {fleeing} on foot.
e.zh: 嫌疑人在徒步逃跑时被抓获。

flees.t: v. 逃离（第三人称单数）

e.en: The suspect {flees} the scene before police arrive.
e.zh: 嫌疑人在警察到达前逃离了现场。

e.en: Every winter she {flees} the cold for warmer countries.
e.zh: 每年冬天她都会逃离寒冷,去温暖的国家。

fleet.t:
n. 舰队；车队
adj. 快速的

e.en: The company operates a {fleet} of electric delivery vans.
e.zh: 该公司运营着一支电动送货车队。

e.en: She is surprisingly {fleet} on her feet for her age.
e.zh: 以她的年纪来说,她跑起来出奇地敏捷。

fleeting.t: adj. 短暂的；转瞬即逝的

e.en: He caught a {fleeting} glimpse of her in the crowd.
e.zh: 他在人群中匆匆瞥见了她一眼。

e.en: Fame can be {fleeting} in the social media era.
e.zh: 在社交媒体时代,名声可能转瞬即逝。

e.en: She smiled {fleetingly} before turning back to her work.
e.zh: 她短暂地一笑,然后又回到工作中。

e.en: The idea crossed his mind only {fleetingly}.
e.zh: 那个念头只是短暂地掠过他的脑海。

e.en: Major airlines are upgrading their {fleets} with newer jets.
e.zh: 各大航空公司正用更新的喷气机升级机队。

e.en: Two rival {fleets} met near the harbor entrance.
e.zh: 两支敌对舰队在港口入口附近相遇。

fleetwood.t: n. 弗利特伍德（人名／地名）

e.en: My parents grew up listening to {Fleetwood} Mac on vinyl.
e.zh: 我父母是听着黑胶唱片里的Fleetwood Mac长大的。

e.en: The band {Fleetwood} Mac released their debut album in 1968.
e.zh: Fleetwood Mac乐队于1968年发行了首张专辑。

flemish.t:
adj. 佛兰德的
n. 佛兰德语

e.en: The museum displays many {Flemish} paintings from the Renaissance.
e.zh: 博物馆展出许多文艺复兴时期的佛兰德绘画。

e.en: She studies {Flemish} literature at the university in Ghent.
e.zh: 她在根特的大学学习佛兰德文学。

e.en: The peach has soft, juicy {flesh} inside its skin.
e.zh: 桃子皮里面是柔软多汁的果肉。

e.en: Let's {flesh} out this idea before the meeting tomorrow.
e.zh: 我们在明天开会前把这个想法充实一下。

fleshes.t:
v. flesh 的三单；充实
n. 肉（复数）

e.en: She {fleshes} out the rough draft with vivid details.
e.zh: 她用生动的细节充实了草稿。

e.en: The author {fleshes} every character with a unique backstory.
e.zh: 作者为每个角色赋予了独特的背景故事。

e.en: The {fleshiness} of ripe mangoes makes them perfect for smoothies.
e.zh: 成熟芒果的丰厚果肉非常适合做奶昔。

e.en: He noted the {fleshiness} of her cheeks when she smiled.
e.zh: 她微笑时,他注意到她脸颊的丰润。

fleshless.t: adj. 没有肉的；骨瘦如柴的

e.en: A {fleshless} skeleton stood in the biology classroom.
e.zh: 生物教室里立着一具没有皮肉的骨架。

e.en: The argument felt {fleshless} without concrete examples.
e.zh: 这个论点没有具体例子,显得空洞无物。

e.en: The monk renounced all {fleshly} pleasures and material wealth.
e.zh: 那位僧人摒弃了一切肉体享乐和物质财富。

e.en: Ancient texts often warn against {fleshly} desires.
e.zh: 古代典籍常告诫人们要警惕肉体欲望。

e.en: Las Vegas is often called the {fleshpot} of America.
e.zh: 拉斯维加斯常被称为美国的纵欲之地。

e.en: He avoided every {fleshpot} during his pilgrimage abroad.
e.zh: 他在海外朝圣期间避开了每一处声色场所。

fleshpots.t: n. 声色场所；奢华生活

e.en: Tourists flock to the {fleshpots} of Bangkok every weekend.
e.zh: 游客每个周末都涌向曼谷的声色场所。

e.en: He wrote a novel exposing the city's hidden {fleshpots}.
e.zh: 他写了一部小说,揭露这座城市隐秘的纵欲场所。

e.en: Aloe vera has thick, {fleshy} leaves full of gel.
e.zh: 芦荟有着厚实多肉的叶片,里面充满了胶质。

e.en: The doctor examined the {fleshy} part of his thumb.
e.zh: 医生检查了他拇指肉厚的部位。

fletcher.t: n. 弗莱彻（姓氏）；造箭匠

e.en: The medieval {fletcher} crafted arrows for the king's archers.
e.zh: 中世纪的箭匠为国王的弓箭手制作箭矢。

e.en: His surname {Fletcher} comes from an old arrow-making profession.
e.zh: 他的姓氏Fletcher源自一个古老的制箭职业。

fleur.t: n. 花（法语词，常见于 fleur-de-lis 鸢尾花饰）

e.en: The royal flag features a golden {fleur}-de-lis on blue.
e.zh: 皇家旗帜上有蓝底金色的鸢尾花纹章。

e.en: She tattooed a small {fleur}-de-lis on her wrist.
e.zh: 她在手腕上纹了一个小小的鸢尾花纹。

e.en: The {Fleury} cross appears often in heraldic designs.
e.zh: 花饰十字在纹章设计中经常出现。

e.en: Saint-Benoît-de-{Fleury} abbey houses many medieval manuscripts.
e.zh: 弗勒里圣本笃修道院藏有许多中世纪手稿。

flew.t: v. fly 的过去式：飞；飞行

e.en: She {flew} to Tokyo for a business meeting yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天飞往东京参加商务会议。

e.en: Time {flew} by while we were chatting over coffee.
e.zh: 我们边喝咖啡边聊天,时间过得飞快。

flex.t:
v. 弯曲（肌肉）；炫耀
n. 弹性

e.en: He likes to {flex} his new sneakers on Instagram.
e.zh: 他喜欢在Instagram上炫耀他的新运动鞋。

e.en: Try to {flex} your wrist gently after the injury.
e.zh: 受伤后试着轻轻活动一下你的手腕。

e.en: The new contract offers various scheduling {flexibilities} for parents.
e.zh: 新合同为家长提供了多种排班灵活性。

e.en: Different yoga poses develop different {flexibilities} in the body.
e.zh: 不同的瑜伽姿势能锻炼身体不同部位的柔韧性。

e.en: Remote work gives employees more {flexibility} in daily schedules.
e.zh: 远程办公让员工的日程安排更具灵活性。

e.en: Daily stretching greatly improves your {flexibility} over time.
e.zh: 每天拉伸能随时间大大提升你的柔韧性。

e.en: My new job has a {flexible} work-from-home policy.
e.zh: 我的新工作有灵活的居家办公政策。

e.en: Yoga has made her body much more {flexible}.
e.zh: 瑜伽让她的身体变得柔韧多了。

e.en: Good managers respond {flexibly} to changing project requirements.
e.zh: 优秀的管理者会灵活应对不断变化的项目需求。

e.en: The software adapts {flexibly} to different screen sizes.
e.zh: 该软件能灵活适应不同的屏幕尺寸。

flexing.t: v. 屈伸；炫耀（现在分词）

e.en: He kept {flexing} his biceps in front of the mirror.
e.zh: 他一直在镜子前秀他的肱二头肌。

e.en: She's {flexing} her new car all over social media.
e.zh: 她在社交媒体上到处炫耀她的新车。

e.en: The therapist measured the {flexion} in his injured knee.
e.zh: 治疗师测量了他受伤膝盖的弯曲度。

e.en: Full {flexion} of the elbow takes weeks to recover.
e.zh: 肘部的完全屈曲需要几周时间才能恢复。

e.en: Our company introduced {flexitime} to improve work-life balance.
e.zh: 我们公司引入了弹性工时来改善工作与生活的平衡。

e.en: She uses {flexitime} so she can pick up her kids.
e.zh: 她采用弹性工时,这样可以去接孩子。

e.en: He pulled a {flexor} muscle while lifting heavy weights.
e.zh: 他举重时拉伤了一块屈肌。

e.en: The {flexor} tendons in your hand control finger movement.
e.zh: 手部的屈肌腱控制着手指的运动。

e.en: Many tech companies offer {flextime} to attract top talent.
e.zh: 许多科技公司提供弹性工作时间以吸引顶尖人才。

e.en: With {flextime}, I can start work at any hour.
e.zh: 有了弹性工时,我可以在任何时间开始工作。

e.en: Engineers tested the {flexural} strength of the new beam.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种新型梁的抗弯强度。

e.en: Concrete has high compressive but low {flexural} resistance.
e.zh: 混凝土抗压强度高,但抗弯强度低。

e.en: The bridge was designed to allow slight {flexure} in winds.
e.zh: 这座桥设计成在风中可以轻微弯曲。

e.en: Repeated {flexure} eventually caused the metal pipe to crack.
e.zh: 反复弯曲最终导致金属管开裂。

flick.t:
v. 轻弹；快速挥动
n. 轻弹；电影

e.en: Just {flick} the switch to turn on the lamp.
e.zh: 轻按一下开关就能打开台灯。

e.en: We watched a fun action {flick} on Netflix last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚在Netflix上看了一部好玩的动作片。

flicked.t: v. 轻弹；轻拂（flick 的过去式）

e.en: She {flicked} her hair back over her shoulder.
e.zh: 她把头发轻轻甩到肩后。

e.en: He {flicked} through the magazine while waiting for coffee.
e.zh: 他一边等咖啡一边翻阅杂志。

flicker.t:
v. 闪烁；摇曳
n. 闪光

e.en: The candle's {flicker} cast shadows on the cave walls.
e.zh: 烛光摇曳的火苗在洞壁上投下了阴影。

e.en: I saw a {flicker} of doubt in his eyes.
e.zh: 我在他眼中看到一丝怀疑。

e.en: The {flickering} streetlight made the alley feel eerie.
e.zh: 忽明忽暗的路灯让小巷显得阴森。

e.en: They sat by the {flickering} fire telling old stories.
e.zh: 他们坐在摇曳的火堆旁讲述着旧故事。

flickers.t:
v. 闪烁（第三人称单数）
n. 闪光（复数）

e.en: The screen {flickers} whenever the laptop battery runs low.
e.zh: 笔记本电池电量低时,屏幕就会闪烁。

e.en: Hope still {flickers} despite all the recent setbacks.
e.zh: 尽管最近接连受挫,希望仍未熄灭。

flicking.t: v. 轻弹；快速拨动（进行时）

e.en: Stop {flicking} rubber bands across the classroom, please.
e.zh: 请别再往教室那边弹橡皮筋了。

e.en: He kept {flicking} through TV channels without choosing one.
e.zh: 他不停地切换电视频道,却一个也没选定。

flicks.t:
v. 轻弹（第三人称单数）
n. 电影（口语复数）

e.en: She {flicks} the lights off before leaving the office.
e.zh: 她离开办公室前轻按关掉了灯。

e.en: We watch cheesy horror {flicks} every Halloween weekend.
e.zh: 每年万圣节周末我们都会看俗套的恐怖片。

e.en: A volunteer handed me a {flier} for the concert.
e.zh: 一位志愿者递给我一张音乐会的传单。

e.en: My grandfather was a wartime {flier} in the air force.
e.zh: 我祖父是空军的一名战时飞行员。

flies.t:
n. 苍蝇（复数）
v. 飞（第三人称单数）

e.en: Time {flies} when you're having fun with friends.
e.zh: 和朋友一起玩乐时时间过得飞快。

e.en: Annoying {flies} kept buzzing around our picnic table.
e.zh: 恼人的苍蝇一直在我们的野餐桌旁嗡嗡乱飞。

flight.t:
n. 航班；飞行
n. 一段楼梯

e.en: Our {flight} to Singapore has been delayed by two hours.
e.zh: 我们飞往新加坡的航班延误了两小时。

e.en: She climbed a {flight} of stairs to her apartment.
e.zh: 她爬了一段楼梯回到她的公寓。

e.en: His {flightiness} makes him hard to work with on projects.
e.zh: 他做事浮躁,跟他合作项目很困难。

e.en: She outgrew the {flightiness} of her teenage years.
e.zh: 她已不再有少年时代那种轻浮的性子。

e.en: The novel explores the {flightinesses} of various young heroines.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了几位年轻女主人公的轻浮性格。

e.en: Their {flightinesses} of mood made teamwork nearly impossible.
e.zh: 他们情绪的反复无常让团队合作几乎无法进行。

e.en: Penguins are {flightless} birds that swim incredibly well.
e.zh: 企鹅是不会飞却游泳极佳的鸟类。

e.en: The kiwi is a {flightless} bird native to New Zealand.
e.zh: 几维鸟是新西兰特有的一种不会飞的鸟。

e.en: All {flights} were canceled due to the heavy snowstorm.
e.zh: 由于大雪暴,所有航班都被取消了。

e.en: He climbed three {flights} of stairs to reach the rooftop.
e.zh: 他爬了三段楼梯才到达屋顶。

flighty.t: adj. 轻浮的；反复无常的

e.en: She's too {flighty} to commit to a long-term plan.
e.zh: 她太轻浮了,无法投入长期计划。

e.en: His {flighty} attention span makes studying difficult for him.
e.zh: 他注意力很难集中,这让他学习起来很吃力。

flimflam.t:
n. 骗局；胡扯
v. 欺骗

e.en: That investment scheme turned out to be pure {flimflam}.
e.zh: 那个投资计划最后被证明完全是骗局。

e.en: Don't let smooth talkers {flimflam} you out of money.
e.zh: 别让花言巧语的人骗走你的钱。

flimsy.t: adj. 脆弱的；薄弱的（理由）

e.en: This {flimsy} umbrella broke on the first windy day.
e.zh: 这把脆弱的雨伞第一次刮风就坏了。

e.en: His alibi was {flimsy} and the detective saw through it.
e.zh: 他的不在场证明站不住脚,侦探一眼就看穿了。

e.en: She didn't {flinch} when the doctor gave her the injection.
e.zh: 医生给她打针时她连眉头都没皱一下。

e.en: Even loud thunder doesn't make this dog {flinch}.
e.zh: 就算是响雷,这只狗也不会退缩一下。

e.en: The vase shattered into tiny {flinders} on the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 花瓶在厨房地板上摔成了无数碎片。

e.en: The explosion blew the door into {flinders}.
e.zh: 爆炸把门炸成了碎片。

fling.t:
v. 猛投；抛
n. 短暂恋情

e.en: She decided to {fling} the old letters into the fire.
e.zh: 她决定把那些旧信件扔进火里。

e.en: He had a brief summer {fling} before college started.
e.zh: 他在上大学前有过一段短暂的夏日恋情。

e.en: The toddler kept {flinging} toys across the living room.
e.zh: 那个幼儿不停地把玩具扔得满客厅都是。

e.en: She was {flinging} accusations without any real evidence.
e.zh: 她在没有真凭实据的情况下乱扔指控。

e.en: My lighter ran out of {flint} this morning.
e.zh: 我的打火机今早没火石了。

e.en: Ancient humans used {flint} to start fires and make tools.
e.zh: 古人用燧石生火和制作工具。

e.en: The museum displayed a {flintlock} pistol from the 1700s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一把十八世纪的燧发枪。

e.en: Soldiers loaded their {flintlock} muskets before the battle.
e.zh: 士兵们在战斗前装填好燧发滑膛枪。

e.en: The kids watched a {flintstone} cartoon every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 孩子们每周六早上都看《摩登原始人》动画。

e.en: He picked up a small {flintstone} from the riverbank.
e.zh: 他从河岸边捡起一块小燧石。

e.en: The judge gave him a {flinty} stare across the courtroom.
e.zh: 法官隔着法庭冷冷地盯着他。

e.en: This wine has a crisp, {flinty} taste I really enjoy.
e.zh: 这款酒带有清爽的矿石味,我很喜欢。

flip.t:
v. 翻转；轻抛
adj. 轻率的

e.en: Just {flip} the switch to turn on the lights.
e.zh: 按一下开关就能开灯。

e.en: Let's {flip} a coin to decide who pays.
e.zh: 我们抛硬币决定谁付钱吧。

e.en: His {flippancy} during the meeting annoyed the senior managers.
e.zh: 他在会上的轻浮态度惹恼了高层管理者。

e.en: There's no place for {flippancy} when discussing serious issues.
e.zh: 讨论严肃问题时没有轻佻的余地。

e.en: Her {flippant} reply made the teacher genuinely upset.
e.zh: 她轻佻的回答让老师真的生气了。

e.en: Don't be so {flippant} about other people's feelings.
e.zh: 别对别人的感受这么不当回事。

flippantly.t: adv. 轻率地；油嘴滑舌地

e.en: He {flippantly} dismissed the customer's serious complaint.
e.zh: 他轻率地把顾客的严重投诉打发掉了。

e.en: She answered {flippantly}, clearly not taking the question seriously.
e.zh: 她漫不经心地回答,显然没把问题当回事。

flipped.t:
v. 翻转（过去式）
adj. 抓狂的

e.en: He {flipped} the pancake perfectly on his first try.
e.zh: 他一次就把煎饼完美翻面。

e.en: She totally {flipped} when she saw the surprise party.
e.zh: 看到惊喜派对时她完全乐疯了。

e.en: The seal slapped the water with its powerful {flipper}.
e.zh: 海豹用有力的鳍肢拍打水面。

e.en: Each diver needs a mask, snorkel and one {flipper} per foot.
e.zh: 每位潜水员都需要面镜、呼吸管和每只脚一只脚蹼。

flipping.t:
v. 翻转（进行时）
adj. 该死的（委婉）

e.en: He's been {flipping} houses in the suburbs for extra income.
e.zh: 他一直在郊区炒房赚外快。

e.en: Stop {flipping} through the channels and pick something already.
e.zh: 别再换台了,赶紧选一个吧。

flippy.t: adj. 飘逸摆动的（裙摆等）

e.en: She wore a cute {flippy} skirt to the dance.
e.zh: 她穿着一条可爱的蓬蓬短裙去跳舞。

e.en: My niece loves her new {flippy} ponytail hairstyle.
e.zh: 我侄女很喜欢她新换的俏皮马尾发型。

flips.t: v. 翻转（第三人称单数）

e.en: The gymnast does three {flips} in a row effortlessly.
e.zh: 那位体操运动员能轻松连做三个空翻。

e.en: My phone always {flips} the screen when I rotate it.
e.zh: 我的手机一旋转屏幕就会自动翻转。

e.en: The {flipside} of remote work is feeling isolated from colleagues.
e.zh: 远程办公的另一面是会觉得与同事疏远。

e.en: On the {flipside}, fewer tourists means quieter beaches.
e.zh: 反过来说,游客少意味着海滩更清静。

flirt.t:
v. 调情；卖弄风情
n. 调情者

e.en: He likes to {flirt} with the barista every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上都喜欢和咖啡师调情。

e.en: The startup is starting to {flirt} with bankruptcy.
e.zh: 这家初创公司开始游走在破产边缘。

e.en: Their office {flirtation} eventually turned into a serious relationship.
e.zh: 他们办公室里的暧昧最终发展成了认真的恋爱。

e.en: He had a brief {flirtation} with vegetarianism last year.
e.zh: 他去年短暂尝试过素食主义。

flirtatious.t: adj. 爱调情的；卖弄风情的

e.en: She gave him a {flirtatious} smile across the bar.
e.zh: 她隔着吧台给了他一个挑逗的微笑。

e.en: His {flirtatious} comments made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他那些挑逗的话让餐桌上的人都很不自在。

flirtatiously.t: adv. 卖弄风情地；挑逗地

e.en: She winked {flirtatiously} as she walked past his desk.
e.zh: 她经过他办公桌时俏皮地眨了眨眼。

e.en: He smiled {flirtatiously} at the woman in the red dress.
e.zh: 他对着那位穿红裙的女士露出挑逗的笑容。

e.en: They were openly {flirting} during the entire dinner party.
e.zh: 整场晚宴上他们都在公然调情。

e.en: The company is {flirting} with disaster by ignoring safety rules.
e.zh: 这家公司无视安全规定,简直是在玩火。

e.en: She sent him a {flirty} text just before midnight.
e.zh: 快到午夜时她给他发了一条暧昧的短信。

e.en: He's always in a {flirty} mood after a few drinks.
e.zh: 他喝几杯后总是变得很爱撩人。

e.en: Hummingbirds {flit} from flower to flower in the garden.
e.zh: 蜂鸟在花园里从一朵花飞到另一朵花。

e.en: Strange thoughts {flit} through my mind late at night.
e.zh: 深夜里各种奇怪念头在我脑中闪过。

flits.t: v. 掠过（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {flits} between three different jobs every week.
e.zh: 她每周在三份不同的工作之间穿梭。

e.en: A small butterfly {flits} above the lavender bushes.
e.zh: 一只小蝴蝶在薰衣草丛上方翩翩飞舞。

e.en: A shadow {flitted} across the wall and then vanished.
e.zh: 一道影子掠过墙面随即消失。

e.en: She {flitted} from guest to guest at the party.
e.zh: 她在派对上穿梭于一位又一位宾客之间。

e.en: Moths {flitter} around the porch light every summer evening.
e.zh: 夏夜里飞蛾总在门廊灯周围扑腾。

e.en: I watched the leaves {flitter} down from the maple tree.
e.zh: 我看着枫叶轻盈地从树上飘落。

e.en: The sparrow kept {flitting} between branches outside my window.
e.zh: 那只麻雀不停地在我窗外的树枝间跳来跳去。

e.en: Her eyes were {flitting} nervously around the crowded room.
e.zh: 她的目光紧张地在拥挤的房间里四处扫视。

float.t:
v. 漂浮；浮动
n. 浮标；浮点数

e.en: Wooden boats easily {float} on calm lake water.
e.zh: 木船能轻易地浮在平静的湖面上。
