e.en: They want to {float} the company on the stock exchange.
e.zh: 他们打算让公司在证券交易所上市。

floated.t: v. 漂浮（过去式）；提出（想法）

e.en: A red balloon {floated} gently across the blue sky.
e.zh: 一只红气球缓缓飘过蓝天。

e.en: She {floated} the idea of working from home permanently.
e.zh: 她提出了永久在家办公的想法。

e.en: I keep seeing a tiny {floater} in my left eye.
e.zh: 我左眼里总能看到一个小飞蚊。

e.en: The point guard sank a smooth {floater} over the defender.
e.zh: 控球后卫在防守者头上投出一记柔和的抛投。

floating.t:
adj. 漂浮的；浮动的
n. 浮动

e.en: Plastic bottles were {floating} all over the polluted river.
e.zh: 塑料瓶漂得满受污染的河面都是。

e.en: The new building has a {floating} staircase in the lobby.
e.zh: 新大楼大堂里有一道悬空楼梯。

floss.t:
n. 牙线
v. 用牙线清洁牙齿

e.en: My dentist reminds me to {floss} after every meal.
e.zh: 我的牙医提醒我每餐后都要用牙线。

e.en: The kids enjoyed pink cotton {floss} at the carnival.
e.zh: 孩子们在嘉年华享用粉色棉花糖。

flotation.t: n. 漂浮；（公司）上市发行

e.en: The lifeguard tossed a {flotation} device to the struggling swimmer.
e.zh: 救生员向挣扎的游泳者扔了一个救生圈。

e.en: Investors are watching the company's {flotation} on the stock exchange.
e.zh: 投资者正在关注该公司的上市发行。

e.en: A small {flotilla} of fishing boats left the harbor at dawn.
e.zh: 一支小型渔船队在黎明时分离开港口。

e.en: The protest {flotilla} sailed peacefully across the bay.
e.zh: 抗议船队平静地驶过海湾。

flotsam.t: n. 水上漂浮的残骸、杂物

e.en: Beachcombers found unusual {flotsam} washed up after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后,海滩拾荒者发现了不寻常的漂浮物。

e.en: The novel describes the {flotsam} and jetsam of urban life.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了都市生活中的漂泊与失落。

flounce.t:
n. 裙摆荷叶边
v. 气冲冲地走

e.en: Don't {flounce} out of the room every time you lose an argument.
e.zh: 别每次输了争论就气冲冲地走出房间。

e.en: Her dress had a delicate lace {flounce} along the hem.
e.zh: 她的裙子下摆有一圈精致的蕾丝荷叶边。

flounced.t: v. 气冲冲地离开（flounce 过去式）

e.en: She {flounced} out of the meeting after being interrupted again.
e.zh: 她在再次被打断后愤然离开了会议。

e.en: The bride wore a {flounced} skirt with layers of tulle.
e.zh: 新娘穿着一条多层薄纱的荷叶边裙。

flounder.t:
v. 挣扎；不知所措
n. 比目鱼

e.en: New employees often {flounder} during their first month on the job.
e.zh: 新员工常常在工作的第一个月里手足无措。

e.en: The chef grilled a fresh {flounder} with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 厨师用柠檬和香草烤了一条新鲜的比目鱼。

floundering.t: v. 挣扎、手足无措（进行式）

e.en: The startup is {floundering} after losing its main investor.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在失去主要投资者后陷入困境。

e.en: I was {floundering} through the math homework without any help.
e.zh: 我在没有任何帮助下笨拙地应付数学作业。

flour.t:
n. 面粉
v. 撒面粉

e.en: Sift the {flour} carefully before adding it to the batter.
e.zh: 在加入面糊之前先仔细筛过面粉。

e.en: We ran out of {flour} halfway through baking the cake.
e.zh: 我们烤蛋糕烤到一半时面粉用完了。

floured.t: v. 撒上面粉（flour 过去式）

e.en: Roll the dough out on a lightly {floured} surface.
e.zh: 在撒了一层薄面粉的台面上把面团擀开。

e.en: She {floured} her hands before kneading the bread dough.
e.zh: 她在揉面团前在手上撒了些面粉。

flourish.t:
v. 繁荣；兴旺
n. 炫耀的动作

e.en: Small businesses {flourish} when the local economy is strong.
e.zh: 经济好的时候小企业就会蓬勃发展。

e.en: He signed the contract with a dramatic {flourish} of his pen.
e.zh: 他用钢笔潇洒地一挥签下了合同。

flourished.t: v. 兴旺、蓬勃发展（过去式）

e.en: Ancient Greek philosophy {flourished} during the fifth century BC.
e.zh: 古希腊哲学在公元前五世纪繁荣兴盛。

e.en: The magician {flourished} his wand and produced a white dove.
e.zh: 魔术师挥动魔杖,变出一只白鸽。

flourishes.t:
v. 繁荣（第三人称单数）
n. 花饰

e.en: Her writing {flourishes} with vivid metaphors and clever wordplay.
e.zh: 她的文章充满生动的比喻和巧妙的文字游戏。

e.en: The chef adds final {flourishes} of fresh herbs before serving.
e.zh: 厨师上菜前用新鲜香草做最后的点缀。

e.en: Beijing has a {flourishing} tech scene that rivals Silicon Valley.
e.zh: 北京拥有可与硅谷媲美的蓬勃科技产业。

e.en: My tomato plants are {flourishing} in the new greenhouse.
e.zh: 我的番茄苗在新温室里长得茂盛。

e.en: The garden's sudden {flourishment} surprised everyone in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 花园突然的繁茂景象让附近所有人都惊讶。

e.en: Her career enjoyed a remarkable {flourishment} after the promotion.
e.zh: 她的事业在升职后获得了显著的发展。

floury.t: adj. 像面粉的；沾满面粉的

e.en: Wipe your {floury} hands before answering the phone.
e.zh: 接电话前先把沾满面粉的手擦干净。

e.en: These potatoes have a soft, {floury} texture when boiled.
e.zh: 这些土豆煮熟后有种松软粉糯的口感。

flout.t: v. 公然蔑视、违抗（规则）

e.en: Drivers who {flout} traffic laws face heavy fines downtown.
e.zh: 无视交通法规的司机在市中心会被处以重罚。

e.en: Some companies openly {flout} environmental regulations to save money.
e.zh: 一些公司公然无视环保法规以节省成本。

e.en: He kept {flouting} the dress code by wearing sneakers to work.
e.zh: 他不断无视着装规定,穿运动鞋上班。

e.en: The CEO was fined for {flouting} new privacy regulations.
e.zh: 那位首席执行官因无视新的隐私法规而被罚款。

flow.t:
v. 流动
n. 流量；流程

e.en: Rivers {flow} from the mountains down to the sea.
e.zh: 河流从山上流向大海。

e.en: Try to keep the conversation {flow} natural and easy.
e.zh: 尽量让谈话自然顺畅地进行。

e.en: The team drew a {flowchart} to map out the user journey.
e.zh: 团队画了一张流程图来梳理用户旅程。

e.en: This {flowchart} helps new engineers understand our deployment process.
e.zh: 这张流程图帮助新工程师了解我们的部署流程。

e.en: Water {flowed} steadily from the fountain throughout the afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午泉水都源源不断地从喷泉流出。

e.en: Conversation {flowed} easily once everyone had a drink in hand.
e.zh: 大家手里都拿了饮料后,谈话就顺畅起来。

e.en: He picked a single yellow {flower} for her birthday.
e.zh: 他为她的生日摘了一朵黄色的小花。

e.en: Talents like hers tend to {flower} in supportive environments.
e.zh: 她这样的才华往往在支持的环境中绽放。

e.en: She planted tulips in the {flowerbed} by the front door.
e.zh: 她在前门旁的花坛里种了郁金香。

e.en: The neighbor's cat keeps digging up our {flowerbed}.
e.zh: 邻居家的猫总是把我们的花坛刨乱。

flowered.t:
adj. 有花图案的
v. 开花（过去式）

e.en: She wore a {flowered} dress to the summer picnic.
e.zh: 她穿着一条印花裙去参加夏日野餐。

e.en: The cherry tree {flowered} earlier than usual this year.
e.zh: 今年樱花树开花比往年都早。

flowering.t:
n. 开花期
adj. 开花的

e.en: The garden is full of {flowering} shrubs in May.
e.zh: 五月里花园开满了正在盛放的灌木。

e.en: Jazz had its {flowering} period in the 1920s.
e.zh: 爵士乐在二十年代迎来了它的繁盛期。

e.en: Ferns and mosses are {flowerless} plants.
e.zh: 蕨类和苔藓都属于无花植物。

e.en: The garden looked bare and {flowerless} in winter.
e.zh: 冬天的花园光秃秃的,没有一朵花。

e.en: She knocked over a {flowerpot} while dusting the shelf.
e.zh: 她擦架子时不小心打翻了一只花盆。

e.en: A small cactus sat in the clay {flowerpot} by the window.
e.zh: 窗边的陶花盆里放着一棵小仙人掌。

flowers.t:
n. 花（复数）
v. 开花（第三人称单数）

e.en: He brought her a bouquet of fresh {flowers}.
e.zh: 他给她带来了一束鲜花。

e.en: The cherry tree {flowers} every April.
e.zh: 这棵樱花树每年四月开花。

flowery.t: adj. 多花的；辞藻华丽的

e.en: His speech was full of {flowery} language and clichés.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了华丽辞藻和陈词滥调。

e.en: She picked out a {flowery} wallpaper for the bedroom.
e.zh: 她为卧室挑了一款带花纹的壁纸。

e.en: The river was {flowing} fast after the heavy rain.
e.zh: 暴雨过后,河水流得很急。

e.en: She wore a long, {flowing} dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一条飘逸的长裙出席晚会。

e.en: The engineer checked the {flowmeter} readings every hour.
e.zh: 工程师每小时都会检查一次流量计的读数。

e.en: A faulty {flowmeter} caused the pipeline alarm.
e.zh: 一只故障的流量计触发了管道警报。

e.en: I have {flown} to Tokyo three times this year.
e.zh: 今年我已经飞过东京三次了。

e.en: The migrating birds have already {flown} south.
e.zh: 候鸟已经飞往南方了。

flows.t:
v. 流动（第三人称单数）
n. 流量（复数）

e.en: The Mississippi River {flows} into the Gulf of Mexico.
e.zh: 密西西比河注入墨西哥湾。

e.en: The app tracks daily cash {flows} for small businesses.
e.zh: 这款应用为小企业追踪每日的现金流。

e.en: The listing said "3rd {flr}, walk-up apartment, no elevator."
e.zh: 房源信息写着"三楼,步梯公寓,无电梯"。

e.en: Building maps abbreviate floor as {flr} to save space.
e.zh: 楼层平面图用 flr 来缩写 floor 以节省空间。

e.en: The boarding pass listed {flt} 287 to Singapore.
e.zh: 登机牌上印着飞往新加坡的 flt 287 航班。

e.en: Airlines often abbreviate flight as {flt} on schedules.
e.zh: 航空公司在时刻表上常把 flight 缩写为 flt。

e.en: Half the office is out with the {flu} this week.
e.zh: 这周办公室里一半人都因流感请假了。

e.en: You should get a {flu} shot before winter starts.
e.zh: 你应该在入冬前打一针流感疫苗。

flub.t:
v. 笨拙地搞砸
n. 失误

e.en: Don't {flub} your lines during the audition tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天试镜时别把台词说错了。

e.en: The goalie watched his teammate {flub} an easy save.
e.zh: 守门员眼看着队友把一个简单的扑救搞砸了。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {fluconazole} for the yeast infection.
e.zh: 医生开了氟康唑来治疗念珠菌感染。

e.en: {Fluconazole} is taken orally and usually well tolerated.
e.zh: 氟康唑可口服,耐受性通常很好。

e.en: Stock prices can {fluctuate} wildly during earnings season.
e.zh: 在财报季,股价可能剧烈波动。

e.en: Temperatures here {fluctuate} a lot between day and night.
e.zh: 这里昼夜温度起伏很大。

e.en: The exchange rate {fluctuated} sharply after the announcement.
e.zh: 消息发布后汇率剧烈波动。

e.en: Her mood {fluctuated} between excitement and nerves all morning.
e.zh: 整个上午她的情绪都在兴奋与紧张之间起伏。

fluctuates.t: v. 波动（第三人称单数）

e.en: The signal strength {fluctuates} when I move around the house.
e.zh: 我在屋子里走动时,信号强度会忽强忽弱。

e.en: Her weight {fluctuates} by a few pounds each month.
e.zh: 她的体重每月会有几磅的波动。

e.en: Investors are nervous about {fluctuating} oil prices.
e.zh: 投资者对油价的波动感到紧张。

e.en: He struggles with {fluctuating} energy levels throughout the day.
e.zh: 他一整天精力起伏不定,挺难受的。

e.en: Even small {fluctuation} in temperature can ruin the experiment.
e.zh: 哪怕温度有一点点波动都会毁掉这个实验。

e.en: There's been a noticeable {fluctuation} in subscriber numbers lately.
e.zh: 最近订阅人数出现了明显的波动。

e.en: Currency {fluctuations} affect the cost of imported goods.
e.zh: 汇率波动会影响进口商品的成本。

e.en: The sensor filters out small {fluctuations} in voltage.
e.zh: 该传感器会过滤掉电压的微小波动。

e.en: Soot had built up inside the chimney {flue}.
e.zh: 烟囱的烟道里积了不少烟灰。

e.en: A blocked {flue} can let dangerous gases back into the room.
e.zh: 烟道堵塞会让危险气体倒灌进房间。

e.en: Researchers measured the laser {fluence} at the target surface.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了激光在靶面处的能量通量。

e.en: Higher {fluence} caused more damage to the sample.
e.zh: 更高的辐射通量对样品造成了更大的损伤。

e.en: The job requires {fluencies} in both English and Mandarin.
e.zh: 这份工作要求精通英语和普通话。

e.en: Her resume listed {fluencies} in three European languages.
e.zh: 她的简历上列出了三种欧洲语言的流利程度。

e.en: She speaks French with near-native {fluency}.
e.zh: 她的法语流利程度几乎和母语者一样。

e.en: Reading aloud daily can really improve your {fluency}.
e.zh: 每天大声朗读能切实提升你的流利度。

e.en: We took a {floatplane} from Vancouver to a remote island.
e.zh: 我们从温哥华乘水上飞机飞到一座偏远小岛。

e.en: The {floatplane} landed smoothly on the calm mountain lake.
e.zh: 水上飞机平稳地降落在平静的山中湖面上。

floats.t:
v. 漂浮；浮动
n. 浮子；花车

e.en: The parade {floats} were decorated with thousands of fresh flowers.
e.zh: 游行的花车上装饰着成千上万朵鲜花。

e.en: Oil always {floats} on top of water in a glass.
e.zh: 油在杯子里总是浮在水面上。

e.en: She wore a {floaty} summer dress to the garden party.
e.zh: 她穿着一条飘逸的夏装去参加花园派对。

e.en: After the massage, I felt totally relaxed and {floaty}.
e.zh: 按摩后我感觉整个人放松得飘飘然。

flock.t:
n. （鸟、羊）群；一大群
v. 成群结队

e.en: A {flock} of geese flew south for the winter.
e.zh: 一群大雁向南飞去过冬。

e.en: Tourists {flock} to this beach every summer weekend.
e.zh: 每逢夏季周末,游客都涌向这片海滩。

flocked.t: v. 蜂拥而至（flock 的过去式）

e.en: Fans {flocked} to the stadium hours before the concert.
e.zh: 歌迷在演唱会开始前几小时就涌向体育场。

e.en: The shop sells {flocked} Christmas trees with a snowy finish.
e.zh: 这家店出售带雪花涂层的植绒圣诞树。

flocks.t:
n. 群（复数）
v. 成群而来

e.en: Large {flocks} of starlings create amazing patterns at dusk.
e.zh: 大群椋鸟在黄昏时拼出令人惊叹的图案。

e.en: Everyone {flocks} to that café on weekend mornings.
e.zh: 周末早上大家都蜂拥到那家咖啡馆。

flodden.t: n. 弗洛登（苏格兰地名）

e.en: The Battle of {Flodden} took place in northern England in 1513.
e.zh: 弗洛登战役于一五一三年在英格兰北部爆发。

e.en: He wrote a long poem about the tragedy at {Flodden} field.
e.zh: 他写了一首长诗,讲述弗洛登战场上的悲剧。

e.en: A polar bear rested on a drifting ice {floe}.
e.zh: 一只北极熊在漂浮的浮冰上休息。

e.en: The ship carefully navigated around a massive ice {floe}.
e.zh: 船小心翼翼地绕开一大块浮冰航行。

e.en: Seals were sunning themselves on the ice {floes}.
e.zh: 海豹们正在浮冰上晒太阳。

e.en: The expedition crew photographed huge {floes} drifting in the Arctic.
e.zh: 探险队拍下了北极海上漂浮的巨大浮冰。

e.en: He's been trying to {flog} that old car for months.
e.zh: 他想把那辆旧车卖掉已经折腾好几个月了。

e.en: In the past, sailors could {flog} disobedient crew members.
e.zh: 过去水手长可以鞭打不服从命令的船员。

flogging.t:
n. 鞭打；鞭刑
v. 鞭打（进行时）

e.en: He keeps {flogging} the same tired joke at every meeting.
e.zh: 他每次开会都翻来覆去讲那个老掉牙的笑话。

e.en: Public {flogging} was abolished in most countries long ago.
e.zh: 大多数国家早已废除了公开鞭刑。

flood.t:
n. 洪水；大量涌入
v. 淹没；蜂拥

e.en: The {flood} destroyed dozens of homes near the river.
e.zh: 洪水冲毁了河边几十户人家。

e.en: Complaints began to {flood} into the customer service inbox.
e.zh: 投诉开始大量涌入客服邮箱。

flooded.t:
v. 淹没；涌入（过去式）
adj. 被水淹的

e.en: Heavy rain {flooded} the basement of our apartment building.
e.zh: 大雨把我们公寓楼的地下室淹了。

e.en: My inbox got {flooded} with promotional emails this morning.
e.zh: 今早我的收件箱被推广邮件淹没了。

e.en: Engineers opened the {floodgate} to release pressure on the dam.
e.zh: 工程师打开闸门以减轻大坝的压力。

e.en: That ruling opened the {floodgate} for similar lawsuits nationwide.
e.zh: 那项裁决为全国类似诉讼打开了闸门。

floodgates.t: n. 水闸（复数，常喻情绪宣泄）

e.en: Her resignation opened the {floodgates} for others to leave.
e.zh: 她的辞职引发了一波接一波的离职潮。

e.en: Operators raised the {floodgates} as the storm approached.
e.zh: 风暴临近时,操作员升起了水闸。

flooding.t:
n. 洪水泛滥；水浸
v. 淹没（进行时）

e.en: Severe {flooding} closed several highways across the region.
e.zh: 严重的洪涝导致该地区多条高速公路关闭。

e.en: Memories kept {flooding} back as she read the old letters.
e.zh: 读着那些旧信,回忆不断涌上心头。

e.en: They installed a powerful {floodlight} above the back garage door.
e.zh: 他们在车库后门上方装了一盏强力泛光灯。

e.en: The single {floodlight} lit up the entire football field.
e.zh: 那一盏泛光灯照亮了整个足球场。

e.en: The castle looked magical when it was {floodlit} at night.
e.zh: 城堡在夜间泛光灯下显得如梦似幻。

e.en: We played a {floodlit} match against our biggest rivals.
e.zh: 我们在泛光灯下与最大的对手进行了一场比赛。

e.en: Building houses on a {floodplain} is generally a bad idea.
e.zh: 在泛洪平原上盖房子通常不是个好主意。

e.en: The river's {floodplain} provides rich soil for local farmers.
e.zh: 这条河的泛滥平原为当地农民提供了肥沃的土壤。

floods.t:
n. 洪水（复数）
v. 淹没

e.en: Heavy rain {floods} the streets every summer in this city.
e.zh: 每年夏天暴雨都会淹没这座城市的街道。

e.en: My inbox {floods} with emails after every product launch.
e.zh: 每次产品发布后我的邮箱就被邮件淹没。

e.en: The city built a tall {floodwall} to protect downtown.
e.zh: 市政府修建了一道高大的防洪墙来保护市中心。

e.en: Engineers reinforced the {floodwall} before the hurricane arrived.
e.zh: 工程师在飓风来临前加固了防洪墙。

e.en: The {floodwater} reached the second floor of the house.
e.zh: 洪水已经涨到房子的二楼。

e.en: Volunteers pumped {floodwater} out of the flooded basement.
e.zh: 志愿者把洪水从被淹的地下室抽出来。

e.en: The {floodwaters} slowly receded after three long days.
e.zh: 经过漫长的三天,洪水慢慢退去。

e.en: Rescue boats navigated through the muddy {floodwaters} at dawn.
e.zh: 救援船在黎明时穿过浑浊的洪水。

floor.t:
n. 地板；楼层
v. 击倒；难倒

e.en: Please don't leave wet towels on the bathroom {floor}.
e.zh: 请不要把湿毛巾留在浴室地板上。

e.en: Her office is on the fifteenth {floor} of the building.
e.zh: 她的办公室在大楼的十五层。

e.en: One loose {floorboard} creaks every time someone walks past.
e.zh: 有一块松动的地板,每次有人走过都会嘎吱作响。

e.en: He hid the letters under a {floorboard} in the attic.
e.zh: 他把信藏在阁楼的一块地板下面。

floored.t: v. 击倒；使惊呆（过去式）

e.en: I was completely {floored} by the surprise birthday party.
e.zh: 那个惊喜生日派对让我彻底惊呆了。

e.en: She {floored} the gas pedal and sped onto the highway.
e.zh: 她猛踩油门,飞速驶上高速公路。

e.en: We chose hardwood {flooring} for the living room renovation.
e.zh: 我们为客厅翻新选择了硬木地板。

e.en: Vinyl {flooring} is cheaper and easier to clean.
e.zh: 乙烯基地板更便宜,也更容易清洁。

floorplan.t: n. 楼层平面图；户型图

e.en: The apartment's open {floorplan} makes it feel much larger.
e.zh: 这套公寓的开放式户型让空间显得宽敞许多。

e.en: She sketched a rough {floorplan} before hiring a contractor.
e.zh: 她在雇承包商之前画了一张粗略的户型图。

e.en: The hotel has twenty {floors} and a rooftop pool.
e.zh: 这家酒店有二十层,还有屋顶泳池。

e.en: He mops the kitchen {floors} every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 他每个周日早上都拖厨房地板。

e.en: The tabloid unfairly labeled the actress a {floozy}.
e.zh: 小报不公平地把那位女演员说成是轻浮女子。

e.en: He dismissed the rumor that his date was a {floozy}.
e.zh: 他驳斥了关于他约会对象是放荡女人的传言。

flop.t:
v. 瘫倒；彻底失败
n. 惨败之作

e.en: The new movie was a complete {flop} at the box office.
e.zh: 这部新电影在票房上彻底失败了。

e.en: After work I just {flop} onto the couch and relax.
e.zh: 下班后我就一头倒在沙发上放松。

e.en: He spent his last dollar on a bed in a {flophouse}.
e.zh: 他把最后一美元花在了廉价旅馆的一张床位上。

e.en: The old {flophouse} downtown was finally torn down last year.
e.zh: 市中心那家破旧的廉价旅店去年终于被拆除了。

floppy.t:
adj. 松软下垂的
n. 软盘

e.en: The puppy has adorable {floppy} ears that bounce when running.
e.zh: 这只小狗有可爱的耷拉耳朵,跑起来一颠一颠的。

e.en: My grandfather still keeps an old {floppy} disk collection.
e.zh: 我爷爷还保留着一堆旧软盘。

e.en: The island's unique {flora} attracts botanists from around the world.
e.zh: 这座岛屿独特的植物群吸引着世界各地的植物学家。

e.en: Gut {flora} plays a key role in human digestion.
e.zh: 肠道菌群在人体消化中起着关键作用。

e.en: She wore a bright {floral} dress to the garden party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条亮丽的花朵裙参加花园派对。

e.en: The perfume has a soft {floral} scent with hints of jasmine.
e.zh: 这款香水有淡淡的花香,带着茉莉的气息。

florence.t: n. 佛罗伦萨（意大利城市）；女子名

e.en: We spent three days exploring museums in {Florence}, Italy.
e.zh: 我们花了三天时间游览意大利佛罗伦萨的博物馆。

e.en: My grandmother {Florence} taught me how to bake bread.
e.zh: 我奶奶弗洛伦斯教我怎么烤面包。

florentine.t:
adj. 佛罗伦萨的
n. 佛罗伦萨人

e.en: The chef served eggs {Florentine} with creamy spinach sauce.
e.zh: 厨师端上了配奶油菠菜酱的佛罗伦萨式鸡蛋。

e.en: The museum displays several {Florentine} paintings from the Renaissance.
e.zh: 博物馆展出几幅文艺复兴时期的佛罗伦萨绘画。

e.en: We hiked across the volcanic island of {Flores} in Indonesia.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿越了印度尼西亚的弗洛勒斯火山岛。

e.en: Maria {Flores} won the local poetry competition this year.
e.zh: 玛丽亚·弗洛雷斯今年赢得了当地诗歌比赛。

e.en: Spring brings a sudden {florescence} of cherry blossoms across Tokyo.
e.zh: 春天给东京带来樱花的盛放。

e.en: The 1920s saw a remarkable {florescence} of jazz music.
e.zh: 二十世纪二十年代爵士乐迎来了显著的繁荣期。

e.en: The garden was a {florescent} display of color in May.
e.zh: 五月的花园呈现出繁花盛开的色彩。

e.en: Photographers love capturing the {florescent} cherry trees each spring.
e.zh: 摄影师喜欢每年春天拍摄盛开的樱花树。

floret.t: n. 小花；（菜花的）小花球

e.en: Cut each broccoli {floret} into bite-sized pieces before cooking.
e.zh: 烹饪前把每朵西兰花切成一口大小。

e.en: A single {floret} of cauliflower fell off the cutting board.
e.zh: 一朵花椰菜从砧板上掉了下来。

floribunda.t: n. 丰花月季（一类多花蔷薇）

e.en: She planted a pink {floribunda} rose by the front gate.
e.zh: 她在前门旁种了一株粉色的丰花月季。

e.en: The {floribunda} produces clusters of blooms all summer long.
e.zh: 这种丰花月季整个夏天都会成簇绽放。

florid.t: adj. 辞藻华丽的；面色红润的

e.en: His {florid} writing style felt outdated to modern readers.
e.zh: 他华丽的写作风格让现代读者觉得过时。

e.en: The man's {florid} face suggested he had been drinking heavily.
e.zh: 那男人涨红的脸表明他喝了不少酒。

e.en: We're driving down to {Florida} for spring break next week.
e.zh: 我们下周开车去佛罗里达过春假。

e.en: {Florida} is famous for its beaches and theme parks.
e.zh: 佛罗里达以海滩和主题公园闻名。

florin.t: n. 弗罗林（旧时硬币/货币）

e.en: The merchant accepted a single gold {florin} as payment.
e.zh: 商人接受了一枚金弗罗林作为付款。

e.en: My grandfather kept an old Dutch {florin} as a souvenir.
e.zh: 我爷爷把一枚旧荷兰盾留作纪念。

e.en: The {florist} arranged a beautiful bouquet for the wedding.
e.zh: 花店老板为婚礼布置了一束漂亮的花。

e.en: I called the local {florist} to send flowers to my mom.
e.zh: 我打电话给当地花店给妈妈送花。

e.en: Researchers conducted a {floristic} survey of the rainforest region.
e.zh: 研究人员对该雨林地区进行了植物区系调查。

e.en: The book documents the {floristic} diversity of the Andes mountains.
e.zh: 这本书记录了安第斯山脉的植物多样性。

e.en: He is {fluent} in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.
e.zh: 他能流利地说英语、西班牙语和葡萄牙语。

e.en: After two years abroad, her Japanese became truly {fluent}.
e.zh: 在国外住了两年后,她的日语真正变得流利了。

e.en: She speaks Mandarin {fluently} after living in Beijing.
e.zh: 在北京住过之后,她说普通话非常流利。

e.en: The toddler chattered {fluently} about her new toy.
e.zh: 那个小娃娃滔滔不绝地讲起她的新玩具。

fluff.t:
n. 绒毛，软毛
v. 弄蓬松；搞砸

e.en: There's some lint and {fluff} stuck on your sweater.
e.zh: 你毛衣上粘了一些线头和绒毛。

e.en: Most of the article was just {fluff} with no real news.
e.zh: 那篇文章大多是空话,根本没什么真新闻。

e.en: The kitten has soft, {fluffy} white fur.
e.zh: 那只小猫长着柔软蓬松的白色绒毛。

e.en: Her pancakes turned out light and {fluffy}.
e.zh: 她做的松饼又轻又松软。

fluid.t:
n. 液体，流体
adj. 流动的；易变的

e.en: Drink plenty of {fluid} when you have a fever.
e.zh: 发烧时要多补充水分。

e.en: The team's plans are still pretty {fluid} at this stage.
e.zh: 现阶段团队的计划还很灵活,没定下来。

e.en: The dancer moved with remarkable {fluidity} across the stage.
e.zh: 那位舞者在舞台上动作行云流水。

e.en: Cooler temperatures reduce the {fluidity} of engine oil.
e.zh: 低温会降低发动机机油的流动性。

e.en: The reactor uses a {fluidized} bed of fine catalyst particles.
e.zh: 该反应器采用细颗粒催化剂的流化床。

e.en: Hot air {fluidized} the sand inside the drying chamber.
e.zh: 热空气使干燥室内的沙子呈流化状态。

e.en: The new app switches between tabs {fluidly} on older phones.
e.zh: 这款新应用在旧手机上也能流畅地切换标签。

e.en: She moved {fluidly} from one yoga pose to the next.
e.zh: 她从一个瑜伽体式流畅地过渡到下一个。

e.en: Doctors told him to drink plenty of {fluids} and rest.
e.zh: 医生让他多喝水多休息。

e.en: The mechanic checked all the {fluids} under the hood.
e.zh: 修车师傅检查了引擎盖下所有的油液。

e.en: Winning the lottery twice was a complete {fluke}.
e.zh: 中两次彩票纯属侥幸。

e.en: That goal was a {fluke}, not real skill.
e.zh: 那个进球只是运气,不是真本事。

e.en: The team's first win felt a bit {fluky} to the fans.
e.zh: 球迷觉得球队的首胜有点靠运气。

e.en: He scored a {fluky} goal off his own knee.
e.zh: 他用膝盖侥幸打进了一球。

e.en: Loggers once floated timber down the wooden {flume}.
e.zh: 伐木工人曾用木制水槽顺水漂运木材。

e.en: The kids screamed all the way down the water-park {flume}.
e.zh: 孩子们一路尖叫着冲下水上乐园的滑水道。

e.en: Trick questions on the test always {flummox} new students.
e.zh: 考试里的脑筋急转弯总能把新生难倒。

e.en: Even simple software updates {flummox} my grandfather.
e.zh: 哪怕是简单的软件更新也能把我爷爷搞糊涂。

flummoxed.t: adj. 困惑的，不知所措的

e.en: The riddle completely {flummoxed} everyone at the dinner table.
e.zh: 那个谜语把饭桌上所有人都难住了。

e.en: She looked totally {flummoxed} by the new coffee machine.
e.zh: 她被那台新咖啡机弄得一脸懵。

e.en: If you skip every class, you'll definitely {flunk} the course.
e.zh: 你要是天天翘课,这门课肯定挂。

e.en: He was terrified he might {flunk} his driving test again.
e.zh: 他很怕自己驾照考试又会挂掉。

flunked.t: v. 不及格了（flunk 过去式）

e.en: She {flunked} her chemistry final and had to retake it.
e.zh: 她化学期末考试挂了,只能重考。

e.en: He {flunked} the physical and didn't make the team.
e.zh: 他体测没过,没能进队。

e.en: The CEO treated his assistant like a personal {flunkey}.
e.zh: 那位 CEO 把助理当成了自己的跟班。

e.en: Don't act like a {flunkey} just to please the boss.
e.zh: 别为了讨好老板就活成一个马屁精。

flunking.t: v. 不及格（flunk 进行式）

e.en: He's worried about {flunking} math this semester.
e.zh: 他担心这学期数学会挂科。

e.en: Skipping practice is a quick way to start {flunking} tryouts.
e.zh: 翘掉训练就是开始被选拔淘汰的捷径。

flunks.t: v. 不及格（flunk 第三人称单数）

e.en: If a student {flunks} three classes, they lose the scholarship.
e.zh: 学生若有三门课不及格,就会失去奖学金。

e.en: The new battery {flunks} every safety test we run.
e.zh: 这块新电池连续没通过我们做的每一项安全测试。

e.en: Certain minerals {fluoresce} bright green under UV light.
e.zh: 某些矿物在紫外光下会发出明亮的绿色荧光。

e.en: Tonic water will {fluoresce} when you shine a blacklight on it.
e.zh: 汤力水在黑光灯下会发出荧光。

e.en: The eye doctor used {fluorescein} to check for corneal scratches.
e.zh: 眼科医生用荧光素来检查角膜有没有划伤。

e.en: Researchers added {fluorescein} dye to trace the underground stream.
e.zh: 研究人员加入荧光素染料来追踪地下水流。

e.en: The mineral's green {fluorescence} appears only under UV light.
e.zh: 这种矿物的绿色荧光只有在紫外光下才会出现。

e.en: Scientists use {fluorescence} to track proteins inside living cells.
e.zh: 科学家利用荧光来追踪活细胞内的蛋白质。

e.en: The office was lit by harsh {fluorescent} tubes.
e.zh: 办公室里点着刺眼的日光灯管。

e.en: Cyclists wear {fluorescent} vests to stay visible at dusk.
e.zh: 骑行者穿荧光背心,以便在黄昏时被看见。

fluoridated.t: adj. 加氟的，氟化处理的

e.en: Most cities supply {fluoridated} tap water to prevent cavities.
e.zh: 大多数城市供应加氟自来水以预防蛀牙。

e.en: Dentists generally support drinking {fluoridated} water from childhood.
e.zh: 牙医普遍支持从小就饮用加氟水。

e.en: The city approved water {fluoridation} to improve dental health.
e.zh: 市政府批准在饮用水中加氟以改善牙齿健康。

e.en: Some activists still protest against {fluoridation} of public water.
e.zh: 一些活动人士仍在抗议公共用水加氟。

e.en: Most toothpastes contain {fluoride} to prevent cavities.
e.zh: 大多数牙膏都含氟以预防蛀牙。

e.en: The dentist applied a {fluoride} gel to my teeth.
e.zh: 牙医在我牙齿上涂了一层氟化物凝胶。

e.en: {Fluorine} is the most reactive element in the periodic table.
e.zh: 氟是元素周期表中反应性最强的元素。

e.en: Pure {fluorine} gas is extremely dangerous to handle.
e.zh: 纯氟气处理起来极其危险。

e.en: She collects {fluorite} crystals because they glow under UV light.
e.zh: 她收集萤石晶体,因为它们在紫外光下会发光。

e.en: The mine produces high-grade {fluorite} for industrial use.
e.zh: 这座矿山出产工业用的高品级萤石。

e.en: Old refrigerators leaked {fluorocarbon} gases that damaged the ozone layer.
e.zh: 旧冰箱泄漏的氟碳化合物破坏了臭氧层。

e.en: This nonstick pan uses a {fluorocarbon} coating.
e.zh: 这款不粘锅采用了氟碳涂层。

e.en: The surgeon used {fluoroscopy} to guide the catheter into place.
e.zh: 外科医生使用透视成像将导管准确送到位。

e.en: {Fluoroscopy} provides real-time X-ray images during procedures.
e.zh: 荧光透视检查可在手术中提供实时 X 光影像。

e.en: Excessive fluoride intake in childhood can cause dental {fluorosis}.
e.zh: 儿童期摄入过多氟化物会导致牙齿氟斑症。

e.en: The villagers showed signs of skeletal {fluorosis} from the well water.
e.zh: 村民们因井水问题出现了骨骼氟中毒的症状。

e.en: Her doctor prescribed {fluoxetine} for moderate depression.
e.zh: 医生给她开了氟西汀治疗中度抑郁。

e.en: {Fluoxetine} is sold under the brand name Prozac.
e.zh: 氟西汀以百忧解的品牌名销售。

e.en: The announcement caused a {flurry} of activity on social media.
e.zh: 这则公告在社交媒体上引发了一阵热议。

e.en: A light {flurry} of snow dusted the rooftops.
e.zh: 一阵小雪轻轻覆盖了屋顶。

flush.t:
v. 冲洗；脸红
adj. 齐平的

e.en: Please remember to {flush} the toilet after use.
e.zh: 用完厕所请记得冲水。

e.en: Her cheeks {flush} red whenever she's embarrassed.
e.zh: 她每次尴尬时脸颊都会泛红。

e.en: He looked {flushed} and feverish after the long run.
e.zh: 长跑之后他看起来满脸通红、发着烧。

e.en: She felt {flushed} with pride at her son's graduation.
e.zh: 儿子毕业时她感到无比自豪。

e.en: The plumber is {flushing} the pipes to clear the blockage.
e.zh: 水管工正在冲洗管道以疏通堵塞。

e.en: Her face kept {flushing} during the awkward conversation.
e.zh: 那段尴尬的对话中她的脸一直在发红。

fluster.t:
v. 使慌乱
n. 慌张

e.en: Don't let the tough questions {fluster} you in the interview.
e.zh: 面试时别让那些刁钻问题把你弄慌。

e.en: The sudden noise threw the speaker into a {fluster}.
e.zh: 突如其来的噪音让演讲者一阵慌乱。

flustered.t: adj. 慌乱的，手足无措的

e.en: She got {flustered} when the boss walked into the meeting.
e.zh: 老板走进会议室时她一下子慌了神。

e.en: He felt {flustered} after forgetting his lines on stage.
e.zh: 在台上忘词后他显得很慌乱。

e.en: She played a soft melody on the {flute}.
e.zh: 她用长笛吹奏了一段柔和的旋律。

e.en: The waiter handed each guest a {flute} of champagne.
e.zh: 服务员给每位客人递上一杯香槟。

e.en: The dress had a beautifully {fluted} hem.
e.zh: 这件连衣裙的裙摆做了漂亮的波浪褶。

e.en: Greek temples often feature tall, {fluted} columns.
e.zh: 希腊神庙常有高大的凹槽圆柱。

e.en: The orchestra has four {flutes} in its woodwind section.
e.zh: 乐团的木管部有四支长笛。

e.en: He poured champagne into the tall crystal {flutes}.
e.zh: 他把香槟倒进高高的水晶香槟杯里。

e.en: The carpenter added decorative {fluting} along the cabinet edge.
e.zh: 木匠在橱柜边缘加了装饰性的凹槽线条。

e.en: Soft {fluting} from a nearby room filled the hallway.
e.zh: 邻室飘来的轻柔笛声充满了走廊。

e.en: The young {flutist} won first prize at the music competition.
e.zh: 那位年轻的长笛手在音乐比赛中夺得一等奖。

e.en: She trained for years to become a professional {flutist}.
e.zh: 她苦练多年才成为一名职业长笛演奏家。

flutter.t:
v. 颤动，飘动
n. 一阵激动

e.en: Butterflies {flutter} around the lavender bushes all afternoon.
e.zh: 蝴蝶整个下午都在薰衣草丛旁翩翩飞舞。

e.en: His message gave her heart a sudden {flutter}.
e.zh: 他的消息让她的心猛地一颤。

e.en: Flags were {fluttering} in the strong harbor wind.
e.zh: 旗帜在港口强劲的风中猎猎飘扬。

e.en: She felt a {fluttering} sensation in her chest before the speech.
e.zh: 演讲前她感到胸口有一阵心慌。

flutters.t: v. 颤动（第三人称单数）

e.en: Her stomach {flutters} every time he calls.
e.zh: 他每次打电话来,她心里都像小鹿乱撞。

e.en: A small bird {flutters} against the windowpane.
e.zh: 一只小鸟扑棱着翅膀撞向窗玻璃。

fluttery.t: adj. 飘动的，心神不定的

e.en: She wore a light, {fluttery} summer dress to the picnic.
e.zh: 她穿了一件轻盈飘逸的夏日连衣裙去野餐。

e.en: He felt {fluttery} and nervous before his first date.
e.zh: 第一次约会前他既紧张又心跳加速。

e.en: Geologists studied the {fluvial} deposits along the riverbank.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了河岸边的河流沉积物。

e.en: The valley was shaped by ancient {fluvial} erosion.
e.zh: 这条山谷是由古代河流侵蚀塑造而成的。

flux.t: n. 不断变化；流量；助焊剂

e.en: The job market has been in constant {flux} this year.
e.zh: 今年的就业市场一直在剧烈变化。

e.en: The startup's strategy is still in {flux}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的战略仍处于不断调整之中。

fly.t:
v. 飞，飞行
n. 苍蝇

e.en: I'd love to {fly} to Tokyo for the weekend.
e.zh: 我很想周末飞去东京玩一趟。

e.en: There's a {fly} buzzing around the kitchen window.
e.zh: 有只苍蝇在厨房窗户旁嗡嗡乱飞。

flyaway.t: adj. (头发) 飘散的、乱飞的

e.en: This serum tames {flyaway} hair on humid days.
e.zh: 这款精华能在潮湿天气里抚平飞起的碎发。

e.en: She wore a hat to control her {flyaway} curls.
e.zh: 她戴了顶帽子来收住乱飞的卷发。

flyball.t: n. (棒球) 高飞球；飞球犬运动

e.en: Their dog won a ribbon at the local {flyball} tournament.
e.zh: 他们家的狗在本地飞球比赛中赢得了奖带。

e.en: {Flyball} is a fast-paced relay race for dogs.
e.zh: 飞球是一种节奏很快的犬类接力比赛。

e.en: Her grandfather was a cocky {flyboy} during the war.
e.zh: 她爷爷战时是个神气十足的飞行员。

e.en: The movie portrays a young {flyboy} chasing his dreams.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述一位年轻飞行员追逐梦想的故事。

e.en: We watched the sunset from the yacht's {flybridge}.
e.zh: 我们在游艇的飞桥上看夕阳。

e.en: The captain steered the boat from the upper {flybridge}.
e.zh: 船长在上层飞桥上掌舵。

flyby.t: n. 飞行器近距离飞越

e.en: The spacecraft completed a successful {flyby} of Jupiter.
e.zh: 航天器成功完成了对木星的飞掠。

e.en: A military jet did a low {flyby} over the stadium.
e.zh: 一架军用喷气机低空掠过了体育场。

flycatcher.t: n. 捕蝇的鸟；食虫植物

e.en: A small {flycatcher} perched on the fence post.
e.zh: 一只小捕蝇鸟停在了篱笆桩上。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {flycatcher} in the park.
e.zh: 观鸟者在公园里发现了一种稀有的捕蝇鸟。

flyer.t:
n. 传单、宣传单
n. 飞行者

e.en: She handed me a {flyer} for the new yoga studio.
e.zh: 她递给我一张新瑜伽馆的传单。

e.en: He's a frequent {flyer} on transpacific business routes.
e.zh: 他是经常飞跨太平洋商务航线的常旅客。

flying.t:
adj. 飞行的
n. 飞行

e.en: I'm {flying} to Singapore tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我明天上午要飞新加坡。

e.en: The kids love watching planes {flying} overhead.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢看飞机从头顶飞过。

e.en: Her logbook recorded all her {flyings} across the Pacific.
e.zh: 她的飞行日志记录了所有跨太平洋的飞行经历。

e.en: The pilot's early {flyings} were full of close calls.
e.zh: 这位飞行员早年的飞行经历充满了惊险瞬间。

e.en: He signed his name on the {flyleaf} of the novel.
e.zh: 他在小说的扉页上签了名。

e.en: A handwritten note was tucked into the book's {flyleaf}.
e.zh: 书的扉页里夹着一张手写便条。

flyover.t:
n. 立交桥、天桥
n. 飞越表演

e.en: Traffic was diverted under the new {flyover}.
e.zh: 车辆被改道至新建的高架桥下方。

e.en: A military jet did a low {flyover} during the parade.
e.zh: 游行期间一架军用喷气机进行了低空飞越。

e.en: Grandma hung sticky {flypaper} from the kitchen ceiling.
e.zh: 奶奶在厨房天花板上挂了粘苍蝇纸。

e.en: The old shop sold {flypaper} by the roll.
e.zh: 那家旧店按卷出售苍蝇纸。

e.en: The royal celebration featured a stunning {flypast} by the air force.
e.zh: 皇家庆典上演了空军壮观的编队飞越。

e.en: Crowds cheered as the {flypast} thundered overhead.
e.zh: 机群轰鸣飞过头顶时人群欢呼起来。

flysheet.t:
n. 帐篷防雨外罩
n. 单页传单

e.en: Don't forget to attach the {flysheet} before it rains.
e.zh: 下雨之前别忘了把外帐撑起来。

e.en: The tent's {flysheet} kept us dry all night.
e.zh: 帐篷的外帐让我们一整晚都没被淋湿。

e.en: There was a tiny {flyspeck} on the otherwise spotless mirror.
e.zh: 那面原本光洁的镜子上有一个小小的苍蝇屎点。

e.en: From orbit, the island looked like a mere {flyspeck}.
e.zh: 从轨道上看,这座岛屿不过是个小黑点。

e.en: He grabbed a {flyswatter} and chased the bug around the kitchen.
e.zh: 他抓起苍蝇拍在厨房里追打那只虫子。

e.en: A plastic {flyswatter} hung on the back porch.
e.zh: 后廊上挂着一个塑料苍蝇拍。

e.en: Medieval poets would {flyte} with each other in clever insults.
e.zh: 中世纪诗人会以巧妙的互骂相互斗诗。

e.en: The two bards engaged in a lively {flyte} at court.
e.zh: 两位吟游诗人在宫廷里展开了一场激烈的斗诗。

e.en: My niece keeps a Venus {flytrap} on her windowsill.
e.zh: 我侄女在窗台上养了一株捕蝇草。

e.en: The {flytrap} snapped shut on the unlucky insect.
e.zh: 捕蝇草猛地合拢,夹住了那只倒霉的昆虫。

e.en: Millions of birds use this {flyway} during fall migration.
e.zh: 秋季迁徙时数百万只鸟会沿这条迁飞通道飞行。

e.en: Conservationists work to protect the Pacific {flyway}.
e.zh: 环保人士致力于保护太平洋鸟类迁飞路线。

e.en: He won the championship in the {flyweight} division last night.
e.zh: 他昨晚在蝇量级比赛中夺得了冠军。

e.en: The young boxer fights at {flyweight}.
e.zh: 这位年轻拳手参加蝇量级比赛。

flywheel.t: n. 飞轮（机械储能装置）

e.en: The engine's {flywheel} stores energy and smooths out rotation.
e.zh: 发动机的飞轮可以储能并使旋转更平稳。

e.en: Strong reviews created a {flywheel} effect for the startup.
e.zh: 好评为这家初创公司带来了飞轮效应。

fmi.t: abbr. 更多信息 (for more information)

e.en: She added '{FMI}, ping me on Slack' at the bottom of the email.
e.zh: 她在邮件末尾加了一句"如需更多信息请在 Slack 上找我"。

e.en: The memo ended with '{FMI}, see the attached report.'
e.zh: 备忘录结尾写道:"详情请见随附报告。"

foal.t:
n. 幼驹
v. (母马) 产驹

e.en: The mare gave birth to a healthy {foal} at dawn.
e.zh: 那匹母马在黎明时分生下了一只健康的小马驹。

e.en: The {foal} struggled to its feet within minutes of birth.
e.zh: 小马驹出生几分钟后就挣扎着站了起来。

foam.t:
n. 泡沫
v. 起泡沫

e.en: The barista poured {foam} carefully on top of my latte.
e.zh: 咖啡师小心地在我的拿铁上铺了一层奶泡。

e.en: Sea {foam} washed up along the beach after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,海浪卷起的泡沫涌上了沙滩。

e.en: The dog was {foaming} at the mouth after the long run.
e.zh: 那只狗长跑后嘴里直冒泡沫。

e.en: She poured the {foaming} beer into a frosted glass.
e.zh: 她把起泡的啤酒倒进冰镇杯子里。

e.en: The barista topped the latte with a {foamy} layer of milk.
e.zh: 咖啡师在拿铁上加了一层奶泡。

e.en: Waves left a {foamy} trail along the sandy beach.
e.zh: 海浪在沙滩上留下一道泡沫痕迹。

fob.t:
n. 钥匙扣、小挂件
v. 哄骗、搪塞

e.en: I lost the key {fob} for my car yesterday.
e.zh: 我昨天把车钥匙挂件弄丢了。

e.en: Tap your {fob} on the reader to unlock the door.
e.zh: 把感应卡贴在读卡器上就能开门。

e.en: The Spanish word {foca} means seal in English.
e.zh: 西班牙语里 foca 这个词意思是海豹。

e.en: Children laughed as the {foca} balanced a ball at the zoo.
e.zh: 孩子们看到动物园的海豹顶球都笑了。

e.en: She baked rosemary {focaccia} fresh from the oven.
e.zh: 她刚烤好一炉迷迭香佛卡夏面包。

e.en: This Italian restaurant serves warm {focaccia} before every meal.
e.zh: 这家意大利餐厅每餐前都会上热佛卡夏。

e.en: Trust became the {focal} point of the team meeting.
e.zh: 信任成了团队会议的核心议题。

e.en: Adjust the {focal} length for a sharper portrait shot.
e.zh: 调整焦距能拍出更清晰的人像。

e.en: The novel uses internal {focalization} to reveal the hero's thoughts.
e.zh: 这部小说用内聚焦展现主人公的内心想法。

e.en: Critics praised the film's tight {focalization} on one character.
e.zh: 影评人称赞影片紧紧聚焦在一个角色身上。

e.en: The story is {focalized} through a child's perspective.
e.zh: 这个故事是从孩子的视角展开叙述的。

e.en: The professor {focalized} the discussion on climate policy.
e.zh: 教授把讨论的焦点集中在气候政策上。

e.en: The narrator acts as the main {focalizer} in this novel.
e.zh: 叙述者在这部小说里担任主要聚焦者。

e.en: Identifying the {focalizer} helps readers understand whose viewpoint matters.
e.zh: 找出聚焦者有助于读者理解谁的视角最重要。

e.en: An ellipse has two {foci} that define its shape.
e.zh: 椭圆有两个焦点用来确定它的形状。

e.en: The report identifies three main {foci} for next year.
e.zh: 这份报告列出了明年的三大重点方向。

focus.t:
n. 焦点、重点
v. 聚焦、专注

e.en: It's hard to {focus} when notifications keep popping up.
e.zh: 通知不停弹出时很难集中注意力。

e.en: Our main {focus} this quarter is user retention.
e.zh: 我们这个季度的重点是用户留存。

e.en: She stayed {focused} on the project despite the distractions.
e.zh: 尽管干扰不断,她仍然专注于这个项目。

e.en: The startup is {focused} on solving climate problems.
e.zh: 这家初创公司专注于解决气候问题。

e.en: The telescope's {focuser} lets you fine-tune image sharpness.
e.zh: 望远镜的调焦座可以微调图像清晰度。

e.en: Replace the broken {focuser} before the next stargazing night.
e.zh: 下次观星前先换掉坏掉的调焦座。

focuses.t:
v. focus 的三单
n. 焦点 (复数)

e.en: The course {focuses} on practical writing skills.
e.zh: 这门课重点培养实用写作技能。

e.en: Her research {focuses} on early childhood development.
e.zh: 她的研究专注于幼儿早期发展。

focusing.t:
n. 聚焦
v. 正在专注/对焦

e.en: I'm {focusing} on health goals this year.
e.zh: 今年我把重点放在健康目标上。

e.en: The lens has trouble {focusing} in low light.
e.zh: 这只镜头在弱光下很难对焦。

focuss.t: v. focus 的非标准拼写

e.en: Some British writers spell it {focuss} with two s's.
e.zh: 有些英国作家会把这个词拼成 focuss。

e.en: The dictionary lists {focuss} as a rare variant spelling.
e.zh: 词典把 focuss 列为罕见的变体拼写。

e.en: She remained {focussed} during the entire presentation.
e.zh: 整场演讲她都保持着高度专注。

e.en: The British report stayed {focussed} on long-term outcomes.
e.zh: 这份英国报告始终聚焦于长期成果。

fodder.t:
n. 饲料
n. 素材、谈资

e.en: The scandal became great {fodder} for late-night comedians.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻成了深夜脱口秀的绝佳素材。

e.en: Farmers store hay as winter {fodder} for cattle.
e.zh: 农民储存干草作为牛群的过冬饲料。

e.en: Climate change is a common {foe} of every nation.
e.zh: 气候变化是每个国家共同的敌人。

e.en: Once rivals, the two players became friend rather than {foe}.
e.zh: 曾经的对手,这两位选手最终化敌为友。

e.en: She curled up in the {foetal} position on the couch.
e.zh: 她在沙发上蜷缩成胎儿般的姿势。

e.en: Doctors monitor {foetal} heart rate during pregnancy checkups.
e.zh: 医生在产检时会监测胎儿的心率。

e.en: A {foetid} smell rose from the abandoned canal.
e.zh: 那条废弃水渠散发出一股恶臭。

e.en: The damp basement had a {foetid} odor of mold.
e.zh: 潮湿的地下室散发着难闻的霉味。

foetus.t: n. 胎儿（英式拼写，同 fetus）

e.en: The ultrasound showed a healthy {foetus} growing well.
e.zh: B 超显示胎儿发育良好。

e.en: Scientists study how a {foetus} responds to outside sounds.
e.zh: 科学家研究胎儿如何回应外界声音。

fog.t:
n. 雾
v. 使模糊

e.en: Thick {fog} delayed all morning flights from the airport.
e.zh: 浓雾导致机场上午所有航班延误。

e.en: After the surgery, my brain felt in a {fog}.
e.zh: 手术后我感觉脑子昏昏沉沉的。

e.en: My grandfather calls himself an old {fogey} who hates smartphones.
e.zh: 我爷爷自称是讨厌智能手机的老古板。

e.en: Don't be such a {fogey} about new music trends.
e.zh: 对新音乐潮流别那么老古板嘛。

fogged.t:
adj. 起雾的；朦胧的
v. fog 的过去式

e.en: My glasses {fogged} up the moment I stepped inside.
e.zh: 我一进屋眼镜就起雾了。

e.en: The bathroom mirror {fogged} during the long hot shower.
e.zh: 洗了好久热水澡后浴室镜子全起雾了。

e.en: It was a cold and {foggy} morning in San Francisco.
e.zh: 旧金山的清晨又冷又有雾。

e.en: My memory of last night is a bit {foggy}.
e.zh: 我对昨晚的记忆有点模糊。

e.en: The {foghorn} blasted across the bay every few minutes.
e.zh: 雾笛每隔几分钟就在海湾上空鸣响。

e.en: His voice boomed like a {foghorn} across the room.
e.zh: 他的嗓音像雾笛一样响彻整个房间。

fogs.t:
n. fog 的复数
v. fog 的第三人称单数

e.en: Heavy {fogs} often roll in from the coast at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨常有浓雾从海岸涌入内陆。

e.en: Lack of sleep {fogs} my judgment at work.
e.zh: 睡眠不足让我在工作时判断力下降。

e.en: Don't call me a {fogy} just because I prefer books.
e.zh: 我喜欢看书,你可别说我是老古板。

e.en: The old {fogy} refused to use the new app.
e.zh: 那位老顽固拒绝使用新应用。

e.en: Forgetting names is just one of his harmless {foible}s.
e.zh: 记不住名字只是他无伤大雅的小毛病之一。

e.en: Every great writer has a personal {foible} or two.
e.zh: 每位伟大的作家都会有一两个小怪癖。

foil.t:
n. 箔，锡纸
v. 挫败

e.en: The detective managed to {foil} the robbery in time.
e.zh: 侦探及时挫败了那起抢劫案。

e.en: Wrap the leftover salmon in {foil} before refrigerating.
e.zh: 剩下的三文鱼用锡纸包好再放进冰箱。

foiled.t:
v. foil 的过去式，被挫败
adj. 受挫的

e.en: Security cameras {foiled} the thieves' careful escape plan.
e.zh: 监控摄像头让窃贼精心策划的逃跑落空。

e.en: Her dreams were {foiled} by an unexpected illness.
e.zh: 一场突如其来的疾病让她的梦想化为泡影。

e.en: Don't try to {foist} your opinions on everyone else.
e.zh: 别试图把你的观点强加给别人。

e.en: Salespeople often {foist} unwanted add-ons onto new customers.
e.zh: 销售员常常向新顾客硬塞他们不需要的附加品。

fokker.t: n. 福克（飞机品牌/荷兰制造商）

e.en: The vintage {fokker} biplane drew crowds at the airshow.
e.zh: 那架老式福克双翼机在航展上吸引了大批观众。

e.en: He built a model {fokker} from a wooden kit.
e.zh: 他用木质套件拼装了一架福克飞机模型。

e.en: Pregnant women are advised to take {folate} supplements daily.
e.zh: 医生建议孕妇每天补充叶酸。

e.en: Leafy greens are an excellent source of {folate}.
e.zh: 绿叶蔬菜是叶酸的绝佳来源。

fold.t:
v. 折叠
n. 褶；羊圈

e.en: Please {fold} the laundry and put it away.
e.zh: 请把洗好的衣服叠好收起来。

e.en: The startup had to {fold} after running out of cash.
e.zh: 那家初创公司因资金耗尽不得不倒闭。

foldable.t: adj. 可折叠的（如折叠屏手机）

e.en: Samsung released a new {foldable} phone last week.
e.zh: 三星上周发布了一款新的折叠屏手机。

e.en: This {foldable} chair fits easily in the trunk.
e.zh: 这把折叠椅能轻松塞进后备箱。

folded.t:
adj. 折叠的
v. fold 的过去式

e.en: She {folded} the letter and slipped it into an envelope.
e.zh: 她把信折好,塞进了信封。

e.en: He {folded} his arms and waited for an answer.
e.zh: 他抱起双臂,等着对方回答。

e.en: Drag the file into the {folder} on your desktop.
e.zh: 把文件拖到桌面上的那个文件夹里。

e.en: She kept all the contracts in a red {folder}.
e.zh: 她把所有合同都放在一个红色文件夹里。

e.en: Cut out the {folderol} and tell me the actual plan.
e.zh: 别废话连篇了,直接告诉我真正的计划。

e.en: The ceremony was full of pointless pomp and {folderol}.
e.zh: 整场典礼充满了毫无意义的繁文缛节。

folders.t: n. folder 的复数，文件夹

e.en: Organize your photos into {folders} by year and event.
e.zh: 把照片按年份和活动分到不同文件夹里。

e.en: The desk drawer overflowed with old paper {folders}.
e.zh: 抽屉里塞满了旧的纸质文件夹。

folding.t:
adj. 折叠的
n. 折叠

e.en: He's {folding} clothes while watching a movie.
e.zh: 他一边看电影一边叠衣服。

e.en: The {folding} table is perfect for small apartments.
e.zh: 这张折叠桌很适合小户型公寓。

folds.t:
v. fold 的第三人称单数
n. 褶皱（复数）

e.en: She carefully {folds} every shirt before putting it away.
e.zh: 她每件衬衫都仔细叠好再收起来。

e.en: The curtain hung in soft {folds} by the window.
e.zh: 窗边的窗帘垂下柔和的褶皱。

e.en: The {foley} artist created footsteps using coconut shells.
e.zh: 拟音师用椰子壳模拟出脚步声。

e.en: Good {foley} work makes a movie feel much more real.
e.zh: 出色的拟音让电影显得更加真实。

e.en: Autumn {foliage} in Vermont attracts thousands of visitors each year.
e.zh: 佛蒙特州的秋叶每年吸引数千名游客。

e.en: Dense {foliage} hid the cabin from the road.
e.zh: 茂密的枝叶把小屋从公路上挡得看不见。

folic.t: adj. 叶酸的（folic acid 叶酸）

e.en: Doctors recommend {folic} acid before and during pregnancy.
e.zh: 医生建议在孕前和孕期补充叶酸。

e.en: This cereal is fortified with iron and {folic} acid.
e.zh: 这款麦片强化添加了铁和叶酸。

e.en: Their shared paranoia became a classic {folie} à deux.
e.zh: 他们共有的妄想成了典型的二联性精神病。

e.en: Psychiatrists discussed the rare {folie} between the twin sisters.
e.zh: 精神科医生讨论了这对双胞胎姐妹间罕见的共有妄想。

e.en: The library displayed a rare Shakespeare {folio} from 1623.
e.zh: 图书馆展出了一本 1623 年的莎士比亚珍本对开本。

e.en: Each {folio} of the manuscript was carefully numbered.
e.zh: 手稿的每一对开页都被仔细编了号。

folk.t:
n. 人们；民俗
adj. 民间的

e.en: Country {folk} often gather at the diner on Sundays.
e.zh: 乡下人常在周日聚到那家小餐馆。

e.en: She plays {folk} music at coffee shops on weekends.
e.zh: 她周末在咖啡馆演奏民谣音乐。

folkestone.t: n. 福克斯通（英国城市）

e.en: We took the train from London to {folkestone} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐火车从伦敦去福克斯通过周末。

e.en: {folkestone} sits on the southern coast of England.
e.zh: 福克斯通位于英格兰南海岸。

e.en: My uncle is an old-school {folkie} who plays acoustic gigs.
e.zh: 我叔叔是个老派民谣歌手，常去弹原声吉他演出。

e.en: The café hosts {folkie} singers every Thursday night.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆每周四晚都会请民谣歌手驻唱。

e.en: Japanese {folklore} is full of mischievous fox spirits.
e.zh: 日本民间传说里满是调皮的狐妖。

e.en: That bug has become office {folklore} at this point.
e.zh: 那个 bug 现在已经成了办公室的传奇故事。

folkloric.t: adj. 民俗的，民间传说的

e.en: The dancers wore {folkloric} costumes from rural Mexico.
e.zh: 舞者们穿着墨西哥乡村的传统民俗服饰。

e.en: Her paintings draw on {folkloric} themes from Eastern Europe.
e.zh: 她的画作取材于东欧的民俗题材。

e.en: The {folklorist} spent years recording stories in remote villages.
e.zh: 这位民俗学家花了多年时间在偏远村庄采集故事。

e.en: A respected {folklorist} edited the new fairy tale anthology.
e.zh: 一位德高望重的民俗学家编纂了这部新童话集。

e.en: The novel has a strong {folkloristic} flavor throughout.
e.zh: 这部小说通篇充满浓厚的民俗色彩。

e.en: Her thesis takes a {folkloristic} approach to internet memes.
e.zh: 她的论文用民俗学视角来研究网络梗。

e.en: Hey {folks}, thanks for joining the livestream tonight!
e.zh: 嘿，各位，谢谢你们来看今晚的直播！

e.en: My {folks} are visiting from out of town this weekend.
e.zh: 我爸妈这周末从外地过来看我。

e.en: She closed the show with a Scottish {folksong}.
e.zh: 她以一首苏格兰民谣结束了演出。

e.en: Every child in the village knows that {folksong} by heart.
e.zh: 村里每个孩子都能把那首民歌倒背如流。

folksy.t: adj. 朴实亲切的；乡土的

e.en: The senator has a {folksy} charm that voters love.
e.zh: 那位参议员有种亲民的魅力，选民很买账。

e.en: The diner's {folksy} decor makes you feel right at home.
e.zh: 那家小餐馆的乡土风装潢让人很有家的感觉。

e.en: My grandma told me a {folktale} about a clever rabbit.
e.zh: 奶奶给我讲了一个聪明兔子的民间故事。

e.en: The film is loosely based on a Korean {folktale}.
e.zh: 这部电影松散地改编自一则韩国民间故事。

folktales.t: n. folktale 的复数，民间故事

e.en: African {folktales} often feature talking animals as moral teachers.
e.zh: 非洲民间故事里常有会说话的动物充当道德导师。

e.en: She collected {folktales} from her grandmother and published them.
e.zh: 她把奶奶讲的民间故事收集起来出版了。

e.en: Anthropologists study the {folkways} of small island communities.
e.zh: 人类学家研究小岛社区的民俗习惯。

e.en: Modern life is slowly erasing the old village {folkways}.
e.zh: 现代生活正在慢慢抹去古老的村庄风俗。

e.en: Her new album has a warm, {folky} acoustic vibe.
e.zh: 她的新专辑有种温暖的民谣原声感。

e.en: The wedding band played {folky} versions of pop hits.
e.zh: 婚礼乐队把流行金曲改编成了民谣风。

e.en: Each hair grows from a tiny {follicle} in the skin.
e.zh: 每根头发都从皮肤里的一个小毛囊长出来。

e.en: The treatment claims to stimulate every dormant hair {follicle}.
e.zh: 这款产品声称能唤醒每一个休眠的毛囊。

e.en: The dermatologist diagnosed a mild case of {follicular} inflammation.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生诊断说是轻度的毛囊炎症。

e.en: Egg quality drops sharply in the late {follicular} phase.
e.zh: 卵子质量在卵泡期后段会明显下降。

e.en: Hot tub {folliculitis} can appear a day after swimming.
e.zh: 泡热水浴池后一天可能会出现毛囊炎。

e.en: Shaving too aggressively often leads to {folliculitis} on the neck.
e.zh: 刮胡子太猛常常会让脖子长毛囊炎。

follies.t: n. folly 的复数，蠢事；歌舞剧

e.en: Looking back, my college {follies} make me laugh and cringe.
e.zh: 回头看，我大学时干的傻事让我又笑又尴尬。

e.en: The book chronicles the {follies} of Wall Street in the 90s.
e.zh: 这本书记录了九十年代华尔街的种种荒唐事。

follow.t: v. 关注（账号）；跟随；遵循

e.en: You can {follow} her on Instagram for daily recipes.
e.zh: 你可以在 Instagram 上关注她，每天看食谱。

e.en: Just {follow} the signs to the parking lot.
e.zh: 顺着指示牌走就能到停车场。

followed.t: v. follow 的过去式，已关注；跟随

e.en: The dog {followed} me all the way home from the park.
e.zh: 那只狗从公园一路跟着我回了家。

e.en: A long silence {followed} her surprising announcement.
e.zh: 她惊人的宣布之后是一段长长的沉默。

follower.t: n. 粉丝，关注者；追随者

e.en: He's a loyal {follower} of every new tech podcast.
e.zh: 每出一档新科技播客他都忠实追听。

e.en: She gained another thousand {follower} count overnight.
e.zh: 她一夜之间又涨了一千个粉丝。

e.en: The influencer has over two million {followers} on TikTok.
e.zh: 那位网红在 TikTok 上有两百多万粉丝。

e.en: His {followers} hung on every word of his speech.
e.zh: 他的追随者们把他演讲的每一个字都听进了心里。

following.t:
n. 关注列表；追随者
adj. 接下来的

e.en: The band built a huge {following} during their tour.
e.zh: 那支乐队在巡演期间积累了大批粉丝。

e.en: We'll discuss the {following} topics in tomorrow's meeting.
e.zh: 明天的会议我们会讨论以下几个议题。

e.en: Both streamers have built loyal {followings} over the years.
e.zh: 这两位主播多年来都积累了忠实的粉丝群。

e.en: Niche podcasts often have small but passionate {followings}.
e.zh: 小众播客往往拥有人数不多但极度热情的粉丝群。

e.en: My cat {follows} me into every room of the house.
e.zh: 我家的猫不管我走到哪个房间都会跟着。

e.en: It {follows} that we'll need a bigger budget next year.
e.zh: 由此可以推出，明年我们需要更高的预算。

e.en: Investing your savings in that scam was sheer {folly}.
e.zh: 把积蓄投到那个骗局里完全是愚蠢之举。

e.en: It would be {folly} to ignore the safety warnings.
e.zh: 无视安全警告将是愚蠢的行为。

foment.t: v. 煽动；助长（不良情绪）

e.en: The article was written to {foment} anger online.
e.zh: 这篇文章就是为了在网上煽动愤怒而写的。

e.en: Outside groups tried to {foment} unrest in the city.
e.zh: 外部势力试图在这座城市煽动动乱。

e.en: The {Fon} people are one of the largest groups in Benin.
e.zh: 丰族是贝宁最大的族群之一。

e.en: She's learning {Fon} to talk with her grandparents.
e.zh: 她在学丰语，好跟祖父母聊天。

e.en: I'm really {fond} of my neighbor's golden retriever.
e.zh: 我特别喜欢邻居家那只金毛犬。

e.en: She has {fond} memories of summers at the lake.
e.zh: 她对在湖边度过的那些夏天怀有美好的回忆。

e.en: The wedding cake was covered in smooth white {fondant}.
e.zh: 婚礼蛋糕外面裹着一层光滑的白色翻糖。

e.en: Rolling {fondant} evenly takes a lot of practice.
e.zh: 把翻糖擀得均匀需要大量练习。

e.en: He likes to {fondle} the cat's ears while watching TV.
e.zh: 他看电视时喜欢轻轻摸猫的耳朵。

e.en: She would {fondle} the locket whenever she missed him.
e.zh: 每当想念他时，她就会摩挲那枚小盒坠。

fondling.t:
n. 爱抚
v. 抚摸（fondle 的现在分词）

e.en: The puppy enjoys being {fondling} of soft toys all day.
e.zh: 那只小狗整天都喜欢摆弄各种毛绒玩具。

e.en: She sat on the porch, {fondling} the old wedding ring.
e.zh: 她坐在门廊上，摩挲着那枚旧婚戒。

e.en: He {fondly} remembered the summers at his grandparents' farm.
e.zh: 他深情地回忆起在祖父母农场度过的那些夏天。

e.en: She smiled {fondly} at her sleeping baby.
e.zh: 她温柔地朝熟睡的宝宝微笑。

e.en: He has a real {fondness} for old jazz records.
e.zh: 他对老爵士唱片有种由衷的喜爱。

e.en: Her {fondness} for stray cats is well known in the building.
e.zh: 她爱护流浪猫的事在整栋楼里人尽皆知。

e.en: His many {fondnesses} include vintage pens and rare teas.
e.zh: 他的众多嗜好包括古董钢笔和稀有茶叶。

e.en: We all have small {fondnesses} that comfort us in hard times.
e.zh: 我们都有些小喜好，在艰难时刻给自己带来安慰。

fondue.t: n. 芝士火锅；奶酪火锅

e.en: We dipped bread cubes into the bubbling cheese {fondue}.
e.zh: 我们把面包块蘸进咕嘟冒泡的芝士火锅里。

e.en: Chocolate {fondue} is the perfect dessert for a date night.
e.zh: 巧克力火锅是约会之夜的完美甜点。

e.en: Please change the {font} to something more readable.
e.zh: 请把字体换成更容易阅读的那种。

e.en: Designers often debate the merits of every new {font}.
e.zh: 设计师们常常争论每款新字体的优劣。

fontainebleau.t: n. 枫丹白露（法国地名）

e.en: We spent a lazy afternoon walking the gardens of {Fontainebleau}.
e.zh: 我们悠闲地在枫丹白露的花园里走了一下午。

e.en: The kings of France often hunted in the forest of {Fontainebleau}.
e.zh: 法国国王们常常在枫丹白露森林里打猎。

e.en: Tourists toss coins into the {Fontana} di Trevi for luck.
e.zh: 游客们往特雷维喷泉里投硬币祈求好运。

e.en: The square is dominated by a baroque {fontana} from 1650.
e.zh: 广场中央矗立着一座 1650 年的巴洛克喷泉。

fontina.t: n. 芳堤娜奶酪（意大利奶酪）

e.en: Melted {fontina} makes the best gooey grilled cheese.
e.zh: 融化的芳提娜奶酪能做出最拉丝的烤奶酪三明治。

e.en: The recipe calls for a quarter pound of Italian {fontina}.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要四分之一磅的意大利芳提娜奶酪。

foo.t: n. 示例占位符（编程用）

e.en: In the example, just replace {foo} with your variable name.
e.zh: 在示例里，把 foo 替换成你自己的变量名就行。

e.en: The tutorial uses {foo} and bar as placeholder values.
e.zh: 这个教程用 foo 和 bar 作为占位符。

e.en: Street {food} in Bangkok is some of the best in Asia.
e.zh: 曼谷的街头小吃是亚洲最棒的之一。

e.en: Don't forget to bring {food} for the hike tomorrow.
e.zh: 别忘了明天徒步要带吃的。

foodborne.t: adj. 食源性的（经食物传播的）

e.en: Undercooked chicken is a common source of {foodborne} illness.
e.zh: 没煮熟的鸡肉是常见的食源性疾病来源。

e.en: The CDC tracks outbreaks of {foodborne} bacteria every year.
e.zh: 美国疾控中心每年都会追踪食源性细菌的爆发情况。

e.en: My sister is a total {foodie} who reviews every restaurant.
e.zh: 我妹妹是个十足的吃货，每家餐厅都要点评一番。

e.en: Lisbon has become a hot destination for serious {foodie} travelers.
e.zh: 里斯本已经成了资深美食旅行者的热门目的地。

e.en: Rice is the most important {foodstuff} in many Asian countries.
e.zh: 在许多亚洲国家，大米是最重要的食品。

e.en: The aid trucks carried medicine and basic {foodstuff} supplies.
e.zh: 救援卡车载着药品和基本的食品物资。

fool.t:
n. 傻瓜
v. 欺骗；愚弄

e.en: Don't let his calm voice {fool} you about his temper.
e.zh: 别让他平静的语气骗了你，他脾气其实很大。

e.en: I felt like a complete {fool} after sending that email.
e.zh: 发完那封邮件后，我觉得自己像个彻头彻尾的傻瓜。

fooled.t: v. 被欺骗；被愚弄（fool 过去式）

e.en: The deepfake video {fooled} thousands of viewers online.
e.zh: 那段深度伪造视频骗倒了网上成千上万的观众。

e.en: Don't be {fooled} by the cheap price — quality matters.
e.zh: 别被低价骗了，质量才是关键。

e.en: His {foolhardiness} on the climb nearly cost him his life.
e.zh: 他攀登时的莽撞差点让他丢了命。

e.en: There's a fine line between courage and pure {foolhardiness}.
e.zh: 勇敢和纯粹的鲁莽之间只有一线之隔。

foolhardy.t: adj. 鲁莽的；有勇无谋的

e.en: It would be {foolhardy} to drive in this blizzard.
e.zh: 在这种暴风雪里开车简直是莽撞行事。

e.en: His {foolhardy} stunts get millions of views on YouTube.
e.zh: 他那些莽撞的特技在 YouTube 上有上百万播放量。

fooling.t: v. 戏弄；胡闹（fool 的现在分词）

e.en: Stop {fooling} around and finish your homework, please.
e.zh: 别再瞎闹了，赶紧把作业写完。

e.en: You're only {fooling} yourself if you ignore the warning signs.
e.zh: 无视这些警示信号，你只是在自欺欺人。

e.en: It was {foolish} of me to lend him the car keys.
e.zh: 我把车钥匙借给他实在是太蠢了。

e.en: Don't make a {foolish} decision when you're this tired.
e.zh: 这么累的时候别做出愚蠢的决定。

e.en: I {foolishly} clicked the link and got my account hacked.
e.zh: 我傻乎乎地点了那个链接，结果账号被盗了。

e.en: She {foolishly} agreed to help him move on a Sunday.
e.zh: 她傻傻地答应在周日帮他搬家。

e.en: His {foolishness} cost the company a major client.
e.zh: 他的愚蠢让公司失去了一个重要客户。

e.en: There's a fine line between bravery and {foolishness}.
e.zh: 勇敢与愚蠢之间只有一线之隔。

foolproof.t: adj. 傻瓜式的；万无一失的

e.en: This recipe is {foolproof} even for beginners.
e.zh: 这个食谱连新手都能轻松做好。

e.en: No security system is completely {foolproof}.
e.zh: 没有任何安保系统是绝对万无一失的。

fools.t:
n. 傻瓜们
v. 愚弄（fool 的三单）

e.en: Only {fools} ignore safety warnings on the trail.
e.zh: 只有傻瓜才会忽视步道上的安全警告。

e.en: The clever scam {fools} even experienced investors.
e.zh: 这个高明的骗局连经验丰富的投资者都骗过了。

foolscap.t: n. 大页书写纸（一种纸张规格）

e.en: He drafted the letter on a sheet of {foolscap}.
e.zh: 他在一张大页书写纸上起草了那封信。

e.en: Old offices kept stacks of {foolscap} for handwritten notes.
e.zh: 旧办公室会备着成堆的大页纸用来手写笔记。

e.en: We played {foosball} during the lunch break at work.
e.zh: 午休时我们在公司玩了桌上足球。

e.en: The bar has a {foosball} table near the entrance.
e.zh: 那家酒吧入口附近摆着一台桌上足球。

e.en: She hurt her {foot} while running yesterday morning.
e.zh: 她昨天早上跑步时弄伤了脚。

e.en: The cat sleeps at the {foot} of my bed.
e.zh: 那只猫睡在我床尾。

footage.t: n. 影片片段；录像素材

e.en: The security camera captured clear {footage} of the incident.
e.zh: 监控摄像头拍下了事件的清晰画面。

e.en: She edited hours of {footage} into a short film.
e.zh: 她把几小时的素材剪成了一部短片。

footages.t: n. 影像素材（footage 复数）

e.en: The documentary combined rare {footages} from several archives.
e.zh: 这部纪录片汇集了多个档案馆的珍贵影像资料。

e.en: News teams shared {footages} of the rescue operation.
e.zh: 新闻团队互相分享了救援行动的影像资料。

e.en: My brother plays {football} every Saturday afternoon.
e.zh: 我弟弟每周六下午都踢足球。

e.en: Millions watched the {football} final on TV.
e.zh: 数百万人在电视上观看了那场足球决赛。

e.en: He dreams of becoming a professional {footballer} one day.
e.zh: 他梦想有一天成为职业足球运动员。

e.en: The young {footballer} signed with a top European club.
e.zh: 那位年轻足球运动员与欧洲顶级俱乐部签了约。

e.en: Top {footballers} earn millions in salary and endorsements.
e.zh: 顶级足球运动员通过薪资和代言赚取数百万。

e.en: Several {footballers} were injured during the rough match.
e.zh: 几名足球运动员在那场激烈的比赛中受了伤。

footballing.t:
adj. 足球的
n. 踢足球

e.en: He had a long and successful {footballing} career.
e.zh: 他有着漫长而成功的足球生涯。

e.en: Brazil is famous for its {footballing} talent worldwide.
e.zh: 巴西以其闻名世界的足球人才著称。

e.en: The coach brought a bag of {footballs} to practice.
e.zh: 教练带了一袋足球来训练。

e.en: Kids kicked {footballs} around the park all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在公园里踢足球。

e.en: The antique bed has a carved wooden {footboard}.
e.zh: 那张古董床有一块雕花木质床尾板。

e.en: She hung a blanket over the {footboard} for warmth.
e.zh: 她把毯子搭在床尾板上以保暖。

e.en: We crossed the wooden {footbridge} over the stream.
e.zh: 我们走过那座跨越溪流的木制人行桥。

e.en: The narrow {footbridge} sways slightly in strong winds.
e.zh: 那座狭窄的人行桥在大风中会轻微摇晃。

footed.t: adj. 有脚的（常用于复合词）

e.en: The cat is remarkably sure-{footed} on the narrow ledge.
e.zh: 那只猫在窄窄的窗台上脚步异常稳健。

e.en: She bought a four-{footed} stool for the kitchen.
e.zh: 她为厨房买了一张四脚凳。

e.en: Add the copyright notice to the page {footer}.
e.zh: 把版权声明加到页脚里。

e.en: The website's {footer} contains links to privacy policies.
e.zh: 该网站的页脚包含隐私政策的链接。

forces.t:
n. 力量；武装力量
v. 强迫（force 的变形）

e.en: Gravity {forces} all objects to fall toward the ground.
e.zh: 重力迫使所有物体向地面坠落。

e.en: Allied {forces} landed on the beach at dawn.
e.zh: 盟军部队在拂晓时分登陆海滩。

e.en: Police made a {forcible} entry into the apartment.
e.zh: 警方强行进入了那间公寓。

e.en: The judge ruled against the {forcible} eviction of tenants.
e.zh: 法官裁定不允许强制驱逐租户。

e.en: Protesters were {forcibly} removed from the building.
e.zh: 抗议者被强行带离大楼。

e.en: He was {forcibly} reminded of his earlier promise.
e.zh: 他被强烈地提醒起自己先前的承诺。

forcing.t:
v. 强迫（force 的现在分词）
n. 促成；催熟

e.en: The deadline is {forcing} the team to work weekends.
e.zh: 截止日期迫使团队在周末加班。

e.en: Stop {forcing} that puzzle piece — it doesn't fit.
e.zh: 别再硬塞那块拼图了,它根本不合适。

ford.t:
n. 浅滩；可涉水而过处
v. 涉水而过

e.en: The hikers had to {ford} a shallow stream.
e.zh: 徒步者不得不涉水穿过一条浅溪。

e.en: He drives an old blue {Ford} pickup truck.
e.zh: 他开着一辆蓝色的老式福特皮卡。

fordham.t: n. 福特汉姆（姓氏或地名）

e.en: She earned her law degree at {Fordham} University.
e.zh: 她在福特汉姆大学获得了法学学位。

e.en: The basketball game was held on the {Fordham} campus.
e.zh: 那场篮球赛在福特汉姆大学校园举行。

fore.t:
adj. 前部的；船首的
adv. 在前

e.en: Climate change has come to the {fore} in recent debates.
e.zh: 气候变化在近期的辩论中变得突出起来。

e.en: The golfer shouted '{fore}!' before swinging hard.
e.zh: 那位高尔夫球手用力挥杆前喊了一声“fore”。

forearm.t:
n. 前臂
v. 预先武装

e.en: He has a colorful tattoo on his left {forearm}.
e.zh: 他左前臂上有一幅彩色纹身。

e.en: She rested her {forearm} on the table while typing.
e.zh: 她打字时把前臂搁在桌上。

forearmed.t: adj. 预先武装的；有所准备的

e.en: Forewarned is {forearmed} when negotiating a salary.
e.zh: 在谈薪资时,有所预警就是有所准备。

e.en: The team felt {forearmed} after studying the rival's tactics.
e.zh: 研究过对手的战术后,球队感到已有备而来。

e.en: His {forebear} emigrated from Ireland in the 1800s.
e.zh: 他的祖先在十九世纪从爱尔兰移民而来。

e.en: Many of her {forebears} were skilled craftsmen.
e.zh: 她的许多祖辈都是技艺精湛的工匠。

forebode.t: v. 预示；预感（不祥之事）

e.en: Dark clouds {forebode} a heavy thunderstorm tonight.
e.zh: 乌云预示着今晚有一场大雷雨。

e.en: The silence seemed to {forebode} bad news.
e.zh: 那阵沉默似乎预示着坏消息。

foreboding.t:
n. 不祥的预感
adj. 预示不祥的

e.en: She had a strong {foreboding} that something was wrong.
e.zh: 她强烈预感到事情有些不对劲。

e.en: The {foreboding} music made the scene truly terrifying.
e.zh: 那段不祥的音乐让场景显得格外惊悚。

e.en: The {forebrain} controls thinking, planning, and decision-making.
e.zh: 前脑负责思考、规划和决策。

e.en: Damage to the {forebrain} can affect personality and memory.
e.zh: 前脑受损可能影响人格与记忆。

forecast.t:
n. 预报；预测
v. 预测；预报

e.en: The weather {forecast} predicts heavy snow tomorrow.
e.zh: 天气预报预测明天将有大雪。

e.en: Analysts {forecast} steady growth for the tech sector.
e.zh: 分析师预测科技行业将保持稳定增长。

forecasted.t: v. 预测（forecast 的过去式）

e.en: Economists {forecasted} a mild recession next quarter.
e.zh: 经济学家预测下个季度会出现温和衰退。

e.en: Sales were higher than the team had {forecasted}.
e.zh: 销售业绩高于团队此前的预测。

e.en: The TV {forecaster} warned of dangerous icy roads.
e.zh: 电视气象预报员警告道路结冰非常危险。

e.en: A senior {forecaster} reviewed the company's quarterly outlook.
e.zh: 一位资深预测分析师审阅了公司的季度展望。

forecasting.t:
n. 预测；预报
v. 预测（进行时）

e.en: Modern {forecasting} relies heavily on machine learning models.
e.zh: 现代预测在很大程度上依赖机器学习模型。

e.en: She specializes in {forecasting} consumer demand for retailers.
e.zh: 她专长于为零售商预测消费者需求。

forecasts.t:
n. 预报（复数）
v. 预测（第三人称单数）

e.en: The latest sales {forecasts} look surprisingly optimistic.
e.zh: 最新的销售预测显得出奇地乐观。

e.en: He {forecasts} record temperatures across the southern states.
e.zh: 他预测南部各州将出现创纪录的高温。

foreclose.t: v. 取消抵押品赎回权；排除

e.en: The bank may {foreclose} if payments aren't made soon.
e.zh: 如果不尽快还款,银行可能会取消房屋赎回权。

e.en: Strict rules can {foreclose} creative solutions to the problem.
e.zh: 严格的规则可能会扼杀解决问题的创新方案。

foreclosed.t: v. 已取消赎回权（过去式）

e.en: The {foreclosed} home sold for half its original price.
e.zh: 那栋被止赎的房子以原价的一半售出。

e.en: The bank {foreclosed} on the property after months of arrears.
e.zh: 在拖欠数月后,银行收回了这处房产。

foreclosure.t: n. 取消抵押品赎回权；止赎

e.en: Many families lost their homes during the {foreclosure} crisis.
e.zh: 许多家庭在止赎危机中失去了房屋。

e.en: He worked with a lawyer to avoid {foreclosure}.
e.zh: 他请律师协助以避免被取消赎回权。

forecourt.t: n. 前院；前场（球场靠网区域）

e.en: Cars lined the {forecourt} of the busy gas station.
e.zh: 汽车排满了繁忙加油站的前场。

e.en: Guests gathered in the hotel's marble {forecourt}.
e.zh: 宾客聚集在酒店的大理石前庭。

e.en: Sailors gathered on the {foredeck} to watch the sunrise.
e.zh: 水手们聚在前甲板上观看日出。

e.en: Heavy waves crashed over the ship's {foredeck}.
e.zh: 巨浪一次次拍打着船的前甲板。

e.en: His {forefather} fought in the American Revolution.
e.zh: 他的先祖曾参加过美国独立战争。

e.en: We honor the {forefathers} who built this nation.
e.zh: 我们缅怀那些缔造这个国家的先辈们。

e.en: She pointed at the screen with her {forefinger}.
e.zh: 她用食指指着屏幕。

e.en: He tapped his {forefinger} nervously on the desk.
e.zh: 他紧张地用食指敲着桌面。

forefoot.t: n. (动物) 前脚；(人) 前脚掌

e.en: The horse injured its {forefoot} during the race.
e.zh: 那匹马在比赛中前蹄受了伤。

e.en: Runners often land on the {forefoot} for speed.
e.zh: 跑者为了提速常常用前脚掌着地。

e.en: The startup is at the {forefront} of AI research.
e.zh: 这家初创公司处于人工智能研究的前沿。

e.en: Climate concerns moved to the {forefront} of the campaign.
e.zh: 气候问题成为这次竞选活动的核心议题。

e.en: Old friends {foregather} every summer at the lake house.
e.zh: 老朋友们每年夏天都在湖边小屋相聚。

e.en: Scholars {foregather} in Paris for the annual conference.
e.zh: 学者们每年聚集在巴黎参加年会。

e.en: I'll {forego} dessert to save room for coffee.
e.zh: 我打算不吃甜点,留点空间喝咖啡。

e.en: She chose to {forego} a vacation and finish the project.
e.zh: 她选择放弃假期,先把项目完成。

foregoing.t: adj. 前面提到的；上述的

e.en: The {foregoing} examples illustrate the main argument well.
e.zh: 上述例子很好地说明了核心论点。

e.en: Please review the {foregoing} sections before signing the contract.
e.zh: 签合同前请先审阅前述各节内容。

foregone.t: adj. 既定的；预料之中的

e.en: His promotion seemed a {foregone} conclusion to everyone.
e.zh: 他的晋升在大家看来已是板上钉钉的事。

e.en: The election outcome was a {foregone} conclusion by midnight.
e.zh: 到午夜时分,选举结果已成定局。

foreground.t:
n. (图像) 前景
v. 突出；强调

e.en: A red flower stands out in the {foreground} of the photo.
e.zh: 照片前景中一朵红花格外醒目。

e.en: The app keeps music playing even when not in the {foreground}.
e.zh: 即便不在前台,这款应用仍能持续播放音乐。

e.en: The documentary {foregrounded} the voices of young activists.
e.zh: 这部纪录片着重突出了年轻活动家的声音。

e.en: Her essay {foregrounded} issues that others had ignored.
e.zh: 她的文章把别人忽视的问题摆在了首要位置。

foregrounding.t:
v. 使居前景；突出（进行时）
n. 前景化

e.en: The film keeps {foregrounding} the cost of war on ordinary families.
e.zh: 这部电影不断突出战争给普通家庭带来的代价。

e.en: By {foregrounding} accessibility, the redesign helped many more users.
e.zh: 通过把无障碍性放在首位，改版让更多用户受益。

forehand.t:
n. (网球等) 正手击球
adj. 正手的

e.en: Her {forehand} down the line won the match point.
e.zh: 她沿边线的正手球赢得了赛点。

e.en: The coach said my {forehand} needs more topspin.
e.zh: 教练说我的正手击球需要更多的上旋。

e.en: She pressed a cool cloth against his {forehead}.
e.zh: 她把一块凉毛巾贴在他的额头上。

e.en: Sweat dripped from his {forehead} during the long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步时汗水从他额头滴落。

e.en: The kids had paint smeared across their {foreheads}.
e.zh: 孩子们的额头上都涂满了颜料。

e.en: Both runners wiped their {foreheads} at the finish line.
e.zh: 两位选手在终点都擦了擦额头。

e.en: She speaks four {foreign} languages fluently.
e.zh: 她能流利地讲四门外语。

e.en: The concept of tipping feels {foreign} to many travelers.
e.zh: 对许多游客来说，给小费的习惯很陌生。

e.en: As a {foreigner}, I needed a visa to work here.
e.zh: 作为外国人，我需要签证才能在这里工作。

e.en: The shopkeeper smiled warmly at the {foreigner}.
e.zh: 店主对那位外国人热情地笑了笑。

e.en: Many {foreigners} visit Kyoto during cherry blossom season.
e.zh: 樱花季有很多外国人来京都旅游。

e.en: The app helps {foreigners} navigate the local subway system.
e.zh: 这款应用帮助外国人使用本地地铁系统。

e.en: The {foreignness} of the city slowly faded as she settled in.
e.zh: 随着她逐渐适应，这座城市的陌生感慢慢消退了。

e.en: His accent gave a charming {foreignness} to every word.
e.zh: 他的口音让每个词都带着一种迷人的异域感。

e.en: He denied any {foreknowledge} of the planned attack.
e.zh: 他否认事先知道任何袭击计划。

e.en: With {foreknowledge} of the storm, we secured the boat.
e.zh: 由于事先知道风暴要来，我们把船固定好了。

e.en: Sheep graze peacefully on the windy {foreland}.
e.zh: 羊群在多风的岬角上安静地吃草。

e.en: A lighthouse stands at the tip of the rocky {foreland}.
e.zh: 一座灯塔矗立在岩石海角的尖端。

e.en: The horse injured its right {foreleg} during the race.
e.zh: 那匹马在比赛中右前腿受了伤。

e.en: The puppy lifted its {foreleg} to shake hands.
e.zh: 小狗抬起前腿来握手。

e.en: Birds evolved wings from the same {forelimb} bones as other vertebrates.
e.zh: 鸟类的翅膀由与其他脊椎动物相同的前肢骨演化而来。

e.en: The fossil shows a clearly preserved {forelimb} structure.
e.zh: 这块化石清晰地保存了前肢的结构。

forelock.t: n. 额前的头发；马额毛

e.en: He brushed a stray {forelock} away from his eyes.
e.zh: 他把一缕散落的额发从眼前拂开。

e.en: The pony's white {forelock} fell over its face.
e.zh: 小马的白色额毛垂在脸上。

foreman.t: n. 工头；领班；陪审团主席

e.en: The {foreman} signaled the crew to take a lunch break.
e.zh: 工头示意工人们去吃午饭。

e.en: The jury {foreman} read the verdict aloud in court.
e.zh: 陪审团团长在法庭上宣读了判决。

e.en: A sailor climbed the {foremast} to repair the rigging.
e.zh: 一名水手爬上前桅去修理索具。

e.en: Lightning struck the {foremast} during the violent storm.
e.zh: 猛烈的风暴中闪电击中了前桅。

e.en: The construction {foremen} met every Monday to coordinate schedules.
e.zh: 工地上的工头每周一开会协调进度。

e.en: Two factory {foremen} were promoted to plant managers.
e.zh: 两位工厂工头被提拔为厂长。

e.en: The mall reported lower {footfall} during the rainy season.
e.zh: 商场报告称雨季期间客流量下降。

e.en: She heard a soft {footfall} in the hallway.
e.zh: 她听见走廊里传来轻轻的脚步声。

e.en: Proper {footgear} is essential for hiking rough terrain.
e.zh: 在崎岖地形徒步时,合适的鞋具至关重要。

e.en: The store sells specialized {footgear} for winter sports.
e.zh: 这家店销售冬季运动专用鞋具。

e.en: Their cabin sits in the {foothill} of the Rockies.
e.zh: 他们的小木屋坐落在落基山脉的山麓。

e.en: We hiked through the green {foothill} trails all morning.
e.zh: 我们整个上午都在翠绿的山麓小径上徒步。

e.en: The startup gained a {foothold} in the Asian market.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在亚洲市场站稳了脚跟。

e.en: The climber searched for a secure {foothold} on the rock.
e.zh: 攀岩者在岩石上寻找牢固的落脚点。

e.en: She lost her {footing} on the icy steps.
e.zh: 她在结冰的台阶上失足滑倒。

e.en: The two companies now compete on equal {footing}.
e.zh: 这两家公司如今在平等的基础上竞争。

e.en: Stop {footle} around and finish your homework.
e.zh: 别再瞎混了,快把作业做完。

e.en: He tends to {footle} away weekends watching old movies.
e.zh: 他周末总爱无所事事地看老电影。

e.en: The actress stepped into the glow of the {footlight}.
e.zh: 那位女演员走入舞台脚灯的光晕中。

e.en: A single {footlight} illuminated the dancer's silhouette.
e.zh: 一盏脚灯映出舞者的剪影。

e.en: He stored his uniform neatly in the {footlocker}.
e.zh: 他把制服整齐地放进床尾的储物箱里。

e.en: Each recruit was issued a metal {footlocker} for belongings.
e.zh: 每名新兵都领到一个金属储物箱来装个人物品。

footloose.t: adj. 自由自在的；无拘无束的

e.en: After graduation she felt {footloose} and ready to travel.
e.zh: 毕业后她感到无拘无束,准备去旅行。

e.en: He lived a {footloose} life backpacking across Europe.
e.zh: 他背包游欧洲,过着自由自在的生活。

e.en: A {footman} in livery opened the carriage door.
e.zh: 一位身穿制服的男仆打开了马车的门。

e.en: The duke employed a {footman} to greet his guests.
e.zh: 公爵雇了一名男仆来迎接他的客人。

e.en: A muddy {footmark} on the carpet revealed the intruder.
e.zh: 地毯上一个泥泞的脚印暴露了入侵者。

e.en: She spotted a small {footmark} on the freshly waxed floor.
e.zh: 她在刚打过蜡的地板上发现了一个小脚印。

footnote.t:
n. 脚注
v. 给…加脚注

e.en: He added a {footnote} to clarify the original source.
e.zh: 他加了一个脚注来说明原始出处。

e.en: The scandal became a mere {footnote} in history.
e.zh: 那场丑闻只成了历史上一个小小的注脚。

e.en: Academic papers usually require detailed {footnotes} for every citation.
e.zh: 学术论文通常要求每条引用都有详细的脚注。

e.en: The book's {footnotes} take up half of each page.
e.zh: 这本书的脚注占了每页一半的篇幅。

footpad.t: n. 徒步拦路抢劫的强盗

e.en: A {footpad} once robbed travelers along this dark road.
e.zh: 过去曾有拦路抢劫犯在这条黑暗的路上抢劫旅人。

e.en: The old novel features a daring {footpad} as villain.
e.zh: 那部老小说以一个胆大的拦路贼为反派。

e.en: A narrow {footpath} winds through the forest to the lake.
e.zh: 一条狭窄的小径穿过森林通向湖边。

e.en: Cyclists are not allowed on this {footpath}.
e.zh: 这条人行小道禁止自行车通行。

e.en: The engineer stood on the {footplate} of the steam locomotive.
e.zh: 司机站在蒸汽机车的司机台上。

e.en: Heat from the firebox made the {footplate} unbearable in summer.
e.zh: 夏天炉膛的高温让司机台热得难以忍受。

footprint.t: n. 足迹；占用面积；碳足迹

e.en: The company aims to reduce its carbon {footprint} by half.
e.zh: 该公司力争将碳足迹减少一半。

e.en: A muddy {footprint} on the floor led to the kitchen.
e.zh: 地板上一个泥脚印一直延伸到厨房。

e.en: The kids organized a {footrace} across the playground.
e.zh: 孩子们在操场上组织了一场赛跑。

e.en: She won the charity {footrace} by a wide margin.
e.zh: 她以巨大优势赢得了那场慈善赛跑。

e.en: The recliner has a built-in {footrest} for comfort.
e.zh: 这把躺椅自带搁脚凳,坐着很舒服。

e.en: Use the {footrest} under your desk to improve posture.
e.zh: 使用桌下的脚踏来改善坐姿。

footsie.t: n. 用脚调情；暗中勾结

e.en: They played {footsie} under the dinner table.
e.zh: 他们在餐桌下用脚互相挑逗。

e.en: The politician was accused of playing {footsie} with lobbyists.
e.zh: 那位政客被指责与游说团体暗中勾结。

e.en: She heard a {footstep} approaching the front door.
e.zh: 她听到有脚步声朝大门走来。

e.en: He followed in his father's {footstep} as a doctor.
e.zh: 他追随父亲的脚步成为了一名医生。

e.en: She rested her tired feet on the velvet {footstool}.
e.zh: 她把疲惫的双脚搁在天鹅绒脚凳上。

e.en: The cat curled up on the small wooden {footstool}.
e.zh: 那只猫蜷缩在小木脚凳上。

e.en: The guitarist tapped the {footswitch} to change effects.
e.zh: 吉他手踩下脚踏开关切换效果。

e.en: This sewing machine has a {footswitch} for hands-free control.
e.zh: 这台缝纫机配有脚踏开关,可以解放双手。

e.en: Pedestrians should keep to the {footway} along the road.
e.zh: 行人应沿着道路旁的人行道行走。

e.en: The council widened the {footway} to improve safety.
e.zh: 市政府拓宽了人行道以提高安全性。

e.en: This store sells {footwear} for hiking and running.
e.zh: 这家店出售徒步和跑步用的鞋类。

e.en: Comfortable {footwear} is essential for long city walks.
e.zh: 长时间在城市中步行,舒适的鞋类必不可少。

e.en: The boxer's quick {footwork} helped him dodge every punch.
e.zh: 拳击手敏捷的步法帮他躲开了每一次出拳。

e.en: Closing the deal required some clever political {footwork}.
e.zh: 达成这笔交易需要一些巧妙的政治手段。

fop.t: n. 爱打扮的纨绔子弟

e.en: He dressed like a {fop} in silk and lace.
e.zh: 他打扮得像个花花公子,穿着丝绸和蕾丝。

e.en: The young {fop} spent hours arranging his hair.
e.zh: 那个年轻的纨绔子弟花数小时打理他的头发。

e.en: His {foppish} manners amused the other guests at dinner.
e.zh: 他装腔作势的举止逗乐了晚宴上的其他客人。

e.en: He wore a {foppish} purple suit to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿了一身浮夸的紫色西装去参加婚礼。

for.t:
prep. 为了；给；对于
conj. 因为

e.en: I bought this gift {for} my younger sister.
e.zh: 我买这份礼物是给我妹妹的。

e.en: She has been waiting {for} the bus all morning.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在等公交车。

forage.t:
v. 觅食；搜寻
n. 饲料

e.en: Squirrels {forage} for nuts before winter arrives.
e.zh: 松鼠在冬天来临前四处觅食坚果。

e.en: Chefs sometimes {forage} wild mushrooms in nearby forests.
e.zh: 厨师们有时会在附近的森林里采集野生蘑菇。

e.en: The {forager} returned with a basket of wild berries.
e.zh: 那位采集者带着一篮野莓回来了。

e.en: An experienced {forager} can identify edible plants easily.
e.zh: 经验丰富的采集者能轻易辨认可食用植物。

e.en: Bears spend the autumn {foraging} for food before hibernation.
e.zh: 熊在秋天四处觅食,为冬眠做准备。

e.en: Urban {foraging} has become a popular weekend hobby.
e.zh: 城市采集已成为一种流行的周末爱好。

foray.t:
n. 突袭；涉足尝试
v. 袭击

e.en: Her {foray} into politics ended after one election.
e.zh: 她在一次选举后就结束了从政的尝试。

e.en: The company made a brief {foray} into the smartphone market.
e.zh: 该公司曾短暂涉足智能手机市场。

forbade.t: v. forbid 的过去式；禁止

e.en: The teacher {forbade} phones during the exam.
e.zh: 老师禁止在考试期间使用手机。

e.en: Her parents {forbade} her from staying out late.
e.zh: 她的父母不许她在外面待到很晚。

forbear.t:
v. 克制；忍耐
n. 祖先

e.en: Please {forbear} from interrupting during the presentation.
e.zh: 请在演讲期间克制不要打断。

e.en: He chose to {forbear} criticizing his colleague publicly.
e.zh: 他选择克制自己,不公开批评同事。

e.en: The bank showed {forbearance} on his missed mortgage payment.
e.zh: 银行对他逾期的房贷给予了宽限。

e.en: Thank you for your {forbearance} during the long delay.
e.zh: 感谢您在漫长的延误中保持耐心。

e.en: She made the {Forbes} list of richest entrepreneurs this year.
e.zh: 她今年登上了《福布斯》最富有企业家榜单。

e.en: {Forbes} magazine published a profile of the young CEO.
e.zh: 《福布斯》杂志刊登了那位年轻首席执行官的专访。

e.en: The rules {forbid} eating in the library.
e.zh: 规定禁止在图书馆里吃东西。

e.en: I {forbid} you to drive after drinking.
e.zh: 我不允许你喝酒后开车。

forbidden.t:
adj. 被禁止的
v. forbid 的过去分词

e.en: Smoking is strictly {forbidden} inside the building.
e.zh: 楼内严禁吸烟。

e.en: The {forbidden} app was removed from the store.
e.zh: 那款被禁的应用已从商店下架。

forbidding.t: adj. 令人生畏的；冷峻的

e.en: The cliffs looked dark and {forbidding} in the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中那些悬崖显得阴森可怖。

e.en: He has a {forbidding} expression that scares new hires.
e.zh: 他那副严厉的表情把新员工都吓到了。

e.en: The mountain rose {forbiddingly} above the tiny village.
e.zh: 那座山令人生畏地耸立在小村庄上方。

e.en: The manager stared {forbiddingly} at the late employee.
e.zh: 经理严厉地盯着那位迟到的员工。

forbids.t: v. forbid 的第三人称单数

e.en: Company policy {forbids} sharing passwords with coworkers.
e.zh: 公司政策禁止与同事共享密码。

e.en: The contract {forbids} reselling the tickets online.
e.zh: 合同禁止在网上转售这些门票。

forbore.t: v. forbear 的过去式；克制

e.en: She {forbore} to mention his embarrassing mistake.
e.zh: 她克制住没有提起他那令人尴尬的失误。

e.en: He {forbore} from arguing further with his boss.
e.zh: 他忍住没有再与老板争辩下去。

force.t:
n. 力量；武力；部队
v. 强迫；迫使

e.en: Don't {force} the door — use the right key.
e.zh: 别硬掰那扇门,用正确的钥匙。

e.en: The wind hit the sail with tremendous {force}.
e.zh: 狂风以巨大的力量打在帆上。

e.en: Heavy rain {forced} us to cancel the picnic.
e.zh: 大雨迫使我们取消了野餐。

e.en: She gave a {forced} smile during the awkward meeting.
e.zh: 在尴尬的会议上她挤出了一丝勉强的微笑。

forceful.t: adj. 强有力的；有说服力的

e.en: She made a {forceful} argument for remote work.
e.zh: 她为远程办公做出了强有力的论证。

e.en: His {forceful} personality dominates every team meeting.
e.zh: 他强势的个性主导了每一次团队会议。

e.en: The CEO {forcefully} defended the new pricing strategy.
e.zh: 首席执行官强有力地为新定价策略辩护。

e.en: She pushed the heavy door open {forcefully}.
e.zh: 她用力把那扇沉重的门推开。

e.en: The {forcefulness} of her speech impressed the entire audience.
e.zh: 她演讲的力度令全场听众印象深刻。

e.en: His {forcefulness} in negotiations often closes big deals.
e.zh: 他在谈判中的强势常常促成大单。

forcep.t: n. 镊子（forceps 的单数形式，罕用）

e.en: The dentist picked up a tiny {forcep} from the tray.
e.zh: 牙医从托盘上拿起一把小镊子。

e.en: A single {forcep} lay beside the surgical instruments.
e.zh: 一把镊子放在手术器械旁边。

e.en: The surgeon used {forceps} to remove the splinter.
e.zh: 外科医生用镊子取出了那根碎片。

e.en: Sterile {forceps} are essential in every operating room.
e.zh: 无菌镊子是每间手术室的必需品。

foremost.t:
adj. 最重要的；首要的
adv. 居首位地

e.en: She is the {foremost} expert on ancient Chinese pottery.
e.zh: 她是研究中国古陶瓷的首屈一指的专家。

e.en: Safety must be {foremost} in every engineer's mind.
e.zh: 每个工程师都应把安全放在第一位。

e.en: Please print your {forename} clearly on the application.
e.zh: 请在申请表上工整地填写你的名字。

e.en: His {forename} is Daniel, but everyone calls him Danny.
e.zh: 他的名字是丹尼尔，但大家都叫他丹尼。

e.en: The shop is busiest in the {forenoon}, before lunch.
e.zh: 店里在午饭前的上午最为繁忙。

e.en: We finished the inspection during the {forenoon}.
e.zh: 我们在上午就完成了检查工作。

forensic.t: adj. 法医的；司法鉴定的

e.en: {Forensic} evidence linked the suspect directly to the scene.
e.zh: 法医证据将嫌疑人与现场直接联系起来。

e.en: She works as a {forensic} accountant tracing hidden assets.
e.zh: 她做法务会计，专门追查隐匿资产。

e.en: Modern {forensics} can identify a person from a single hair.
e.zh: 现代法医技术能凭一根头发就锁定身份。

e.en: Digital {forensics} recovered the deleted messages from the phone.
e.zh: 数字取证从手机上恢复了被删的短信。

e.en: The cat lifted its {forepaw} and tapped the window.
e.zh: 猫抬起前爪轻拍窗户。

e.en: The bear cub had a thorn stuck in its {forepaw}.
e.zh: 小熊的前爪扎了一根刺。

e.en: The {foreperson} stood and announced the jury's decision.
e.zh: 陪审团团长起立宣布了陪审团的决定。

e.en: Our {foreperson} ensured every voice on the team was heard.
e.zh: 我们的领班确保团队里每个人的声音都被听到。

e.en: Many couples find that {foreplay} deepens emotional intimacy.
e.zh: 许多伴侣发现前戏能加深情感上的亲密。

e.en: The therapist suggested taking more time for {foreplay}.
e.zh: 治疗师建议多花些时间进行前戏。

e.en: The telegraph was a {forerunner} of modern instant messaging.
e.zh: 电报是现代即时通讯的先驱。

e.en: This prototype is a {forerunner} of next year's flagship phone.
e.zh: 这款原型机是明年旗舰手机的先驱。

foresaw.t: v. 预见（foresee 的过去式）

e.en: Few investors {foresaw} how quickly the market would crash.
e.zh: 很少有投资者预见到市场会崩盘得这么快。

e.en: She {foresaw} the problem and prepared a backup plan.
e.zh: 她预见到了问题，并准备了备用方案。

e.en: I don't {foresee} any major delays in the project.
e.zh: 我预计项目不会出现重大延误。

e.en: Even experts cannot {foresee} every twist in the economy.
e.zh: 即使是专家也无法预见经济的每一次起伏。

e.en: The court ruled the accident was beyond reasonable {foreseeability}.
e.zh: 法院裁定该事故超出了合理可预见范围。

e.en: {Foreseeability} of harm is key to proving negligence.
e.zh: 伤害的可预见性是证明过失的关键。

e.en: Remote work will continue for the {foreseeable} future.
e.zh: 远程办公在可预见的未来还会继续。

e.en: There's no {foreseeable} reason to change our pricing now.
e.zh: 目前没有任何可以预见的理由要调整定价。

e.en: The new tariffs will {foreseeably} raise consumer prices.
e.zh: 可以预见，新关税将推高消费者价格。

e.en: Heavy rain {foreseeably} delayed the outdoor concert.
e.zh: 不出所料，大雨延误了露天音乐会。

foreseeing.t: v. 预见（foresee 的现在分词）

e.en: {Foreseeing} traffic, she left for the airport two hours early.
e.zh: 她预料到会堵车，提前两小时出发去机场。

e.en: The novel praises her gift for {foreseeing} social change.
e.zh: 小说称赞了她预见社会变迁的天赋。

foreseen.t: v. 预见（foresee 的过去分词）

e.en: No one could have {foreseen} the pandemic's lasting impact.
e.zh: 没有人能够预见到这场大流行的长远影响。

e.en: The risks were {foreseen} but ignored by management.
e.zh: 这些风险其实早被预见，却被管理层忽视了。

foresees.t: v. 预见（foresee 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The CEO {foresees} strong growth in overseas markets.
e.zh: 首席执行官预计海外市场会有强劲增长。

e.en: Our model {foresees} a mild winter this year.
e.zh: 我们的模型预测今年是个暖冬。

e.en: The dark clouds seemed to {foreshadow} a stormy night.
e.zh: 乌云仿佛预示着一个暴风雨之夜。

e.en: Early scenes {foreshadow} the betrayal that ends the film.
e.zh: 开篇几场戏预示着影片结尾的那场背叛。

foreshadowing.t:
n. 伏笔；铺垫
v. 预示

e.en: The author uses subtle {foreshadowing} throughout the novel.
e.zh: 作者在整部小说中使用了细腻的伏笔。

e.en: That broken mirror is clearly {foreshadowing} bad luck.
e.zh: 那面破碎的镜子显然是在预示厄运。

e.en: Children searched the {foreshore} for shells at low tide.
e.zh: 孩子们在退潮时的滩涂上找贝壳。

e.en: Driftwood lay scattered along the {foreshore} after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后，海滩潮间带散落着浮木。

e.en: Painters {foreshorten} the arm to suggest depth on a flat canvas.
e.zh: 画家会用透视缩短手臂来在平面上表现纵深。

e.en: Tight deadlines often {foreshorten} the testing phase.
e.zh: 紧迫的截止日期常常压缩测试阶段。

e.en: The {foreshortened} pose makes the figure look like he's leaping forward.
e.zh: 这种透视压缩的姿势让人物看起来像是在向前跃出。

e.en: Budget cuts {foreshortened} the research project to six months.
e.zh: 预算削减把这个研究项目缩短到了六个月。

e.en: With great {foresight}, she bought the apartment before prices soared.
e.zh: 她颇有远见，在房价飙升前买下了那套公寓。

e.en: The team lacked the {foresight} to back up their data.
e.zh: 团队缺乏远见，没有备份他们的数据。

e.en: The doctor explained how to clean under the {foreskin} properly.
e.zh: 医生讲解了如何正确清洁包皮下面。

e.en: Some cultures perform circumcision to remove the {foreskin}.
e.zh: 一些文化会通过割礼切除包皮。

forest.t:
n. 森林
v. 植树造林

e.en: We hiked through a quiet pine {forest} all afternoon.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都在一片寂静的松林中徒步。

e.en: Climate change is putting tropical {forest} ecosystems at risk.
e.zh: 气候变化正威胁着热带森林的生态系统。

forestal.t: adj. 森林的；与森林有关的

e.en: The agency drafted new {forestal} policies to protect old growth.
e.zh: 该机构起草了新的森林政策以保护原始林。

e.en: Local {forestal} reserves attract birdwatchers from across the country.
e.zh: 当地的林区保护地吸引着全国的观鸟者。

forestall.t: v. 抢先阻止；预先防止

e.en: The company cut prices to {forestall} a wave of cancellations.
e.zh: 公司降价是为了抢先阻止一波退订潮。

e.en: A quick apology can {forestall} a much larger conflict.
e.zh: 一句及时的道歉能预先化解更大的冲突。

e.en: They built a small cabin in the heavily {forested} valley.
e.zh: 他们在林木茂密的山谷里建了一间小木屋。

e.en: Most of the island remains {forested} and uninhabited.
e.zh: 这座岛大部分仍是森林覆盖、无人居住。

e.en: The {forester} marked diseased trees for removal.
e.zh: 林务员标记出了需要清除的病树。

e.en: As a {forester}, she spends most days outdoors in the woods.
e.zh: 作为林务员，她大部分时间都在林子里工作。

e.en: The state protects millions of acres of public {forestland}.
e.zh: 该州保护着数百万英亩的公共林地。

e.en: Wildfires destroyed thousands of hectares of {forestland} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天野火烧毁了数千公顷林地。

e.en: Different national {forestries} share research on pest control.
e.zh: 不同国家的林业部门共享病虫害防治的研究。

e.en: Tropical {forestries} face unique sustainability challenges.
e.zh: 热带林业面临着独特的可持续发展挑战。

e.en: She studied {forestry} and now manages a national park.
e.zh: 她学的是林业，现在管理着一座国家公园。

e.en: Sustainable {forestry} balances logging with reforestation.
e.zh: 可持续林业在采伐和造林之间寻求平衡。

e.en: The Amazon {forests} produce a huge share of the world's oxygen.
e.zh: 亚马逊森林贡献了全世界很大一部分氧气。

e.en: Ancient {forests} once covered most of northern Europe.
e.zh: 远古森林曾覆盖北欧的大部分地区。

e.en: The free sample gave us a {foretaste} of the new menu.
e.zh: 那份免费试吃让我们提前尝到了新菜单的味道。

e.en: Last week's heatwave was a {foretaste} of summer.
e.zh: 上周的热浪算是夏天的一次预演。

e.en: No one can {foretell} exactly when the next earthquake will strike.
e.zh: 没人能准确预言下一次地震何时来袭。

e.en: Economists try to {foretell} market trends using historical data.
e.zh: 经济学家尝试用历史数据预测市场走势。

forethought.t: n. 深谋远虑；事先考虑

e.en: With a little {forethought}, we could have avoided this mess.
e.zh: 只要稍加考虑,我们本可以避免这场混乱。

e.en: Packing snacks showed real {forethought} on a long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行带零食真是想得周到。

foretold.t: v. 预言（foretell 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The novel {foretold} a future ruled by intelligent machines.
e.zh: 那本小说预言了一个由智能机器统治的未来。

e.en: Ancient prophecies {foretold} the fall of the empire.
e.zh: 古老的预言预示了帝国的覆灭。

e.en: This software update seems to be taking {forever} to install.
e.zh: 这次软件更新感觉装了好久好久。

e.en: She promised to love him {forever} on their wedding day.
e.zh: 婚礼那天她承诺永远爱他。

e.en: I should {forewarn} you that the meeting may run long.
e.zh: 我得先提醒你,这次会议可能会开得很久。

e.en: Weather apps {forewarn} users about incoming storms.
e.zh: 天气应用会提前警告用户暴风雨即将来临。

e.en: Being {forewarned} about the traffic, we left an hour early.
e.zh: 事先得知交通拥堵,我们提前一小时出发。

e.en: Customers were {forewarned} that prices would rise next month.
e.zh: 客户已被提前告知下月价格将上调。

e.en: The earthquake struck without any {forewarning} at all.
e.zh: 地震毫无预警地袭来。

e.en: A small leak can be a {forewarning} of bigger plumbing problems.
e.zh: 小漏水可能是更大管道问题的预警信号。

e.en: The butterfly's {forewing} has bright orange patterns near the tip.
e.zh: 这只蝴蝶的前翅末端有鲜艳的橙色花纹。

e.en: Scientists studied damage to the moth's {forewing} under a microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在显微镜下研究飞蛾前翅的损伤。
