forewoman.t: n. 女工头；女陪审团主席

e.en: The {forewoman} announced the jury's verdict in a steady voice.
e.zh: 陪审团女主席用平稳的声音宣布了裁决。

e.en: She became the first {forewoman} at the construction site.
e.zh: 她成了那个工地上的第一位女工头。

e.en: A famous chef wrote the {foreword} to her new cookbook.
e.zh: 一位著名厨师为她的新食谱书写了序言。

e.en: Skip the {foreword} if you want to dive into the story immediately.
e.zh: 如果想直接读故事,可以跳过前言。

forex.t: n. 外汇（foreign exchange 的缩写）

e.en: He lost a lot of money trading on the {forex} market.
e.zh: 他在外汇市场交易亏了不少钱。

e.en: Many banks offer {forex} services for international travelers.
e.zh: 很多银行为国际旅客提供外汇兑换服务。

e.en: We stopped in {Forfar} on our way through eastern Scotland.
e.zh: 我们穿越苏格兰东部时在福法尔停了一下。

e.en: {Forfar} is famous for its traditional bridie pastries.
e.zh: 福法尔以传统肉馅饼布里迪而闻名。

forfeit.t:
v. 丧失；被没收
n. 罚金

e.en: If you miss the deadline, you {forfeit} your deposit.
e.zh: 如果错过截止日期,你就要没收押金。

e.en: The team had to {forfeit} the match due to injuries.
e.zh: 由于伤病,该队不得不放弃这场比赛。

forfeited.t:
v. 丧失（forfeit 的过去式）
adj. 被没收的

e.en: He {forfeited} his driver's license after the third violation.
e.zh: 第三次违章后,他被吊销了驾照。

e.en: The company {forfeited} the contract by missing the deadline.
e.zh: 公司因错过截止日期而失去了那份合同。

forfeiting.t: v. 丧失（forfeit 的现在分词）

e.en: Quitting now means {forfeiting} months of hard work.
e.zh: 现在放弃就意味着白白浪费几个月的努力。

e.en: She avoided {forfeiting} her scholarship by retaking the exam.
e.zh: 她通过重考避免了奖学金被取消。

forfeits.t: v. 丧失（forfeit 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Anyone who breaks the rules {forfeits} their entry fee.
e.zh: 违反规则的人将被没收报名费。

e.en: Skipping the final round {forfeits} all your earned points.
e.zh: 跳过最后一轮会让你失去所有已获得的积分。

forfeiture.t: n. (财产、权利的) 丧失；没收

e.en: The judge ordered the {forfeiture} of all illegal assets.
e.zh: 法官下令没收所有非法资产。

e.en: Late payment may result in {forfeiture} of your reservation.
e.zh: 延迟付款可能导致预订被取消。

forfeitures.t: n. 没收物；丧失 (forfeiture 的复数)

e.en: The court announced several {forfeitures} of property this month.
e.zh: 法院本月宣布了多起财产没收案件。

e.en: Recent {forfeitures} have helped fund local police programs.
e.zh: 近期的没收所得帮助资助了当地警务项目。

forgave.t: v. 原谅 (forgive 的过去式)

e.en: She {forgave} him after he sincerely apologized for lying.
e.zh: 在他诚恳道歉之后,她原谅了他撒谎的事。

e.en: The bank {forgave} part of the loan during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间银行免除了部分贷款。

forge.t:
v. 锻造；伪造
n. 铁匠铺

e.en: Startups try to {forge} strong partnerships with bigger companies.
e.zh: 初创公司努力与大公司建立牢固的合作关系。

e.en: The blacksmith heated the iron in the {forge} until it glowed.
e.zh: 铁匠把铁加热到通红,在熔炉里锻造。

forged.t:
adj. 伪造的
v. 锻造/伪造 (过去式)

e.en: Police discovered that the passport had been {forged} overseas.
e.zh: 警方发现这本护照是在海外伪造的。

e.en: The two leaders {forged} a lasting alliance during the crisis.
e.zh: 两位领导人在危机中结成了持久的同盟。

e.en: The {forger} was caught selling fake masterpieces to collectors.
e.zh: 那位伪造者因向藏家出售假名作而被抓获。

e.en: A skilled {forger} can replicate signatures almost perfectly.
e.zh: 熟练的伪造者几乎能完美复制签名。

e.en: Experts confirmed the painting was a clever {forgery}.
e.zh: 专家确认这幅画是高明的赝品。

e.en: He was sentenced to two years in prison for {forgery}.
e.zh: 他因伪造罪被判两年监禁。

forges.t: v. 锻造；伪造 (第三人称单数)

e.en: The teacher {forges} strong bonds with every student in class.
e.zh: 这位老师与班里每个学生都建立起深厚的感情。

e.en: Old village {forges} once produced tools for the entire region.
e.zh: 古老的乡村铁匠铺曾为整个地区制造工具。

e.en: Don't {forget} to back up your files before updating the system.
e.zh: 更新系统前别忘了备份文件。

e.en: I'll never {forget} the first time I saw the ocean.
e.zh: 我永远不会忘记第一次看到大海的情景。

e.en: Grandma has become quite {forgetful} since turning eighty.
e.zh: 奶奶自从八十岁后变得相当健忘。

e.en: I'm so {forgetful} that I keep sticky notes on my monitor.
e.zh: 我太健忘了,总在显示器上贴便利贴。

e.en: Her constant {forgetfulness} worried the whole family deeply.
e.zh: 她不断的健忘让全家人都深感担忧。

e.en: Stress and lack of sleep often cause temporary {forgetfulness}.
e.zh: 压力和睡眠不足常常导致暂时性健忘。

forgets.t: v. 忘记 (第三人称单数)

e.en: He always {forgets} his umbrella on rainy days.
e.zh: 下雨天他总是忘记带雨伞。

e.en: She never {forgets} a face, even after many years.
e.zh: 她对面孔过目不忘,哪怕过了很多年。

forgettable.t: adj. 容易被忘掉的；平淡无奇的

e.en: The movie was entertaining but ultimately quite {forgettable}.
e.zh: 这部电影挺好看,但最终相当容易让人忘掉。

e.en: Most pop songs today feel pretty {forgettable} after a week.
e.zh: 如今大多数流行歌曲过一周就让人毫无印象了。

e.en: I keep {forgetting} my password for that streaming service.
e.zh: 我老是忘记那个流媒体服务的密码。

e.en: {Forgetting} your anniversary is never a good idea.
e.zh: 忘记结婚纪念日绝对不是个好主意。

forging.t:
n. 锻件
v. 锻造；伪造 (现在分词)

e.en: He spent years {forging} a reputation as a reliable journalist.
e.zh: 他花了多年时间塑造可靠记者的声誉。

e.en: The ancient sword was made by {forging} layers of steel.
e.zh: 那把古剑是通过层层锻造钢材打造而成。

e.en: Showing up late once is a {forgivable} mistake at most jobs.
e.zh: 在大多数工作中,迟到一次是可以原谅的错误。

e.en: Lying to your best friend isn't easily {forgivable}.
e.zh: 对最好的朋友撒谎不是轻易能被原谅的。

e.en: Please {forgive} me for missing your birthday party last week.
e.zh: 请原谅我上周错过了你的生日派对。

e.en: It can take years to truly {forgive} a serious betrayal.
e.zh: 真正原谅一次严重的背叛可能需要数年。

e.en: All your past mistakes are {forgiven} as far as I'm concerned.
e.zh: 在我看来,你过去的所有错误都已被原谅。

e.en: He hasn't quite {forgiven} his brother for that argument.
e.zh: 他还没有完全原谅他哥哥那次争吵。

e.en: She asked for {forgiveness} after realizing how much she'd hurt him.
e.zh: 意识到伤害有多深后,她请求他的原谅。

e.en: Many religions emphasize {forgiveness} as a path to peace.
e.zh: 许多宗教都强调宽恕是通往内心平静的途径。

forgives.t: v. 原谅 (第三人称单数)

e.en: My mom always {forgives} me, no matter how badly I mess up.
e.zh: 无论我搞砸成什么样,妈妈总会原谅我。

e.en: The new policy {forgives} student loans for public servants.
e.zh: 新政策免除了公务员的助学贷款。

e.en: She has a remarkably {forgiving} nature toward difficult people.
e.zh: 她对难相处的人有着非常宽容的天性。

e.en: This camera lens is very {forgiving} of beginner mistakes.
e.zh: 这款相机镜头对新手的失误非常包容。

e.en: I'll {forgo} dessert tonight to save room for breakfast tomorrow.
e.zh: 我今晚不吃甜点了,留点空间给明天的早餐。

e.en: Many employees {forgo} bonuses to keep their jobs during layoffs.
e.zh: 很多员工在裁员期间放弃奖金以保住工作。

forgone.t:
adj. 已放弃的
v. forgo 的过去分词

e.en: The deal's outcome was a {forgone} conclusion before negotiations began.
e.zh: 谈判开始前,这笔交易的结果就已成定局。

e.en: She has {forgone} sugar for over six months now.
e.zh: 她已经戒糖六个多月了。

forgot.t: v. 忘记 (forget 的过去式)

e.en: I completely {forgot} to send the invoice last Friday.
e.zh: 我上周五完全忘了发那张发票。

e.en: He {forgot} his lines halfway through the performance.
e.zh: 演出进行到一半时他忘词了。

forgotten.t:
adj. 被遗忘的
v. forget 的过去分词

e.en: This little café feels like a {forgotten} corner of the city.
e.zh: 这家小咖啡馆感觉像是城市里被遗忘的角落。

e.en: I had completely {forgotten} about that old photo album.
e.zh: 我已经完全忘记那本旧相册的存在了。

forint.t: n. 福林 (匈牙利货币单位)

e.en: I exchanged a hundred dollars for Hungarian {forint} at the airport.
e.zh: 我在机场把一百美元换成了匈牙利福林。

e.en: Dinner in Budapest cost about five thousand {forint} per person.
e.zh: 在布达佩斯吃晚餐每人大约花五千福林。

fork.t:
n. 叉子；分叉
v. 分叉；(代码) 分支

e.en: Developers can {fork} the project on GitHub and add features.
e.zh: 开发者可以在 GitHub 上派生这个项目并添加功能。

e.en: Please pass me a clean {fork} for my salad.
e.zh: 请递给我一把干净的叉子吃沙拉。

e.en: His nasty {forkball} drops sharply just before reaching the plate.
e.zh: 他那刁钻的叉指球在到达本垒前会突然下坠。

e.en: Few pitchers throw a {forkball} as effectively as he does.
e.zh: 很少有投手能像他那样把叉指球投得如此犀利。

forked.t:
adj. 分叉的
v. 分叉 (过去式)

e.en: The path {forked} sharply, leaving us unsure which way to go.
e.zh: 小路突然分岔,让我们不知该走哪一条。

e.en: He {forked} the open-source repo to add his own features.
e.zh: 他把开源仓库 fork 了一份,添加自己的功能。

e.en: She took one {forkful} of the cake and smiled happily.
e.zh: 她叉了一口蛋糕,开心地笑了。

e.en: Each {forkful} of pasta was bursting with garlic and butter.
e.zh: 每一叉意面都满是蒜香和黄油的味道。

e.en: The {forklift} operator carefully stacked pallets in the warehouse.
e.zh: 叉车司机在仓库里小心地堆放货盘。

e.en: You need a license to drive a {forklift} in most countries.
e.zh: 在大多数国家,开叉车需要持证。

forks.t:
n. 叉子 (复数)
v. 分叉 (第三人称单数)

e.en: Open-source projects often have hundreds of {forks} on GitHub.
e.zh: 开源项目在 GitHub 上往往有数百个分支版本。

e.en: Could you grab some {forks} from the kitchen drawer?
e.zh: 你能从厨房抽屉里拿几把叉子吗?

e.en: The abandoned puppy looked utterly {forlorn} in the rain.
e.zh: 那只被遗弃的小狗在雨中显得十分凄凉。

e.en: She gave a {forlorn} smile when he said goodbye.
e.zh: 他道别时,她露出了一个失落的微笑。

e.en: The dog stared {forlornly} out the window all afternoon.
e.zh: 那只狗整个下午都失落地望着窗外。

e.en: He sat {forlornly} on the bench after losing the championship.
e.zh: 输掉冠军后,他孤零零地坐在长椅上。

form.t:
n. 表单；形式
v. 形成

e.en: Please fill out this {form} before your appointment.
e.zh: 请在预约前填写这张表格。

e.en: Ice is a solid {form} of water.
e.zh: 冰是水的固体形态。

e.en: The wedding requires {formal} attire and proper etiquette.
e.zh: 婚礼要求穿正装并遵守礼仪。

e.en: She sent a {formal} complaint to the manager.
e.zh: 她向经理提交了一份正式投诉。

e.en: The lab uses {formaldehyde} to preserve biological specimens.
e.zh: 实验室用甲醛保存生物标本。

e.en: New furniture often emits trace amounts of {formaldehyde}.
e.zh: 新家具常会释放微量甲醛。

formalin.t: n. 福尔马林 (甲醛水溶液)

e.en: The tissue sample was stored in {formalin} overnight.
e.zh: 组织样本在福尔马林中浸泡了一夜。

e.en: Pathologists use {formalin} to fix specimens before slicing.
e.zh: 病理学家用福尔马林固定标本后再切片。

formalisation.t: n. 形式化；正式确立 (英式拼写)

e.en: The {formalisation} of the agreement took several months.
e.zh: 协议的正式化花了好几个月。

e.en: He proposed a mathematical {formalisation} of the theory.
e.zh: 他提出了该理论的数学化表述。

formalise.t: v. 使正式化；形式化 (英式拼写)

e.en: They plan to {formalise} the partnership next week.
e.zh: 他们打算下周正式确立合作关系。

e.en: The committee will {formalise} the new safety rules.
e.zh: 委员会将把新的安全规定正式化。

formalised.t: v. formalise 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: The two companies {formalised} their merger yesterday.
e.zh: 两家公司昨天正式完成了合并。

e.en: She {formalised} her résumé before the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试前把简历整理得更规范。

e.en: His teaching style relies heavily on mathematical {formalism}.
e.zh: 他的教学风格非常依赖数学形式化方法。

e.en: The court rejected the appeal on pure {formalism}.
e.zh: 法院以纯粹的形式主义为由驳回了上诉。

e.en: The critic took a {formalist} approach to the painting.
e.zh: 评论家以形式主义视角分析这幅画。

e.en: She is a {formalist} who values structure over emotion.
e.zh: 她是个形式主义者,重结构轻情感。

formalistic.t: adj. 形式主义的；拘泥形式的

e.en: The report felt cold and overly {formalistic}.
e.zh: 这份报告显得冷漠且过于形式化。

e.en: His {formalistic} writing style alienates many readers.
e.zh: 他过于形式化的文风让许多读者望而却步。

formalities.t: n. 手续；礼节 (formality 的复数)

e.en: Let's skip the {formalities} and get straight to business.
e.zh: 我们省去客套,直接谈正事吧。

e.en: The visa {formalities} took almost an hour to complete.
e.zh: 办理签证手续花了将近一个小时。

e.en: Signing the contract is just a {formality} at this point.
e.zh: 现在签合同只是走个形式。

e.en: He spoke with the {formality} expected at a state dinner.
e.zh: 他以国宴应有的庄重语气讲话。

e.en: The {formalization} of the new policy took weeks.
e.zh: 新政策的正式化用了好几周。

e.en: Mathematicians worked on the {formalization} of the proof.
e.zh: 数学家们致力于将该证明形式化。

e.en: We should {formalize} the agreement in writing soon.
e.zh: 我们应该尽快把协议落实成书面文件。

e.en: The team will {formalize} the project plan next Monday.
e.zh: 团队下周一会把项目计划正式确定下来。

formalized.t: v. formalize 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: The startup {formalized} its hiring process last year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司去年把招聘流程规范化了。

e.en: Their relationship was {formalized} with a marriage license.
e.zh: 他们通过结婚证书使关系正式化。

e.en: She was {formally} introduced to the board members.
e.zh: 她被正式介绍给董事会成员。

e.en: The candidate has not {formally} announced his campaign.
e.zh: 这位候选人尚未正式宣布参选。

forte.t:
n. 强项，擅长之事
adj. (音乐) 强音的

e.en: Public speaking has never really been my {forte}.
e.zh: 公开演讲从来都不是我的强项。

e.en: Cooking Italian food is definitely her {forte}.
e.zh: 做意大利菜绝对是她的拿手好戏。

e.en: He stepped {forth} from the crowd to volunteer.
e.zh: 他从人群中走出来主动报名。

e.en: The river flows back and {forth} with the tides.
e.zh: 河水随潮汐来回流动。

forthcoming.t:
adj. 即将到来的
adj. 乐于提供信息的

e.en: Details about the {forthcoming} album will drop next week.
e.zh: 即将发行的专辑细节将在下周公布。

e.en: She wasn't very {forthcoming} about her past relationships.
e.zh: 她对自己过去的恋情不太愿意透露。

e.en: I appreciate her {forthright} approach to giving feedback.
e.zh: 我欣赏她直率的反馈方式。

e.en: The CEO gave a {forthright} answer about the layoffs.
e.zh: 首席执行官就裁员问题给出了直截了当的回答。

e.en: She spoke {forthrightly} about the company's financial troubles.
e.zh: 她直率地谈论了公司的财务困境。

e.en: He answered the reporter's question {forthrightly} and clearly.
e.zh: 他坦率而清晰地回答了记者的提问。

e.en: His {forthrightness} during the interview impressed the panel.
e.zh: 他面试时的直率给评委留下了深刻印象。

e.en: I value the {forthrightness} of her honest critiques.
e.zh: 我看重她坦率诚实的批评。

e.en: All employees must update their passwords {forthwith}.
e.zh: 所有员工必须立即更新密码。

e.en: The judge ordered the documents released {forthwith}.
e.zh: 法官下令立即公开文件。

fortieth.t:
adj. 第四十的
n. 四十分之一

e.en: They threw a big party for her {fortieth} birthday.
e.zh: 他们为她的四十岁生日办了一场盛大的派对。

e.en: This marks the {fortieth} anniversary of the company.
e.zh: 这标志着公司成立四十周年。

fortification.t:
n. 防御工事，要塞
n. 加固，强化

e.en: The medieval {fortification} still stands on the hilltop.
e.zh: 那座中世纪的防御工事仍矗立在山顶上。

e.en: Vitamin {fortification} of cereal helps prevent deficiencies.
e.zh: 在麦片中添加维生素有助于预防营养缺乏。

fortified.t:
adj. 加固的，设防的
adj. (食品) 强化的

e.en: The army {fortified} the border with concrete walls.
e.zh: 军队用混凝土墙加固了边境。

e.en: Many breakfast cereals are {fortified} with iron and vitamins.
e.zh: 许多早餐麦片都添加了铁和维生素。

fortify.t:
v. 加固，设防
v. 增强，强化

e.en: A hot breakfast will {fortify} you for the long hike.
e.zh: 一顿热腾腾的早餐能让你有体力应对长途徒步。

e.en: They plan to {fortify} the database against cyber attacks.
e.zh: 他们计划加强数据库以抵御网络攻击。

fortissimo.t: adj./adv. (音乐) 极强的；极强地

e.en: The orchestra played the final chord {fortissimo}.
e.zh: 乐团以极强的力度演奏了最后的和弦。

e.en: She marked the passage {fortissimo} for dramatic effect.
e.zh: 她将这段标记为极强,以营造戏剧性效果。

e.en: She showed remarkable {fortitude} during her long recovery.
e.zh: 她在漫长的康复期中展现了非凡的坚韧。

e.en: It takes real {fortitude} to start a business alone.
e.zh: 独自创业需要真正的毅力。

e.en: We're going to Spain for a {fortnight} this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天我们要去西班牙待两周。

e.en: The report should be ready within a {fortnight}.
e.zh: 报告应该会在两周内准备好。

fortnightly.t:
adj. 每两周一次的
adv. 每两周地

e.en: Our team holds a {fortnightly} planning meeting on Fridays.
e.zh: 我们团队每两周在周五开一次规划会议。

e.en: She gets paid {fortnightly} rather than monthly.
e.zh: 她每两周领一次薪水,而不是每月。

e.en: The training program runs over six {fortnights} total.
e.zh: 该培训项目总共持续六个两周期。

e.en: We met every two {fortnights} to review progress.
e.zh: 我们每四周见一次面来回顾进展。

e.en: Many scientific simulations are still written in {Fortran}.
e.zh: 许多科学模拟程序仍然用 Fortran 编写。

e.en: My grandfather learned {Fortran} back in the 1970s.
e.zh: 我祖父早在 1970 年代就学过 Fortran。

e.en: The ancient {fortress} overlooks the entire harbor.
e.zh: 这座古老的要塞俯瞰着整个港口。

e.en: Their data center is basically a digital {fortress}.
e.zh: 他们的数据中心基本上是一座数字堡垒。

e.en: Meeting my old mentor at the airport was truly {fortuitous}.
e.zh: 在机场遇到我的老导师真是巧合。

e.en: A {fortuitous} discovery led to the new drug treatment.
e.zh: 一次偶然的发现催生了这种新药疗法。

e.en: We {fortuitously} caught the last train home.
e.zh: 我们碰巧赶上了回家的末班车。

e.en: The two researchers {fortuitously} worked on similar problems.
e.zh: 两位研究人员碰巧在研究类似的问题。

fortuna.t: n. 福尔图娜（罗马命运女神）

e.en: The Romans worshipped {Fortuna}, the goddess of luck.
e.zh: 罗马人崇拜命运女神福尔图娜。

e.en: Statues of {Fortuna} often hold a wheel of fate.
e.zh: 福尔图娜的雕像通常手持命运之轮。

e.en: We're {fortunate} to have such supportive neighbors.
e.zh: 我们很幸运有这么支持我们的邻居。

e.en: She felt {fortunate} to land her dream job so quickly.
e.zh: 她觉得能这么快找到梦想的工作很幸运。

e.en: {Fortunately}, no one was hurt in the minor accident.
e.zh: 幸好,这场小事故中没有人受伤。

e.en: {Fortunately}, the rain stopped right before the wedding.
e.zh: 幸运的是,雨在婚礼前刚好停了。

fortune.t:
n. 财富，巨款
n. 命运，运气

e.en: He made a {fortune} selling software to big corporations.
e.zh: 他靠向大公司销售软件赚了一大笔钱。

e.en: The fortune teller predicted good {fortune} ahead.
e.zh: 算命师预言前方会有好运。

fortunes.t:
n. 命运，际遇
n. 财富 (复数)

e.en: The company's {fortunes} improved after the new CEO arrived.
e.zh: 新任 CEO 上任后,公司的运势有所好转。

e.en: Many {fortunes} were lost during the market crash.
e.zh: 许多财富在市场崩盘中化为乌有。

e.en: She just turned {forty} and feels great about it.
e.zh: 她刚满四十岁,对此感觉非常好。

e.en: The drive takes about {forty} minutes in traffic.
e.zh: 在车流中开过去大约要四十分钟。

e.en: The man at the counter looked {fortyish} and friendly.
e.zh: 柜台后的男子看起来四十岁左右,很友好。

e.en: She's a {fortyish} mother of two with a busy career.
e.zh: 她是一位四十岁左右的两个孩子的母亲,事业繁忙。

e.en: I posted my question on a developer {forum} last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚在一个开发者论坛上发了我的问题。

e.en: The conference provides a {forum} for sharing research.
e.zh: 这次会议为分享研究成果提供了一个平台。

e.en: Online {forums} are great places to find niche advice.
e.zh: 在线论坛是寻找小众建议的好地方。

e.en: Several {forums} discussed the new game's release.
e.zh: 好几个论坛都在讨论这款新游戏的发布。

forward.t:
adv. 向前
v. 转发（邮件、消息）

e.en: Please {forward} this email to the entire team.
e.zh: 请把这封邮件转发给整个团队。

e.en: The project is finally moving {forward} again.
e.zh: 这个项目终于又开始向前推进了。

e.en: We hired a freight {forwarder} to handle international shipping.
e.zh: 我们雇了一家货运代理公司来处理国际运输。

e.en: The email {forwarder} automatically sends messages to my main inbox.
e.zh: 邮件转发器会自动把消息发送到我的主收件箱。

forwarding.t:
n. 转发，转运
adj. 转寄的

e.en: Set up mail {forwarding} before you move to your new address.
e.zh: 搬到新地址之前,先设置好邮件转发。

e.en: She left a {forwarding} address with the building manager.
e.zh: 她给楼宇管理员留下了一个转寄地址。

forwards.t:
adv. 向前
v. forward 的第三人称单数

e.en: He took two steps {forwards} and bowed to the audience.
e.zh: 他向前走了两步,然后向观众鞠躬。

e.en: The car rolled {forwards} after the brake failed.
e.zh: 刹车失灵后,汽车向前滑行。

e.en: Many developers contribute to {FOSS} projects in their spare time.
e.zh: 许多开发者在业余时间为开源软件项目做贡献。

e.en: Linux is one of the most successful {FOSS} operating systems.
e.zh: Linux 是最成功的自由开源操作系统之一。

fossa.t:
n. (解剖) 窝，凹陷
n. 马岛獴

e.en: The {fossa} is a predator native to Madagascar.
e.zh: 马岛獴是原产于马达加斯加的食肉动物。

e.en: Anatomy class covered the cranial {fossa} in detail.
e.zh: 解剖课详细讲解了颅窝。

e.en: A deep {fosse} surrounded the medieval castle walls.
e.zh: 一条深沟环绕着中世纪的城堡城墙。

e.en: Choreographer Bob {Fosse} revolutionized Broadway dance.
e.zh: 编舞家鲍勃·福斯彻底改变了百老汇舞蹈。

fossil.t:
n. 化石
adj. 化石的，过时的

e.en: They found a dinosaur {fossil} embedded in the cliff.
e.zh: 他们在悬崖中发现了一块嵌入的恐龙化石。

e.en: We need to reduce our reliance on {fossil} fuels.
e.zh: 我们需要减少对化石燃料的依赖。

fossilise.t: v. 使成化石（英式拼写）；僵化

e.en: It takes millions of years for bones to {fossilise}.
e.zh: 骨头要经过数百万年才能化石化。

e.en: Outdated rules can {fossilise} an organization's culture.
e.zh: 过时的规则会让一个组织的文化僵化。

fossilised.t: adj. 化石化的；僵化的（英式拼写）

e.en: Scientists studied the {fossilised} leaves from the ancient forest.
e.zh: 科学家们研究了来自古代森林的化石叶子。

e.en: His thinking has become {fossilised} after decades in the same role.
e.zh: 在同一岗位待了几十年后,他的思维已经僵化。

e.en: The {fossilization} of bad habits makes them hard to break.
e.zh: 坏习惯的固化使它们很难改掉。

e.en: {Fossilization} preserves dinosaur bones for millions of years.
e.zh: 化石化作用使恐龙骨骼保存数百万年。

e.en: Old ideas tend to {fossilize} if no one challenges them.
e.zh: 如果没人质疑,旧观念容易僵化。

e.en: It takes thousands of years for bones to {fossilize}.
e.zh: 骨头变成化石需要数千年时间。

e.en: Scientists discovered a {fossilized} fish in the desert rock.
e.zh: 科学家在沙漠岩石中发现了一条鱼化石。

e.en: The company's {fossilized} management style drove away young talent.
e.zh: 公司僵化的管理方式赶走了年轻人才。

e.en: The museum displays dinosaur {fossils} from around the world.
e.zh: 博物馆展出来自世界各地的恐龙化石。

e.en: Burning {fossils} fuels contributes to climate change.
e.zh: 燃烧化石燃料会加剧气候变化。

foster.t:
v. 寄养，收养
v. 培养，促进

e.en: Good teachers {foster} curiosity in their students.
e.zh: 好老师能激发学生的好奇心。

e.en: The couple decided to {foster} a child from the agency.
e.zh: 这对夫妇决定从机构寄养一个孩子。

fostered.t: v. foster 的过去式；培养，寄养

e.en: The program {fostered} closer ties between the two communities.
e.zh: 该项目促进了两个社区之间更紧密的联系。

e.en: She was {fostered} by a kind family after her parents died.
e.zh: 父母去世后,她被一户善良的家庭收养照顾。

fostering.t:
n. 培养，扶持
v. foster 的现在分词

e.en: The school is {fostering} a culture of inclusion and respect.
e.zh: 学校正在培育包容与尊重的文化氛围。

e.en: {Fostering} a pet can be a rewarding experience.
e.zh: 临时寄养宠物会是一段很有意义的经历。

fosters.t: v. foster 的第三人称单数；培养

e.en: Regular feedback {fosters} growth and improvement at work.
e.zh: 定期的反馈能促进职场上的成长与进步。

e.en: The charity {fosters} abandoned puppies until they find homes.
e.zh: 该慈善机构寄养被遗弃的小狗直到它们找到家。

e.en: Many sociology courses begin with {Foucault} and his theories of power.
e.zh: 许多社会学课程都从福柯及其权力理论讲起。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on {Foucault}'s concept of the panopticon.
e.zh: 她以福柯的全景敞视监狱概念为题写了论文。

foucaultian.t: adj. 福柯式的，福柯思想的

e.en: His analysis takes a {Foucaultian} approach to surveillance technology.
e.zh: 他对监控技术的分析采用了福柯式的视角。

e.en: The article offers a {Foucaultian} reading of modern prisons.
e.zh: 这篇文章对现代监狱进行了福柯式的解读。

fought.t: v. fight 的过去式/过去分词；战斗、争夺

e.en: She {fought} hard for equal pay at her company.
e.zh: 她为公司里的同工同酬而努力抗争。

e.en: The two brothers {fought} over the last slice of pizza.
e.zh: 两兄弟为最后一块披萨吵了起来。

foul.t:
n. 犯规
adj. 肮脏的，恶臭的

e.en: Something in the fridge smells absolutely {foul}.
e.zh: 冰箱里有东西闻起来真的很难闻。

e.en: The referee called a {foul} on the defender.
e.zh: 裁判判罚后卫犯规。

fouled.t: v. 弄脏、堵塞（foul 的过去式）

e.en: The striker was {fouled} just outside the penalty box.
e.zh: 前锋在禁区外被犯规了。

e.en: Plastic waste has {fouled} beaches across the coast.
e.zh: 塑料垃圾污染了沿岸的海滩。

fouling.t:
n. 污染，结垢
v. 弄脏、犯规（进行时）

e.en: Factories were {fouling} the river with toxic chemicals.
e.zh: 工厂正用有毒化学品污染河流。

e.en: The defender received a yellow card for repeatedly {fouling}.
e.zh: 那名后卫因反复犯规吃到了一张黄牌。

e.en: The victim was {foully} murdered in his own home.
e.zh: 受害者在自己家中惨遭杀害。

e.en: He spoke {foully} about his former boss in public.
e.zh: 他在公开场合恶毒地谈论他的前老板。

e.en: The {foulness} of the air near the factory was unbearable.
e.zh: 工厂附近空气的恶臭令人难以忍受。

e.en: She was shocked by the {foulness} of his language.
e.zh: 他言语之粗俗令她感到震惊。

found.t:
v. find 的过去式，找到
v. 创立、创办

e.en: I {found} my keys under the couch this morning.
e.zh: 今早我在沙发底下找到了钥匙。

e.en: The company was {found} in 1998 by two college friends.
e.zh: 该公司由两位大学好友于1998年创立。

foundation.t:
n. 基础，地基
n. 基金会

e.en: Trust is the {foundation} of every healthy relationship.
e.zh: 信任是每段健康关系的基础。

e.en: The Gates {Foundation} supports global health initiatives.
e.zh: 盖茨基金会支持全球卫生项目。

e.en: Calculus is a {foundational} skill for engineering students.
e.zh: 微积分是工程专业学生的基础技能。

e.en: The book covers {foundational} concepts in machine learning.
e.zh: 这本书介绍了机器学习中的基础概念。

foundationalism.t: n. 基础主义（哲学流派）

e.en: {Foundationalism} holds that knowledge rests on basic, self-evident beliefs.
e.zh: 基础主义认为知识建立在基本的、自明的信念之上。

e.en: Critics argue that {foundationalism} ignores the social nature of knowledge.
e.zh: 批评者认为基础主义忽视了知识的社会性。

foundations.t: n. foundation 的复数；地基，基金会

e.en: The earthquake damaged the {foundations} of several buildings.
e.zh: 地震损坏了好几栋建筑的地基。

e.en: This course teaches the {foundations} of modern web design.
e.zh: 这门课程教授现代网页设计的基础知识。

founded.t: v. 创立、建立（found 的过去式）

e.en: Apple was {founded} in a garage in 1976.
e.zh: 苹果公司于1976年在一间车库里创立。

e.en: Her argument is {founded} on solid research data.
e.zh: 她的论点建立在扎实的研究数据之上。

founder.t:
n. 创始人
v. (船) 沉没，失败

e.en: The {founder} of the startup stepped down as CEO last year.
e.zh: 这家创业公司的创始人去年卸任了CEO。

e.en: Without funding, the project may {founder} within months.
e.zh: 没有资金,这个项目可能几个月内就会失败。

e.en: The struggling business is {foundering} despite recent investment.
e.zh: 尽管有近期投资,这家陷入困境的企业仍在走下坡路。

e.en: The ship was {foundering} in the storm off the coast.
e.zh: 船在沿海风暴中正逐渐沉没。

founders.t: n. founder 的复数；创始人

e.en: The two {founders} disagreed about the company's future direction.
e.zh: 两位创始人对公司未来方向意见不合。

e.en: Many startups fail when their {founders} lose motivation.
e.zh: 许多创业公司在创始人失去动力后就失败了。

founding.t:
n. 创立，创建
adj. 创始的

e.en: She is a {founding} member of the design team.
e.zh: 她是设计团队的创始成员之一。

e.en: The {founding} of the city dates back to the 1700s.
e.zh: 这座城市的建立可以追溯到18世纪。

e.en: The orphanage took in the {foundling} left at its door.
e.zh: 孤儿院收留了被遗弃在门口的弃婴。

e.en: In the novel, the hero turns out to be a {foundling}.
e.zh: 在小说中,主人公原来是个被遗弃的孩子。

e.en: The {foundress} of the convent was canonized last year.
e.zh: 该修道院的女创立者去年被封为圣人。

e.en: She is remembered as the {foundress} of the women's college.
e.zh: 她作为这所女子学院的创立者而被人们铭记。

e.en: The old iron {foundry} was converted into a museum.
e.zh: 那座旧铸铁厂被改造成了博物馆。

e.en: TSMC operates the world's largest semiconductor {foundry}.
e.zh: 台积电经营着全球最大的半导体代工厂。

founds.t: v. find/found 的第三人称单数

e.en: Every year she {founds} a new charity for homeless children.
e.zh: 她每年都为无家可归的儿童创办一个新的慈善机构。

e.en: The professor {founds} her research on decades of fieldwork.
e.zh: 这位教授将她的研究建立在数十年的田野调查之上。

fount.t: n. 源泉，泉源（文学用法）

e.en: My grandmother was a {fount} of family stories and wisdom.
e.zh: 我祖母是家族故事与智慧的源泉。

e.en: Wikipedia is a {fount} of information for curious minds.
e.zh: 维基百科是好奇者的信息宝库。

e.en: Tourists threw coins into the {fountain} for good luck.
e.zh: 游客们往喷泉里投硬币以求好运。

e.en: There's a drinking {fountain} near the park entrance.
e.zh: 公园入口附近有一个饮水机。

e.en: Ancient Greece is often called the {fountainhead} of Western philosophy.
e.zh: 古希腊常被称为西方哲学的源头。

e.en: She is regarded as the {fountainhead} of modern feminist theory.
e.zh: 她被视为现代女性主义理论的源头人物。

e.en: The plaza features dancing {fountains} that light up at night.
e.zh: 广场上有夜晚会亮灯的音乐喷泉。

e.en: Rome is famous for its beautiful baroque {fountains}.
e.zh: 罗马以其美丽的巴洛克喷泉而闻名。

e.en: I'll meet you at {four} o'clock outside the cafe.
e.zh: 我们四点在咖啡馆外面见。

e.en: The table seats {four} people comfortably.
e.zh: 这张桌子可以舒适地坐四个人。

four-poster.t: n. 四柱床（带顶盖的床）

e.en: The hotel suite featured an antique {four-poster} bed.
e.zh: 酒店套房里有一张古董四柱床。

e.en: She always dreamed of sleeping in a grand {four-poster}.
e.zh: 她一直梦想能睡在一张华丽的四柱床上。

fourfold.t: adj. 四倍的；adv. 四倍地

e.en: Online sales have increased {fourfold} since the pandemic began.
e.zh: 自疫情开始以来,网上销售额已增长了四倍。

e.en: The plan has a {fourfold} purpose: educate, train, employ, and retain.
e.zh: 该计划有四重目标:教育、培训、就业和留任。

fourier.t: n. 傅里叶（法国数学家）

e.en: Engineers use the {Fourier} transform to analyze audio signals.
e.zh: 工程师使用傅里叶变换来分析音频信号。

e.en: {Fourier} series can represent almost any periodic function.
e.zh: 傅里叶级数几乎可以表示任何周期函数。

fourpence.t: n. 四便士（旧英国货币）

e.en: The old shopkeeper charged just {fourpence} for a loaf of bread.
e.zh: 老店主一条面包只卖四便士。

e.en: In Victorian times, {fourpence} could buy a simple meal.
e.zh: 在维多利亚时代,四便士能买到一顿简餐。

fours.t: n. four 的复数；四个一组

e.en: The toddler crawled around the room on all {fours}.
e.zh: 那个小孩四肢着地在房间里爬来爬去。

e.en: Please line up in {fours} before entering the museum.
e.zh: 进入博物馆前请四人一排排好队。

e.en: Our {foursome} tees off at eight tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我们四人组明早八点开球。

e.en: The {foursome} has been close friends since college.
e.zh: 这四人从大学时代起就是好朋友。

foursquare.t:
adj. 坚定的，直截了当的
adj. 正方形的

e.en: The mayor stood {foursquare} behind the new education policy.
e.zh: 市长坚定地支持新的教育政策。

e.en: People used to check in on {Foursquare} at every restaurant.
e.zh: 人们以前在每家餐厅都会用Foursquare签到。

e.en: My daughter just turned {fourteen} last weekend.
e.zh: 我女儿上周末刚满十四岁。

e.en: The flight to Tokyo takes about {fourteen} hours.
e.zh: 飞往东京的航班大约需要十四小时。

fourteenth.t:
num. 第十四
n. 十四分之一

e.en: Her birthday falls on the {fourteenth} of February.
e.zh: 她的生日是二月十四日。

e.en: He finished {fourteenth} in the marathon last year.
e.zh: 他在去年的马拉松比赛中获得第十四名。

fourth.t:
num. 第四
n. 四分之一

e.en: July {fourth} is Independence Day in the United States.
e.zh: 七月四日是美国的独立日。

e.en: This is the {fourth} time I've called customer service today.
e.zh: 这是我今天第四次打电话给客服了。

e.en: {Fourthly}, we need to consider the environmental impact carefully.
e.zh: 第四,我们需要仔细考虑环境影响。

e.en: And {fourthly}, the budget must be approved by the board.
e.zh: 第四点,预算必须经董事会批准。

fourths.t: n. fourth 的复数；四分之几

e.en: Cut the pizza into {fourths} so everyone gets a slice.
e.zh: 把披萨切成四块,这样每个人都有一份。

e.en: Three {fourths} of the class passed the final exam.
e.zh: 四分之三的学生通过了期末考试。

e.en: The {fovea} is responsible for our sharpest central vision.
e.zh: 中央凹负责我们最敏锐的中央视觉。

e.en: Damage to the {fovea} can severely impair reading ability.
e.zh: 中央凹受损会严重影响阅读能力。

e.en: We spent the weekend sailing around {Fowey} harbor in Cornwall.
e.zh: 我们在康沃尔的福伊港周围航行了一个周末。

e.en: {Fowey} is a charming fishing town on the south coast.
e.zh: 福伊是南海岸一个迷人的渔业小镇。

e.en: The farmer raises chickens, ducks, and other {fowl}.
e.zh: 这位农民饲养鸡、鸭和其他家禽。

e.en: Wild {fowl} migrate south every autumn for warmer weather.
e.zh: 野禽每年秋天南迁以寻找温暖的天气。

fowler.t:
n. 福勒（姓氏）
n. 捕鸟人

e.en: The {fowler} waited quietly in the marsh at dawn.
e.zh: 捕鸟人在黎明时分静静守候在沼泽里。

e.en: My neighbor {Fowler} runs a small bakery downtown.
e.zh: 我的邻居福勒在市中心经营一家小面包店。

e.en: He inherited an old {fowling} piece from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里继承了一支古老的猎鸟枪。

e.en: {Fowling} was a popular pastime in the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 猎鸟在十九世纪是一种流行的消遣方式。

fox.t:
n. 狐狸
v. 使困惑

e.en: A red {fox} darted across the snowy field at midnight.
e.zh: 一只红狐午夜时分窜过雪地。

e.en: The riddle was clever enough to {fox} even the experts.
e.zh: 这道谜题足够巧妙，连专家也被难住了。

foxes.t:
n. 狐狸（复数）
v. 使迷惑

e.en: Urban {foxes} often raid trash bins at night.
e.zh: 城市里的狐狸常常在夜里翻找垃圾桶。

e.en: That tricky math problem really {foxes} most students.
e.zh: 那道刁钻的数学题真的把大多数学生都难住了。

e.en: Tall purple {foxglove} flowers lined the garden path.
e.zh: 高高的紫色毛地黄花排列在花园小径两旁。

e.en: Be careful—{foxglove} leaves are highly toxic if eaten.
e.zh: 小心，毛地黄的叶子误食会有剧毒。

e.en: The soldiers dug a {foxhole} for cover during the attack.
e.zh: 士兵们在袭击中挖了散兵坑作掩护。

e.en: There are no atheists in a {foxhole}, the saying goes.
e.zh: 俗话说，散兵坑里没有无神论者。

e.en: The {foxhound} caught the scent and bolted into the woods.
e.zh: 猎狐犬嗅到气味便冲进了树林。

e.en: She breeds {foxhound} puppies on her countryside farm.
e.zh: 她在乡下农场里繁育猎狐犬幼崽。

e.en: Wild {foxtail} grass swayed gently along the roadside.
e.zh: 野生的狗尾草沿着路边轻轻摇曳。

e.en: The vet removed a {foxtail} stuck in the dog's paw.
e.zh: 兽医从狗爪里取出了一根卡住的狗尾草。

e.en: We stopped in {Foxton} to watch the famous canal locks.
e.zh: 我们在福克斯顿停下来观看著名的运河船闸。

e.en: {Foxton} village hosts a charming summer fair every year.
e.zh: 福克斯顿村每年都会举办迷人的夏季集市。

foxtrot.t:
n. 狐步舞
v. 跳狐步舞

e.en: They learned to {foxtrot} for their wedding reception.
e.zh: 他们为婚礼宴会学习了狐步舞。

e.en: The pilot used the call sign Whiskey {Foxtrot} Two.
e.zh: 飞行员使用的呼号是威士忌狐步二号。

foxy.t: adj. 性感迷人的；狡猾的

e.en: She gave him a {foxy} smile and walked away slowly.
e.zh: 她妩媚一笑，慢慢走开了。

e.en: That was a {foxy} move to win the negotiation.
e.zh: 赢下那场谈判真是个狡猾的招数。

e.en: The villagers held a farewell {foy} for the departing sailor.
e.zh: 村民们为即将远行的水手举办了一场饯别宴。

e.en: My great-aunt {Foy} taught me how to bake bread.
e.zh: 我的姑奶奶福伊教过我怎么烤面包。

e.en: Guests gathered in the hotel {foyer} before the gala.
e.zh: 宾客们在晚宴前聚集在酒店大堂里。

e.en: Please leave wet umbrellas in the {foyer} when entering.
e.zh: 进门时请把湿伞放在门厅里。

e.en: The River {Foyle} flows through the heart of Derry.
e.zh: 福伊尔河穿过德里市的中心。

e.en: Detective {Foyle} solved cases set during World War Two.
e.zh: 福伊尔探长破解了一些二战时期的案件。

e.en: The model's {FPR} dropped after we tuned the threshold.
e.zh: 调整阈值后模型的假阳性率下降了。

e.en: A low {FPR} is critical for fraud detection systems.
e.zh: 低假阳性率对欺诈检测系统至关重要。

fra.t: n. 修士（意大利语称谓）

e.en: The painting was created by {Fra} Angelico in Florence.
e.zh: 这幅画是修士安杰利科在佛罗伦萨创作的。

e.en: {Fra} Mauro drew one of the most detailed medieval maps.
e.zh: 修士毛罗绘制了中世纪最详尽的地图之一。

e.en: A loud {fracas} broke out near the stadium entrance.
e.zh: 体育场入口附近爆发了一场吵闹的冲突。

e.en: Police were called to settle the {fracas} at the bar.
e.zh: 警察被叫来处理酒吧里的争吵。

fractal.t:
n. 分形
adj. 分形的

e.en: The Mandelbrot set is the most famous {fractal} pattern.
e.zh: 曼德博集合是最著名的分形图案。

e.en: Snowflakes display a beautiful {fractal} structure under magnification.
e.zh: 雪花在放大镜下呈现出美丽的分形结构。

e.en: Only a small {fraction} of users ever read the terms.
e.zh: 只有一小部分用户会真正阅读条款。

e.en: Convert this {fraction} into a decimal for the report.
e.zh: 把这个分数换算成小数填进报告里。

e.en: The startup hired a {fractional} CFO to save costs.
e.zh: 这家初创公司聘请了一位兼职财务总监以节省成本。

e.en: Even {fractional} delays can ruin a high-frequency trading strategy.
e.zh: 即使是极小的延迟也可能毁掉高频交易策略。

e.en: Bitcoin rose {fractionally} after the announcement this morning.
e.zh: 今早消息发布后比特币略微上涨。

e.en: Her time was {fractionally} faster than the world record.
e.zh: 她的成绩比世界纪录略快一点点。

e.en: Engineers {fractionate} crude oil into gasoline and diesel.
e.zh: 工程师将原油分馏成汽油和柴油。

e.en: The lab will {fractionate} the blood sample by centrifuge.
e.zh: 实验室将用离心机对血样进行分离。

e.en: Plasma {fractionation} produces life-saving therapeutic proteins.
e.zh: 血浆分离能制造出救命的治疗用蛋白。

e.en: The refinery uses {fractionation} towers to separate hydrocarbons.
e.zh: 炼油厂用分馏塔来分离碳氢化合物。

e.en: My daughter is learning to add {fractions} in third grade.
e.zh: 我女儿在三年级学习分数的加法。

e.en: The latency improved by {fractions} of a second.
e.zh: 延迟改善了零点几秒。

e.en: The {fractious} toddler refused to put on his shoes.
e.zh: 那个爱闹脾气的小孩不肯穿鞋。

e.en: Coalition talks grew {fractious} after the budget leak.
e.zh: 预算外泄后联合谈判变得越来越火爆。

fracture.t:
n. 骨折；断裂
v. 使破裂

e.en: The X-ray revealed a hairline {fracture} in her wrist.
e.zh: X光片显示她的手腕有一处细微骨折。

e.en: Rising prices could {fracture} the fragile political coalition.
e.zh: 价格上涨可能会撕裂脆弱的政治联盟。

e.en: He {fractured} his ankle while skateboarding last weekend.
e.zh: 他上周末玩滑板时摔骨折了脚踝。

e.en: The party remains deeply {fractured} after the leadership vote.
e.zh: 领导层投票后该党依然严重分裂。

fracturing.t:
n. 压裂（工艺）
v. 使破裂

e.en: Hydraulic {fracturing} has transformed the American energy industry.
e.zh: 水力压裂法彻底改变了美国能源产业。

e.en: Repeated stress is {fracturing} the bridge's concrete supports.
e.zh: 反复的应力正在使桥的混凝土支撑出现裂缝。

frag.t:
v. 击杀（游戏）
n. 碎片

e.en: He scored a triple {frag} in the final round.
e.zh: 他在最后一局拿下了三杀。

e.en: Players celebrated each {frag} with a quick voice line.
e.zh: 玩家们每次击杀都会喊出一句简短的台词。

e.en: Please handle this box carefully—it contains {fragile} glassware.
e.zh: 请小心搬运这个箱子，里面装着易碎的玻璃器皿。

e.en: The ceasefire remains {fragile} despite weeks of negotiation.
e.zh: 尽管谈判数周，停火仍然脆弱。

e.en: The pandemic exposed the {fragility} of global supply chains.
e.zh: 疫情暴露了全球供应链的脆弱性。

e.en: The vase's {fragility} made shipping it incredibly stressful.
e.zh: 花瓶的易碎性让运输过程压力极大。

fragment.t:
n. 片段；碎片
v. 使碎裂

e.en: Archaeologists found a {fragment} of pottery dating back 3000 years.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了一片三千年前的陶器残片。

e.en: That sentence is just a {fragment}—it needs a verb.
e.zh: 那个句子只是个片段，缺少动词。

e.en: Early reports about the accident were {fragmentary} and contradictory.
e.zh: 关于事故的早期报道支离破碎且互相矛盾。

e.en: Only {fragmentary} evidence of the lost civilization remains today.
e.zh: 那个失落文明今天只剩下零碎的证据。

e.en: Disk {fragmentation} can noticeably slow down older computers.
e.zh: 磁盘碎片会让旧电脑明显变慢。

e.en: Habitat {fragmentation} threatens the survival of many species.
e.zh: 栖息地破碎化威胁着许多物种的生存。

e.en: The report compared market {fragmentations} across different European countries.
e.zh: 该报告比较了不同欧洲国家的市场割裂程度。

e.en: Multiple memory {fragmentations} occurred during the long-running process.
e.zh: 长时间运行的进程中发生了多次内存碎片化。

e.en: The streaming market has become increasingly {fragmented} in recent years.
e.zh: 近年来流媒体市场变得越来越分散。

e.en: His memories of the accident were {fragmented} and unreliable.
e.zh: 他对事故的记忆零碎且不可靠。

e.en: Tiny {fragments} of glass were scattered across the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 细小的玻璃碎片散落在厨房地板上。

e.en: GraphQL {fragments} let you reuse field selections across queries.
e.zh: GraphQL片段让你可以在多个查询中复用字段选择。

e.en: This candle has a warm {fragrance} of vanilla and cedar.
e.zh: 这支蜡烛散发着香草与雪松的温暖香气。

e.en: She launched a new {fragrance} line for the holiday season.
e.zh: 她为节日季推出了新的香水系列。

e.en: The shop sells handcrafted {fragrances} made from natural essential oils.
e.zh: 这家店出售由天然精油手工调制的香水。

e.en: Floral {fragrances} dominate this season's perfume collections.
e.zh: 花香调主导了本季的香水系列。

e.en: Freshly baked bread filled the kitchen with a {fragrant} aroma.
e.zh: 刚烤好的面包让厨房里弥漫着诱人的香气。

e.en: The garden is full of {fragrant} jasmine in early summer.
e.zh: 初夏时节花园里开满了芬芳的茉莉花。

e.en: My grandmother has grown {frail} since her hip surgery.
e.zh: 自从髋关节手术后，我奶奶就变得很虚弱。

e.en: The {frail} wooden bridge swayed dangerously in the wind.
e.zh: 那座单薄的木桥在风中摇晃得很危险。

e.en: The novel explores human {frailty} and the search for meaning.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了人性的脆弱与对意义的追寻。

e.en: Doctors assess {frailty} before recommending major surgery for elderly patients.
e.zh: 医生在为老年患者推荐大手术前会评估其衰弱程度。

e.en: The Norwegian ship {Fram} survived years frozen in Arctic ice.
e.zh: 挪威的前进号船在北极冰封中安然度过多年。

e.en: He swears by {Fram} oil filters for every car he owns.
e.zh: 他对自己所有车都坚持使用Fram机油滤清器。

frame.t:
n. 框架；画面
v. 构建；陷害

e.en: I bought a wooden {frame} for our wedding photo.
e.zh: 我买了一个木相框来装我们的婚纱照。

e.en: Try to {frame} the question in a more positive way.
e.zh: 试着用更积极的方式来表达这个问题。

e.en: She {framed} the diploma and hung it in the office.
e.zh: 她把毕业证装裱起来挂在了办公室。

e.en: The defendant insisted he had been {framed} by the police.
e.zh: 被告坚称自己是被警方陷害的。

frameless.t: adj. 无边框的；无框架的

e.en: The bathroom features a sleek {frameless} glass shower door.
e.zh: 浴室配有时尚的无框玻璃淋浴门。

e.en: He prefers {frameless} eyeglasses for a minimalist look.
e.zh: 他偏爱无框眼镜，看起来更简约。

e.en: Designers love {Framer} for prototyping interactive web animations.
e.zh: 设计师们喜欢用Framer来做交互式网页动效原型。

e.en: The {framer} carefully measured the canvas before cutting moulding.
e.zh: 装框师在裁切线条之前仔细量好了画布。

e.en: This new monitor displays games at 240 {frames} per second.
e.zh: 这台新显示器以每秒240帧显示游戏画面。

e.en: She tried on several stylish {frames} at the optician's.
e.zh: 她在眼镜店试戴了好几副时髦的镜框。

e.en: React is the most popular JavaScript {framework} for building UIs.
e.zh: React是构建用户界面最流行的JavaScript框架。

e.en: We need a clear ethical {framework} for AI deployment.
e.zh: 我们需要一个清晰的人工智能部署伦理框架。

e.en: Modern web {frameworks} make building single-page apps much easier.
e.zh: 现代Web框架让构建单页应用变得容易得多。

e.en: Regulators are drafting new {frameworks} for cryptocurrency oversight.
e.zh: 监管机构正在起草新的加密货币监管框架。

framing.t:
n. 构图；取景
v. 构建（framing 的进行式）

e.en: The {framing} of the question made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 这个问题的措辞方式让大家都很不自在。

e.en: Workers finished {framing} the new house this week.
e.zh: 工人们这周完成了新房子的框架搭建。

e.en: We visited {Framlingham} Castle on our trip to Suffolk.
e.zh: 我们去萨福克旅行时参观了弗拉姆林厄姆城堡。

e.en: Ed Sheeran grew up in the town of {Framlingham}.
e.zh: 艾德·希兰在弗拉姆林厄姆这个小镇长大。

franc.t: n. 法郎（旧法国货币单位）

e.en: He paid fifty {franc} for the old book at the market.
e.zh: 他在市场上花五十法郎买下了那本旧书。

e.en: The Swiss {franc} remains a popular safe-haven currency.
e.zh: 瑞士法郎仍是热门的避险货币。

franca.t: n. 女性人名；常见于 lingua franca（通用语）

e.en: English serves as the lingua {franca} of global business.
e.zh: 英语是全球商业的通用语言。

e.en: In this region, Swahili is the lingua {franca}.
e.zh: 在这个地区,斯瓦希里语是通用语。

francais.t:
adj. 法国的
n. 法语（français）

e.en: She ordered the menu in {francais} without hesitation.
e.zh: 她毫不犹豫地用法语点了菜。

e.en: Parlez-vous {francais}? he asked the tourist politely.
e.zh: 他礼貌地问游客:你会说法语吗?

e.en: She studied à la {francaise} cuisine in Paris last summer.
e.zh: 她去年夏天在巴黎学习法式烹饪。

e.en: The hotel offers a classic {francaise} breakfast every morning.
e.zh: 酒店每天早上提供经典的法式早餐。

e.en: We are flying to {France} for our honeymoon.
e.zh: 我们要飞往法国度蜜月。

e.en: {France} won the World Cup that summer.
e.zh: 那年夏天法国赢得了世界杯。

franchise.t:
n. 特许经营权；系列作品
v. 授予特许经营权

e.en: He opened a coffee shop {franchise} downtown last year.
e.zh: 他去年在市中心开了一家咖啡连锁加盟店。

e.en: The Marvel {franchise} keeps releasing new films every year.
e.zh: 漫威系列每年都在推出新电影。

franchised.t: adj. 加盟的；特许经营的

e.en: Most of the gyms in this city are {franchised} operations.
e.zh: 这座城市里大多数健身房都是加盟经营的。

e.en: The brand {franchised} hundreds of stores across Asia.
e.zh: 该品牌在亚洲授权开设了数百家加盟店。

e.en: Each {franchisee} must follow strict brand guidelines.
e.zh: 每个加盟商都必须遵守严格的品牌规范。

e.en: She became a {franchisee} after saving for ten years.
e.zh: 她攒了十年钱后成为了一名加盟商。

e.en: The {franchiser} provides training and marketing support.
e.zh: 特许方提供培训和市场营销支持。

e.en: Disputes between the {franchiser} and store owners went to court.
e.zh: 特许方与店主之间的纠纷闹上了法庭。

franchises.t: n. 特许经营权；系列作品（复数）

e.en: Fast food {franchises} dominate every highway exit.
e.zh: 快餐连锁店占据了每个高速路出口。

e.en: Star Wars is one of the highest-grossing {franchises} ever.
e.zh: 《星球大战》是有史以来最赚钱的系列之一。

franchising.t: n. 特许经营（经营模式）

e.en: {Franchising} allowed the brand to expand quickly worldwide.
e.zh: 特许加盟让该品牌迅速拓展到全球。

e.en: She attended a seminar on {franchising} small businesses.
e.zh: 她参加了一场关于小企业特许经营的研讨会。

e.en: The {franchisor} collects royalties from each store monthly.
e.zh: 特许方每月向各门店收取特许使用费。

e.en: A good {franchisor} helps new owners succeed quickly.
e.zh: 优秀的特许方能帮助新店主迅速取得成功。

franciscan.t:
adj. 方济各会的
n. 方济各会修士

e.en: A {Franciscan} monk greeted us at the monastery gate.
e.zh: 一位方济各会修士在修道院门口迎接我们。

e.en: She admires the simple lifestyle of {Franciscan} friars.
e.zh: 她钦佩方济各会修士简朴的生活方式。

e.en: My cousin moved to San {Francisco} for a tech job.
e.zh: 我表哥为了一份科技工作搬到了旧金山。

e.en: San {Francisco} is famous for its steep, foggy streets.
e.zh: 旧金山以陡峭多雾的街道闻名。

franco.t: n. 佛朗哥（西班牙独裁者）；人名

e.en: The dictator {Franco} ruled Spain for nearly forty years.
e.zh: 独裁者佛朗哥统治了西班牙近四十年。

e.en: They signed a {Franco}-German agreement last week.
e.zh: 他们上周签署了一份法德协议。

francophile.t: n. 崇尚法国文化的人

e.en: As a {francophile}, she visits Paris every spring.
e.zh: 作为法国迷,她每年春天都去巴黎。

e.en: He's a true {francophile} who collects French wine.
e.zh: 他是个真正的法国迷,专门收藏法国葡萄酒。

francophone.t:
adj. 说法语的
n. 法语使用者

e.en: Quebec is the largest {francophone} province in Canada.
e.zh: 魁北克是加拿大最大的法语省份。

e.en: Many {francophone} countries celebrate this annual cultural festival.
e.zh: 许多法语国家都会庆祝这个年度文化节。

e.en: The {frangipani} flowers filled the garden with sweet fragrance.
e.zh: 鸡蛋花让花园里弥漫着甜美的香气。

e.en: She tucked a white {frangipani} behind her ear.
e.zh: 她把一朵白色鸡蛋花别在耳后。

frank.t:
adj. 坦率的；直言的
n. 人名

e.en: To be {frank}, I don't really like the design.
e.zh: 坦白说,我不太喜欢这个设计。

e.en: She had a {frank} conversation with her boss yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天和老板坦诚地谈了一次。

frankenstein.t: n. 科学怪人；失控的造物

e.en: This patched-together codebase has become a real {Frankenstein}.
e.zh: 这个东拼西凑的代码库已经变成了一个怪物拼盘。

e.en: Mary Shelley wrote {Frankenstein} when she was just eighteen.
e.zh: 玛丽·雪莱写《弗兰肯斯坦》时年仅十八岁。

frankfurt.t: n. 法兰克福（德国城市）

e.en: Our flight has a layover in {Frankfurt} tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我们的航班明天早上要在法兰克福转机。

e.en: {Frankfurt} is a major financial hub in Europe.
e.zh: 法兰克福是欧洲主要的金融中心。

frankfurter.t: n. 法兰克福香肠；热狗肠

e.en: He grilled a {frankfurter} and put it in a bun.
e.zh: 他烤了一根法兰克福香肠,夹进了面包里。

e.en: The stadium sells {frankfurter} sausages with mustard and onions.
e.zh: 球场出售配芥末和洋葱的法兰克福香肠。

e.en: The temple smelled of burning {frankincense} and myrrh.
e.zh: 寺庙里弥漫着燃烧的乳香和没药的气味。

e.en: Ancient traders carried {frankincense} across the Arabian deserts.
e.zh: 古代商人穿越阿拉伯沙漠运送乳香。

frankish.t:
adj. 法兰克人的
n. 法兰克语

e.en: The {Frankish} kingdom expanded under Charlemagne's rule.
e.zh: 法兰克王国在查理曼大帝的统治下不断扩张。

e.en: Many French place names have {Frankish} origins.
e.zh: 许多法语地名都源自法兰克语。

e.en: Benjamin {Franklin} signed the Declaration of Independence in 1776.
e.zh: 本杰明·富兰克林于1776年签署了《独立宣言》。

e.en: Her grandfather always carried a hundred-dollar {Franklin} in his wallet.
e.zh: 她爷爷钱包里总放着一张印有富兰克林的百元钞。

e.en: {Frankly}, I think the meeting was a waste of time.
e.zh: 坦白说,我觉得这场会议是浪费时间。

e.en: She spoke {frankly} about her struggles with anxiety.
e.zh: 她坦率地谈起了自己与焦虑的抗争。

e.en: I appreciated her {frankness} during the difficult discussion.
e.zh: 我很感激她在那次艰难讨论中的坦率。

e.en: His {frankness} sometimes upset more sensitive colleagues.
e.zh: 他的直言不讳有时会让较敏感的同事不快。

franks.t: n. 法兰克人；人名（复数）

e.en: We grilled {franks} and burgers at the backyard barbecue.
e.zh: 我们在后院烧烤上烤了热狗肠和汉堡。

e.en: The {Franks} conquered much of Western Europe in the Middle Ages.
e.zh: 法兰克人在中世纪征服了西欧大部分地区。

e.en: She made a {frantic} phone call after losing her wallet.
e.zh: 她丢了钱包后慌乱地打了个电话。

e.en: The newsroom became {frantic} as the deadline approached.
e.zh: 截稿时间临近,新闻编辑室一片忙乱。

e.en: He searched {frantically} for his keys before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前他疯狂地翻找钥匙。

e.en: She typed {frantically} to finish the email on time.
e.zh: 她飞快地敲键盘,想准时把邮件发出去。

e.en: The {Fraser} River runs through British Columbia to the Pacific.
e.zh: 弗雷泽河穿过不列颠哥伦比亚省汇入太平洋。

e.en: Brendan {Fraser} won an Oscar for his comeback role.
e.zh: 布兰登·弗雷泽凭借回归之作赢得了奥斯卡奖。

frat.t: n. 大学兄弟会（fraternity 的缩写）

e.en: He joined a {frat} during his sophomore year of college.
e.zh: 他大二时加入了一个兄弟会。

e.en: The {frat} house threw a huge party last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末兄弟会会所举办了一场盛大的派对。

freedman.t: n. 自由民（尤指被解放的奴隶）

e.en: The {freedman} bought a small farm after gaining his liberty.
e.zh: 那名获释奴隶在获得自由后买了一个小农场。

e.en: Records show the {freedman} later opened a successful bakery.
e.zh: 记录显示这位被释自由人后来开了一家成功的面包店。

e.en: Working remotely gives me a lot of {freedom} over my schedule.
e.zh: 远程办公让我对自己的时间安排有很大自由。

e.en: The new law expands {freedom} of the press.
e.zh: 这项新法律扩大了新闻自由。

freefall.t: n. 自由下落；（价格等）急剧下跌

e.en: Skydivers experience about a minute of {freefall} before opening parachutes.
e.zh: 跳伞者在打开降落伞前大约会自由下落一分钟。

e.en: The company's stock went into {freefall} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻爆出后公司股价直线暴跌。

freehand.t:
adj. 徒手画的
adv. 徒手地

e.en: She drew the entire portrait {freehand}, without any reference.
e.zh: 她不靠任何参考徒手画完了整幅肖像。

e.en: The architect sketched the building {freehand} on a napkin.
e.zh: 那位建筑师在餐巾纸上徒手勾出了建筑草图。

e.en: They bought the property as a {freehold} rather than a lease.
e.zh: 他们以永久产权而非租约形式买下了这处房产。

e.en: A {freehold} flat is rare and usually more expensive.
e.zh: 永久产权的公寓很少见，价格通常也更高。

e.en: As the {freeholder}, she's responsible for the building's roof.
e.zh: 作为永久产权人，她要负责整栋楼的屋顶维护。

e.en: The {freeholder} agreed to extend the lease by 90 years.
e.zh: 产权人同意将租约延长 90 年。

freeing.t: v. 释放；解除（free 的现在分词）

e.en: Quitting that toxic job was incredibly {freeing}.
e.zh: 辞掉那份糟糕的工作让人无比解脱。

e.en: The team is {freeing} up disk space on the server.
e.zh: 团队正在释放服务器上的磁盘空间。

freelance.t:
adj. 自由职业的
v. 做自由职业

e.en: She decided to {freelance} after five years at the agency.
e.zh: 在广告公司干了五年后她决定做自由职业。

e.en: Most of her income comes from {freelance} design projects.
e.zh: 她的大部分收入来自自由设计项目。

e.en: As a {freelancer}, he sets his own rates and hours.
e.zh: 作为自由职业者，他自己定价和安排工作时间。

e.en: The startup hired a {freelancer} to redesign its logo.
e.zh: 这家初创公司请了一位自由职业者重新设计 Logo。

e.en: Don't let your roommates {freeload} off your streaming account.
e.zh: 别让室友白蹭你的流媒体账号。

e.en: He'd rather work two jobs than {freeload} on his parents.
e.zh: 他宁愿打两份工也不愿白吃父母的。

e.en: Every office has at least one snack-stealing {freeloader}.
e.zh: 每个办公室都至少有一个偷零食的揩油党。

e.en: His cousin turned out to be a total {freeloader}.
e.zh: 他表弟原来是个十足的吃白食者。

freely.t: adv. 自由地；毫无保留地

e.en: Feel {freely} to ask questions during the presentation.
e.zh: 演讲过程中欢迎随时提问。

e.en: Information now flows {freely} across the internet.
e.zh: 如今信息在互联网上自由流通。

e.en: In medieval towns, a {freeman} could trade without paying tolls.
e.zh: 在中世纪的城镇里，自由民可以免税经商。

e.en: He was granted the title of {freeman} of the city.
e.zh: 他被授予该市的荣誉市民称号。

e.en: The Smiths and the {Freemans} live on the same quiet street.
e.zh: 史密斯家和弗里曼家住在同一条安静的街上。

e.en: The {Freemans} hosted a barbecue for the whole neighborhood.
e.zh: 弗里曼一家为整个街区办了一场烧烤聚会。

freemantle.t: n. 弗里曼特尔（澳洲港口城市）

e.en: We caught the ferry from {Freemantle} to Rottnest Island.
e.zh: 我们从弗里曼特尔搭渡轮去罗特尼斯岛。

e.en: {Freemantle} is famous for its weekend markets and cafes.
e.zh: 弗里曼特尔以周末市集和咖啡馆闻名。

e.en: His grandfather was a {freemason} for over fifty years.
e.zh: 他的祖父做共济会员超过五十年。

e.en: The novel revolves around a secret {freemason} ritual.
e.zh: 这部小说围绕一场秘密的共济会仪式展开。

e.en: {Freemasonry} has lodges in nearly every major city worldwide.
e.zh: 共济会在全球几乎每座大城市都设有分会。

e.en: Historians still debate the political influence of {freemasonry}.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍在讨论共济会的政治影响。

e.en: Call our {freephone} number for technical support.
e.zh: 如需技术支持，请拨打我们的免费电话。

e.en: The advert listed a {freephone} number in bold print.
e.zh: 广告上用粗体列出了一个免费咨询电话。

e.en: Return the form using the enclosed {freepost} envelope.
e.zh: 请用随附的免邮信封寄回表格。

e.en: Mark the package {freepost} so customers don't pay shipping.
e.zh: 在包裹上标注免邮，这样顾客就不用付运费。

frees.t: v. 释放；解除（free 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Closing unused tabs {frees} up a lot of memory.
e.zh: 关闭不用的标签页能释放很多内存。

e.en: Meal-prepping on Sunday {frees} my weeknights for hobbies.
e.zh: 周日做好备餐能腾出工作日晚上的爱好时间。

e.en: The bouquet smelled strongly of {freesia} and roses.
e.zh: 花束散发着浓郁的小苍兰和玫瑰香。

e.en: She planted {freesia} bulbs along the garden path.
e.zh: 她沿着花园小径种下了小苍兰球茎。

freestanding.t: adj. 独立式的；无依托的

e.en: They installed a {freestanding} bathtub in the new bathroom.
e.zh: 他们在新浴室里装了一个独立式浴缸。

e.en: The sculpture is {freestanding} and visible from all sides.
e.zh: 这座雕塑是独立式的，从各个角度都能看到。

e.en: I prefer {freestone} peaches because the pit comes out cleanly.
e.zh: 我更喜欢离核桃，因为果核很容易取出。

e.en: The cathedral was built from local {freestone}.
e.zh: 这座大教堂是用当地的易切石建造的。

freestyle.t:
n. 自由式（泳、摔跤等）
adj. 自由式的

e.en: He won the gold medal in the 200-meter {freestyle}.
e.zh: 他赢得了 200 米自由泳金牌。

e.en: The rapper started to {freestyle} over the new beat.
e.zh: 那位说唱歌手开始即兴地随着新节拍说唱。

freetown.t: n. 弗里敦（塞拉利昂首都）

e.en: {Freetown} is the bustling capital of Sierra Leone.
e.zh: 弗里敦是塞拉利昂繁忙的首都。

e.en: Our flight to {Freetown} was delayed by heavy rain.
e.zh: 我们飞往弗里敦的航班因大雨延误了。

e.en: He uses {freeware} to edit photos on his old laptop.
e.zh: 他在旧笔记本上用免费软件修图。

e.en: This {freeware} is reliable but has no official support.
e.zh: 这款免费软件很可靠，但没有官方技术支持。

e.en: Traffic on the {freeway} is awful during rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时段高速公路上的交通糟透了。

e.en: Take the {freeway} exit just past the airport.
e.zh: 过了机场就下高速出口。

freewheel.t: v. （车辆）滑行；随心所欲行事

e.en: The kids love to {freewheel} down the gentle hill.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢从缓坡上滑行下来。

e.en: He let the bike {freewheel} for the last mile home.
e.zh: 回家最后一英里他让自行车自由滑行。

freewheeling.t: adj. 无拘无束的；随心所欲的

e.en: The podcast has a fun, {freewheeling} conversational style.
e.zh: 这档播客风格轻松随性，对话自由。

e.en: She enjoyed the {freewheeling} lifestyle of being a digital nomad.
e.zh: 她享受数字游民那种无拘无束的生活方式。

freeze.t:
v. 冻结；（画面、程序）卡住
n. 冻结；严寒

e.en: Please {freeze} the leftover soup for next week.
e.zh: 请把剩下的汤冷冻起来下周吃。

e.en: My laptop tends to {freeze} when too many tabs are open.
e.zh: 我的笔记本开太多标签页时容易卡死。

e.en: I keep ice cream in the {freezer} for hot days.
e.zh: 我把冰淇淋放在冷冻室里以备热天享用。

e.en: The {freezer} stopped working and everything melted overnight.
e.zh: 冰柜坏了,东西一夜之间全化了。

freezers.t: n. 冷冻柜（freezer 的复数）

e.en: The supermarket installed two new {freezers} this week.
e.zh: 超市本周新装了两台冷冻柜。

e.en: Commercial {freezers} use much more electricity than home models.
e.zh: 商用冷冻柜的耗电量远高于家用型号。

freezes.t: v. 冻结（freeze 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The lake {freezes} solid every January.
e.zh: 这个湖每年一月都会完全结冰。

e.en: The app {freezes} whenever I try to upload a video.
e.zh: 我一上传视频,这个应用就卡住。

freezing.t:
adj. 极冷的
n. 冰点；冻结

e.en: It's absolutely {freezing} outside today.
e.zh: 今天外面冷得要命。

e.en: She is {freezing} the berries to make jam later.
e.zh: 她正把浆果冷冻起来,以后做果酱。

e.en: We spent a sunny weekend cycling around {Freiburg}.
e.zh: 我们在弗赖堡骑车度过了一个阳光明媚的周末。

e.en: The university in {Freiburg} is famous for its medical research.
e.zh: 弗赖堡大学以医学研究闻名。

freight.t:
n. 货运；运费
v. 运输

e.en: The {freight} costs more than the product itself.
e.zh: 运费比商品本身还贵。

e.en: A long {freight} train blocked the crossing for ten minutes.
e.zh: 一列长长的货运列车把路口堵了十分钟。

freighted.t: adj. 负载的；充满（意味）的

e.en: Her words were {freighted} with quiet disappointment.
e.zh: 她的话里饱含着默默的失望。

e.en: The ship was heavily {freighted} with grain from Argentina.
e.zh: 这艘船满载着来自阿根廷的谷物。

e.en: A massive {freighter} slowly entered the harbor.
e.zh: 一艘巨大的货轮缓缓驶入港口。

e.en: The cargo was loaded onto a {freighter} bound for Shanghai.
e.zh: 货物被装上了开往上海的货船。

french.t:
adj. 法国的；法语的
n. 法语；法国人

e.en: She speaks {French} fluently after living in Paris.
e.zh: 在巴黎住过之后,她法语说得很流利。

e.en: We ordered {French} fries and a milkshake.
e.zh: 我们点了薯条和一杯奶昔。

e.en: The {Frenchman} next door bakes bread every morning.
e.zh: 隔壁那位法国人每天早上都烤面包。

e.en: A retired {Frenchman} taught me how to make croissants.
e.zh: 一位退休的法国人教我做羊角面包。

e.en: The {Frenchwoman} ran a small bookstore in the village.
e.zh: 那位法国女士在村里经营一家小书店。

e.en: A stylish {Frenchwoman} sat sketching by the river.
e.zh: 一位时髦的法国女子坐在河边写生。

e.en: The startup has a {frenetic} pace that exhausts new hires.
e.zh: 这家创业公司节奏狂乱,新员工常被累垮。

e.en: Tokyo's streets feel {frenetic} during the evening rush.
e.zh: 晚高峰时,东京的街头感觉忙乱不堪。

e.en: He typed {frenetically} to meet the midnight deadline.
e.zh: 他疯狂地敲键盘,赶在午夜前交稿。

e.en: Volunteers worked {frenetically} to sort the donations.
e.zh: 志愿者们手忙脚乱地分拣捐赠物资。

e.en: There was a {frenzied} rush for tickets when sales opened.
e.zh: 开售时大家疯狂抢票。

e.en: The fans gave a {frenzied} cheer as the band appeared.
e.zh: 乐队一出场,粉丝们就疯狂欢呼。

e.en: The puppy wagged its tail {frenziedly} at the door.
e.zh: 小狗在门口疯狂地摇尾巴。

e.en: She searched {frenziedly} through her bag for the keys.
e.zh: 她在包里疯狂地翻找钥匙。

e.en: Black Friday sparked a shopping {frenzy} at every mall.
e.zh: 黑色星期五在各大商场引发了抢购狂潮。

e.en: The post sent social media into a {frenzy}.
e.zh: 那条帖子在社交媒体上引爆了狂热讨论。

e.en: Different radio stations broadcast on different {frequencies}.
e.zh: 不同的电台在不同的频率上广播。

e.en: Dogs can hear {frequencies} far above human range.
e.zh: 狗能听到远超人类听觉范围的频率。

e.en: The {frequency} of software updates has increased lately.
e.zh: 近来软件更新的频率提高了。

e.en: Tune the radio to a slightly higher {frequency}.
e.zh: 把收音机调到稍高一点的频率。

frequent.t:
adj. 频繁的；常见的
v. 常去

e.en: She is a {frequent} visitor to our weekend market.
e.zh: 她是我们周末市集的常客。

e.en: Power cuts are {frequent} in this neighborhood.
e.zh: 这个街区经常停电。

e.en: I {frequently} check my phone for new messages.
e.zh: 我经常查看手机有没有新消息。

e.en: This question is asked {frequently} by new users.
e.zh: 新用户经常问这个问题。

e.en: The painter {Frere} is best known for his rural scenes.
e.zh: 画家弗雷尔以乡村题材作品最为人熟知。

e.en: In French, mon {frere} simply means my brother.
e.zh: 在法语里,mon frère 就是我兄弟的意思。

fresco.t: n. 湿壁画（绘于湿灰泥上的画）

e.en: Tourists admired the ceiling {fresco} for hours.
e.zh: 游客们花了好几个小时欣赏天顶上的湿壁画。

e.en: Restoring a Renaissance {fresco} requires extreme patience.
e.zh: 修复一幅文艺复兴时期的壁画需要极大的耐心。

e.en: We dined inside a beautifully {frescoed} hall.
e.zh: 我们在一座装饰着精美壁画的大厅里用餐。

e.en: The chapel ceiling is {frescoed} with biblical scenes.
e.zh: 小教堂的天花板上绘有圣经题材的壁画。

fresh.t:
adj. 新鲜的；崭新的
adj. 清新的（空气、气息）

e.en: I love starting the day with {fresh} coffee.
e.zh: 我喜欢用一杯新鲜咖啡开启一天。

e.en: The team needs a {fresh} approach to this problem.
e.zh: 团队需要用全新的思路来解决这个问题。

freshen.t: v. 使焕然一新；使变清新

e.en: Let me {freshen} your drink before dinner.
e.zh: 我在饭前给你的饮料续一下杯。

e.en: A quick shower will {freshen} you up after the flight.
e.zh: 飞机落地后冲个澡会让你立刻清爽起来。

freshener.t: n. 清新剂（如 air freshener 空气清新剂）

e.en: I hung a pine air {freshener} in the car.
e.zh: 我在车里挂了个松香味的空气清新剂。

e.en: This breath {freshener} actually tastes pretty good.
e.zh: 这款口气清新剂其实味道还不错。

freshening.t: v. freshen 的现在分词；使清新

e.en: A cool breeze was {freshening} the stuffy room.
e.zh: 一阵凉风让闷热的房间清新起来。

e.en: The wind is {freshening} ahead of the coming storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前,风正逐渐增强。

fresher.t:
adj. fresh 的比较级
n. (英) 大一新生

e.en: Morning air feels much {fresher} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后的清晨空气感觉清新多了。

e.en: She is a {fresher} just starting her university life.
e.zh: 她是个刚开始大学生活的新生。

e.en: The spring {freshet} swelled the river overnight.
e.zh: 春汛一夜之间让河水暴涨。

e.en: Melting snow caused a sudden {freshet} downstream.
e.zh: 融化的积雪让下游突然涨了一场春潮。

e.en: The bakery smells of {freshly} baked bread.
e.zh: 这家面包店里飘着刚出炉面包的香味。

e.en: He served the salad with {freshly} ground pepper.
e.zh: 他在沙拉上撒了现磨的胡椒。

e.en: As a {freshman}, he joined the debate club right away.
e.zh: 作为一名大一新生,他立刻加入了辩论社。

e.en: The {freshman} dorm is the loudest building on campus.
e.zh: 新生宿舍是校园里最吵的一栋楼。

freshmen.t: n. freshman 的复数；大一新生们

e.en: Hundreds of {freshmen} crowded the orientation tent.
e.zh: 数百名新生挤满了迎新帐篷。

e.en: Most {freshmen} take introductory courses in their first semester.
e.zh: 大多数新生第一学期都会修入门课程。

e.en: Vacuum sealing helps preserve the {freshness} of coffee.
e.zh: 真空密封有助于保持咖啡的新鲜度。

e.en: There's a certain {freshness} to her writing style.
e.zh: 她的写作风格有一种独特的清新感。

freshwater.t:
adj. 淡水的
n. 淡水

e.en: This lake is home to many {freshwater} fish species.
e.zh: 这片湖里栖息着许多淡水鱼种。

e.en: Only three percent of Earth's water is {freshwater}.
e.zh: 地球上只有百分之三的水是淡水。

fret.t:
v. 烦恼、焦虑
n. (吉他的) 品丝

e.en: Don't {fret} about the test — you've prepared well.
e.zh: 别为考试发愁,你准备得很充分了。

e.en: He pressed down hard on the top {fret} of the guitar.
e.zh: 他用力按住吉他最上方的品格。

e.en: Her fingers glided smoothly along the {fretboard}.
e.zh: 她的手指在指板上流畅地滑动。

e.en: This guitar has a rosewood {fretboard} with pearl inlays.
e.zh: 这把吉他有一块镶珍珠的玫瑰木指板。

fretful.t: adj. 烦躁的；焦虑不安的

e.en: The {fretful} baby refused to sleep all afternoon.
e.zh: 那个烦躁的宝宝一整个下午都不肯睡。

e.en: He grew {fretful} as the delay dragged on.
e.zh: 延误持续下去,他变得焦躁不安。

e.en: She paced {fretfully} while waiting for the results.
e.zh: 她焦躁地踱步,等待结果出来。

e.en: The toddler tugged {fretfully} at his mother's sleeve.
e.zh: 那个学步的孩子烦躁地拽着妈妈的袖子。

fretted.t:
v. fret 的过去式
adj. 带品丝的（乐器）

e.en: He {fretted} for days before sending the email.
e.zh: 他烦恼了好几天才发出那封邮件。

e.en: The ceiling was beautifully {fretted} with intricate patterns.
e.zh: 天花板上雕饰着精美复杂的花纹。

fretting.t: v. fret 的现在分词；烦躁、担忧

e.en: Stop {fretting} over things you cannot control.
e.zh: 别再为你无法掌控的事情烦恼了。

e.en: She was {fretting} about being late to the interview.
e.zh: 她正为面试要迟到而焦虑不已。

fretwork.t: n. 镂空雕花；回纹装饰

e.en: The wooden screen featured delicate {fretwork} along the edges.
e.zh: 那扇木屏风边缘装饰着精致的镂花。

e.en: Victorian houses often have ornate {fretwork} on the porches.
e.zh: 维多利亚风格的房子门廊常有华丽的镂空雕饰。

freud.t: n. 弗洛伊德（精神分析学创始人）

e.en: {Freud} changed how we think about dreams and the mind.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德改变了我们对梦境和心灵的看法。

e.en: Many of {Freud}'s theories remain controversial today.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德的许多理论至今仍存在争议。

freudian.t: adj. 弗洛伊德的；精神分析学派的

e.en: That was a classic {Freudian} slip during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时那真是典型的弗洛伊德式口误。

e.en: The film offers a {Freudian} reading of family conflict.
e.zh: 这部电影从弗洛伊德视角解读家庭冲突。

freudianism.t: n. 弗洛伊德主义；精神分析学说

e.en: {Freudianism} dominated psychology for much of the 20th century.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德学说在20世纪大部分时间里主导着心理学。

e.en: Modern therapists rarely rely strictly on {Freudianism}.
e.zh: 现代治疗师很少严格依赖弗洛伊德学说。

frey.t: n. 弗雷（北欧神话丰饶之神）

e.en: In Norse myth, {Frey} is the god of fertility and harvest.
e.zh: 在北欧神话中,弗雷是丰收与生育之神。

e.en: Glenn {Frey} co-founded the Eagles in the early 1970s.
e.zh: 格伦·弗雷在七十年代初共同创立了老鹰乐队。

frg.t: n. 联邦德国（Federal Republic of Germany 缩写）

e.en: During the Cold War, the {FRG} referred to West Germany.
e.zh: 冷战时期,FRG 指的是西德。

e.en: The {FRG} and the GDR reunified in 1990.
e.zh: 联邦德国和民主德国于1990年实现统一。

e.en: The calendar shows the meeting is on {Fri} at 3 p.m.
e.zh: 日历上显示会议在周五下午三点。

e.en: I marked the deadline as {Fri} in my planner.
e.zh: 我在记事本上把截止日期标成了周五。

e.en: The soil here is dry and {friable}, perfect for planting.
e.zh: 这里的土壤干燥松脆,非常适合种植。

e.en: Old asbestos becomes {friable} and dangerous over time.
e.zh: 老旧的石棉久了会变得易碎,十分危险。

friar.t: n. (天主教) 修士、托钵僧

e.en: A gentle {friar} greeted us at the monastery gate.
e.zh: 一位和蔼的修士在修道院门口迎接我们。

e.en: The {friar} spent his days tending the herb garden.
e.zh: 那位修士每天都在打理药草园。

e.en: The old {friary} on the hill now houses a small museum.
e.zh: 山上那座古老的修道院如今改建成了一座小型博物馆。

e.en: Monks lived peacefully in the {friary} for centuries.
e.zh: 修士们在这座修道院里平静地生活了几个世纪。

e.en: We spent a weekend exploring the medieval streets of {Fribourg}.
e.zh: 我们用了一个周末游览弗里堡的中世纪街道。

e.en: {Fribourg} is known for its bilingual French and German culture.
e.zh: 弗里堡以其法德双语文化而闻名。

fricassee.t: n. 白汁烩肉（法式菜肴）

e.en: She served chicken {fricassee} with creamy mushroom sauce.
e.zh: 她端上了配奶油蘑菇酱的炖鸡。

e.en: The recipe for rabbit {fricassee} has been in our family for generations.
e.zh: 这道炖兔肉的食谱在我们家已经传了好几代。

fricative.t:
n. (语音学) 擦音
adj. 摩擦音的

e.en: The sound 'f' is a {fricative} produced by air friction.
e.zh: 音素 f 是一种由气流摩擦产生的擦音。

e.en: English has more {fricative} consonants than many other languages.
e.zh: 英语中的擦音辅音比许多其他语言都要多。

friction.t:
n. 摩擦；摩擦力
n. 摩擦、矛盾（人际）

e.en: There has been some {friction} between the two departments lately.
e.zh: 最近两个部门之间出现了一些摩擦。

e.en: Brakes work by using {friction} to slow the wheels.
e.zh: 刹车的原理是利用摩擦力来减慢车轮。

frictional.t: adj. 摩擦的；因摩擦产生的

e.en: Engineers calculate {frictional} forces when designing machines.
e.zh: 工程师在设计机械时会计算摩擦力。

e.en: The economy still has some {frictional} unemployment between jobs.
e.zh: 经济中仍存在一些换工作过程中的摩擦性失业。

frictionless.t: adj. 无摩擦的；顺畅无阻的

e.en: The app promises a {frictionless} checkout experience.
e.zh: 这款应用承诺提供顺畅无阻的结账体验。

e.en: In physics class we imagine a {frictionless} surface for simplicity.
e.zh: 在物理课上,我们为了简化会假设一个无摩擦的表面。

e.en: Let's grab dinner together this {Friday} after work.
e.zh: 我们这周五下班后一起去吃晚饭吧。

e.en: {Friday} is usually the busiest night at the restaurant.
e.zh: 周五通常是餐厅最忙的一个晚上。

fridays.t:
n. 星期五（复数）
adv. 每逢周五

e.en: Our team works from home on {Fridays}.
e.zh: 我们团队周五都在家办公。

e.en: She always orders pizza on {Fridays} as a treat.
e.zh: 她每个周五都会点披萨犒劳自己。

fridge.t: n. 冰箱（refrigerator 的口语说法）

e.en: There's leftover pizza in the {fridge} if you're hungry.
e.zh: 你饿的话冰箱里还有剩的披萨。

e.en: We need a bigger {fridge} for the new apartment.
e.zh: 新公寓需要一台更大的冰箱。

e.en: Modern {fridges} use much less electricity than older models.
e.zh: 现代的冰箱比旧款省电得多。

e.en: The store sells {fridges} in many different sizes and styles.
e.zh: 这家店出售各种尺寸和款式的冰箱。

fried.t:
adj. 油炸的；煎的
v. fry 的过去式

e.en: I'll have two {fried} eggs with toast for breakfast.
e.zh: 我早餐要两个煎蛋配吐司。

e.en: After three nights of no sleep, my brain is totally {fried}.
e.zh: 连续三晚没睡,我的脑子完全废了。

friend.t:
n. 朋友
v. 加为好友

e.en: My best {friend} is flying in from Tokyo next week.
e.zh: 我最好的朋友下周要从东京飞过来。

e.en: She added me as a {friend} on the new app.
e.zh: 她在那款新应用上把我加为好友了。

friendless.t: adj. 没有朋友的，孤单的

e.en: He felt lonely and {friendless} after moving to a new city.
e.zh: 搬到新城市后他感到孤独又没有朋友。

e.en: No child should grow up {friendless} and isolated.
e.zh: 没有孩子应该在没有朋友的孤立中长大。

e.en: The hotel staff impressed us with their warmth and {friendliness}.
e.zh: 酒店员工的热情和友好给我们留下了深刻印象。

e.en: Her natural {friendliness} makes everyone feel welcome.
e.zh: 她天生的友善让每个人都感到很受欢迎。

e.en: The survey compared the relative {friendlinesses} of different city neighborhoods.
e.zh: 这项调查比较了不同城市街区的友好程度。

e.en: Researchers measured the {friendlinesses} of various dog breeds toward strangers.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了不同犬种对陌生人的友善程度。

e.en: The new neighbors are really {friendly} and helpful.
e.zh: 新邻居非常友好,也很乐于助人。

e.en: This app has a clean, user-{friendly} interface.
e.zh: 这款应用界面简洁,对用户很友好。

e.en: I'm meeting some {friends} for coffee this afternoon.
e.zh: 我今天下午要和几个朋友一起去喝咖啡。

e.en: She has thousands of {friends} on social media.
e.zh: 她在社交媒体上有成千上万的好友。

e.en: Their {friendship} has lasted more than twenty years.
e.zh: 他们的友谊已经维持了二十多年。

e.en: Online games can lead to genuine {friendship} across continents.
e.zh: 网络游戏能促成跨越大洲的真挚友谊。

e.en: College is where many lifelong {friendships} begin.
e.zh: 大学是许多终身友谊开始的地方。

e.en: Maintaining {friendships} takes effort once everyone gets busy.
e.zh: 等大家都忙起来后,维系友谊需要花心思。

e.en: Can I get a large order of {fries} with that burger?
e.zh: 汉堡能再加一份大薯条吗?

e.en: She {fries} the onions until they turn golden brown.
e.zh: 她把洋葱煎到金黄色。

friesian.t: n. 荷斯坦乳牛；弗里斯兰马

e.en: The farm raises black-and-white {Friesian} cows for milk.
e.zh: 这家农场养殖黑白相间的弗里斯兰奶牛产奶。

e.en: She rides a beautiful {Friesian} horse with a flowing black mane.
e.zh: 她骑着一匹长着飘逸黑鬃的漂亮弗里斯兰马。

frieze.t: n. 建筑中楣，装饰横条

e.en: A carved {frieze} runs along the top of the temple wall.
e.zh: 神庙墙顶沿着一圈雕刻的装饰带。

e.en: The museum displays a {frieze} from ancient Greece.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件来自古希腊的雕带。

e.en: The naval {frigate} patrols the coast for smugglers.
e.zh: 这艘海军护卫舰在海岸巡逻搜查走私者。

e.en: A {frigate} bird soared effortlessly above the tropical island.
e.zh: 一只军舰鸟在热带岛屿上空轻松地翱翔。

e.en: Two {frigates} were dispatched to escort the cargo ships.
e.zh: 两艘护卫舰被派去为货船护航。

e.en: The shipyard is building three new {frigates} for the navy.
e.zh: 造船厂正在为海军建造三艘新护卫舰。

frigging.t:
adj. 该死的（委婉脏话）
adv. 非常

e.en: Where's my {frigging} phone? I just had it!
e.zh: 我那破手机哪去了?刚才还在手上呢!

e.en: It's {frigging} cold outside today, bring a coat.
e.zh: 今天外面冷得要命,带件外套吧。

e.en: The loud bang gave me quite a {fright}.
e.zh: 那声巨响把我吓了一大跳。

e.en: She jumped back in {fright} when the cat suddenly appeared.
e.zh: 猫突然冒出来时,她吓得往后一跳。

e.en: Loud thunder can {frighten} small children at night.
e.zh: 夜里响雷可能会吓到小孩子。

e.en: Don't {frighten} the birds, they'll fly away.
e.zh: 别吓到那些鸟,它们会飞走的。

e.en: The {frightened} puppy hid under the couch during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨时,受惊的小狗躲到了沙发底下。

e.en: She was too {frightened} to speak in front of the crowd.
e.zh: 她太害怕了,不敢在人群面前讲话。

frightener.t: n. 令人害怕的人或物

e.en: That late-night phone call really put the {frightener} on me.
e.zh: 那个深夜来电真的把我吓得不轻。

e.en: His sudden anger was a real {frightener} for everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他突然发火可把屋里每个人都吓坏了。

e.en: It's {frightening} how quickly the wildfire spread.
e.zh: 野火蔓延的速度快得令人害怕。

e.en: She watched a {frightening} horror movie all alone.
e.zh: 她独自一人看了一部吓人的恐怖片。

e.en: The new chatbot is {frighteningly} good at writing essays.
e.zh: 这款新聊天机器人写文章好得令人害怕。

e.en: Prices have risen {frighteningly} fast over the past year.
e.zh: 过去一年里物价上涨得快得吓人。

frightens.t: v. 吓唬（frighten 第三人称单数）

e.en: Public speaking still {frightens} her even after years of practice.
e.zh: 即使练习了多年,公开演讲仍让她感到害怕。

e.en: What {frightens} most people about flying is turbulence.
e.zh: 大多数人对飞行最害怕的是颠簸。

frightful.t: adj. 可怕的，糟糕透顶的

e.en: We had a {frightful} time getting home in the snowstorm.
e.zh: 暴风雪中我们回家的过程糟糕透了。

e.en: Her hair looked absolutely {frightful} after the windy walk.
e.zh: 在大风中走完后她的头发看起来一团糟。

e.en: I'm {frightfully} sorry to bother you so late.
e.zh: 这么晚打扰你,我真是非常抱歉。

e.en: The exam was {frightfully} difficult this year.
e.zh: 今年的考试难得吓人。

e.en: The haunted house gave us several good {frights}.
e.zh: 那间鬼屋让我们结结实实被吓了好几次。

e.en: Roller coasters are designed to deliver harmless {frights}.
e.zh: 过山车的设计就是为了给人无害的惊吓。

e.en: A {frigid} wind blew across the empty parking lot.
e.zh: 一阵刺骨的寒风吹过空荡荡的停车场。

e.en: Her response to his apology was polite but {frigid}.
e.zh: 她对他道歉的回应礼貌但冷淡。

e.en: The {frigidity} of the Arctic winter shocked the new researchers.
e.zh: 北极冬天的严寒令新来的研究员震惊。

e.en: There was a noticeable {frigidity} in her tone during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议中她的语气里透着一丝明显的冷淡。

frill.t: n. 褶边饰物；多余的花哨装饰

e.en: Her dress had a delicate lace {frill} along the hem.
e.zh: 她的连衣裙下摆缀着一圈精致的蕾丝褶边。

e.en: This basic plan offers no extra {frill} or hidden features.
e.zh: 这个基础套餐没有任何额外花哨功能或隐藏特性。

e.en: She wore a {frilled} blouse with high-waisted jeans.
e.zh: 她穿了一件荷叶边衬衫搭配高腰牛仔裤。

e.en: The {frilled} lizard puffs out its neck to scare predators.
e.zh: 褶伞蜥会撑开颈部褶皱来吓跑捕食者。

e.en: The little girl loved her {frilly} pink party dress.
e.zh: 小女孩很喜欢她那条带荷叶边的粉色派对裙。

e.en: He prefers simple shirts to anything too {frilly}.
e.zh: 他喜欢简单的衬衫,不喜欢太花哨的款式。

fringe.t:
n. 流苏；边缘，边缘群体
v. 给…加边饰

e.en: His ideas were once considered {fringe} but are now mainstream.
e.zh: 他的想法曾被视为非主流,如今却已成为主流观点。

e.en: She trimmed her {fringe} a little too short this time.
e.zh: 这次她把刘海剪得有点太短了。

e.en: The lake is {fringed} with tall pine trees.
e.zh: 湖边环绕着高大的松树。

e.en: She bought a leather jacket {fringed} with brown tassels.
e.zh: 她买了一件边缘缀有棕色流苏的皮夹克。

e.en: The festival attracts a {fringy} crowd of artists and dreamers.
e.zh: 这个节日吸引了一群非主流的艺术家和梦想家。

e.en: She wore a {fringy} suede vest to the concert.
e.zh: 她穿着一件带流苏的麂皮马甲去看演唱会。

frippery.t: n. 俗丽的装饰；无谓的花哨

e.en: He dismissed the awards ceremony as expensive {frippery}.
e.zh: 他把这场颁奖典礼贬为昂贵的虚饰。

e.en: The minimalist designer avoided any kind of decorative {frippery}.
e.zh: 这位极简主义设计师避免任何形式的装饰性浮华。

e.en: We threw a {frisbee} around at the park all afternoon.
e.zh: 我们在公园里玩了一下午飞盘。

e.en: Our dog can catch a {frisbee} mid-air every time.
e.zh: 我们家的狗每次都能在空中接住飞盘。

frisk.t: v. 搜身检查；欢蹦乱跳

e.en: Security guards may {frisk} visitors before the concert begins.
e.zh: 演唱会开始前保安可能会对观众进行搜身。

e.en: The lambs {frisk} happily across the spring meadow.
e.zh: 小羊羔在春天的草地上欢快地蹦跳。

frisket.t: n. 印刷机上的遮纸框

e.en: The printer used a {frisket} to mask the page edges during printing.
e.zh: 印刷工用挡纸框在印刷时遮住页面边缘。

e.en: Watercolor artists sometimes apply a {frisket} to protect highlights.
e.zh: 水彩画家有时会用遮蔽液来保护高光部分。

frisky.t: adj. 活泼的，欢蹦乱跳的

e.en: The puppy gets really {frisky} after his afternoon nap.
e.zh: 小狗午睡醒来后变得特别欢腾活泼。

e.en: Grandpa was feeling a bit {frisky} and asked grandma to dance.
e.zh: 爷爷有点兴致勃勃,邀请奶奶跳舞。

e.en: A {frisson} of excitement ran through the crowd as the band appeared.
e.zh: 乐队出现时,人群中掠过一阵兴奋的悸动。

e.en: The mystery novel gave her a delicious {frisson} of fear.
e.zh: 这本悬疑小说让她感到一阵令人愉悦的恐惧颤栗。

frith.t: n. 河口，海湾（古/方言用法）

e.en: The ancient {frith} offered sanctuary to weary travelers in medieval times.
e.zh: 古时候，这片林地为疲惫的旅人提供庇护。

e.en: Old laws once protected the king's {frith} from poachers.
e.zh: 古老的法律曾保护国王的林地不受偷猎者侵扰。

e.en: I made a vegetable {frittata} for brunch this morning.
e.zh: 我今早做了蔬菜烘蛋当早午餐。

e.en: This {frittata} recipe uses fresh spinach and goat cheese.
e.zh: 这道意式烘蛋用了新鲜菠菜和山羊奶酪。

fritter.t:
n. 油炸馅饼
v. 浪费（时间、钱）

e.en: Don't {fritter} away your savings on impulse purchases.
e.zh: 别把存款浪费在冲动消费上。

e.en: She ordered an apple {fritter} with her morning coffee.
e.zh: 她点了一个苹果油炸馅饼配晨间咖啡。

fritz.t: n. 故障（on the fritz 坏掉）

e.en: My old laptop is finally on the {fritz} again.
e.zh: 我那台旧笔记本电脑又出毛病了。

e.en: The air conditioner went on the {fritz} during the heatwave.
e.zh: 空调在热浪期间彻底罢工了。

e.en: The boss has no patience for {frivolity} during meetings.
e.zh: 老板在开会时容不得任何轻浮举动。

e.en: A bit of {frivolity} can lighten even the dullest party.
e.zh: 一点轻松俏皮能让最沉闷的派对都活跃起来。

e.en: The judge dismissed the {frivolous} lawsuit immediately.
e.zh: 法官当即驳回了这起无聊的诉讼。

e.en: She regretted her {frivolous} spending after seeing the bill.
e.zh: 看到账单后她为自己乱花钱感到后悔。

e.en: He spent his inheritance {frivolously} on luxury cars.
e.zh: 他把遗产轻率地挥霍在豪车上。

e.en: Don't treat important decisions {frivolously}.
e.zh: 重要的决定不要草率对待。

frizz.t:
n. 卷曲毛躁的头发
v. 使卷曲

e.en: Humidity always makes my hair {frizz} uncontrollably.
e.zh: 潮湿天气总让我的头发毛躁得无法控制。

e.en: This serum tames {frizz} and adds shine.
e.zh: 这款精华能抚平毛躁并增添光泽。

e.en: She tied back her {frizzy} hair before the workout.
e.zh: 她在锻炼前把毛躁的头发扎了起来。

e.en: The rain left everyone with {frizzy} hair at the picnic.
e.zh: 野餐时一场雨让大家的头发都变得毛糙。

fro.t: adv. 向后（多用于 to and fro 来回）

e.en: The pendulum swung to and {fro} steadily.
e.zh: 钟摆稳定地来回摆动着。

e.en: He paced to and {fro} waiting for the test results.
e.zh: 他来回踱步等待检测结果。

e.en: She wore a vintage {frock} to the garden party.
e.zh: 她穿了一件复古连衣裙参加花园派对。

e.en: The little girl twirled in her new floral {frock}.
e.zh: 小女孩穿着新的碎花连衣裙转圈圈。

frodo.t: n. 弗罗多（《指环王》角色名）

e.en: In the novel, {Frodo} carries the One Ring to Mordor.
e.zh: 小说中，弗罗多把魔戒带去了魔多。

e.en: My cat is named {Frodo} after the Hobbit hero.
e.zh: 我的猫以霍比特英雄弗罗多命名。

e.en: A green {frog} leaped from the lily pad into the pond.
e.zh: 一只绿青蛙从睡莲叶上跳进了池塘。

e.en: The kids learned about the life cycle of a {frog}.
e.zh: 孩子们学习了青蛙的生命周期。

e.en: He woke up with a {froggy} voice from the cold.
e.zh: 他感冒后醒来嗓子哑得像青蛙叫。

e.en: The pond had a distinctly {froggy} smell that summer.
e.zh: 那个夏天池塘有种明显的青蛙气味。

e.en: A military {frogman} disarmed the underwater mine.
e.zh: 一名军方蛙人拆除了水下的地雷。

e.en: The {frogman} surfaced after a long reconnaissance dive.
e.zh: 蛙人在长时间侦察潜水后浮出水面。

frogmarch.t: v. 架住双臂强行押走

e.en: Security guards {frogmarch} the protester out of the hall.
e.zh: 保安将抗议者强行押出大厅。

e.en: Police had to {frogmarch} the drunk man into the cruiser.
e.zh: 警察不得不把那名醉汉强行押进警车。

e.en: The {frogs} croaked loudly all through the summer night.
e.zh: 青蛙们在整个夏夜里大声鸣叫。

e.en: Scientists are studying why local {frogs} are disappearing.
e.zh: 科学家正在研究本地青蛙消失的原因。

frolic.t:
v. 嬉戏；欢闹
n. 玩乐

e.en: The puppies {frolic} in the freshly fallen snow.
e.zh: 小狗们在新落的雪地里嬉戏。

e.en: Children {frolic} on the beach while parents relaxed.
e.zh: 孩子们在沙滩上欢闹，父母则在一旁放松。

froliced.t: v. 嬉戏（frolic 的过去式，非规范拼写）

e.en: The lambs {froliced} across the meadow at sunrise.
e.zh: 羊羔们在日出时跑遍草地嬉戏。

e.en: They {froliced} in the waves until sunset.
e.zh: 他们在海浪中嬉戏直到日落。

frolicing.t: v. 嬉戏（frolic 的现在分词，非规范拼写）

e.en: The dolphins were {frolicing} alongside our boat.
e.zh: 海豚在我们的船边欢快地嬉戏。

e.en: Kids spent the afternoon {frolicing} in the sprinklers.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在喷水器下嬉闹。

frolick.t: v. 嬉戏（frolic 的旧拼写）

e.en: The kittens {frolick} together in the sunbeam.
e.zh: 小猫们在阳光下一起嬉戏。

e.en: Otters {frolick} playfully along the rocky shore.
e.zh: 水獭沿着岩石海岸嬉戏玩闹。

e.en: The children's summer {frolics} filled the park with laughter.
e.zh: 孩子们夏日的嬉戏让公园充满了笑声。

e.en: Our dog {frolics} happily whenever we visit the lake.
e.zh: 我们去湖边时狗狗总是欢快地撒欢。

e.en: The {frolicsome} puppy wouldn't stop chasing its tail.
e.zh: 那只活泼的小狗一直追着自己的尾巴跑。

e.en: She had a {frolicsome} spirit that lifted everyone's mood.
e.zh: 她那爱嬉闹的性格让大家的心情都变好了。

e.en: This package arrived {from} Japan yesterday afternoon.
e.zh: 这个包裹昨天下午从日本寄到了。

e.en: She works {from} home three days a week.
e.zh: 她每周有三天在家办公。

frome.t: n. 弗罗姆（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: The town of {Frome} in Somerset hosts a famous market.
e.zh: 萨默塞特郡的弗罗姆镇有一个著名的集市。

e.en: We drove through {Frome} on our way to Bath.
e.zh: 我们去巴斯的路上经过了弗罗姆。

frond.t: n. 蕨类或棕榈的大叶片

e.en: A single palm {frond} fell onto the patio table.
e.zh: 一片棕榈叶落到了露台桌子上。

e.en: Ferns unfurled their delicate {frond} in the morning light.
e.zh: 蕨类植物在晨光中舒展着柔嫩的叶片。

front.t:
n. 前面；正面
adj. 前部的

e.en: Please sit in the {front} row for the presentation.
e.zh: 请坐在前排观看演示。

e.en: A cold {front} is moving in from the north tonight.
e.zh: 今晚一股冷锋将从北方移入。

frontage.t: n. 房屋或地块的正面；临街面

e.en: The shop has wide {frontage} on the busy main street.
e.zh: 这家店铺在繁忙的主街上有宽阔的临街面。

e.en: Properties with river {frontage} sell at a premium.
e.zh: 临河的房产能卖出溢价。

e.en: The {frontal} attack caught the defenders off guard.
e.zh: 正面攻击让防御者措手不及。

e.en: Damage to the {frontal} lobe affects decision-making.
e.zh: 额叶受损会影响决策能力。

frontality.t: n. 正面性（艺术构图术语）

e.en: Egyptian art is known for its strict {frontality} of figures.
e.zh: 埃及艺术以人物严格的正面性而闻名。

e.en: The portrait's {frontality} gives it a confrontational feel.
e.zh: 这幅肖像的正面构图带来一种对峙感。

e.en: The car was struck {frontally} at the intersection.
e.zh: 汽车在十字路口被正面撞击。

e.en: She addressed the issue {frontally} during the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议中正面回应了这个问题。

frontbencher.t: n. 英国议会前排议员

e.en: The {frontbencher} delivered a fierce response in Parliament.
e.zh: 这位前座议员在议会里作出了激烈的回应。

e.en: As a senior {frontbencher}, she shapes party policy.
e.zh: 作为资深前座议员，她主导着党派政策。

e.en: Their {frontcourt} dominated the rebounding all game.
e.zh: 他们的前场球员整场比赛都主导着篮板球。

e.en: The team needs more depth in the {frontcourt} this season.
e.zh: 球队本赛季需要前场更厚的板凳深度。

e.en: AI research is the new {frontier} of computer science.
e.zh: 人工智能研究是计算机科学的新前沿。

e.en: Settlers crossed the {frontier} in search of farmland.
e.zh: 拓荒者们越过边疆寻找农田。

e.en: Space exploration pushes the {frontiers} of human knowledge.
e.zh: 太空探索推动着人类知识的边界。

e.en: The treaty redrew the {frontiers} between the two nations.
e.zh: 该条约重新划定了两国之间的边界。

e.en: Daniel Boone became a legendary American {frontiersman}.
e.zh: 丹尼尔·布恩成了传奇的美国拓荒者。

e.en: The {frontiersman} built his cabin deep in the forest.
e.zh: 那位拓荒者在森林深处建起了小木屋。

e.en: The book's {frontispiece} features a hand-drawn map.
e.zh: 书的卷首插图是一张手绘地图。

e.en: An elaborate {frontispiece} graced the old encyclopedia.
e.zh: 那本旧百科全书的卷首有一幅精美的插图。

frontline.t:
n. 前线；第一线
adj. 一线的

e.en: Nurses worked tirelessly on the {frontline} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间护士们在一线不知疲倦地工作。

e.en: He spent two years as a {frontline} reporter in conflict zones.
e.zh: 他在冲突地区做了两年一线记者。

e.en: The band's charismatic {frontman} captivated the crowd.
e.zh: 乐队那位魅力十足的主唱征服了观众。

e.en: He served as the {frontman} for the company's marketing campaign.
e.zh: 他担任公司营销活动的代言人。

e.en: She emerged as the {frontrunner} in the early polls.
e.zh: 她在早期民调中成为领跑者。

e.en: The clear {frontrunner} for the award is a debut novel.
e.zh: 该奖项明显的热门人选是一本处女作小说。

fronts.t:
n. 前面（复数）
v. 面向

e.en: The company is making progress on multiple {fronts} this quarter.
e.zh: 公司本季度在多条战线上取得了进展。

e.en: Two storm {fronts} will collide over the Midwest tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天两股锋面将在中西部相遇。

e.en: He landed a clean {frontside} 180 on the halfpipe.
e.zh: 他在半管上漂亮地完成了一个正面180度旋转。

e.en: The skater attempted a {frontside} grind down the rail.
e.zh: 滑手尝试沿着栏杆做正面磨杆动作。

e.en: The {frosh} arrived on campus full of nervous excitement.
e.zh: 新生们带着紧张又兴奋的心情来到校园。

e.en: Our college hosts a welcome week for every {frosh} class.
e.zh: 我们大学为每届新生举办迎新周活动。

frost.t:
n. 霜；严寒
v. 结霜

e.en: A heavy {frost} damaged the citrus crops overnight.
e.zh: 一场严霜在一夜之间毁坏了柑橘作物。

e.en: She'll {frost} the cake once it cools completely.
e.zh: 她会在蛋糕完全冷却后给它涂糖霜。

e.en: Climbers risk {frostbite} on the summit without proper gear.
e.zh: 登山者在登顶时若装备不足就有冻伤的风险。

e.en: He lost two toes to {frostbite} during the expedition.
e.zh: 他在探险中因冻伤失去了两根脚趾。

e.en: His {frostbitten} fingers turned an alarming shade of white.
e.zh: 他冻伤的手指变成了令人担忧的白色。

e.en: The hiker returned from the mountain with {frostbitten} cheeks.
e.zh: 那名徒步者从山上回来时双颊冻伤了。

e.en: The bathroom window has {frosted} glass for privacy.
e.zh: 浴室窗户用磨砂玻璃以保护隐私。

e.en: She served {frosted} cupcakes at her daughter's birthday party.
e.zh: 她在女儿的生日派对上端出了裹着糖霜的纸杯蛋糕。

e.en: She greeted her ex-husband {frostily} at the gallery opening.
e.zh: 她在画廊开幕式上冷淡地跟前夫打了招呼。

e.en: The CEO {frostily} dismissed the reporter's question.
e.zh: CEO冷冰冰地拒绝回答记者的问题。

frosting.t: n. 蛋糕糖霜；磨砂处理

e.en: The chocolate cake had thick buttercream {frosting} on top.
e.zh: 巧克力蛋糕上盖着厚厚的奶油糖霜。

e.en: Kids licked the {frosting} off their fingers eagerly.
e.zh: 孩子们急切地舔着手指上的糖霜。

frosts.t:
n. 霜（复数）
v. 结霜

e.en: Late spring {frosts} can devastate young vineyard buds.
e.zh: 晚春的霜冻可能毁掉葡萄园的嫩芽。

e.en: She {frosts} every cake with handmade buttercream roses.
e.zh: 她给每个蛋糕都裱上手工制作的奶油玫瑰。

e.en: The grass was {frosty} when I left for work.
e.zh: 我出门上班时草地结了一层霜。

e.en: She gave him a {frosty} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子冷冷地看了他一眼。

froth.t:
n. 泡沫
v. 起泡

e.en: A thick layer of {froth} sat on top of the cappuccino.
e.zh: 卡布奇诺上面有一层厚厚的奶泡。

e.en: Waves crashed and left {froth} along the shore.
e.zh: 海浪拍打过后在岸边留下泡沫。

e.en: He was {frothing} milk for the morning lattes.
e.zh: 他正在打奶泡准备做早晨的拿铁。

e.en: The dog came back {frothing} at the mouth from the heat.
e.zh: 那只狗因高温回来时嘴边都是白沫。

e.en: She ordered a {frothy} matcha latte to go.
e.zh: 她点了一杯外带的奶泡抹茶拿铁。

e.en: The novel is a {frothy} summer read with no real depth.
e.zh: 这本小说是轻松的夏日读物,没什么深度。

froufrou.t: n. 花哨的装饰；衣料窸窣声

e.en: The dress was too {froufrou} for a casual dinner.
e.zh: 那条裙子对随意的晚餐来说太花哨了。

e.en: Her bedroom is full of {froufrou} pillows and lace.
e.zh: 她的卧室里到处是花哨的抱枕和蕾丝。

frown.t:
v. 皱眉
n. 不悦的表情

e.en: A small {frown} appeared as he read the email.
e.zh: 他读邮件时眉头微微皱了起来。

e.en: Teachers tend to {frown} on phones during class.
e.zh: 老师们一般不赞成上课时使用手机。

e.en: She was {frowning} at her laptop screen all morning.
e.zh: 她整个上午都皱着眉看笔记本屏幕。

e.en: The boss kept {frowning} during the entire presentation.
e.zh: 整场演示老板一直皱着眉头。

e.en: He looked {frowsy} after pulling an all-nighter.
e.zh: 他熬了一整夜后看起来邋里邋遢的。

e.en: The motel room had a {frowsy}, unwashed smell.
e.zh: 那间汽车旅馆房间有股没洗过的霉味。

e.en: Her hair was {frowzy} from sleeping on the plane.
e.zh: 她在飞机上睡过觉,头发乱糟糟的。

e.en: The old bookshop had a charmingly {frowzy} atmosphere.
e.zh: 那家旧书店有种破旧却迷人的氛围。

froze.t: v. freeze 的过去式，冻结；僵住

e.en: The lake {froze} solid during the cold snap.
e.zh: 寒潮期间湖面完全冻结了。

e.en: My laptop {froze} right in the middle of the call.
e.zh: 我的笔记本在通话中间卡死了。

frozen.t:
adj. 冷冻的；冻结的
v. freeze 的过去分词

e.en: I keep a bag of {frozen} berries for smoothies.
e.zh: 我冰箱里常备一袋冷冻莓果做奶昔。

e.en: The screen is {frozen} again — try restarting the app.
e.zh: 屏幕又卡住了,试试重启一下应用。

frs.t: n. 英国皇家学会会员（Fellow of the Royal Society）

e.en: She added {FRS} after her name on her business card.
e.zh: 她在名片的名字后面加上了皇家学会会士头衔。

e.en: Only a handful of scientists are elected {FRS} each year.
e.zh: 每年只有少数科学家当选英国皇家学会会士。
