e.en: The label {FRU} marks the smallest replaceable part of the server.
e.zh: FRU标签标示出服务器中最小的可更换部件。

e.en: Technicians swap out a faulty {FRU} instead of the whole unit.
e.zh: 技术员只更换故障的现场可换单元,而不是整台机器。

e.en: Years of patient research finally began to {fructify}.
e.zh: 多年耐心的研究终于开始结出成果。

e.en: He hopes his small investments will {fructify} over time.
e.zh: 他希望自己的小笔投资随着时间会有回报。

e.en: Fruit juice contains a lot of natural {fructose}.
e.zh: 果汁中含有大量天然果糖。

e.en: She avoids drinks sweetened with high-{fructose} corn syrup.
e.zh: 她不喝用高果糖玉米糖浆调味的饮料。

e.en: My grandmother was famously {frugal} with electricity.
e.zh: 我奶奶以省电闻名。

e.en: They live a {frugal} lifestyle to save for early retirement.
e.zh: 他们过着节俭的生活,为提前退休存钱。

e.en: His {frugality} let him retire by forty.
e.zh: 他的节俭让他四十岁就退休了。

e.en: The book preaches {frugality} as the path to freedom.
e.zh: 这本书宣扬节俭是通向自由的途径。

e.en: She lives {frugally} despite earning a high salary.
e.zh: 尽管收入很高,她仍然过得很节俭。

e.en: Travel {frugally} and you can stay abroad much longer.
e.zh: 省着花的话,在国外能待得更久。

e.en: I try to eat {fruit} instead of candy in the afternoon.
e.zh: 下午我尽量吃水果而不是糖果。

e.en: His hard work finally bore {fruit} this quarter.
e.zh: 他的努力终于在这个季度有了成果。

e.en: My aunt sends a homemade {fruitcake} every Christmas.
e.zh: 我姑妈每年圣诞都会寄来自制的水果蛋糕。

e.en: He's a bit of a {fruitcake}, but harmless.
e.zh: 他有点疯疯癫癫的,但人畜无害。

fruited.t: adj. 结了果的；加入水果的

e.en: She baked a {fruited} loaf with raisins and cranberries.
e.zh: 她烤了一个加了葡萄干和蔓越莓的水果面包。

e.en: The orchard {fruited} heavily after the wet spring.
e.zh: 潮湿的春天过后,果园结果累累。

e.en: The local {fruiterer} has the best mangoes in town.
e.zh: 街边那家水果店的芒果是城里最好吃的。

e.en: She bought a basket of figs from the corner {fruiterer}.
e.zh: 她在街角的水果店买了一篮无花果。

fruitful.t: adj. 富有成效的；多产的

e.en: We had a {fruitful} discussion about the new product.
e.zh: 我们就新产品进行了一次富有成效的讨论。

e.en: His collaboration with the team was very {fruitful}.
e.zh: 他与团队的合作非常富有成果。

e.en: They worked {fruitfully} together for over a decade.
e.zh: 他们在一起卓有成效地合作了十多年。

e.en: The two researchers collaborated {fruitfully} on the project.
e.zh: 两位研究员在该项目上合作得很有成果。

e.en: Autumn is associated with harvest and {fruitfulness}.
e.zh: 秋天总让人联想到丰收与硕果。

e.en: The {fruitfulness} of the partnership surprised everyone.
e.zh: 这次合作的丰硕成果令所有人惊讶。

e.en: This wine has a pleasant {fruitiness} on the finish.
e.zh: 这款酒尾韵带有怡人的果香。

e.en: I love the {fruitiness} of the new shampoo.
e.zh: 我喜欢这款新洗发水的果香味。

fruiting.t:
v. 结果实
adj. 结果的

e.en: The apple trees are {fruiting} earlier this year.
e.zh: 今年苹果树结果比往年早。

e.en: Mushrooms produce a {fruiting} body above the soil.
e.zh: 蘑菇会在土壤上方长出子实体。

e.en: Years of planning finally came to {fruition} last week.
e.zh: 多年的规划终于在上周开花结果。

e.en: Her dream of opening a café came to {fruition}.
e.zh: 她开咖啡馆的梦想最终实现了。

e.en: Few startup ideas reach their full {fruitions}.
e.zh: 很少有创业点子能完全开花结果。

e.en: The book traces the {fruitions} of several social movements.
e.zh: 这本书追溯了几场社会运动的成果。

e.en: After hours of {fruitless} searching, we gave up.
e.zh: 找了几个小时毫无结果,我们就放弃了。

e.en: Arguing with him is usually {fruitless}.
e.zh: 和他争论通常都是徒劳。

e.en: He searched {fruitlessly} for his missing keys.
e.zh: 他徒劳地找了半天丢失的钥匙。

e.en: They negotiated {fruitlessly} for nearly a year.
e.zh: 他们谈判了将近一年,毫无结果。

e.en: This rosé has a light, {fruity} flavor.
e.zh: 这款桃红葡萄酒口感清爽带果味。

e.en: I prefer {fruity} candies over chocolate ones.
e.zh: 比起巧克力,我更喜欢水果糖。

e.en: She refused to be dressed up like a {frump} for the photo.
e.zh: 她拒绝在拍照时被打扮得土里土气。

e.en: He called himself a {frump} but secretly liked fashion.
e.zh: 他自称是个邋遢人,其实暗地里挺爱时尚的。

frumpy.t: adj. 衣着土气的；过时的

e.en: She thought the cardigan made her look {frumpy}.
e.zh: 她觉得这件开衫让她看起来很土气。

e.en: He swapped his {frumpy} suit for something more modern.
e.zh: 他把那身老气的西装换成了更时髦的款式。

e.en: Slow Wi-Fi can really {frustrate} remote workers.
e.zh: 网速慢真的会让远程办公者抓狂。

e.en: Heavy rain may {frustrate} our weekend plans.
e.zh: 大雨可能会打乱我们的周末计划。

e.en: I'm getting {frustrated} with this buggy app.
e.zh: 这个有bug的应用让我越来越烦躁。

e.en: She felt {frustrated} after waiting on hold for an hour.
e.zh: 等了一个小时电话,她感到很沮丧。

e.en: He sighed {frustratedly} and closed his laptop.
e.zh: 他沮丧地叹了口气,合上了笔记本。

e.en: She tapped the screen {frustratedly} when it froze.
e.zh: 屏幕卡住时她烦躁地敲打着屏幕。

frustrating.t: adj. 令人沮丧的；让人抓狂的

e.en: It's so {frustrating} when the website keeps logging me out.
e.zh: 网站老是把我登出,真让人抓狂。

e.en: Learning a new language can be {frustrating} at first.
e.zh: 刚开始学一门新语言可能会很令人沮丧。

e.en: The app is {frustratingly} slow on older phones.
e.zh: 这款应用在旧手机上慢得让人抓狂。

e.en: Her instructions were {frustratingly} vague.
e.zh: 她的指示含糊得让人着急。

e.en: He slammed the door in {frustration}.
e.zh: 他气得把门用力关上。

e.en: Customer {frustration} grew as the outage continued.
e.zh: 故障持续不断,客户的不满越来越强烈。

frustrations.t: n. frustration 的复数，种种挫败

e.en: She vented her {frustrations} to a close friend.
e.zh: 她向闺蜜倾诉自己的种种烦恼。

e.en: Daily commuting brings small {frustrations} for everyone.
e.zh: 每天通勤给每个人都带来不少小烦恼。

fry.t:
v. 油炸；煎
n. 薯条

e.en: I'll {fry} some eggs for breakfast.
e.zh: 我来煎几个鸡蛋当早餐。

e.en: Don't {fry} your phone by charging it in the rain.
e.zh: 别在雨中充电,会把手机弄坏的。

e.en: My air {fryer} makes the crispiest fries.
e.zh: 我的空气炸锅炸出来的薯条最酥脆。

e.en: He bought a deep {fryer} for homemade donuts.
e.zh: 他买了一台油炸锅在家做甜甜圈。

e.en: She's {frying} dumplings for the family dinner.
e.zh: 她正在煎饺子准备家庭晚餐。

e.en: The smell of {frying} bacon filled the kitchen.
e.zh: 煎培根的香味弥漫了整个厨房。

fsa.t: n. 金融服务局（Financial Services Authority）

e.en: I use my {FSA} card to pay for prescriptions.
e.zh: 我用医疗弹性账户的卡来支付处方药。

e.en: Don't forget to spend your {FSA} balance before year-end.
e.zh: 别忘了在年底前用完弹性消费账户的余额。

fta.t: n. 自由贸易协定（Free Trade Agreement）

e.en: The two countries signed a new {FTA} last month.
e.zh: 两国上个月签署了新的自由贸易协定。

e.en: The {FTA} should lower tariffs on most exported goods.
e.zh: 该自由贸易协定应能降低大多数出口商品的关税。

ftse.t: n. 富时指数（英国股市指数）

e.en: The {FTSE} 100 closed slightly higher today.
e.zh: 富时100指数今天收盘小幅上涨。

e.en: Many pension funds track the {FTSE} index.
e.zh: 许多养老基金追踪富时指数。

fuchsia.t: n. 紫红色；倒挂金钟花

e.en: She painted her nails a bright {fuchsia}.
e.zh: 她把指甲涂成了亮丽的紫红色。

e.en: The garden was full of pink {fuchsia} flowers.
e.zh: 花园里开满了粉色的倒挂金钟花。

e.en: Oh {fuck}, I left my wallet at home.
e.zh: 该死,我把钱包忘在家里了。

e.en: He doesn't give a {fuck} what anyone thinks.
e.zh: 他根本不在乎别人怎么想。

fucked.t: adj. 完蛋了；糟透了（粗俗）

e.en: My laptop is totally {fucked} after the coffee spill.
e.zh: 咖啡洒了之后我的笔记本彻底报废了。

e.en: We're {fucked} if the deadline doesn't get pushed back.
e.zh: 截止日期要是不能延后,我们就完蛋了。

e.en: That {fucker} cut me off in traffic again.
e.zh: 那个混蛋又在路上别我的车了。

e.en: The lazy {fucker} never replies to emails.
e.zh: 那个懒鬼从来不回邮件。

fucking.t: adj./adv. 他妈的（粗俗加强语气）

e.en: This {fucking} printer never works when I need it.
e.zh: 这台破打印机每次要用就坏。

e.en: That movie was {fucking} amazing last night.
e.zh: 昨晚那部电影真他妈精彩。

e.en: He looked {fuddled} after three glasses of wine.
e.zh: 他喝了三杯酒后看起来有点迷糊。

e.en: The complex instructions left her completely {fuddled}.
e.zh: 复杂的说明让她完全摸不着头脑。

fudge.t:
n. 奶油软糖
v. 含糊应付；蒙混

e.en: She bought a box of chocolate {fudge} as a gift.
e.zh: 她买了一盒巧克力软糖作为礼物。

e.en: Politicians often {fudge} the numbers in their reports.
e.zh: 政客们常常在报告中含糊处理数字。

fumble.t:
v. 摸索；笨手笨脚地做
n. 失球（橄榄球）

e.en: I watched him {fumble} for keys in his coat pocket.
e.zh: 我看着他在外套口袋里摸索钥匙。

e.en: The quarterback's {fumble} cost the team the championship game.
e.zh: 四分卫的失球让球队输掉了冠军赛。

fumbled.t: v. 摸索（fumble 的过去式）

e.en: She {fumbled} with the lock as the rain poured down.
e.zh: 大雨倾盆时,她笨拙地摆弄着锁。

e.en: He {fumbled} his answer during the live TV interview.
e.zh: 他在电视直播采访中回答得磕磕巴巴。

fumbling.t:
adj. 笨手笨脚的
v. 摸索（进行时）

e.en: After {fumbling} for words, she finally apologized to him.
e.zh: 她结结巴巴说了半天,终于向他道歉。

e.en: His {fumbling} attempts at cooking made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他笨拙的下厨尝试把大家都逗乐了。

fume.t:
v. 冒烟；发怒
n. 烟雾

e.en: Don't {fume} over things you cannot change.
e.zh: 别为你无法改变的事情而生闷气。

e.en: A toxic {fume} leaked from the chemical plant overnight.
e.zh: 一股有毒气体连夜从化工厂泄漏出来。

fumes.t:
n. 烟雾；废气
v. 冒烟（第三人称）

e.en: Diesel {fumes} filled the underground parking garage quickly.
e.zh: 柴油废气很快充满了地下停车场。

e.en: She always {fumes} when meetings start late without warning.
e.zh: 会议无故晚开,她总是气得不行。

e.en: The warehouse uses a strong {fumigant} to kill termites.
e.zh: 仓库使用强效熏蒸剂来灭白蚁。

e.en: This {fumigant} is banned in most European countries now.
e.zh: 这种熏蒸剂在大多数欧洲国家已被禁用。

e.en: They had to {fumigate} the apartment after the bedbug infestation.
e.zh: 床虫侵袭后,他们不得不熏蒸消毒整个公寓。

e.en: Workers will {fumigate} the greenhouse before planting new seeds.
e.zh: 工人们会在播种前对温室进行熏蒸。

e.en: The building is closed for {fumigation} until next Monday.
e.zh: 大楼因熏蒸消毒关闭至下周一。

e.en: Proper {fumigation} eliminated every cockroach in the old kitchen.
e.zh: 彻底的熏蒸消除了旧厨房里所有的蟑螂。

fuming.t: adj. 冒烟的；怒气冲冲的

e.en: She was {fuming} after reading his rude email reply.
e.zh: 看完他粗鲁的邮件回复后,她气炸了。

e.en: The wreck sat {fuming} on the highway shoulder for hours.
e.zh: 那辆残骸在高速路肩冒了几小时的烟。

fun.t:
n. 乐趣；好玩
adj. 有趣的

e.en: We had so much {fun} at the beach yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天在海滩玩得特别开心。

e.en: Learning a new language can be both hard and {fun}.
e.zh: 学一门新语言既辛苦又有趣。

funboard.t: n. 趣味冲浪板（短板风帆）

e.en: Beginners often start surfing on a stable {funboard}.
e.zh: 初学者通常用稳定的中长板开始冲浪。

e.en: She rented a {funboard} for the weekend surf lesson.
e.zh: 她为周末的冲浪课租了一块中长板。

funchal.t: n. 丰沙尔（葡萄牙城市）

e.en: We spent three days exploring {Funchal}, the capital of Madeira.
e.zh: 我们花了三天游览马德拉首府丰沙尔。

e.en: Cruise ships dock regularly at the harbor of {Funchal}.
e.zh: 游轮经常停靠在丰沙尔的港口。

function.t:
n. 功能；函数
v. 运行

e.en: This button's main {function} is to mute the microphone.
e.zh: 这个按钮的主要功能是把麦克风静音。

e.en: Define a {function} that returns the user's full name.
e.zh: 定义一个返回用户全名的函数。

e.en: The prototype is rough but fully {functional} for testing.
e.zh: 原型虽然粗糙,但完全可以用于测试。

e.en: Their kitchen design is sleek, minimal, and highly {functional}.
e.zh: 他们的厨房设计简约时尚,而且非常实用。

e.en: Bauhaus architecture is rooted in early twentieth-century {functionalism}.
e.zh: 包豪斯建筑根植于二十世纪初的功能主义。

e.en: Sociologists debate the limits of {functionalism} in modern theory.
e.zh: 社会学家在争论功能主义在当代理论中的局限。

functionalist.t:
n. 功能主义者
adj. 功能主义的

e.en: He took a {functionalist} approach to designing the office space.
e.zh: 他以功能主义的思路来设计办公空间。

e.en: The {functionalist} view sees institutions as serving social needs.
e.zh: 功能主义观点认为制度是为满足社会需要而存在。

e.en: The new app adds several useful {functionalities} for power users.
e.zh: 新应用为高级用户增加了几项实用功能。

e.en: Premium {functionalities} are locked behind a monthly subscription fee.
e.zh: 高级功能需付费订阅才能解锁。

e.en: This update improves the search {functionality} across all devices.
e.zh: 这次更新在所有设备上改进了搜索功能。

e.en: The website looks pretty but lacks basic {functionality}.
e.zh: 这个网站外观漂亮,却缺乏基本功能。

e.en: The two phone models are {functionally} identical despite different names.
e.zh: 这两款手机虽然名字不同,功能上几乎一样。

e.en: His old laptop is {functionally} useless for video editing now.
e.zh: 他那台旧笔记本现在做视频剪辑实际上没什么用。

e.en: A low-level {functionary} stamped our visa without a word.
e.zh: 一名低级官员一言不发地给我们的签证盖了章。

e.en: She rose from clerk to senior party {functionary} quickly.
e.zh: 她很快就从文员升为党内高级官员。

e.en: The old radio still {functioned} despite its cracked casing.
e.zh: 那台旧收音机虽然外壳裂了,却仍能正常使用。

e.en: For years, the warehouse {functioned} as a temporary art gallery.
e.zh: 多年来,这间仓库一直被当作临时艺术展厅使用。

functioning.t:
n. 运作；运转
adj. 正常运作的

e.en: After the storm, only one elevator was still {functioning}.
e.zh: 风暴过后,只剩一部电梯还能运行。

e.en: A well {functioning} team needs trust and clear communication.
e.zh: 运转良好的团队需要信任和清晰的沟通。

e.en: The decorative knob is purely {functionless} but looks elegant.
e.zh: 那个装饰把手纯粹没用处,但看起来很雅致。

e.en: Without batteries, the remote is essentially a {functionless} plastic shell.
e.zh: 没有电池,这个遥控器基本就是个没用的塑料壳。

functions.t:
n. 功能；函数（复数）
v. 运行（第三人称）

e.en: This software {functions} smoothly even on older operating systems.
e.zh: 这款软件在老旧操作系统上也能流畅运行。

e.en: Pure {functions} make code easier to test and debug.
e.zh: 纯函数让代码更易于测试和调试。

fund.t:
n. 基金；资金
v. 资助

e.en: The city plans to {fund} new bike lanes downtown.
e.zh: 市政府打算出资在市中心修建新的自行车道。

e.en: She invested her savings in a low-cost index {fund}.
e.zh: 她把积蓄投入了一只低成本的指数基金。

fund-raising.t:
n. 筹款；募捐
adj. 募款的

e.en: The charity held a {fund-raising} dinner at the hotel.
e.zh: 慈善机构在酒店举办了一场筹款晚宴。

e.en: Online platforms have transformed {fund-raising} for small nonprofits.
e.zh: 网络平台改变了小型非营利组织的筹款方式。

e.en: Trust is the {fundament} of any lasting friendship.
e.zh: 信任是任何长久友谊的根基。

e.en: Clear data forms the {fundament} of every scientific claim.
e.zh: 清晰的数据是每个科学论断的基础。

fundamental.t:
adj. 基本的；根本的
n. 基础

e.en: Honesty is a {fundamental} value in our company culture.
e.zh: 诚实是我们公司文化中的核心价值观。

e.en: There's a {fundamental} difference between guessing and actually knowing.
e.zh: 猜测和真正知道之间有着根本的区别。

e.en: Religious {fundamentalism} has shaped politics across many regions.
e.zh: 宗教原教旨主义影响着许多地区的政治。

e.en: He warned against the dangers of ideological {fundamentalism}.
e.zh: 他警告人们要警惕意识形态原教旨主义的危险。

fundamentalist.t:
n. 原教旨主义者
adj. 原教旨主义的

e.en: A small {fundamentalist} group rejected all the proposed reforms.
e.zh: 一个小型原教旨主义团体拒绝了所有改革提议。

e.en: Her parents come from a strict {fundamentalist} religious background.
e.zh: 她父母出身于严格的原教旨主义宗教背景。

e.en: Remote work has {fundamentally} changed how teams communicate.
e.zh: 远程办公从根本上改变了团队的沟通方式。

e.en: We {fundamentally} disagree on how to handle customer complaints.
e.zh: 在如何处理客户投诉上,我们存在根本分歧。

fundamentals.t: n. 基本原理；基础知识

e.en: Master the {fundamentals} before trying advanced piano techniques.
e.zh: 学高级钢琴技巧前,先掌握基本功。

e.en: This course covers the {fundamentals} of personal finance clearly.
e.zh: 这门课清晰地讲解了个人理财的基础知识。

funded.t:
v. 已资助（fund 的过去式）
adj. 有资金的

e.en: The research was {funded} by a private technology foundation.
e.zh: 这项研究由一家私人科技基金会资助。

e.en: Their startup is fully {funded} for the next two years.
e.zh: 他们的初创公司未来两年的资金已全部到位。

e.en: The main {funder} pulled out just before the project launched.
e.zh: 主要出资方在项目启动前夕撤了资。

e.en: Every {funder} expects regular updates on the program's progress.
e.zh: 每位资助方都希望定期收到项目进展更新。

e.en: As {fundholder}, the practice manages its own annual budget.
e.zh: 作为基金持有人,该诊所自行管理年度预算。

e.en: Each {fundholder} signs an agreement outlining spending responsibilities clearly.
e.zh: 每位基金持有人都需签署明确支出责任的协议。

e.en: The {fundholding} scheme gave doctors more control over budgets.
e.zh: 基金持有制让医生对预算有更多掌控权。

e.en: Critics argued {fundholding} created inequality between different clinics.
e.zh: 批评者认为基金持有制造成了不同诊所间的不平等。

fundic.t: adj. 胃底的；眼底的（医学）

e.en: The doctor noted abnormal {fundic} cells during the endoscopy.
e.zh: 医生在内镜检查中发现了异常的胃底细胞。

e.en: {Fundic} gland polyps are usually benign and require monitoring.
e.zh: 胃底腺息肉通常是良性的,但需要定期监测。

funding.t:
n. 资金；拨款
v. 资助（进行时）

e.en: The startup secured {funding} from three major venture capital firms.
e.zh: 这家初创公司获得了三家主要风投公司的融资。

e.en: Schools are struggling due to repeated cuts in government {funding}.
e.zh: 由于政府拨款屡次削减,学校举步维艰。

fundings.t: n. 多笔资金（funding 复数，少用）

e.en: The report compared research {fundings} across European universities.
e.zh: 该报告比较了欧洲各大学的科研经费。

e.en: Several private {fundings} supported the museum's renovation work.
e.zh: 多笔私人资助支持了博物馆的翻新工程。

e.en: The team plans to {fundraise} for new soccer uniforms.
e.zh: 球队打算筹款购买新的足球队服。

e.en: Nonprofits often {fundraise} online during the December holiday season.
e.zh: 非营利组织常在十二月节日期间在网上筹款。

e.en: Our school's annual {fundraiser} raised twenty thousand dollars this year.
e.zh: 我们学校今年的年度筹款活动募集了两万美元。

e.en: She works as a professional {fundraiser} for a children's hospital.
e.zh: 她在一家儿童医院担任专业募款人。

e.en: Their {fundraising} campaign exceeded its goal within just one week.
e.zh: 他们的筹款活动仅用一周就超额完成了目标。

e.en: Effective {fundraising} requires storytelling, transparency, and personal connection.
e.zh: 有效的筹款需要讲故事、透明度和人与人之间的联结。

fundraisings.t: n. 多次募款活动（少用）

e.en: The charity reported steady growth in its annual {fundraisings}.
e.zh: 该慈善机构报告称年度筹款活动稳步增长。

e.en: Multiple {fundraisings} were organized to support earthquake victims.
e.zh: 为支援地震受灾者,组织了多场筹款活动。

funds.t:
n. 资金；基金（复数）
v. 资助（第三人称）

e.en: The charity {funds} clean water projects in rural villages.
e.zh: 该慈善机构资助乡村的清洁饮水项目。

e.en: Please ensure sufficient {funds} are available before the transfer.
e.zh: 请在转账前确保账户有足够的资金。

fundus.t: n. 底部（胃底、眼底，医学）

e.en: The ophthalmologist examined the {fundus} of her right eye.
e.zh: 眼科医生检查了她右眼的眼底。

e.en: A {fundus} photograph can reveal early signs of diabetes.
e.zh: 眼底照片可以显示糖尿病的早期迹象。

e.en: The {funeral} was held quietly at a small countryside chapel.
e.zh: 葬礼在一座乡村小教堂里静静举行。

e.en: Hundreds attended the {funeral} of the beloved local teacher.
e.zh: 数百人参加了这位深受爱戴的当地老师的葬礼。

e.en: In some cultures, {funerals} last several days with daily rituals.
e.zh: 在一些文化中,葬礼会持续数天,每天都有仪式。

e.en: He has attended too many {funerals} in the past year.
e.zh: 过去一年,他参加了太多场葬礼。

e.en: The museum displays ancient Egyptian {funerary} masks and amulets.
e.zh: 博物馆展出古埃及的丧葬面具和护身符。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered intricate {funerary} objects in the royal tomb.
e.zh: 考古学家在王陵中发现了精美的随葬品。

e.en: The room had a {funereal} silence after the bad news arrived.
e.zh: 坏消息传来后，房间里一片如丧的寂静。

e.en: He spoke in a {funereal} tone that made everyone uneasy.
e.zh: 他用一种沉痛的语气说话，让大家都很不安。

funfair.t: n. 游乐场；露天游艺会

e.en: The kids begged to visit the {funfair} every weekend.
e.zh: 孩子们每个周末都嚷着要去游乐场。

e.en: A traveling {funfair} set up rides in the empty parking lot.
e.zh: 一个流动游乐场在空停车场上搭起了游乐设施。

fungal.t: adj. 真菌的；霉菌引起的

e.en: The doctor prescribed cream for a mild {fungal} infection.
e.zh: 医生开了药膏来治疗轻微的真菌感染。

e.en: Damp basements often develop {fungal} growth on the walls.
e.zh: 潮湿的地下室墙上常常长出真菌。

e.en: Many {fungi} grow on rotting logs in the forest.
e.zh: 许多真菌生长在森林里腐烂的原木上。

e.en: Scientists discovered new species of {fungi} deep in the cave.
e.zh: 科学家在洞穴深处发现了新的真菌物种。

fungible.t: adj. 可互换的；可替代的（金融、代币）

e.en: Money is {fungible} because any dollar is interchangeable with another.
e.zh: 钱是可替代的，因为每一美元都可以互换。

e.en: Crude oil is largely {fungible} on the global market.
e.zh: 原油在全球市场上基本是可互换的商品。

fungicide.t: n. 杀真菌剂；杀霉菌剂

e.en: Farmers spray {fungicide} on grapes to prevent mildew.
e.zh: 农民给葡萄喷洒杀菌剂以防霉病。

e.en: This {fungicide} is safe for organic gardens when used correctly.
e.zh: 这种杀菌剂正确使用时对有机花园是安全的。

fungo.t: n. 棒球自抛自击的练习球

e.en: The coach hit a {fungo} to the outfielders during practice.
e.zh: 教练在训练时把腾空球击向外野手。

e.en: He swung a long {fungo} bat to drill the team.
e.zh: 他挥舞着一根长长的练习棒训练球队。

e.en: A strange {fungus} was growing under the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 厨房水槽下长出了一种奇怪的真菌。

e.en: Athlete's foot is caused by a common {fungus}.
e.zh: 脚气是由一种常见的真菌引起的。

funhouse.t: n. 游乐场中的趣味屋

e.en: The {funhouse} mirrors made everyone look hilariously stretched.
e.zh: 哈哈镜屋的镜子让每个人看起来都被滑稽地拉长了。

e.en: Kids screamed with delight inside the carnival {funhouse}.
e.zh: 孩子们在嘉年华的趣味屋里兴奋地尖叫。

funicular.t:
n. 缆索铁路
adj. 索道的

e.en: We rode the {funicular} up the steep hillside to the castle.
e.zh: 我们坐缆索铁路爬上陡峭的山坡前往城堡。

e.en: The old {funicular} still carries tourists every summer.
e.zh: 那条古老的缆索铁路每年夏天仍载着游客。

funk.t:
n. 放克音乐
n. 恐惧；萎靡

e.en: He's been in a {funk} ever since losing his job.
e.zh: 自从丢了工作，他就一直情绪低落。

e.en: The band played classic {funk} all night long.
e.zh: 乐队整晚演奏经典的放克音乐。

funks.t:
n. funk 的复数
v. 害怕；退缩

e.en: She always {funks} the difficult conversation with her boss.
e.zh: 她总是逃避和老板那场难谈的对话。

e.en: He hits creative {funks} whenever a deadline approaches.
e.zh: 每当截稿日临近，他就陷入创作低潮。

funky.t:
adj. 时髦的；放克风格的
adj. 怪怪的；有异味的

e.en: The fridge smells {funky} after the power outage.
e.zh: 停电之后冰箱有股怪味。

e.en: She wore a {funky} jacket covered in colorful patches.
e.zh: 她穿着一件缝满彩色补丁的潮酷夹克。

funnel.t:
n. 漏斗；烟囱
v. (资金、流量) 汇集导流

e.en: Use a {funnel} to pour the oil without spilling it.
e.zh: 用漏斗倒油，免得洒出来。

e.en: The app aims to {funnel} new users toward the paid plan.
e.zh: 该应用旨在引导新用户转向付费方案。

funnest.t: adj. 最有趣的（fun 的口语最高级）

e.en: That was the {funnest} road trip we've ever taken.
e.zh: 那是我们经历过最好玩的一次公路旅行。

e.en: Kids voted dodgeball the {funnest} game at recess.
e.zh: 孩子们投票选躲避球为课间最好玩的游戏。

e.en: {Funnily} enough, I just ran into him yesterday.
e.zh: 说来好笑，我昨天刚碰到他。

e.en: She {funnily} mimicked her boss to make us laugh.
e.zh: 她滑稽地模仿老板逗我们笑。

funny.t:
adj. 有趣的；好笑的
adj. 奇怪的

e.en: His joke was so {funny} that everyone burst out laughing.
e.zh: 他的笑话太好笑了，大家都笑出声来。

e.en: My laptop has been acting {funny} since the update.
e.zh: 自从更新之后，我的笔记本就有点不对劲。

funnyman.t: n. 喜剧演员；搞笑艺人

e.en: The veteran {funnyman} headlined the comedy festival again.
e.zh: 那位资深谐星再次担任喜剧节的压轴嘉宾。

e.en: He played the office {funnyman} who lightened every meeting.
e.zh: 他在办公室里是那个让每次会议都活跃起来的开心果。

fur.t:
n. 毛皮；皮草
n. 动物绒毛

e.en: The cat's {fur} was soft and warm in winter.
e.zh: 猫的毛在冬天又软又暖。

e.en: Many designers no longer use real {fur} in their collections.
e.zh: 许多设计师不再在系列中使用真皮草。

furball.t: n. 毛球（猫吐出的）；毛茸茸的宠物

e.en: The cat coughed up a {furball} on the new rug.
e.zh: 猫在新地毯上吐出了一个毛球。

e.en: Our tiny puppy is just an adorable little {furball}.
e.zh: 我们的小狗就是个可爱的小毛球。

e.en: They hired an artisan to {furbish} the old brass fixtures.
e.zh: 他们请了一位工匠来翻新那些旧铜器。

e.en: The museum will {furbish} the antique armor before the exhibit.
e.zh: 博物馆将在展览前将古董盔甲擦拭翻新。

furby.t: n. 菲比电子宠物玩具

e.en: My niece begged for a {furby} for her birthday.
e.zh: 我侄女生日时吵着要一只菲比精灵玩具。

e.en: The original {furby} toy became a huge craze in the late 90s.
e.zh: 最早的菲比玩具在九十年代末风靡一时。

furious.t:
adj. 狂怒的
adj. 猛烈的；激烈的

e.en: She was {furious} when she found out about the lie.
e.zh: 她发现那个谎言后勃然大怒。

e.en: The team worked at a {furious} pace before the launch.
e.zh: 团队在发布前以疯狂的速度赶工。

e.en: He typed {furiously} to finish the email before midnight.
e.zh: 他疯狂地敲键盘，赶在午夜前发完邮件。

e.en: The dog barked {furiously} at the delivery driver.
e.zh: 狗对着快递员狂吠不止。

e.en: The sailors {furl} the sails before the storm hits.
e.zh: 水手们在暴风雨来临前收起船帆。

e.en: Please {furl} the flag carefully after the ceremony.
e.zh: 仪式结束后请仔细把旗帜卷起来。

furled.t:
v. furl 的过去式
adj. 卷起的

e.en: She {furled} her umbrella once the rain stopped.
e.zh: 雨停后她把伞收了起来。

e.en: The banner stayed tightly {furled} until the parade began.
e.zh: 横幅一直紧紧卷着，直到游行开始。

furlong.t: n. 弗隆（长度单位，约 201 米）

e.en: The horse pulled ahead in the final {furlong} of the race.
e.zh: 那匹马在比赛最后一弗隆冲到了前面。

e.en: His farm sits about a {furlong} from the main road.
e.zh: 他的农场离大路大约一弗隆远。

furlough.t:
n. 无薪休假；暂时解雇
v. 强制休假

e.en: The company put half its staff on unpaid {furlough}.
e.zh: 公司让一半员工无薪休假。

e.en: Soldiers were granted a brief {furlough} to visit their families.
e.zh: 士兵们获准短暂休假回家探亲。

e.en: Our old {furnace} broke down on the coldest night of the year.
e.zh: 我们的旧锅炉在一年中最冷的夜里坏了。

e.en: Steel is forged inside a blazing {furnace}.
e.zh: 钢铁是在熊熊燃烧的熔炉里锻造的。

furness.t: n. 弗内斯（英国地名、姓氏）

e.en: We toured the ruins of {Furness} Abbey on our trip to Cumbria.
e.zh: 我们在坎布里亚旅行时参观了弗内斯修道院的遗迹。

e.en: Frank {Furness} designed several iconic Philadelphia buildings.
e.zh: 弗兰克·弗内斯设计了费城几座标志性的建筑。

furnish.t:
v. 布置家具；配备
v. 提供（信息、资料）

e.en: They plan to {furnish} the new apartment with secondhand pieces.
e.zh: 他们打算用二手家具布置新公寓。

e.en: Please {furnish} proof of address when you sign up.
e.zh: 注册时请提供地址证明。

furnished.t:
adj. 配有家具的
v. furnish 的过去式

e.en: The apartment comes fully {furnished} for short-term renters.
e.zh: 这套公寓为短租客人配备了全套家具。

e.en: She {furnished} the team with the latest sales data.
e.zh: 她向团队提供了最新的销售数据。

furnisher.t: n. 家具供应商；装潢商

e.en: The local {furnisher} delivered our new sofa the next day.
e.zh: 当地的家具商第二天就把新沙发送来了。

e.en: He works as a {furnisher} for boutique hotels.
e.zh: 他为精品酒店做家具陈设供应商。

furnishes.t: v. furnish 的第三人称单数

e.en: The landlord {furnishes} every unit with a bed and desk.
e.zh: 房东为每个单元都配备了床和书桌。

e.en: This report {furnishes} the evidence the lawyer needed.
e.zh: 这份报告提供了律师所需的证据。

furnishing.t:
n. 家具陈设
v. furnish 的现在分词

e.en: She enjoys {furnishing} small apartments on a tight budget.
e.zh: 她喜欢用有限预算来布置小公寓。

e.en: The witness was charged with {furnishing} false information.
e.zh: 那位证人被指控提供虚假信息。

furnishings.t: n. 家具陈设；室内装饰品

e.en: The hotel's {furnishings} blend modern art with vintage charm.
e.zh: 酒店的陈设把现代艺术和复古韵味融为一体。

e.en: They sold all the {furnishings} before moving abroad.
e.zh: 他们移居海外前把所有家具陈设都卖掉了。

e.en: We bought new {furniture} for the living room last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们给客厅买了新家具。

e.en: Most of the office {furniture} is assembled flat-pack style.
e.zh: 办公室大部分家具都是平板包装自行组装的。

e.en: The CEO's tweet caused a public {furor} overnight.
e.zh: 那位CEO的推文一夜之间引发了公众轰动。

e.en: Her debut novel created quite a {furor} among critics.
e.zh: 她的处女作小说在评论界引起了不小的轰动。

furore.t: n. 轰动；强烈反响（= furor）

e.en: The new policy sparked a {furore} across social media.
e.zh: 新政策在社交媒体上引发了一片哗然。

e.en: His controversial speech caused a {furore} in parliament.
e.zh: 他那段有争议的发言在议会引起了轩然大波。

e.en: The director's films have triggered several public {furores}.
e.zh: 那位导演的影片曾引发数次公众风波。

e.en: Tabloid headlines stoked the {furores} surrounding the trial.
e.zh: 小报标题煽动了围绕这场审判的种种风波。

e.en: Online {furors} can erupt over the smallest celebrity gaffe.
e.zh: 网上的风波常常因明星一点小失误就爆发。

e.en: The senator weathered multiple {furors} during her career.
e.zh: 这位参议员在职业生涯中挺过了多次舆论风波。

e.en: The coat had a thickly {furred} collar for winter warmth.
e.zh: 那件外套有一圈厚厚的毛领，冬天很保暖。

e.en: His tongue felt {furred} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后他感觉舌苔厚厚的。

e.en: The {furrier} repaired her grandmother's old mink coat.
e.zh: 皮草商修补了她外婆那件旧貂皮大衣。

e.en: My cat is much {furrier} than the neighbor's tabby.
e.zh: 我的猫比邻居家的虎斑猫毛多多了。

furrow.t:
n. 犁沟；皱纹
v. 犁地；皱眉

e.en: A deep {furrow} appeared on his brow as he read the email.
e.zh: 他读邮件时眉头出现了一道深深的皱纹。

e.en: The tractor cut a straight {furrow} across the field.
e.zh: 拖拉机在田里犁出了一道笔直的沟。

furrowed.t: adj. 布满皱纹的；有犁沟的

e.en: She {furrowed} her brow trying to solve the puzzle.
e.zh: 她皱起眉头努力想解开这道谜题。

e.en: The farmer {furrowed} the soil before planting seeds.
e.zh: 农夫在播种前犁开了土地。

furry.t: adj. 毛茸茸的；似毛皮的

e.en: A small, {furry} creature darted across the trail.
e.zh: 一只毛茸茸的小动物飞快地穿过小径。

e.en: She loves cuddling her {furry} golden retriever after work.
e.zh: 她下班后喜欢抱着她那只毛茸茸的金毛犬。

furs.t: n. fur 的复数；毛皮制品

e.en: Wealthy guests arrived wrapped in expensive {furs}.
e.zh: 富有的宾客们裹着昂贵的毛皮大衣到场。

e.en: The shop no longer sells real {furs} for ethical reasons.
e.zh: 出于伦理考虑，这家店不再售卖真皮草。

further.t:
adv. 进一步；更远
adj. 更多的；更深入的

e.en: We need to discuss this issue {further} before deciding.
e.zh: 我们需要进一步讨论这个问题再做决定。

e.en: The store is {further} down the street than I remembered.
e.zh: 那家店比我记得的还要往前走一些。

e.en: The grant supports the {furtherance} of medical research.
e.zh: 这笔拨款用于推动医学研究的发展。

e.en: He acted in {furtherance} of the company's long-term goals.
e.zh: 他的行动是为了推进公司的长远目标。

e.en: The plan is risky; {furthermore}, it costs too much.
e.zh: 该计划有风险；此外，成本也太高。

e.en: She is highly qualified; {furthermore}, she speaks three languages.
e.zh: 她非常合格；而且，她还会说三种语言。

furthest.t:
adv. 最远地
adj. 最远的；最大程度的

e.en: This is the {furthest} I've ever traveled from home.
e.zh: 这是我离家最远的一次旅行。

e.en: His ideas are the {furthest} thing from practical.
e.zh: 他的想法离实用差得最远。

furtive.t: adj. 鬼鬼祟祟的；偷偷摸摸的

e.en: She cast a {furtive} glance at her phone during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时她偷偷瞥了一眼手机。

e.en: His {furtive} behavior made the security guard suspicious.
e.zh: 他鬼鬼祟祟的举止引起了保安的怀疑。

fudging.t:
v. 蒙混；含糊其辞
n. 软糖（fudge 的动名词）

e.en: Stop {fudging} the truth and tell me what happened.
e.zh: 别再含糊其辞了,告诉我到底发生了什么。

e.en: He was caught {fudging} the expense report.
e.zh: 他被抓到在报销单上做手脚。

e.en: The chef named his hot sauce {Fuego} for its kick.
e.zh: 主厨给辣酱取名「Fuego」是因为够劲。

e.en: Tierra del {Fuego} lies at the southern tip of Argentina.
e.zh: 火地岛位于阿根廷的最南端。

e.en: Hitler styled himself as the {Fuehrer} of Nazi Germany.
e.zh: 希特勒自封为纳粹德国的元首。

e.en: Historians study how the {Fuehrer} consolidated power so quickly.
e.zh: 历史学家研究元首如何如此迅速地巩固权力。

fuel.t:
n. 燃料
v. 加燃料；助长

e.en: The car ran out of {fuel} on the highway.
e.zh: 车在高速公路上没油了。

e.en: Coffee is the {fuel} that keeps me going each morning.
e.zh: 咖啡是我每天早上的动力来源。

fueled.t: v. 加燃料；助长（fuel 过去式）

e.en: His success was {fueled} by years of hard work.
e.zh: 他的成功源于多年的努力。

e.en: The rumors {fueled} widespread panic on social media.
e.zh: 那些谣言在社交媒体上引发了广泛恐慌。

fueling.t: v. 加燃料；助长（fuel 进行式）

e.en: Inflation is {fueling} concerns about a recession.
e.zh: 通货膨胀正在加剧人们对经济衰退的担忧。

e.en: The plane was {fueling} up before the long flight.
e.zh: 飞机在长途飞行前正在加油。

fuels.t:
n. 燃料（复数）
v. 加燃料（第三人称）

e.en: Renewable {fuels} are replacing gasoline in many cities.
e.zh: 可再生燃料正在许多城市取代汽油。

e.en: Curiosity {fuels} every great scientific discovery.
e.zh: 好奇心推动着每一项伟大的科学发现。

e.en: Villagers gather {fuelwood} from the forest each winter.
e.zh: 村民们每年冬天都会去森林里捡柴火。

e.en: Demand for {fuelwood} contributes to deforestation in the region.
e.zh: 对柴火的需求加剧了该地区的森林砍伐。

e.en: The classroom was filled with a stale {fug} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后教室里弥漫着一股闷闷的浊气。

e.en: She opened the window to clear the smoky {fug}.
e.zh: 她打开窗户驱散烟雾弥漫的浊气。

e.en: Bach is famous for his intricate {fugal} compositions.
e.zh: 巴赫以其精巧的赋格作品而闻名。

e.en: The pianist studied the {fugal} structure for weeks.
e.zh: 那位钢琴家研究了赋格结构好几个星期。

fugitive.t:
n. 逃犯；逃亡者
adj. 短暂的

e.en: Police arrested the {fugitive} after a six-month manhunt.
e.zh: 经过六个月的追捕,警方逮捕了那名逃犯。

e.en: She caught a {fugitive} glimpse of him in the crowd.
e.zh: 她在人群中匆匆瞥见了他。

e.en: Bach's {fugue} in D minor remains a piano staple.
e.zh: 巴赫的D小调赋格曲至今仍是钢琴必练曲目。

e.en: He entered a dissociative {fugue} and forgot his name.
e.zh: 他陷入了解离性神游状态,连自己的名字都忘了。

e.en: The {Fuhrer} addressed massive rallies in 1930s Germany.
e.zh: 元首在1930年代的德国对大规模集会发表演讲。

e.en: Critics mocked the manager as a tiny office {fuhrer}.
e.zh: 批评者嘲笑那位经理是办公室里的小元首。

fuji.t: n. 富士（山 / 品牌名）

e.en: Mount {Fuji} is Japan's tallest and most iconic mountain.
e.zh: 富士山是日本最高也最具代表性的山。

e.en: She bought a {Fuji} apple at the farmers' market.
e.zh: 她在农夫市集买了一个富士苹果。

e.en: {Fujitsu} builds some of the world's fastest supercomputers.
e.zh: 富士通制造了一些世界上最快的超级计算机。

e.en: He works as an engineer at {Fujitsu}'s Tokyo office.
e.zh: 他在富士通东京办公室担任工程师。

e.en: Egyptian {ful} medames is a popular breakfast dish.
e.zh: 埃及蚕豆泥是一道很受欢迎的早餐。

e.en: We ordered {ful} with warm pita at the Cairo café.
e.zh: 我们在开罗的咖啡馆点了蚕豆泥配热皮塔饼。

e.en: The lever pivots on a small metal {fulcrum}.
e.zh: 杠杆以一个小金属支点为轴旋转。

e.en: Trust is the {fulcrum} of any healthy relationship.
e.zh: 信任是任何健康关系的支点。

fulfil.t: v. 实现；履行（英式拼写）

e.en: She worked hard to {fulfil} her childhood dream.
e.zh: 她努力工作以实现儿时的梦想。

e.en: The company failed to {fulfil} its delivery promises.
e.zh: 该公司未能兑现其交付承诺。

e.en: Amazon promises to {fulfill} orders within two days.
e.zh: 亚马逊承诺在两天内完成订单配送。

e.en: He hopes to {fulfill} his potential as a writer.
e.zh: 他希望充分发挥自己作为作家的潜力。

fulfilled.t:
v. 已实现（过去式）
adj. 满足的

e.en: She felt deeply {fulfilled} after volunteering at the shelter.
e.zh: 在收容所做志愿者后,她感到非常充实。

e.en: The contract was {fulfilled} ahead of schedule.
e.zh: 合同提前履行完毕。

fulfilling.t:
adj. 令人满足的
v. 实现（进行式）

e.en: Teaching kids is the most {fulfilling} job I've had.
e.zh: 教孩子是我做过最有成就感的工作。

e.en: They are {fulfilling} the terms of the agreement.
e.zh: 他们正在履行协议中的条款。

e.en: Many seek personal {fulfillment} through travel and hobbies.
e.zh: 许多人通过旅行和爱好寻求个人满足感。

e.en: The {fulfillment} center ships thousands of orders daily.
e.zh: 该配送中心每天发出数千份订单。

fulfills.t: v. 实现；履行（第三人称）

e.en: This course {fulfills} the writing requirement for graduation.
e.zh: 这门课满足毕业的写作课程要求。

e.en: Her new role really {fulfills} her creatively.
e.zh: 她的新职位真的让她在创意上得到了满足。

fulfilment.t: n. 实现；成就感（英式拼写）

e.en: He found great {fulfilment} in mentoring younger colleagues.
e.zh: 他从指导年轻同事中获得了极大的满足感。

e.en: Order {fulfilment} usually takes three business days.
e.zh: 订单履行通常需要三个工作日。

fulfils.t: v. 实现；履行（英式第三人称）

e.en: The new app {fulfils} a real need for busy parents.
e.zh: 这款新应用真正满足了忙碌父母的需求。

e.en: She always {fulfils} her promises to her team.
e.zh: 她总是对团队信守承诺。

fulham.t: n. 富勒姆（伦敦地区/足球俱乐部）

e.en: {Fulham} drew with Arsenal at Craven Cottage on Saturday.
e.zh: 周六富勒姆队在卡拉云农球场与阿森纳战平。

e.en: He bought a flat in {Fulham} near the river.
e.zh: 他在富勒姆区靠近河边买了一套公寓。

full.t:
adj. 满的；完整的
adv. 完全地

e.en: My phone storage is almost {full} again this month.
e.zh: 我的手机存储这个月又快满了。

e.en: She gave the project her {full} attention all week.
e.zh: 她整个星期都把全部注意力放在这个项目上。

full-blown.t: adj. 完全发展的；成熟的

e.en: What started as a cold became a {full-blown} flu.
e.zh: 原本只是感冒,后来发展成了完全的流感。

e.en: The argument turned into a {full-blown} family crisis.
e.zh: 争吵演变成了一场全面的家庭危机。

e.en: This Cabernet has a rich, {full-bodied} flavor.
e.zh: 这款赤霞珠口感醇厚浓郁。

e.en: She prefers {full-bodied} coffee with breakfast.
e.zh: 她早餐喜欢喝口感浓郁的咖啡。

full-fledged.t: adj. 完全成熟的；羽翼丰满的

e.en: After two years he became a {full-fledged} engineer.
e.zh: 两年后他成为了一名正式的工程师。

e.en: The startup is now a {full-fledged} tech company.
e.zh: 这家初创公司现在已发展成一家成熟的科技公司。

full-time.t:
adj. 全职的
adv. 全职地

e.en: She landed her first {full-time} job after graduation.
e.zh: 毕业后她找到了第一份全职工作。

e.en: Caring for a newborn is a {full-time} commitment.
e.zh: 照顾新生儿是一项全职的承诺。

e.en: The {fullback} blocked the defender to clear a path.
e.zh: 那名后卫挡开防守球员,开出了一条通路。

e.en: Their star {fullback} scored the winning try.
e.zh: 他们的明星后卫达阵得分锁定胜局。

fuller.t:
adj. 更满的（full 比较级）
n. 漂洗工

e.en: My hair looks {fuller} after using this shampoo.
e.zh: 用了这款洗发水后我的头发显得更丰盈了。

e.en: She wanted a {fuller} understanding of the issue.
e.zh: 她想对这个问题有更全面的理解。

e.en: A {fullerene} is a hollow carbon molecule shaped like a ball.
e.zh: 富勒烯是一种球状的中空碳分子。

e.en: Scientists discovered {fullerene} structures in 1985.
e.zh: 科学家在1985年发现了富勒烯结构。

e.en: Cal State {Fullerton} is known for its baseball program.
e.zh: 加州州立大学富勒顿分校以棒球项目闻名。

e.en: They moved to {Fullerton} for the better schools.
e.zh: 他们为了更好的学校搬到了富勒顿。

fulling.t: n. 缩绒；漂洗（呢绒加工）

e.en: Medieval workers used water mills for {fulling} wool cloth.
e.zh: 中世纪工人使用水车来缩绒羊毛布料。

e.en: The {fulling} process makes wool denser and warmer.
e.zh: 缩绒工艺使羊毛更紧密、更保暖。

e.en: Eating slowly helps you notice {fullness} sooner.
e.zh: 慢慢吃有助于你更快感受到饱腹感。

e.en: She admired the {fullness} of the autumn moon.
e.zh: 她欣赏着秋月的圆满。

e.en: He switched from freelance to {fulltime} employment last year.
e.zh: 他去年从自由职业转为全职工作。

e.en: Parenting feels like a {fulltime} job some days.
e.zh: 有些日子当父母感觉就像一份全职工作。

e.en: The battery is now {fully} charged and ready to use.
e.zh: 电池现在已充满电,可以使用了。

e.en: I {fully} support your decision to take the offer.
e.zh: 我完全支持你接受这份录用的决定。

e.en: A {fulmar} glided low over the icy North Sea.
e.zh: 一只暴雪鹱在冰冷的北海上低空滑翔。

e.en: The {fulmar} nests on steep coastal cliffs.
e.zh: 暴雪鹱在陡峭的海边悬崖上筑巢。

fulminant.t: adj. (医) 暴发性的；剧烈的

e.en: Doctors treated her {fulminant} hepatitis in intensive care.
e.zh: 医生在重症监护室治疗她的暴发性肝炎。

e.en: {Fulminant} infections can develop within hours.
e.zh: 暴发性感染可以在数小时内发展起来。

fulminate.t: v. 严厉谴责；猛烈抨击

e.en: Critics continue to {fulminate} against the new tax law.
e.zh: 批评人士继续猛烈抨击新的税法。

e.en: He would {fulminate} whenever traffic made him late.
e.zh: 每当堵车让他迟到时他就会大发雷霆。

fulmination.t: n. 严厉谴责；猛烈抨击

e.en: His angry {fulmination} on Twitter went viral overnight.
e.zh: 他在推特上愤怒的抨击一夜之间爆红。

e.en: The senator's {fulmination} surprised even her allies.
e.zh: 那位参议员的猛烈抨击连她的盟友都感到意外。

fulness.t: n. 丰满；充满（fullness 旧拼写）

e.en: The poem describes the {fulness} of summer in vivid imagery.
e.zh: 这首诗以生动的意象描绘了盛夏的丰盈。

e.en: She felt a quiet {fulness} after the family dinner.
e.zh: 家庭聚餐后她感到一种宁静的满足。

fulsome.t: adj. 过分的；令人反感的恭维

e.en: His {fulsome} praise made everyone uncomfortable at the meeting.
e.zh: 他过分的赞美让会议上的每个人都不自在。

e.en: The CEO offered a {fulsome} apology to customers.
e.zh: 首席执行官向客户作出了详尽的道歉。

e.en: She thanked her supporters {fulsomely} in her victory speech.
e.zh: 她在胜选演讲中对支持者大加感谢。

e.en: The host welcomed us {fulsomely} at the door.
e.zh: 主人在门口热情洋溢地欢迎我们。

e.en: The {Fulton} steamboat changed river travel forever in America.
e.zh: 富尔顿的蒸汽船彻底改变了美国的河运。

e.en: We met at a small café on {Fulton} Street.
e.zh: 我们在富尔顿街的一家小咖啡馆见面。

e.en: Steam hissed from a {fumarole} near the volcano's crater.
e.zh: 火山口附近的喷气孔嘶嘶地冒着蒸汽。

e.en: Hikers were warned to avoid the boiling {fumarole} ahead.
e.zh: 徒步者被警告要避开前方沸腾的喷气孔。

furtively.t: adv. 偷偷地，鬼鬼祟祟地

e.en: He {furtively} slipped the note into her bag.
e.zh: 他偷偷地把纸条塞进她的包里。

e.en: The cat {furtively} watched the birds from behind the curtain.
e.zh: 猫从窗帘后偷偷地盯着鸟儿。

furtiveness.t: n. 鬼鬼祟祟，偷偷摸摸

e.en: There was a {furtiveness} in his eyes that worried me.
e.zh: 他眼中那种鬼祟的神情让我担心。

e.en: Her {furtiveness} around the package gave away the surprise.
e.zh: 她在包裹旁边那种鬼祟的样子泄露了惊喜。

fury.t:
n. 狂怒，暴怒
n. 猛烈（风暴等）

e.en: He punched the wall in a fit of {fury}.
e.zh: 他一气之下一拳砸向墙壁。

e.en: The storm hit the coast with terrifying {fury}.
e.zh: 风暴以惊人的猛烈程度袭击了海岸。

fuse.t:
n. 保险丝；导火线
v. 熔合，融合

e.en: The two companies plan to {fuse} their operations next year.
e.zh: 两家公司计划明年合并业务。

e.en: A blown {fuse} cut power to the entire kitchen.
e.zh: 一根烧断的保险丝切断了整个厨房的电源。

fused.t:
adj. 熔合的，已融合的
v. fuse 的过去式

e.en: The artist {fused} traditional and digital techniques in her work.
e.zh: 这位艺术家在作品中融合了传统与数字技法。

e.en: The metal pieces were {fused} together by intense heat.
e.zh: 金属块在高温下熔合在了一起。

e.en: The plane's {fuselage} was damaged during the rough landing.
e.zh: 飞机的机身在粗暴的着陆中受损。

e.en: Engineers inspected every inch of the {fuselage} for cracks.
e.zh: 工程师检查了机身每一寸是否有裂缝。

fuses.t:
n. 保险丝（复数）
v. 熔合（第三人称）

e.en: This album {fuses} jazz with electronic beats beautifully.
e.zh: 这张专辑将爵士乐与电子节拍完美融合。

e.en: Always keep spare {fuses} in the toolbox at home.
e.zh: 家里工具箱里要常备一些备用保险丝。

e.en: His grandfather served as a {fusilier} during the war.
e.zh: 他祖父在战争期间曾担任火枪手。

e.en: The young {fusilier} stood proudly in his regimental uniform.
e.zh: 那位年轻的火枪手骄傲地穿着团服站立着。

e.en: The {fusiliers} marched through the town in formation.
e.zh: 火枪团士兵列队穿过小镇。

e.en: A regiment of {fusiliers} guarded the royal palace.
e.zh: 一团火枪兵守卫着皇宫。

fusillade.t: n. 连续射击，一阵猛烈抨击

e.en: A {fusillade} of questions met the politician at the press conference.
e.zh: 政客在记者会上遭遇了一连串质问。

e.en: The soldiers opened up with a deadly {fusillade}.
e.zh: 士兵们开火,射出了致命的连排齐射。

fusing.t: v. 熔合，融合（fuse 的现在分词）

e.en: The chef is known for {fusing} Asian and Italian cuisines.
e.zh: 这位厨师以融合亚洲与意大利菜闻名。

e.en: {Fusing} the broken pipe required a special torch.
e.zh: 焊接断裂的管道需要专用的喷枪。

fusion.t:
n. 融合，合并
n. 核聚变

e.en: The restaurant serves Korean-Mexican {fusion} dishes.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应韩国和墨西哥风味的融合菜。

e.en: Scientists are still working to make nuclear {fusion} practical.
e.zh: 科学家仍在努力让核聚变变得实用。

e.en: His music explores unusual {fusions} of folk and hip-hop.
e.zh: 他的音乐探索民谣与嘻哈的独特融合。

e.en: Several spinal {fusions} helped relieve her chronic back pain.
e.zh: 几次脊柱融合手术缓解了她长期的背痛。

fuss.t:
n. 大惊小怪
v. 瞎忙，烦扰

e.en: Don't make such a {fuss} over a small mistake.
e.zh: 别为一个小错误大惊小怪。

e.en: The new phone launch caused quite a {fuss} online.
e.zh: 这款新手机的发布在网上引起了不小的骚动。

fussbudget.t: n. 爱挑剔、爱大惊小怪的人

e.en: My uncle is a real {fussbudget} about how his coffee is made.
e.zh: 我叔叔对咖啡的做法非常挑剔。

e.en: Don't be such a {fussbudget} about every little detail.
e.zh: 别为每个小细节都那么挑三拣四。

fussed.t: v. 大惊小怪，烦扰（过去式）

e.en: She {fussed} over the baby all afternoon.
e.zh: 她整个下午都围着宝宝忙前忙后。

e.en: Honestly, I'm not too {fussed} about which restaurant we pick.
e.zh: 老实说,我并不太在意我们挑哪家餐厅。

fusses.t:
v. 大惊小怪（第三人称）
n. 大惊小怪（复数）

e.en: He always {fusses} with his hair before going on camera.
e.zh: 他每次上镜前都要不停地摆弄头发。

e.en: My grandmother {fusses} over us whenever we visit.
e.zh: 我们每次去看奶奶,她都对我们百般照顾。

fussily.t: adv. 过分讲究地，挑剔地

e.en: He arranged the flowers {fussily} on the dining table.
e.zh: 他在餐桌上一丝不苟地摆弄着鲜花。

e.en: She dressed {fussily}, adjusting every fold and button.
e.zh: 她穿衣服很讲究,反复整理每一道褶和纽扣。

fussiness.t: n. 爱挑剔，爱计较小事

e.en: The baby's {fussiness} usually means she's hungry or tired.
e.zh: 宝宝闹腾通常意味着她饿了或累了。

e.en: His {fussiness} about food made dinner parties stressful.
e.zh: 他对食物的挑剔让晚宴变得很有压力。

e.en: My son is a {fussy} eater who refuses most vegetables.
e.zh: 我儿子吃东西很挑剔,大多数蔬菜都不肯吃。

e.en: I'm not {fussy} about which seat we get.
e.zh: 我们坐哪个座位我都不挑。

fustian.t:
n. 粗斜纹棉布
adj. 夸大的，浮夸的

e.en: His speech was full of {fustian} phrases that impressed no one.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了浮夸的辞藻,没打动任何人。

e.en: The old workman wore a jacket of coarse {fustian}.
e.zh: 那位老工人穿着一件粗厚棉布的外套。

e.en: The attic smelled {fusty} after being closed all winter.
e.zh: 阁楼关了一冬,闻起来一股霉味。

e.en: The committee's {fusty} rules need a serious update.
e.zh: 委员会那些陈腐的规章亟需大刀阔斧地更新。

e.en: All her efforts to change his mind proved {futile}.
e.zh: 她劝他改变主意的所有努力都白费了。

e.en: Arguing with a toddler about bedtime is usually {futile}.
e.zh: 和小孩争论睡觉时间通常是徒劳的。

e.en: He {futilely} searched for his keys for an hour.
e.zh: 他白白找了一个小时钥匙也没找到。

e.en: She {futilely} tried to explain the joke to her grandmother.
e.zh: 她费尽口舌也没能向奶奶解释清那个笑话。

e.en: He finally recognized the {futility} of arguing with her.
e.zh: 他终于意识到和她争论是徒劳的。

e.en: The {futility} of the old approach pushed the team to innovate.
e.zh: 旧方法的无用迫使团队进行了创新。

e.en: Guests can sleep on the {futon} in the living room.
e.zh: 客人可以睡在客厅的沙发床上。

e.en: I rolled up the {futon} and put it in the closet.
e.zh: 我把蒲团卷起来放进了壁橱。

future.t:
n. 未来，将来
adj. 未来的

e.en: Nobody can predict exactly what the {future} will look like.
e.zh: 没人能准确预测未来会是什么样子。

e.en: We need to plan for our children's {future} education.
e.zh: 我们需要为孩子未来的教育做好规划。

futures.t:
n. 期货
n. 未来前景（复数）

e.en: He trades oil {futures} on the commodities market.
e.zh: 他在商品市场上交易石油期货。

e.en: Both companies see bright {futures} in renewable energy.
e.zh: 两家公司都看好可再生能源的前景。

futurism.t: n. 未来主义（艺术流派）

e.en: The exhibit explores Italian {futurism} from the early 1900s.
e.zh: 展览探讨了二十世纪初的意大利未来主义。

e.en: Her designs are heavily influenced by retro {futurism}.
e.zh: 她的设计深受复古未来主义风格的影响。

futurist.t: n. 未来学家，未来主义者

e.en: The {futurist} predicted that AI would reshape every industry.
e.zh: 这位未来学家预言人工智能将重塑各行各业。

e.en: As a {futurist}, she advises tech companies on long-term trends.
e.zh: 作为未来学家,她为科技公司提供长期趋势咨询。

futuristic.t: adj. 未来派的，富有未来感的

e.en: The new concept car has a sleek, {futuristic} design.
e.zh: 这款概念车造型流畅,极具未来感。

e.en: Her apartment is full of {futuristic} gadgets and smart devices.
e.zh: 她的公寓里满是未来感十足的小玩意和智能设备。

e.en: The novel imagines a strange {futurity} where machines dream.
e.zh: 小说想象了一个机器会做梦的奇异未来。

e.en: Philosophers have long debated the nature of {futurity}.
e.zh: 哲学家长期争论着未来的本质。

e.en: The {futurologist} gave a fascinating talk about life in 2050.
e.zh: 这位未来学家做了一场关于2050年生活的精彩演讲。

e.en: As a {futurologist}, he studies emerging technology trends daily.
e.zh: 作为未来学家,他每天研究新兴的科技趋势。

e.en: Stop {futz}ing with the settings and just start the video.
e.zh: 别再瞎鼓捣设置了,直接开始播放视频吧。

e.en: I spent all morning {futz}ing around with the printer.
e.zh: 我整个上午都在瞎摆弄那台打印机。

fuzz.t:
n. 绒毛，细毛
n. (俚) 警察

e.en: There's a layer of {fuzz} on this old peach.
e.zh: 这个老桃子表面有一层绒毛。

e.en: The microphone picked up a constant {fuzz} in the background.
e.zh: 麦克风一直收到背景里的杂音。

e.en: The distant mountains appeared {fuzzily} through the morning mist.
e.zh: 远山在晨雾中显得朦朦胧胧。

e.en: He remembered the night only {fuzzily} the next morning.
e.zh: 第二天早上他只对那一晚有些模糊的印象。

e.en: There's some {fuzziness} in the photo from camera shake.
e.zh: 照片有点模糊,是相机抖动造成的。

e.en: The {fuzziness} of the contract terms worried our lawyer.
e.zh: 合同条款的含糊让我们的律师感到担心。

fuzzy.t:
adj. 模糊的
adj. 毛茸茸的

e.en: The photo turned out a little {fuzzy} in low light.
e.zh: 在弱光下拍出来的照片有点模糊。

e.en: My memories of that birthday are pretty {fuzzy} now.
e.zh: 我对那个生日的记忆现在已经很模糊了。

e.en: They moved to the {Fylde} coast for the sea air.
e.zh: 他们为了海边的空气搬到了菲尔德海岸。

e.en: The {Fylde} region in Lancashire is known for its flat farmland.
e.zh: 兰开夏郡的菲尔德地区以平坦的农田闻名。

fynbos.t: n. 芬博斯（南非灌木植被）

e.en: The {fynbos} of South Africa contains thousands of unique plant species.
e.zh: 南非的凡波斯灌丛蕴藏着数千种独特的植物。

e.en: Hikers wandered through fragrant {fynbos} on the mountain slopes.
e.zh: 徒步者们穿行于山坡上芬芳的凡波斯灌丛中。

e.en: They share a strong {fraternal} bond despite living apart.
e.zh: 尽管两地分居,他们仍保有深厚的兄弟情谊。

e.en: My twins are {fraternal}, not identical.
e.zh: 我的双胞胎是异卵的,不是同卵的。

fraternise.t: v. 亲近交往（尤指与不该交往者）

e.en: Soldiers were warned not to {fraternise} with the locals.
e.zh: 士兵们被告诫不要与当地人过分亲近。

e.en: Managers shouldn't {fraternise} too closely with their direct reports.
e.zh: 经理不应与直属下属过分亲近交往。

e.en: He pledged a {fraternity} during his first semester at college.
e.zh: 他大学第一学期就申请加入了一个兄弟会。

e.en: The medical {fraternity} welcomed the new research findings.
e.zh: 医学界欢迎这些新的研究成果。

e.en: The army strictly forbids {fraternization} between officers and enlisted soldiers.
e.zh: 军队严禁军官与士兵之间私下亲近交往。

e.en: Workplace {fraternization} can create awkward power dynamics.
e.zh: 职场上的过度亲近可能造成尴尬的权力关系。

e.en: Teachers shouldn't {fraternize} with students outside of school events.
e.zh: 老师不应在校外活动之外与学生过度亲近。

e.en: He likes to {fraternize} with customers after closing time.
e.zh: 他喜欢在打烊后与顾客打成一片。

fratricidal.t: adj. 自相残杀的；手足相残的

e.en: The civil war became a {fratricidal} struggle that split families.
e.zh: 内战变成了一场撕裂家庭的同室操戈。

e.en: Their {fratricidal} rivalry destroyed the family business.
e.zh: 兄弟间的相残最终毁掉了家族企业。

fratricide.t: n. 杀兄弟姐妹（者）；手足相残

e.en: The novel explores guilt following an act of {fratricide}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了手足相残后的负罪感。

e.en: Ancient myths often feature stories of {fratricide} and revenge.
e.zh: 古代神话常出现弑兄与复仇的故事。

frau.t: n. 夫人（德语对已婚女性的称呼）

e.en: {Frau} Schmidt teaches German at the local high school.
e.zh: 施密特女士在当地高中教德语。

e.en: The hotel clerk politely greeted the elderly {frau}.
e.zh: 酒店前台礼貌地向那位年长的女士问好。

fraud.t:
n. 欺诈；骗局
n. 骗子

e.en: He was arrested for credit card {fraud} last Tuesday.
e.zh: 他上周二因信用卡诈骗被捕。

e.en: The investigation uncovered massive accounting {fraud} at the company.
e.zh: 调查揭露了公司大规模的会计造假行为。

e.en: Online shopping {frauds} cost consumers billions every year.
e.zh: 网络购物诈骗每年给消费者造成数十亿损失。

e.en: Investigators exposed several investment {frauds} this quarter.
e.zh: 调查人员本季度揭露了多起投资诈骗案。

e.en: The {fraudster} tricked elderly people out of their savings.
e.zh: 那个骗子骗光了老年人的积蓄。

e.en: Police arrested the {fraudster} after a year-long investigation.
e.zh: 警方经过一年的调查终于逮捕了那名骗子。

e.en: The auditor proved the {fraudulence} of the financial reports.
e.zh: 审计师证实了那些财务报告的欺诈性。

e.en: He was shocked by the {fraudulence} hidden in the contracts.
e.zh: 合同中隐藏的欺诈让他大为震惊。

e.en: The bank flagged several {fraudulent} transactions on her account.
e.zh: 银行标记了她账户上的几笔欺诈交易。

e.en: He was convicted of submitting {fraudulent} insurance claims.
e.zh: 他因提交虚假保险索赔被判有罪。

e.en: She {fraudulently} signed her sister's name on the document.
e.zh: 她在文件上欺诈性地伪造了姐姐的签名。

e.en: The company {fraudulently} reported inflated revenue to investors.
e.zh: 该公司向投资者虚报了夸大的收入数字。

fraught.t: adj. 充满（问题、危险）的；令人担忧的

e.en: Their relationship has been {fraught} with misunderstandings lately.
e.zh: 他们的关系最近充满了各种误会。

e.en: The negotiations were {fraught} but ultimately successful.
e.zh: 谈判虽然紧张,但最终取得了成功。

fray.t:
v. 磨损；变毛糙
n. 争斗

e.en: The cuffs of his old jacket began to {fray}.
e.zh: 他那件旧夹克的袖口开始磨损起毛了。

e.en: Two more candidates joined the political {fray} this week.
e.zh: 本周又有两名候选人加入了这场政治混战。

frayed.t: adj. 磨损的；（神经）紧张的

e.en: The cuffs of his old jacket were badly {frayed}.
e.zh: 他那件旧外套的袖口已经磨得很破了。

e.en: Tempers were {frayed} after the long delay at the airport.
e.zh: 机场长时间延误后大家的情绪都很烦躁。

e.en: The rope was {fraying} where it rubbed against the rock.
e.zh: 绳子在与岩石摩擦的地方正在磨损。

e.en: Her patience was {fraying} as the meeting dragged on.
e.zh: 会议拖得太久，她的耐心快耗尽了。

frazzle.t:
n. 筋疲力尽
v. 使疲惫不堪

e.en: Long shifts at the hospital {frazzle} even experienced nurses.
e.zh: 医院里的长班连经验丰富的护士都会累垮。

e.en: The kids managed to {frazzle} their babysitter within an hour.
e.zh: 孩子们一小时内就把保姆折腾得筋疲力尽。

frazzled.t: adj. 筋疲力尽的；心烦意乱的

e.en: She looked completely {frazzled} after the chaotic morning.
e.zh: 经历了混乱的早晨后她看起来精疲力竭。

e.en: Parents often feel {frazzled} during the holiday season.
e.zh: 父母们在假期里常常感到身心俱疲。

frc.t: n. 财务报告委员会（Financial Reporting Council）

e.en: His high school robotics team competes in the {FRC} league.
e.zh: 他高中的机器人队参加 FRC 联赛。

e.en: The {FRC} season kicks off every January with a new challenge.
e.zh: FRC 赛季每年一月以新挑战拉开帷幕。

freak.t:
n. 怪人；狂热爱好者
v. 吓坏

e.en: Don't {freak} out — the deadline got extended by a week.
e.zh: 别慌，截止日期延长了一周。

e.en: The storm was a complete {freak} of nature.
e.zh: 那场风暴完全是大自然的反常现象。

freaked.t: v. 吓坏；抓狂（freak 的过去式）

e.en: She totally {freaked} when she saw the spider on her desk.
e.zh: 她看到桌上的蜘蛛时彻底吓坏了。

e.en: Everyone {freaked} out over the surprise announcement.
e.zh: 大家对这个突如其来的消息都炸了锅。

freaking.t: adj./adv. 该死的（委婉语气加强词）

e.en: This new phone is {freaking} amazing.
e.zh: 这部新手机简直好得不得了。

e.en: Stop {freaking} out — we still have plenty of time.
e.zh: 别慌张，我们时间还多着呢。

e.en: The {freakish} weather brought snow in late May.
e.zh: 反常的天气在五月底竟然下起了雪。

e.en: He has a {freakish} talent for memorizing license plates.
e.zh: 他有种异于常人的记车牌号天赋。

e.en: The new player is {freakishly} fast on the court.
e.zh: 这名新球员在场上快得离谱。

e.en: It was {freakishly} warm for a January morning.
e.zh: 对一月的早晨来说，天气暖得反常。

e.en: Loud thunder always {freaks} my dog out.
e.zh: 响雷总是把我家狗吓得不行。

e.en: Comic conventions attract all kinds of lovable {freaks}.
e.zh: 漫展吸引各种可爱的怪咖。

e.en: That horror movie had some really {freaky} scenes.
e.zh: 那部恐怖片里有几个场面真的很瘆人。

e.en: It's {freaky} how similar the twins sound on the phone.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎电话里的声音像得吓人。

freckle.t:
n. 雀斑
v. 长雀斑

e.en: A tiny {freckle} appeared on her nose after summer.
e.zh: 夏天过后她鼻子上出现了一颗小雀斑。

e.en: Sun exposure can make a {freckle} darken over time.
e.zh: 日晒会让雀斑随时间变深。

e.en: The {freckled} boy grinned for the camera.
e.zh: 那个长着雀斑的男孩对着镜头咧嘴笑。

e.en: Her shoulders became {freckled} after a week at the beach.
e.zh: 在海滩待了一周后，她肩膀上长出了雀斑。

free.t:
adj. 免费的；自由的
v. 释放；解除

e.en: The app is {free} to download but has in-app purchases.
e.zh: 这个 App 免费下载但有内购。

e.en: Are you {free} to grab coffee tomorrow afternoon?
e.zh: 你明天下午有空喝咖啡吗？

freebie.t: n. 免费赠品；免费之物

e.en: Every customer got a tote bag as a {freebie}.
e.zh: 每位顾客都获得一个手提袋作为赠品。

e.en: The conference goodie bag had several useful {freebie} items.
e.zh: 会议礼包里有好几样实用的免费小礼物。

freeboard.t: n. 干舷（船甲板到水面的高度）

e.en: The cargo ship's {freeboard} is checked before every voyage.
e.zh: 货轮每次出航前都要检查干舷。

e.en: Heavy loading reduced the {freeboard} to dangerous levels.
e.zh: 过重的装载使干舷降到了危险水平。

e.en: The notorious {freebooter} terrorized merchant ships for decades.
e.zh: 那名臭名昭著的海盗劫掠商船数十年。

e.en: History books still debate whether he was hero or {freebooter}.
e.zh: 史书至今仍在争论他是英雄还是劫掠者。

freeborn.t: adj. 生而自由的；非奴隶出身的

e.en: Every {freeborn} citizen had the right to vote in the assembly.
e.zh: 每个生而自由的公民都有权在议会中投票。

e.en: The poem celebrates the dignity of {freeborn} people.
e.zh: 这首诗歌颂了自由人的尊严。

e.en: The startup handed out a stress ball as a {freeby}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司发了减压球作为赠品。

e.en: Don't expect a {freeby} just because you signed up early.
e.zh: 别以为提早注册就会有免费赠品。

freed.t: v. 释放；解除（free 的过去式）

e.en: Volunteers {freed} the dolphin from the tangled net.
e.zh: 志愿者们把海豚从缠住的渔网中解救出来。

e.en: Automating reports {freed} her to focus on strategy.
e.zh: 报表自动化让她得以专注于战略工作。

formant.t: n. 共振峰（语音声学中的频率峰值）

e.en: Vowel sounds differ mainly in their {formant} frequencies.
e.zh: 元音的差异主要体现在共振峰频率上。

e.en: The synthesizer adjusts each {formant} to mimic speech.
e.zh: 合成器通过调节共振峰来模拟人声。

format.t:
n. 格式；版式
v. 格式化

e.en: Please save the file in PDF {format}.
e.zh: 请把文件保存为 PDF 格式。

e.en: The show changed its {format} for the new season.
e.zh: 这档节目在新一季改变了节目形式。

formation.t:
n. 形成；组建
n. 队形；阵型

e.en: The {formation} of the band happened in 2010.
e.zh: 这支乐队成立于2010年。

e.en: Cloud {formation} depends on humidity and temperature.
e.zh: 云的形成取决于湿度和温度。

formations.t:
n. 队形；阵型
n. 形成；构造

e.en: The jets flew in tight {formations} over the stadium.
e.zh: 喷气式飞机以紧密的编队飞越体育场。

e.en: The cave's rock {formations} attract many tourists.
e.zh: 这个洞穴的岩石形态吸引了许多游客。

formative.t:
adj. 成长期的；塑造性的
adj. 形成的；发展中的

e.en: His teenage years were the most {formative} of his life.
e.zh: 青少年时期是他人生中最具塑造性的阶段。

e.en: Teachers use {formative} assessments to guide instruction.
e.zh: 老师用形成性评估来指导教学。

formats.t:
n. 格式（复数）
v. 格式化；设置格式

e.en: The app supports several image {formats} including PNG.
e.zh: 该应用支持包括 PNG 在内的多种图片格式。

e.en: This editor automatically {formats} your code on save.
e.zh: 这款编辑器会在保存时自动格式化代码。

formatted.t:
adj. 已格式化的
v. format 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: I {formatted} the spreadsheet to match our brand colors.
e.zh: 我把电子表格按品牌色重新排版了。

e.en: The drive must be {formatted} before you can use it.
e.zh: 硬盘必须先格式化才能使用。

formatting.t:
n. 格式设置；排版
v. format 的现在分词

e.en: The {formatting} of this document is completely off.
e.zh: 这份文档的排版完全乱了。

e.en: Pasting from the web often messes up the {formatting}.
e.zh: 从网页粘贴常常会把格式弄乱。

e.en: They walked along the sandy beaches of {Formby}.
e.zh: 他们沿着福姆比的沙滩散步。

e.en: {Formby} is a coastal town in northwest England.
e.zh: 福姆比是英格兰西北部的一座海滨小镇。

forme.t:
n. (印刷) 活字版；模板
(罕用)

e.en: The printer locked the type into a heavy {forme}.
e.zh: 印刷工把铅字锁进了沉重的版框中。

e.en: Each page was prepared as a separate {forme}.
e.zh: 每一页都被排成单独的一块版框。

formed.t:
adj. 已形成的；成形的
v. form 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: Three friends {formed} a startup in their garage.
e.zh: 三个朋友在车库里创办了一家初创公司。

e.en: Ice {formed} on the windshield overnight.
e.zh: 挡风玻璃上一夜之间结了冰。

former.t:
adj. 以前的；前任的
n. 前者（两者中的第一个）

e.en: She is a {former} CEO of the company.
e.zh: 她是这家公司的前任首席执行官。

e.en: Of the two options, the {former} is cheaper.
e.zh: 两个选项中,前者更便宜。

e.en: The building was {formerly} a textile factory.
e.zh: 这栋建筑以前是一家纺织厂。

e.en: He worked {formerly} at a major tech company.
e.zh: 他以前在一家大型科技公司工作。

formic.t: adj. 蚁的；蚁酸的（formic acid 甲酸）

e.en: Ant stings inject a small dose of {formic} acid.
e.zh: 蚂蚁叮咬会注入少量蚁酸。

e.en: Beekeepers sometimes use {formic} acid to kill mites.
e.zh: 养蜂人有时用蚁酸来杀螨虫。

formica.t:
n. 富美家（装饰耐火板品牌）
n. 蚁属（昆虫学）

e.en: The diner had classic {Formica} tabletops.
e.zh: 那家小餐馆配着经典的富美家塑胶贴面桌。

e.en: She wiped crumbs off the yellow {Formica} counter.
e.zh: 她从黄色的塑胶贴面台面上擦掉面包屑。

formidable.t:
adj. 令人敬畏的；强大的
adj. 艰巨的（任务、挑战）

e.en: The team faces a {formidable} opponent in the final.
e.zh: 这支队伍在决赛中将面对一个强劲的对手。

e.en: She has a {formidable} reputation as a trial lawyer.
e.zh: 她作为出庭律师享有令人敬畏的声誉。

formidably.t: adv. 令人敬畏地；强大地

e.en: He argued his case {formidably} in front of the judge.
e.zh: 他在法官面前极有气势地为自己辩护。

e.en: The fortress was {formidably} defended for centuries.
e.zh: 这座要塞数百年来都防御得固若金汤。

forming.t: v. 形成、构成（form 的现在分词）

e.en: Storm clouds are {forming} over the mountains.
e.zh: 暴风云正在山顶上空聚集。

e.en: They are {forming} a new committee to review safety.
e.zh: 他们正在组建一个新的安全审查委员会。

e.en: The fog turned the city into a {formless} blur.
e.zh: 雾把这座城市变成了一片模糊难辨的景象。

e.en: His anxiety was a vague, {formless} dread.
e.zh: 他的焦虑是一种模糊而无形的恐惧。

e.en: The painting captures the {formlessness} of pure emotion.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉了纯粹情感的无形感。

e.en: There is a strange beauty in the cloud's {formlessness}.
e.zh: 云朵的无定形之中有一种奇异的美。

formosa.t: n. 福尔摩沙（台湾旧称）

e.en: Portuguese sailors named the island {Formosa}.
e.zh: 葡萄牙水手把这座岛命名为福尔摩沙。

e.en: Old maps still label Taiwan as {Formosa}.
e.zh: 旧地图上仍把台湾标为福尔摩沙。

formosan.t:
adj. 台湾的；台湾原住民的
n. 台湾原住民语言

e.en: The {Formosan} clouded leopard is likely extinct.
e.zh: 台湾云豹很可能已经灭绝。

e.en: Linguists study several {Formosan} languages on the island.
e.zh: 语言学家研究该岛上的几种台湾南岛语。

forms.t:
n. 表单；表格（form 的复数）
v. 形成；构成

e.en: The clinic requires three {forms} before your visit.
e.zh: 诊所要求就诊前填写三份表格。

e.en: Water {forms} ice when the temperature drops.
e.zh: 温度下降时,水会形成冰。

formula.t:
n. 公式；配方
n. 套路（固定模式）

e.en: He memorized the {formula} for the area of a circle.
e.zh: 他记住了圆面积的公式。

e.en: The baby drank her {formula} and fell asleep.
e.zh: 宝宝喝完配方奶后就睡着了。

formulaic.t: adj. 公式化的；套路化的

e.en: Critics called the movie's plot painfully {formulaic}.
e.zh: 影评人说这部电影的情节套路得令人难受。

e.en: His emails are polite but completely {formulaic}.
e.zh: 他的邮件礼貌却毫无新意,全是套路。

formulary.t:
n. 处方集；药典
adj. 公式的；规定的

e.en: This drug isn't covered on our insurance {formulary}.
e.zh: 这种药不在我们保险的药品目录里。

e.en: The hospital updated its {formulary} last month.
e.zh: 医院上个月更新了药品目录。

formulas.t: n. 公式；配方（formula 的复数）

e.en: The spreadsheet broke when I changed several {formulas}.
e.zh: 我改了几个公式后,表格就出问题了。

e.en: Different shampoo {formulas} suit different hair types.
e.zh: 不同配方的洗发水适合不同的发质。

formulate.t:
v. 制定（计划、策略）
v. 规划；用公式表达

e.en: It took weeks to {formulate} a clear strategy.
e.zh: 花了好几周才制定出清晰的策略。

e.en: Chemists {formulate} new medications in the lab.
e.zh: 化学家在实验室里研制新药。

formulated.t: v. 制定、规划（formulate 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: She {formulated} a plan to expand into Asia.
e.zh: 她制定了一项进军亚洲市场的计划。

e.en: This sunscreen is {formulated} for sensitive skin.
e.zh: 这款防晒霜是为敏感肌肤特别配制的。

formulates.t:
v. 制定，规划（formulate 第三人称单数）
v. 用公式表达

e.en: The professor {formulates} questions that make students think.
e.zh: 这位教授善于提出引人深思的问题。

e.en: Each year the board {formulates} a new budget.
e.zh: 董事会每年都会制定新的预算方案。

formulating.t:
v. 正在制定、规划（formulate 现在分词）
v. 正在用公式表达

e.en: The team is {formulating} a response to the crisis.
e.zh: 团队正在拟定应对这场危机的方案。

e.en: She spent hours {formulating} the perfect opening line.
e.zh: 她花了好几个小时来构思完美的开场白。

formulation.t:
n. 表述；阐述
n. 配方（药品、化学品）

e.en: The new {formulation} of the drug has fewer side effects.
e.zh: 这款药物的新配方副作用更少。

e.en: His {formulation} of the problem helped us solve it.
e.zh: 他对问题的表述方式帮我们找到了解法。

e.en: Strict religious codes forbid people to {fornicate}.
e.zh: 严格的宗教戒律禁止人们发生婚外性行为。

e.en: The old law made it illegal to {fornicate} publicly.
e.zh: 旧法律规定公开通奸属于违法行为。

e.en: The sermon condemned {fornication} as a serious sin.
e.zh: 那篇布道把通奸斥为严重的罪行。

e.en: Some historical laws punished {fornication} with fines.
e.zh: 一些历史上的法律对通奸处以罚款。

e.en: The old text condemned the {fornicator} as morally corrupt.
e.zh: 古老的文本谴责通奸者道德败坏。

e.en: The novel labeled him a {fornicator} without any evidence.
e.zh: 那本小说毫无证据地把他贴上淫乱者的标签。

forres.t: n. 福雷斯（苏格兰城镇名）

e.en: We drove through {Forres} on our way to Inverness.
e.zh: 我们在前往因弗内斯的途中经过福里斯。

e.en: The town of {Forres} is famous for its flower displays.
e.zh: 福里斯镇以其花卉展览而闻名。

forrester.t:
n. 林务员；护林人
n. 弗雷斯特（研究咨询公司）

e.en: The character {Forrester} appears in the classic film adaptation.
e.zh: 福雷斯特这个角色出现在经典的电影改编版中。

e.en: Mr. {Forrester} taught English at our local high school.
e.zh: 福雷斯特先生在我们当地的高中教英语。

forsake.t:
v. 抛弃；舍弃
v. 遗弃（某人）

e.en: She promised never to {forsake} her closest friends.
e.zh: 她承诺永远不会抛弃她最亲密的朋友。

e.en: He refused to {forsake} his principles for quick money.
e.zh: 他拒绝为了快钱而背弃自己的原则。

forsaken.t: adj. 被遗弃的；孤立无援的

e.en: The {forsaken} village had been empty for decades.
e.zh: 那座被遗弃的村庄已经空置了几十年。

e.en: She felt {forsaken} after all her colleagues left.
e.zh: 所有同事离开后,她感到被抛弃了。

forseeable.t: adj. 可预见的（foreseeable 的拼写变体）

e.en: Remote work will continue for the {forseeable} future.
e.zh: 在可预见的未来,远程办公将继续下去。

e.en: There is no {forseeable} end to the negotiations.
e.zh: 谈判没有可预见的结束日期。

forsook.t: v. 抛弃、舍弃（forsake 的过去式）

e.en: He {forsook} his old habits after the diagnosis.
e.zh: 确诊后他抛弃了过去的旧习惯。

e.en: She {forsook} city life for a quiet farm.
e.zh: 她舍弃了城市生活,选择了宁静的农场。

forswear.t: v. 郑重放弃；发誓戒除

e.en: He vowed to {forswear} sugar for an entire year.
e.zh: 他发誓整整一年都不再碰糖。

e.en: The candidate had to {forswear} all foreign business ties.
e.zh: 该候选人必须发誓断绝所有海外商业关系。

forsworn.t:
adj. 违背誓言的；发伪誓的
v. forswear 的过去分词

e.en: She had {forsworn} alcohol after her health scare.
e.zh: 经历健康危机后,她已发誓戒酒。

e.en: The knight was {forsworn} and lost his honor.
e.zh: 那位骑士食言了,失去了他的荣誉。

forsythia.t: n. 连翘（一种早春开黄花的灌木）

e.en: The {forsythia} bloomed bright yellow in early spring.
e.zh: 连翘在早春绽放出明亮的黄色花朵。

e.en: She planted a {forsythia} hedge along the back fence.
e.zh: 她沿着后围栏种了一排连翘树篱。

fort.t:
n. 堡垒；要塞
n. 军事驻地

e.en: The kids built a {fort} out of pillows and blankets.
e.zh: 孩子们用枕头和毯子搭了一个堡垒。

e.en: Tourists visit the old stone {fort} every summer.
e.zh: 游客每年夏天都会参观那座古老的石堡。

faintest.t: n. 昏厥, 昏倒\na. 模糊的, 微弱的, 无力的\nvi. 昏倒, 变得微弱

fairest.t:
n. 展览会, 市集, 美好的事物
a. 公平的, 按规则进行的, 不好不坏的, 晴朗的, 美丽的
adv. 公平地, 正面地, 有教养地, 清楚地
vi. 转晴

fantasied.t: n. 幻想, 想象的产物\n[医] 幻想

fattest.t:
n. 脂肪, 脂油, 肥肉
a. 肥的, 胖的, 油腻的
n. 文件分配表
[计] 文件分配表

fattier.t: a. 肥胖的, 脂肪的, 含脂肪的\n[医] 脂肪的

fattiest.t: a. 肥胖的, 脂肪的, 含脂肪的\n[医] 脂肪的

ferried.t: n. 渡船, 渡口\n[法] 摆渡营业权, 轮渡

fiddlier.t: a. 需要手巧的, 要求高精度的

fiercest.t: a. 凶猛的, 猛烈的, 热烈的, 暴躁的

fieriest.t: a. 炽热的, 热烈的, 暴躁的

filthiest.t: a. 污秽的, 丑恶的

filthier.t: a. 污秽的, 丑恶的

finest.t:
n. 罚款, 罚金, 晴天, 精细
a. 好的, 晴朗的, 健康的, 细小的, 精细的
vt. 罚款, 精炼, 澄清
vi. 变清, 变细
adv. 很好
[计] 精细

firemen.t: n. 救火队员, 消防队员\n[机] 司炉

fishwives.t: n. 卖鱼妇, 说话粗野的女人

fishier.t: a. 鱼似的, 多鱼的, 腥臭的, 呆滞的

fittest.t:
n. 适宜, 合身, 发作, 痉挛
a. 适宜的, 对的, 准备好的
vt. 适合, 安装, 使合身, 使适应, 使合格
vi. 适合, 符合, 合身
[计] 非特

fizzier.t: a. 嘶嘶作响的, 起泡沫的

e.en: The physicist drew an {f-diagram} for the interaction.
e.zh: 物理学家为这次相互作用画了一张费曼图。

e.en: Each {f-diagram} represents a term in the calculation.
e.zh: 每张F图都代表计算中的一项。

e.en: The camera showed the aperture on the {f-display}.
e.zh: 相机在F显示区显示了光圈值。

e.en: Engineers checked the {f-display} during the test.
e.zh: 工程师在测试期间检查了功能显示。

e.en: Dust had gathered inside the violin's {f-hole}.
e.zh: 灰尘积在小提琴的f形音孔里。

e.en: The luthier carved each {f-hole} by hand.
e.zh: 制琴师手工雕刻每一个f形音孔。

e.en: A smaller {f-number} lets in more light.
e.zh: 较小的光圈数能让更多光线进入。

e.en: The lens has a maximum {f-number} of 1.8.
e.zh: 这枚镜头的最大光圈数为1.8。

e.en: Radio signals bounced off the ionospheric {f-region}.
e.zh: 无线电信号从电离层F区反射回来。

e.en: Solar storms can disturb the {f-region} at night.
e.zh: 太阳风暴会在夜间扰动F区。

e.en: The technician ran an {f-scan} on the receiver.
e.zh: 技术员对接收器进行了频率扫描。

e.en: An {f-scan} revealed interference near the target band.
e.zh: 一次F扫描显示目标频段附近有干扰。

e.en: The old radar room still had an {f-scope}.
e.zh: 旧雷达室里仍有一台F示波器。

e.en: Operators watched the {f-scope} for signal changes.
e.zh: 操作员盯着频率显示器观察信号变化。

e.en: The software reported significant {f-statistics} for the model.
e.zh: 软件报告该模型的F统计量显著。

e.en: Students compared {f-statistics} from two regression tests.
e.zh: 学生们比较了两次回归检验的F统计量。

e.en: Use a lower {f-stop} for a blurred background.
e.zh: 用较低的光圈值可以让背景虚化。

e.en: The photographer changed the {f-stop} before shooting.
e.zh: 摄影师在拍摄前调整了光圈级数。

e.en: He apologized for using the {f-word} in class.
e.zh: 他为在课堂上说那个脏话道了歉。

e.en: The film contains the {f-word} several times.
e.zh: 这部电影里多次出现那个以f开头的词。

fa-la.t: 啦啦声；无意义的歌唱音节

e.en: The chorus ended with a bright {fa-la}.
e.zh: 合唱以一串明亮的啦啦声结束。

e.en: She sang {fa-la} when she forgot the words.
e.zh: 她忘词时就唱起无意义的啦啦音节。

e.en: The botanist described the plant as {fabaceous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种植物描述为豆科植物。

e.en: Its {fabaceous} pods dried in the sun.
e.zh: 它那些像豆荚的果荚在太阳下晒干了。

fabianism.t: 费边主义；渐进社会主义

e.en: Her essay traced the rise of {fabianism} in Britain.
e.zh: 她的文章追溯了费边主义在英国的兴起。

e.en: He preferred {fabianism} to sudden revolution.
e.zh: 比起突然革命，他更倾向于渐进社会主义。

e.en: The design is {fabricable} with ordinary tools.
e.zh: 这个设计用普通工具就可以制造出来。

e.en: The rumor was easily {fabricable} from public facts.
e.zh: 这个谣言很容易用公开事实编造出来。

e.en: A local {fabricant} supplied the metal parts.
e.zh: 当地一家制造商供应了这些金属零件。

e.en: The old {fabricant} was known for fine lace.
e.zh: 那位老工匠以精致蕾丝闻名。

e.en: The novel has a strongly {fabular} structure.
e.zh: 这部小说有很强的寓言式结构。

e.en: Her {fabular} style turns history into myth.
e.zh: 她那种故事般的风格把历史写成了神话。

fabulistic.t: 寓言式的；虚构色彩浓的

e.en: The poem uses a {fabulistic} speaking animal.
e.zh: 这首诗用了一个寓言式的会说话动物。

e.en: His account sounded too {fabulistic} to trust.
e.zh: 他的叙述虚构色彩太浓，难以相信。

e.en: Writers often {fabulize} political events for satire.
e.zh: 作家常把政治事件写成寓言来讽刺。

e.en: The film tries to {fabulize} an ordinary childhood.
e.zh: 这部电影试图把普通童年神奇化。

fabulized.t: 被寓言化的；被神奇化的

e.en: The battle was {fabulized} in later poems.
e.zh: 这场战役在后来的诗歌中被寓言化了。

e.en: Her childhood is {fabulized} as a golden age.
e.zh: 她的童年被神奇化成了黄金时代。

e.en: The director is {fabulizing} the family's escape.
e.zh: 导演正在把这家人的逃亡故事寓言化。

e.en: His memoir keeps {fabulizing} ordinary school days.
e.zh: 他的回忆录不断把普通校园生活神奇化。

e.en: The show celebrated pure {fabulosity} and glamour.
e.zh: 这场秀尽情展现了华丽又绝妙的魅力。

e.en: Her outfit had a playful sense of {fabulosity}.
e.zh: 她的穿搭带着一种俏皮而浮夸的精彩感。

e.en: The infection gave him terrible {face-ache}.
e.zh: 感染让他脸部疼得厉害。

e.en: Stop being such a {face-ache} about lunch.
e.zh: 别为午饭这点事这么烦人。

e.en: The panel failed because of poor {face-bonding}.
e.zh: 这块面板因表面贴合不良而失效。

e.en: Strong {face-bonding} keeps the layers together.
e.zh: 牢固的面粘结能让各层保持在一起。

e.en: Copper has a {face-centered} cubic structure.
e.zh: 铜具有面心立方结构。

e.en: The model shows atoms in a {face-centered} lattice.
e.zh: 这个模型显示原子处在面心晶格中。

e.en: Aluminium forms a {face-centred} cubic crystal.
e.zh: 铝会形成面心立方晶体。

e.en: The diagram labels the {face-centred} lattice clearly.
e.zh: 图中清楚标出了面心晶格。

e.en: She puts on {face-cream} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都涂面霜。

e.en: This {face-cream} is too oily for my skin.
e.zh: 这款面霜对我的皮肤来说太油了。

e.en: Place the card {face-down} on the table.
e.zh: 把那张牌正面朝下放在桌上。

e.en: He lay {face-down} in the snow.
e.zh: 他面朝下躺在雪地里。

e.en: I saw her {face-harden} at the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息时，我看见她的脸色变得冷硬。

e.en: His {face-harden} seemed strange in that sentence.
e.zh: 这个句子里用face-harden这个说法显得很奇怪。

e.en: Her {face-hardened} when he mentioned the money.
e.zh: 他提到那笔钱时，她的脸色冷硬起来。

e.en: The witness's {face-hardened} expression worried the lawyer.
e.zh: 证人那副冷硬的表情让律师担心。

e.en: His {face-hardening} told us he was angry.
e.zh: 他脸色变得冷硬，让我们知道他生气了。

e.en: She noticed the slow {face-hardening} of the crowd.
e.zh: 她注意到人群的脸色慢慢变得冷硬。

e.en: His {face-hardens} whenever the subject returns.
e.zh: 每当话题又回到这里，他的脸色就变得冷硬。

e.en: The guard's {face-hardens} at the sound of footsteps.
e.zh: 听到脚步声时，守卫的脸色变得冷硬。

e.en: She considered a {face-lift} after turning sixty.
e.zh: 六十岁后，她考虑做面部拉皮手术。

e.en: The old station needs a {face-lift}.
e.zh: 这座旧车站需要翻新一下。

e.en: Modern {face-lifting} can look very natural.
e.zh: 现代拉皮手术可以显得很自然。

e.en: The building is undergoing {face-lifting} before summer.
e.zh: 这栋楼正在夏天前进行翻新改造。

e.en: Wear a {face-mask} in the clinic.
e.zh: 在诊所里要戴口罩。

e.en: She used a clay {face-mask} before bed.
e.zh: 她睡前敷了一片泥膜。

e.en: The debate became a tense {face-off}.
e.zh: 这场辩论变成了紧张的对峙。

e.en: The referee dropped the puck for the {face-off}.
e.zh: 裁判放下冰球，开始开球。

e.en: This herbal {face-pack} smells fresh.
e.zh: 这款草本面膜闻起来很清新。

e.en: She washed off the {face-pack} after ten minutes.
e.zh: 十分钟后，她把敷脸膏洗掉了。

e.en: Children loved the {face-painting} booth at the fair.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢集市上的脸部彩绘摊位。

e.en: Her {face-painting} made her look like a tiger.
e.zh: 她的脸部彩绘让她看起来像一只老虎。

e.en: The apology was a useful {face-saver}.
e.zh: 这次道歉是个有用的保全面子的办法。

e.en: They offered him a {face-saver} before the vote.
e.zh: 投票前，他们给了他一个保全面子的台阶。

e.en: Small concessions can be {face-savers} in talks.
e.zh: 谈判中的小让步可以成为保全面子的办法。

e.en: The manager prepared several {face-savers} for the team.
e.zh: 经理为团队准备了几个下台阶的办法。

e.en: They reached a {face-saving} compromise.
e.zh: 他们达成了一个保全面子的妥协。

e.en: The official needed a {face-saving} explanation.
e.zh: 这名官员需要一个保全面子的解释。

e.en: New employees need more {face-time} with managers.
e.zh: 新员工需要更多和经理面对面相处的时间。

e.en: She values {face-time} more than long emails.
e.zh: 比起冗长的邮件，她更看重面对面交流。

e.en: The helmet's {facebar} protected his mouth.
e.zh: 头盔的面部护栏保护了他的嘴。

e.en: A broken {facebar} made the mask unsafe.
e.zh: 前挡杆坏了，使这个面罩不安全。

e.en: She rinsed the {facecloth} in warm water.
e.zh: 她用温水把洗脸巾冲了冲。

e.en: A clean {facecloth} hung beside the sink.
e.zh: 水槽旁挂着一条干净的面巾。

e.en: He got a {faceful} of dust.
e.zh: 他被扬了一脸灰。

e.en: She received a {faceful} of cold spray.
e.zh: 她被冷水雾喷了满脸。

e.en: The candidates prepared for a televised {faceoff}.
e.zh: 候选人为一场电视对决做准备。

e.en: The {faceoff} began after the whistle.
e.zh: 哨声响后，冰球开球开始了。

e.en: The book collected old {facetiae} from London.
e.zh: 这本书收录了伦敦旧时的诙谐文字。

e.en: His speech was full of learned {facetiae}.
e.zh: 他的演讲里满是卖弄学问的俏皮话。

e.en: Leave the document {faceup} on my desk.
e.zh: 把文件正面朝上放在我桌上。

e.en: The coin landed {faceup} in the sand.
e.zh: 硬币落在沙里时正面朝上。

faceworker.t: 美容按摩师；脸部护理员

e.en: The spa hired a trained {faceworker} for facial treatments.
e.zh: 这家水疗馆聘请了一名受过训练的脸部护理员做面部护理。

e.en: A skilled {faceworker} can ease tension around the jaw.
e.zh: 熟练的美容按摩师可以缓解下颌周围的紧张。

e.en: The surgeon carefully separated the {facia} from the muscle.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地把筋膜同肌肉分离开。

e.en: The shop's old {facia} was replaced after the renovation.
e.zh: 装修后，店铺旧的招牌板被换掉了。

faciend.t: 数学中待作之事；待求量

e.en: The old textbook called the required construction the {faciend}.
e.zh: 那本旧教材把需要完成的作图称为待作之事。

e.en: In the problem, the {faciend} was the unknown line segment.
e.zh: 在这道题中，待求量是那条未知线段。

e.en: The report identified poor ventilation as a {facient} in the illness.
e.zh: 报告指出通风不良是这种疾病的促成因素。

e.en: The chemical was {facient} in speeding the reaction.
e.zh: 这种化学物质在加快反应中起了作用。

e.en: The doctor noted the patient's pale {facies}.
e.zh: 医生注意到病人面容苍白。

e.en: The sandstone {facies} suggests a shallow marine environment.
e.zh: 这种砂岩岩相表明当时是浅海环境。

e.en: His {facilite} manner made the difficult speech seem effortless.
e.zh: 他轻快流畅的风格让这场艰难的演讲显得毫不费力。

e.en: Critics disliked the novel's {facilite} answers to moral questions.
e.zh: 评论家不喜欢这部小说对道德问题给出的轻易答案。

e.en: The new {facilitiy} includes a gym and a clinic.
e.zh: 这处新设施包括健身房和诊所。

e.en: Online payment is a useful {facilitiy} for customers.
e.zh: 在线支付对顾客来说是一项有用的便利条件。

e.en: The judge condemned the {facinorous} plot against civilians.
e.zh: 法官谴责了这个针对平民的罪大恶极的阴谋。

e.en: Such {facinorous} cruelty shocked even hardened officers.
e.zh: 这种极恶的残忍行为连老练的军官都震惊了。

e.en: The patient described brief {faciobrachial} spasms on the left side.
e.zh: 病人描述左侧出现短暂的面部和手臂痉挛。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {faciobrachial} symptoms after the seizure.
e.zh: 癫痫发作后，医生监测了面部和手臂症状。

e.en: The scan showed swelling in the {faciocervical} region.
e.zh: 扫描显示面部和颈部区域有肿胀。

e.en: She needed therapy for {faciocervical} muscle tightness.
e.zh: 她需要治疗面颈部肌肉紧张。

e.en: The dentist measured the {faciolingual} width of the molar.
e.zh: 牙医测量了这颗磨牙从面侧到舌侧的宽度。

e.en: A {faciolingual} groove can trap plaque if cleaning is poor.
e.zh: 如果清洁不到位，面舌向沟槽可能积聚牙菌斑。

e.en: The infection caused temporary {facioplegia} on one side.
e.zh: 感染导致一侧出现暂时性面瘫。

e.en: Early treatment improved her {facioplegia} within weeks.
e.zh: 早期治疗使她的面部麻痹在几周内有所改善。

e.en: In dialect, he used {fack} where others said fact.
e.zh: 在方言中，他用fack来表示别人说的fact。

e.en: The old craftsman said he would {fack} the piece by hand.
e.zh: 那位老工匠说他会亲手把这件东西做成。

e.en: The tailor admired the French {facon} of the coat.
e.zh: 裁缝欣赏这件外套的法式样式。

e.en: She explained the old {facon} of preparing the dish.
e.zh: 她解释了准备这道菜的老做法。

e.en: The curtains were made from pale {faconne} silk.
e.zh: 窗帘是用浅色提花丝绸做的。

e.en: She chose a {faconne} fabric for the formal jacket.
e.zh: 她为那件正式外套选了有花纹的织物。

e.en: The committee asked for a {fact-based} report.
e.zh: 委员会要求提交一份基于事实的报告。

e.en: A {fact-based} debate avoids personal attacks.
e.zh: 基于事实的辩论会避免人身攻击。

e.en: Editors must {fact-check} every claim before publication.
e.zh: 编辑必须在发表前核查每一项说法的事实。

e.en: The article failed a basic {fact-check}.
e.zh: 这篇文章连基本的事实核查都没通过。

fact-finder.t: 事实调查员；查明事实者

e.en: The court appointed a neutral {fact-finder}.
e.zh: 法院指定了一名中立的事实调查员。

e.en: A good {fact-finder} separates evidence from opinion.
e.zh: 优秀的查明事实者会把证据和意见区分开。

e.en: The senator joined a {fact-finding} mission overseas.
e.zh: 这名参议员参加了一次海外事实调查任务。

e.en: The company opened a {fact-finding} inquiry after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后，公司启动了查明情况的调查。

e.en: The lawyer distinguished the {facta} from the legal conclusions.
e.zh: 律师把事实同法律结论区分开来。

e.en: Medieval writers often listed the king's {facta} in Latin.
e.zh: 中世纪作者常用拉丁文列出国王的事迹。

e.en: The compound used {factice} to improve the rubber mixture.
e.zh: 这种配方使用硫化油胶来改善橡胶混合物。

e.en: His smile had a {factice} brightness that fooled nobody.
e.zh: 他的笑容带着一种做作的明亮，骗不了任何人。

e.en: The historian questioned the {facticity} of the legend.
e.zh: 历史学家质疑这个传说的事实性。

e.en: Existentialists discuss the {facticity} of birth and social limits.
e.zh: 存在主义者讨论出生和社会限制这种既成现实性。

e.en: The chairman accused him of being a dangerous {factionalist}.
e.zh: 主席指责他是个危险的派系主义者。

e.en: A committed {factionalist} often values loyalty over policy.
e.zh: 坚定的派系主义者往往把忠诚看得比政策更重要。

e.en: The leadership dispute began to {factionalize} the party.
e.zh: 领导权争端开始使这个政党派系化。

e.en: Online arguments can {factionalize} a small community quickly.
e.zh: 网络争论可能很快把一个小社区分裂成派系。

e.en: The council was weakened by {factionary} quarrels.
e.zh: 委员会因派系争吵而被削弱。

e.en: Each {factionary} defended his own group's interests.
e.zh: 每个派系成员都维护自己集团的利益。

e.en: The old pamphlet denounced him as a dangerous {factionist}.
e.zh: 那本旧小册子谴责他是危险的派系主义者。

e.en: A skilled {factionist} can split a committee without seeming hostile.
e.zh: 老练的结党者能在不显得敌对的情况下分裂委员会。

e.en: In grammar, a {factitive} verb can express making someone something.
e.zh: 在语法中，使成动词可以表示使某人成为某种状态。

e.en: The phrase has a {factitive} meaning in this old analysis.
e.zh: 在这份旧分析中，这个短语带有使役含义。

e.en: The verb is used {factitively} in that sentence.
e.zh: 这个动词在那个句子里是以使役方式使用的。

e.en: Older grammarians described the construction {factitively}.
e.zh: 早期语法学家用使成的角度描述这种结构。

e.en: Know is often called a {factive} verb.
e.zh: know 常被称为预设内容为真的动词。

e.en: Her reply carried a {factive} assumption that the report existed.
e.zh: 她的回答带有一个事实性预设，即那份报告确实存在。

e.en: The merchant charged a small {factorage} on each shipment.
e.zh: 商人对每批货收取少量代理佣金。

e.en: His family survived through {factorage} and coastal trade.
e.zh: 他家靠代理业务和沿海贸易维持生计。

factoried.t: 设有代理商的；工厂化的

e.en: The colonial port was heavily {factoried} by foreign traders.
e.zh: 这个殖民港口曾有许多外国商人设立代理机构。

e.en: The valley became {factoried} after decades of industrial growth.
e.zh: 经过几十年的工业发展，这个山谷变得工厂化。

e.en: Prime {factorisation} is introduced early in the course.
e.zh: 素因数分解在课程早期就会讲到。

e.en: The algorithm speeds up matrix {factorisation}.
e.zh: 这个算法加快了矩阵分解过程。

e.en: Can you {factorise} this quadratic expression?
e.zh: 你能把这个二次表达式因式分解吗？

e.en: The program can {factorise} large numbers very quickly.
e.zh: 这个程序能很快把大数分解为因子。

e.en: She {factorises} the equation before solving it.
e.zh: 她先把方程因式分解，然后再求解。

e.en: This method {factorises} the matrix into simpler parts.
e.zh: 这种方法把矩阵分解成更简单的部分。

e.en: Students learn to {factorize} simple polynomials.
e.zh: 学生学习把简单多项式因式分解。

e.en: Modern software can {factorize} enormous integers.
e.zh: 现代软件可以分解极大的整数。

factorized.t: 已因式分解的；已分解的

e.en: The equation is easier once it is {factorized}.
e.zh: 方程一旦被因式分解，就更容易处理。

e.en: The data were {factorized} into several hidden variables.
e.zh: 这些数据被分解成几个隐藏变量。

e.en: He {factorizes} the polynomial on the board.
e.zh: 他在黑板上把这个多项式因式分解。

e.en: The library {factorizes} matrices for numerical analysis.
e.zh: 这个库会为数值分析分解矩阵。

factorizing.t: 正在因式分解；分解因子

e.en: She is {factorizing} the expression step by step.
e.zh: 她正在一步步地对这个表达式做因式分解。

e.en: The server spent hours {factorizing} the huge number.
e.zh: 服务器花了数小时分解那个巨大数字。

e.en: He accepted the {factorship} in a distant trading post.
e.zh: 他接受了远方贸易站的代理商职位。

e.en: The contract defined the limits of the {factorship}.
e.zh: 合同规定了这种代理关系的权限范围。

e.en: A tired {factory-hand} waited for the night bus.
e.zh: 一个疲惫的工厂工人在等夜班公交。

e.en: The novel follows a young {factory-hand} in Manchester.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述曼彻斯特一名年轻厂工的生活。

e.en: The {factory-owner} promised safer machines.
e.zh: 工厂老板承诺会使用更安全的机器。

e.en: A local {factory-owner} donated money to the school.
e.zh: 一位当地厂主向学校捐了钱。

e.en: The will named her as the estate's {factrix}.
e.zh: 遗嘱指定她为这份地产的女代理人。

e.en: The scholar used {factrix} as a rare feminine form of factor.
e.zh: 那位学者把 factrix 用作 factor 罕见的阴性形式。

e.en: His dry {factualism} left little room for speculation.
e.zh: 他干巴巴的重事实主义几乎不给推测留下空间。

e.en: The essay defends {factualism} against sentimental history.
e.zh: 这篇文章为事实论辩护，反对感伤化的历史写法。

e.en: As a {factualist}, she distrusted dramatic explanations.
e.zh: 作为重事实者，她不信任戏剧化的解释。

e.en: The {factualist} approach shaped his historical writing.
e.zh: 这种事实论者的方法影响了他的历史写作。

e.en: The report takes a strictly {factualistic} tone.
e.zh: 这份报告采用了严格重事实的语气。

e.en: His {factualistic} style can feel cold but precise.
e.zh: 他那种重事实的风格可能显得冷淡，但很准确。

e.en: The court considered the {factum} submitted by the appellant.
e.zh: 法院审阅了上诉人提交的法律陈述书。

e.en: Philosophers sometimes treat the event as a brute {factum}.
e.zh: 哲学家有时把这个事件视为一个原始事实。

e.en: The painting's rough {facture} reveals the artist's hand.
e.zh: 这幅画粗粝的艺术肌理显露出画家的手法。

e.en: Critics admired the careful {facture} of the sculpture.
e.zh: 评论家赞赏这件雕塑精细的制作方式。

facty.t: 事实感很强的；满是事实的

e.en: The article felt too {facty} to be persuasive.
e.zh: 这篇文章事实堆得太满，反而不太有说服力。

e.en: He prefers {facty} podcasts over casual chat shows.
e.zh: 比起闲聊节目，他更喜欢信息量很大的播客。

e.en: A bright {facula} appeared near the sunspot.
e.zh: 一个明亮的太阳光斑出现在黑子附近。

e.en: The astronomer marked each {facula} on the image.
e.zh: 天文学家在图像上标出每一个光斑。

e.en: Bright {faculae} appeared near the sunspot.
e.zh: 明亮的光斑出现在太阳黑子附近。

e.en: Astronomers mapped the solar {faculae} carefully.
e.zh: 天文学家仔细绘制了太阳光斑的分布。

e.en: The telescope recorded {facular} regions on the Sun.
e.zh: 望远镜记录到太阳上的光斑区域。

e.en: Scientists studied {facular} brightness changes.
e.zh: 科学家研究了光斑亮度的变化。

e.en: The philosopher discussed {faculative} powers of the mind.
e.zh: 那位哲学家讨论了心智能力。

e.en: Older texts describe memory as a {faculative} function.
e.zh: 旧文献把记忆描述为一种机能作用。

e.en: The charter would {facultize} the committee to act.
e.zh: 该章程将授权委员会采取行动。

e.en: Education can {facultize} people for civic life.
e.zh: 教育能使人具备参与公民生活的能力。

e.en: The report described the {fadayeen} as irregular fighters.
e.zh: 报告把敢死队员描述为非正规武装人员。

e.en: Several {fadayeen} crossed the border at night.
e.zh: 几名游击战士在夜间越过边境。

e.en: His diet advice was dismissed as {faddism}.
e.zh: 他的饮食建议被斥为盲目追潮流。

e.en: The market often rewards {faddism} over substance.
e.zh: 市场常常奖励赶时髦，而不是重视实质。

e.en: A {faddist} bought every new kitchen gadget.
e.zh: 一个赶时髦的人买下了每种新厨房小玩意。

e.en: The critic called him a literary {faddist}.
e.zh: 评论家称他是文学上的追新狂。

e.en: Stop that {faddle} and answer plainly.
e.zh: 别说那些废话，直接回答。

e.en: The meeting dissolved into bureaucratic {faddle}.
e.zh: 会议陷入了官僚式的琐碎胡闹。

e.en: The film opened with a slow {fade-in}.
e.zh: 这部电影以缓慢的淡入开场。

e.en: Use a {fade-in} for the first slide.
e.zh: 给第一张幻灯片使用淡入效果。

e.en: The song ended in a gentle {fade-out}.
e.zh: 这首歌以柔和的淡出结束。

e.en: Add a {fade-out} before the scene changes.
e.zh: 在场景切换前加一个淡出效果。

e.en: The editor added a quick {fadein} effect.
e.zh: 编辑加了一个快速淡入效果。

e.en: A soft {fadein} made the title appear.
e.zh: 柔和的淡入让标题显现出来。

e.en: She chose {fadeless} ink for the certificate.
e.zh: 她为证书选择了不褪色的墨水。

e.en: The poem speaks of {fadeless} love.
e.zh: 这首诗写的是永不消逝的爱。

e.en: The colors shone {fadelessly} in the old tapestry.
e.zh: 旧挂毯上的色彩依然不褪地闪耀。

e.en: Her kindness remained {fadelessly} in his memory.
e.zh: 她的善意永不消逝地留在他的记忆中。

e.en: The lab tested dyes with a {fadeometer}.
e.zh: 实验室用褪色测定仪测试染料。

e.en: A {fadeometer} measures resistance to light.
e.zh: 褪色测定仪用于测量耐光性。

e.en: The audio track needs a longer {fadeout}.
e.zh: 这条音轨需要更长的淡出。

e.en: They used {fadeout} to end the video.
e.zh: 他们用淡出效果结束了视频。

e.en: The plan did not {fadge} with their budget.
e.zh: 这个计划和他们的预算并不合拍。

e.en: Somehow the rough arrangement began to {fadge}.
e.zh: 这个粗略安排不知怎的开始凑合运转起来。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {fadometer} before testing.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前校准了褪色测定仪。

e.en: A {fadometer} exposed the fabric to strong light.
e.zh: 褪色测定仪让织物暴露在强光下。

e.en: The cheap cloth was bright but {fady}.
e.zh: 这块廉价布料颜色鲜亮却容易褪色。

e.en: Avoid {fady} pigments in outdoor signs.
e.zh: 户外标牌应避免使用易褪色的颜料。

e.en: Doctors tested the patient's {faeces} for infection.
e.zh: 医生检测了病人的粪便是否有感染。

e.en: Animal {faeces} can spread parasites.
e.zh: 动物粪便可能传播寄生虫。

e.en: The liquid left a brown {faecula} at the bottom.
e.zh: 液体在底部留下了棕色沉淀物。

e.en: Old chemists called the residue {faecula}.
e.zh: 早期化学家把这种残渣称为渣滓。

e.en: The matador began the final {faena} confidently.
e.zh: 斗牛士自信地开始了最后的斗牛表演。

e.en: Critics praised the elegance of his {faena}.
e.zh: 评论家称赞他的斗牛动作优雅。

faggotry.t: 男同性恋行为；冒犯性说法

e.en: The slur {faggotry} should be avoided in conversation.
e.zh: faggotry这个侮辱性词语在谈话中应避免使用。

e.en: The article examined how {faggotry} was used to shame men.
e.zh: 文章考察了这个冒犯性词语如何被用来羞辱男性。

faggoty.t: 像柴捆的；冒犯性同性恋的

e.en: The old fence had a {faggoty} tangle of sticks.
