e.en: They hoped to {federalise} several regional programs.
e.zh: 他们希望把几个地区项目改由联邦统筹。

e.en: As a {federationist}, he backed stronger regional autonomy.
e.zh: 作为联邦制支持者，他赞成更强的地区自治。

e.en: The {federationist} argument gained support after the election.
e.zh: 选举后，支持联邦制的论点获得了更多支持。

e.en: The actor boomed {fee-faw-fum} from backstage.
e.zh: 演员在后台大声喊出童谣里的巨人吼声。

e.en: Children laughed at the giant's {fee-faw-fum}.
e.zh: 孩子们听到巨人的那句怪吼都笑了。

e.en: The clinic uses a {fee-for-service} payment model.
e.zh: 这家诊所采用按服务收费的支付模式。

e.en: Some doctors prefer {fee-for-service} contracts.
e.zh: 一些医生更喜欢按服务收费的合同。

e.en: The university accepts many {fee-paying} students.
e.zh: 这所大学招收许多自费学生。

e.en: Only {fee-paying} members can enter the club lounge.
e.zh: 只有付费会员才能进入俱乐部休息室。

e.en: The partners agreed on {fee-splitting} after each case.
e.zh: 合伙人同意每个案子结束后分摊费用。

e.en: The board banned illegal {fee-splitting} between doctors.
e.zh: 委员会禁止医生之间非法分成回扣。

e.en: The estate was held in {fee-tail} for generations.
e.zh: 这处地产数代以来以限嗣继承方式持有。

e.en: The lawyer explained the old {fee-tail} restriction.
e.zh: 律师解释了那条古老的限嗣继承限制。

e.en: Many viewers switched from {fee-tv} to streaming services.
e.zh: 许多观众从收费电视转向了流媒体服务。

e.en: The match was shown only on {fee-tv}.
e.zh: 这场比赛只在收费电视上播出。

e.en: Stop acting like a {feeb} and read the instructions.
e.zh: 别像个笨蛋一样，先看看说明。

e.en: The insult {feeb} now sounds old-fashioned.
e.zh: “feeb”这个骂人的词现在听起来很老派。

e.en: The old records used the term {feeble-minded}.
e.zh: 那些旧记录使用了“智力低下”这个说法。

e.en: Calling someone {feeble-minded} is now deeply offensive.
e.zh: 说某人智力低下现在非常冒犯。

e.en: The novel describes a {feebleminded} servant cruelly.
e.zh: 这部小说残酷地描写了一名智力低下的仆人。

e.en: His {feebleminded} excuse convinced no one.
e.zh: 他那愚蠢的借口没有说服任何人。

e.en: He {feeblemindedly} repeated the same wrong answer.
e.zh: 他糊涂地重复了同一个错误答案。

e.en: She smiled {feeblemindedly} at the confusing instructions.
e.zh: 面对令人困惑的说明，她傻乎乎地笑了笑。

e.en: Even the {feeblest} patient showed some improvement.
e.zh: 即使最虚弱的病人也有了一些好转。

e.en: That was the {feeblest} excuse I had heard.
e.zh: 那是我听过最无力的借口。

e.en: He gave a {feeblish} wave from the doorway.
e.zh: 他在门口有气无力地挥了挥手。

e.en: The lamp cast a {feeblish} light over the desk.
e.zh: 那盏灯在桌上投下微弱的光。

e.en: The baby refused the {feed-bottle} at first.
e.zh: 宝宝一开始拒绝用奶瓶。

e.en: Wash the {feed-bottle} carefully after each use.
e.zh: 每次使用后都要仔细清洗喂食瓶。

e.en: The machine has a paper {feed-in} slot.
e.zh: 这台机器有一个进纸输入槽。

e.en: Solar panels use a {feed-in} tariff system.
e.zh: 太阳能板采用上网电价补贴制度。

e.en: The operator checked the {feed-tank} before startup.
e.zh: 操作员在启动前检查了供料罐。

e.en: Sediment had collected inside the {feed-tank}.
e.zh: 沉淀物积在了给料箱内部。

e.en: The old computer read commands from {feed-tape}.
e.zh: 那台旧电脑从输入带读取命令。

e.en: Replace the {feed-tape} when the machine jams.
e.zh: 机器卡住时要更换送料带。

felicitator.t: 祝贺者；道贺的人，如礼仪主持者

e.en: The mayor acted as the official {felicitator} at the ceremony.
e.zh: 市长在仪式上担任正式的致贺人。

e.en: Every {felicitator} praised the couple warmly after the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼之后，每位祝贺者都热情称赞这对新人。

e.en: The lynx is a wild {felid} with tufted ears.
e.zh: 猞猁是一种耳尖有毛簇的野生猫科动物。

e.en: Researchers compared the skulls of several extinct {felids}.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了几种已灭绝猫科动物的头骨。

e.en: The laboratory measured {felinine} levels in the cat's urine.
e.zh: 实验室测量了这只猫尿液中的猫尿氨酸含量。

e.en: Male cats often produce more {felinine} than female cats.
e.zh: 公猫产生的猫尿氨酸通常比母猫更多。

e.en: Her quiet movements had a certain {felinity}.
e.zh: 她安静的动作带着某种猫一般的特质。

e.en: The dancer used {felinity} to make the role seem dangerous.
e.zh: 舞者用猫似的气质让这个角色显得危险。

e.en: Only the dead trees were marked as {fellable}.
e.zh: 只有枯死的树被标记为可以砍倒。

e.en: The old wall looked weak and {fellable} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，那堵旧墙看起来脆弱得可以被推倒。

e.en: The report described a captured {fellagha} near the border.
e.zh: 报告描述了一名在边境附近被俘的法拉加游击队员。

e.en: French newspapers used {fellagha} for rebels in North Africa.
e.zh: 法国报纸曾用法拉加一词称呼北非叛乱者。

e.en: The traveler wrote about the {fellaheen} working beside the Nile.
e.zh: 旅行者写到了在尼罗河边劳作的埃及农民。

e.en: Many {fellaheen} lived in villages tied to old estates.
e.zh: 许多佃农住在与旧庄园相连的村庄里。

e.en: The {fellahin} irrigated their fields before sunrise.
e.zh: 这些农民在日出前给田地灌溉。

e.en: Historians studied how the {fellahin} paid taxes under the empire.
e.zh: 历史学家研究这些佃农在帝国统治下如何纳税。

e.en: The clinical text used {fellator} as a technical term.
e.zh: 这本临床文本把为他人口交者用作技术术语。

e.en: In older legal language, a {fellator} was described very bluntly.
e.zh: 在较旧的法律语言中，为他人口交者会被很直白地描述。

e.en: The carpenter replaced two cracked {fellies} on the wagon wheel.
e.zh: 木匠更换了马车轮上两块开裂的轮辋木。

e.en: Old wheels often used several {fellies} joined around the hub.
e.zh: 旧式车轮常用几段轮辋木围绕轮毂拼接而成。

e.en: The {fellmonger} bought hides from farms outside town.
e.zh: 这名生皮商从城外农场收购兽皮。

e.en: A {fellmonger} once removed wool from sheepskins by hand.
e.zh: 从前羊毛剥取工会手工从羊皮上取下羊毛。

fellmongered.t: 处理过生皮或剥过羊毛的

e.en: The hides were {fellmongered} before being sent to the tannery.
e.zh: 这些兽皮先经过生皮处理，再送往制革厂。

e.en: He {fellmongered} sheepskins in a workshop near the river.
e.zh: 他在河边的作坊里处理羊皮并剥取羊毛。

e.en: {Fellmongering} was once an important trade in the town.
e.zh: 生皮处理业曾是这座城镇的重要行当。

e.en: The smell of {fellmongering} drifted from the riverside sheds.
e.zh: 剥取羊毛和处理生皮的气味从河边棚屋飘来。

e.en: A broken {felloe} made the cart wheel wobble badly.
e.zh: 一块断裂的轮辋木让车轮摇晃得很厉害。

e.en: The wheelwright shaped each {felloe} to fit the wooden rim.
e.zh: 车轮匠把每块轮辋弧木削成适合木轮圈的形状。

e.en: She praised her {fellow-actor} after the final scene.
e.zh: 最后一场戏结束后，她称赞了同台演员。

e.en: A {fellow-actor} helped him rehearse the difficult speech.
e.zh: 一位同行演员帮他排练那段困难的台词。

e.en: He asked every {fellow-citizen} to vote responsibly.
e.zh: 他呼吁每一位同胞负责任地投票。

e.en: A {fellow-citizen} offered her help during the flood.
e.zh: 洪水期间，一位同国公民向她伸出了援手。

e.en: He could not bear to see a {fellow-creature} suffer.
e.zh: 他无法忍受看见另一个生命受苦。

e.en: The essay urges kindness toward every {fellow-creature}.
e.zh: 这篇文章呼吁善待每一个同为生命的存在。

e.en: We share this planet with many {fellow-creatures}.
e.zh: 我们与许多其他生灵共同生活在这个星球上。

e.en: The monk taught compassion for all {fellow-creatures}.
e.zh: 那位僧人教人怜悯一切众生。

e.en: A {fellow-guest} told us the hotel was closing early.
e.zh: 一位同住客告诉我们酒店会提前关门。

e.en: She shared dessert with a {fellow-guest} at dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时她和一位同席客人分享了甜点。

e.en: He believed every {fellow-man} deserved basic dignity.
e.zh: 他相信每个同胞都应享有基本尊严。

e.en: The sermon asked people to love their {fellow-man}.
e.zh: 布道要求人们关爱自己的同类。

e.en: A {fellow-passenger} helped me lift my suitcase.
e.zh: 一位同行旅客帮我抬起了行李箱。

e.en: She chatted with a {fellow-passenger} during the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行中，她和一位同机乘客聊了起来。

e.en: The delay annoyed all the {fellow-passengers} on the train.
e.zh: 这次延误让火车上所有同行乘客都很恼火。

e.en: He thanked his {fellow-passengers} for staying calm.
e.zh: 他感谢同行旅客们保持冷静。

fellow-scientists.t: 同行科学家；科学家同事

e.en: She shared the early results with her {fellow-scientists}.
e.zh: 她把早期结果分享给同行科学家。

e.en: The award was celebrated by his {fellow-scientists} worldwide.
e.zh: 世界各地的科学家同事都为他获奖而庆祝。

e.en: A {fellow-student} helped me find the lecture hall.
e.zh: 一位同学帮我找到了讲堂。

e.en: She borrowed notes from a {fellow-student} after missing class.
e.zh: 她缺课后向同校学生借了笔记。

e.en: We met a {fellow-traveling} couple on the night train.
e.zh: 我们在夜车上遇到了一对同路旅行的夫妇。

e.en: Her {fellow-traveling} friends preferred small local cafes.
e.zh: 她同行旅行的朋友更喜欢当地小咖啡馆。

e.en: The storm forced the {fellow-travellers} to share a shelter.
e.zh: 暴风雨迫使这些同行旅伴共用一个避难处。

e.en: He greeted his {fellow-travellers} before boarding the coach.
e.zh: 上长途车前，他向同路人打了招呼。

e.en: A {fellow-travelling} journalist knew the safest route.
e.zh: 一位同行旅行的记者知道最安全的路线。

e.en: They relied on their {fellow-travelling} companions for advice.
e.zh: 他们依靠同路的伙伴提供建议。

e.en: The old sailor felt {fellowless} in the crowded port.
e.zh: 那位老水手在拥挤的港口里感到没有同伴。

e.en: The poet called the mountain {fellowless} in its grandeur.
e.zh: 诗人称那座山气势无匹。

e.en: His {fellowlike} warmth made strangers feel included.
e.zh: 他像伙伴般的热情让陌生人也感到被接纳。

e.en: The manager spoke in a {fellowlike} way, not as a boss.
e.zh: 经理说话像同伴一样，而不是摆老板架子。

e.en: He believed every {fellowman} deserved basic dignity.
e.zh: 他相信每个同胞都应享有基本尊严。

e.en: The sermon urged kindness toward one's {fellowman}.
e.zh: 那篇布道劝人善待自己的同类。

e.en: They worked to improve the lives of their {fellowmen}.
e.zh: 他们努力改善同胞们的生活。

e.en: A leader should not despise his {fellowmen}.
e.zh: 领导者不应轻视自己的同类。

e.en: The wheelwright replaced the cracked {felly} before dawn.
e.zh: 车轮匠在天亮前换掉了开裂的轮辋段。

e.en: Each wooden {felly} had to fit the iron tire tightly.
e.zh: 每段木制车轮外圈都必须紧贴铁轮箍。

e.en: The old law treated a {felo-de-se} as a criminal.
e.zh: 旧法律把自杀者视为罪犯。

e.en: The coroner avoided the term {felo-de-se} in the report.
e.zh: 验尸官在报告中避免使用自杀行为这个说法。

e.en: The pamphlet described the prison as a school of {felonry}.
e.zh: 那本小册子把监狱描述成重罪犯的学校。

e.en: Officials blamed organized {felonry} for the wave of robberies.
e.zh: 官员把这波抢劫归咎于有组织的重罪行为。

e.en: The hikers crossed a cold {felsenmeer} below the ridge.
e.zh: 徒步者穿过山脊下方一片寒冷的石海。

e.en: A {felsenmeer} can form when frost breaks bedrock apart.
e.zh: 霜冻把基岩裂开时，可能形成大片岩块堆。

e.en: The geologist identified the pale rock as {felsite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把那块浅色岩石鉴定为霏细岩。

e.en: A vein of {felsite} cut through the older formation.
e.zh: 一条细粒长英岩岩脉穿过了较老的地层。

felsitic.t: 霏细岩质的；细粒长英质的

e.en: The sample had a dense {felsitic} texture.
e.zh: 样品具有致密的霏细岩质结构。

e.en: They mapped several {felsitic} dikes near the quarry.
e.zh: 他们在采石场附近绘出了几条细粒长英质岩墙。

felsophaerite.t: 球粒霏细岩；球状长英岩

e.en: The thin section showed tiny spheres of {felsophaerite}.
e.zh: 薄片中显示出细小的球粒霏细岩颗粒。

e.en: Collectors prized the unusual pattern in the {felsophaerite}.
e.zh: 收藏者看重这块球状长英岩中不寻常的纹理。

e.en: The old textbook spelled feldspar as {felspar}.
e.zh: 那本旧教材把长石拼作felspar。

e.en: Miners found quartz and {felspar} in the same vein.
e.zh: 矿工在同一条矿脉中发现了石英和长石。

e.en: The granite contains a high proportion of {felspathic} minerals.
e.zh: 这种花岗岩含有大量长石质矿物。

e.en: A pale {felspathic} sand covered the dry stream bed.
e.zh: 浅色的含长石沙覆盖着干涸的河床。

e.en: Nepheline is a common {felspathoid} in alkaline rocks.
e.zh: 霞石是碱性岩中常见的似长石矿物。

e.en: The mineralogist noted a {felspathoid} where quartz was absent.
e.zh: 矿物学家注意到在缺少石英处有副长石。

e.en: The wall was built from blocks of local {felstone}.
e.zh: 这堵墙是用当地霏细岩石块砌成的。

e.en: Weathered {felstone} gave the hillside a pale grey color.
e.zh: 风化的细粒火成岩让山坡呈现浅灰色。

e.en: She wrote the labels with a black {felt-tip}.
e.zh: 她用黑色毡头笔写标签。

e.en: The child drew stars with {felt-tip} markers.
e.zh: 孩子用毡尖马克笔画星星。

e.en: The plant's leaves had a soft, {felty} surface.
e.zh: 这种植物的叶子表面柔软，像毡一样。

e.en: A {felty} layer formed inside the old pipe.
e.zh: 旧管道内部形成了一层毡状物。

felucca.t: 三角帆小船；尼罗河帆船

e.en: We crossed the river in a wooden {felucca}.
e.zh: 我们乘一艘木制三角帆小船过河。

e.en: A white {felucca} moved slowly along the Nile.
e.zh: 一艘白色尼罗河帆船沿着尼罗河缓缓前行。

fembot.t: 女性外形机器人；女机器人

e.en: The old sci-fi film features a charming {fembot}.
e.zh: 那部老科幻片里有一个迷人的女性机器人。

e.en: Critics said the character felt like a stereotyped {fembot}.
e.zh: 评论者说这个角色像刻板化的女机器人。

fembots.t: 女性外形机器人；女机器人

e.en: The laboratory displayed three silver {fembots}.
e.zh: 实验室展示了三个银色的女性机器人。

e.en: The comedy used {fembots} to parody spy movies.
e.zh: 这部喜剧用女机器人来戏仿间谍电影。

e.en: The document described the manor as a {feme}.
e.zh: 文件把这座庄园描述为一块封建采邑。

e.en: A historian explained how the {feme} passed to the heir.
e.zh: 一位历史学家解释了这块封地如何传给继承人。

e.en: The clinic provided a {femidom} during the workshop.
e.zh: 诊所在讲座中提供了一个女用避孕套。

e.en: She asked whether a {femidom} was available at the pharmacy.
e.zh: 她询问药店是否有女用避孕套出售。

e.en: The essay links {feminacy} with social expectations.
e.zh: 这篇文章把女性特质同社会期待联系起来。

e.en: Victorian writers often treated {feminacy} as moral refinement.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的作家常把阴柔气质视为道德上的精致。

e.en: The poet praised the {feminal} grace of the figure.
e.zh: 诗人赞美那个人物的女性柔美。

e.en: Biologists noted a {feminal} pattern in the markings.
e.zh: 生物学家注意到这些斑纹呈现雌性特征。

e.en: The novel questions fixed ideas of {feminality}.
e.zh: 这部小说质疑对女性气质的固定看法。

e.en: Her costume exaggerated {feminality} for comic effect.
e.zh: 她的服装夸张了女性特质，以制造喜剧效果。

e.en: The portrait suggests quiet {femineity} rather than weakness.
e.zh: 这幅肖像表现的是安静的女性气质，而不是软弱。

e.en: Scholars debated the meaning of {femineity} in the poem.
e.zh: 学者们讨论这首诗中女性特质的含义。

e.en: The campaign tried to {feminise} the public image of leadership.
e.zh: 这场宣传试图让领导力的公众形象更女性化。

e.en: Hormone treatment may {feminise} some physical features.
e.zh: 激素治疗可能会使某些身体特征女性化。

feministic.t: 女权主义的；带女权色彩的

e.en: Her speech had a strongly {feministic} tone.
e.zh: 她的演讲带有很强的女权主义色彩。

e.en: The editor rejected the article as too {feministic}.
e.zh: 编辑认为那篇文章女权色彩过浓而拒绝了它。

e.en: The dancer expressed {feminity} with deliberate restraint.
e.zh: 舞者以克制的方式表现女性气质。

e.en: The advertisement presented {feminity} as elegance and care.
e.zh: 这则广告把女性特质表现为优雅和关怀。

e.en: The paper reported the result in {femitron} units.
e.zh: 论文用飞米电子伏特单位报告了结果。

e.en: Few students had heard the term {femitron} before the lecture.
e.zh: 讲座之前很少有学生听过飞米电子伏特这个术语。

e.en: The table listed several values in {femitrons}.
e.zh: 表格列出了几个以飞米电子伏特表示的数值。

e.en: Older notes converted the measurements into {femitrons}.
e.zh: 旧笔记把这些测量值换算成了飞米电子伏特。

e.en: The archaeologists found two human {femora}.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了两根人类股骨。

e.en: Doctors compared the fractured {femora} on the scans.
e.zh: 医生比较了扫描图像中的断裂股骨。

femorotibial.t: 股胫部的；股骨胫骨间的

e.en: The scan showed damage in the {femorotibial} joint.
e.zh: 扫描显示股胫关节有损伤。

e.en: Surgeons assessed the {femorotibial} alignment before surgery.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术前评估了股骨与胫骨的对线情况。

e.en: The sample contained less than one {femtogram} of DNA.
e.zh: 样本中的DNA少于一飞克。

e.en: Modern instruments can detect a single {femtogram}.
e.zh: 现代仪器能够检测到一飞克的物质。

e.en: A proton is roughly one {femtometer} across.
e.zh: 一个质子的直径大约是一飞米。

e.en: The physicist converted the radius into {femtometers}.
e.zh: 物理学家把半径换算成飞米。

e.en: The detector measured a signal of one {femtovolt}.
e.zh: 探测器测得了一个一飞伏的信号。

e.en: Noise can hide changes below a {femtovolt}.
e.zh: 噪声可能掩盖低于一飞伏的变化。

e.en: The sensor operated at about one {femtowatt}.
e.zh: 这个传感器的工作功率约为一飞瓦。

e.en: Astronomers detected radiation measured in {femtowatts}.
e.zh: 天文学家探测到以飞瓦计量的辐射。

fenagle.t: 用诡计骗取；耍手腕弄到

e.en: He tried to {fenagle} a better seat at the concert.
e.zh: 他想耍点手腕在音乐会上弄到更好的座位。

e.en: They managed to {fenagle} extra funding from the board.
e.zh: 他们设法从董事会那里争取到额外资金。

e.en: The old lantern became a {fence-hanger} outside the barn.
e.zh: 那盏旧灯笼成了谷仓外挂在栅栏上的东西。

e.en: A tired {fence-hanger} watched the parade from the field edge.
e.zh: 一个倚在栅栏边的人从田地边看着游行。

e.en: After the argument, the senator began some careful {fence-mending}.
e.zh: 争吵之后，那位参议员开始谨慎地修复关系。

e.en: The farmers spent Saturday {fence-mending} before the cattle returned.
e.zh: 牛群回来前，农民们周六都在修围栏。

e.en: The horse rubbed its neck against a {fence-post}.
e.zh: 那匹马把脖子在一根栅栏柱上蹭来蹭去。

e.en: We replaced every rotten {fence-post} along the road.
e.zh: 我们换掉了路边每一根腐烂的围栏桩。

fence-sitter.t: 骑墙派；观望不表态的人

e.en: The mayor called him a {fence-sitter} on the tax issue.
e.zh: 市长说他在税收问题上是个骑墙派。

e.en: In family disputes, she refuses to be a {fence-sitter}.
e.zh: 在家庭争执中，她不愿做一个只观望不表态的人。

e.en: His constant {fence-sitting} frustrated both sides of the debate.
e.zh: 他总是骑墙观望，让辩论双方都很沮丧。

e.en: There is no room for {fence-sitting} during this crisis.
e.zh: 在这场危机中，没有继续不表态的余地。

e.en: The sheep wandered across the {fenceless} meadow.
e.zh: 羊群在没有围栏的草地上四处走动。

e.en: A {fenceless} border made the villages feel connected.
e.zh: 没有屏障的边界让这些村庄显得彼此相连。

e.en: The park's {fencelessness} made it easy to enter from any street.
e.zh: 公园没有围栏，从任何一条街都很容易进去。

e.en: Her poems celebrate the {fencelessness} of childhood imagination.
e.zh: 她的诗赞美童年想象那种没有边界的状态。

e.en: A {fencelike} row of reeds lined the riverbank.
e.zh: 河岸边一排芦苇像栅栏一样排列着。

e.en: The sculpture used {fencelike} bars to suggest separation.
e.zh: 那件雕塑用围栏状的杆子来暗示隔离。

e.en: No one trusted the {fencesitter} after the vote.
e.zh: 投票之后，没人再信任那个骑墙派。

e.en: A cautious {fencesitter} waited until the winner was obvious.
e.zh: 一个谨慎的观望者等到胜负明显后才表态。

e.en: The hilltop village was easily {fencible} against raids.
e.zh: 山顶上的村庄很容易抵御袭击。

e.en: He served as a {fencible} during the old border wars.
e.zh: 在早年的边境战争中，他曾当过地方民兵。

e.en: She was late because of a {fender-bender} downtown.
e.zh: 她迟到是因为市中心发生了一起轻微撞车事故。

e.en: The insurance company treated it as a minor {fender-bender}.
e.zh: 保险公司把它当作一次轻微追尾事故处理。

e.en: The {fenderless} bicycle sprayed mud onto his coat.
e.zh: 那辆没有挡泥板的自行车把泥水溅到了他的外套上。

e.en: A {fenderless} hot rod roared past the garage.
e.zh: 一辆没有挡泥板的改装车轰鸣着驶过车库。

e.en: The farm stopped using {fenoprop} near the stream.
e.zh: 这家农场停止在溪流附近使用芬诺丙这种除草剂。

e.en: Old records listed {fenoprop} among banned chemicals.
e.zh: 旧记录把芬诺丙列入禁用化学品之中。

e.en: The label described {fenormone} as a plant regulator.
e.zh: 标签把芬诺蒙描述为一种植物生长调节剂。

e.en: Researchers compared {fenormone} with other agricultural chemicals.
e.zh: 研究人员把芬诺蒙与其他农用化学品作了比较。

e.en: The doctor avoided prescribing {fenpentadiol} to elderly patients.
e.zh: 医生避免给老年患者开芬戊二醇这种镇静药。

e.en: Older textbooks mention {fenpentadiol} as a sedative.
e.zh: 较早的教材把芬戊二醇列为一种镇静药。

e.en: The pesticide {fensulfothion} was handled with special care.
e.zh: 处理芬硫磷这种杀虫剂时格外小心。

e.en: Soil tests detected traces of {fensulfothion} after spraying.
e.zh: 喷洒后，土壤检测发现了微量芬硫磷。

e.en: The village banned {fenthion} after fish died downstream.
e.zh: 下游鱼类死亡后，村里禁用了倍硫磷。

e.en: Workers wore masks while mixing {fenthion}.
e.zh: 工人调配倍硫磷时戴着口罩。

e.en: The report classified {fenthiuron} as a hazardous pesticide.
e.zh: 报告把芬硫脲归为危险杀虫剂。

e.en: Farmers received instructions for storing {fenthiuron} safely.
e.zh: 农民收到了安全储存芬硫脲的说明。

e.en: The shipment contained {fentiazon} for agricultural use.
e.zh: 这批货物含有用于农业的芬噻唑。

e.en: Inspectors checked whether {fentiazon} residues exceeded the limit.
e.zh: 检查员查看芬噻唑残留是否超标。

e.en: The orchard once used {fentinacetate} to control fungal disease.
e.zh: 这片果园曾使用薯瘟锡乙酸盐防治真菌病害。

e.en: Regulators restricted {fentinacetate} because of environmental concerns.
e.zh: 出于环境担忧，监管机构限制了薯瘟锡乙酸盐。

e.en: The document spelled {fentinactate} differently from the label.
e.zh: 文件中薯瘟锡乙酸盐的拼写与标签不同。

e.en: Some catalogs list {fentinactate} as an old fungicide.
e.zh: 一些目录把芬锡乙酸盐列为旧式杀菌剂。

e.en: The weed trial included {fenuram} and several newer products.
e.zh: 除草试验包括芬尿隆和几种较新的产品。

e.en: The technician measured {fenuram} residues in the soil sample.
e.zh: 技术员测量了土壤样本中的芬尿隆残留。

e.en: Crews applied {fenuron-tac} along the railway embankment.
e.zh: 施工队在铁路路堤沿线喷洒了芬尿隆混合除草剂。

e.en: The manual warned that {fenuron-tac} could persist in soil.
e.zh: 手册警告说芬尿隆混合剂可能在土壤中残留。

e.en: The sample contained {feochromin}, giving it a dark color.
e.zh: 样品含有含铁色素，因此呈现深色。

e.en: Scientists studied {feochromin} in the organism's tissues.
e.zh: 科学家研究了该生物组织中的含铁色素。

e.en: The knight held a small {feod} from the lord.
e.zh: 这名骑士从领主那里持有一小块封地。

e.en: Medieval charters often described land as a {feod}.
e.zh: 中世纪宪章常把土地称为采邑。

e.en: The village kept several {feodal} obligations.
e.zh: 这个村庄保留了几项封建义务。

e.en: Historians debated the {feodal} nature of the grant.
e.zh: 历史学家争论这项授予是否具有封地性质。

e.en: The king agreed to {feoff} the loyal soldier.
e.zh: 国王同意把封地授予那名忠诚的士兵。

e.en: A lord could {feoff} land to a vassal.
e.zh: 领主可以把土地作为封地授给附庸。

e.en: The baron {feoffed} his nephew with the manor.
e.zh: 男爵把庄园作为封地授给了侄子。

e.en: She was {feoffed} in lands near the river.
e.zh: 她获得了河边土地的封地授予。

e.en: The {feoffee} promised service in return for the estate.
e.zh: 受封地者承诺以服役来回报这处地产。

e.en: Each {feoffee} was named in the deed.
e.zh: 契约中列出了每一名受封地者。

e.en: The {feoffer} retained certain rights over the land.
e.zh: 授封地者保留了对这片土地的某些权利。

e.en: Lawyers identified the original {feoffer} in the old deed.
e.zh: 律师在旧契约中确认了最初的授封地者。

e.en: The ceremony of {feoffing} took place before witnesses.
e.zh: 授予封地的仪式在见证人面前举行。

e.en: He was {feoffing} land to secure military loyalty.
e.zh: 他通过授予封地来确保军事忠诚。

e.en: The {feoffment} transferred the manor to the tenant.
e.zh: 这份封地授予把庄园转给了佃领人。

e.en: A written {feoffment} confirmed the legal transfer.
e.zh: 书面授封契据确认了这次法律转让。

e.en: The {feoffor} delivered possession in a formal act.
e.zh: 授封地者通过正式行为交付了占有权。

e.en: Records named the {feoffor} and the new tenant.
e.zh: 记录写明了授封地者和新的佃领人。

e.en: The valley was {feracious} after years of flooding.
e.zh: 多年洪水冲积后，这片山谷变得肥沃多产。

e.en: Her {feracious} imagination filled the novel with strange cities.
e.zh: 她丰富多产的想象力让小说充满奇异城市。

e.en: Medieval preachers condemned {feneration} as sinful greed.
e.zh: 中世纪传教士谴责放债取息是罪恶的贪婪。

e.en: The old statute treated secret {feneration} as a public offense.
e.zh: 那部旧法把暗中放高利贷视为公害。

e.en: The surgeon inspected the tiny {fenestella} in the bone.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了骨头上的小窗孔。

e.en: A carved {fenestella} let light into the chapel wall.
e.zh: 一个雕刻的小窗洞让光线进入礼拜堂墙内。

e.en: Several {fenestellae} were visible along the damaged shell.
e.zh: 受损外壳上可以看到几个小窗孔。

e.en: The diagram labels the {fenestellae} between the delicate ribs.
e.zh: 图中标出了细小肋条之间的那些小开口。

e.en: Sound vibrations pass through the oval {fenestra} of the ear.
e.zh: 声音振动会通过耳内的卵圆窗。

e.en: The fossil shows a large {fenestra} behind the eye socket.
e.zh: 这块化石显示眼眶后方有一个大孔。

e.en: The architect preserved the building's original {fenestral} pattern.
e.zh: 建筑师保留了这栋楼原有的窗户布局。

e.en: The report describes a rare {fenestral} defect in the membrane.
e.zh: 报告描述了膜上罕见的窗孔样缺损。

e.en: The disease can {fenestrate} the thin tissue over time.
e.zh: 这种疾病会随着时间在薄组织上形成小孔。

e.en: Engineers sometimes {fenestrate} panels to reduce weight.
e.zh: 工程师有时会在面板上开孔以减轻重量。

e.en: The patient received a {fenestrated} surgical graft.
e.zh: 患者接受了带孔的外科移植物。

e.en: Sunlight filtered through the {fenestrated} stone screen.
e.zh: 阳光透过有窗孔的石屏洒进来。

e.en: The procedure {fenestrates} the membrane to relieve pressure.
e.zh: 该手术在膜上开孔以缓解压力。

e.en: This tool {fenestrates} the sheet without tearing its edges.
e.zh: 这个工具能给薄片打孔而不撕裂边缘。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {fenfluramine} for weight loss.
e.zh: 医生曾经开芬氟拉明用于减重。

e.en: The study linked {fenfluramine} to serious heart problems.
e.zh: 研究把芬氟拉明与严重心脏问题联系起来。

e.en: The extract contained traces of {feniculin}.
e.zh: 这种提取物含有微量茴香相关成分。

e.en: Researchers measured {feniculin} in the plant sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了植物样本中的茴香成分。

e.en: The vineyard trial compared {fenidim} with older fungicides.
e.zh: 葡萄园试验把芬尼定与较旧的杀菌剂作了比较。

e.en: Residues of {fenidim} were tested after harvest.
e.zh: 收获后检测了芬尼定的残留。

e.en: Farmers used {fenitrothion} to control rice pests.
e.zh: 农民使用杀螟硫磷来防治水稻害虫。

e.en: The river sample showed low levels of {fenitrothion}.
e.zh: 河水样本显示含有低水平的杀螟硫磷。

e.en: The paper reviewed early trials of {fenmetozole}.
e.zh: 论文回顾了芬美托唑的早期试验。

e.en: No pharmacy nearby stocked {fenmetozole}.
e.zh: 附近没有药房备有芬美托唑。

e.en: A {fennec} can hear insects moving under sand.
e.zh: 耳廓狐能听见沙下昆虫的动静。

e.en: The zoo's {fennec} slept through the hot afternoon.
e.zh: 动物园里的耳廓狐在炎热的下午睡了过去。

e.en: The old book spells the animal as {fennek}.
e.zh: 那本旧书把这种动物拼作fennek。

e.en: A {fennek} survives by conserving water in the desert.
e.zh: 耳廓狐靠节水在沙漠中生存。

e.en: She planted {fennelflower} beside the herb bed.
e.zh: 她在香草畦旁种了黑种草。

e.en: The blue {fennelflower} attracted bees all morning.
e.zh: 蓝色的黑种草整个上午都吸引着蜜蜂。

e.en: The field study monitored {fenophosphon} in treated soil.
e.zh: 田间研究监测了处理土壤中的芬膦酸。

e.en: Regulators restricted {fenophosphon} after environmental concerns grew.
e.zh: 环保担忧增加后，监管机构限制了芬膦酸。

e.en: The old tale praised the wolf's {feracity} in winter.
e.zh: 这个古老故事赞美了狼在冬天的野性。

e.en: His sudden {feracity} frightened the whole room.
e.zh: 他突然显出的凶猛吓坏了整个房间。

e.en: The vineyard used {ferbam} to control fungal disease.
e.zh: 葡萄园使用福美铁来控制真菌病害。

e.en: Workers handled {ferbam} only with protective gloves.
e.zh: 工人只有戴上防护手套才处理福美铁。

e.en: The geologist identified {ferberite} in the dark vein.
e.zh: 地质学家在深色矿脉中辨认出黑钨矿。

e.en: Samples of {ferberite} were sent to the laboratory.
e.zh: 黑钨矿样品被送往实验室检测。

e.en: A {ferdelance} lay hidden beside the trail.
e.zh: 一条矛头蝮蛇藏在小路旁边。

e.en: The guide warned us that the {ferdelance} was highly venomous.
e.zh: 向导警告我们矛头蝮蛇毒性很强。

e.en: The knight rode beside his trusted {fere}.
e.zh: 骑士与他信任的同伴并肩骑行。

e.en: She called him her {fere} in the old poem.
e.zh: 在那首古诗里，她称他为自己的伴侣。

e.en: Pilgrims gathered before the silver {feretory}.
e.zh: 朝圣者聚集在银制圣骨匣前。

e.en: The abbey kept the saint's relics in a {feretory}.
e.zh: 修道院把圣人的遗物存放在圣物龛中。

e.en: The collector bought a small crystal of {ferghanite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一小块费尔干石晶体。

e.en: They described {ferghanite} as a rare borate mineral.
e.zh: 他们把费尔干石描述为一种稀有硼酸盐矿物。

e.en: The specimen contained traces of {fergusonite}.
e.zh: 这件标本含有少量褐钇铌矿。

e.en: Miners found {fergusonite} near the granite contact.
e.zh: 矿工在花岗岩接触带附近发现了褐钇铌矿。

e.en: The service was assigned to the second {feria}.
e.zh: 这场礼拜被安排在第二个平日举行。

e.en: In Spanish towns, a {feria} can fill the streets with music.
e.zh: 在西班牙城镇，集市节日会让街上充满音乐。

e.en: Public business stopped during the {feriae}.
e.zh: 在古罗马节假日期间，公共事务会暂停。

e.en: The historian studied how families observed the {feriae}.
e.zh: 历史学家研究家庭如何庆祝这些古罗马节假日。

e.en: The church used a simpler {ferial} service.
e.zh: 教堂采用了更简朴的平日礼拜。

e.en: Her notes marked the date as {ferial}, not festive.
e.zh: 她的笔记把那天标为平日，而不是节日。

e.en: Many offices close for the summer {ferias}.
e.zh: 许多办公室会因夏季假日而关闭。

e.en: The town's {ferias} attracted dancers and merchants.
e.zh: 镇上的集市节日吸引了舞者和商贩。

e.en: A {ferine} hunger flashed in his eyes.
e.zh: 他的眼中闪过一种野兽般的饥饿。

e.en: The critic admired the poem's {ferine} energy.
e.zh: 评论家欣赏这首诗中野性的力量。

e.en: The traveler was called a {feringhee} in the market.
e.zh: 那名旅行者在市场里被称作外国人。

e.en: Old stories used {feringhee} for a European visitor.
e.zh: 旧故事用feringhee来称呼欧洲访客。

e.en: The sailors heard locals call them {feringi}.
e.zh: 水手们听见当地人称他们为外国人。

e.en: In the diary, {feringi} meant a European stranger.
e.zh: 在日记里，feringi指的是欧洲来的陌生人。

e.en: Her doctor checked her {feritin} level after months of fatigue.
e.zh: 她疲劳数月后，医生检查了她的铁蛋白水平。

e.en: Low {feritin} can suggest depleted iron stores.
e.zh: 铁蛋白偏低可能说明体内铁储备不足。

e.en: The novel exposes the {ferity} of unchecked power.
e.zh: 这部小说揭露了不受约束的权力的凶残。

e.en: He mistook her frankness for {ferity}.
e.zh: 他把她的坦率误认为野蛮。

e.en: The sudden rainbow seemed a {ferlie} to the children.
e.zh: 突然出现的彩虹在孩子们看来像一件奇事。

e.en: She cried out in {ferlie} at the strange machine.
e.zh: 她看到那台奇怪的机器时惊奇地叫了出来。

e.en: The old bridge still felt {ferme} underfoot.
e.zh: 那座老桥踩上去仍然很结实。

e.en: He gave a {ferme} answer despite the pressure.
e.zh: 尽管有压力，他还是给出了坚定的回答。

e.en: Brewers test the {fermentability} of each malt batch.
e.zh: 酿酒师会测试每批麦芽的可发酵性。

e.en: High {fermentability} can produce a drier beer.
e.zh: 较高的可发酵性会酿出更干爽的啤酒。

e.en: Barley contains sugars that are {fermentable} by yeast.
e.zh: 大麦含有酵母可以发酵的糖分。

e.en: The lab measured how much {fermentable} material remained.
e.zh: 实验室测量了还剩多少可发酵物质。

e.en: The cheese develops its flavor through {fermentative} activity.
e.zh: 这种奶酪通过发酵活动形成风味。

e.en: They studied the bacteria's {fermentative} pathways.
e.zh: 他们研究了这种细菌的发酵代谢途径。

e.en: The brewer selected a {fermentive} strain of yeast.
e.zh: 酿酒师选择了一种能发酵的酵母菌株。

e.en: Old texts describe wine as a {fermentive} liquor.
e.zh: 古书把葡萄酒描述为一种发酵酒。

e.en: The bakery used a {fermentograph} to test dough behavior.
e.zh: 面包房用发酵记录仪测试面团的表现。

e.en: A {fermentograph} can record gas production during fermentation.
e.zh: 发酵记录仪可以记录发酵过程中的产气量。

e.en: She specialized in {fermentology} at the food science institute.
e.zh: 她在食品科学研究所专攻发酵学。

e.en: Modern {fermentology} improves the quality of beer and yogurt.
e.zh: 现代发酵学提升了啤酒和酸奶的品质。

e.en: The technician cleaned the {fermentor} before adding the culture.
e.zh: 技术员在加入菌种前清洗了发酵罐。

e.en: Yeast is the main {fermentor} in this traditional drink.
e.zh: 酵母是这种传统饮料中的主要发酵者。

e.en: Medieval writers used {fermentum} to mean a leavening agent.
e.zh: 中世纪作者用fermentum指发面剂。

e.en: The pharmacist noted the {fermentum} in an old formula.
e.zh: 药剂师注意到旧配方中的发酵物。

e.en: {Fermium} is a radioactive synthetic element.
e.zh: 镄是一种放射性人工合成元素。

e.en: Scientists produced tiny amounts of {fermium} in a reactor.
e.zh: 科学家在反应堆中制得了微量镄。

e.en: The old estate had a shaded {fernery} behind the house.
e.zh: 那座老庄园的房后有一片阴凉的蕨园。

e.en: Visitors admired rare plants in the glass {fernery}.
e.zh: 游客在玻璃蕨类温室里欣赏珍稀植物。

e.en: He ordered a small glass of {fernet} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他点了一小杯菲奈特苦味酒。

e.en: The cocktail tastes sharper with a splash of {fernet}.
e.zh: 这款鸡尾酒加一点菲奈特后味道更辛烈。

e.en: The seal used {fernico} because it expands like glass.
e.zh: 这个密封件使用铁镍钴合金，因为它的膨胀性接近玻璃。

e.en: Engineers chose {fernico} for the electronic component.
e.zh: 工程师为这个电子元件选用了铁镍钴合金。

e.en: The fossil showed delicate {fernlike} leaves.
e.zh: 这块化石呈现出精致的蕨类状叶片。

e.en: A {fernlike} pattern spread across the frosted window.
e.zh: 结霜的窗户上铺开了像蕨叶一样的图案。

e.en: The steel plant added {feromolybdenum} to improve hardness.
e.zh: 钢厂加入钼铁合金以提高硬度。

e.en: Prices for {feromolybdenum} rose with demand from manufacturers.
e.zh: 随着制造商需求增加，钼铁合金价格上涨。

e.en: The experimental circuit included a small {ferractor}.
e.zh: 这个实验电路包含一个小型铁氧体反应器。

e.en: A {ferractor} can change behavior under a magnetic field.
e.zh: 铁氧体反应器会在磁场下改变工作状态。

e.en: The antenna used a {ferramic} core.
e.zh: 这根天线使用了铁氧体陶瓷磁芯。

e.en: {Ferramic} materials are useful in high-frequency devices.
e.zh: 铁氧体陶瓷材料常用于高频设备。

e.en: The old {ferrary} stood beside the river.
e.zh: 那座旧炼铁场坐落在河边。

e.en: Workers repaired tools in the {ferrary}.
e.zh: 工人们在铁匠作坊里修理工具。

e.en: The lab prepared a small sample of {ferrate}.
e.zh: 实验室制备了一小份高铁酸盐样品。

e.en: Engineers tested {ferrate} for water treatment.
e.zh: 工程师测试高铁酸盐用于水处理。

e.en: The chemist described the compound as a {ferratogen}.
e.zh: 化学家把这种化合物称为生成铁盐的物质。

e.en: A strong {ferratogen} was added to the mixture.
e.zh: 一种强效的生成铁盐物质被加入混合物中。

e.en: Plants use {ferredoxin} in photosynthetic electron transfer.
e.zh: 植物在光合作用的电子传递中使用铁氧还蛋白。

e.en: The mutation reduced {ferredoxin} activity in the cells.
e.zh: 这种突变降低了细胞中铁氧还蛋白的活性。

e.en: Different {ferredoxins} serve different bacterial enzymes.
e.zh: 不同的铁氧还蛋白类服务于不同的细菌酶。

e.en: Researchers compared several {ferredoxins} from algae.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了几种来自藻类的铁氧还蛋白。

e.en: The stream left a {ferreous} stain on the rocks.
e.zh: 溪水在岩石上留下了含铁的污迹。

e.en: A {ferreous} taste lingered in the water.
e.zh: 水里残留着一股铁质的味道。

e.en: He gave me a {ferrety} little smile.
e.zh: 他朝我露出一个狡黠的小笑容。

e.en: Her {ferrety} face peered around the door.
e.zh: 她那张像雪貂般尖瘦的脸从门边探出来。

e.en: The inn charged travelers for {ferriage} across the river.
e.zh: 客栈向旅客收取过河渡船费。

e.en: Bad weather delayed the {ferriage} of the cattle.
e.zh: 恶劣天气耽搁了牲畜的渡运。

e.en: The fungus produced {ferrichrysin} under iron-poor conditions.
e.zh: 这种真菌在缺铁条件下产生铁色素。

e.en: Scientists measured {ferrichrysin} in the culture medium.
e.zh: 科学家测量了培养基中的真菌铁载体。

e.en: The road cut exposed a hard layer of {ferricrete}.
e.zh: 路堑露出了一层坚硬的铁质结砾岩。

e.en: Rainwater helped form {ferricrete} in the soil.
e.zh: 雨水促成了土壤中铁质结砾岩的形成。

e.en: Potassium {ferricyanide} is used in some chemical tests.
e.zh: 铁氰化钾用于某些化学检测。

e.en: The solution turned blue after adding {ferricyanide}.
e.zh: 加入铁氰化物后，溶液变成了蓝色。

e.en: The old text called the radical {ferricyanogen}.
e.zh: 旧文献把这个基团称为铁氰基。

e.en: Chemists discussed {ferricyanogen} in the reaction scheme.
e.zh: 化学家在反应式中讨论了铁氰化基。

e.en: Miners searched the hills for {ferriferous} rock.
e.zh: 矿工在山里寻找含铁岩石。

e.en: The valley was known for its {ferriferous} deposits.
e.zh: 这个山谷以产铁矿藏而闻名。

e.en: The enzyme binds {ferriheme} during the reaction.
e.zh: 这种酶在反应过程中结合高铁血红素。

e.en: Oxidation converted the pigment into {ferriheme}.
e.zh: 氧化作用把这种色素转化为高铁血红素。

e.en: The titration endpoint was detected with {ferriin}.
e.zh: 滴定终点用铁菲咯啉络合物检测。

e.en: A drop of {ferriin} changed the color sharply.
e.zh: 一滴铁菲咯啉络合物使颜色明显变化。

e.en: The study examined {ferrikinetics} after iron injection.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了注射铁剂后的铁代谢动力学。

e.en: Abnormal {ferrikinetics} can reveal hidden disease.
e.zh: 异常的铁代谢动力学可能揭示潜在疾病。

e.en: The ceramic behaved like a {ferrimagnet} below that temperature.
e.zh: 在低于那个温度时，这种陶瓷表现得像亚铁磁体。

e.en: A {ferrimagnet} has opposing but unequal magnetic moments.
e.zh: 亚铁磁体具有方向相反但大小不等的磁矩。

e.en: The sample became {ferrimagnetic} when it cooled.
e.zh: 样品冷却后变成亚铁磁性的。

e.en: Engineers chose a {ferrimagnetic} material for the sensor.
e.zh: 工程师为传感器选择了一种亚铁磁性材料。

e.en: The lecture introduced {ferrimagnetism} with crystal diagrams.
e.zh: 讲座用晶体图示介绍了亚铁磁性。

e.en: Temperature strongly affects {ferrimagnetism} in this compound.
e.zh: 温度会强烈影响这种化合物中的亚铁磁性。

e.en: The geologist identified a {ferrimanganic} crust on the seabed.
e.zh: 地质学家在海床上发现了一层铁锰质结壳。

e.en: These {ferrimanganic} deposits formed slowly in deep water.
e.zh: 这些含铁和锰的沉积物在深水中缓慢形成。

e.en: The lab used {ferrimetry} to measure iron in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室用铁含量测定法测量样品中的铁。

e.en: Accurate {ferrimetry} is important in ore analysis.
e.zh: 准确的铁含量测定对矿石分析很重要。

ferrimolybdite.t: 钼铁矿；水合钼酸铁矿物

e.en: Yellow {ferrimolybdite} coated parts of the weathered rock.
e.zh: 黄色的钼铁矿覆盖在风化岩石的部分表面。

e.en: The collector labeled the specimen as {ferrimolybdite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把这件标本标为钼铁矿。

e.en: The report described a {ferripotassium} salt used in the reaction.
e.zh: 报告描述了反应中使用的一种含三价铁和钾的盐。

e.en: A {ferripotassium} compound gave the solution a dark color.
e.zh: 一种含三价铁和钾的化合物使溶液呈深色。

e.en: Hemoglobin contains {ferriprotoporphyrin} bound within its heme group.
e.zh: 血红蛋白的血红素基团中含有铁原卟啉。

e.en: The parasite converts free {ferriprotoporphyrin} into a safer crystal.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫会把游离铁原卟啉转化为较安全的晶体。

e.en: The old formulary listed {ferripyrin} among iron preparations.
e.zh: 旧药典把铁吡啉列在铁剂之中。

e.en: A physician once prescribed {ferripyrin} for anemia.
e.zh: 过去医生曾开铁吡啉来治疗贫血。

e.en: The chemist prepared a {ferrisodium} complex for testing.
e.zh: 化学家制备了一种含三价铁和钠的络合物用于测试。

e.en: This {ferrisodium} reagent reacts quickly with the indicator.
e.zh: 这种含三价铁和钠的试剂会迅速与指示剂反应。

e.en: The circuit used a {ferristor} to control magnetic response.
e.zh: 该电路使用铁磁电阻器来控制磁响应。

e.en: Engineers tested the {ferristor} under changing current.
e.zh: 工程师在变化电流下测试了铁磁电阻器。

e.en: The antenna has a small {ferrite} core inside it.
e.zh: 天线内部有一个小铁氧体芯。

e.en: Slow cooling can increase {ferrite} in the steel.
e.zh: 缓慢冷却会增加钢中的铁素体。

e.en: Soft {ferrites} are common in radio components.
e.zh: 软磁铁氧体常见于无线电元件中。

e.en: Different {ferrites} give the alloy different properties.
e.zh: 不同铁素体会赋予合金不同的性能。

e.en: The tank was made from {ferritic} stainless steel.
e.zh: 这个罐体由铁素体不锈钢制成。

e.en: A {ferritic} material can show useful magnetic behavior.
e.zh: 铁氧体材料可以表现出有用的磁性。

e.en: The plant produces {ferro-alloy} for steelmakers.
e.zh: 这家工厂为钢厂生产铁合金。

e.en: Adding a {ferro-alloy} changed the steel's hardness.
e.zh: 加入一种铁合金改变了钢的硬度。

e.en: The foundry added {ferro-boron} to refine the melt.
e.zh: 铸造厂加入硼铁合金来精炼熔体。

e.en: High-grade {ferro-boron} is used in specialty steels.
e.zh: 高品级硼铁合金用于特种钢。

e.en: Stainless steel production often requires {ferro-chromium}.
e.zh: 不锈钢生产通常需要铬铁合金。

e.en: The price of {ferro-chromium} rose with energy costs.
e.zh: 铬铁合金价格随着能源成本上涨。

e.en: The mill bought {ferro-phosphorus} for alloy adjustment.
e.zh: 轧钢厂购买磷铁合金用于调整合金成分。

e.en: Excess {ferro-phosphorus} can make steel brittle.
e.zh: 过量磷铁合金可能使钢变脆。

e.en: Workers added {ferro-silicon} during steelmaking.
e.zh: 工人在炼钢过程中加入硅铁合金。

e.en: The shipment of {ferro-silicon} arrived from the smelter.
e.zh: 这批硅铁合金从冶炼厂运到了。

e.en: Tool steels may contain {ferro-vanadium} for strength.
e.zh: 工具钢可能含有钒铁合金以提高强度。

e.en: Demand for {ferro-vanadium} increased after the new standard.
e.zh: 新标准出台后，钒铁合金需求增加了。

e.en: A {ferroalloy} supplies alloying elements to molten steel.
e.zh: 铁合金向钢水提供合金元素。

e.en: The company exports {ferroalloy} to several mills.
e.zh: 这家公司向几家钢厂出口铁合金。

e.en: The alloy shop ordered {ferroaluminium} for deoxidation.
e.zh: 合金车间订购铝铁合金用于脱氧。

e.en: Small amounts of {ferroaluminium} improved the final melt.
e.zh: 少量铝铁合金改善了最终熔体。

e.en: The metallurgist selected {ferroboron} for the heat treatment batch.
e.zh: 冶金师为这批热处理材料选择了硼铁合金。

e.en: Adding {ferroboron} can improve hardenability in some steels.
e.zh: 加入硼铁合金可提高某些钢的淬透性。

e.en: The chemistry class synthesized {ferrocene} in a small flask.
e.zh: 化学课在小烧瓶中合成了二茂铁。

e.en: Researchers use {ferrocene} as a stable organometallic compound.
e.zh: 研究人员把二茂铁用作稳定的有机金属化合物。

e.en: {Ferrochelatase} inserts iron into protoporphyrin during heme synthesis.
e.zh: 亚铁螯合酶在血红素合成过程中把铁插入原卟啉。

e.en: A mutation in {ferrochelatase} can disrupt normal red blood cell production.
e.zh: 亚铁螯合酶发生突变可能会扰乱正常红细胞生成。

e.en: The foundry added {ferrochromium} to improve the steel's corrosion resistance.
e.zh: 铸造厂加入铬铁以提高钢材的耐腐蚀性。

e.en: Prices for {ferrochromium} rose after several smelters reduced output.
e.zh: 几家冶炼厂减产后，铬铁价格上涨。

e.en: The alloy plant uses {ferrocolumbium} to strengthen specialty steels.
e.zh: 合金厂使用铌铁来增强特种钢的强度。

e.en: Demand for {ferrocolumbium} depends heavily on the steel industry.
e.zh: 铌铁的需求很大程度上取决于钢铁行业。

e.en: The old bridge was built from {ferroconcrete} in the 1920s.
e.zh: 这座旧桥是在二十世纪二十年代用钢筋混凝土建成的。

e.en: Cracks in the {ferroconcrete} exposed the rusting steel bars inside.
e.zh: 钢筋混凝土上的裂缝露出了内部生锈的钢筋。

e.en: Potassium {ferrocyanide} is used in some chemical tests.
e.zh: 亚铁氰化钾用于某些化学测试。

e.en: The label listed trace amounts of {ferrocyanide} as an anti-caking agent.
e.zh: 标签上列出微量亚铁氰化物作为抗结剂。

e.en: The chemist described {ferrocyanogen} as part of the complex ion.
e.zh: 化学家把亚铁氰基描述为该络离子的一部分。

e.en: Older texts sometimes discuss {ferrocyanogen} in studies of cyanide compounds.
e.zh: 旧教材有时会在氰化物研究中讨论亚铁氰基。

e.en: The engineer placed a {ferrod} inside the coil to increase inductance.
e.zh: 工程师在线圈内放入铁磁棒以增加电感。

e.en: A cracked {ferrod} can change the response of the circuit.
e.zh: 开裂的铁磁杆可能改变电路的响应。

e.en: A {ferroelectric} material can retain electric polarization after the field is removed.
e.zh: 铁电材料在电场移除后仍能保持电极化。

e.en: The sensor uses a thin {ferroelectric} film to detect pressure changes.
e.zh: 该传感器使用一层薄铁电膜来检测压力变化。

e.en: Researchers study {ferroelectrics} for use in memory devices.
e.zh: 研究人员研究铁电材料在存储器件中的应用。

e.en: The course covers the basic physics of {ferroelectrics}.
e.zh: 这门课讲授铁电学的基础物理。

e.en: The museum displayed a blue {ferroenamel} bowl from the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一只十九世纪的蓝色搪瓷铁碗。

e.en: Chipped {ferroenamel} can expose the metal beneath to rust.
e.zh: 搪瓷铁器的釉面剥落后，下面的金属可能会生锈。

ferroferric.t: 亚铁高铁的；四氧化三铁的

e.en: Magnetite is often described as a {ferroferric} oxide.
e.zh: 磁铁矿常被描述为一种亚铁高铁氧化物。

e.en: The sample contained a black {ferroferric} compound.
e.zh: 样品中含有一种黑色的亚铁高铁化合物。

e.en: The precipitate was identified as {ferroferricyanide} in the old analysis notes.
e.zh: 旧分析记录中把这种沉淀鉴定为亚铁铁氰化物。

e.en: Students compared {ferroferricyanide} with related cyanide complexes.
e.zh: 学生们把亚铁铁氰化物与相关氰络合物进行比较。

e.en: The mineral sample contained traces of {ferroferrite}.
e.zh: 这份矿物样品含有微量亚铁酸铁。

e.en: A ceramic {ferroferrite} can show useful magnetic properties.
e.zh: 陶瓷铁氧体可能表现出有用的磁性。

e.en: The geologist mapped a body of {ferrogabbro} near the ridge.
e.zh: 地质学家在山脊附近绘制出一处富铁辉长岩体。

e.en: This {ferrogabbro} contains more iron-rich minerals than ordinary gabbro.
e.zh: 这种富铁辉长岩比普通辉长岩含有更多富铁矿物。

e.en: The lab tested {ferroglass} for unusual electrical behavior.
e.zh: 实验室测试了铁电玻璃的异常电学行为。

e.en: Ancient {ferroglass} beads often have a dark green tint.
e.zh: 古代含铁玻璃珠常带有深绿色调。

e.en: The technician used a {ferrograph} to examine wear particles in the oil.
e.zh: 技术员用铁谱仪检查油中的磨损颗粒。

e.en: A clear {ferrograph} can reveal early damage inside a machine.
e.zh: 清晰的磁粉分析图能显示机器内部的早期损伤。

e.en: Oxygen binds to the iron atom in {ferroheme}.
e.zh: 氧气会与亚铁血红素中的铁原子结合。

e.en: The protein keeps {ferroheme} in a form suitable for gas transport.
e.zh: 这种蛋白使亚铁血红素保持适合气体运输的形式。

e.en: {Ferrohemoglobin} carries oxygen through the bloodstream.
e.zh: 亚铁血红蛋白在血液中运输氧气。

e.en: Oxidation can convert {ferrohemoglobin} into a form that binds oxygen poorly.
e.zh: 氧化会把亚铁血红蛋白转变成一种不易结合氧的形式。

e.en: The titration endpoint was detected with {ferroin}.
e.zh: 滴定终点是用邻菲咯啉亚铁指示剂检测出来的。

e.en: Fresh {ferroin} gives a sharper color change in the reaction.
e.zh: 新配制的邻菲咯啉亚铁指示剂在反应中颜色变化更明显。

e.en: The quarry sold {ferrolite} for heavy construction work.
e.zh: 采石场出售含铁石料用于重型建筑工程。

e.en: Weathered {ferrolite} left reddish stains on the wall.
e.zh: 风化的铁质岩在墙上留下了红褐色污迹。

e.en: Basalt contains several dark {ferromagnesian} minerals.
e.zh: 玄武岩含有几种深色铁镁质矿物。

e.en: The rock's {ferromagnesian} composition suggests a volcanic origin.
e.zh: 这块岩石的铁镁质成分表明它可能源于火山活动。

e.en: A {ferromagnet} can remain magnetized after the external field is removed.
e.zh: 铁磁体在外部磁场移除后仍能保持磁化。

e.en: Iron is the classic example of a {ferromagnet}.
e.zh: 铁是铁磁体的典型例子。

e.en: {Ferromagnetism} explains why iron can form a permanent magnet.
e.zh: 铁磁性解释了为什么铁能形成永久磁体。

e.en: The material loses {ferromagnetism} above its Curie temperature.
e.zh: 这种材料在超过居里温度后会失去铁磁性。

e.en: The model treats a {ferromagnon} as a quantized spin wave.
e.zh: 该模型把铁磁磁振子视为量子化的自旋波。

e.en: Detecting a {ferromagnon} requires very sensitive magnetic measurements.
e.zh: 探测铁磁磁振子需要非常灵敏的磁性测量。

e.en: Steelmakers add {ferromanganese} to remove oxygen and sulfur from molten steel.
e.zh: 炼钢工人加入锰铁以去除钢水中的氧和硫。

e.en: The shipment of {ferromanganese} arrived at the port before dawn.
e.zh: 这批锰铁在黎明前抵达港口。

e.en: The geologist noted a {ferromanganic} crust on the seafloor rock.
e.zh: 地质学家注意到海底岩石上有一层铁锰壳。

e.en: A {ferromanganic} compound formed during the oxidation process.
e.zh: 氧化过程中形成了一种高价锰铁化合物。

e.en: The sample contained a {ferromanganous} mineral mixture.
e.zh: 样品中含有一种铁锰矿物混合物。

e.en: Researchers described the deposit as {ferromanganous} rather than purely iron-rich.
e.zh: 研究人员把这处沉积物描述为铁锰质，而不是单纯富铁。

e.en: The technician checked the alloy with a {ferrometer}.
e.zh: 技术员用铁量计检查了这种合金。

e.en: A portable {ferrometer} helped identify magnetic contamination.
e.zh: 一台便携式磁性测量仪帮助发现了磁性污染。

e.en: The steel mill added {ferromolybdenum} to improve heat resistance.
e.zh: 钢厂加入钼铁合金以提高耐热性。

e.en: Prices for {ferromolybdenum} rose after supply tightened.
e.zh: 供应趋紧后，钼铁价格上涨了。

e.en: The chemist used {ferron} to test for dissolved iron.
e.zh: 化学师用铁试剂检测溶解铁。

e.en: A small amount of {ferron} changed the solution's color.
e.zh: 少量铁试剂使溶液变了颜色。

e.en: The furnace produced {ferronickel} from laterite ore.
e.zh: 这座炉子用红土矿生产镍铁合金。

e.en: Stainless steel makers rely on {ferronickel} as a nickel source.
e.zh: 不锈钢制造商依赖镍铁作为镍来源。

e.en: The report mentioned a {ferrophosphorous} residue in the furnace.
e.zh: 报告提到炉内有含铁磷残渣。

e.en: A {ferrophosphorous} material can affect the brittleness of steel.
e.zh: 磷铁材料会影响钢的脆性。

e.en: Hemoglobin contains a {ferroporphyrin} group that binds oxygen.
e.zh: 血红蛋白含有能结合氧气的铁卟啉基团。

e.en: The catalyst was modeled on a natural {ferroporphyrin}.
e.zh: 这种催化剂是仿照天然铁卟啉设计的。

e.en: The old formula referred to a {ferropotassium} salt.
e.zh: 旧配方提到了一种铁钾盐。

e.en: A {ferropotassium} compound appeared in the analytical notes.
e.zh: 分析记录中出现了一种含铁钾化合物。

ferroprobe.t: 磁通门探头；铁磁探测器

e.en: The survey team carried a {ferroprobe} across the field.
e.zh: 勘测队带着磁通门探头穿过田地。

e.en: A {ferroprobe} can detect small changes in Earth's magnetic field.
e.zh: 磁通门探头能探测地磁场的细微变化。

e.en: Older papers sometimes spell {ferroprotoporphrin} without the extra y.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时把铁原卟啉拼作不带额外 y 的形式。

e.en: The enzyme binds {ferroprotoporphrin} during heme synthesis.
e.zh: 这种酶在血红素合成过程中结合铁原卟啉。

e.en: Heme is a form of {ferroprotoporphyrin} found in blood.
e.zh: 血红素是血液中存在的一种铁原卟啉。

e.en: The lab measured {ferroprotoporphyrin} levels in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室测定了样品中的铁原卟啉水平。

e.en: The thin section showed grains of {ferropseudobrookite}.
e.zh: 薄片中可见铁假板钛矿颗粒。

e.en: Volcanic rocks may contain {ferropseudobrookite} after high-temperature alteration.
e.zh: 火山岩经过高温蚀变后可能含有铁假板钛矿。

e.en: The transformer failed after a bout of {ferroresonance}.
e.zh: 变压器在一次铁磁谐振后发生故障。

e.en: Engineers added damping to prevent {ferroresonance} in the circuit.
e.zh: 工程师加入阻尼以防止电路中出现铁磁谐振。

e.en: The manual used {ferrorsonance} where ferroresonance was intended.
e.zh: 手册中把本应写作 ferroresonance 的词误写成 ferrorsonance。

e.en: Search results for {ferrorsonance} usually point to ferroresonance topics.
e.zh: 搜索 ferrorsonance 的结果通常指向铁磁谐振相关内容。

e.en: Foundries use {ferrosilicon} to deoxidize molten steel.
e.zh: 铸造厂用硅铁为钢水脱氧。

e.en: The shipment of {ferrosilicon} arrived at the port yesterday.
e.zh: 这批硅铁昨天运抵港口。

e.en: The ceramic contained a dark {ferrospinel} phase.
e.zh: 这种陶瓷中含有深色铁尖晶石相。

e.en: A {ferrospinel} structure can influence magnetic behavior.
e.zh: 铁尖晶石结构会影响磁性表现。

e.en: The brochure advertised {ferrosteel} panels for industrial buildings.
e.zh: 宣传册宣传用于工业建筑的铁钢板材。

e.en: Old trade catalogs used {ferrosteel} for a hard iron alloy.
e.zh: 旧贸易目录用 ferrosteel 指一种硬质铁合金。

e.en: The metamorphic rock contained flakes of {ferrostilpnomelane}.
e.zh: 这块变质岩中含有片状铁绿泥云母。

e.en: Mineralogists identified {ferrostilpnomelane} under the microscope.
e.zh: 矿物学家在显微镜下鉴定出铁绿泥云母。

e.en: Steelmakers add {ferrotitanium} to control grain size.
e.zh: 炼钢工人加入钛铁合金来控制晶粒尺寸。

e.en: Demand for {ferrotitanium} increased with specialty steel production.
e.zh: 随着特种钢生产增加，钛铁需求上升。

e.en: The engineer replaced an old {ferrotron} in the control unit.
e.zh: 工程师更换了控制装置中的旧铁磁放大器。

e.en: A {ferrotron} was once used for reliable switching in harsh systems.
e.zh: 铁磁放大器曾用于恶劣系统中的可靠开关控制。

e.en: Tool steel often contains {ferrotungsten} for added hardness.
e.zh: 工具钢常含钨铁合金以增加硬度。

e.en: The company imported {ferrotungsten} for alloy production.
e.zh: 该公司进口钨铁用于合金生产。

e.en: The museum displayed a nineteenth-century {ferrotype}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一张十九世纪的铁版照片。

e.en: A {ferrotype} image is made directly on a thin metal plate.
e.zh: 铁版照相的图像直接制在薄金属板上。

e.en: The lab tested {ferrouranium} under high heat.
e.zh: 实验室在高温下测试铀铁合金。

e.en: Old metallurgy papers mention {ferrouranium} as a special alloy.
e.zh: 旧冶金论文把铀铁合金列为一种特殊合金。

e.en: The steelmaker added {ferrovanadium} to strengthen the alloy.
e.zh: 钢厂加入钒铁合金来增强合金强度。

e.en: Prices for {ferrovanadium} rose after demand increased.
e.zh: 需求增加后，钒铁合金价格上涨。

e.en: Researchers identified {ferroverdin} in the bacterial sample.
e.zh: 研究人员在细菌样本中鉴定出含铁绿色色素。

e.en: The pigment {ferroverdin} gave the culture a green color.
e.zh: 含铁绿色色素让培养物呈现绿色。

e.en: The foundry used {ferrozirconium} to refine the steel.
e.zh: 铸造厂使用锆铁合金来精炼钢材。

e.en: A small amount of {ferrozirconium} can affect grain structure.
e.zh: 少量锆铁合金会影响晶粒结构。

e.en: The mineral showed a {ferrozoid} surface after polishing.
e.zh: 这种矿物抛光后呈现类铁表面。

e.en: He described the strange material as {ferrozoid} rather than truly metallic.
e.zh: 他把这种奇怪材料描述为类铁，而不是真正的金属。

e.en: The old pipe had a {ferrugineous} stain around the joint.
e.zh: 旧管道接头周围有一圈铁锈色污迹。

e.en: A {ferrugineous} powder covered the broken rock.
e.zh: 破碎岩石上覆盖着铁锈色粉末。

e.en: The stream left {ferruginous} deposits on the stones.
e.zh: 溪水在石头上留下含铁沉积物。

e.en: Her boots were stained by {ferruginous} mud.
e.zh: 她的靴子被铁锈色泥浆弄脏了。

e.en: In Latin, {ferrum} means iron.
e.zh: 在拉丁语中，ferrum表示铁。

e.en: The chemical symbol Fe comes from {ferrum}.
e.zh: 化学符号Fe来源于表示铁的ferrum。

e.en: The ticket included the cost of {ferryage} across the river.
e.zh: 这张票包含过河渡运费。

e.en: Regular {ferryage} helped the village trade with the town.
e.zh: 定期渡运帮助村庄与城镇做买卖。

e.en: The {ferrymen} waited by the flooded river.
e.zh: 渡船船夫们在涨水的河边等候。

e.en: Local {ferrymen} carried passengers before the bridge was built.
e.zh: 桥建成以前，当地渡船船夫负责载客。

e.en: Only a {fertilisable} egg can develop after mating.
e.zh: 只有可受精的卵子才能在交配后发育。

e.en: The farmer tested whether the poor soil was still {fertilisable}.
e.zh: 农民检测这片贫瘠土壤是否仍可施肥改良。

e.en: The microscope showed that the egg was {fertilizable}.
e.zh: 显微镜显示这个卵子可以受精。

e.en: Even sandy land may be {fertilizable} with enough organic matter.
e.zh: 只要有足够有机质，沙地也可能可以施肥改良。

e.en: The biologist studied {fertilizin} in sea urchin eggs.
e.zh: 生物学家研究海胆卵中的受精素。

e.en: Early papers described {fertilizin} as a substance aiding fertilization.
e.zh: 早期论文把受精素描述为帮助受精的物质。

e.en: The resin came from a species of {ferula}.
e.zh: 这种树脂来自一种阿魏属植物。

e.en: The teacher once kept a {ferula} for punishment.
e.zh: 那位老师过去曾备有戒尺用于惩罚。

e.en: The plant had a tall, {ferulaceous} stem.
e.zh: 这株植物有一根高高的、像阿魏属植物的茎。

e.en: Botanists noted its {ferulaceous} form in the field guide.
e.zh: 植物学家在野外指南中注明了它类似阿魏属植物的形态。

e.en: The old schoolmaster carried a wooden {ferule}.
e.zh: 那位老校长带着一把木制戒尺。

e.en: He threatened to {ferule} any boy who whispered.
e.zh: 他威胁说，哪个男孩窃窃私语就用戒尺打。

feruled.t: 被戒尺打的；用箍加固的

e.en: The boy was {feruled} for speaking out of turn.
e.zh: 那个男孩因插话而被戒尺打了。

e.en: The handle was {feruled} with a narrow metal band.
e.zh: 手柄用一圈窄金属箍加固。

e.en: Several old {ferules} hung on the classroom wall.
e.zh: 几把旧戒尺挂在教室墙上。

e.en: The carpenter fitted brass {ferules} onto the tool handles.
e.zh: 木匠给工具手柄装上黄铜箍。

e.en: The headmaster disliked {feruling} students for small mistakes.
e.zh: 校长不喜欢因小错而用戒尺打学生。

e.en: The craftsperson was {feruling} the cane to prevent splitting.
e.zh: 工匠正在给手杖加箍，以防开裂。

e.en: She spoke with unusual {fervency} about the reform.
e.zh: 她谈到改革时带着非同寻常的热情。

e.en: The prayer's quiet {fervency} moved everyone in the room.
e.zh: 那段祈祷中安静而强烈的情感打动了屋里所有人。

e.en: The speech gained {fervidity} as the crowd cheered.
e.zh: 人群欢呼时，演讲变得更加热烈激昂。

e.en: Her letters carried a strange {fervidity} of feeling.
e.zh: 她的信里带着一种奇异而炽热的情感。

fescennine.t: 粗俗戏谑的；猥亵打趣的

e.en: The banquet ended with {fescennine} songs and loud laughter.
e.zh: 宴会在粗俗戏谑的歌声和大笑中结束。

e.en: His {fescennine} remarks shocked the polite guests.
e.zh: 他猥亵打趣的话让那些彬彬有礼的客人很震惊。

e.en: The shield showed a red {fesse} across the center.
e.zh: 盾徽中央有一条红色横带。

e.en: Heralds described the {fesse} before naming the smaller charges.
e.zh: 纹章官先描述盾徽中部横带，再说较小的图记。

e.en: They served {fessikh} during the spring holiday.
e.zh: 他们在春季节日里供应埃及发酵咸鱼。

e.en: The strong smell of {fessikh} filled the small kitchen.
e.zh: 埃及发酵咸鱼的浓烈气味充满了小厨房。

e.en: The village {festa} lasted until midnight.
e.zh: 村里的节日庆典一直持续到午夜。

e.en: Families prepared special food for the annual {festa}.
e.zh: 各家为一年一度的庆典准备了特别食物。

e.en: His obscure book on {festilogy} catalogued medieval feast days.
e.zh: 他那本冷门的节庆学著作记录了中世纪的节日。

e.en: The lecture treated {festilogy} as a branch of cultural history.
e.zh: 这场讲座把节日论述视为文化史的一个分支。

e.en: The messenger made a {festinate} departure before dawn.
e.zh: 信使在黎明前匆忙离开。

e.en: Do not {festinate} through a decision this important.
e.zh: 这么重要的决定不要仓促作出。

e.en: He {festinated} through the formalities and left quickly.
e.zh: 他匆匆办完手续后很快离开了。

e.en: The {festinated} plan collapsed under basic questioning.
e.zh: 这个仓促制定的计划在基本质询下就垮了。

e.en: She answered {festinately}, as if afraid of silence.
e.zh: 她匆促地回答，好像害怕沉默。

e.en: The clerk moved {festinately} from desk to desk.
e.zh: 办事员急忙地从一张桌子走到另一张桌子。

e.en: He {festinates} whenever pressure begins to build.
e.zh: 一有压力开始累积，他就会急忙行事。

e.en: The argument {festinates} toward a conclusion it has not earned.
e.zh: 这段论证仓促地走向一个尚未站稳的结论。

e.en: The {festinating} courier nearly dropped the sealed letter.
e.zh: 那名急忙赶路的信差差点把密封信掉了。

e.en: He was {festinating} toward an answer without reading the evidence.
e.zh: 他没看证据就匆忙奔向一个答案。

e.en: Her {festination} made the apology sound insincere.
e.zh: 她的仓促让道歉听起来不真诚。

e.en: The doctor noted {festination} in the patient's walk.
e.zh: 医生注意到病人的步态有急行现象。

e.en: Every {festival-goer} received a map at the entrance.
e.zh: 每位参加节日活动的人都在入口处拿到一张地图。

e.en: A tired {festival-goer} slept beside the music tent.
e.zh: 一名疲惫的节日游客睡在音乐帐篷旁边。

e.en: Each {festivalgoer} wore a bright wristband for entry.
e.zh: 每位入场的节日游客都戴着鲜亮的腕带。

e.en: The survey asked every {festivalgoer} about transport home.
e.zh: 调查询问每个参加节日活动的人如何回家。

e.en: The room had a {festivous} air after the lamps were lit.
e.zh: 灯点亮后，房间里有了欢乐的节庆气氛。

e.en: His {festivous} jokes softened the solemn meeting.
e.zh: 他那些欢快的玩笑缓和了会议的严肃气氛。

e.en: The hall was heavy with {festoonery} for the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼大厅里挂满了花彩装饰。

e.en: Old photographs showed balconies draped in patriotic {festoonery}.
e.zh: 老照片显示阳台上垂挂着爱国主题的成串饰物。

e.en: She chose a {festucine} ribbon for the plain straw hat.
e.zh: 她为那顶朴素草帽选了一条稻草色丝带。

e.en: The painting's {festucine} light made the fields look dry.
e.zh: 画中淡黄褐色的光让田野显得干燥。

e.en: The article discussed {fetalization} in certain evolutionary theories.
e.zh: 文章讨论了某些进化理论中的胎儿化现象。

e.en: Some critics used {fetalization} to describe the retained juvenile traits.
e.zh: 一些评论者用胎儿化来描述保留下来的幼态特征。

e.en: The physician wrote about abnormal {fetation} in the case report.
e.zh: 医生在病例报告中写到了异常妊娠。

e.en: Older texts used {fetation} for the development of the fetus.
e.zh: 旧文献用胎儿形成来指胎儿的发育过程。

e.en: The sled gave a sudden {fetch-up} at the fence.
e.zh: 雪橇在篱笆旁突然停住了。

e.en: After years abroad, he made a strange {fetch-up} in Maine.
e.zh: 在海外多年后，他竟然最后落脚到了缅因州。

e.en: The farmer planted {feterita} because it tolerated drought.
e.zh: 农民种下这种非洲高粱，因为它耐旱。

e.en: Researchers compared {feterita} with other sorghum varieties.
e.zh: 研究人员把非洲高粱与其他高粱品种进行比较。

e.en: A {fetial} priest performed the ritual before war was declared.
e.zh: 宣战前，一名古罗马祭司法祭司举行了仪式。

e.en: The treaty followed ancient {fetial} procedures.
e.zh: 这份条约遵循了古罗马祭司法程序。

e.en: The traveler described the carved stone as a {fetich}.
e.zh: 旅行者把那块雕刻石头描述为物神。

e.en: For him, efficiency became a {fetich} that excused cruelty.
e.zh: 对他来说，效率成了一种为残酷开脱的盲目崇拜物。

fetiche.t: 物神；迷恋物品的崇拜物品；恋物对象

e.en: The carved stone was treated as a {fetiche} by the villagers.
e.zh: 村民把那块雕刻过的石头当作物神来供奉。

e.en: For the collector, the old camera became a private {fetiche}.
e.zh: 对那位收藏者来说，那台旧相机成了私人的迷恋对象。

e.en: The essay discusses {fetichism} in early religious practice.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论了早期宗教实践中的物神崇拜。

e.en: Victorian doctors often misunderstood sexual {fetichism}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的医生常常误解性方面的恋物癖。

e.en: The traveler described the priest as a {fetichist}.
e.zh: 那名旅行者把这位祭司描述成物神崇拜者。

e.en: A {fetichist} may attach desire to a particular material or object.
e.zh: 恋物者可能会把欲望寄托在某种材料或物品上。

feticidal.t: 杀胎的；导致胎儿死亡的

e.en: The report examined the possible {feticidal} effect of the toxin.
e.zh: 报告研究了这种毒素可能导致胎儿死亡的作用。

e.en: Doctors avoided any procedure with a known {feticidal} risk.
e.zh: 医生避免进行任何已知有杀胎风险的操作。

e.en: The law treated intentional {feticide} as a separate offense.
e.zh: 法律把故意杀胎视为一项单独罪行。

e.en: The article used {feticide} in a strictly medical context.
e.zh: 这篇文章是在严格的医学语境中使用杀胎这个词。

e.en: The surgeon noted the rare {fetiferous} tumor in the case report.
e.zh: 外科医生在病例报告中记录了罕见的带胎肿瘤。

e.en: Older medical texts sometimes describe a pregnant animal as {fetiferous}.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献有时把怀孕动物描述为怀有胎儿的。

e.en: The obsolete term {fetiparous} appears in a nineteenth-century zoology book.
e.zh: 这个过时词fetiparous出现在一本十九世纪的动物学书中，意思是胎生的。

e.en: Some mammals were once classified as {fetiparous} in older manuals.
e.zh: 一些哺乳动物在旧手册中曾被归为产胎类。

e.en: The campaign seemed to {fetishise} toughness over compassion.
e.zh: 这场宣传似乎盲目崇拜强硬，而不是重视同情心。

e.en: Critics argued that the film would {fetishise} violence.
e.zh: 批评者认为这部电影会把暴力恋物化。

e.en: She chose {fetology} as her area of medical research.
e.zh: 她选择胎儿学作为自己的医学研究领域。

e.en: Modern {fetology} relies heavily on detailed imaging.
e.zh: 现代胎儿学在很大程度上依赖精细影像。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {fetomaternal} medicine.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门从事胎儿与母体医学。

e.en: They monitored {fetomaternal} blood flow throughout the pregnancy.
e.zh: 他们在整个孕期监测胎儿与母体之间的血流。

e.en: The blood test measured a specific {fetoprotein}.
e.zh: 这项血液检测测量了一种特定的胎蛋白。

e.en: High {fetoprotein} levels may require further investigation.
e.zh: 胎蛋白水平偏高可能需要进一步检查。

e.en: A sour {fetor} filled the neglected room.
e.zh: 一股酸腐的恶臭充满了那间无人照看的房间。

e.en: The doctor noted the characteristic {fetor} of the infection.
e.zh: 医生记录下这种感染特有的臭气。

e.en: The midwife listened with a wooden {fetoscope}.
e.zh: 助产士用木制胎儿听诊器听胎心。

e.en: A flexible {fetoscope} can help doctors examine the fetus directly.
e.zh: 柔性胎儿镜可以帮助医生直接检查胎儿。

e.en: The specialist recommended {fetoscopy} after the abnormal scan.
e.zh: 扫描结果异常后，专科医生建议进行胎儿镜检查。

e.en: Modern {fetoscopy} can sometimes allow treatment before birth.
e.zh: 现代胎儿镜检查有时能让医生在出生前进行治疗。

e.en: The laboratory isolated {fetosulfoglycoprotein} from the sample.
e.zh: 实验室从样本中分离出了胎儿硫酸糖蛋白。

e.en: Researchers measured {fetosulfoglycoprotein} levels during the study.
e.zh: 研究人员在研究期间测量了胎儿硫酸糖蛋白水平。

e.en: She crumbled {fetta} over the warm vegetables.
e.zh: 她把菲达奶酪捏碎撒在热蔬菜上。

e.en: The salad tasted sharper with salty {fetta}.
e.zh: 加了咸香的白奶酪后，沙拉味道更鲜明。

fetterbush.t: 绊脚灌木；一种北美灌木

e.en: The path narrowed beside a thicket of {fetterbush}.
e.zh: 小路在一丛绊脚灌木旁变窄了。

e.en: Gardeners sometimes plant {fetterbush} for its glossy leaves.
e.zh: 园丁有时会种植这种北美灌木，因为它叶片有光泽。

e.en: The poem imagines a {fetterless} spirit crossing the sea.
e.zh: 这首诗想象一个无拘无束的灵魂横越大海。

e.en: He dreamed of a {fetterless} life beyond the court.
e.zh: 他梦想着在宫廷之外过一种自由无束的生活。

e.en: The shield bore a silver {fetterlock} on a blue field.
e.zh: 盾牌的蓝底上有一个银色马脚镣形纹章图案。

e.en: Historians identified the {fetterlock} as part of the family badge.
e.zh: 历史学家确认这个马脚镣图案是家族徽章的一部分。

e.en: She served {fettuccini} with a rich mushroom sauce.
e.zh: 她端上了配浓郁蘑菇酱的意式宽扁面。

e.en: The restaurant makes its {fettuccini} by hand.
e.zh: 这家餐厅的意式宽扁面是手工制作的。

e.en: I ordered {fettucine} with cream and spinach.
e.zh: 我点了奶油菠菜意式宽扁面。

e.en: Fresh {fettucine} cooks in only a few minutes.
e.zh: 新鲜的意式宽扁面几分钟就能煮好。

e.en: The menu lists {fettucini} under homemade pasta.
e.zh: 菜单把意式宽扁面列在手工意面下面。

e.en: He tossed the {fettucini} with butter and herbs.
e.zh: 他把意式宽扁面拌上黄油和香草。

e.en: The scholar issued a {fetwa} on the dispute.
e.zh: 那位学者就这场争议发布了伊斯兰教法裁决。

e.en: Some newspapers discussed the controversial {fetwa}.
e.zh: 一些报纸讨论了那项有争议的教法裁决。

e.en: The historian called him a convinced {feudalist}.
e.zh: 历史学家称他是坚定的封建主义者。

e.en: A {feudalist} defended hereditary land rights.
e.zh: 一名封建主义者为世袭土地权辩护。

e.en: The village kept a {feudalistic} social order.
e.zh: 这个村庄保留着封建式的社会秩序。

e.en: Critics attacked the company's {feudalistic} hierarchy.
e.zh: 批评者抨击这家公司封建式的等级制度。

e.en: The book examines {feudality} in medieval Europe.
e.zh: 这本书考察了中世纪欧洲的封建制度。

e.en: Traces of {feudality} survived in local customs.
e.zh: 当地习俗中仍保留着封建性质的痕迹。

e.en: The region underwent gradual {feudalization} after conquest.
e.zh: 该地区在被征服后逐渐经历了封建化。

e.en: Scholars debate the {feudalization} of early Japan.
e.zh: 学者们争论早期日本的封建化过程。

e.en: The rulers tried to {feudalize} the conquered lands.
e.zh: 统治者试图使被征服的土地封建化。

e.en: Central power weakened as nobles began to {feudalize} authority.
e.zh: 随着贵族开始使权力封建化，中央权力削弱了。

e.en: The province became heavily {feudalized} by the tenth century.
e.zh: 到十世纪时，该省已高度封建化。

e.en: A {feudalized} army depended on local lords.
e.zh: 一支封建化的军队依赖地方领主。

e.en: The policy {feudalizes} political power in practice.
e.zh: 这项政策实际上使政治权力封建化。

e.en: He argues that debt {feudalizes} rural society.
e.zh: 他认为债务会使农村社会封建化。

e.en: The king was accused of {feudalizing} public offices.
e.zh: 国王被指责在使公共职位封建化。

e.en: They studied the {feudalizing} tendencies of the empire.
e.zh: 他们研究了这个帝国的封建化倾向。

e.en: A {feudary} owed military service to his lord.
e.zh: 封臣有义务为领主服兵役。

e.en: The charter recorded several {feudary} obligations.
e.zh: 这份特许状记录了几项封地义务。

e.en: The king summoned his {feudatories} to war.
e.zh: 国王召集他的封臣参战。

e.en: Several {feudatories} refused to pay tribute.
e.zh: 几位附庸诸侯拒绝进贡。

e.en: The duke ruled as a {feudatory} of the crown.
e.zh: 公爵作为王室的封臣进行统治。

e.en: A {feudatory} state paid tribute every year.
e.zh: 一个附庸国每年都要进贡。

e.en: The old {feudist} explained the land tenure rules.
e.zh: 那位老封建法专家解释了土地保有规则。

e.en: A learned {feudist} advised the noble family.
e.zh: 一位博学的封建法专家为这个贵族家族提供建议。

feuilleton.t: 报纸文艺专栏；连载小说

e.en: Her essays appeared in the Sunday {feuilleton}.
e.zh: 她的随笔刊登在周日的报纸文艺专栏。

e.en: The novel began as a weekly {feuilleton}.
e.zh: 这部小说最初是每周连载的作品。

e.en: Critics mocked the essay's airy {feuilletonism}.
e.zh: 批评家嘲笑这篇文章轻飘飘的文艺专栏风格。

e.en: His journalism slipped into elegant {feuilletonism}.
e.zh: 他的新闻写作逐渐带上优雅的文艺随笔腔。

e.en: The {feuilletonist} wrote about theater and cafés.
e.zh: 这位文艺专栏作家写剧场和咖啡馆的话题。

e.en: As a {feuilletonist}, she favored wit over argument.
e.zh: 作为文艺专栏作家，她更重机智而非论证。

e.en: The child had only a slight {feveret}.
e.zh: 这个孩子只是有点轻微发热。

e.en: A passing {feveret} kept him indoors.
e.zh: 一阵短暂的轻微发热让他待在室内。

e.en: His {feverous} skin worried the nurse.
e.zh: 他发热的皮肤让护士很担心。

e.en: The crowd moved with {feverous} excitement.
e.zh: 人群带着狂热的兴奋涌动起来。

e.en: She slept {feverously} through the afternoon.
e.zh: 她整个下午都发着热昏睡。

e.en: The fans cheered {feverously} after the goal.
e.zh: 进球后，球迷们狂热地欢呼起来。

feverroot.t: 退烧草根；治热病草药根部

e.en: The healer boiled {feverroot} for the sick child.
e.zh: 治疗者为生病的孩子煮了退烧草根。

e.en: Old herbals listed {feverroot} among remedies for chills.
e.zh: 旧草药书把退烧草根列为治疗寒战的药方之一。

e.en: They gathered {feverweed} near the damp meadow.
e.zh: 他们在潮湿的草地附近采集退烧草。

e.en: The tea was made from dried {feverweed}.
e.zh: 这茶是用晒干的退烧草泡成的。

e.en: A bunch of {feverwort} hung above the stove.
e.zh: 一束退烧草挂在炉子上方。

e.en: Medieval writers praised {feverwort} for treating fevers.
e.zh: 中世纪作者称赞退烧草可用来治疗发热。

fiacre.t: 出租马车；小型四轮马车

e.en: They hired a {fiacre} outside the station.
e.zh: 他们在车站外雇了一辆出租马车。

e.en: A muddy {fiacre} rattled through the old street.
e.zh: 一辆满是泥的四轮马车哐当驶过老街。

e.en: She used a kingside {fianchetto} in the opening.
e.zh: 她在开局中采用了王翼象翼出动。

e.en: The bishop was {fianchettoed} behind the pawn chain.
e.zh: 那枚象被斜线发展到兵链后方。

e.en: The children were harmless {fibbers}, not serious liars.
e.zh: 这些孩子只是爱撒小谎，并不是严重的骗子。

e.en: Experienced {fibbers} often avoid direct answers.
e.zh: 老练的骗子常常避开直接回答。

e.en: The surgeon recommended {fiberarthroscopy} for the injured knee.
e.zh: 外科医生建议对受伤的膝盖做纤维关节镜检查。

e.en: Early {fiberarthroscopy} helped reveal the cartilage damage.
e.zh: 早期纤维关节镜检查帮助发现了软骨损伤。

e.en: The old rope had a rough, {fiberd} surface.
e.zh: 那根旧绳子的表面粗糙而带有纤维。

e.en: A {fiberd} sheet covered the insulation layer.
e.zh: 一层纤维化薄片覆盖在保温层上。

e.en: The doctor inserted a {fiberduodenoscope} with great care.
e.zh: 医生非常小心地插入了纤维十二指肠镜。

e.en: A modern {fiberduodenoscope} can show the bile duct opening.
e.zh: 现代纤维十二指肠镜能显示胆管开口。

e.en: A {fiberendoscope} lets doctors view narrow passages.
e.zh: 纤维内窥镜让医生能观察狭窄通道。

e.en: The clinic replaced its old {fiberendoscope} last year.
e.zh: 这家诊所去年更换了旧的纤维内窥镜。

e.en: The specialist ordered {fiberesophagoscopy} after persistent swallowing pain.
e.zh: 持续吞咽疼痛后，专科医生安排了纤维食管镜检查。

e.en: During {fiberesophagoscopy}, the lesion was clearly visible.
e.zh: 在纤维食管镜检查中，病变清晰可见。

e.en: The jacket uses {fiberfill} instead of down.
e.zh: 这件夹克使用化纤棉而不是羽绒。

e.en: Cheap pillows often contain clumps of {fiberfill}.
e.zh: 便宜枕头里常有结块的纤维填充物。

fibergastroduodenoscopy.t: 纤维胃十二指肠镜检查

e.en: He underwent {fibergastroduodenoscopy} to investigate stomach bleeding.
e.zh: 他接受了纤维胃十二指肠镜检查，以查明胃出血原因。

e.en: The report from {fibergastroduodenoscopy} showed a small ulcer.
e.zh: 纤维胃十二指肠镜检查报告显示有一个小溃疡。

e.en: The hospital scheduled {fibergastroscopy} for Monday morning.
e.zh: 医院把纤维胃镜检查安排在周一上午。

e.en: After {fibergastroscopy}, she rested until the sedative wore off.
e.zh: 纤维胃镜检查后，她休息到镇静剂药效消退。

fiberglas.t: 玻璃纤维材料；玻璃钢制品

e.en: The old boat was repaired with {fiberglas} panels.
e.zh: 那艘旧船用玻璃纤维板修好了。

e.en: Wear gloves when cutting {fiberglas}.
e.zh: 切割玻璃纤维材料时要戴手套。

e.en: The machine can {fiberize} recycled plastic.
e.zh: 这台机器能把回收塑料处理成纤维。

e.en: Heat helps {fiberize} the raw material evenly.
e.zh: 加热有助于让原料均匀纤维化。

e.en: Modern internet cables often use {fiberoptics}.
e.zh: 现代互联网电缆常常使用光纤技术。

e.en: She studied {fiberoptics} in her engineering course.
e.zh: 她在工程课程中学习了光纤学。

e.en: The doctor used a {fiberscope} to inspect his throat.
e.zh: 医生用纤维内窥镜检查了他的喉咙。

e.en: A flexible {fiberscope} can see inside narrow pipes.
e.zh: 柔性光纤镜可以查看狭窄管道内部。

e.en: The clinic scheduled a {fibersigmoidoscopy} for Friday.
e.zh: 诊所把纤维乙状结肠镜检查安排在周五。

e.en: A {fibersigmoidoscopy} can help find inflammation in the lower colon.
e.zh: 纤维乙状结肠镜检查有助于发现下结肠炎症。

e.en: The surgeon recommended {fiberthoracoscopy} before major treatment.
e.zh: 外科医生建议在主要治疗前先做纤维胸腔镜检查。

e.en: During {fiberthoracoscopy}, doctors viewed the pleural space directly.
e.zh: 在纤维胸腔镜检查中，医生直接观察了胸膜腔。

e.en: The team used {fiberventriculoscopy} to examine the brain ventricle.
e.zh: 团队用纤维脑室镜检查来观察脑室。

e.en: Successful {fiberventriculoscopy} requires very delicate instruments.
e.zh: 成功的纤维脑室镜检查需要非常精细的器械。

fiborinogen.t: 纤维蛋白原（疑为拼写变体）

e.en: The report listed {fiborinogen} among the clotting-related measurements.
e.zh: 报告把纤维蛋白原列在凝血相关指标中。

e.en: Low {fiborinogen} may increase bleeding risk.
e.zh: 纤维蛋白原偏低可能增加出血风险。

fibration.t: 纤维化；数学中的纤维丛映射

e.en: The paper describes a {fibration} over a compact space.
e.zh: 这篇论文描述了紧空间上的一种纤维丛映射。

e.en: Liver {fibration} is sometimes used loosely for fibrous change.
e.zh: 肝脏纤维化有时会被宽泛地这样称呼。

e.en: The jacket is padded with warm {fibrefill}.
e.zh: 这件夹克填充了保暖的化纤棉。

e.en: Cheap pillows often use polyester {fibrefill}.
e.zh: 廉价枕头常用聚酯纤维填充料。

e.en: The juice was smooth and almost {fibreless}.
e.zh: 这杯果汁很顺滑，几乎没有纤维。

e.en: They bred a {fibreless} variety of mango.
e.zh: 他们培育出一种少纤维的芒果品种。

e.en: The lab calibrated the {fibremeter} before testing cotton samples.
e.zh: 实验室在检测棉样前校准了纤维测量仪。

e.en: A {fibremeter} measures fibre length and quality.
e.zh: 纤维计用于测量纤维长度和质量。

e.en: Hospitals use {fibreoptics} in many imaging tools.
e.zh: 医院在许多成像工具中使用光纤技术。

e.en: British textbooks often spell it {fibreoptics}.
e.zh: 英国教材中常把这个词拼作fibreoptics。

e.en: A {fibrescope} let the engineer inspect the engine interior.
e.zh: 光纤镜让工程师检查了发动机内部。

e.en: The specialist guided the {fibrescope} through the nasal passage.
e.zh: 专科医生把纤维内窥镜引入鼻腔通道。

fibrid.t: 合成纤维微粒；纤维状颗粒

e.en: The manufacturer added {fibrid} material to strengthen the sheet.
e.zh: 制造商加入纤维状颗粒来增强薄片。

e.en: A {fibrid} can bind other fibers in specialty paper.
e.zh: 合成纤维微粒可在特种纸中黏结其他纤维。

e.en: The mineral had a pale {fibriform} texture.
e.zh: 这种矿物呈淡色的纤维状纹理。

e.en: Under the lens, the tissue looked {fibriform}.
e.zh: 在镜头下，这种组织看起来像纤维。

e.en: Each muscle {fibrilla} is too small to see unaided.
e.zh: 每条肌肉原纤维都小到肉眼看不见。

e.en: The drawing showed a single {fibrilla} inside the cell.
e.zh: 图中显示了细胞内的一条小纤维。

e.en: The sample showed a dense {fibrillar} network.
e.zh: 样本显示出密集的原纤维网络。

e.en: Collagen has a strongly {fibrillar} structure.
e.zh: 胶原蛋白具有明显的纤维状结构。

e.en: The heart may {fibrillate} during severe electrical disturbance.
e.zh: 在严重电活动紊乱时，心脏可能发生纤颤。

e.en: Some proteins {fibrillate} under stressful laboratory conditions.
e.zh: 有些蛋白质在严苛实验条件下会形成原纤维。

e.en: The patient had a {fibrillated} heartbeat after surgery.
e.zh: 患者术后出现了纤颤性心跳。

e.en: The {fibrillated} fibers improved bonding in the paper.
e.zh: 原纤维化的纤维改善了纸张的结合力。

fibrilliform.t: 细纤维状的；似原纤维的

e.en: The specimen contained {fibrilliform} strands near the edge.
e.zh: 标本边缘附近含有细纤维状条索。

e.en: A {fibrilliform} pattern appeared under high magnification.
e.zh: 高倍放大下出现了似原纤维的图案。

fibrillose.t: 具细纤维的；被小纤维覆盖的

e.en: The fungus cap had a {fibrillose} surface.
e.zh: 这种真菌的菌盖表面带有细纤维。

e.en: Botanists described the stem as {fibrillose}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这根茎描述为具细纤维。

e.en: The root had a {fibrillous} outer layer.
e.zh: 这条根有一层细纤维状外层。

e.en: Microscopy revealed {fibrillous} material around the cells.
e.zh: 显微镜显示细胞周围有纤维状物质。

fibrinase.t: 纤维蛋白酶；溶纤维蛋白酶

e.en: Researchers tested {fibrinase} activity in the blood sample.
e.zh: 研究人员检测了血样中的纤维蛋白酶活性。

e.en: A purified {fibrinase} can break down fibrin clots.
e.zh: 纯化的纤维蛋白酶可以分解纤维蛋白凝块。

e.en: The assay measured {fibrination} in the blood sample.
e.zh: 这项检测测量了血样中的纤维蛋白形成。

e.en: Abnormal {fibrination} can affect wound healing.
e.zh: 异常的纤维蛋白形成会影响伤口愈合。

e.en: The liver releases {fibrinogenic} proteins into the plasma.
e.zh: 肝脏会把产纤维蛋白的蛋白质释放到血浆中。

e.en: Doctors monitored the patient's {fibrinogenic} activity after surgery.
e.zh: 医生在术后监测了患者的产纤维蛋白活性。

e.en: The newborn was diagnosed with {fibrinogenopenia}.
e.zh: 这个新生儿被诊断为纤维蛋白原减少症。

e.en: Severe {fibrinogenopenia} increases the risk of bleeding.
e.zh: 严重的纤维蛋白原减少症会增加出血风险。

e.en: The biopsy showed {fibrinoid} changes in the vessel wall.
e.zh: 活检显示血管壁出现了纤维蛋白样改变。

e.en: Pathologists noted {fibrinoid} material around the lesion.
e.zh: 病理医生注意到病灶周围有纤维蛋白样物质。

e.en: The study examined how {fibrinokinase} affects clot breakdown.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了纤维蛋白激酶如何影响血栓分解。

e.en: Purified {fibrinokinase} was added to the laboratory sample.
e.zh: 研究人员向实验样本中加入了纯化的纤维蛋白激酶。

e.en: The technician analyzed the {fibrinolysate} after clot digestion.
e.zh: 技术员分析了血凝块消化后的纤维蛋白溶解产物。

e.en: Researchers compared each {fibrinolysate} for protein fragments.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了每份纤维蛋白溶解产物中的蛋白片段。

e.en: Older papers often called plasmin {fibrinolysin}.
e.zh: 较早的论文常把纤溶酶称为纤维蛋白溶酶。

e.en: The enzyme {fibrinolysin} helps dissolve fibrin clots.
e.zh: 纤维蛋白溶酶这种酶有助于溶解纤维蛋白血栓。

e.en: Normal {fibrinolysis} prevents clots from growing too large.
e.zh: 正常的纤维蛋白溶解能防止血栓变得过大。

e.en: The drug accelerates {fibrinolysis} after a heart attack.
e.zh: 这种药会在心脏病发作后加速纤维蛋白溶解。

e.en: Thrombin releases a {fibrinopeptide} during clot formation.
e.zh: 凝血酶在血凝块形成过程中会释放一种纤维蛋白肽。

e.en: The lab measured {fibrinopeptide} levels in plasma.
e.zh: 实验室测量了血浆中的纤维蛋白肽水平。

e.en: Several {fibrinopeptides} appear during coagulation.
e.zh: 凝血过程中会出现几种纤维蛋白肽。

e.en: High {fibrinopeptides} may suggest active clot formation.
e.zh: 纤维蛋白肽水平较高可能提示血栓正在形成。
