e.en: The report compares each {field-crop} by yield.
e.zh: 报告按产量比较每一种田间作物。

e.en: The lab bought a {field-emissionmicroscope} for surface studies.
e.zh: 实验室购买了一台场发射显微镜用于表面研究。

e.en: A {field-emissionmicroscope} can reveal atomic-scale features.
e.zh: 场发射显微镜可以显示原子尺度的特征。

e.en: The particles moved through a {field-free} region.
e.zh: 这些粒子穿过了一个无场区域。

e.en: The measurement needs a nearly {field-free} environment.
e.zh: 这项测量需要一个几乎不受场影响的环境。

field-marshal.t: 陆军元帅；最高军阶军官

e.en: The {field-marshal} reviewed the troops at dawn.
e.zh: 陆军元帅在黎明时检阅了部队。

e.en: He was promoted to {field-marshal} after the campaign.
e.zh: 那场战役后，他被晋升为陆军元帅。

e.en: The display used a {field-sequential} color system.
e.zh: 这台显示器采用了场序彩色系统。

e.en: A {field-sequential} method shows images one field at a time.
e.zh: 场序方法会按场逐次显示图像。

field-strip.t: 野外拆卸；进行野战分解

e.en: Soldiers learn to {field-strip} the rifle quickly.
e.zh: 士兵要学习快速野外拆卸步枪。

e.en: A proper {field-strip} makes cleaning the weapon easier.
e.zh: 正确的野战分解会让清洁武器更容易。

field-stripped.t: 已野外拆卸的；野战分解过的

e.en: The pistol was {field-stripped} on the table.
e.zh: 手枪已经在桌上被野外拆解开。

e.en: He carried a {field-stripped} rifle for repair.
e.zh: 他带着一支已野战分解的步枪去修理。

e.en: The team will {field-test} the new sensor tomorrow.
e.zh: 团队明天将实地测试这个新传感器。

e.en: A long {field-test} revealed problems in the design.
e.zh: 一次长时间现场试验暴露了设计中的问题。

e.en: This equipment has been {field-tested} in heavy rain.
e.zh: 这套设备已经在大雨中经过实地测试。

e.en: They chose a {field-tested} method for the rescue.
e.zh: 他们为救援选择了一种经过现场检验的方法。

field-testing.t: 实地测试；现场试验过程

e.en: {Field-testing} began after the prototype was stable.
e.zh: 原型稳定后，实地测试开始了。

e.en: The company spent months {field-testing} the app.
e.zh: 公司花了几个月在现场测试这款应用。

field-tests.t: 实地测试；现场试验复数

e.en: The engineers ran several {field-tests} in winter.
e.zh: 工程师们在冬季进行了几次实地测试。

e.en: She {field-tests} medical kits before approving them.
e.zh: 她在批准医疗包之前会进行现场测试。

e.en: Each {field-worker} recorded interviews in the village.
e.zh: 每名外勤人员都在村里记录访谈。

e.en: The {field-worker} picked tomatoes before sunrise.
e.zh: 那名田间工人在日出前采摘番茄。

e.en: The farmer was suddenly {fieldless} after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，这个农民一下子失去了田地。

e.en: The model assumes a {fieldless} space around the object.
e.zh: 该模型假设物体周围是无场空间。

e.en: The {fieldman} checked the wells every morning.
e.zh: 外勤员每天早晨检查那些水井。

e.en: A good {fieldman} knows the soil by touch.
e.zh: 优秀的田间工作人员凭触感就了解土壤。

e.en: A {fieldmouse} darted under the garden fence.
e.zh: 一只田鼠飞快钻到花园篱笆下面。

e.en: The owl hunted a {fieldmouse} near the barn.
e.zh: 猫头鹰在谷仓附近捕到一只田鼠。

e.en: Use a clear {fieldname} for each database column.
e.zh: 给每个数据库列使用清楚的字段名。

e.en: The form rejected a duplicate {fieldname}.
e.zh: 表单拒绝了一个重复的栏位名称。

e.en: The old {fieldpiece} stood outside the museum.
e.zh: 那门旧野战炮立在博物馆外。

e.en: He carried a light {fieldpiece} on the hunt.
e.zh: 他打猎时带着一支轻便的田猎枪。

e.en: The {fieldsman} caught the ball near the boundary.
e.zh: 守场员在边界附近接住了球。

e.en: An experienced {fieldsman} inspected the crop damage.
e.zh: 一名有经验的田间工作人员查看了作物受损情况。

e.en: Recruits practice a quick {fieldstrip} under pressure.
e.zh: 新兵在压力下练习快速野战分解。

e.en: You should {fieldstrip} the weapon before cleaning it.
e.zh: 清洁武器之前，你应该先进行野外拆卸。

fieldwards.t: 朝田野方向；向战场方向

e.en: The children ran {fieldwards} after the bell rang.
e.zh: 铃声响后，孩子们朝田野方向跑去。

e.en: The regiment marched {fieldwards} before sunrise.
e.zh: 这个团在日出前向战场方向行进。

figeater.t: 食无花果的甲虫或鸟类

e.en: A green {figeater} crawled across the ripe fruit.
e.zh: 一只绿色食无花果甲虫爬过熟透的果子。

e.en: The farmer blamed the {figeater} for damaging his figs.
e.zh: 农夫把无花果受损归咎于这种食果虫。

e.en: She managed to {fight off} the attacker.
e.zh: 她设法击退了袭击者。

e.en: He drank tea to {fight off} a cold.
e.zh: 他喝茶来抵御感冒。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {fighter-bomber} from the war.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一架战争时期的旧战斗轰炸机。

e.en: A {fighter-bomber} can attack both aircraft and ground targets.
e.zh: 战斗轰炸机既能攻击飞机，也能打击地面目标。

e.en: The air force launched a {fighter-interceptor} at dawn.
e.zh: 空军在黎明派出了一架截击战斗机。

e.en: A {fighter-interceptor} is built for rapid response.
e.zh: 截击战斗机是为快速反应而设计的。

e.en: His {fightful} mood made the meeting tense.
e.zh: 他好斗的情绪让会议气氛紧张。

e.en: The poem describes a {fightful} age of kings and armies.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了一个君王与军队纷争不断的时代。

e.en: The monster was only a {figmentary} fear.
e.zh: 那个怪物只是想象中的恐惧。

e.en: Her essay explored {figmentary} worlds in childhood stories.
e.zh: 她的文章探讨了童年故事里的虚构世界。

e.en: The archaeologist found a small {figuline} bowl.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了一个小陶碗。

e.en: The workshop specialized in {figuline} ornaments.
e.zh: 这间作坊专门制作陶土装饰品。

e.en: The artist questioned the {figurability} of grief.
e.zh: 艺术家质疑悲痛是否能够被形象表现。

e.en: This theory concerns the {figurability} of abstract ideas.
e.zh: 这一理论关注抽象观念的可描绘性。

e.en: The concept is barely {figurable} in ordinary language.
e.zh: 这个概念几乎无法用日常语言描绘。

e.en: Soft clay is easily {figurable} by hand.
e.zh: 柔软的黏土很容易用手塑形。

e.en: He worked as a {figurant} in the opera.
e.zh: 他在歌剧中担任群众演员。

e.en: A silent {figurant} crossed the stage during the scene.
e.zh: 一名无台词配角在这一幕中走过舞台。

e.en: She appeared as a {figurante} in the ballet.
e.zh: 她在芭蕾舞剧中担任女群舞演员。

e.en: The film hired each {figurante} for only one day.
e.zh: 这部电影只雇用每位女群众演员一天。

e.en: The old vase has a {figurate} pattern of vines.
e.zh: 这只旧花瓶上有藤蔓形图案。

e.en: Medieval writers used {figurate} language for spiritual ideas.
e.zh: 中世纪作家用象征性语言表达精神观念。

e.en: She wore a {figure-hugging} black dress.
e.zh: 她穿了一条紧身显身材的黑裙子。

e.en: The brand is known for {figure-hugging} sportswear.
e.zh: 这个品牌以贴身运动服闻名。

e.en: She learned to {figure-skate} after school.
e.zh: 她放学后学习花样滑冰。

e.en: He bought a new {figure skate} for competition.
e.zh: 他为比赛买了一只新的花滑鞋。

e.en: The fog made the landscape {figureless}.
e.zh: 雾气让整片风景变得没有轮廓。

e.en: She chose a plain, {figureless} fabric.
e.zh: 她选了一块素净无图案的布料。

e.en: The herbalist collected {figwort} near the stream.
e.zh: 草药师在溪边采集玄参属植物。

e.en: Bees often visit the flowers of {figwort}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂常常飞到玄参属植物的花上。

e.en: The biologist examined the tiny {fila} under a microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下观察那些细小丝状结构。

e.en: Several {fila} stretched from the damaged tissue.
e.zh: 几条丝状物从受损组织中延伸出来。

e.en: The plant had long {filaceous} roots.
e.zh: 这株植物长着细长的线状根。

e.en: A {filaceous} thread hung from the shell.
e.zh: 一根丝状细线从壳上垂下来。

e.en: The antique box was covered with silver {filagree}.
e.zh: 那个古董盒子覆有银丝细工装饰。

e.en: Sunlight made the iron {filagree} cast delicate shadows.
e.zh: 阳光让铁艺细饰投下精致的影子。

e.en: The engineer measured {filamentsaturation} in the old lamp.
e.zh: 工程师测量了旧灯泡中的灯丝饱和状态。

e.en: The paper discusses {filamentsaturation} during material testing.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论了材料测试中的丝状物饱和现象。

e.en: The instrument used a fine {filar} scale.
e.zh: 这台仪器使用精细的丝线刻度。

e.en: The parasite has a slender {filar} form.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫呈细长丝状。

e.en: The geologist noted {filicite} in the thin section.
e.zh: 地质学家在薄片中发现了丝状矿物。

e.en: Old reports described the deposit as rich in {filicite}.
e.zh: 旧报告称该矿床富含纤维状物质。

e.en: The fossil had a {filicoid} pattern on its surface.
e.zh: 这块化石表面有似蕨类的纹样。

e.en: She sketched the plant's {filicoid} leaves carefully.
e.zh: 她仔细画下那株植物蕨类状的叶子。

e.en: The poem treats {filiety} as a sacred duty.
e.zh: 这首诗把子女关系视为神圣的责任。

e.en: Legal debates once linked inheritance to {filiety}.
e.zh: 法律争论曾把继承权同子女身份联系起来。

filiferous.t: 生有丝状物的；带细丝的

e.en: The seed has a {filiferous} edge that catches the wind.
e.zh: 这种种子有带细丝的边缘，能借风传播。

e.en: Under magnification, the insect's {filiferous} antennae were visible.
e.zh: 在放大镜下，可以看到昆虫生有细丝的触角。

e.en: The doctor used a {filiform} probe during the procedure.
e.zh: 医生在操作中使用了一根丝状探针。

e.en: The algae formed {filiform} strands in the water.
e.zh: 藻类在水中形成了线形的细丝。

filigrain.t: 金银细丝工艺；精细纹饰

e.en: The brooch was decorated with delicate {filigrain}.
e.zh: 这枚胸针饰有精细的金银细丝工艺。

e.en: A border of {filigrain} softened the heavy design.
e.zh: 一圈精细纹饰让厚重的设计显得柔和。

filiopietistic.t: 过度尊祖的；孝敬先人的

e.en: His speech sounded oddly {filiopietistic} to modern listeners.
e.zh: 在现代听众看来，他的演讲显得过分尊祖。

e.en: The museum avoided a purely {filiopietistic} account of the founders.
e.zh: 博物馆没有只用孝敬先人的口吻讲述创始人。

e.en: He gave the coin a quick {filip} across the table.
e.zh: 他用手指把硬币轻轻一弹，弹过桌面。

e.en: The award gave her career a useful {filip}.
e.zh: 这个奖项给她的事业带来了有益的推动。

e.en: The old text used {filipin} for a woman from the Philippines.
e.zh: 这篇旧文本用filipin指来自菲律宾的女性。

e.en: A {filipin} dress appeared in the historical catalogue.
e.zh: 历史目录中出现了一件菲律宾式女装。

e.en: Can you be my {fill-in} at the meeting?
e.zh: 你能在会议上临时代替我吗？

e.en: Each blank needs a short {fill-in} answer.
e.zh: 每个空格都需要填入一个简短答案。

e.en: We stopped to {fill-up} the car before leaving town.
e.zh: 离开城镇前，我们停下来给车加满油。

e.en: The shelves {fill-up} quickly during the sale.
e.zh: 促销期间，货架很快就被摆满了。

e.en: The senator began a {fillibuster} late at night.
e.zh: 那名参议员深夜开始冗长发言阻挠议事。

e.en: Critics called the debate a calculated {fillibuster}.
e.zh: 批评者称这场辩论是有意安排的拖延战术。

e.en: She is {filling-in} for the manager this week.
e.zh: 她这周在替经理代班。

e.en: The clerk spent the morning {filling-in} forms.
e.zh: 办事员整个上午都在填写表格。

e.en: They played {fillipeen} with cherry stones after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们用樱桃核玩弹指打赌的游戏。

e.en: The word {fillipeen} survives mainly in old dictionaries.
e.zh: fillipeen这个词主要保存在旧词典里。

e.en: The carpenter reached for a {fillister} to shape the rebate.
e.zh: 木匠拿起槽刨来修出那道凹槽。

e.en: Use a screwdriver that fits the {fillister} head.
e.zh: 要用能配合这种带槽螺钉头的螺丝刀。

e.en: Please {fillout} the form before your appointment.
e.zh: 请在预约前填写这张表格。

e.en: The puppy began to {fillout} after a month of care.
e.zh: 经过一个月照料，小狗开始长得丰满起来。

e.en: My sister is a serious {film-fan}.
e.zh: 我妹妹是个很认真的影迷。

e.en: Every {film-fan} in town wanted a ticket.
e.zh: 城里的每个电影爱好者都想买到票。

e.en: The average {film-goer} expects comfortable seats.
e.zh: 普通观影者都希望座椅舒服。

e.en: As a regular {film-goer}, he noticed the sound quality.
e.zh: 作为经常看电影的人，他注意到了音响效果。

e.en: She studied {film-making} at college.
e.zh: 她在大学学习电影制作。

e.en: Digital tools have changed independent {film-making}.
e.zh: 数字工具改变了独立电影制作。

filaree.t: 鹳嘴草属植物；野天竺葵

e.en: The dry pasture was dotted with purple {filaree} in spring.
e.zh: 春天，干草场上点缀着紫色的鹳嘴草。

e.en: Ranchers sometimes use {filaree} as early forage for sheep.
e.zh: 牧场主有时把鹳嘴草当作绵羊早春的牧草。

e.en: The microscope revealed a living {filaria} in the blood sample.
e.zh: 显微镜显示血样中有一条活的丝虫。

e.en: A mosquito can transmit {filaria} to a human host.
e.zh: 蚊子可以把丝虫传播给人体宿主。

e.en: Several {filariae} were found in the infected dog's tissues.
e.zh: 在受感染狗的组织中发现了数条丝虫。

e.en: The lab counted the {filariae} under a stained slide.
e.zh: 实验室在染色载玻片下清点这些丝虫。

e.en: The clinic treats many cases of {filarial} infection each year.
e.zh: 这家诊所每年治疗许多丝虫感染病例。

e.en: Public health workers mapped {filarial} disease in rural districts.
e.zh: 公共卫生人员绘制了农村地区丝虫病的分布图。

e.en: The parasite was identified as a {filariid} nematode.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫被鉴定为丝虫科线虫。

e.en: A {filariid} worm often depends on insects for transmission.
e.zh: 丝虫科蠕虫常依靠昆虫传播。

e.en: The old workshop stored bundles of {filasse} for rope making.
e.zh: 旧作坊里存放着成捆的粗麻纤维，用来制绳。

e.en: Workers cleaned the {filasse} before spinning it into coarse thread.
e.zh: 工人先清理这些亚麻粗纤维，再纺成粗线。

e.en: The botanist noted the flower's long {filate} stamens.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这朵花有细长丝状的雄蕊。

e.en: A {filate} structure trailed from the tiny marine animal.
e.zh: 这个微小海洋动物身后拖着一条丝状结构。

e.en: The abandoned {filature} once employed hundreds of silk workers.
e.zh: 那座废弃的缫丝厂曾雇用数百名丝织工人。

e.en: Modern {filature} improved the quality of the raw silk.
e.zh: 现代缫丝工艺提高了生丝的质量。

filchingly.t: 偷窃地；鬼鬼祟祟地拿取

e.en: He smiled {filchingly} as he slipped the coin away.
e.zh: 他把硬币悄悄拿走时，露出偷窃般的笑。

e.en: The child reached {filchingly} toward the jar of sweets.
e.zh: 孩子鬼鬼祟祟地把手伸向糖果罐。

e.en: The company banned illegal {file-sharing} on office computers.
e.zh: 公司禁止在办公电脑上进行非法文件共享。

e.en: We used a secure {file-sharing} service for the project.
e.zh: 我们为这个项目使用了安全的文件共享服务。

e.en: A small {filefish} hid among the swaying seaweed.
e.zh: 一条小革鲀躲在摇曳的海藻之间。

e.en: The diver photographed a brightly patterned {filefish}.
e.zh: 潜水员拍到了一条花纹鲜艳的革鲀。

e.en: Her coat was a soft {filemot} shade.
e.zh: 她的外套是柔和的枯叶黄褐色。

e.en: The autumn hills turned {filemot} after weeks without rain.
e.zh: 数周无雨后，秋天的山丘变成了枯叶般的黄褐色。

e.en: The corrupted {filesystem} prevented the laptop from starting.
e.zh: 损坏的文件系统导致笔记本无法启动。

e.en: Linux can mount more than one {filesystem} type.
e.zh: Linux 可以挂载不止一种文件系统类型。

fili.t: 古爱尔兰诗人；吟游学者

e.en: A {fili} preserved the king's genealogy in verse.
e.zh: 一位古爱尔兰诗人用诗句保存国王的族谱。

e.en: The medieval {fili} held a respected place at court.
e.zh: 中世纪的吟游学者在宫廷中地位受人尊敬。

e.en: The court may {filiate} the child to the alleged father.
e.zh: 法院可以确认该孩子与被指称父亲的亲子关系。

e.en: Scholars tried to {filiate} the manuscript to an older tradition.
e.zh: 学者们试图把这份手稿归入更古老的传承。

filiated.t: 已确定亲缘的；已隶属的

e.en: The child was legally {filiated} to his biological father.
e.zh: 这个孩子在法律上被确认与生父有亲子关系。

e.en: The dialect was {filiated} with a northern language group.
e.zh: 这种方言被归入一个北方语族。

e.en: The lawyer is {filiating} the claim through old parish records.
e.zh: 律师正通过旧教区记录来确认这项亲属主张。

e.en: The historian spent years {filiating} local myths to classical sources.
e.zh: 历史学家花多年时间把地方神话追溯到古典来源。

filibeg.t: 苏格兰短褶裙；小格子裙

e.en: He wore a tartan {filibeg} at the Highland gathering.
e.zh: 他在高地聚会上穿了一条格纹苏格兰短褶裙。

e.en: The museum displayed a woolen {filibeg} from the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一条十八世纪的羊毛苏格兰短褶裙。

filibusterism.t: 冗长阻挠议事；海盗式冒险主义

e.en: The senator's allies defended {filibusterism} as a minority right.
e.zh: 这位参议员的盟友把冗长阻挠议事辩护为少数派权利。

e.en: Nineteenth-century {filibusterism} often mixed private ambition with foreign conquest.
e.zh: 十九世纪的海盗式冒险主义常把个人野心与海外征服混在一起。

e.en: The specimen had a delicate {filicauline} stem.
e.zh: 这个标本有一根纤细的蕨茎状茎。

e.en: Botanists described the fossil as {filicauline} in form.
e.zh: 植物学家把这块化石描述为茎部呈蕨类形态。

e.en: The report examined rare cases of {filicide} in detail.
e.zh: 这份报告详细研究了罕见的杀害子女案件。

e.en: In legal writing, {filicide} refers to a parent killing a child.
e.zh: 在法律写作中，filicide 指父母杀害子女。

e.en: The fossil leaf showed a clearly {filiciform} pattern.
e.zh: 这片叶化石呈现出明显的蕨状纹样。

e.en: Gardeners liked the plant's airy, {filiciform} foliage.
e.zh: 园丁喜欢这种植物轻盈、形似蕨类的叶片。

e.en: The old remedy contained {filicin} from male fern.
e.zh: 这种旧药方含有来自雄蕨的绵马素。

e.en: Chemists studied {filicin} because of its anthelmintic effect.
e.zh: 化学家研究绵马素，是因为它有驱虫作用。

e.en: The {film-star} arrived late for the premiere.
e.zh: 那位电影明星首映礼迟到了。

e.en: She still dreamed of becoming a {film-star}.
e.zh: 她仍梦想成为电影明星。

e.en: The novel is highly {filmable} because of its vivid scenes.
e.zh: 这部小说场景生动，很适合拍成电影。

e.en: Not every true story is {filmable}.
e.zh: 并不是每个真实故事都适合拍成电影。

e.en: The teacher loaded a {filmastrip} for the history lesson.
e.zh: 老师为历史课装上了一卷幻灯片条。

e.en: A damaged {filmastrip} lay beside the old projector.
e.zh: 一条损坏的电影胶片条放在旧放映机旁。

e.en: He bought a {filmbook} about silent cinema.
e.zh: 他买了一本关于默片的电影书。

e.en: The festival gave each guest a small {filmbook}.
e.zh: 电影节给每位来宾发了一本小资料册。

e.en: Her return caused excitement across {filmdom}.
e.zh: 她的回归在整个电影界引起轰动。

e.en: Few actors in {filmdom} kept such privacy.
e.zh: 影坛里很少有演员能这样保持隐私。

e.en: The city hosts a popular {filmfest} every spring.
e.zh: 这座城市每年春天都会举办热门电影节。

e.en: We spent the weekend at an indie {filmfest}.
e.zh: 我们周末去了一个独立电影影展。

filmgoer.t: 电影观众；常看电影的人

e.en: The average {filmgoer} wants a clear story.
e.zh: 普通电影观众想看一个清楚的故事。

e.en: As a regular {filmgoer}, she notices small editing mistakes.
e.zh: 作为经常看电影的人，她会注意到细小的剪辑错误。

e.en: The critic drew a {filmgraph} of the director's career.
e.zh: 影评人画了一张导演生涯的电影图表。

e.en: This archive stores each {filmgraph} with release dates.
e.zh: 这个档案库保存每张影片记录图及上映日期。

filmically.t: 以电影方式；从电影角度

e.en: The scene works {filmically} despite its simple dialogue.
e.zh: 尽管对白简单，这个场景从电影角度看很有效。

e.en: She thinks {filmically} when planning a stage play.
e.zh: 她策划舞台剧时会用电影化的方式思考。

filmier.t: 更薄膜状的；更像电影的

e.en: The soup developed a {filmier} surface as it cooled.
e.zh: 汤冷却后表面形成了更薄膜状的一层。

e.en: His second video looked {filmier} than the first.
e.zh: 他的第二个视频比第一个更有电影感。

filmiest.t: 最薄膜状的；最像电影的

e.en: Choose the {filmiest} layer for the microscope slide.
e.zh: 为显微镜载玻片选最薄膜状的那一层。

e.en: That sunset shot is the {filmiest} moment in the video.
e.zh: 那段日落镜头是视频里最有电影感的时刻。

e.en: Oil spread {filmily} across the puddle.
e.zh: 油呈薄膜状在水坑表面扩散开来。

e.en: The old window glowed {filmily} in the morning light.
e.zh: 旧窗在晨光里显得朦胧发亮。

e.en: The studio hopes to {filmize} the comic series.
e.zh: 制片厂希望把这套漫画拍成电影。

e.en: He tried to {filmize} the play with fast cuts.
e.zh: 他试图用快速剪辑把这部戏剧电影化。

e.en: She moved to {filmland} with one suitcase.
e.zh: 她带着一个手提箱搬去了电影之乡。

e.en: Gossip from {filmland} filled the magazine.
e.zh: 这本杂志满是电影界的八卦。

e.en: The museum showed a silent {filmlet} from 1910.
e.zh: 博物馆放映了一部1910年的无声短片。

e.en: A tiny {filmlet} covered the surface of the chemical solution.
e.zh: 化学溶液表面覆盖着一层小薄膜。

filmnoir.t: 黑色电影；黑色电影风格

e.en: The detective story borrows heavily from {filmnoir}.
e.zh: 这个侦探故事大量借鉴黑色电影风格。

e.en: They screened a classic {filmnoir} after midnight.
e.zh: 他们午夜后放映了一部经典黑色电影。

e.en: The technician checked the reel with a {filmometer}.
e.zh: 技术员用胶片测量仪检查了那卷胶片。

e.en: An old {filmometer} sat unused in the lab.
e.zh: 一台旧测片器闲置在实验室里。

e.en: She revised the {filmscript} before meeting the producer.
e.zh: 见制片人前，她修改了电影剧本。

e.en: The archive keeps the original {filmscript} in a box.
e.zh: 档案馆把原始影片脚本保存在盒子里。

e.en: Visitors must stay quiet on the {filmset}.
e.zh: 访客在电影拍摄现场必须保持安静。

e.en: The abandoned warehouse became a crowded {filmset}.
e.zh: 那座废弃仓库变成了拥挤的片场。

filmsetting.t: 电影背景；影片场景设定

e.en: The island makes a dramatic {filmsetting}.
e.zh: 这座岛形成了很有戏剧性的电影背景。

e.en: Her essay compares the novel's city with its {filmsetting}.
e.zh: 她的论文比较了小说中的城市和影片场景设定。

e.en: The {filmstar} signed posters for the crowd.
e.zh: 那位影星为人群签了海报。

e.en: He dressed like an old Hollywood {filmstar}.
e.zh: 他打扮得像老好莱坞电影明星。

e.en: A {filoplume} helps a bird sense feather movement.
e.zh: 丝状羽能帮助鸟感知羽毛的运动。

e.en: The biologist found a tiny {filoplume} near the wing feather.
e.zh: 生物学家在翅羽旁发现了一根细小丝状羽。

e.en: The cell extended a {filopodium} toward the signal.
e.zh: 细胞向信号方向伸出一个丝状伪足。

e.en: Under the microscope, each {filopodium} looked like a thin thread.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，每个丝状突起都像一根细线。

e.en: The amoeba used {filopods} to explore its surroundings.
e.zh: 变形虫用丝状伪足探索周围环境。

e.en: Researchers counted the {filopods} along the cell edge.
e.zh: 研究人员数了细胞边缘的细丝状突起。

filose.t: 丝状的；有线的；细丝般的

e.en: The algae had a {filose} shape under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，这种藻类呈细丝状。

e.en: A {filose} appendage extended from the tiny organism.
e.zh: 一个细丝般的附属物从这个微小生物上伸出。

e.en: She stitched the border with red {filoselle}.
e.zh: 她用红色绢丝线缝出了边框。

e.en: The old pattern called for fine {filoselle}.
e.zh: 这份旧图样要求使用细绢丝线。

e.en: Pour the mixture through the {filter-paper} slowly.
e.zh: 把混合物慢慢倒过这张滤纸。

e.en: The chemist folded a piece of {filter-paper}.
e.zh: 化学师折起了一张过滤用纸。

e.en: He bought a pack of {filter-tipped} cigarettes.
e.zh: 他买了一包带过滤嘴的香烟。

e.en: The ad promoted a new {filter-tipped} design.
e.zh: 广告宣传了一种新的带过滤嘴设计。

e.en: Engineers tested the sludge for {filterability}.
e.zh: 工程师检测了污泥的可过滤性。

e.en: Low {filterability} can slow the whole process.
e.zh: 可过滤性低会拖慢整个流程。

e.en: The liquid is {filterable} through a fine membrane.
e.zh: 这种液体可以通过细膜过滤。

e.en: The results are {filterable} by date and region.
e.zh: 这些结果可以按日期和地区筛选。

e.en: The report compared the {filterableness} of several samples.
e.zh: 报告比较了几种样品的可过滤性。

e.en: Poor {filterableness} made the mixture hard to process.
e.zh: 可过滤性差使这种混合物难以处理。

filtergram.t: 滤膜培养片；过滤培养图

e.en: The lab examined the {filtergram} for bacterial colonies.
e.zh: 实验室检查了滤膜培养片上的细菌菌落。

e.en: A clear {filtergram} helped confirm the water quality.
e.zh: 清晰的滤膜培养片帮助确认了水质。

e.en: Workers wore a {filtermask} near the chemical spill.
e.zh: 工人在化学品泄漏处附近戴着过滤面罩。

e.en: The old {filtermask} no longer sealed properly.
e.zh: 那副旧滤毒面具已经无法严密贴合。

e.en: The floodwater {filthied} the carpets overnight.
e.zh: 洪水一夜之间把地毯弄脏了。

e.en: His lies {filthied} a once-honorable name.
e.zh: 他的谎言玷污了一个曾经体面的名声。

e.en: The children arrived {filthily} dressed after the game.
e.zh: 孩子们赛后穿得脏兮兮地来了。

e.en: He laughed {filthily} at the crude remark.
e.zh: 听到那句粗俗的话，他下流地笑了起来。

e.en: The landlord ignored the {filthiness} of the kitchen.
e.zh: 房东无视厨房的肮脏状况。

e.en: She objected to the {filthiness} of the language.
e.zh: 她反感那些话语的下流。

e.en: The study measured the {filtrability} of the suspension.
e.zh: 研究测量了这种悬浮液的可过滤性。

e.en: High {filtrability} reduced the cost of treatment.
e.zh: 较高的可过滤性降低了处理成本。

e.en: Only the {filtrable} fraction was collected for testing.
e.zh: 只有可过滤的部分被收集起来做测试。

e.en: The solution remained {filtrable} after cooling.
e.zh: 溶液冷却后仍然可以过滤。

e.en: The clear {filtrate} was poured into a clean flask.
e.zh: 澄清的滤液被倒入一个干净烧瓶。

e.en: They tested the {filtrate} for traces of metal.
e.zh: 他们检测滤液中是否含有金属痕量。

e.en: The {filtrated} water was stored in glass bottles.
e.zh: 过滤后的水被储存在玻璃瓶中。

e.en: They {filtrated} the sample before analysis.
e.zh: 他们在分析前过滤了样品。

e.en: The machine {filtrates} the oil before reuse.
e.zh: 机器会在再次使用前过滤油。

e.en: Different {filtrates} were kept in labeled tubes.
e.zh: 不同的滤液被保存在贴有标签的试管里。

e.en: The technician was {filtrating} the sample carefully.
e.zh: 技术员正在仔细过滤样品。

e.en: A {filtrating} device removed the fine particles.
e.zh: 一台过滤装置去除了细小颗粒。

e.en: The {filtrator} removed dust from the incoming air.
e.zh: 过滤器去除了进入空气中的灰尘。

e.en: A damaged {filtrator} can contaminate the product.
e.zh: 受损的过滤装置可能污染产品。

e.en: The old manual used {filtre} instead of filter.
e.zh: 那本旧手册用filtre来表示过滤器。

e.en: He replaced the {filtre} in the laboratory apparatus.
e.zh: 他更换了实验装置中的滤器。

e.en: The surgeon identified the {filum} during the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术过程中辨认出终丝。

e.en: A delicate {filum} connected the two structures.
e.zh: 一条细丝状结构连接着这两个部分。

e.en: The microscope showed a delicate {fimbria} along the tissue edge.
e.zh: 显微镜显示组织边缘有一条细小的伞状边缘。

e.en: Each bacterial {fimbria} helps the cell attach to surfaces.
e.zh: 每根细菌菌毛状结构都帮助细胞附着在表面上。

e.en: The fallopian tube has tiny {fimbriae} near the ovary.
e.zh: 输卵管靠近卵巢处有细小的伞状边缘。

e.en: Bacterial {fimbriae} can make infection more likely.
e.zh: 细菌菌毛会增加感染发生的可能性。

e.en: The surgeon inspected the {fimbrial} end of the tube.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了输卵管的伞端。

e.en: Researchers studied {fimbrial} proteins on the bacterial surface.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了细菌表面的菌毛蛋白。

e.en: The leaf has a {fimbriate} margin under magnification.
e.zh: 放大观察时，这片叶子有流苏状边缘。

e.en: Some bacteria are {fimbriate} and cling tightly to host cells.
e.zh: 有些细菌具菌毛，会牢牢附着在宿主细胞上。

e.en: The artist used a {fimbriating} stitch around the cloth.
e.zh: 艺术家在布料周围用了形成流苏边的针法。

e.en: The specimen showed {fimbriating} growth along its border.
e.zh: 标本边缘呈现出流苏状生长。

e.en: The shell's {fimbriation} is visible only with a lens.
e.zh: 贝壳的流苏状边缘只有用放大镜才能看见。

e.en: The study measured {fimbriation} in several bacterial strains.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了几种细菌菌株的菌毛形成情况。

e.en: The novel captures a {fin-de-siecle} mood of anxiety and luxury.
e.zh: 这部小说捕捉到一种世纪末的焦虑与奢华氛围。

e.en: Her apartment was decorated in {fin-de-siecle} style.
e.zh: 她的公寓按世纪末风格装饰得华丽而颓废。

e.en: The contract awaits {finalisation} by both legal teams.
e.zh: 这份合同正等待双方法律团队最终确定。

e.en: Budget {finalisation} will happen after the board meeting.
e.zh: 预算将在董事会会议后定稿。

e.en: She wrote {finaly} when she meant finally.
e.zh: 她本想写finally，却写成了finaly。

e.en: The teacher circled {finaly} as a spelling mistake.
e.zh: 老师把finaly圈出来，标为拼写错误。

e.en: The bank launched a new {financial-service} platform.
e.zh: 这家银行推出了一个新的金融服务平台。

e.en: She works in the {financial-service} sector downtown.
e.zh: 她在市中心的金融服务行业工作。

e.en: The city depends heavily on {financial-services} jobs.
e.zh: 这座城市高度依赖金融服务业岗位。

e.en: Our company sells software to {financial-services} firms.
e.zh: 我们公司向金融服务公司销售软件。

e.en: A {finback} surfaced beside the research vessel.
e.zh: 一头长须鲸在科研船旁浮出水面。

e.en: The museum displayed a {finback} whale skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具长须鲸骨架。

e.en: The archaeologist recorded the coin's {find-spot} carefully.
e.zh: 考古学家仔细记录了这枚硬币的发现地点。

e.en: Without a reliable {find-spot}, the artifact lost context.
e.zh: 没有可靠的发现地点，这件文物就失去了背景信息。

e.en: Make the document {findable} with clear file names.
e.zh: 用清楚的文件名让这份文档容易找到。

e.en: The old article is still {findable} online.
e.zh: 那篇旧文章现在仍能在网上检索到。

e.en: She used a {fine-comb} to remove the tangles.
e.zh: 她用细齿梳把打结的头发梳开。

e.en: Police will {fine-comb} the area for evidence.
e.zh: 警方会仔细搜查该区域寻找证据。

fine-cut.t: 切得很细的；精确剪辑的

e.en: The recipe calls for {fine-cut} herbs.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要切得很细的香草。

e.en: The documentary used {fine-cut} editing to build tension.
e.zh: 这部纪录片通过精确剪辑营造紧张感。

e.en: The tailor could {fine-draw} a tear almost invisibly.
e.zh: 裁缝能把裂口细密缝补得几乎看不出来。

e.en: The essay tries to {fine-draw} the difference between duty and desire.
e.zh: 这篇文章试图细致描绘责任与欲望的区别。

fine-drawn.t: 细致入微的；线条精细的

e.en: Her argument depends on a {fine-drawn} distinction.
e.zh: 她的论点依赖一个细致入微的区分。

e.en: The portrait has {fine-drawn} features and pale shading.
e.zh: 这幅肖像五官线条精细，阴影淡雅。

e.en: The app provides {fine-grained} control over privacy settings.
e.zh: 这个应用能对隐私设置进行细粒度控制。

e.en: This beach is known for its {fine-grained} sand.
e.zh: 这片海滩以颗粒细腻的沙子闻名。

e.en: He arrived in a {fine-looking} suit.
e.zh: 他穿着一套漂亮的西装来了。

e.en: They adopted a {fine-looking} old house by the river.
e.zh: 他们买下了河边一栋很漂亮的老房子。

e.en: Cover the jar with a {fine-meshed} cloth.
e.zh: 用一块网眼细密的布盖住罐子。

e.en: The {fine-meshed} screen keeps insects out.
e.zh: 这张细密的纱网能把昆虫挡在外面。

fine-spun.t: 精巧细致的；牵强精微的

e.en: The lawyer offered a {fine-spun} interpretation of the rule.
e.zh: 律师对这条规则提出了精巧却有些牵强的解释。

e.en: The scarf was made from {fine-spun} silk.
e.zh: 这条围巾是用细纺丝绸制成的。

e.en: Use a {fine-tooth} comb on the wet hair.
e.zh: 在湿头发上用一把细齿梳。

e.en: The editor gave the report a {fine-tooth} review.
e.zh: 编辑对这份报告做了细致审查。

e.en: She removed the knots with a {fine-tooth-comb}.
e.zh: 她用细齿梳把打结的地方梳开。

e.en: The lawyer went through the contract with a {fine-tooth-comb}.
e.zh: 律师非常仔细地审阅了合同。

e.en: A {fine-toothed} comb can catch tiny insects.
e.zh: 细齿梳能梳出很小的虫子。

e.en: The machine uses a {fine-toothed} gear for precision.
e.zh: 这台机器使用细齿齿轮来提高精度。

e.en: We need to {fine-tune} the engine before the race.
e.zh: 比赛前我们需要微调发动机。

e.en: She will {fine-tune} the speech tonight.
e.zh: 她今晚会把演讲稿再仔细打磨一下。

e.en: The system is {fine-tuned} for faster searches.
e.zh: 这个系统经过微调，搜索速度更快。

e.en: His ear is {fine-tuned} to small changes in pitch.
e.zh: 他的耳朵对音高的细微变化很敏感。

e.en: The radio has a {fine-tuner} for weak signals.

e.en: Good {fire-proofing} can slow the spread of flames.
e.zh: 良好的防火处理能减缓火势蔓延。

e.en: He was charged with {fire-raising} after the warehouse burned down.
e.zh: 仓库被烧毁后，他被控故意纵火。

e.en: The old law treated {fire-raising} as a grave crime.
e.zh: 旧法律把纵火视为严重罪行。

e.en: The archive uses {fire-resistant} cabinets for old records.
e.zh: 档案室用耐火柜存放旧记录。

e.en: Workers wore {fire-resistant} clothing near the furnace.
e.zh: 工人在炉子旁穿着防火服。

e.en: The design requires {fire-resistive} walls between the units.
e.zh: 设计要求各单元之间使用具耐火性能的墙体。

e.en: Inspectors checked the building's {fire-resistive} materials.
e.zh: 检查员查看了建筑的耐火材料。

e.en: The curtains were treated with a {fire-retardant} chemical.
e.zh: 这些窗帘经过阻燃化学剂处理。

e.en: Firefighters dropped {fire-retardant} on the forest edge.
e.zh: 消防员在森林边缘投放了阻燃剂。

e.en: The shop held a {fire-sale} after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，这家店举行了大甩卖。

e.en: Investors feared a {fire-sale} of the company's assets.
e.zh: 投资者担心公司资产会被低价抛售。

e.en: Install a {fire-stop} where the cable passes through the wall.
e.zh: 电缆穿墙处要安装防火封堵。

e.en: The inspector found a missing {fire-stop} above the ceiling.
e.zh: 检查员发现天花板上方少了一个阻火构件。

e.en: The bombing created a deadly {fire-storm} in the city.
e.zh: 轰炸在城里引发了致命的火风暴。

e.en: Her remarks started a political {fire-storm}.
e.zh: 她的言论引发了一场政治风波。

e.en: Ancient {fire-worship} appears in several religious traditions.
e.zh: 古代拜火现象出现在多种宗教传统中。

e.en: The exhibit explained symbols used in {fire-worship}.
e.zh: 展览解释了火崇拜中使用的符号。

e.en: The {firealarm} rang during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议期间火警警报器响了。

e.en: Please test the {firealarm} every month.
e.zh: 请每个月测试一次火警警报器。

e.en: Ash had collected under the old {firebar}.
e.zh: 灰烬积在旧炉栅条下面。

e.en: The blacksmith replaced a cracked {firebar} in the grate.
e.zh: 铁匠更换了炉栅里裂开的火炉铁条。

e.en: They lined the stove recess with {fireboard}.
e.zh: 他们用防火板铺了炉灶凹位。

e.en: Use {fireboard} behind the heater, not ordinary plywood.
e.zh: 取暖器后面要用耐火板，不要用普通胶合板。

e.en: A {firebrat} crawled near the warm boiler.
e.zh: 一只火衣鱼在温暖的锅炉旁爬行。

e.en: The museum treated the storage room for {firebrat} damage.
e.zh: 博物馆处理了储藏室里的火衣鱼危害。

e.en: The kiln was built with heavy {firebrick}.
e.zh: 这座窑是用厚重的耐火砖砌成的。

e.en: Replace any cracked {firebrick} before using the stove.
e.zh: 使用炉子前要更换所有裂开的耐火砖。

e.en: The mason stacked {firebricks} beside the oven frame.
e.zh: 泥瓦匠把耐火砖堆在烤炉框架旁。

e.en: Old {firebricks} can often be reused in garden ovens.
e.zh: 旧耐火砖常可再用于花园烤炉。

e.en: Police suspected a {firebug} after three barns burned.
e.zh: 三座谷仓起火后，警方怀疑是纵火狂所为。

e.en: A child tried to catch a glowing {firebug} in the yard.
e.zh: 一个孩子想在院子里捉发光的萤火虫。

e.en: The potter mixed {fireclay} into the kiln lining.
e.zh: 陶工把耐火黏土混入窑炉内衬。

e.en: Good {fireclay} withstands very high temperatures.
e.zh: 优质耐火黏土能承受很高的温度。

e.en: We spotted a tiny {firecrest} in the pine trees.
e.zh: 我们在松树间发现了一只小小的火冠戴菊鸟。

e.en: The {firecrest} has a bright stripe on its head.
e.zh: 火冠戴菊鸟头上有一道鲜亮的条纹。

e.en: The crowd was {fired-up} before the final song.
e.zh: 最后一首歌开始前，观众已经很激动。

e.en: She came into work {fired-up} about the new project.
e.zh: 她上班时对新项目充满干劲。

e.en: Miners feared {firedamp} in the narrow tunnel.
e.zh: 矿工担心狭窄巷道里有可燃瓦斯。

e.en: A small spark can ignite {firedamp} underground.
e.zh: 一点火星就可能点燃地下矿井瓦斯。

e.en: He placed the logs across the iron {firedog}.
e.zh: 他把木柴横放在铁制壁炉柴架上。

e.en: The antique {firedog} stood beside the hearth.
e.zh: 那个古董柴架立在炉边。

e.en: The brass {firedogs} held the logs above the ashes.
e.zh: 黄铜柴架把木柴托在灰烬上方。

e.en: She polished the old {firedogs} before winter.
e.zh: 入冬前她擦亮了那些旧壁炉柴架。

e.en: The legend tells of a {firedrake} guarding treasure.
e.zh: 传说中有一条喷火龙守护宝藏。

e.en: A painted {firedrake} curled around the shield.
e.zh: 盾牌上画着一条盘绕的火龙。

e.en: At sunset, the waterfall looked like a {firefall}.
e.zh: 日落时，瀑布看起来像一条火瀑。

e.en: The festival ended with a dramatic {firefall} from the cliff.
e.zh: 节日以悬崖上壮观的落火表演结束。

firefang.t: 干草霉热；饲草发热变质

e.en: The farmer checked the hay for {firefang} after heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨后，农民检查干草是否发热变质。

e.en: Poor ventilation can cause {firefang} in stored fodder.
e.zh: 通风不良会导致储存饲草发热变质。

fireflood.t: 火灾后的洪流；火般洪水

e.en: The burst pipe sent a {fireflood} through the burned warehouse.
e.zh: 爆裂的水管让烧毁的仓库里涌过一股洪流。

e.en: The poet imagined war as a {fireflood} sweeping the valley.
e.zh: 诗人把战争想象成席卷山谷的火般洪水。

e.en: A {firefox} climbed slowly through the bamboo.
e.zh: 一只小熊猫慢慢爬过竹林。

e.en: The old tale says a {firefox} guarded the mountain shrine.
e.zh: 古老传说说有一只火狐守护着山间神社。

e.en: She placed fresh logs on the {firegrate}.
e.zh: 她把新木柴放在壁炉炉栅上。

e.en: Ash had collected beneath the iron {firegrate}.
e.zh: 铁制壁炉炉栅下面积了一层灰。

e.en: The old house still had three iron {firegrates}.
e.zh: 这座老房子里仍有三个铁制壁炉炉栅。

e.en: Workers cleaned the {firegrates} before winter arrived.
e.zh: 工人在冬天到来前清理了那些壁炉炉栅。

e.en: Some Australians call the black kite a {firehawk}.
e.zh: 有些澳大利亚人把黑鸢称作火鹰。

e.en: The {firehawk} dropped a burning twig near the grass.
e.zh: 那只火鹰把一根燃烧的小枝丢在草地旁。

e.en: The cabin felt cold and {fireless} after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后，小屋没有炉火，显得很冷。

e.en: They tested a {fireless} cooker for camping trips.
e.zh: 他们测试了一种露营用的无火炊具。

e.en: Crews cut a {fireline} through the dry brush.
e.zh: 队员们在干燥灌木丛中开出一条防火线。

e.en: Reporters stayed behind the {fireline} during the battle.
e.zh: 战斗期间，记者们留在火线后方。

e.en: The museum displayed a seventeenth-century {firelock}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一支十七世纪的燧发枪。

e.en: Rain made the soldier's {firelock} unreliable.
e.zh: 雨水使那名士兵的燧发枪变得不可靠。

e.en: A small {firepot} warmed the room.
e.zh: 一个小火盆让房间暖和起来。

e.en: Soldiers carried a clay {firepot} for signaling.
e.zh: 士兵们带着一个陶制燃火罐用来发信号。

e.en: The engineer inspected the ship's {fireroom}.
e.zh: 工程师检查了船上的锅炉舱。

e.en: Heat poured from the hotel {fireroom}.
e.zh: 热气从旅馆的炉房里涌出来。

e.en: A {firespotter} noticed smoke beyond the ridge.
e.zh: 一名火情观察员注意到山脊那边有烟。

e.en: The plane carried a trained {firespotter} during summer.
e.zh: 夏季那架飞机搭载了一名受训的火情观察员。

e.en: Dry bark makes a useful {firestarter}.
e.zh: 干树皮是很有用的引火物。

e.en: Police searched for the {firestarter} after three suspicious blazes.
e.zh: 三起可疑火灾后，警方搜寻那名纵火者。

e.en: We spotted a {firetail} near the reeds.
e.zh: 我们在芦苇附近看到一只火尾雀。

e.en: The tiny {firetail} flashed red as it flew.
e.zh: 那只小小的红尾鸟飞过时露出一抹红色。

e.en: The {firethorn} was covered with orange berries.
e.zh: 火棘上结满了橙色浆果。

e.en: She planted {firethorn} along the garden wall.
e.zh: 她沿着花园围墙种下火棘。

e.en: The festival ended with a dramatic {firewalking} ceremony.
e.zh: 节日以一场震撼的走火仪式结束。

e.en: He studied {firewalking} as a test of faith and focus.
e.zh: 他研究赤脚踩火，把它视为信念和专注的考验。

firewarden.t: 防火管理员；消防监督员

e.en: The {firewarden} checked every exit before the drill.
e.zh: 防火管理员在演练前检查了每个出口。

e.en: A forest {firewarden} warned campers about the dry wind.
e.zh: 一名森林消防监督员提醒露营者注意干燥的风。

e.en: The {firewatcher} spent nights in the tower.
e.zh: 火情瞭望员夜里待在瞭望塔中。

e.en: A careful {firewatcher} kept the camp embers contained.
e.zh: 细心的看火人让营火余烬始终受控。

e.en: The {firewoman} carried a child to safety.
e.zh: 那名女消防员把一个孩子抱到安全处。

e.en: As a {firewoman}, Maria trains every morning.
e.zh: 作为女消防员，玛丽亚每天早上训练。

e.en: A {fireworm} can sting a careless diver.
e.zh: 刺毛海虫会蜇到粗心的潜水者。

e.en: The glowing {fireworm} appeared in the old sailor's story.
e.zh: 那条发光的火虫出现在老水手的故事里。

e.en: The soldiers waited on the {firingline}.
e.zh: 士兵们在火线上等待。

e.en: The minister found herself on the {firingline} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后，那位部长发现自己成了众矢之的。

e.en: The brewer tapped a {firkin} of ale.
e.zh: 酿酒师打开了一小木桶麦芽酒。

e.en: A {firkin} once measured a specific amount of butter.
e.zh: firkin曾是计量黄油的一种旧容量单位。

firlot.t: 苏格兰旧谷物容量单位

e.en: The record listed one {firlot} of oats.
e.zh: 记录中列着一firlot燕麦。

e.en: A {firlot} varied by region in old Scotland.
e.zh: 在旧时苏格兰，firlot这个谷物容量单位因地区而异。

e.en: The report includes {firm-specific} risk factors.
e.zh: 这份报告包含某家公司特有的风险因素。

e.en: Analysts removed {firm-specific} data before comparing industries.
e.zh: 分析师在比较行业前删除了公司特定数据。

e.en: The poet described a {firmamental} glow above the sea.
e.zh: 诗人描写海面上方苍穹般的光辉。

e.en: Ancient maps often used {firmamental} imagery for heaven.
e.zh: 古代地图常用天空意象来表现天堂。

e.en: The governor acted under a royal {firman}.
e.zh: 总督依据一份王室敕令行事。

e.en: Merchants waited for the {firman} allowing trade.
e.zh: 商人们等待准许贸易的官方命令。

e.en: Several {firmans} confirmed the monastery's rights.
e.zh: 几道敕令确认了修道院的权利。

e.en: The archive preserves Ottoman {firmans} on taxation.
e.zh: 档案馆保存着关于税收的奥斯曼敕令。

e.en: Choose the {firmest} mattress for better support.
e.zh: 选择最结实的床垫以获得更好的支撑。

e.en: She remained the {firmest} supporter of the plan.
e.zh: 她始终是这个计划最坚定的支持者。

firmoviscosity.t: 黏度随压力增大的性质

e.en: The engineer measured the oil's {firmoviscosity} under load.
e.zh: 工程师测量了油在负荷下的增黏特性。

e.en: High {firmoviscosity} can protect gears at extreme pressure.
e.zh: 高压下黏度增大的性质可以保护齿轮。

e.en: The old cheese had a {firmy} texture.
e.zh: 这种陈年奶酪质地较硬。

e.en: A {firmy} handshake greeted every visitor.
e.zh: 每位访客都受到有力握手的迎接。

e.en: The climbers crossed a slope of hard {firn}.
e.zh: 登山者穿过一片坚硬的粒雪坡。

e.en: Over time, {firn} can turn into glacial ice.
e.zh: 随着时间推移，粒雪会变成冰川冰。

e.en: Cold summers slow {firnification} on the glacier.
e.zh: 寒冷的夏季会减缓冰川上积雪变成粒雪的过程。

e.en: Scientists model {firnification} to estimate ice-sheet growth.
e.zh: 科学家通过模拟粒雪化过程来估算冰盖增长。

e.en: A {firry} scent filled the winter cabin.
e.zh: 冬日小屋里弥漫着冷杉般的气味。

e.en: They walked through a dark, {firry} valley.
e.zh: 他们穿过一条长满冷杉的幽暗山谷。

e.en: She became {first-chair} violin in the orchestra.
e.zh: 她成了管弦乐队的首席小提琴手。

e.en: The {first-chair} clarinet led the woodwinds confidently.
e.zh: 首席单簧管手自信地带领木管组。

e.en: This hotel is my {first-choice} for business trips.
e.zh: 这家酒店是我商务出差的首选。

e.en: She was the {first-choice} candidate for the role.
e.zh: 她是这个职位的第一人选。

e.en: The captain served a {first-chop} dinner aboard ship.
e.zh: 船长在船上招待了一顿上等晚餐。

e.en: His references were {first-chop}, according to the manager.
e.zh: 经理说他的推荐信是一流的。

e.en: They bought {first-class} tickets for the long flight.
e.zh: 他们为这趟长途航班买了头等舱机票。

e.en: The hospital provides {first-class} care for patients.
e.zh: 这家医院为病人提供一流的护理。

e.en: Seats are {first-come-first-serve} at the workshop.
e.zh: 研讨会座位先到先得。

e.en: The parking spaces are {first-come-first-serve} after six.
e.zh: 六点以后停车位按先到先得分配。

e.en: The {first-comer} received the only free ticket.
e.zh: 最先来的人拿到了唯一一张免费票。

e.en: In the village, every {first-comer} was treated with caution.
e.zh: 在村里，每个新来者都会被谨慎对待。

e.en: He was charged with {first-degree} murder.
e.zh: 他被控一级谋杀。

e.en: The doctor treated a {first-degree} burn on her hand.
e.zh: 医生处理了她手上的一度烧伤。

e.en: The team won its {first-ever} championship.
e.zh: 这支队伍赢得了有史以来第一个冠军。

e.en: Her {first-ever} speech in public went smoothly.
e.zh: 她第一次公开演讲进行得很顺利。

e.en: In Scotland, the {first-foot} brings luck for the year.
e.zh: 在苏格兰，新年首位登门者会带来一年的好运。

e.en: My uncle agreed to {first-foot} after midnight.
e.zh: 我叔叔答应午夜后第一个进门拜年。

e.en: The family welcomed the {first-footer} with whisky.
e.zh: 这家人用威士忌欢迎新年首位登门者。

e.en: A dark-haired {first-footer} was considered especially lucky.
e.zh: 黑发的新年首位登门者被认为特别吉利。

e.en: She is a {first-generation} college student.
e.zh: 她是家里第一代大学生。

e.en: The museum displayed a {first-generation} personal computer.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台第一代个人电脑。

e.en: The team scored twice in the {first-half}.
e.zh: 球队在上半场进了两个球。

e.en: Sales improved during the {first-half} of the year.
e.zh: 今年前半年的销售有所改善。

e.en: She gave a {first-hand} account of the accident.
e.zh: 她对事故作了第一手描述。

e.en: I learned {first-hand} how difficult farming can be.
e.zh: 我亲身体会到务农可能有多艰难。

first-lady.t: 第一夫人；女性领袖配偶或代表人物

e.en: The {first lady} visited the children's hospital today.
e.zh: 第一夫人今天探访了儿童医院。

e.en: She was known as the {first lady} of jazz.
e.zh: 她被誉为爵士乐界的第一夫人。

e.en: Antibiotics are often the {first-line} treatment for this infection.
e.zh: 抗生素常是这种感染的一线治疗方法。

e.en: Write your name on the {first line} of the form.
e.zh: 把你的名字写在表格的第一行。

first-mover.t: 先行者；率先进入市场者

e.en: The company gained a {first-mover} advantage in electric delivery vans.
e.zh: 这家公司在电动送货车领域获得了先发优势。

e.en: A {first mover} can shape customer expectations early.
e.zh: 先行者能较早影响顾客的期待。

e.en: Please write your {first name} and family name clearly.
e.zh: 请把你的名和姓写清楚。

e.en: We are on a {first-name} basis at work.
e.zh: 我们在工作中熟到可以直呼其名。

first-nighter.t: 首演夜观众；常看首演的人

e.en: The theatre was packed with critics and {first-nighters}.
e.zh: 剧院里挤满了评论家和首演夜观众。

e.en: As a devoted {first-nighter}, she never missed a premiere.
e.zh: 她是热衷首演的人，从不错过任何首场演出。

first-of-its-kind.t: 同类首创的；前所未有的

e.en: The hospital opened a {first-of-its-kind} clinic for long Covid patients.
e.zh: 医院开设了一家同类首创的长新冠门诊。

e.en: It was a {first-of-its-kind} agreement between the two rivals.
e.zh: 这是两个竞争对手之间前所未有的协议。

first-past-the-post.t: 简单多数当选制；领先者获胜制

e.en: Britain uses a {first-past-the-post} system for general elections.
e.zh: 英国大选采用简单多数当选制。

e.en: Under {first-past-the-post}, small parties often win fewer seats.
e.zh: 在简单多数制下，小党往往赢得较少席位。

e.en: She is a {first-rank} scholar in medieval history.
e.zh: 她是中世纪史领域的一流学者。

e.en: Only {first-rank} evidence should guide such a decision.
e.zh: 这种决定只能依据最高等级的证据。

e.en: The cinema shows mostly {first-run} films.
e.zh: 这家电影院主要放映首轮上映的电影。

e.en: The machine failed during its {first run}.
e.zh: 这台机器在首次运行时出了故障。

first-runner.t: 第一名赛跑者；首棒跑者

e.en: The {first-runner} set a fast pace for the relay team.
e.zh: 首棒跑者为接力队带出了很快的节奏。

e.en: The coach chose the strongest {first runner} for the race.
e.zh: 教练为这场比赛选了最强的第一名跑者。

first-strike.t: 先发制人的打击；首次攻击

e.en: The treaty was designed to reduce {first-strike} incentives.
e.zh: 这项条约旨在降低先发制人打击的诱因。

e.en: The team scored with a {first strike} in the opening minute.
e.zh: 球队在开场第一分钟就首次进攻得分。

e.en: He became the {first-string} quarterback after two injuries.
e.zh: 两名球员受伤后，他成了一线主力四分卫。

e.en: The director brought in her {first-string} designers for the launch.
e.zh: 总监调来了她的主力设计师参与发布。

e.en: Many {first-time} buyers need help understanding mortgages.
e.zh: 许多首次购房者需要帮助来理解按揭贷款。

e.en: I was nervous the {first time} I spoke in public.
e.zh: 我第一次公开讲话时很紧张。

first-timer.t: 初次尝试者；第一次来的人

e.en: The instructor gave every {first-timer} extra help.
e.zh: 教练给每个初学者都提供了额外帮助。

e.en: As a {first-timer}, he arrived early to find his seat.
e.zh: 作为第一次来的人，他早早到场找座位。

e.en: The hotel provided {first-class} service all weekend.
e.zh: 这家酒店整个周末都提供一流服务。

e.en: She mailed the letter by {first class}.
e.zh: 她用一等邮件寄出了那封信。

e.en: The villagers offered the {firstfruits} of the harvest.
e.zh: 村民献上了收成中最早成熟的果实。

e.en: The report showed the {firstfruits} of years of research.
e.zh: 这份报告展现了多年研究的最初成果。

e.en: The shepherd marked the {firstling} of the flock.
e.zh: 牧羊人给羊群中头生的幼畜做了标记。

e.en: The poem was the {firstling} of his imagination.
e.zh: 这首诗是他想象力最早的产物。

e.en: Enter your {firstname} in the top box.
e.zh: 在最上面的框里输入你的名字。

e.en: The database stores each customer's {firstname} separately.
e.zh: 数据库会单独保存每位客户的名。

e.en: A tall {fir tree} stood beside the cabin.
e.zh: 小屋旁立着一棵高高的冷杉树。

e.en: They decorated the {firtree} with silver lights.
e.zh: 他们用银色灯饰装点那棵冷杉树。

e.en: The new tax brought money into the royal {fisc}.
e.zh: 这项新税为王室国库带来了收入。

e.en: Historians traced how the imperial {fisc} was managed.
e.zh: 历史学家追溯了帝国财政收入的管理方式。

fish-and-chip.t: 炸鱼薯条的；卖炸鱼薯条的

e.en: We stopped at a {fish-and-chip} shop near the pier.
e.zh: 我们在码头附近的一家炸鱼薯条店停了下来。

e.en: The town's old {fish-and-chip} van still draws a crowd.
e.zh: 镇上那辆老式炸鱼薯条餐车仍然吸引很多人。

e.en: We ate {fish and chips} on the beach.
e.zh: 我们在海滩上吃了炸鱼薯条。

e.en: The pub serves excellent {fish-and-chips} every Friday.
e.zh: 这家酒吧每周五供应很不错的炸鱼薯条。

e.en: A {fish-bellied} sky appeared before sunrise.
e.zh: 日出前，天空泛起鱼肚白。

e.en: The old boat had a {fish-bellied} curve underneath.
e.zh: 那条旧船底部有一道像鱼腹一样的弧线。

e.en: The photographer used a {fish-eye} lens inside the cathedral.
e.zh: 摄影师在大教堂内使用了鱼眼镜头。

e.en: She gave the salesman a {fish-eye} and walked away.
e.zh: 她怀疑地瞪了推销员一眼，然后走开了。

e.en: {Fish-farming} has grown quickly in coastal towns.
e.zh: 沿海城镇的养鱼业发展很快。

e.en: The report studies pollution from {fish-farming}.
e.zh: 这份报告研究鱼类养殖业造成的污染。

e.en: She put a {fish-finger} sandwich in his lunchbox.
e.zh: 她在他的午餐盒里放了一个炸鱼条三明治。

e.en: The child dipped a {fish-finger} in ketchup.
e.zh: 孩子把一根鱼柳条蘸进番茄酱里。

e.en: The old {fish-hook} was rusty but sharp.
e.zh: 那只旧鱼钩生了锈，但仍然很锋利。

e.en: He caught his sleeve on a {fish-hook}.
e.zh: 他的袖子被一个鱼钩挂住了。

e.en: The robot moved with a {fish-like} motion.
e.zh: 这个机器人以鱼似的动作移动。

e.en: A {fish-like} smell came from the bucket.
e.zh: 桶里传出一股像鱼的气味。

e.en: They repaired the {fish-net} before dawn.
e.zh: 他们在天亮前修好了渔网。

e.en: She wore a black {fish-net} top on stage.
e.zh: 她在舞台上穿了一件黑色网眼上衣。

e.en: The farm has a small {fish-pond} behind the barn.
e.zh: 农场谷仓后面有一个小鱼塘。

e.en: Children watched the carp in the {fish-pond}.
e.zh: 孩子们看着养鱼池里的鲤鱼。

e.en: The device detects {fish-sound} under the boat.
e.zh: 这台设备能探测船下鱼群发出的声响。

e.en: Researchers recorded {fish-sound} near the reef at night.
e.zh: 研究人员夜间在礁石附近录下了鱼类声响。

fishability.t: 可钓鱼性；适合捕捞程度

e.en: Heavy rain reduced the river's {fishability}.
e.zh: 大雨降低了这条河的可钓鱼性。

e.en: Managers rated the lake's {fishability} before opening season.
e.zh: 管理人员在开放季前评估了湖泊的适合捕捞程度。

fishbolt.t: 系船缆的栓环；鱼尾螺栓

e.en: The sailor checked the {fishbolt} on the dock.
e.zh: 水手检查了码头上系船缆的栓环。

e.en: The mechanic replaced a damaged {fishbolt} in the joint.
e.zh: 机械师更换了接头里损坏的鱼尾螺栓。

e.en: I ordered a spicy {fishcake} with rice.
e.zh: 我点了一份配米饭的辣味鱼饼。

e.en: The soup included slices of Korean {fishcake}.
e.zh: 汤里有几片韩式鱼糕。

e.en: We fried the {fishcakes} until golden.
e.zh: 我们把鱼饼煎到金黄。

e.en: Street vendors sold hot {fishcakes} in broth.
e.zh: 街头小贩卖浸在汤里的热鱼糕。

e.en: My grandfather is a lifelong {fisheater}.
e.zh: 我祖父一辈子都爱吃鱼。

e.en: The osprey is a skilled {fisheater}.
e.zh: 鱼鹰是一种善于捕鱼为食的动物。

e.en: The photographer used a {fisheye} lens indoors.
e.zh: 摄影师在室内使用了鱼眼镜头。

e.en: She gave the offer a {fisheye} look.
e.zh: 她用怀疑的眼神看着这个提议。

e.en: The old {fishgarth} still stood across the stream.
e.zh: 旧捕鱼围栏仍横在溪流上。

e.en: Local history mentions a medieval {fishgarth} near the bridge.
e.zh: 地方史提到桥边曾有一处中世纪鱼梁。

e.en: He carried a {fishgig} into the shallow water.
e.zh: 他拿着捕鱼叉走进浅水区。

e.en: The museum displayed a handmade {fishgig}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件手工制作的鱼镖。

e.en: The {fishiest} dish was served with lemon.
e.zh: 最有鱼味的那道菜配了柠檬。

e.en: That was the {fishiest} excuse I had heard.
e.zh: 那是我听过最可疑的借口。

e.en: Too much sauce will {fishify} the whole stew.
e.zh: 酱料太多会让整锅炖菜都有鱼味。

e.en: The artist tried to {fishify} the character's face.
e.zh: 艺术家试图把这个角色的脸画得像鱼。

e.en: The kitchen smelled {fishily} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后厨房闻起来带着鱼腥味。

e.en: He smiled {fishily} when asked about the money.
e.zh: 被问到那笔钱时，他笑得很可疑。

e.en: Lemon helped reduce the {fishiness} of the soup.
e.zh: 柠檬有助于减轻汤里的鱼腥味。

e.en: The {fishiness} of the deal worried investors.
e.zh: 这笔交易的可疑之处让投资者担心。

e.en: A small {fishing-boat} left the harbor early.
e.zh: 一艘小渔船很早就离开了港口。

e.en: They repaired the engine of the {fishing-boat}.
e.zh: 他们修理了那艘渔船的发动机。

e.en: Pollution caused a major {fishkill} in the river.
e.zh: 污染导致河里发生大规模鱼类死亡事件。

e.en: Scientists investigated the summer {fishkill} near the dam.
e.zh: 科学家调查了水坝附近夏季的鱼类大量死亡事件。

e.en: The {fishline} snapped during the fight.
e.zh: 搏鱼时钓鱼线断了。

e.en: She tied the hook carefully to the {fishline}.
e.zh: 她小心地把鱼钩系到渔线上。

e.en: The electrician cut a strip of {fishpaper}.
e.zh: 电工剪下一条绝缘青壳纸。

e.en: The market wrapped the cod in {fishpaper}.
e.zh: 市场用鱼包装纸把鳕鱼包起来。

e.en: Workers tightened the {fishplate} beside the rail.
e.zh: 工人拧紧了钢轨旁的夹板。

e.en: A cracked {fishplate} delayed the train repairs.
e.zh: 一块开裂的接合板延误了铁路维修。

e.en: The old {fishpot} was baited with scraps.
e.zh: 那个旧捕鱼笼里放了些碎食作诱饵。

e.en: A clay {fishpot} stood beside the river hut.
e.zh: 一只陶制鱼篓放在河边小屋旁。

e.en: The tide filled the stone {fishpound} each morning.
e.zh: 每天早晨潮水都会灌满那座石砌围鱼栏。

e.en: Villagers repaired the {fishpound} before the season began.
e.zh: 渔季开始前，村民们修好了养鱼围场。

e.en: The chef fried the {fishskin} until crisp.
e.zh: 厨师把鱼皮炸到酥脆。

e.en: Traditional boots were sometimes sewn from {fishskin}.
e.zh: 传统靴子有时会用鱼皮缝制。

e.en: Salmon used the new {fishway} to pass the dam.
e.zh: 鲑鱼通过新建的鱼道越过水坝。

e.en: Engineers inspected the {fishway} after heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨过后，工程师检查了鱼梯。

e.en: A {fishwoman} sold fresh cod by the pier.
e.zh: 一名女鱼贩在码头旁卖新鲜鳕鱼。

e.en: The {fishwoman} knew every boat in the harbor.
e.zh: 这位渔妇认识港里每一条船。

e.en: The {fishwomen} cleaned their stalls before dawn.
e.zh: 女鱼贩们天亮前就清理好了摊位。

e.en: Several {fishwomen} waited for the boats to return.
e.zh: 几位渔妇等着渔船返港。

e.en: The old {fishworks} closed when catches declined.
e.zh: 捕捞量下降后，那家旧鱼类加工厂关闭了。

e.en: New {fishworks} brought jobs to the coastal town.
e.zh: 新的渔业设施给这座海滨小镇带来了工作机会。

e.en: The biologist found a {fishworm} under the gill.
e.zh: 生物学家在鱼鳃下发现了一条鱼寄生虫。

e.en: He threaded a {fishworm} onto the small hook.
e.zh: 他把一条钓鱼虫饵穿到小鱼钩上。

e.en: The canoe had a narrow, {fishyback} profile.
e.zh: 那只独木舟轮廓狭长，背部像鱼一样隆起。

e.en: A {fishyback} ridge ran along the carved handle.
e.zh: 雕刻手柄上有一道鱼背状的棱线。

e.en: The specimen had a {fissilingual} deformity noted in the report.
e.zh: 报告中记录了这个标本有裂舌畸形。

e.en: A {fissilingual} condition can affect speech and feeding.
e.zh: 裂舌状况可能影响说话和进食。

e.en: The shale's {fissility} made it split into thin sheets.
e.zh: 页岩的易裂性使它能裂成薄片。

e.en: Engineers tested the {fissility} of the laminated material.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种层压材料的可分裂性。

e.en: Her paper discussed {fissiochemistry} in irradiated fuels.
e.zh: 她的论文讨论了受辐照燃料中的核裂变化学。

e.en: The course introduced {fissiochemistry} alongside nuclear physics.
e.zh: 这门课程在核物理之外还介绍了裂变化学。

fissiography.t: 裂变产物记录法；裂变成像

e.en: The lab used {fissiography} to map uranium distribution.
e.zh: 实验室用裂变成像来绘制铀的分布。

e.en: Early {fissiography} required careful handling of radioactive samples.
e.zh: 早期裂变产物记录法需要小心处理放射性样品。

e.en: The isotope's {fissionability} depends on neutron energy.
e.zh: 这种同位素的可裂变性取决于中子能量。

e.en: Researchers compared the {fissionability} of several heavy elements.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了几种重元素的能裂变程度。

e.en: The cell showed a {fissional} stage under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下这个细胞呈现出分裂阶段。

e.en: The reactor study focused on {fissional} processes in fuel rods.
e.zh: 反应堆研究关注燃料棒中的裂变过程。

e.en: Bacterial {fissiparity} can produce huge colonies quickly.
e.zh: 细菌的分裂繁殖能很快形成庞大菌落。

e.en: The lecturer contrasted {fissiparity} with budding reproduction.
e.zh: 讲师把裂殖与出芽繁殖作了对比。

e.en: The fox was once classed as a {fissiped}.
e.zh: 狐狸曾被归为趾裂动物。

e.en: A {fissiped} foot has separated toes rather than a hoof.
e.zh: 趾分裂的足部有分开的脚趾，而不是蹄。

e.en: The track showed a clearly {fissipedal} pattern.
e.zh: 这串足迹显示出清楚的裂趾形态。

e.en: Zoologists described the animal as {fissipedal}.
e.zh: 动物学家把这种动物描述为有裂趾。

e.en: The swallow has a {fissirostral} bill suited to catching insects.
e.zh: 燕子有适合捕虫的阔嘴喙。

e.en: Older ornithologists grouped several {fissirostral} birds together.
e.zh: 早期鸟类学家把几种阔嘴鸟归为一类。

e.en: The report used {fissium} for a mixture of fission products.
e.zh: 报告用fissium指一组裂变产物混合物。

e.en: Engineers discussed {fissium} in the context of reactor waste.
e.zh: 工程师在反应堆废料的语境中讨论裂变物质。

e.en: Repeated freezing caused {fissuration} in the concrete wall.
e.zh: 反复冻结导致混凝土墙出现裂缝。

e.en: The doctor noted skin {fissuration} around the heel.
e.zh: 医生注意到脚跟周围皮肤有龟裂。

e.en: The collector specialized in Victorian {fistiana}.
e.zh: 这位收藏家专门收集维多利亚时代的拳击资料。

e.en: Old newspapers preserve plenty of {fistiana} from bare-knuckle days.
e.zh: 旧报纸保存了许多徒手拳击时代的拳坛轶闻。

e.en: The novel ends with a brief {fistic} encounter.
e.zh: 这部小说以一场短暂的拳斗收尾。

e.en: Reporters loved his old-fashioned {fistic} style.
e.zh: 记者们喜欢他那种老派的拳击风格。

fistical.t: 像笛子的；管状的；瘘管的

e.en: The old glossary described a {fistical} reed pipe.
e.zh: 那本旧词汇表把它描述成像笛子的芦管。

e.en: The surgeon noted a {fistical} passage near the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到伤口附近有一条瘘管样通道。

e.en: The warriors fought {fistmele} in the narrow gate.
e.zh: 武士们在狭窄的城门处拳拳相接地肉搏。

e.en: The poem says the rivals met {fistmele} at dawn.
e.zh: 诗中说那两个对手在黎明时近身交锋。

e.en: The editor added a {fistnote} below the passage.
e.zh: 编辑在这段文字下方加了一条脚注。

e.en: One {fistnote} explains the old spelling.
e.zh: 有一条页下注释解释了这个旧拼法。

e.en: Several {fistulae} formed after the infection.
e.zh: 感染之后形成了几条瘘管。

e.en: The scan showed small {fistulae} near the intestine.
e.zh: 扫描显示肠道附近有几处小的异常管道。

e.en: The doctor examined the {fistular} opening carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了那个瘘管开口。

e.en: A {fistular} stem can carry water efficiently.
e.zh: 管状茎能高效输送水分。

e.en: The sample had a {fistuliform} cavity inside.
e.zh: 样本内部有一个瘘管状空腔。

e.en: Botanists described the leaf as {fistuliform}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这片叶子描述为细管状。

e.en: The hospital scheduled {fistulography} for Friday morning.
e.zh: 医院把瘘管造影检查安排在周五上午。

e.en: The surgeon used {fistulography} to map the tract.
e.zh: 外科医生用瘘管造影来确定通道走向。

e.en: The patient had a {fistulous} opening near the scar.
e.zh: 病人疤痕附近有一个瘘管开口。

e.en: The report described a {fistulous} connection between organs.
e.zh: 报告描述了器官之间的一处异常瘘性连接。

e.en: The office {fit-out} took three months to finish.
e.zh: 办公室的装修配置花了三个月才完成。

e.en: They delayed the shop {fit-out} until summer.
e.zh: 他们把店铺内部装配推迟到了夏天。

e.en: He claimed the arrest was a police {fit-up}.
e.zh: 他声称这次逮捕是警方的诬陷。

e.en: The crew built a quick {fit-up} for the stage.
e.zh: 工作人员为舞台做了一个临时装配。

e.en: A {fitchew} slipped through the barn at night.
e.zh: 夜里一只鸡貂溜进了谷仓。

e.en: The old fur was labeled {fitchew} by the dealer.
e.zh: 商人把那张旧毛皮标为臭鼬皮。

e.en: The shield bore a {fitchy} cross.
e.zh: 盾牌上有一个下端尖的十字纹章。

e.en: A {fitchy} stake was driven into the soil.
e.zh: 一根尖脚状木桩被打进土里。

fitified.t: 被整理得合适的；装扮过的

e.en: The shabby room looked oddly {fitified} for the guests.
e.zh: 那间破旧房间为迎接客人被收拾得有些刻意。

e.en: He appeared {fitified} in a borrowed coat.
e.zh: 他穿着借来的外套，看起来像是特意装扮过。

e.en: The manuscript opens with a long {fitt}.
e.zh: 这份手稿开头是一段很长的诗节。

e.en: Each {fitt} tells a different part of the legend.
e.zh: 每个歌谣段落讲述传说的不同部分。

e.en: The lawyer called the evidence a {fitup}.
e.zh: 律师称这些证据是一场诬陷。

e.en: The theater used a simple {fitup} for the scene.
e.zh: 剧院为这一幕用了简单的临时装配。

e.en: We play {five-a-side} after work on Tuesdays.
e.zh: 我们每周二下班后踢五人制足球。

e.en: The school organized a {five-a-side} tournament.
e.zh: 学校组织了一场五人制足球锦标赛。

e.en: She bought thread at the old {five-and-dime}.
e.zh: 她在那家老式廉价杂货店买了线。

e.en: The novel begins inside a small-town {five-and-dime}.
e.zh: 小说开篇发生在小镇的一家小商品店里。

e.en: She bought thread at the old {five-and-ten}.
e.zh: 她在那家老廉价杂货店买了线。

e.en: The town's {five-and-ten} closed years ago.
e.zh: 镇上的廉价杂货店多年前就关门了。

e.en: The tiles form a {five-by-five} square.
e.zh: 这些瓷砖拼成一个五乘五的正方形。

e.en: I hear you {five-by-five} on the radio.
e.zh: 我在无线电里听得很清楚。

e.en: The glove has a {five-finger} design.
e.zh: 这只手套采用五指分开的设计。
