e.zh: 他把现代艺术看得一文不值，让策展人很恼火。

e.en: The essay mocked the committee's {floccinaucinihilipilification} of public opinion.
e.zh: 那篇文章嘲讽委员会对民意的轻视。

e.en: The leaf had a {floccose} white surface.
e.zh: 这片叶子的表面覆着白色绒毛。

e.en: A {floccose} coating formed on the old cheese.
e.zh: 旧奶酪上形成了一层絮状覆盖物。

e.en: The report used {flocculaation} where it meant flocculation.
e.zh: 报告里把絮凝作用误写成了 flocculaation。

e.en: She corrected {flocculaation} in the chemistry notes.
e.zh: 她改正了化学笔记中的 flocculaation 这个误拼写。

e.en: The technician added a {flocculant} to clear the water.
e.zh: 技术员加入絮凝剂来澄清水。

e.en: A {flocculant} polymer helped the particles settle.
e.zh: 一种促絮凝的聚合物帮助颗粒沉降。

e.en: Different {flocculants} work best at different pH levels.
e.zh: 不同絮凝剂在不同酸碱度下效果最好。

e.en: The plant tested several {flocculants} for wastewater treatment.
e.zh: 工厂测试了几种用于废水处理的絮凝剂。

e.en: The scan showed damage near the {floccular} region of the cerebellum.
e.zh: 扫描显示小脑小叶区域附近有损伤。

e.en: The sample contained {floccular} masses suspended in the liquid.
e.zh: 样品中有絮状团块悬浮在液体里。

e.en: The clay particles began to {flocculate} in salty water.
e.zh: 黏土颗粒在盐水中开始聚成絮状。

e.en: Engineers {flocculate} the waste before filtering it.
e.zh: 工程师在过滤前先让废料絮凝。

e.en: The {flocculated} solids settled at the bottom of the tank.
e.zh: 已絮凝的固体沉到了水箱底部。

e.en: The chemist examined the {flocculated} suspension under a microscope.
e.zh: 化学家在显微镜下检查聚成絮状的悬浮液。

e.en: The solution {flocculates} when the salt concentration rises.
e.zh: 盐浓度升高时，溶液会发生絮凝。

e.en: This additive {flocculates} fine particles very quickly.
e.zh: 这种添加剂能很快使细小颗粒聚成絮状。

e.en: The {flocculating} mixture became cloudy within minutes.
e.zh: 正在絮凝的混合物几分钟内就变浑浊了。

e.en: They chose a {flocculating} agent for the wastewater trial.
e.zh: 他们为废水试验选择了一种促絮凝剂。

e.en: {Flocculation} makes tiny particles clump together in water.
e.zh: 絮凝作用会使水中的微小颗粒结成团。

e.en: Poor {flocculation} left the beer hazy.
e.zh: 絮凝不佳使啤酒显得浑浊。

e.en: A small {floccule} drifted through the cloudy sample.
e.zh: 一个小絮团在浑浊样品中漂动。

e.en: Each {floccule} trapped fine sediment as it sank.
e.zh: 每个絮状颗粒下沉时都裹住了细小沉积物。

e.en: The {flocculence} of the mold was visible on the fruit.
e.zh: 水果上能看出霉菌的绒毛状形态。

e.en: Researchers measured the {flocculence} of the treated sludge.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了处理后污泥的絮状程度。

e.en: A {flocculent} cloud of sediment rose from the riverbed.
e.zh: 一团絮状沉积物从河床上升起。

e.en: The fungus formed a {flocculent} growth on the culture plate.
e.zh: 真菌在培养皿上形成了绒毛般的生长层。

e.en: Tiny {flocculi} appeared after the chemical was added.
e.zh: 加入化学品后出现了细小絮团。

e.en: The neurologist compared the two cerebellar {flocculi} on the scan.
e.zh: 神经科医生比较了扫描图上的两个小脑小叶。

e.en: The {flocculonodular} lobe helps control balance and eye movement.
e.zh: 小脑绒球小结叶有助于控制平衡和眼动。

e.en: Damage to the {flocculonodular} area can cause dizziness.
e.zh: 绒球小结叶区域受损可能会导致眩晕。

e.en: The microscope revealed a single {flocculus} in the liquid.
e.zh: 显微镜显示液体中有一个小絮团。

e.en: The {flocculus} is part of the cerebellum.
e.zh: 小脑绒球是小脑的一部分。

e.en: A loose {floccus} of wool clung to his sleeve.
e.zh: 一小团松散的羊毛絮粘在他的袖子上。

e.en: The biologist noted each {floccus} in the water sample.
e.zh: 生物学家记录了水样中的每个絮团。

e.en: The hallway was covered with faded {flock-paper}.
e.zh: 走廊贴着已经褪色的植绒壁纸。

e.en: She chose {flock-paper} for its soft raised pattern.
e.zh: 她选择绒面纸，因为它有柔软的凸起花纹。

e.en: The servant slept on a narrow {flockbed} near the kitchen.
e.zh: 仆人睡在厨房旁一张窄窄的填絮床垫上。

e.en: An old {flockbed} sagged in the corner of the room.
e.zh: 房间角落里有一张塌陷的旧式软床。

e.en: The {flockmaster} counted the sheep before dusk.
e.zh: 羊群主人在黄昏前清点了羊只。

e.en: A skilled {flockmaster} knows when to move the animals.
e.zh: 熟练的牧羊管理者知道何时转移牲畜。

e.en: The old blanket had a {flocky} surface.
e.zh: 那条旧毯子表面像绒毛一样。

e.en: A {flocky} residue floated on the mixture.
e.zh: 混合物上漂着一层絮状残渣。

e.en: A white {flokati} covered the wooden floor.
e.zh: 一张白色希腊长毛羊毛地毯铺在木地板上。

e.en: She shook the {flokati} outside to remove dust.
e.zh: 她把那张长毛羊毛地毯拿到外面抖掉灰尘。

e.en: Please wipe your shoes on the {floormat}.
e.zh: 请在门垫上擦擦鞋。

e.en: The old {floormat} was full of mud.
e.zh: 那块旧地垫沾满了泥。

e.en: The club offered a lively {floorshow} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后，俱乐部安排了一场热闹的歌舞表演。

e.en: Tourists stayed late to watch the {floorshow}.
e.zh: 游客们待到很晚，只为观看那场现场表演。

e.en: The {floorwalker} directed shoppers to the shoe department.
e.zh: 商场巡视员把顾客引到鞋类区。

e.en: A stern {floorwalker} watched the sales staff closely.
e.zh: 一位严厉的领班密切看着销售人员。

e.en: The lamp tilted {floorward} after the table shook.
e.zh: 桌子一晃，台灯就朝地面倾斜。

e.en: His tired gaze drifted {floorward} during the lecture.
e.zh: 讲座中，他疲惫的目光慢慢垂向地面。

e.en: The insult {floosy} sounds old-fashioned and harsh.
e.zh: floosy这个骂人的词听起来老派又刺耳。

e.en: She hated being dismissed as a {floosy}.
e.zh: 她讨厌别人把她贬称为轻佻女子。

e.en: The gossip column called her a {floozie}.
e.zh: 八卦专栏把她称作轻佻女子。

e.en: He regretted using the word {floozie} in anger.
e.zh: 他后悔一时气愤用了“荡妇”这个词。

e.en: He spent the night in a cheap {flop-house}.
e.zh: 他在一家廉价住宿所过了一夜。

e.en: The old {flop-house} smelled of smoke and damp clothes.
e.zh: 那家旧简陋旅店有烟味和潮衣服的味道。

e.en: The heavy curtain made a sudden {flopover} onto the chair.
e.zh: 厚窗帘突然垂倒在椅子上。

e.en: A {flopover} of papers covered the desk edge.
e.zh: 一叠纸翻落下来，盖住了桌边。

e.en: She chose the {floppiest} sunhat on the rack.
e.zh: 她选了架子上最松软的遮阳帽。

e.en: The {floppiest} seedlings needed support sticks.
e.zh: 那些最无力下垂的幼苗需要支撑杆。

e.en: The sleeves hung {floppily} over his hands.
e.zh: 袖子松垮地垂到他的手上。

e.en: The dog’s ears bounced {floppily} as it ran.
e.zh: 那只狗奔跑时耳朵软软地晃动。

e.en: The {floppiness} of the hat made it hard to pack.
e.zh: 这顶帽子的松软让它很难打包。

e.en: The doctor checked the baby's unusual {floppiness}.
e.zh: 医生检查了婴儿异常的松软无力。

e.en: A layer of {flor} protects the aging sherry.
e.zh: 一层酒花酵母膜保护着陈年的雪利酒。

e.en: Winemakers monitor the {flor} during fermentation.
e.zh: 酿酒师会在发酵期间监测这层酵母膜。

e.en: The old school motto began with {floreat}.
e.zh: 那所老学校的校训以“愿其兴盛”开头。

e.en: Supporters shouted {floreat} at the college ceremony.
e.zh: 支持者们在学院典礼上高喊“万岁”。

e.en: The artist planned to {floriate} the border of the manuscript.
e.zh: 艺术家打算用花纹装饰手稿边框。

e.en: They {floriate} the ceiling with painted vines.
e.zh: 他们用彩绘藤蔓花纹装饰天花板。

e.en: The church has a {floriated} stone doorway.
e.zh: 那座教堂有一扇饰有花纹的石门。

e.en: She admired the {floriated} letters in the old book.
e.zh: 她欣赏那本旧书里带花饰的字母。

e.en: The vase shows delicate {floriation} around its rim.
e.zh: 花瓶边缘有精致的花纹装饰。

e.en: Medieval scribes often added {floriation} to capital letters.
e.zh: 中世纪抄写员常给大写字母加上花饰。

e.en: The shrub's {floribundine} made it popular in gardens.
e.zh: 这种灌木开花繁茂的特性使它在花园里很受欢迎。

e.en: Botanists noted the plant's unusual {floribundine}.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物异常繁花的特性。

e.en: The rare {florican} lives in tall grassland.
e.zh: 这种稀有的花鸨生活在高草地里。

e.en: Conservationists tracked a male {florican} before dawn.
e.zh: 保护人员在黎明前追踪一只雄性花鸨。

e.en: The town hosts a major {floricultural} exhibition each spring.
e.zh: 这座小镇每年春天举办大型花卉栽培展。

e.en: She studied {floricultural} techniques at the agricultural college.
e.zh: 她在农业学院学习花卉栽培技术。

e.en: The valley's economy depends heavily on {floriculture}.
e.zh: 这个山谷的经济很依赖花卉栽培业。

e.en: She studied {floriculture} before opening a greenhouse.
e.zh: 她在开温室前学过花卉栽培。

e.en: The {floriculturist} selected roses for the cool climate.
e.zh: 花卉栽培师为寒凉气候挑选了玫瑰。

e.en: A skilled {floriculturist} can improve bloom quality.
e.zh: 熟练的花卉栽培师能提高开花质量。

e.en: Critics disliked the {floridiness} of his prose.
e.zh: 评论家不喜欢他散文的华丽繁复。

e.en: The doctor noticed the unusual {floridiness} of her cheeks.
e.zh: 医生注意到她脸颊异常红润。

e.en: The speech lost force through its excessive {floridity}.
e.zh: 这篇演讲因过分华丽浮夸而失去力量。

e.en: The sudden {floridity} of his face worried us.
e.zh: 他脸上突然泛红让我们很担心。

e.en: This {floriferous} shrub brightens the garden all summer.
e.zh: 这种开花繁多的灌木让花园整个夏天都很亮丽。

e.en: Gardeners prize {floriferous} varieties for long displays.
e.zh: 园艺爱好者珍视花多且花期长的品种。

e.en: Scientists linked {florigen} to the timing of flowering.
e.zh: 科学家把成花素与开花时间联系起来。

e.en: The plant produces {florigen} after longer nights.
e.zh: 这种植物在夜晚变长后会产生成花素。

e.en: The team studied a {florigenic} signal in rice.
e.zh: 团队研究了水稻中的促成花信号。

e.en: Cool temperatures may trigger {florigenic} changes.
e.zh: 低温可能引发促成花的变化。

e.en: The monastery kept a medieval {florilegium} of sermons.
e.zh: 修道院保存着一部中世纪讲道文选。

e.en: Her book resembles a botanical {florilegium}.
e.zh: 她的书像一本植物花卉图集。

e.en: The islands are {floristically} distinct from the mainland.
e.zh: 从植物区系看，这些岛屿不同于大陆。

e.en: Researchers compared the valleys {floristically} and geologically.
e.zh: 研究人员从植物区系和地质方面比较这些山谷。

e.en: She learned {floristry} at a local college.
e.zh: 她在当地学院学习花艺。

e.en: Modern {floristry} uses both fresh and dried materials.
e.zh: 现代花艺会使用鲜花和干燥材料。

e.en: The painter's {floruit} is usually dated to 1620.
e.zh: 这位画家的创作盛期通常被定在1620年前后。

e.en: Little is known beyond the poet's approximate {floruit}.
e.zh: 除了这位诗人大致的在世期外，人们所知甚少。

e.en: The botanist published a {florule} of the alpine meadow.
e.zh: 这位植物学家出版了一本高山草甸小植物志。

e.en: A local {florule} can guide conservation work.
e.zh: 地方小植物志可以指导保护工作。

e.en: The shield bore a cross {flory} in gold.
e.zh: 盾牌上有一枚金色花形十字。

e.en: Heralds described the old emblem as {flory}.
e.zh: 纹章官把这个旧徽记描述为饰有花形。

e.en: The microscope revealed a {floscular} structure on the head.
e.zh: 显微镜显示其头部有小花状结构。

e.en: Botanists noted the plant's {floscular} parts.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物的小花部位。

e.en: Each tiny {floscule} forms part of the flower head.
e.zh: 每一朵小花都是这个头状花序的一部分。

e.en: He drew a single {floscule} under magnification.
e.zh: 他在放大观察下画出了一朵小花。

e.en: The daisy has a {flosculous} center.
e.zh: 雏菊有一个由小花组成的中心。

e.en: A {flosculous} head may contain many minute blooms.
e.zh: 一个由小花组成的花头可能包含许多微小花朵。

e.en: The factory adopted {flospinning} for synthetic fibers.
e.zh: 工厂采用丝束纺丝法生产合成纤维。

e.en: Older manuals describe {flospinning} in textile production.
e.zh: 旧手册描述了纺织生产中的丝束纺丝法。

e.en: Blue {flossflower} filled the border beside the path.
e.zh: 小路旁的花境种满了蓝色藿香蓟。

e.en: Gardeners grow {flossflower} for its soft clustered blooms.
e.zh: 园丁种藿香蓟是为了欣赏它柔软成簇的花。

e.en: The seeds drifted {flossily} through the air.
e.zh: 种子像绒毛般在空中飘动。

e.en: She dressed {flossily} for the evening party.
e.zh: 她为晚会打扮得很浮华。

e.en: The plant released {flossy} seeds in late summer.
e.zh: 这种植物在夏末释放出绒毛似的种子。

e.en: He wore a {flossy} suit to impress clients.
e.zh: 他穿了一套浮华的西装来给客户留下印象。

e.en: After the storm, {flotage} covered the riverbank.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，河岸上满是漂浮物。

e.en: The engineer calculated the raft's {flotage}.
e.zh: 工程师计算了木筏的浮力。

e.en: Several {flotels} opened near the busy harbor.
e.zh: 几家浮动旅馆在繁忙港口附近开业。

e.en: Workers stayed on {flotels} during the offshore project.
e.zh: 海上项目期间，工人住在浮动旅馆上。

flotsan.t: 漂流物；海上漂货；遗失货物

e.en: The old law treated {flotsan} differently from goods deliberately abandoned.
e.zh: 旧法律对漂流物的处理不同于故意丢弃的货物。

e.en: After the storm, fishermen found {flotsan} scattered along the shore.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，渔民发现岸边散落着海上漂货。

flouncy.t: 荷叶边很多的；浮夸轻佻的

e.en: She wore a {flouncy} skirt to the summer party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条荷叶边很多的裙子去夏日派对。

e.en: His {flouncy} manner made the simple announcement seem theatrical.
e.zh: 他浮夸的样子让这则简单通知显得像在演戏。

e.en: The engineer checked the {flourometer} before opening the valve.
e.zh: 工程师在打开阀门前检查了流量计。

e.en: A faulty {flourometer} can give misleading readings in the test rig.
e.zh: 有故障的测流仪会让测试装置给出误导性的读数。

e.en: The manager drew a {flow-chart} to explain the approval process.
e.zh: 经理画了一张流程图来说明审批流程。

e.en: A clear {flow-chart} can make a complicated decision easier to follow.
e.zh: 清晰的流程图能让复杂的决策更容易理解。

e.en: Higher fuel prices had a {flow-on} effect on food costs.
e.zh: 燃油价格上涨对食品成本产生了连带影响。

e.en: The strike caused {flow-on} delays across the whole rail network.
e.zh: 罢工导致整个铁路网络出现后续延误。

e.en: The dye revealed the {flow-pattern} around the wing.
e.zh: 染料显示出了机翼周围的流动模式。

e.en: Doctors studied the blood {flow-pattern} inside the narrowed artery.
e.zh: 医生研究了狭窄动脉内的血流模式。

e.en: The mixture must stay {flowable} until it reaches the mold.
e.zh: 混合物在到达模具前必须保持可流动。

e.en: Warm syrup is more {flowable} than cold syrup.
e.zh: 温热的糖浆比冷糖浆更容易流淌。

e.en: The permit controlled the {flowage} of water through the canal.
e.zh: 许可证限制了水通过运河的流动。

e.en: Seasonal {flowage} damaged several low fields near the river.
e.zh: 季节性泛滥淹没损坏了河边几块低洼田地。

e.en: A blue {flower-de-luce} grew beside the garden wall.
e.zh: 一株蓝色鸢尾花长在花园墙边。

e.en: The shield was decorated with a golden {flower-de-luce}.
e.zh: 盾牌上装饰着一个金色的百合花饰。

e.en: Her {flower-garden} is full of roses in June.
e.zh: 她的花园在六月开满玫瑰。

e.en: The children helped water the school {flower-garden}.
e.zh: 孩子们帮忙给学校花圃浇水。

e.en: Cut off each dead {flower-head} to encourage new blooms.
e.zh: 剪掉每个枯萎的花头，可以促使新花开放。

e.en: The sunflower's {flower-head} turned slowly toward the light.
e.zh: 向日葵的头状花序慢慢转向光线。

e.en: The {flower-of-an-hour} opened after breakfast and faded by noon.
e.zh: 一时花早餐后开放，到中午就凋谢了。

e.en: Botanists recorded {flower-of-an-hour} among the annuals in the field.
e.zh: 植物学家在田野里的一年生植物中记录到短命花。

e.en: The orchard's {flowerage} was unusually early this spring.
e.zh: 这个果园今年春天开花异常早。

e.en: The manuscript border was rich with painted {flowerage}.
e.zh: 手稿边框上绘有繁复的花饰。

e.en: Each tiny {floweret} formed part of the larger cluster.
e.zh: 每一朵小花都是这个较大花簇的一部分。

e.en: She pressed a single {floweret} between the pages of her diary.
e.zh: 她把一朵小花夹在日记本的书页之间。

e.en: The garden's {floweriness} surprised visitors in early May.
e.zh: 五月初，花园里繁花似锦让游客很惊喜。

e.en: The editor cut the {floweriness} from the speech.
e.zh: 编辑删去了演讲中辞藻过于华丽的部分。

e.en: The lamp had a {flowerlike} shade made of thin glass.
e.zh: 这盏灯有一个薄玻璃制成的花状灯罩。

e.en: Her {flowerlike} smile softened the tense conversation.
e.zh: 她如花般的微笑缓和了紧张的谈话。

e.en: The technician replaced the broken {flowmetre} in the pipeline.
e.zh: 技术员更换了管道中坏掉的流量计。

e.en: Read the {flowmetre} every hour during the experiment.
e.zh: 实验期间每小时读取一次测流表。

e.en: The pump's {flowrate} dropped when the filter became blocked.
e.zh: 过滤器堵塞后，泵的流量下降了。

e.en: Nurses adjusted the drip {flowrate} according to the doctor's order.
e.zh: 护士按照医嘱调整了输液流速。

e.en: A sheet of {flowstone} covered the cave wall.
e.zh: 一层流石覆盖着洞穴的墙壁。

e.en: The guide warned us not to touch the fragile {flowstone}.
e.zh: 导游提醒我们不要触摸脆弱的洞穴钙华。

e.en: The report was full of {flubdub} instead of clear evidence.
e.zh: 这份报告满是废话，没有清楚证据。

e.en: Voters grew tired of the candidate's cheerful {flubdub}.
e.zh: 选民厌倦了那位候选人听起来轻快却空洞的浮夸空谈。

e.en: He {flubdubbed} through the interview without answering the question.
e.zh: 他在采访中一路说空话，没有回答问题。

e.en: The salesman {flubdubbed} about innovation but offered no details.
e.zh: 销售员大谈创新的空话，却没有给出任何细节。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {flucloxacillin} for the skin infection.
e.zh: 医生开了氟氯西林来治疗皮肤感染。

e.en: She took {flucloxacillin} four times a day.
e.zh: 她每天服用四次氟氯西林。

e.en: The market remained {fluctuant} throughout the week.
e.zh: 整个星期市场都处于波动状态。

e.en: The swelling felt soft and {fluctuant} under pressure.
e.zh: 按压时肿块感觉柔软，并有液波感。

e.en: He takes {fludrocortisone} to help control low blood pressure.
e.zh: 他服用氟氢可的松来帮助控制低血压。

e.en: The dose of {fludrocortisone} was adjusted after the test.
e.zh: 检查后，氟氢可的松的剂量被调整了。

e.en: The company buys {flue-cured} tobacco from local farms.
e.zh: 这家公司从当地农场购买热风管烘烤烟叶。

e.en: {Flue-cured} leaves often have a bright golden color.
e.zh: 经过热风管烘烤的叶子常呈明亮的金黄色。

e.en: He played a warm solo on the {fluegelhorn}.
e.zh: 他用富鲁格号吹奏了一段温暖的独奏。

e.en: The band added a {fluegelhorn} for a softer brass sound.
e.zh: 乐队加入了一支富鲁格号，以获得更柔和的铜管音色。

e.en: I felt tired and {fluey} all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午我都觉得疲倦，像是得了流感。

e.en: She stayed home with a {fluey} cough.
e.zh: 她因带有流感症状的咳嗽待在家里。

e.en: Don't be such a {fluffhead} about the instructions.
e.zh: 别在这些说明上这么糊涂。

e.en: The novel treats him as a charming {fluffhead}.
e.zh: 小说把他写成一个讨人喜欢却轻浮的人。

e.en: The kitten's fur stood {fluffily} around its face.
e.zh: 小猫脸周围的毛蓬松地立着。

e.en: He answered {fluffily} without giving any figures.
e.zh: 他回答得很空泛，没有给出任何数字。

e.en: The cake's {fluffiness} depends on beating the eggs well.
e.zh: 蛋糕的蓬松感取决于鸡蛋是否打发充分。

e.en: Editors cut the {fluffiness} from the report.
e.zh: 编辑删去了报告中空泛的内容。

e.en: The jazz player switched to {flugelhorn} for the ballad.
e.zh: 那位爵士乐手在演奏抒情曲时换成了富鲁格号。

e.en: A {flugelhorn} sounds mellower than a trumpet.
e.zh: 富鲁格号的声音比小号更柔和。

e.en: Two {flugelhorns} carried the melody in the arrangement.
e.zh: 编曲中两支富鲁格号承担了主旋律。

e.en: The shop repairs trumpets, cornets, and {flugelhorns}.
e.zh: 这家店修理小号、短号和富鲁格号。

e.en: The lava cooled into a {fluidal} pattern.
e.zh: 熔岩冷却后形成了流纹状图案。

e.en: Her paintings have a {fluidal} sense of movement.
e.zh: 她的画有一种流动般的动感。

e.en: The minerals were arranged {fluidally} in the rock.
e.zh: 矿物在岩石中呈流纹状排列。

e.en: The colors spread {fluidally} across the wet paper.
e.zh: 颜色在湿纸上像流体一样扩散开来。

e.en: The pharmacist measured the herbal {fluidextract} carefully.
e.zh: 药剂师仔细量取草药流浸膏。

e.en: This {fluidextract} must be diluted before use.
e.zh: 这种液体提取物使用前必须稀释。

e.en: The lab built a tiny {fluidic} sensor.
e.zh: 实验室制造了一个微型流控传感器。

e.en: The device uses {fluidic} pressure instead of electronics.
e.zh: 这个装置使用流体压力，而不是电子元件。

e.en: She studies {fluidics} for medical testing devices.
e.zh: 她研究用于医学检测设备的流控技术。

e.en: Early computers sometimes used {fluidics} instead of circuits.
e.zh: 早期计算机有时用流体学原理代替电路。

e.en: Heat can {fluidify} the thick mixture.
e.zh: 加热可以使这种黏稠混合物变成流体。

e.en: Engineers tried to {fluidify} the powder with air.
e.zh: 工程师试图用空气使粉末流态化。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {fluidimeter} before the test.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前校准了流体计。

e.en: A {fluidimeter} recorded the liquid's changing flow rate.
e.zh: 液体测量仪记录了液体不断变化的流速。

e.en: The process can {fluidise} fine particles with air.
e.zh: 这个过程可以用空气使细小颗粒流态化。

e.en: They {fluidise} the bed before adding the catalyst.
e.zh: 他们在加入催化剂前先使床层流态化。

e.en: {Fluidization} improves contact between gas and solids.
e.zh: 流态化能改善气体与固体之间的接触。

e.en: The reactor depends on stable {fluidization}.
e.zh: 这个反应器依赖稳定的流态化过程。

fluoglass.t: 氟光玻璃；荧光玻璃材料

e.en: The instrument used {fluoglass} to improve light transmission.
e.zh: 这台仪器使用氟光玻璃来提高透光效果。

e.en: Researchers tested the {fluoglass} under intense ultraviolet light.
e.zh: 研究人员在强紫外线下测试了这种荧光玻璃材料。

e.en: The {fluonomist} advised the town on water treatment.
e.zh: 这位氟化物专家为该镇的水处理提供建议。

e.en: A careful {fluonomist} measured fluoride levels in each sample.
e.zh: 一位细心的氟化物专家测量了每个样本中的氟含量。

e.en: The dye contains a {fluophor} that glows blue.
e.zh: 这种染料含有一个会发蓝光的荧光团。

e.en: Chemists attached a {fluophor} to track the protein.
e.zh: 化学家接上一个发光基团来追踪这种蛋白质。

e.en: The compound releases {fluor} during the reaction.
e.zh: 该化合物在反应过程中释放出氟。

e.en: Old chemistry texts sometimes call fluorine {fluor}.
e.zh: 旧化学书有时把氟称作fluor。

e.en: The collection included a pale specimen of {fluor-adelite}.
e.zh: 这批藏品中有一块颜色很浅的氟砷钙矿标本。

e.en: Geologists identified {fluor-adelite} in the altered rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在蚀变岩中鉴定出氟砷钙矿。

e.en: The lab synthesized {fluorandiol} for a materials study.
e.zh: 实验室为一项材料研究合成了氟二醇类化合物。

e.en: Small amounts of {fluorandiol} changed the polymer's behavior.
e.zh: 少量氟二醇改变了这种聚合物的性能。

e.en: The surface was {fluorated} to resist oil stains.
e.zh: 这个表面经过氟处理，以抵抗油污。

e.en: They compared ordinary plastic with {fluorated} plastic.
e.zh: 他们把普通塑料和含氟塑料进行了比较。

e.en: The sample turned yellow because it contained {fluorenone}.
e.zh: 样品因含有芴酮而变成黄色。

e.en: Students purified {fluorenone} in the organic chemistry lab.
e.zh: 学生们在有机化学实验室中提纯芴酮。

e.en: The {fluorer} checked the equipment before the coating process.
e.zh: 施氟者在涂层处理前检查了设备。

e.en: A skilled {fluorer} can control the reaction temperature precisely.
e.zh: 熟练的氟化处理者能精确控制反应温度。

e.en: The doctor used {fluorescin} to examine the eye.
e.zh: 医生使用荧光素来检查眼睛。

e.en: A drop of {fluorescin} made the liquid glow green.
e.zh: 一滴荧光素让液体发出绿色荧光。

e.en: The technician looked through the {fluorescope} for defects.
e.zh: 技术员通过荧光检查镜寻找缺陷。

e.en: An early {fluorescope} made hidden structures visible.
e.zh: 早期荧光镜能让隐藏结构显现出来。

e.en: The surgeon used {fluorescopy} during the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术过程中使用了荧光透视检查。

e.en: Modern {fluorescopy} can guide a catheter in real time.
e.zh: 现代透视检查可以实时引导导管。

e.en: The analyst added {fluorexone} to detect calcium ions.
e.zh: 分析员加入荧光络合剂来检测钙离子。

e.en: Under the lamp, {fluorexone} showed a clear color change.
e.zh: 在灯下，氟雷克酮显示出明显的颜色变化。

e.en: The chemist noted a strong {fluoric} odor near the vessel.
e.zh: 化学家注意到容器附近有强烈的含氟气味。

e.en: Older books describe hydrofluoric acid as {fluoric} acid.
e.zh: 旧书中把氢氟酸称为氟酸。

e.en: The test measured {fluorid} in the drinking water.
e.zh: 这项测试测量饮用水中的氟化物含量。

e.en: Excess {fluorid} can damage developing teeth.
e.zh: 过量氟化物可能损害发育中的牙齿。

e.en: The city voted to {fluoridate} its water supply.
e.zh: 该市投票决定给供水系统加氟。

e.en: Officials planned to {fluoridate} the wells gradually.
e.zh: 官员计划逐步给这些水井加氟。

e.en: The plant {fluoridates} water before distribution.
e.zh: 这家水厂在供水前给水加氟。

e.en: She studies how each district {fluoridates} its supply.
e.zh: 她研究各区如何给供水系统加氟。

e.en: The council debated {fluoridating} the local water supply.
e.zh: 委员会讨论是否给当地供水系统加氟。

e.en: Engineers monitored the pumps while {fluoridating} the reservoir.
e.zh: 工程师在给水库加氟时监控水泵。

e.en: The {fluoridationist} argued that children would benefit.
e.zh: 这位加氟支持者认为儿童会从中受益。

e.en: A cautious {fluoridationist} still asked for better monitoring.
e.zh: 一位谨慎的加氟支持者仍要求加强监测。

e.en: Public meetings discussed {fluoridisation} of the water supply.
e.zh: 公众会议讨论了供水加氟的问题。

e.en: The report compared {fluoridisation} policies across several towns.
e.zh: 报告比较了几个城镇的加氟政策。

e.en: Some councils chose to {fluoridise} drinking water.
e.zh: 一些地方议会选择给饮用水加氟。

e.en: They refused to {fluoridise} the rural wells.
e.zh: 他们拒绝给乡村水井加氟。

e.en: The policy introduced {fluoridization} in several cities.
e.zh: 该政策在几个城市推行了加氟处理。

e.en: Critics questioned the cost of water {fluoridization}.
e.zh: 批评者质疑供水加氟的成本。

e.en: The authority decided to {fluoridize} the public water system.
e.zh: 主管部门决定给公共供水系统加氟。

e.en: They may {fluoridize} the supply after more testing.
e.zh: 经过更多检测后，他们可能会给供水加氟。

e.en: The town has used {fluoridized} water for decades.
e.zh: 这个镇几十年来一直使用加氟水。

e.en: Dentists compared children from fluoridized and non-{fluoridized} areas.
e.zh: 牙医比较了来自加氟地区和非加氟地区的儿童。

e.en: The {fluoridizer} keeps the mineral level steady.
e.zh: 加氟装置能保持矿物质含量稳定。

e.en: A trained {fluoridizer} adjusted the dose each morning.
e.zh: 一名受过训练的加氟人员每天早晨调整剂量。

e.en: Engineers {fluidize} the powder with a stream of hot air.
e.zh: 工程师用一股热空气使粉末流态化。

e.en: The process can {fluidize} solid particles inside the reactor.
e.zh: 这个过程能让反应器里的固体颗粒呈流体状。

e.en: The {fluidizing} gas keeps the particles in motion.
e.zh: 流态化气体使颗粒保持运动。

e.en: They adjusted the {fluidizing} pressure before starting production.
e.zh: 他们在投产前调节了使物料流态化的压力。

e.en: Early control systems sometimes used {fluidonics} instead of electronics.
e.zh: 早期控制系统有时用流体逻辑技术代替电子技术。

e.en: The museum displayed a small {fluidonics} device from the 1960s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件二十世纪六十年代的小型流体逻辑装置。

e.en: Add one {fluidounce} of syrup to the mixture.
e.zh: 往混合物里加入一流体盎司糖浆。

e.en: The bottle holds eight {fluidounces} of medicine.
e.zh: 这个瓶子能装八流体盎司药液。

e.en: The old pump used a {fluidram} to lift water uphill.
e.zh: 那台旧泵用水力撞锤把水送上坡。

e.en: A {fluidram} can work without an external motor.
e.zh: 液压冲锤可以不用外部电机运转。

e.en: The pharmacist measured each dose in {fluigrams}.
e.zh: 药剂师按流体克计量每一剂药。

e.en: One {fluigram} was enough for the laboratory test.
e.zh: 一流体克就足够做这项实验室测试。

e.en: Their {flukey} goal came in the final minute.
e.zh: 他们那个侥幸进球出现在最后一分钟。

e.en: It was a {flukey} win, but the team celebrated anyway.
e.zh: 那是一场靠运气的胜利，但球队还是庆祝了。

e.en: The veterinarian prescribed a {flukicide} for the infected sheep.
e.zh: 兽医给感染的羊开了杀吸虫剂。

e.en: Farmers must use {flukicide} carefully to avoid resistance.
e.zh: 农民必须谨慎使用杀吸虫剂，以免产生抗药性。

e.en: The ancient text described a sacred {flumen} beyond the hills.
e.zh: 古文献描述了山丘之外的一条神圣河流。

e.en: Geographers used {flumen} as a technical term for a stream.
e.zh: 地理学者把flumen作为表示溪流的术语。

e.en: The doctor mentioned {flumethiazide} as an older diuretic.
e.zh: 医生提到氟甲噻嗪是一种较老的利尿药。

e.en: Patients should take {flumethiazide} only under medical supervision.
e.zh: 患者只能在医生指导下服用氟甲噻嗪。

e.en: The speech was full of patriotic {flummery}.
e.zh: 那篇演讲充满了爱国主义空话。

e.en: Grandmother served cold {flummery} with cream.
e.zh: 祖母端上了配奶油的冷甜麦粥布丁。

e.en: She let the backpack {flump} onto the floor.
e.zh: 她让背包扑通一声落到地板上。

e.en: After work, he would {flump} into the nearest chair.
e.zh: 下班后，他总会重重坐进最近的椅子里。

e.en: He {flumped} down on the sofa after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他扑通一声坐到沙发上。

e.en: The wet towel {flumped} onto the bathroom floor.
e.zh: 湿毛巾重重掉在浴室地板上。

e.en: The children were {flumping} onto the beanbags one by one.
e.zh: 孩子们一个接一个扑通坐到豆袋椅上。

e.en: I heard boxes {flumping} in the hallway.
e.zh: 我听见箱子在走廊里咚咚落下。

e.en: She {flumps} into bed without taking off her shoes.
e.zh: 她鞋都没脱就重重倒在床上。

e.en: The sack {flumps} against the wall when he drops it.
e.zh: 他一松手，袋子就扑通撞到墙边。

e.en: The minister arrived with several obedient {flunkies}.
e.zh: 部长带着几个唯命是从的随从到了。

e.en: Critics called the advisers corporate {flunkies}.
e.zh: 批评者把那些顾问称作企业的马屁精。

flunky.t: 马屁精；卑躬屈膝的随从

e.en: He behaved like a {flunky} around powerful guests.
e.zh: 他在有权势的客人面前表现得像个马屁精。

e.en: The prince sent a {flunky} to carry the message.
e.zh: 王子派了一个随从去传话。

e.en: The satire mocked the whole culture of {flunkydom}.
e.zh: 这部讽刺作品嘲弄了整套奴颜婢膝的文化。

e.en: Around the tycoon grew a small world of {flunkydom}.
e.zh: 那个大亨身边形成了一个小小的随从圈子。

flunkyism.t: 奴颜婢膝作风；拍马习气

e.en: The essay attacked political {flunkyism} in sharp language.
e.zh: 那篇文章用尖锐语言抨击政治上的拍马习气。

e.en: Her promotion depended more on {flunkyism} than talent.
e.zh: 她的晋升更多靠奴颜婢膝，而不是才干。

e.en: The chemist used {fluobenzene} as a solvent in the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家在反应中把氟苯用作溶剂。

e.en: Pure {fluobenzene} must be handled in a ventilated hood.
e.zh: 纯氟苯必须在通风橱中操作。

e.en: The plating bath contained a copper {fluoborate} solution.
e.zh: 电镀槽里含有氟硼酸铜溶液。

e.en: Workers tested the {fluoborate} level before production began.
e.zh: 工人在生产开始前检测了氟硼酸盐含量。

e.en: The collection included a rare sample of {fluocerite}.
e.zh: 这批收藏品中有一块稀有的氟铈矿样本。

e.en: Miners identified {fluocerite} in the unusual ore deposit.
e.zh: 矿工在这个特殊矿床中鉴定出了氟铈矿。

e.en: The technician added {fluocin} to trace the leak.
e.zh: 技术员加入荧光素类染料来追踪泄漏。

e.en: Under blue light, {fluocin} made the sample glow.
e.zh: 在蓝光下，荧光素类染料让样本发光。

e.en: The lab used {fluodensitometry} to measure the stained proteins.
e.zh: 实验室用荧光密度测定法测量染色后的蛋白质。

e.en: Modern {fluodensitometry} can detect very small changes in intensity.
e.zh: 现代荧光密度测定法能检测到很小的强度变化。

e.en: The city {fluoridizes} its water to reduce tooth decay.
e.zh: 这座城市给自来水加氟，以减少蛀牙。

e.en: The dentist says the treatment {fluoridizes} weakened enamel.
e.zh: 牙医说这种处理会使受损牙釉质氟化。

e.en: Officials discussed {fluoridizing} the town's drinking water.
e.zh: 官员们讨论了给镇上的饮用水加氟。

e.en: The gel works by {fluoridizing} the surface of the teeth.
e.zh: 这种凝胶通过使牙齿表面氟化来起作用。

e.en: The lab used a {fluorimeter} to measure the sample.
e.zh: 实验室用荧光计测量了这个样品。

e.en: A portable {fluorimeter} checked fluoride levels in the water.
e.zh: 一台便携式氟量计检测了水中的氟含量。

fluorimetric.t: 荧光测定的；荧光计量的

e.en: The team chose a {fluorimetric} method for the assay.
e.zh: 团队为这项测定选择了荧光测定法。

e.en: A {fluorimetric} sensor detected the dye at low levels.
e.zh: 一个荧光计量传感器检测到了低浓度染料。

e.en: They used {fluorimetry} to quantify the protein.
e.zh: 他们用荧光测定法来定量这种蛋白质。

e.en: Modern {fluorimetry} can reveal tiny traces of contamination.
e.zh: 现代荧光分析能显示极微量的污染物。

e.en: Early chemists called the element {fluorin}.
e.zh: 早期化学家把这种元素称为氟。

e.en: The old textbook lists {fluorin} beside chlorine.
e.zh: 这本旧教材把氟列在氯的旁边。

e.en: Chemists can {fluorinate} the compound under mild conditions.
e.zh: 化学家可以在温和条件下使该化合物氟化。

e.en: The process will {fluorinate} only one part of the molecule.
e.zh: 这个过程只会在分子的一个部位引入氟原子。

e.en: The pan has a {fluorinated} coating that resists stains.
e.zh: 这口锅有一层耐污的含氟涂层。

e.en: Researchers tested several {fluorinated} drugs for stability.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了几种氟化药物的稳定性。

e.en: {Fluorination} changed the material's chemical behavior.
e.zh: 氟化作用改变了这种材料的化学性质。

e.en: Water {fluorination} remains debated in some communities.
e.zh: 在一些社区，自来水加氟仍有争议。

e.en: The detector responded to a free {fluorinion} in solution.
e.zh: 检测器对溶液中的游离氟离子有反应。

e.en: A stable {fluorinion} can affect the reaction pathway.
e.zh: 稳定的含氟阴离子会影响反应路径。

e.en: {Fluoroacetamide} is highly toxic and must be handled carefully.
e.zh: 氟乙酰胺毒性很强，必须小心处理。

e.en: The report found traces of {fluoroacetamide} in the bait.
e.zh: 报告在诱饵中发现了微量氟乙酰胺。

e.en: Sodium {fluoroacetate} is used as a poison in some regions.
e.zh: 一些地区把氟乙酸钠用作毒剂。

e.en: The plant naturally contains {fluoroacetate} in its leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物的叶子里天然含有氟乙酸盐。

e.en: A {fluoroalkane} may behave differently from a normal alkane.
e.zh: 氟代烷烃的性质可能不同于普通烷烃。

e.en: The solvent was classified as a {fluoroalkane}.
e.zh: 这种溶剂被归类为含氟烷烃。

e.en: The coating used {fluoroalkylpolysiloxane} to repel oil.
e.zh: 这种涂层使用氟烷基聚硅氧烷来防油。

e.en: Engineers selected {fluoroalkylpolysiloxane} for its heat resistance.
e.zh: 工程师因其耐热性而选用了氟烷基聚硅氧烷。

e.en: The synthesis began with {fluoroaniline} as a reagent.
e.zh: 这项合成以氟苯胺作为试剂开始。

e.en: Samples of {fluoroaniline} were stored in a sealed cabinet.
e.zh: 氟苯胺样品被存放在密封柜中。

e.en: {Fluorobenzene} has a fluorine atom attached to benzene.
e.zh: 氟苯是在苯环上连有一个氟原子。

e.en: The reaction produced {fluorobenzene} as the main product.
e.zh: 该反应生成的主要产物是氟苯。

e.en: The cylinder contained {fluorobutane} under pressure.
e.zh: 这个钢瓶中装有加压的氟丁烷。

e.en: Chemists compared {fluorobutane} with other halogenated butanes.
e.zh: 化学家把氟丁烷与其他卤代丁烷进行了比较。

e.en: The factory makes {fluorochemical} products for electronics.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产用于电子行业的含氟化学品。

e.en: Regulators reviewed the {fluorochemical} found in the river.
e.zh: 监管人员审查了河水中发现的含氟化学物质。

e.en: The antibody was tagged with a bright {fluorochrome}.
e.zh: 这种抗体被标记上明亮的荧光染料。

e.en: Each {fluorochrome} emits light at a different wavelength.
e.zh: 每种荧光色素都会发出不同波长的光。

e.en: They analyzed the gel by {fluorodensitometry}.
e.zh: 他们用荧光密度测定法分析了凝胶。

e.en: {Fluorodensitometry} gave a more sensitive reading than staining.
e.zh: 荧光密度测定法给出了比染色更灵敏的读数。

e.en: The seal is made from {fluoroelastomer} for chemical resistance.
e.zh: 这个密封件由氟橡胶制成，以提高耐化学性。

e.en: A {fluoroelastomer} gasket can withstand high temperatures.
e.zh: 氟橡胶垫片能承受高温。

e.en: {Fluoroethylene} is an important monomer in polymer chemistry.
e.zh: 氟乙烯是聚合物化学中的重要单体。

e.en: The study measured how {fluoroethylene} reacts under pressure.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了氟乙烯在压力下的反应方式。

e.en: {Fluoroform} is also known as trifluoromethane.
e.zh: 氟仿也称为三氟甲烷。

e.en: The gas mixture contained a small amount of {fluoroform}.
e.zh: 这种混合气体中含有少量氟仿。

fluoroformol.t: 氟福尔马林；含氟甲醛液

e.en: The tissue was preserved in {fluoroformol} for examination.
e.zh: 组织被保存在氟福尔马林中以供检查。

e.en: Older manuals mention {fluoroformol} as a laboratory fixative.
e.zh: 较旧的手册把氟福尔马林列为一种实验室固定液。

e.en: The technician examined the {fluorogram} for faint traces of dye.
e.zh: 技术员检查了这张荧光图，寻找微弱的染料痕迹。

e.en: A clear {fluorogram} helped confirm the position of the marker.
e.zh: 清晰的荧光照片帮助确认了标记物的位置。

e.en: The lab stored each {fluorograph} with the patient's scan records.
e.zh: 实验室把每张荧光照片都和患者的扫描记录一起保存。

e.en: A damaged {fluorograph} made the old experiment hard to interpret.
e.zh: 一张受损的荧光照相图让那项旧实验难以解读。

e.en: The hospital once used {fluorography} to screen many workers quickly.
e.zh: 医院过去曾用荧光摄影快速筛查大量工人。

e.en: In research, {fluorography} can reveal radioactive bands on a gel.
e.zh: 在研究中，荧光摄影可以显示凝胶上的放射性条带。

e.en: The chemist calibrated the {fluorometer} before measuring the samples.
e.zh: 化学师在测量样品前校准了荧光计。

e.en: A portable {fluorometer} can test water quality in the field.
e.zh: 便携式荧光测定仪可以在现场检测水质。

e.en: The team used a {fluorometric} assay to estimate enzyme activity.
e.zh: 团队使用荧光测定法来估算酶活性。

e.en: These {fluorometric} readings changed after the solution was diluted.
e.zh: 这些荧光测定读数在溶液稀释后发生了变化。

e.en: They used {fluorometry} to measure tiny amounts of protein.
e.zh: 他们用荧光测定法测量微量蛋白质。

e.en: Modern {fluorometry} is sensitive enough for environmental monitoring.
e.zh: 现代荧光测定法灵敏度足以用于环境监测。

e.en: The dye belongs to the {fluorone} family of compounds.
e.zh: 这种染料属于荧光酮类化合物。

e.en: Researchers modified a {fluorone} to improve its brightness.
e.zh: 研究人员改造了一种荧光酮，以提高它的亮度。

e.en: The report listed {fluoropentachloroethane} among the tested refrigerants.
e.zh: 报告把氟五氯乙烷列入了测试过的制冷剂。

e.en: Handling {fluoropentachloroethane} requires proper ventilation and protective equipment.
e.zh: 处理氟五氯乙烷需要良好通风和防护装备。

e.en: The glass contains a small amount of {fluorophosphate}.
e.zh: 这种玻璃含有少量氟磷酸盐。

e.en: A {fluorophosphate} compound was tested as a battery electrolyte additive.
e.zh: 一种氟磷酸酯化合物被测试为电池电解液添加剂。

e.en: The samples were analyzed by {fluorophotometry} after incubation.
e.zh: 样品孵育后通过荧光光度测定法进行分析。

e.en: Clinicians used {fluorophotometry} to study fluid movement in the eye.
e.zh: 临床医生用荧光光度测定法研究眼内液体流动。

e.en: The valve uses a {fluoroplastic} seal to resist corrosion.
e.zh: 这个阀门使用氟塑料密封件来抗腐蚀。

e.en: Engineers chose {fluoroplastic} tubing for the aggressive solvent.
e.zh: 工程师为这种强腐蚀性溶剂选择了氟塑料管。

e.en: Teflon is a well-known {fluoropolymer} used in nonstick coatings.
e.zh: 特氟龙是一种知名含氟聚合物，用于不粘涂层。

e.en: The cable jacket is made from a heat-resistant {fluoropolymer}.
e.zh: 电缆护套由耐热的含氟聚合物制成。

e.en: The chemist discussed {fluoroprene} as a specialty monomer.
e.zh: 化学师把氟丁二烯作为一种特种单体来讨论。

e.en: Pure {fluoroprene} must be stored under controlled laboratory conditions.
e.zh: 纯氟丁二烯必须在受控的实验室条件下储存。

e.en: Doctors prescribe {fluoroquinolones} for certain serious bacterial infections.
e.zh: 医生会为某些严重细菌感染开氟喹诺酮类抗生素。

e.en: Some {fluoroquinolones} can cause tendon problems in rare cases.
e.zh: 某些氟喹诺酮类药物在少数情况下会引起肌腱问题。

e.en: The surgeon watched the wire on a {fluoroscope} during the procedure.
e.zh: 手术过程中，外科医生通过荧光透视仪观察导丝。

e.en: An old {fluoroscope} exposed patients to more radiation than modern systems.
e.zh: 旧式荧光透视仪让患者承受的辐射比现代系统更多。

e.en: The doctor performed a {fluoroscopic} examination of the joint.
e.zh: 医生对这个关节进行了荧光透视检查。

e.en: A {fluoroscopic} image guided the needle into the correct position.
e.zh: 荧光透视图像引导针头进入正确位置。

e.en: The catheter was placed {fluoroscopically} to avoid damaging nearby tissue.
e.zh: 导管是在荧光透视下放置的，以避免损伤附近组织。

e.en: The fracture alignment was checked {fluoroscopically} before the cast hardened.
e.zh: 石膏硬化前，骨折对位通过荧光透视进行了检查。

e.en: The {fluoroscopist} adjusted the equipment to reduce radiation exposure.
e.zh: 荧光透视操作人员调整设备以减少辐射暴露。

e.en: A skilled {fluoroscopist} can obtain clear images with minimal delay.
e.zh: 熟练的荧光透视操作人员能在很短时间内获得清晰图像。

e.en: The laboratory purchased a new {fluorospectrophotometer} for dye analysis.
e.zh: 实验室购买了一台新的荧光分光光度计用于染料分析。

e.en: A {fluorospectrophotometer} records both excitation and emission spectra.
e.zh: 荧光分光光度计会记录激发光谱和发射光谱。

e.en: The patient received {fluorouracil} as part of chemotherapy.
e.zh: 患者接受了氟尿嘧啶作为化疗方案的一部分。

e.en: Topical {fluorouracil} is sometimes used to treat precancerous skin lesions.
e.zh: 外用氟尿嘧啶有时用于治疗癌前皮肤病变。

e.en: The factory ordered {fluorplastic} sheets for chemical-resistant liners.
e.zh: 工厂订购了氟塑料板，用作耐化学腐蚀的衬里。

e.en: A {fluorplastic} coating protected the metal from acid fumes.
e.zh: 一层氟塑料涂层保护金属免受酸雾腐蚀。

e.en: The paper used {fluorrometry} as an older spelling of fluorometry.
e.zh: 这篇论文把fluorrometry作为fluorometry的旧拼写来使用。

e.en: Results from {fluorrometry} were compared with standard absorbance measurements.
e.zh: 荧光测定法得到的结果与标准吸光度测量进行了比较。

e.en: The mine ships {fluorspar} to glass factories.
e.zh: 这座矿山把萤石运往玻璃厂。

e.en: High-grade {fluorspar} is used in steelmaking.
e.zh: 高品位萤石用于炼钢。

e.en: The engineer tested the {fluosilicate} solution carefully.
e.zh: 工程师仔细检测了氟硅酸盐溶液。

e.en: Some water plants once added {fluosilicate} compounds.
e.zh: 一些水厂曾添加氟硅酸盐化合物。

e.en: The report measured {fluosolids} in the waste stream.
e.zh: 报告测量了废物流中的氟化固体物质。

e.en: Workers stored the {fluosolids} in sealed drums.
e.zh: 工人把这些氟化固体物质存放在密封桶里。

e.en: The doctor discussed {fluoxymesterone} with the patient.
e.zh: 医生和病人讨论了氟甲睾酮的使用。

e.en: Athletes are banned from misusing {fluoxymesterone}.
e.zh: 运动员被禁止滥用氟甲睾酮。

e.en: The psychiatrist adjusted her {fluphenazine} dose.
e.zh: 精神科医生调整了她的氟奋乃静剂量。

e.en: Long-term {fluphenazine} treatment needs careful monitoring.
e.zh: 长期使用氟奋乃静治疗需要仔细监测。

e.en: The pharmacist warned that {flurazepam} may cause drowsiness.
e.zh: 药剂师提醒说氟西泮可能引起嗜睡。

e.en: He stopped taking {flurazepam} under medical supervision.
e.zh: 他在医生监督下停用了氟西泮。

e.en: The lab used a {flurorchrome} to mark the cells.
e.zh: 实验室用一种荧光染料标记细胞。

e.en: A bright {flurorchrome} made the sample easier to see.
e.zh: 明亮的荧光染料让样本更容易观察。

e.en: Engineers studied {flurosion} inside the chemical reactor.
e.zh: 工程师研究了化学反应器内部的氟腐蚀。

e.en: Protective coatings can reduce {flurosion} on metal surfaces.
e.zh: 保护涂层可以减少金属表面的氟腐蚀。

e.en: A sudden {flurr} of snow crossed the road.
e.zh: 一阵飞雪突然掠过道路。

e.en: The news caused a {flurr} of calls.
e.zh: 这条消息引来一阵电话忙乱。

e.en: The old {flush-decker} rode low in the harbor.
e.zh: 那艘旧平甲板船低低地停在港内。

e.en: Sailors repaired the {flush-decker} after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后，水手们修理了那艘平甲板船。

e.en: The drawing specified a {flush-fillet} along the joint.
e.zh: 图纸规定接缝处要做齐平圆角。

e.en: A neat {flush-fillet} strengthened the welded corner.
e.zh: 整齐的齐平圆角加固了焊接转角。

e.en: Use only {flushable} wipes in this toilet.
e.zh: 这个马桶只能使用可冲走的湿巾。

e.en: The package says the liners are {flushable}.
e.zh: 包装上说这些垫纸可以冲入马桶。

e.en: Her {flusteration} showed during the difficult interview.
e.zh: 在那场艰难的面试中，她露出了慌乱。

e.en: The delay caused general {flusteration} at the gate.
e.zh: 延误让登机口的人普遍感到心烦意乱。

e.en: His {flustration} grew as the printer jammed again.
e.zh: 打印机又卡纸时，他的挫败和慌乱更明显了。

e.en: The typo captured her comic {flustration} perfectly.
e.zh: 这个错拼恰好表现出她滑稽的挫败感。

e.en: A {flutelike} call echoed through the woods.
e.zh: 一种像长笛的叫声在树林里回荡。

e.en: The singer's {flutelike} tone suited the aria.
e.zh: 歌手像长笛般的音色很适合这段咏叹调。

e.en: The bird made a soft {flutey} sound.
e.zh: 那只鸟发出柔和的笛声般鸣叫。

e.en: Her {flutey} voice floated above the strings.
e.zh: 她笛声般的嗓音飘在弦乐之上。

e.en: The coach handed each swimmer a {flutterboard}.
e.zh: 教练给每名游泳者发了一块打水板。

e.en: She practiced kicks with a yellow {flutterboard}.
e.zh: 她用一块黄色打水板练习踢腿。

e.en: A {fluty} whistle came from the garden.
e.zh: 花园里传来一声清脆如笛的口哨。

e.en: The old organ had a {fluty} upper register.
e.zh: 那架旧管风琴的高音区有笛声似的音色。

e.en: The museum built a {fluvarium} for local river fish.
e.zh: 博物馆为本地河鱼建了一个河流生态水族箱。

e.en: Children watched minnows swim through the {fluvarium}.
e.zh: 孩子们看着小鱼在河流生态水族箱中游动。

e.en: The {fluvialist} mapped changes in the river channel.
e.zh: 这位河流学研究者绘制了河道变化图。

e.en: As a {fluvialist}, she studies floods and sediment.
e.zh: 作为河流学研究者，她研究洪水和沉积物。

e.en: The valley contains ancient {fluviatic} deposits.
e.zh: 这个山谷中有古老的河流沉积物。

e.en: They studied {fluviatic} patterns after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水后，他们研究了河流形成的模式。

e.en: The cliff exposed layers of {fluviatile} gravel.
e.zh: 悬崖露出了多层河流砾石。

e.en: Some {fluviatile} plants cannot survive in salt water.
e.zh: 有些生于河中的植物无法在盐水中存活。

fluvioglacial.t: 河冰作用形成的；河冰成的

e.en: The valley contains {fluvioglacial} gravel from melting ice.
e.zh: 这个山谷里有融冰留下的河冰成砾石。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {fluvioglacial} deposits near the old river.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了老河道附近的河冰沉积物分布。

e.en: The {fluviograph} recorded a sudden rise overnight.
e.zh: 河流水位记录仪记录到夜间水位突然上涨。

e.en: Engineers checked the {fluviograph} after the flood warning.
e.zh: 洪水预警后，工程师检查了那台河流水位记录仪。

e.en: Her thesis in {fluviology} examined delta erosion.
e.zh: 她的河流学论文研究了三角洲侵蚀。

e.en: Modern {fluviology} combines field surveys with satellite data.
e.zh: 现代河流学把实地调查和卫星数据结合起来。

e.en: The coast shows {fluviomarine} layers of sand and silt.
e.zh: 这片海岸呈现出河海共同作用形成的砂层和粉砂层。

e.en: They studied {fluviomarine} sediments at the river mouth.
e.zh: 他们研究了河口处河海共同作用的沉积物。

e.en: A {fluviometer} measured the river during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间，一台河流水位计测量了河水变化。

e.en: The old {fluviometer} gave unreliable readings in winter.
e.zh: 那台旧流量计在冬天给出的读数不可靠。

e.en: The survey described a {fluvioterrestrial} habitat beside the channel.
e.zh: 调查描述了河道旁一种河流与陆地相连的栖息地。

e.en: Some insects depend on {fluvioterrestrial} food webs.
e.zh: 有些昆虫依赖河流与陆地相互关联的食物网。

e.en: Researchers tested {fluvomycin} against several bacterial strains.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了氟伏霉素对几种细菌菌株的作用。

e.en: The paper described {fluvomycin} as a narrow-spectrum antibiotic.
e.zh: 论文把氟伏霉素描述为一种窄谱抗生素。

e.en: The weld required a stable {flux-covering} for protection.
e.zh: 这道焊缝需要稳定的助熔剂覆盖层来保护。

e.en: Too thin a {flux-covering} can expose the molten metal.
e.zh: 助熔剂覆盖层太薄会使熔融金属暴露出来。

e.en: The satellite carried a {fluxgate} magnetometer.
e.zh: 这颗卫星搭载了一台磁通门磁力计。

e.en: A small {fluxgate} detected changes in the magnetic field.
e.zh: 一个小型磁通门传感器检测到了磁场变化。

e.en: The {fluxgraph} showed a sharp peak at noon.
e.zh: 通量图显示中午出现了一个尖峰。

e.en: Technicians repaired the {fluxgraph} before the next experiment.
e.zh: 技术人员在下一次实验前修好了磁通记录仪。

e.en: The alloy's {fluxibility} improved at higher temperatures.
e.zh: 温度升高后，这种合金的易熔性提高了。

e.en: Potters valued the glaze for its smooth {fluxibility}.
e.zh: 陶工看重这种釉料顺滑的流动性。

e.en: The mineral becomes {fluxible} in a hot furnace.
e.zh: 这种矿物在高温炉中会变得易熔。

e.en: They needed a more {fluxible} mixture for the glaze.
e.zh: 他们需要一种流动性更好的釉料混合物。

e.en: Newton used {fluxion} for a changing quantity's rate.
e.zh: 牛顿用fluxion表示变化量的瞬时变化率。

e.en: The doctor noted a {fluxion} of fluid from the wound.
e.zh: 医生记录到伤口有液体流出。

e.en: The molecule showed {fluxional} behavior at room temperature.
e.zh: 这种分子在室温下表现出动态流变行为。

e.en: His lecture explained {fluxional} calculus in historical terms.
e.zh: 他的讲座从历史角度解释了流数微积分。

e.en: The manuscript used {fluxionary} notation throughout.
e.zh: 这份手稿通篇使用流数法记号。

e.en: She compared {fluxionary} methods with modern calculus.
e.zh: 她把流数法方法同现代微积分作了比较。

e.en: The young {fluxionist} defended Newton's notation.
e.zh: 那位年轻的流数法学者为牛顿的记号辩护。

e.en: A committed {fluxionist} criticized the continental approach.
e.zh: 一位坚定的流数法学者批评了欧洲大陆的方法。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {fluxmeter} before testing.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前校准了磁通计。

e.en: A digital {fluxmeter} displayed the changing field strength.
e.zh: 数字通量计显示了不断变化的场强。

e.en: The superconductor trapped a single {fluxoid}.
e.zh: 超导体俘获了一个磁通子。

e.en: Physicists measured the {fluxoid} in the tiny ring.
e.zh: 物理学家测量了这个微小环中的磁通子。

e.en: The drone made a quick {fly-around} of the tower.
e.zh: 无人机快速绕塔飞行检查了一圈。

e.en: Pilots planned a {fly-around} before landing at the site.
e.zh: 飞行员计划在现场着陆前先绕飞一圈。

e.en: The lamps were fixed to a high {fly-bar}.
e.zh: 灯具固定在一根高处的舞台吊杆上。

e.en: A loose {fly-bar} delayed the theatre rehearsal.
e.zh: 一根松动的飞杆耽误了剧院排练。

e.en: The old {fly-boy} told stories from the war.
e.zh: 那位老飞行员讲起了战争年代的故事。

e.en: She called him a {fly-boy} with a grin.
e.zh: 她笑着叫他空军小伙。

e.en: They hired a {fly-by-night} contractor and regretted it.
e.zh: 他们雇了个不可靠的承包商，后来很后悔。

e.en: The town rejected another {fly-by-night} investment scheme.
e.zh: 镇上拒绝了又一个临时骗人的投资计划。

e.en: Modern jets often use {fly-by-wire} controls.
e.zh: 现代喷气式飞机常使用电传操纵系统。

e.en: The {fly-by-wire} system corrected the pilot's input.
e.zh: 线控飞行系统修正了飞行员的操作输入。

e.en: They {fly-fish} in the mountain stream every spring.
e.zh: 他们每年春天都在山溪里用假蝇钓鱼。

e.en: She learned to {fly-fish} with a light rod.
e.zh: 她学会了用轻钓竿进行假蝇钓。

e.en: He {fly-fished} the river before sunrise.
e.zh: 他日出前就在那条河里用假蝇钓鱼。

e.en: We {fly-fished} for trout all afternoon.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都用假蝇钓鳟鱼。

flyleaves.t: 书籍前后的空白页；扉页

e.en: The old diary had notes written on the {flyleaves}.
e.zh: 那本旧日记的空白页上写着笔记。

e.en: She found a date penciled on one of the {flyleaves}.
e.zh: 她在其中一张扉页上发现了铅笔写的日期。

flyman.t: 舞台吊景工；马车出租人

e.en: The {flyman} raised the backdrop before the actors entered.
e.zh: 演员上场前，舞台吊景工升起了背景幕。

e.en: A {flyman} waited outside the station with his cab.
e.zh: 一名马车出租人在车站外等着客人。

flymen.t: 舞台吊景工；马车出租人

e.en: The {flymen} moved the scenery during the blackout.
e.zh: 灯光熄灭时，舞台吊景工移动了布景。

e.en: Several {flymen} called to passengers leaving the theatre.
e.zh: 几个马车出租人招呼离开剧院的乘客。

e.en: He tried to {flype} the damp sock the right way out.
e.zh: 他想把那只湿袜子翻回正面。

e.en: The old tailor could {flype} a cuff with one quick motion.
e.zh: 那位老裁缝一下就能把袖口翻折好。

e.en: A {flyposter} covered the wall with concert notices overnight.
e.zh: 一名非法张贴者连夜把墙贴满了演唱会海报。

e.en: The council fined the {flyposter} for advertising on public property.
e.zh: 市政会因他在公共设施上贴广告而罚了这名张贴者。

e.en: The geologist identified {flysch} along the folded coast.
e.zh: 地质学家在褶皱海岸一带认出了复理石层。

e.en: Layers of {flysch} record ancient underwater landslides.
e.zh: 复理石层记录了古代水下滑坡的痕迹。

e.en: She grabbed a {flyswat} from the kitchen drawer.
e.zh: 她从厨房抽屉里拿出一个苍蝇拍。

e.en: The broken {flyswat} was useless against the buzzing flies.
e.zh: 那个坏掉的苍蝇拍对嗡嗡乱飞的苍蝇毫无用处。

e.en: The new {flyunder} carries traffic beneath the railway line.
e.zh: 新的下穿道让车辆从铁路线下方通行。

e.en: The pilot planned a risky {flyunder} beneath the bridge.
e.zh: 飞行员计划从桥下方进行一次冒险飞越。

e.en: The sailors slept in the cramped {fo'c's'le}.
e.zh: 水手们睡在狭窄的船首水手舱里。

e.en: Spray broke over the {fo'c's'le} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中浪花打过船首楼。

e.en: A lantern swung inside the dark {fo'c'sle}.
e.zh: 黑暗的船首水手舱里，一盏灯笼摇晃着。

e.en: The crew gathered near the {fo'c'sle} after supper.
e.zh: 晚饭后船员们聚在船首楼附近。

e.en: This cleaner is {foamable} when mixed with warm water.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂和温水混合后可以起泡。

e.en: The factory tested a {foamable} plastic for lightweight panels.
e.zh: 工厂测试了一种可发泡塑料，用来制作轻质板材。

e.en: The carpet had a {foamback} layer for extra comfort.
e.zh: 这块地毯有一层泡沫背衬，踩起来更舒服。

e.en: A {foamback} fabric can make cheap upholstery feel softer.
e.zh: 带泡沫背衬的织物能让廉价软包摸起来更柔软。

e.en: The gardener planted {foamflower} beneath the maple trees.
e.zh: 园丁在枫树下种了泡沫花。

e.en: White {foamflower} brightened the shady path in spring.
e.zh: 春天，白色泡沫花点亮了阴凉的小路。

e.en: This soap makes a {foamier} lather than the old one.
e.zh: 这种肥皂打出的泡沫比旧的更多。

e.en: The cappuccino was {foamier} after she steamed the milk longer.
e.zh: 她把牛奶多蒸了一会儿后，卡布奇诺的奶泡更多了。

e.en: The {foamiest} wave washed over the rocks.
e.zh: 泡沫最多的那道浪冲过了礁石。

e.en: He chose the {foamiest} beer on the menu.
e.zh: 他选了菜单上泡沫最丰富的啤酒。

e.en: The soap slid {foamily} down the sink.
e.zh: 肥皂泡沫顺着水槽滑了下去。

e.en: The waves broke {foamily} against the pier.
e.zh: 浪花带着泡沫拍打在码头上。

foamite.t: 接触传染物；污染媒介物

e.en: A dirty towel can act as a {foamite} in a clinic.
e.zh: 在诊所里，脏毛巾可能成为接触传染物。

e.en: The nurse disinfected every possible {foamite} after the outbreak.
e.zh: 疫情暴发后，护士给每个可能的污染媒介物消了毒。

e.en: The {foamless} detergent is designed for washing machines.
e.zh: 这种无泡沫洗涤剂是为洗衣机设计的。

e.en: A {foamless} sea looked strangely calm at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时无泡沫的海面显得异常平静。

e.en: The therapy helped her {focalise} her attention on breathing.
e.zh: 这种疗法帮助她把注意力集中在呼吸上。

e.en: The lens can {focalise} light onto a tiny sensor.
e.zh: 这枚镜头能把光聚焦到一个微小传感器上。

e.en: The director tried to {focalize} the story through one child.
e.zh: 导演试图通过一个孩子的视角来聚焦这个故事。

e.en: Use the knob to {focalize} the image more sharply.
e.zh: 用这个旋钮把图像调得更清晰。

e.en: The article {focalizes} attention on rural health care.
e.zh: 这篇文章把注意力集中到农村医疗上。

e.en: This microscope {focalizes} light with remarkable precision.
e.zh: 这台显微镜能极其精确地聚焦光线。

e.en: The teacher is {focalizing} the discussion around evidence.
e.zh: 老师正在把讨论集中到证据上。

e.en: The camera kept {focalizing} on the nearest face.
e.zh: 相机一直对焦在最近的那张脸上。

e.en: The {fly-fisher} waded quietly into the stream.
e.zh: 那名飞蝇钓手安静地涉水走进溪流。

e.en: A patient {fly-fisher} studies the insects before casting.
e.zh: 有耐心的飞蝇钓鱼者会先观察昆虫再抛竿。

e.en: She {fly-fishes} for trout every spring.
e.zh: 她每年春天都用飞蝇钓法钓鳟鱼。

e.en: He {fly-fishes} only in clear mountain streams.
e.zh: 他只在清澈的山溪里飞蝇钓鱼。

e.en: He learned {fly-fishing} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里学会了飞蝇钓。

e.en: {Fly-fishing} requires timing and a light touch.
e.zh: 飞蝇钓需要掌握时机，也要手法轻巧。

e.en: These trousers have a hidden {fly-front}.
e.zh: 这条裤子有一个隐藏式门襟。

e.en: The tailor repaired the coat's {fly-front} neatly.
e.zh: 裁缝把外套的前襟门襟修得很整齐。

e.en: Pilots gathered at the annual {fly-in}.
e.zh: 飞行员们参加了一年一度的飞来聚会。

e.en: The team planned a quick {fly-in} visit.
e.zh: 团队计划乘飞机快速到访一次。

fly-man.t: 舞台吊景工；飞行表演人员

e.en: The {fly-man} raised the scenery above the stage.
e.zh: 舞台吊景工把布景升到了舞台上方。

e.en: A skilled {fly-man} checked every rope before the show.
e.zh: 熟练的吊景工在演出前检查了每根绳索。

fly-on-the-wall.t: 旁观而不被注意的人；纪实观察式

e.en: I wished I could be a {fly-on-the-wall} during the meeting.
e.zh: 我真希望能在会议上旁观而不被人注意。

e.en: The film uses a {fly-on-the-wall} documentary style.
e.zh: 这部电影采用了观察式纪实风格。

e.en: They {fly-post} concert ads on empty walls.
e.zh: 他们在空墙上非法张贴演唱会广告。

e.en: The council fined companies that {fly-post} around town.
e.zh: 市政会处罚在城里乱贴广告的公司。

e.en: The farmer treated the {fly-struck} sheep immediately.
e.zh: 农民立刻处理了被苍蝇产卵侵害的羊。

e.en: {Fly-struck} wounds can become infected very quickly.
e.zh: 被苍蝇侵害的伤口很快可能感染。

e.en: Some people {fly-tip} rubbish beside country roads.
e.zh: 有些人在乡间道路旁非法倾倒垃圾。

e.en: The council installed cameras where residents often {fly-tip}.
e.zh: 市政会在居民常乱倒垃圾的地方安装了摄像头。

fly-tipping.t: 非法倾倒垃圾；乱倒废物

e.en: {Fly-tipping} has increased near the old factory.
e.zh: 旧工厂附近非法倾倒垃圾的情况增加了。

e.en: The town introduced higher fines for {fly-tipping}.
e.zh: 镇上对乱倒废物提高了罚款。

e.en: We hung a {fly-trap} near the kitchen door.
e.zh: 我们在厨房门旁挂了一个捕蝇器。

e.en: The Venus {fly-trap} closes when an insect touches it.
e.zh: 捕蝇草在昆虫碰到它时会合拢。

e.en: The damaged plane was still {flyable}.
e.zh: 那架受损的飞机仍然可以飞行。

e.en: Weather conditions were barely {flyable} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，天气条件勉强适合飞行。

flybelt.t: 苍蝇肆虐地带；采采蝇带

e.en: Villages in the {flybelt} faced serious cattle losses.
e.zh: 采采蝇带的村庄面临严重的牛只损失。

e.en: Health workers mapped the {flybelt} before planning control measures.
e.zh: 卫生人员先绘制苍蝇肆虐地带的地图，再规划防治措施。

e.en: The butcher checked the meat for {flyblow}.
e.zh: 屠夫检查肉上有没有苍蝇卵。

e.en: Flies can {flyblow} exposed food in warm weather.
e.zh: 天气暖和时，苍蝇会在暴露的食物上产卵。

e.en: The {flyblown} meat was thrown away.
e.zh: 那块被苍蝇产卵的肉被扔掉了。

e.en: He rejected the {flyblown} excuse as soon as he heard it.
e.zh: 他一听就驳回了那个腐朽不堪的借口。

e.en: The {flyboat} carried passengers along the canal.
e.zh: 那艘快速运河船沿运河运送乘客。

e.en: Merchants once used a {flyboat} for urgent cargo.
e.zh: 商人过去曾用旧式快船运送急货。

e.en: His first {flycast} landed softly on the water.
e.zh: 他的第一次飞蝇钓抛竿轻轻落在水面上。

e.en: She changed the {flycast} before fishing deeper pools.
e.zh: 去钓较深水潭前，她换了飞钓线组。

flycutter.t: 飞刀铣刀；旋转切削刀具

e.en: The machinist used a {flycutter} to smooth the plate.
e.zh: 机工用飞刀铣刀把金属板铣平。

e.en: A sharp {flycutter} leaves a cleaner surface.
e.zh: 锋利的飞刀铣刀能留下更平整的表面。

e.en: They {flyfish} for salmon in Alaska.
e.zh: 他们在阿拉斯加用飞蝇钓法钓鲑鱼。

e.en: I learned to {flyfish} on a narrow river.
e.zh: 我是在一条狭窄的河上学会飞蝇钓的。

e.en: He {flyfished} the river before sunrise.
e.zh: 他在日出前就在那条河上飞蝇钓鱼。

e.en: They {flyfished} together during their holiday.
e.zh: 他们度假时一起用飞蝇钓法钓鱼。

e.en: My uncle {flyfishes} on quiet weekends.
e.zh: 我叔叔在安静的周末会去飞蝇钓鱼。

e.en: She {flyfishes} with handmade artificial flies.
e.zh: 她用手工假蝇来飞蝇钓鱼。

e.en: {Flyfishing} is popular on this river.
e.zh: 这条河上飞蝇钓很受欢迎。

e.en: He bought new gear for {flyfishing}.
e.zh: 他为飞蝇钓买了新装备。

e.en: She reached for the {flyflap} on the shelf.
e.zh: 她伸手去拿架子上的苍蝇拍。

e.en: The old {flyflap} hung beside the kitchen window.
e.zh: 旧苍蝇拍挂在厨房窗边。

flying-boat.t: 水上飞机；飞船式水上飞机

e.en: The {flying-boat} landed smoothly on the lake.
e.zh: 那架水上飞机平稳地降落在湖面上。

e.en: Early airlines used a {flying-boat} for ocean routes.
e.zh: 早期航空公司曾用水上飞机执飞跨洋航线。

e.en: The technician checked the lens with a {focometer}.
e.zh: 技术员用焦距计检查了镜片。

e.en: An old {focometer} sat beside the optical bench.
e.zh: 一台旧聚焦测量仪放在光学台旁边。

fodderless.t: 没有饲料的；缺少素材的

e.en: The farm was nearly {fodderless} after the drought.
e.zh: 旱灾过后，农场几乎没有饲料了。

e.en: His argument felt {fodderless} and quickly collapsed.
e.zh: 他的论点缺少素材，很快就站不住脚了。

e.en: The {fodgel} man squeezed through the narrow gate.
e.zh: 那个矮胖笨拙的男人挤过了窄门。

e.en: A {fodgel} puppy tumbled across the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 一只胖乎乎的小狗在厨房地板上跌跌撞撞地跑过。

e.en: A warm {foehn} swept down from the mountains.
e.zh: 一股温暖的焚风从山上吹下来。

e.en: The {foehn} dried the valley within hours.
e.zh: 干热山风几个小时内就把山谷吹干了。

e.en: The knight faced his {foeman} at dawn.
e.zh: 骑士在黎明时面对他的敌人。

e.en: No wise leader underestimates a wounded {foeman}.
e.zh: 明智的领袖不会低估受伤的仇敌。

e.en: The soldiers watched their {foemen} across the river.
e.zh: 士兵们隔着河注视着敌人们。

e.en: Old songs praised heroes who defeated many {foemen}.
e.zh: 古老的歌谣赞颂打败众多仇敌的英雄。

e.en: The lecture described early {foetation} in mammals.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了哺乳动物早期胎儿形成过程。

e.en: Abnormal {foetation} was noted in the medical report.
e.zh: 医疗报告中记录了异常妊娠情况。

e.en: The law treated forced {foeticide} as a serious crime.
e.zh: 法律将强迫杀胎视为严重犯罪。

e.en: Doctors discussed the ethics of selective {foeticide}.
e.zh: 医生们讨论了选择性杀胎的伦理问题。

e.en: She specialized in {foetology} at the university hospital.
e.zh: 她在大学医院专攻胎儿学。

e.en: Modern {foetology} uses detailed ultrasound imaging.
e.zh: 现代胎儿学会使用精细的超声成像。

e.en: The wound gave off a terrible {foetor}.
e.zh: 伤口散发出一股可怕的恶臭。

e.en: Persistent {foetor} may indicate dental disease.
e.zh: 持续口臭可能提示牙科疾病。

e.en: The {fog-horn} sounded every minute near the harbor.
e.zh: 港口附近的雾号每分钟响一次。

e.en: His voice boomed like a {fog-horn} in the hall.
e.zh: 他的嗓音在大厅里像雾笛一样洪亮。

e.en: The lighthouse sent a {fog-signal} through the mist.
e.zh: 灯塔向雾中发出了雾警信号。

e.en: Ships rely on a {fog-signal} when visibility disappears.
e.zh: 能见度消失时，船只依靠雾中信号航行。

e.en: A dense {fogbank} hid the coastline from view.
e.zh: 一片浓雾团遮住了海岸线。

e.en: The plane descended into a gray {fogbank}.
e.zh: 飞机下降进入一片灰色雾堤。

e.en: The old {fogbell} warned ships away from the rocks.
e.zh: 那口旧雾钟提醒船只避开礁石。

e.en: We heard the {fogbell} long before seeing the shore.
e.zh: 我们还没看见海岸，就先听到了雾钟声。

e.en: The airport was {fogbound} until late afternoon.
e.zh: 机场因大雾受困，直到下午晚些时候才恢复。

e.en: A {fogbound} village appeared only when we reached it.
e.zh: 那个被雾困住的村庄直到我们走近才显现出来。

e.en: A pale {fogbow} formed above the marsh.
e.zh: 沼泽上方形成了一道淡淡的雾虹。

e.en: Photographers waited for the rare {fogbow} at sunrise.
e.zh: 摄影师们等待日出时罕见的白虹。

e.en: The experimental {fogbroom} cleared the runway lights.
e.zh: 实验性驱雾装置清除了跑道灯周围的雾。

e.en: Engineers tested a {fogbroom} on the cold bridge.
e.zh: 工程师们在寒冷的桥上测试扫雾器。

e.en: A faint {fogdog} glimmered beside the low sun.
e.zh: 低低的太阳旁边闪着一个淡淡的雾中亮斑。

e.en: Sailors once watched each {fogdog} for signs of clearing weather.
e.zh: 水手们过去会观察每个雾虹亮点，判断天气是否转晴。

e.en: Locals called the dry mountain wind a {fogeater}.
e.zh: 当地人把这种干燥山风叫作驱雾风。

e.en: The pilot hoped for a {fogeater} before takeoff.
e.zh: 飞行员希望起飞前能来一阵驱雾风。

e.en: The sheep grazed on {foggage} through early winter.
e.zh: 羊群在初冬时吃着秋后再生草。

e.en: Farmers saved the {foggage} for hungry cattle.
e.zh: 农民把留牧草留给饥饿的牛吃。

e.en: The oasis depended on an ancient {foggara}.
e.zh: 这片绿洲依靠一条古老的地下引水渠。

e.en: Workers repaired the {foggara} after the tunnel collapsed.
e.zh: 隧道塌方后，工人们修复了地下引水渠。

e.en: The streetlights glowed {foggily} through the mist.
e.zh: 路灯透过薄雾朦胧地发亮。

e.en: She remembered the conversation only {foggily}.
e.zh: 她只模模糊糊记得那次谈话。

e.en: The driver switched on the {foglamp} near the coast.
e.zh: 司机在靠近海岸时打开了雾灯。

e.en: A cracked {foglamp} failed the vehicle inspection.
e.zh: 一个破裂的雾灯让这辆车没通过检查。

e.en: The thief tucked a red {fogle} into his pocket.
e.zh: 小偷把一条红色丝手帕塞进口袋。

e.en: He wore a bright {fogle} around his neck.
e.zh: 他脖子上围着一条鲜艳的围巾。

e.en: We finally enjoyed a {fogless} day on the mountain.
e.zh: 我们终于在山上遇到了一个无雾的日子。

e.en: Her answer was calm and {fogless}.
e.zh: 她的回答平静而清晰。

e.en: One {foglight} stopped working during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中有一盏雾灯坏了。

e.en: Use the rear {foglight} only in thick fog.
e.zh: 只有在浓雾中才使用后雾灯。

e.en: The office sent a {fogram} before the ship departed.
e.zh: 办公室在船离港前发了一份旧式电报。

e.en: A faded {fogram} confirmed the appointment.
e.zh: 一份褪色的传真信息确认了这次预约。

e.en: The sailors warmed themselves with {fogrum} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜后，水手们喝浓烈热酒取暖。

e.en: He served {fogrum} in heavy mugs by the fire.
e.zh: 他在炉火旁用厚杯端上热酒饮料。

fogyish.t: 守旧派头的；老古板似的

e.en: His {fogyish} complaints annoyed the younger staff.
e.zh: 他那种老古板似的抱怨惹烦了年轻员工。

e.en: The club had a slightly {fogyish} atmosphere.
e.zh: 这家俱乐部有点守旧的气氛。

e.en: Her article mocked the {fogyism} of the committee.
e.zh: 她的文章嘲讽了委员会的守旧作风。

e.en: He mistook caution for {fogyism}.
e.zh: 他把谨慎误认为老古板思想。

e.en: {Foh}, that smell is unbearable.
e.zh: 呸，那股味道真让人受不了。

e.en: The old man cried {foh} at the dirty joke.
e.zh: 老人听到那个下流笑话后喊了声呸。

e.en: A warm {fohn} swept down the valley.
e.zh: 一股温暖的焚风吹下山谷。

e.en: The {fohn} melted the snow unusually fast.
e.zh: 干热山风让积雪异常迅速地融化。

e.en: The chef served {foie} with toasted bread.
e.zh: 厨师把鹅肝配烤面包端上桌。

e.en: The menu listed duck {foie} as a starter.
e.zh: 菜单把鸭肝列为一道前菜。

e.en: The plot was {foilable} with better security.
e.zh: 只要安保更好，这个阴谋是可以挫败的。

e.en: Not every cyberattack is easily {foilable}.
e.zh: 并非每次网络攻击都容易被阻止。

e.en: The young {foilsman} trained before dawn.
e.zh: 这名年轻花剑运动员天亮前就开始训练。

e.en: A skilled {foilsman} wins by timing, not force.
e.zh: 高明的花剑手靠时机取胜，而不是靠蛮力。

e.en: He made a quick {foin} at his opponent.
e.zh: 他向对手迅速刺了一剑。

e.en: The knight tried to {foin} through the gap.
e.zh: 骑士试图从缝隙中刺进去。

e.en: The orchard promised {foison} after the spring rain.
e.zh: 春雨过后，果园显出丰收的希望。

e.en: Her poetry has a {foison} of strange images.
e.zh: 她的诗中有大量奇异的意象。

e.en: Pregnant women often need extra {folacin}.
e.zh: 孕妇通常需要额外补充叶酸。

e.en: Leafy vegetables are good sources of {folacin}.
e.zh: 绿叶蔬菜是叶酸的良好来源。

e.en: We carried a {fold-up} table to the picnic.
e.zh: 我们带了一张折叠桌去野餐。

e.en: The apartment has a {fold-up} bed.
e.zh: 这套公寓里有一张折叠床。

e.en: The kitchen has a {foldaway} breakfast table.
e.zh: 厨房里有一张可收折的早餐桌。

e.en: They slept on a {foldaway} bed in the study.
e.zh: 他们睡在书房的一张折叠床上。

e.en: The singer asked for more {foldback} in her monitor.
e.zh: 歌手要求监听里多一点舞台返听声。

e.en: The sleeve has a neat {foldback} at the cuff.
e.zh: 袖口处有一个整齐的折回部分。

e.en: The mountains formed within an ancient {foldbelt}.
e.zh: 这些山脉形成于一个古老的褶皱带内。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {foldbelt} across the region.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了该地区褶皱带的分布图。

e.en: They packed a {foldboat} for the river trip.
e.zh: 他们为河上旅行带了一只折叠船。

e.en: A canvas {foldboat} can fit in a small car.
e.zh: 帆布折叠船可以装进一辆小车里。

e.en: The {foldboater} carried the compact craft to the river.
e.zh: 那名折叠船使用者把小船带到河边。

e.en: A careful {foldboater} checks every joint before launching.
e.zh: 谨慎的折叠船玩家下水前会检查每个连接处。

e.en: They discovered {foldboating} during a camping trip.
e.zh: 他们在一次露营旅行中接触到折叠船运动。

e.en: {Foldboating} lets hikers carry a boat on their backs.
e.zh: 折叠船运动让徒步者能把船背在身上。

e.en: The old map marked a {foldcourse} through the marsh.
e.zh: 那张旧地图标出了一条穿过沼泽的曲折路线。

e.en: Sailors followed the {foldcourse} to avoid hidden rocks.
e.zh: 水手沿着折线航向前进，以避开暗礁。

e.en: The guidebook includes a large {foldout} map.
e.zh: 这本指南里有一张很大的折页地图。

e.en: The table has a {foldout} section for extra guests.
e.zh: 这张桌子有一块可展开部分，方便多坐几位客人。

e.en: The wallet has a {foldover} flap with a snap.
e.zh: 这个钱包有一个带按扣的翻折盖。

e.en: She wore boots with soft {foldover} cuffs.
e.zh: 她穿着靴口可以翻折的软靴子。

e.en: The manuscript's {folia} were numbered in red ink.
e.zh: 这份手稿的书页用红墨水编了号。

e.en: The botanist compared the {folia} of several mosses.
e.zh: 植物学家比较了几种苔藓的叶片。

e.en: The mineral formed thin {foliaceous} sheets.
e.zh: 这种矿物形成了薄薄的叶状片层。

e.en: A {foliaceous} seaweed covered the shallow rocks.
e.zh: 一种叶状海藻覆盖着浅水中的岩石。

e.en: The farmer applied a {foliar} spray after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后农民喷施了叶面喷剂。

e.en: The disease first appears as {foliar} spots.
e.zh: 这种病害最初表现为叶片上的斑点。

e.en: The artist chose to {foliate} the border with gold leaves.
e.zh: 艺术家选择用金色叶形图案装饰边框。

e.en: Some rocks {foliate} under intense pressure.
e.zh: 有些岩石在强压下会形成片理。

e.en: The doorway had a {foliated} stone arch.
e.zh: 门口有一座带叶饰的石拱。

e.en: The geologist examined a {foliated} metamorphic rock.
e.zh: 地质学家检查了一块片理状变质岩。

e.en: The pattern {foliates} around the central circle.
e.zh: 这个图案围绕中心圆形展开成叶饰。

e.en: Granite rarely {foliates} without strong directional pressure.
e.zh: 花岗岩若没有强烈定向压力，很少会形成片理。

e.en: The artisan was {foliating} the frame by hand.
e.zh: 工匠正在手工给画框加叶形装饰。

e.en: The rock was slowly {foliating} under pressure.
e.zh: 那块岩石在压力下正慢慢形成片理。

e.en: The cathedral carving shows delicate {foliation}.
e.zh: 大教堂的雕刻呈现出精细的叶状装饰。

e.en: The slate's {foliation} made it split cleanly.
e.zh: 板岩的片理让它能整齐地裂开。

e.en: The manuscript margin is filled with golden {foliature}.
e.zh: 手稿页边布满金色叶形装饰。

e.en: Victorian furniture often used carved {foliature}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时期家具常使用雕刻叶饰。

e.en: The doctor noted a swollen {folicle} near the skin.
e.zh: 医生注意到皮肤附近有一个肿胀的小滤泡。

e.en: Each seed developed inside a tiny {folicle}.
e.zh: 每粒种子都在一个细小囊内发育。

e.en: The researcher collected {foliicolous} fungi from the rainforest.
e.zh: 研究人员从雨林中采集了生长在叶上的真菌。

e.en: Many {foliicolous} lichens are sensitive to air pollution.
e.zh: 许多叶生地衣对空气污染很敏感。

e.en: The fossil showed a broad {foliiform} structure.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出宽大的叶形结构。

e.en: A {foliiform} ornament hung from the necklace.
e.zh: 项链上挂着一个叶形饰件。

e.en: The plant has {foliolate} leaves divided into three parts.
e.zh: 这种植物的叶子分成三部分，属于具小叶类型。

e.en: A {foliolate} form is common in this clover group.
e.zh: 这种三叶草类群中常见具小叶的形态。

e.en: Each {foliole} was narrow and sharply pointed.
e.zh: 每片小叶都又窄又尖。

e.en: The botanist measured the central {foliole} first.
e.zh: 植物学家先测量了中间那片小叶。

e.en: A {foliose} lichen spread across the bark.
e.zh: 一种叶状地衣在树皮上铺展开来。

e.en: The shell had a {foliose} outer texture.
e.zh: 贝壳外层有叶片般的纹理。

e.en: The old clock used a {foliot} instead of a pendulum.
e.zh: 这座老钟使用的是摆轮，而不是钟摆。

e.en: A damaged {foliot} made the mechanism run unevenly.
e.zh: 受损的早期钟表横杆让机芯走得不均匀。

e.en: The diagram labels each {folium} of the cerebellum.
e.zh: 图中标出了小脑的每个叶状结构。

e.en: The archivist repaired one damaged {folium}.
e.zh: 档案管理员修复了一页受损的手稿。

e.en: The manuscript had several painted {foliums} bound inside.
e.zh: 这份手稿里装订了几页彩绘叶片。

e.en: The plant's broad {foliums} caught the morning light.
e.zh: 这种植物宽大的叶片映着晨光。

e.en: A sloth is a classic {folivore} in tropical forests.
e.zh: 树懒是热带森林中典型的食叶动物。

e.en: The zoo labels each {folivore} with notes about its diet.
e.zh: 动物园给每种食叶动物都标注了饮食说明。

e.en: The festival preserves an old {folk-custom} from the valley.
e.zh: 这个节日保留了山谷里的一项古老民间习俗。

e.en: Lighting candles at the gate became a local {folk-custom}.
e.zh: 在门口点蜡烛后来成了当地的民间习俗。

e.en: The legend describes a {folk-devil} who steals careless children.
e.zh: 传说中有个民间妖魔会偷走粗心的孩子。

e.en: The newspaper turned the mayor into a {folk-devil}.
e.zh: 报纸把市长塑造成了人人憎恶的替罪恶人。

e.en: The band mixed electric guitars with {folk-rock} harmonies.
e.zh: 这支乐队把电吉他和民谣摇滚的和声结合起来。

e.en: She became famous during the {folk-rock} boom of the sixties.
e.zh: 她在六十年代民谣摇滚热潮中成名。

e.en: The {folk-singer} performed old ballads by the river.
e.zh: 那位民歌手在河边演唱古老的民谣。

e.en: As a young {folk-singer}, he wrote songs about factory life.
e.zh: 年轻时作为民谣歌手，他写了许多关于工厂生活的歌。

e.en: Grandmother taught us a {folk-song} from her village.
e.zh: 祖母教我们唱了一首她村里的民歌。

e.en: The protest began with a simple {folk-song}.
e.zh: 这场抗议从一首朴素的民谣开始。

e.en: The restaurant's rough wooden tables added a pleasant {folkishness}.
e.zh: 餐馆里粗木桌增添了一种讨喜的乡土气息。

e.en: Critics found the film's {folkishness} charming but sentimental.
e.zh: 评论家觉得这部电影的民间风味迷人但有些多愁善感。

e.en: In old law, {folkland} could be held by customary right.
e.zh: 在古代法律中，民有土地可按习惯权利持有。

e.en: The poet imagined England as a shared {folkland}.
e.zh: 诗人把英格兰想象成一片共同的乡土。

e.en: The museum records the {folklife} of coastal villages.
e.zh: 博物馆记录沿海村庄的民俗生活。

e.en: Her research on {folklife} includes food, songs, and crafts.
e.zh: 她对民俗生活的研究包括饮食、歌曲和手工艺。

folklike.t: 像民间故事的；民俗般的

e.en: The novel has a {folklike} rhythm and repeated phrases.
e.zh: 这部小说有民间故事般的节奏和反复出现的短语。

e.en: His paintings use {folklike} colors and simple shapes.
e.zh: 他的画作采用民俗般的色彩和简单形状。

e.en: The costume looked {folklorish} rather than historically accurate.
e.zh: 这套服装看起来带民俗味，而不是严格符合史实。

e.en: She added {folklorish} details to make the tale feel older.
e.zh: 她加入一些似民俗的细节，让故事显得更古老。

e.en: The village called a {folkmoot} to settle the boundary dispute.
e.zh: 村里召开民众大会来解决边界纠纷。

e.en: Historians compare the {folkmoot} with later town councils.
e.zh: 历史学家把古代民会同后来的市镇议会相比较。

e.en: Every {folknik} in town came to the coffeehouse concert.
e.zh: 城里的民谣迷都来参加咖啡馆音乐会。

e.en: He dressed like a sixties {folknik} with boots and a guitar.
e.zh: 他穿着靴子背着吉他，像六十年代的民谣迷。

e.en: The study examined {folkpsychiatry} in rural healing traditions.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了乡村疗愈传统中的民间精神疗法观念。

e.en: Her article contrasts clinical diagnosis with local {folkpsychiatry}.
e.zh: 她的文章把临床诊断与当地民间精神疗法观念作了对比。

e.en: An old {folksay} warns against planting before the last frost.
e.zh: 一句古老的民间说法告诫人们末霜前不要播种。

e.en: The writer filled the dialogue with regional {folksay}.
e.zh: 作者在对白中加入了地方俗谚。

folksey.t: 民俗味过重的；装乡土的

e.en: The hotel decor felt a little {folksey} to urban visitors.
e.zh: 在城市游客看来，酒店装饰有点装乡土。

e.en: His {folksey} jokes did not suit the formal dinner.
e.zh: 他那些民俗味过重的笑话不适合正式晚宴。

e.en: The host chatted {folksily} with everyone in the studio.
e.zh: 主持人在演播室里亲切随和地和每个人聊天。

e.en: She wrote {folksily} about harvest suppers and winter fires.
e.zh: 她用乡土味的笔调描写丰收晚餐和冬日炉火。

e.en: Voters liked the candidate's easy {folksiness}.
e.zh: 选民喜欢这位候选人自然的亲切随和。

e.en: The cafe's {folksiness} came from old photos and homemade pies.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的乡土气来自老照片和自制馅饼。

e.en: The camp ended each night with {folksinging} around the fire.
e.zh: 营地每天晚上都以围着火堆唱民谣结束。

e.en: She studied {folksinging} as part of oral tradition.
e.zh: 她把民歌演唱作为口头传统的一部分来研究。

e.en: The young {folkster} played banjo at the street fair.
e.zh: 那位年轻民谣艺人在街头集市上弹班卓琴。

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a nostalgic {folkster}.
e.zh: 评论家把他贬为怀旧的民俗派人物。

e.en: Sharing bread before a journey was an old {folkway}.
e.zh: 出行前分享面包是一种古老的民俗习惯。

e.en: Sociologists study each {folkway} that guides daily behavior.
e.zh: 社会学家研究引导日常行为的各种群体惯例。

folliberin.t: 促卵泡激素相关物质；卵泡刺激素释放因子类似物或旧称

e.en: The old paper described {folliberin} as a hormone-like substance.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文把促卵泡激素相关物质描述为一种类似激素的物质。

e.en: Few modern doctors would use the term {folliberin} in practice.
e.zh: 如今很少有医生会在实际工作中使用folliberin这个术语。

e.en: The pathologist noted a {folliculated} structure in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 病理学家在组织样本中发现了具滤泡的结构。

e.en: Some glands have a clearly {folliculated} appearance under the microscope.
e.zh: 有些腺体在显微镜下呈现明显的小囊状外观。

e.en: Early researchers used {folliculin} to refer to an ovarian hormone.
e.zh: 早期研究者用folliculin来指一种卵巢激素。

e.en: The textbook mentions {folliculin} only in a historical note.
e.zh: 这本教材只在历史注释中提到滤泡素这个旧称。

e.en: The dermatologist considered {folliculosis} after examining the rash.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生检查皮疹后考虑为毛囊病变。

e.en: Chronic {folliculosis} may require careful follow-up.
e.zh: 慢性滤泡增生症可能需要仔细复查。

e.en: Each {folliculus} contains a developing egg cell.
e.zh: 每个滤泡里都有一个正在发育的卵细胞。

e.en: A blocked hair {folliculus} can become inflamed.
e.zh: 堵塞的毛囊可能会发炎。

e.en: The museum displayed a bronze {follis} from the late Roman Empire.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一枚晚期罗马帝国的青铜follis钱币。

e.en: In Latin texts, {follis} can mean a bag or bellows.
e.zh: 在拉丁文献中，follis可指袋子或风箱。

e.en: The children played {follow-my-leader} across the playground.
e.zh: 孩子们在操场上玩跟着领头人做动作的游戏。

e.en: Their training felt like {follow-my-leader} rather than real thinking.
e.zh: 他们的训练感觉像盲目跟随，而不是真正思考。

e.en: The team scheduled a {follow-on} meeting for Friday.
e.zh: 团队把后续会议安排在星期五。

e.en: The drug showed promise in a {follow-on} study.
e.zh: 这种药在后续研究中显示出希望。

e.en: Several {follow-ons} were added after the first contract.
e.zh: 第一份合同之后又增加了几个后续项目。

e.en: The report lists possible {follow-ons} to the pilot program.
e.zh: 报告列出了试点项目可能的后续事项。

follow-the-leader.t: 跟随领头者游戏；盲目跟风

e.en: We played {follow-the-leader} on the way to school.
e.zh: 我们上学路上玩了跟随领头者的游戏。

e.en: The market turned into {follow-the-leader} after one bank raised rates.
e.zh: 一家银行加息后，市场变成了盲目跟风。

e.en: Her tennis {follow-through} looked smooth and controlled.
e.zh: 她打网球时的随球动作流畅而可控。

e.en: Good ideas fail without strong {follow-through}.
e.zh: 好想法如果没有有力执行也会失败。

e.en: The coach compared the players' {follow-throughs} after each swing.
e.zh: 教练比较了球员每次挥拍后的随球动作。

e.en: The manager praised their careful {follow-throughs} on client requests.
e.zh: 经理称赞他们对客户要求的细致跟进执行。

e.en: Please send a {follow-up} email after the meeting.
e.zh: 会后请发一封跟进邮件。

e.en: She has a {follow-up} appointment next week.
e.zh: 她下周有一次复诊预约。

e.en: The doctor scheduled two {follow-ups} after the surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术后安排了两次复诊。

e.en: I added the client {follow-ups} to my task list.
e.zh: 我把客户跟进事项加入了任务清单。

e.en: The clinic called to arrange a {followup} visit.
e.zh: 诊所打电话安排一次复查。

e.en: His {followup} message clarified the main request.
e.zh: 他的后续消息说明了主要请求。

follutein.t: 促黄体素旧称；相关激素制剂

e.en: The archive listed {follutein} among older hormone preparations.
e.zh: 档案把follutein列在较早的激素制剂之中。

e.en: Modern articles rarely use the term {follutein}.
e.zh: 现代文章很少使用follutein这个术语。

e.en: The speech was accused of {fomentation} of unrest.
e.zh: 那场演讲被指煽动动乱。

e.en: Warm {fomentation} eased the stiffness in her shoulder.
e.zh: 热敷缓解了她肩部的僵硬。

e.en: Dirty bedding can act as a {fomes} for infection.
e.zh: 脏床品可能成为传播感染的媒介物。

e.en: The old traveler kept dry {fomes} for starting fires.
e.zh: 那位老旅人保存干火绒用来生火。

e.en: The patient described {fomulation} as insects crawling under her skin.
e.zh: 患者把蚁行感描述成有虫子在皮肤下面爬。

e.en: Severe {fomulation} can disturb sleep and concentration.
e.zh: 严重的皮肤爬行感会影响睡眠和注意力。

e.en: The old prescription included {fondoform} as an antiseptic powder.
e.zh: 那张旧处方把fondoform列为一种消毒粉剂。

e.en: Few pharmacists today would recognize the name {fondoform}.
e.zh: 如今很少有药剂师会认得fondoform这个名称。

e.en: He {foolhardily} climbed the cliff without a rope.
e.zh: 他鲁莽地不带绳子就去攀登悬崖。

e.en: The team {foolhardily} ignored every safety warning.
e.zh: 那个团队有勇无谋地无视了所有安全警告。

e.en: Critics called the new regime a {foolocracy}.
e.zh: 批评者把这个新政权称为愚人统治。

e.en: The satire imagines a {foolocracy} run by loud incompetents.
e.zh: 这部讽刺作品想象了一个由吵闹无能者掌权的蠢人政治。

e.en: The old comic called every careless apprentice a {fooper}.
e.zh: 那位老喜剧演员把每个粗心学徒都叫作笨手笨脚的人。

e.en: Only a {fooper} would spill ink on the final contract.
e.zh: 只有闯祸的笨蛋才会把墨水洒在最终合同上。

e.en: The farm reported a {foot-and-mouth} outbreak in cattle.
e.zh: 这家农场报告牛群暴发了口蹄疫。

e.en: Officials imposed {foot-and-mouth} controls across the region.
e.zh: 官员在整个地区实施了口蹄疫防控措施。

e.en: Their {foot-dragging} delayed the project for months.
e.zh: 他们的拖延让项目耽误了好几个月。

e.en: The minister denied any {foot-dragging} over the reforms.
e.zh: 部长否认在改革问题上有任何故意磨蹭。

e.en: His {foot-in-mouth} comment offended half the room.
e.zh: 他说错话的评论得罪了房间里一半的人。

e.en: She has a {foot-in-mouth} habit during interviews.
e.zh: 她在采访中有失言的毛病。

e.en: The editor added a {foot-note} to explain the quote.
e.zh: 编辑加了一条脚注来解释这段引文。

e.en: His role became a {foot-note} in the history books.
e.zh: 他的角色后来成了史书中的一条附注。

e.zh: 每位步行乘客都从单独的入口登上渡轮。

e.zh: 这台发动机产生了一百英尺磅的扭矩。

e.zh: 英尺磅是英制体系中衡量功的单位。

e.zh: 这本教材通篇使用英尺磅秒制。

e.en: Older engineers still mention {foot-pound-second} units.
e.zh: 一些老工程师仍会提到英尺磅秒制单位。

e.zh: 这项计算得出的答案以英尺磅达表示。

e.en: A {foot-poundal} is rarely used in modern engineering.
e.zh: 英尺磅达在现代工程中很少使用。

e.zh: 那本旧手册用英尺吨列出了功的数值。

e.en: A {foot-ton} combines a foot and a ton-force.
e.zh: 英尺吨把英尺和吨力结合起来表示。

e.en: He won a small prize in the {football-pool}.
e.zh: 他在足球彩票中赢了一笔小奖金。

e.en: Their office runs a weekly {football-pool}.
e.zh: 他们办公室每周组织一次足球竞猜。

e.en: The sandal's {footband} rubbed against her skin.
e.zh: 凉鞋的脚带磨到了她的皮肤。

e.zh: 他踏上板子前先把脚带系紧。

e.en: She soaked her feet in a warm {footbath}.
e.zh: 她把脚泡在温热的足浴里。

e.en: The spa offers a herbal {footbath} before treatment.
e.zh: 这家水疗馆在护理前提供草本足浴。

e.en: A young {footboy} opened the carriage door.
e.zh: 一个年轻男仆打开了马车门。

e.en: The novel follows a {footboy} in a grand house.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述一座大宅里一名侍童的经历。

e.en: Press the {footbrake} before shifting into gear.
e.zh: 换挡前先踩下脚刹。

e.en: The bicycle has a rear {footbrake} for quick stops.
e.zh: 这辆自行车有后脚制动器，便于快速停车。

e.en: The room measured fifty {footcandles} at desk height.
e.zh: 房间在桌面高度测得五十英尺烛光。

e.en: Lighting codes often specify a minimum {footcandle} level.
e.zh: 照明规范常会规定最低英尺烛光水平。

e.en: The knight's horse wore a bright {footcloth}.
e.zh: 骑士的马披着一块鲜艳的马鞍垂布。

e.en: She wiped the spill with an old {footcloth}.
e.zh: 她用一块旧脚布擦掉了洒出的东西。

e.en: Management's {footdragging} angered the workers.
e.zh: 管理层的拖延激怒了工人。

e.en: There was no excuse for such {footdragging} on a safety issue.
e.zh: 在安全问题上这样故意磨蹭没有任何借口。

e.en: The carpenter used a {footdrill} for the small holes.
e.zh: 木匠用脚踏钻钻那些小孔。

e.en: The instructor began the class with basic {footdrill}.
e.zh: 教练以基础足部操练开始这堂课。

e.en: The umpire called a {footfault} on her serve.
e.zh: 裁判判她发球时脚误。

e.en: One {footfault} cost him the crucial point.
e.zh: 一次发球踩线让他丢掉了关键分。

e.en: The dancer wore a thin {footglove} for grip.
e.zh: 舞者穿了一只薄脚套来增加抓地力。

e.en: A {footglove} separates each toe like a hand glove.
e.zh: 五趾鞋像手套一样把每个脚趾分开。

e.en: He left {foothot} when the alarm sounded.
e.zh: 警报响起时他立即离开了。

e.en: The messenger came {foothot} with news from the coast.
e.zh: 信使急忙赶来，带来了海岸那边的消息。

e.en: The linguist identified each {fone} in the recording.
e.zh: 语言学家辨认出了录音中的每个语音单位。

e.en: A single {fone} can vary between speakers.
e.zh: 同一个音在不同说话者之间可能会有差异。

e.en: The researcher used a {fontactoscope} during the perception test.
e.zh: 研究人员在感知测试中使用了视触觉测验仪。

e.en: An old {fontactoscope} stood in the psychology laboratory.
e.zh: 心理学实验室里放着一台旧的视触觉测验仪。

e.en: The villagers protected the {fontal} spring from pollution.
e.zh: 村民们保护那处泉水源头免受污染。

e.en: A {fontal} basin stood near the chapel door.
e.zh: 教堂门旁放着一个洗礼用水盆。

e.en: The doctor gently checked the baby's {fontanel}.
e.zh: 医生轻轻检查了婴儿的囟门。

e.en: A sunken {fontanel} may signal dehydration.
e.zh: 囟门凹陷可能提示脱水。

e.en: The nurse examined the infant's {fontanelle}.
e.zh: 护士检查了婴儿的囟门。

e.en: Parents should avoid pressing on the baby's {fontanelle}.
e.zh: 父母应避免按压婴儿的囟门。

e.en: She wore a towering {fontange} at the costume ball.
e.zh: 她在化装舞会上戴了一顶高耸的丝带头饰。

e.en: The portrait shows a noblewoman in a lace {fontange}.
e.zh: 这幅肖像画中，一位贵妇戴着蕾丝高头饰。

e.en: The moss grew in a cool {fontinal} habitat.
e.zh: 这种苔藓生长在凉爽的泉边环境中。

e.en: They mapped the {fontinal} plants around the spring.
e.zh: 他们绘制了泉水周围泉生植物的分布图。

e.en: Rice is the main {food-crop} in the valley.
e.zh: 水稻是这个山谷的主要粮食作物。

e.en: Farmers switched from cotton to a drought-resistant {food-crop}.
e.zh: 农民从种棉花改种一种抗旱食用作物。

e.en: The tribe depended on {food-gathering} during the dry season.
e.zh: 这个部落在旱季依靠采集食物维持生活。

e.en: Modern hikers still learn basic {food-gathering} skills.
e.zh: 现代徒步者仍会学习基本的觅食技能。

e.en: We bought noodles from a busy {food-stall}.
e.zh: 我们在一个热闹的小吃摊买了面条。

e.en: Her family runs a {food-stall} near the station.
e.zh: 她家在车站附近经营一个食品摊位。

e.en: As a {foodaholic}, he plans trips around restaurants.
e.zh: 作为美食狂，他总是围绕餐馆来安排行程。

e.en: My sister calls herself a {foodaholic} with no shame.
e.zh: 我妹妹毫不害羞地自称是个贪吃的人。

e.en: The country imported more {foodgrain} after the floods.
e.zh: 洪水过后，这个国家进口了更多粮食谷物。

e.en: Wheat is an important {foodgrain} in this region.
e.zh: 小麦是这个地区重要的食用谷物。

e.en: The refugees spent two {foodless} days on the road.
e.zh: 难民们在路上度过了两天没有食物的日子。

e.en: A {foodless} pantry showed how desperate the family had become.
e.zh: 空无食物的储藏室显示出这家人已多么绝望。

e.en: The report described widespread {foodlessness} after the siege.
e.zh: 报告描述了围困之后普遍的缺粮状态。

e.en: Weeks of {foodlessness} weakened the trapped miners.
e.zh: 数周没有食物使被困矿工身体虚弱。

foofaraw.t: 大惊小怪；华而不实的装饰

e.en: The announcement caused a ridiculous {foofaraw} online.
e.zh: 这则公告在网上引起了一阵荒唐的大惊小怪。

e.en: The dress had too much {foofaraw} for a simple dinner.
e.zh: 这条裙子对一顿普通晚餐来说装饰太繁复了。

e.en: His youthful {fooleries} embarrassed him years later.
e.zh: 多年后，他年轻时的那些蠢事让他感到尴尬。

e.en: The play turns court politics into comic {fooleries}.
e.zh: 这出戏把宫廷政治变成了滑稽的愚蠢闹剧。

e.en: Stop this {foolery} and answer the question.
e.zh: 别再胡闹了，回答这个问题。

e.en: The novel treats human pride as tragic {foolery}.
e.zh: 这部小说把人的骄傲写成一种悲剧性的愚蠢。

e.en: The old workshop kept a {footlathe} near the window.
e.zh: 那间老工坊把一台脚踏车床放在窗边。

e.en: He shaped the wooden spindle on a {footlathe}.
e.zh: 他在脚踏车床上加工那根木轴。

e.en: The statue looked strange with its {footless} base.
e.zh: 这座雕像底部无脚，看起来很奇怪。

e.en: After the long climb, he felt almost {footless}.
e.zh: 长途攀登之后，他几乎觉得双脚站不稳了。

e.en: The dancer's {footmanship} impressed everyone in the hall.
e.zh: 那名舞者的步法让大厅里的所有人都很佩服。

e.en: Good {footmanship} matters as much as strength in fencing.
e.zh: 在击剑中，良好的脚上技巧和力量同样重要。

e.en: They continued at a steady {footpace} through the fog.
e.zh: 他们以稳定的步速穿过雾气。

e.en: The priest stood on the {footpace} before the altar.
e.zh: 牧师站在祭坛前的台阶平台上。

e.en: Press the {footpedal} gently to control the machine.
e.zh: 轻轻踩下脚踏板来控制机器。

e.en: The piano's right {footpedal} made the notes ring longer.
e.zh: 钢琴右侧的脚踏板让音符延续得更久。

e.en: The {footplateman} checked the engine before sunrise.
e.zh: 那名机车踏板工在日出前检查了引擎。

e.en: A tired {footplateman} shoveled coal beside the driver.
e.zh: 疲惫的司炉助手在司机旁边铲煤。

e.en: The sailor balanced carefully on the {footrope}.
e.zh: 水手小心地踩在帆桁下的脚索上保持平衡。

e.en: A worn {footrope} can make reefing the sail dangerous.
e.zh: 磨损的脚索会让收帆变得危险。

e.en: We had to {footslog} through miles of wet fields.
e.zh: 我们不得不艰难地步行穿过数英里的湿地。

e.en: She will {footslog} through the paperwork all weekend.
e.zh: 她整个周末都要苦干，把文书处理完。

e.en: They {footslogged} across the hills in heavy rain.
e.zh: 他们冒着大雨艰难跋涉过群山。

e.en: He {footslogged} through months of tedious research.
e.zh: 他苦干了几个月，完成了枯燥的研究。

e.en: Every seasoned {footslogger} knew the road was endless.
e.zh: 每个经验丰富的长途跋涉者都知道这条路像没有尽头。

e.en: She was a patient {footslogger} in local politics.
e.zh: 她在地方政治中是个耐心苦干的人。

e.en: After hours of {footslogging}, the village finally appeared.
e.zh: 艰难跋涉数小时后，村庄终于出现了。

e.en: The report required weeks of {footslogging} through archives.
e.zh: 这份报告需要连续数周在档案中苦苦查找。

e.en: He {footslogs} to work when the buses stop running.
e.zh: 公交停运时，他就艰难地步行去上班。

e.en: She {footslogs} through every dull assignment without complaint.
e.zh: 她毫无怨言地苦干，完成每项枯燥任务。

e.en: The hikers were {footsore} after crossing the valley.
e.zh: 徒步者穿过山谷后脚都走痛了。

e.zh: 一位脚痛的旅人在路边休息。

e.en: Her {footsoreness} faded after a warm bath.
e.zh: 洗了个热水澡后，她的脚痛减轻了。

e.en: New boots often cause {footsoreness} on long walks.
e.zh: 新靴子常会在长途步行时造成脚部酸痛。

e.en: Each leaf hung from a slender {footstalk}.
e.zh: 每片叶子都由一根细长的叶柄支撑着。

e.en: The botanist measured the flower's {footstalk} carefully.
e.zh: 植物学家仔细测量了那朵花的花梗。

e.en: His boot slipped from the {footstall} during the ride.
e.zh: 骑行时，他的靴子从马镫里滑了出来。

e.en: The falconer used a leather {footstall} to protect the bird's foot.
e.zh: 驯鹰人用皮脚套保护鸟的脚。

e.en: The machinist adjusted the {footstock} before turning the rod.
e.zh: 机械师在车削金属杆前调整了车床尾座。

e.en: The device included a wooden {footstock} for support.
e.zh: 这个装置带有一个木制脚部支架。

e.zh: 她坐在小路旁那块平坦的脚边石上。

e.zh: 那位脚步稳健的向导带我们沿悬崖小路下行。

e.zh: 她稳健的判断帮助团队避免了错误。

e.zh: 他们在餐桌下用脚互碰调情。

e.zh: 这起丑闻表明该公司在和监管方暗中勾连。

e.en: The miners drilled into the {footwall} of the vein.
e.zh: 矿工们钻入矿脉下方的下盘岩壁。

e.zh: 地质学家在规划隧道前绘制了下盘岩壁图。

e.zh: 冬天她在书桌下放了一个暖脚器。

e.zh: 那辆旧马车给乘客配有一个金属暖脚器。

e.zh: 一个瓶子滚进了驾驶员脚下的空间。

e.zh: 乘客座位的脚部空间太小，放不下他的腿。

e.zh: 一条被脚踩磨损的小路通向花园门口。

e.zh: 寺庙台阶经过数百年游客踩踏，已经磨损了。

e.zh: 他每周六早上都去踢球。

e.zh: 她竟然把那个简单的击球打砸了。

e.zh: 别再把开场白讲得乱七八糟。

e.zh: 那个年轻纨绔整理着自己的蕾丝袖口。

e.en: She mocked the {fopling} for his vanity.
e.zh: 她嘲笑那个装腔青年太爱慕虚荣。

e.en: He soon tired of courtly {fopperies}.
