e.zh: 柜门被拆掉后，旧柜子看起来没有了前脸。

e.en: A {frontless} helmet would offer little facial protection.
e.zh: 没有前部护面的头盔几乎保护不了脸部。

e.en: The box stood {frontlessly} open on the shelf.
e.zh: 盒子无遮无挡地敞在架子上。

e.en: The model was displayed {frontlessly} to show its inner frame.
e.zh: 模型以无前盖的方式展示，以便看清内部框架。

e.en: The horse wore a decorated {frontlet} during the parade.
e.zh: 游行时那匹马戴着装饰性的额饰。

e.en: She tied a narrow {frontlet} across her forehead.
e.zh: 她在额头上系了一条窄窄的额带。

frontloader.t: 前装式洗衣机；前装载机

e.en: We bought a quiet {frontloader} for the apartment.
e.zh: 我们给公寓买了一台安静的前装式洗衣机。

e.en: A {frontloader} moved gravel across the building site.
e.zh: 一辆前装载机在工地上搬运碎石。

e.en: Meteorologists tracked {frontogenesis} along the coast overnight.
e.zh: 气象学家连夜追踪沿海的锋生过程。

e.en: Strong {frontogenesis} can intensify bands of snowfall.
e.zh: 强烈的锋面形成会增强带状降雪。

e.en: The forecast mentioned {frontolysis} as the air masses mixed.
e.zh: 预报提到气团混合时会发生锋消。

e.en: Rapid {frontolysis} reduced the storm's sharp temperature contrast.
e.zh: 快速锋消削弱了风暴中明显的温差。

e.en: The players gathered at the {fronton} after work.
e.zh: 下班后，球员们聚集在回力球场。

e.en: A carved {fronton} crowned the entrance of the old building.
e.zh: 一座雕刻山花墙装饰着老建筑的入口上方。

e.en: The scandal became {frontpage} news by morning.
e.zh: 到早晨，这桩丑闻成了头版新闻。

e.en: The website's {frontpage} shows the latest articles.
e.zh: 这个网站的首页显示最新文章。

e.en: The seat has a {frontward} tilt for better posture.
e.zh: 这个座椅有向前的倾斜度，有助于改善坐姿。

e.en: He made a cautious {frontward} step in the dark hallway.
e.zh: 他在昏暗走廊里小心地向前迈了一步。

e.en: Move the chair {frontwards} until it touches the desk.
e.zh: 把椅子向前挪，直到碰到书桌。

e.en: The child leaned {frontwards} to see the screen.
e.zh: 孩子身体向前倾，想看清屏幕。

e.en: Place the box {frontways} so the label is visible.
e.zh: 把盒子正面朝前放，好让标签看得见。

e.en: The dancer turned {frontways} before taking a bow.
e.zh: 舞者转向正面后鞠了一躬。

e.en: The poet described a {frore} dawn over the fields.
e.zh: 诗人描写了田野上一个严寒结霜的黎明。

e.en: Their boots cracked the {frore} grass beside the road.
e.zh: 他们的靴子踩碎了路边结霜的草。

e.en: The village remained {frost-bound} for most of January.
e.zh: 这个村庄一月的大部分时间都被霜冻困住。

e.en: Ships waited outside the {frost-bound} harbor.
e.zh: 船只在冰封的港口外等待。

e.en: A line of {frost-weed} grew beside the dry creek.
e.zh: 干涸小溪旁长着一排霜草。

e.en: The children noticed ice ribbons on the {frost-weed}.
e.zh: 孩子们注意到霜草上结出了冰带。

e.en: His fingers were {frostbit} after the long climb.
e.zh: 长时间攀登后，他的手指冻伤了。

e.en: The {frostbit} leaves turned black overnight.
e.zh: 受霜害的叶子一夜之间变黑了。

frostbound.t: 被霜冻封住的；严寒中的

e.en: The valley lay {frostbound} until noon.
e.zh: 山谷一直被霜冻封住，直到中午才化开。

e.en: They crossed a {frostbound} field at dawn.
e.zh: 他们在黎明时穿过一片严寒结霜的田地。

e.en: Local fishermen call it a {frostfish}.
e.zh: 当地渔民把这种鱼叫作霜鱼。

e.en: A silver {frostfish} flashed under the ice.
e.zh: 一条银色的霜鱼在冰下闪了一下。

e.en: The {frostiness} of the room made us shiver.
e.zh: 房间里的寒意让我们发抖。

e.en: There was obvious {frostiness} in her voice.
e.zh: 她的声音里明显带着冷淡。

e.en: The island has a mostly {frostless} climate.
e.zh: 这座岛的气候大多没有霜冻。

e.en: Gardeners welcomed the {frostless} spring night.
e.zh: 园丁们很高兴迎来这个无霜的春夜。

e.en: Pipes must be buried below the {frostline}.
e.zh: 管道必须埋在冻土线以下。

e.en: The snow stopped just above the {frostline}.
e.zh: 积雪正好停在霜冻界线以上。

e.en: Choose a {frostproof} pot for winter plants.
e.zh: 冬季植物要选一个防霜冻的花盆。

e.en: The new valve is {frostproof} and durable.
e.zh: 这个新阀门抗冻而且耐用。

e.en: We found {frostweed} along the creek.
e.zh: 我们在小溪边发现了霜草。

e.en: The {frostweed} split open after the freeze.
e.zh: 霜冻过后，霜草的茎裂开了。

e.en: Delicate {frostwork} covered the window glass.
e.zh: 精细的冰霜花纹覆在窗玻璃上。

e.en: The silversmith copied natural {frostwork} patterns.
e.zh: 银匠仿照天然霜花纹饰制作图案。

e.en: The old {froth-blower} ordered another ale.
e.zh: 那个老啤酒客又点了一杯麦芽酒。

e.en: Critics called him a noisy {froth-blower}.
e.zh: 批评者说他只是个吵闹的空谈家。

e.en: The soap bubbled {frothily} in the sink.
e.zh: 肥皂水在水槽里泡沫翻涌。

e.en: He spoke {frothily} about instant success.
e.zh: 他轻浮空洞地谈着一夜成功。

e.en: The artist used {frottage} to capture the texture.
e.zh: 艺术家用拓印法捕捉表面的纹理。

e.en: Students tried {frottage} with leaves and coins.
e.zh: 学生们用树叶和硬币尝试拓印法。

e.en: A lace {frounce} trimmed the old gown.
e.zh: 旧长裙上饰有一圈蕾丝褶边。

e.en: The tailor will {frounce} the sleeve edges.
e.zh: 裁缝会把袖口边缘做成皱褶装饰。

e.en: She wore a {frounced} collar to the dance.
e.zh: 她戴着有褶边的衣领去参加舞会。

e.en: The fabric was {frounced} along the hem.
e.zh: 布料沿着下摆被打成皱褶。

e.en: The costume needed careful {frouncing} at the cuffs.
e.zh: 这套服装的袖口需要仔细做褶边处理。

e.en: She was {frouncing} the ribbon by hand.
e.zh: 她正在手工给丝带打皱褶。

e.en: He emerged in a {frouzy} old coat.
e.zh: 他穿着一件邋遢的旧外套走了出来。

e.en: The closed room smelled {frouzy} and stale.
e.zh: 那间封闭的房间闻起来霉臭而沉闷。

e.en: He split shingles with a sharp {frow}.
e.zh: 他用一把锋利的劈木刀劈木瓦。

e.en: The insult called her a {frow}.
e.zh: 那句侮辱把她称作粗俗女人。

e.en: The {froward} child refused every request.
e.zh: 那个任性的孩子拒绝了每一个要求。

e.en: His {froward} temper ruined the talks.
e.zh: 他倔强难管的脾气毁了谈判。

e.en: She answered {frowardly} and turned away.
e.zh: 她任性地回答了一句，然后转身走开。

e.en: He {frowardly} rejected all sensible advice.
e.zh: 他倔强地拒绝了所有明智的建议。

e.en: His {frowardness} tested the teacher's patience.
e.zh: 他的任性考验着老师的耐心。

e.en: The plan failed through sheer {frowardness}.
e.zh: 这个计划纯粹因为倔强固执而失败。

e.en: The toddler made {frownies} at the camera.
e.zh: 那个幼儿对着镜头做出皱眉表情。

e.en: No {frownies} are allowed at this party.
e.zh: 这个聚会上不许摆出不高兴的脸。

e.en: The room was full of {frowst} and smoke.
e.zh: 房间里满是闷热污浊的空气和烟味。

e.en: They would {frowst} indoors all winter.
e.zh: 他们整个冬天都会闷在屋里不出去。

e.en: The {fruitarian} ate only ripe mangoes and bananas.
e.zh: 那位果食者只吃熟芒果和香蕉。

e.en: A strict {fruitarian} may avoid seeds that harm the plant.
e.zh: 严格的果食者可能会避免食用会伤害植物的种子。

fruiteress.t: 女水果商；卖水果的女人

e.en: The {fruiteress} arranged oranges outside her small shop.
e.zh: 那位女水果商把橙子摆在小店外。

e.en: In the old market, a {fruiteress} called out her prices.
e.zh: 在旧市场里，一个卖水果的女人高声报着价格。

e.en: Several {fruiteries} opened near the busy station.
e.zh: 繁忙车站附近开了好几家水果店。

e.en: The estate once included orchards and small {fruiteries}.
e.zh: 这处庄园过去包括果园和一些小型果树园。

e.en: She bought peaches at the corner {fruitery}.
e.zh: 她在街角的水果店买了桃子。

e.en: The old {fruitery} supplied apples to the village.
e.zh: 那片老果树园曾向村里供应苹果。

e.en: The drink smelled {fruitily} of pears and apples.
e.zh: 这杯饮料散发着梨和苹果的果香。

e.en: He laughed {fruitily} in a deep, theatrical voice.
e.zh: 他用低沉而夸张的声音圆润地笑了起来。

e.en: The poem describes a {fruitive} pleasure in simple things.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了从简单事物中获得的享受。

e.en: Her {fruitive} reading of the text focused on delight.
e.zh: 她对文本的享受式解读重在其中的愉悦感。

e.en: Each {fruitlet} contains a tiny seed.
e.zh: 每个小果实里都有一粒细小的种子。

e.en: A raspberry is made of many small {fruitlets}.
e.zh: 一颗覆盆子由许多小果组成。

e.en: The chair was made from polished {fruitwood}.
e.zh: 这把椅子是用抛光果木制成的。

e.en: Chefs often smoke meat over {fruitwood}.
e.zh: 厨师常用果木烟熏肉类。

e.en: The archaeologists found {frumentaceous} remains in the jar.
e.zh: 考古学家在罐中发现了谷物残留。

e.en: The bread had a dense, {frumentaceous} flavor.
e.zh: 这种面包有一种浓厚的谷物风味。

e.en: The medieval feast included bowls of {frumenty}.
e.zh: 中世纪宴席上有一碗碗牛奶煮麦粥。

e.en: She served warm {frumenty} with honey.
e.zh: 她端上加了蜂蜜的温热麦粥。

e.en: The recipe for {frumety} used cracked wheat and milk.
e.zh: 这道麦仁粥的做法用了碎麦和牛奶。

e.en: At the fair, visitors tasted traditional {frumety}.
e.zh: 在集市上，游客品尝了传统的牛奶煮麦粥。

e.en: He dressed {frumpily} for the formal dinner.
e.zh: 他参加正式晚宴时穿得很土气。

e.en: The coat hung {frumpily} around her shoulders.
e.zh: 那件外套松垮邋遢地挂在她肩上。

frumpish.t: 土气的；衣着古板邋遢的

e.en: The old cardigan looked rather {frumpish}.
e.zh: 那件旧开衫看起来相当土气。

e.en: She feared the uniform made her seem {frumpish}.
e.zh: 她担心这套制服让她显得古板邋遢。

e.en: She smiled, though she felt {frumpishly} dressed.
e.zh: 她笑了笑，虽然觉得自己穿得很土气。

e.en: The curtains hung {frumpishly} in the dusty room.
e.zh: 窗帘在满是灰尘的房间里显得古板又邋遢。

e.en: The old biscuit had a dry {frurow} texture.
e.zh: 那块旧饼干呈现出干燥易碎的质地。

e.en: The chemist noted the material's unusual {frurow}.
e.zh: 化学家记录了这种材料不寻常的脆性。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {frusemide} for severe fluid retention.
e.zh: 医生为严重水肿开了呋塞米。

e.en: Patients taking {frusemide} may need potassium checks.
e.zh: 服用呋塞米的患者可能需要检查钾水平。

e.en: Only a {frust} of the old statue remained.
e.zh: 那座旧雕像只剩下一块碎片。

e.en: The manuscript survived as a {frust} in the archive.
e.zh: 这份手稿以残篇形式保存在档案馆中。

e.en: The diagram shows two cone {frusta} side by side.
e.zh: 图中并排显示了两个截头锥体。

e.en: Engineers calculated the volumes of the {frusta}.
e.zh: 工程师计算了这些截头体的体积。

e.en: The delays had a {frustrative} effect on the team.
e.zh: 这些延误对团队造成了令人受挫的影响。

e.en: A {frustrative} rule blocked every simple solution.
e.zh: 一条令人挫败的规定挡住了所有简单办法。

e.en: Each diatom has a glassy {frustule}.
e.zh: 每个硅藻都有一个玻璃状的硅藻壳。

e.en: A tiny {frustule} broke from the mineral sample.
e.zh: 矿物样本上掉下了一小块碎片。

e.en: The microscope revealed delicate {frustules} in the water.
e.zh: 显微镜显示水中有精细的硅藻壳。

e.en: The broken vase left small {frustules} on the floor.
e.zh: 破碎的花瓶在地板上留下了一些小碎片。

e.en: The lampshade forms a simple {frustum}.
e.zh: 这个灯罩形成了一个简单的截头锥体。

e.en: They measured the {frustum} of the square pyramid.
e.zh: 他们测量了这个方棱锥的截头体。

e.en: The model used several plastic {frustums}.
e.zh: 这个模型用了几个塑料截头体。

e.en: Students compared cylinders with cone {frustums}.
e.zh: 学生们把圆柱体和截头锥体作了比较。

frutescence.t: 灌木状生长；灌木性状况

e.en: The botanist described the plant's {frutescence} in the field notes.
e.zh: 植物学家在野外记录中描述了这种植物的灌木状生长。

e.en: Dense {frutescence} made the slope difficult to survey.
e.zh: 茂密的灌木状植被让这片山坡很难勘察。

e.en: The herb becomes {frutescent} in dry coastal soil.
e.zh: 这种草本在干燥的海岸土壤中会变成近灌木状。

e.en: A {frutescent} growth covered the abandoned terrace.
e.zh: 废弃梯田上覆盖着灌木状的生长物。

e.en: The lichen formed a {frutescose} mass on the branch.
e.zh: 地衣在树枝上形成了一团灌木状结构。

e.en: Researchers noted the plant's {frutescose} habit after flowering.
e.zh: 研究人员注意到这种植物开花后呈现似灌木的习性。

e.en: The old glossary defines {frutex} as a small woody shrub.
e.zh: 那本旧词汇表把frutex解释为一种小型木本灌木。

e.en: A single {frutex} survived beside the stone wall.
e.zh: 石墙旁还存活着一株灌木。

e.en: The dialect poem speaks of a {fruther} shore beyond the mist.
e.zh: 那首方言诗写到雾外还有更远的海岸。

e.en: She asked for {fruther} proof before signing the paper.
e.zh: 她要求有进一步证据后才签署文件。

e.en: He reached the {fruthest} field before sunset.
e.zh: 他在日落前走到了最远的那片田地。

e.en: The editor kept only the {fruthest} implication of the argument.
e.zh: 编辑只保留了这个论点最进一步的含义。

e.en: The path ended in a neglected {fruticetum}.
e.zh: 小路尽头是一片无人打理的灌木丛。

e.en: Students mapped every species in the garden's {fruticetum}.
e.zh: 学生们绘制了园中灌木园里每个物种的分布。

fruticole.t: 生于灌木上的；栖灌木的

e.en: The survey focused on {fruticole} insects living among the shrubs.
e.zh: 这项调查关注生活在灌木间的栖灌木昆虫。

e.en: A {fruticole} moss spread across the old hedge.
e.zh: 一种生于灌木上的苔藓蔓延在老树篱上。

e.en: The {fruticose} lichen stood upright like tiny coral.
e.zh: 这种灌木状地衣直立着，像小珊瑚一样。

e.en: Its {fruticose} stems made the plant easy to identify.
e.zh: 它多枝的茎让这种植物很容易辨认。

e.en: We ordered a huge {fry-up} after the early train ride.
e.zh: 坐完清晨的火车后，我们点了一份很大的英式煎早餐。

e.en: A weekend {fry-up} is too heavy for me now.
e.zh: 现在周末吃一顿油煎大餐对我来说太腻了。

e.en: The cafe serves cheap {fry-ups} until noon.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆中午前供应便宜的英式煎早餐。

e.en: Too many late-night {fry-ups} upset his stomach.
e.zh: 太多次深夜油煎大餐让他的胃不舒服。

e.en: She heated the {fryingpan} before adding the eggs.
e.zh: 她先把煎锅加热，然后才放鸡蛋。

e.en: The old {fryingpan} had a loose handle.
e.zh: 那只旧平底锅的把手松了。

e.en: Put the sliced onions in the {frypan}.
e.zh: 把切好的洋葱放进煎锅里。

e.en: He bought a small {frypan} for camping trips.
e.zh: 他买了一只小平底锅，露营时用。

e.en: He tried to {fub} the inspector with vague answers.
e.zh: 他想用含糊的回答搪塞检查员。

e.en: Do not {fub} me with another weak excuse.
e.zh: 别再拿一个站不住脚的借口来敷衍我。

e.en: The database was {fubar} after the failed migration.
e.zh: 迁移失败后，数据库彻底乱套了。

e.en: By midnight, the whole schedule looked {fubar}.
e.zh: 到午夜时，整个日程看起来已经一团糟。

e.en: A {fubsy} little man hurried into the shop.
e.zh: 一个矮胖的小个子男人匆匆走进店里。

e.en: The old chair had short, {fubsy} legs.
e.zh: 那把旧椅子的腿短短粗粗的。

e.en: The technician stained the slide with {fuchsin}.
e.zh: 技术员用品红染料给玻片染色。

e.en: Old recipes used {fuchsin} to produce a vivid red.
e.zh: 旧配方使用品红染料来产生鲜艳的红色。

e.en: The sample turned bright pink after adding {fuchsine}.
e.zh: 加入碱性品红后，样本变成了亮粉色。

e.en: A drop of {fuchsine} marked the damaged tissue.
e.zh: 一滴品红染料标出了受损组织。

e.en: The chemist discussed {fuchsone} in a lecture on dyes.
e.zh: 化学家在一堂关于染料的课上讲到了品红酮。

e.en: A {fuchsone} derivative produced a strong color reaction.
e.zh: 一种品红酮衍生物产生了强烈的显色反应。

frowsty.t: 闷热霉臭的；邋遢的灰尘味的

e.en: The attic was {frowsty} after years without fresh air.
e.zh: 阁楼多年不通风，闷热又有霉臭味。

e.en: He emerged from the tent in a {frowsty} old coat.
e.zh: 他穿着一件邋遢发闷的旧外套从帐篷里出来。

e.en: She came downstairs {frowzily}, still half asleep.
e.zh: 她头发蓬乱地走下楼，还半睡半醒。

e.en: The blankets were piled {frowzily} on the narrow bed.
e.zh: 毯子凌乱地堆在那张窄床上。

e.en: The room's {frowziness} made the visitors open a window.
e.zh: 房间里那股闷臭邋遢的感觉让访客打开了窗。

e.en: He tried to hide the {frowziness} of his hair with a cap.
e.zh: 他想用帽子遮住自己蓬乱不整的头发。

e.en: The carpenter used a {froy} to split the shingles.

e.zh: 泌尿科医生建议对这个小肿瘤进行电灼术。

e.en: The hikers found a fragile {fulgurite} in the sand.
e.zh: 徒步者在沙中发现了一根脆弱的闪电熔岩管。

e.en: A {fulgurite} forms when lightning melts soil or sand.
e.zh: 闪电熔岩管是在闪电熔化土壤或沙子时形成的。

e.en: A {fulgurous} flash split the heavy clouds.
e.zh: 一道闪电般的亮光劈开了厚重的云层。

e.en: The painter used {fulgurous} gold across the saint's halo.
e.zh: 画家在圣人的光环上用了闪耀的金色。

e.en: The room's {fuliginosity} came from years of candle smoke.
e.zh: 房间里的烟黑来自多年蜡烛烟熏。

e.en: He liked the {fuliginosity} of the old industrial skyline.
e.zh: 他喜欢旧工业天际线那种煤烟般的暗色。

e.en: A {fuliginous} haze hung over the factory district.
e.zh: 一层烟黑的雾霾笼罩着工厂区。

e.en: The artist painted the alley in {fuliginous} browns and grays.
e.zh: 画家用煤烟色的棕灰色调描绘那条小巷。

e.en: The chimney smoked {fuliginously} all morning.
e.zh: 烟囱整个上午都冒着烟黑的烟。

e.en: The scene was lit {fuliginously} by a dying lamp.
e.zh: 那一幕被将熄的灯照得阴暗如烟。

e.en: The {full-back} blocked the winger near the corner flag.
e.zh: 那名边后卫在角旗附近挡住了边锋。

e.en: She played {full-back} for the school rugby team.
e.zh: 她在学校橄榄球队里打后卫。

e.en: Both {full-backs} pushed forward during the attack.
e.zh: 两名边后卫在进攻时都压了上去。

e.en: Modern {full-backs} need speed and stamina.
e.zh: 现代边后卫需要速度和耐力。

e.en: The committee gave a {full-blooded} defense of the policy.
e.zh: 委员会对这项政策作出了热烈而彻底的辩护。

e.en: The novel features a {full-blooded} portrait of village life.
e.zh: 这部小说生动饱满地描绘了乡村生活。

e.en: The performance had a {full-bloodedness} that critics admired.
e.zh: 这场演出有一种充沛活力，令评论家赞赏。

e.en: He missed the {full-bloodedness} of the earlier political debate.
e.zh: 他怀念早期政治辩论那种热烈彻底的劲头。

e.en: The team launched a {full-bore} campaign before the election.
e.zh: 团队在选举前发起了一场全力以赴的宣传活动。

e.en: The engine was running {full-bore} down the straight road.
e.zh: 发动机在笔直的道路上全速运转。

full-bottomed.t: 臀部丰满的；底部宽大的

e.en: The old chair had a {full-bottomed} shape.
e.zh: 那把旧椅子的底部很宽大。

e.en: She wore a {full-bottomed} eighteenth-century gown.
e.zh: 她穿着一件裙摆丰厚的十八世纪礼服。

full-dress.t: 正式礼服的；全套正式的

e.en: The officers attended in {full-dress} uniform.
e.zh: 军官们穿着全套礼服出席。

e.en: They held a {full-dress} rehearsal before opening night.
e.zh: 开演前他们进行了一次完整彩排。

e.en: He bought a {full-face} helmet for the motorcycle.
e.zh: 他为骑摩托买了一顶全盔。

e.en: The passport photo must show a {full-face} view.
e.zh: 护照照片必须显示正面脸部。

full-faced.t: 脸庞丰满的；正面朝向的

e.en: The {full-faced} child smiled at the camera.
e.zh: 那个脸庞圆润的孩子对着镜头微笑。

e.en: A {full-faced} portrait hung above the desk.
e.zh: 一幅正面肖像挂在书桌上方。

full-fashioned.t: 全成形针织的；按形织成的

e.en: She preferred {full-fashioned} stockings with shaped seams.
e.zh: 她更喜欢带有成形接缝的全成形长袜。

e.en: The label described the sweater as {full-fashioned}.
e.zh: 标签说明这件毛衣是按形织成的。

full-fleshed.t: 肉感丰满的；写得充实的

e.en: The painter favored {full-fleshed} figures in warm light.
e.zh: 画家偏爱暖光中肉感丰满的人物。

e.en: Her draft became a {full-fleshed} argument after revision.
e.zh: 修改后，她的草稿变成了论证充实的文章。

full-frontal.t: 正面全裸的；直截了当的

e.en: The film includes brief {full-frontal} nudity.
e.zh: 这部电影有短暂的正面全裸镜头。

e.en: The report made a {full-frontal} attack on corruption.
e.zh: 这份报告直截了当地抨击腐败。

e.en: A {full-grown} tiger needs a large territory.
e.zh: 一只成年老虎需要很大的领地。

e.en: The seedling became a {full-grown} tree.
e.zh: 那株幼苗长成了一棵大树。

e.en: The comedian played to a {full-house} crowd.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员面对满场观众演出。

e.en: She won the hand with a {full-house}.
e.zh: 她用一手葫芦牌赢了这一局。

e.en: She wore a {full-length} coat in winter.
e.zh: 冬天她穿了一件长及脚踝的大衣。

e.en: The site posted a {full-length} interview online.
e.zh: 网站在线发布了完整访谈。

e.en: The truck carried a {full-load} of bricks.
e.zh: 卡车满载着砖块。

e.en: The server runs hot under {full-load}.
e.zh: 服务器在全负荷运行时会发热。

e.en: The storm became {full-on} by midnight.
e.zh: 到午夜时，暴风雨变得非常猛烈。

e.en: Their debate turned into a {full-on} argument.
e.zh: 他们的辩论变成了激烈争吵。

e.en: The dancers went {full-out} during the finale.
e.zh: 舞者们在终场时全力表演。

e.en: The team made a {full-out} effort to finish.
e.zh: 团队竭尽全力完成任务。

e.en: The newspaper ran a {full-page} advertisement.
e.zh: 报纸刊登了一整版广告。

e.en: Her article included a {full-page} photograph.
e.zh: 她的文章配了一张整页照片。

e.en: A {full-rigged} ship entered the harbor.
e.zh: 一艘全帆装船驶入港口。

e.en: The expedition used a {full-rigged} camp kitchen.
e.zh: 探险队使用了装备齐全的营地厨房。

e.en: The army launched a {full-scale} attack.
e.zh: 军队发动了全面进攻。

e.en: Engineers built a {full-scale} model of the bridge.
e.zh: 工程师建造了一座桥的原尺寸模型。

e.en: They bought a {full-size} refrigerator for the kitchen.
e.zh: 他们给厨房买了一台标准尺寸的冰箱。

e.en: Click the image to see the {full-size} version.
e.zh: 点击图片可查看全尺寸版本。

e.en: The room has two {full-sized} beds.
e.zh: 房间里有两张标准尺寸的床。

e.en: A {full-sized} replica stood in the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆里陈列着一个足尺寸复制品。

e.en: Use {full-strength} cleaner on stubborn stains.
e.zh: 顽固污渍要用原浓度清洁剂。

e.en: The squad returned to {full-strength} after injuries healed.
e.zh: 伤员恢复后，队伍又回到满员状态。

e.en: The crowd gave a {full-throated} cheer.
e.zh: 人群发出高声欢呼。

e.en: She offered a {full-throated} defense of the policy.
e.zh: 她毫不保留地为这项政策辩护。

full-word.t: 完整单词的；全字形式的

e.en: Search using a {full-word} match only.
e.zh: 搜索时只使用完整单词匹配。

e.en: Please write the {full-word} form, not initials.
e.zh: 请写完整单词形式，不要写首字母缩写。

fullblown.t: 成熟完整的；全面爆发的

e.en: The disagreement became a {fullblown} crisis.
e.zh: 这场分歧演变成了全面危机。

e.en: Her hobby turned into a {fullblown} business.
e.zh: 她的爱好发展成了一门成熟生意。

e.en: Several old {fulleries} once stood by the river.
e.zh: 河边曾经有几座旧缩呢厂。

e.en: The historian mapped medieval {fulleries} in the town.
e.zh: 历史学家标出了镇上的中世纪漂洗作坊。

e.en: The ruined {fullery} still smelled of damp wool.
e.zh: 那座废弃的缩呢厂仍有潮湿羊毛的气味。

e.en: A waterwheel powered the village {fullery}.
e.zh: 一个水轮为村里的漂洗作坊提供动力。

e.en: The medicine contains a {fumarate} salt for better absorption.
e.zh: 这种药含有富马酸盐，以便更好吸收。

e.en: Researchers measured {fumarate} levels in the cell sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了细胞样本中的延胡索酸盐水平。

e.en: {Fumaric} acid is used as a food additive.
e.zh: 富马酸可用作食品添加剂。

e.en: The chemist studied a {fumaric} acid derivative.
e.zh: 化学家研究了一种延胡索酸衍生物。

e.en: The compound showed a {fumaroid} structure in the analysis.
e.zh: 分析显示该化合物具有类似富马酸的结构。

e.en: A {fumaroid} haze drifted over the old kiln.
e.zh: 一层烟状薄雾飘过旧窑。

e.en: The reaction introduced a {fumaroyl} group into the molecule.
e.zh: 该反应把一个富马酰基引入了分子中。

e.en: They compared several {fumaroyl} derivatives in the lab.
e.zh: 他们在实验室比较了几种延胡索酰基衍生物。

e.en: The herbs were dried in a small {fumatorium}.
e.zh: 这些草药在一个小熏蒸室里干燥。

e.en: The old bathhouse included a warm {fumatorium}.
e.zh: 那座旧浴场里有一间温热的烟熏房。

e.en: The workers prepared a {fumatory} chamber for the seeds.
e.zh: 工人们为种子准备了一间熏蒸室。

e.en: A {fumatory} smell lingered in the storage room.
e.zh: 储藏室里残留着一股烟熏气味。

e.en: The chef reduced the fish {fumet} before adding cream.
e.zh: 厨师先把浓鱼汤收浓，再加入奶油。

e.en: The hunter noticed the sharp {fumet} of game.
e.zh: 猎人闻到了明显的野味气味。

e.en: The paper described {fumigacin} as an antibiotic substance.
e.zh: 论文把烟曲霉素类物质描述为一种抗生物质。

e.en: Scientists tested {fumigacin} against several fungal strains.
e.zh: 科学家用烟曲霉素测试了几种真菌菌株。

e.en: The {fumigator} treated the warehouse overnight.
e.zh: 熏蒸人员连夜处理了那座仓库。

e.en: A portable {fumigator} released smoke into the hive.
e.zh: 一台便携式熏蒸器向蜂箱里释放烟雾。

e.en: They used a {fumigatory} treatment to kill pests.
e.zh: 他们采用熏蒸处理来杀灭害虫。

e.en: The manual lists several {fumigatory} chemicals.
e.zh: 手册列出了几种用于熏蒸的化学品。

e.en: Wild {fumitory} grew along the field edge.
e.zh: 野生延胡索草长在田边。

e.en: The herbalist dried {fumitory} for a bitter tea.
e.zh: 草药师晒干紫堇属草本，用来泡带苦味的茶。

e.en: A thin {fumulus} rose from the candle.
e.zh: 一缕细烟从蜡烛上升起。

e.en: The volcano released only a faint {fumulus}.
e.zh: 火山只释放出一小股淡淡的烟气。

e.en: The kitchen became {fumy} after the oil burned.
e.zh: 油烧焦后，厨房变得烟雾弥漫。

e.en: He stepped out of the {fumy} tavern for air.
e.zh: 他走出烟气很重的酒馆透气。

e.en: Her {fun-loving} brother plans every family game night.
e.zh: 她那个爱玩的哥哥会安排每次家庭游戏夜。

e.en: The ad targets {fun-loving} travelers with flexible schedules.
e.zh: 这则广告面向行程灵活、爱享乐的旅行者。

e.en: {Funambulism} requires balance, focus, and steady nerves.
e.zh: 走钢丝表演需要平衡力、专注和稳定的胆量。

e.en: The festival included a lecture on {funambulism}.
e.zh: 节日活动中有一场关于绳索行走的讲座。

e.en: The {funambulist} crossed the square above the crowd.
e.zh: 走钢丝者从人群上方横穿广场。

e.en: A skilled {funambulist} keeps each movement small.
e.zh: 熟练的绳索表演者会让每个动作都很小。

e.en: The building has a plain, {functionalistic} design.
e.zh: 这栋建筑采用朴素的功能主义设计。

e.en: His essay takes a {functionalistic} view of culture.
e.zh: 他的文章从功能主义角度看待文化。

e.en: Surface {functionalization} improved the material's adhesion.
e.zh: 表面功能化提高了这种材料的附着力。

e.en: The lab studied {functionalization} of the polymer chain.
e.zh: 实验室研究了聚合物链的官能团引入。

e.en: They {functionalize} the surface before coating it.
e.zh: 他们在涂层前先使表面功能化。

e.en: Chemists can {functionalize} the molecule at one site.
e.zh: 化学家可以在分子的一个位置引入官能团。

e.en: The old valve still seemed to {functionate} under pressure.
e.zh: 这个旧阀门在压力下似乎仍能发挥作用。

e.en: Each part must {functionate} within the larger system.
e.zh: 每个部分都必须在更大的系统中执行功能。

e.en: A {functor} maps objects and arrows between categories.
e.zh: 函子把范畴之间的对象和箭头对应起来。

e.en: In this grammar, the word acts as a {functor}.
e.zh: 在这套语法中，这个词起功能词作用。

fund-holder.t: 基金持有人；资金保管方

e.en: Each {fund-holder} received a quarterly statement.
e.zh: 每位基金持有人都收到了一份季度报表。

e.en: The charity named a bank as the {fund-holder}.
e.zh: 该慈善机构指定一家银行作为资金保管方。

e.en: She worked as a {fund-raiser} for the hospital.
e.zh: 她为那家医院做募款工作。

e.en: The school held a {fund-raiser} on Saturday.
e.zh: 学校星期六举办了一场筹款活动。

e.en: Only clearly planned projects are {fundable}.
e.zh: 只有规划清楚的项目才可获得资助。

e.en: The idea became {fundable} after the pilot succeeded.
e.zh: 试点成功后，这个想法变得值得拨款支持。

fundamentalistic.t: 原教旨主义的；极端守旧的

e.en: The speech had a {fundamentalistic} tone.
e.zh: 这场演讲带有原教旨主义的口吻。

e.en: Critics rejected his {fundamentalistic} reading of the law.
e.zh: 批评者反对他对法律的极端守旧解读。

e.en: The theory stresses the {fundamentality} of human rights.
e.zh: 该理论强调人权的根本性。

e.en: They debated the {fundamentality} of mathematics to science.
e.zh: 他们争论数学对科学的基础地位。

e.en: The report described rare {fundatrigenia} in the patient.
e.zh: 报告描述了患者罕见的眼底病变。

e.en: Specialists discussed {fundatrigenia} during the eye conference.
e.zh: 专家们在眼科会议上讨论了眼底性疾病。

e.en: The doctor examined both ocular {fundi}.
e.zh: 医生检查了双眼的眼底。

e.en: The museum compared the {fundi} of several ancient vessels.
e.zh: 博物馆比较了几件古代器皿的底部。

fundo.t: 原教旨主义者；极端保守者

e.en: He was dismissed as a political {fundo}.
e.zh: 他被人贬称为政治上的极端保守者。

e.en: The columnist mocked the {fundo} for rejecting compromise.
e.zh: 专栏作者嘲笑那个原教旨主义者拒绝妥协。

e.en: The quartet played a {funebre} movement.
e.zh: 四重奏演奏了一个葬礼风格的乐章。

e.en: Her poem carried a slow, {funebre} rhythm.
e.zh: 她的诗带着缓慢而哀悼的节奏。

e.en: The chapel kept several {funebrial} ornaments.
e.zh: 小礼拜堂保存着几件丧葬饰物。

e.en: They studied {funebrial} customs in medieval towns.
e.zh: 他们研究了中世纪城镇的葬礼习俗。

e.en: The minister made a {funest} decision.
e.zh: 部长作出了一个灾难性的决定。

e.en: A {funest} silence followed the announcement.
e.zh: 公告之后是一阵不祥的沉默。

e.en: A {fungaceous} growth covered the damp wall.
e.zh: 潮湿的墙上长满了真菌似的东西。

e.en: The botanist noted a {fungaceous} smell in the soil.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到土壤里有一股真菌味。

e.en: Cash has high {fungibility} in daily trade.
e.zh: 现金在日常交易中具有很高的可替代性。

e.en: The lawyer questioned the {fungibility} of the assets.
e.zh: 律师质疑这些资产的互换性。

e.en: The farmer sprayed a {fungicidal} solution on the vines.
e.zh: 农民把杀真菌溶液喷在葡萄藤上。

e.en: This cream has a mild {fungicidal} effect.
e.zh: 这种乳膏有温和的抗真菌作用。

e.en: The culture was treated with {fungicidin} overnight.
e.zh: 培养物用制霉菌素处理了一整夜。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {fungicidin} for certain infections.
e.zh: 医生过去会用制霉菌素治疗某些感染。

e.en: The tongue has small {fungiform} papillae.
e.zh: 舌头上有小小的菌状乳头。

e.en: A {fungiform} cloud rose above the field.
e.zh: 一团蘑菇状的云在田野上空升起。

fungilin.t: 抗真菌素；制霉菌素制剂

e.en: The pharmacist checked the dose of {fungilin}.
e.zh: 药剂师核对了抗真菌素的剂量。

e.en: Older records mention {fungilin} for yeast infections.
e.zh: 较早的记录提到用抗真菌素治疗酵母菌感染。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {fungin}.
e.zh: 样本中含有少量真菌素。

e.en: Researchers analyzed {fungin} in the cell wall.
e.zh: 研究人员分析了细胞壁中的真菌物质。

funginert.t: 对真菌惰性的；不受真菌影响的

e.en: The coating is {funginert} under humid conditions.
e.zh: 这种涂层在潮湿条件下对真菌呈惰性。

e.en: They selected a {funginert} material for the lab surface.
e.zh: 他们为实验台面选择了不受真菌影响的材料。

fungistasis.t: 抑真菌作用；真菌生长停滞

e.en: Low temperature caused {fungistasis} in the stored grain.
e.zh: 低温使储存谷物中的真菌生长停滞。

e.en: The study measured {fungistasis} after drug exposure.
e.zh: 研究测量了用药后的抑真菌作用。

e.en: The preservative works as a {fungistat}.
e.zh: 这种防腐剂起到抑真菌剂的作用。

e.en: They added a {fungistat} to the paint.
e.zh: 他们在油漆中加入了一种防霉剂。

e.en: The drug is {fungistatic}, not fungicidal.
e.zh: 这种药是抑制真菌生长的，而不是杀真菌的。

e.en: A {fungistatic} coating protected the stored books.
e.zh: 一层防霉涂层保护了存放的书籍。

e.en: The chemist isolated {fungisterol} from the mold.
e.zh: 化学家从霉菌中分离出真菌甾醇。

e.en: Some textbooks use {fungisterol} for fungal sterols.
e.zh: 有些教材用真菌甾醇一词指真菌中的甾醇。

fungitoxic.t: 对真菌有毒的；杀真菌的

e.en: The lab tested a {fungitoxic} compound on infected leaves.
e.zh: 实验室在受感染的叶片上测试了一种对真菌有毒的化合物。

e.en: Some plant oils have {fungitoxic} effects in storage.
e.zh: 有些植物油在储存中具有抑杀真菌的作用。

fungitoxicity.t: 对真菌的毒性；杀真菌性

e.en: Researchers measured the {fungitoxicity} of the new spray.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种新喷剂对真菌的毒性。

e.en: High {fungitoxicity} can protect grain from mold.
e.zh: 较强的杀真菌性可以保护谷物不发霉。

fungivorous.t: 食真菌的；以真菌为食的

e.en: A {fungivorous} beetle bored into the mushroom cap.
e.zh: 一只食真菌的甲虫钻进了蘑菇伞盖。

e.en: The study focused on {fungivorous} mites in the soil.
e.zh: 这项研究关注土壤中以真菌为食的螨类。

e.en: A {fungoid} growth appeared on the damp wall.
e.zh: 潮湿的墙上出现了一片菌状生长物。

e.en: The doctor noted a {fungoid} mass near the wound.
e.zh: 医生注意到伤口附近有一团似真菌的肿块。

e.en: The old medical text described a red {fungosity}.
e.zh: 那本旧医学书描述了一处红色的海绵状赘生物。

e.en: Moisture encouraged {fungosity} on the stored roots.
e.zh: 潮气促使储存的根部出现菌状物。

e.en: The coal sample contained traces of {fungotelinite}.
e.zh: 这份煤样中含有少量真菌结构煤素质体。

e.en: Specialists identified {fungotelinite} under the microscope.
e.zh: 专家在显微镜下识别出了真菌结构煤素质体。

e.en: The bread had a {fungous} smell after a week.
e.zh: 一周后，面包有了一股真菌般的气味。

e.en: Surgeons removed a {fungous} growth from the tissue.
e.zh: 外科医生从组织中切除了一个菌状赘生物。

e.en: A {funguslike} patch spread across the ceiling.
e.zh: 一片像真菌的斑块在天花板上蔓延开来。

e.en: The organism has a {funguslike} way of feeding.
e.zh: 这种生物有一种类似真菌的取食方式。

e.en: The tent uses {fungusproof} fabric for wet climates.
e.zh: 这顶帐篷在潮湿气候中使用防霉布料。

e.en: They coated the wood with a {fungusproof} finish.
e.zh: 他们给木材涂上了防真菌的面漆。

e.en: The ovule is attached by a slender {funicle}.
e.zh: 胚珠由一条细长的珠柄连接着。

e.en: A tiny {funicle} can be seen in the specimen.
e.zh: 在这个标本中可以看到一条细小的索状结构。

e.en: The seed showed a {funiculate} attachment under magnification.
e.zh: 放大后可以看到这粒种子有索状柄连接。

e.en: Botanists described the structure as {funiculate}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种结构描述为索状的。

e.en: Several {funiculi} connected the ovules to the placenta.
e.zh: 几条珠柄把胚珠连接到胎座上。

e.en: The spinal {funiculi} carry different nerve signals.
e.zh: 脊髓索传递不同的神经信号。

e.en: The plant part had a {funiculose} surface.
e.zh: 这个植物部位表面带有许多小索状结构。

e.en: A {funiculose} pattern appeared in the dried tissue.
e.zh: 干燥组织中出现了多索状的纹理。

e.en: Each ovule hangs from a short {funiculus}.
e.zh: 每个胚珠都由一条短珠柄悬挂着。

e.en: Damage to the posterior {funiculus} affected sensation.
e.zh: 后索受损影响了感觉功能。

e.en: The band played {funkily} through the whole set.
e.zh: 乐队整场演出都演奏得很有放克味。

e.en: She decorated the room {funkily} with bright posters.
e.zh: 她用鲜艳海报把房间装饰得很古怪有趣。

funkiness.t: 放克味；古怪时髦感；怪味

e.en: The song's {funkiness} comes from the bass and drums.
e.zh: 这首歌的放克味来自贝斯和鼓。

e.en: There was a slight {funkiness} in the old fridge.
e.zh: 那台旧冰箱里有一点怪味。

e.en: The flower has a {funnel-shaped} bloom.
e.zh: 这种花有一个漏斗形的花冠。

e.en: Smoke rose through a {funnel-shaped} opening.
e.zh: 烟从一个漏斗形开口升了上去。

e.en: The note called the vase {funnel-shapped}, misspelling the word.
e.zh: 那张说明把花瓶写成了漏斗形，但单词拼错了。

e.en: He searched for {funnel-shapped} parts and found the correct spelling.
e.zh: 他搜索拼错的“漏斗形”零件，随后找到了正确拼法。

e.en: The botanist described the corolla as {funnelform}.
e.zh: 植物学家把花冠描述为漏斗形。

e.en: A {funnelform} cloud formed below the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨下方形成了一团漏斗形云。

e.en: The party was full of {funniment} and music.
e.zh: 聚会上充满了嬉戏作乐和音乐。

e.en: His old letters still carry a touch of {funniment}.
e.zh: 他的旧信里仍带着一点玩笑趣味。

e.en: The {funniness} of the scene made everyone relax.
e.zh: 那个场面的滑稽让大家都放松下来。

e.en: I did not understand the {funniness} of his remark.
e.zh: 我没明白他那句话的有趣之处。

e.en: The comedian's strange {funniosity} divided the audience.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员古怪的滑稽感让观众反应不一。

e.en: There is a quiet {funniosity} in her drawings.
e.zh: 她的画里有一种含蓄的古怪趣味。

funny-looking.t: 样子奇怪的；怪模怪样的

e.en: A {funny-looking} car stopped outside the house.
e.zh: 一辆样子奇怪的车停在房子外面。

e.en: He wore a {funny-looking} hat to the meeting.
e.zh: 他戴着一顶怪模怪样的帽子去开会。

e.en: The cashier spotted the {funny-money} immediately.
e.zh: 收银员立刻发现了那张假币。

e.en: The deal was funded with {funny-money} from offshore accounts.
e.zh: 这笔交易用的是来自离岸账户的可疑资金。

e.en: Our school organized a {funrun} for charity.
e.zh: 我们学校组织了一场公益欢乐跑。

e.en: She joined the weekend {funrun} with her friends.
e.zh: 她和朋友参加了周末的趣味跑。

e.en: My uncle is the family {funster} at every dinner.
e.zh: 每次家庭聚餐，我叔叔都是家里的逗趣者。

e.en: The office {funster} kept sending silly emails.
e.zh: 办公室里那个爱开玩笑的人一直发傻乎乎的邮件。

e.en: The law protects several {fur-bearing} animals.
e.zh: 这项法律保护几种产毛皮的动物。

e.en: Cold regions are home to many {fur-bearing} mammals.
e.zh: 寒冷地区生活着许多有皮毛的哺乳动物。

e.en: She added a small {fur-piece} to the collar.
e.zh: 她在衣领上加了一小块毛皮饰件。

e.en: The tailor kept every {fur-piece} for later repairs.
e.zh: 裁缝把每一块毛皮都留着以后修补用。

e.en: The chemist heated {furan} under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 化学家在受控条件下加热呋喃。

e.en: {Furan} can appear in some processed foods.
e.zh: 呋喃可能出现在一些加工食品中。

e.en: The paper identified {furandienone} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 论文在植物提取物中鉴定出了呋喃二烯酮类化合物。

e.en: Researchers measured {furandienone} during the analysis.
e.zh: 研究人员在分析过程中测量了呋喃二烯酮类化合物。

e.en: The trial compared {furanidine} with older treatments.
e.zh: 这项试验把呋喃啶与较旧的疗法作了比较。

e.en: Doctors monitored patients after giving {furanidine}.
e.zh: 医生在给予呋喃啶后监测患者情况。

e.en: Scientists isolated {furanocadalene} from the resin sample.
e.zh: 科学家从树脂样本中分离出呋喃卡达烯类化合物。

e.en: The spectrum suggested that {furanocadalene} was present.
e.zh: 光谱显示其中可能存在呋喃卡达烯类化合物。

e.en: The team synthesized a new {furanophane} in the lab.
e.zh: 团队在实验室合成了一种新的呋喃环番化合物。

e.en: This {furanophane} has an unusual ring structure.
e.zh: 这种呋喃环番化合物具有不寻常的环状结构。

e.en: Glucose can form a {furanose} structure in solution.
e.zh: 葡萄糖在溶液中可以形成呋喃糖结构。

e.en: The diagram shows the {furanose} form of the sugar.
e.zh: 这张图显示了该糖的呋喃糖形式。

e.en: The chemist identified the compound as a {furanoside}.
e.zh: 化学家把这种化合物鉴定为呋喃糖苷。

e.en: This {furanoside} reacts slowly in water.
e.zh: 这种呋喃糖苷在水中反应较慢。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {furantoin} for the infection.
e.zh: 医生开了呋喃妥因来治疗感染。

e.en: Some bacteria resist {furantoin} treatment.
e.zh: 有些细菌会抵抗呋喃妥因治疗。

e.en: The study compared {furaprofen} with other pain medicines.
e.zh: 这项研究把呋拉洛芬与其他止痛药作比较。

e.en: Patients reported fewer symptoms after taking {furaprofen}.
e.zh: 患者服用呋拉洛芬后报告症状减少。

furazabol.t: 呋拉扎勃类合成代谢药

e.en: Athletes were tested for {furazabol} use.
e.zh: 运动员接受了呋拉扎勃使用检测。

e.en: The old report listed {furazabol} among banned steroids.
e.zh: 旧报告把呋拉扎勃列入禁用类固醇。

e.en: The veterinarian used {furazolidone} to treat the infection.
e.zh: 兽医使用呋喃唑酮治疗这种感染。

e.en: Many countries restrict {furazolidone} in food animals.
e.zh: 许多国家限制在食用动物中使用呋喃唑酮。

e.en: The trapper recorded each {furbearer} caught that season.
e.zh: 猎人记录了那个季节捕到的每只产毛皮动物。

e.en: State rules protect several wild {furbearers}.
e.zh: 州法规保护几种野生产毛皮动物。

e.en: A lace {furbelow} edged the old gown.
e.zh: 那件旧礼服边上缀着蕾丝褶边。

e.en: His speech had too much {furbelow} and too little substance.
e.zh: 他的演讲浮华装饰太多，实质内容太少。

e.en: She wore a heavily {furbelowed} dress.
e.zh: 她穿着一条装饰着许多褶边的裙子。

e.en: The hall was {furbelowed} with ribbons and paper flowers.
e.zh: 大厅用彩带和纸花装饰得很繁复。

e.en: The tailor was {furbelowing} the sleeves with lace.
e.zh: 裁缝正在给袖子加蕾丝褶边。

e.en: The writer kept {furbelowing} a simple story.
e.zh: 作者不断给一个简单故事添上浮华装饰。

e.en: The costume was covered with {furbelows}.
e.zh: 那套戏服满是褶边装饰。

e.en: Cut the verbal {furbelows} and state the point.
e.zh: 删掉那些文字上的花哨装饰，直接说重点。

e.en: The insect has a small {furcal} structure.
e.zh: 这种昆虫有一个小的叉状结构。

e.en: The dentist examined the {furcal} area between the roots.
e.zh: 牙医检查了牙根之间的分叉区域。

furcarbanide.t: 呋喃卡巴尼抗寄生虫药

e.en: The label mentioned {furcarbanide} as an active ingredient.
e.zh: 标签上提到呋喃卡巴尼是有效成分。

e.en: Researchers measured {furcarbanide} residues in tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了组织中的呋喃卡巴尼残留。

e.en: The road begins to {furcate} near the river.
e.zh: 道路在河边附近开始分叉。

e.en: A {furcate} vein marked the leaf surface.
e.zh: 叶面上有一条叉状叶脉。

e.en: The branch {furcated} just above the trunk.
e.zh: 树枝就在树干上方分叉了。

e.en: The diagram shows a {furcated} root system.
e.zh: 图中显示的是分叉的根系。

e.en: The stem {furcates} into two equal arms.
e.zh: 茎分叉成两个相等的枝臂。

e.en: The nerve {furcates} before entering the muscle.
e.zh: 神经在进入肌肉前分叉。

e.en: The {furcating} channel confused the survey team.
e.zh: 正在分叉的水道让测量队感到困惑。

e.en: They watched the root {furcating} under the microscope.
e.zh: 他们在显微镜下观察根部正在分叉。

e.en: The {furcation} of the artery is clearly visible.
e.zh: 这条动脉的分叉处清晰可见。

e.en: Gum disease can damage the tooth {furcation}.
e.zh: 牙龈疾病会损害牙齿的根分叉部位。

e.en: The bird's {furcula} helps support flight muscles.
e.zh: 鸟的叉骨有助于支撑飞行肌肉。

e.en: A springtail jumps by releasing its {furcula}.
e.zh: 跳虫通过释放它的弹器来跳跃。

e.en: The fossil preserved a clear {furcular} shape.
e.zh: 这块化石保留了清晰的叉骨形状。

e.en: The insect's {furcular} mechanism stores energy.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的弹器机制会储存能量。

e.en: The anatomy text called the wishbone a {furculum}.
e.zh: 解剖学教材把叉骨称作furculum。

e.en: A tiny {furculum} appears near the insect's abdomen.
e.zh: 昆虫腹部附近出现一个微小的叉状结构。

e.en: The spray contained {furethrin} as an insecticide.
e.zh: 这种喷雾含有呋喃菊酯作为杀虫成分。

e.en: Technicians tested {furethrin} levels in the sample.
e.zh: 技术人员检测了样品中的呋喃菊酯含量。

e.en: The dermatologist noted fine {furfur} on the scalp.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生注意到头皮上有细小的屑状鳞屑。

e.en: Dry skin left a light {furfur} on his collar.
e.zh: 干燥皮肤在他的衣领上留下轻微的皮屑。

e.en: The proposal received {fullhearted} support from the team.
e.zh: 这个提议得到了团队全心全意的支持。

e.en: He offered a {fullhearted} apology after the mistake.
e.zh: 犯错后，他诚恳地道了歉。

e.en: The band played to a {fullhouse} downtown.
e.zh: 乐队在市中心为满场观众演出。

e.en: She won the hand with a {fullhouse}.
e.zh: 她凭一手满堂红赢了这一局。

e.en: They released a {fulllength} documentary about the trial.
e.zh: 他们发布了一部关于审判的全长纪录片。

e.en: The mirror gives a {fulllength} view of the dress.
e.zh: 这面镜子能照出整条裙子的全身效果。

e.en: The actor spoke in a {fullmouthed} theatrical voice.
e.zh: 那名演员用洪亮而戏剧化的嗓音说话。

e.en: His {fullmouthed} praise sounded less sincere than he hoped.
e.zh: 他夸张的赞美听起来不如他希望的那样真诚。

e.en: The guards were {fully-armed} at the gate.
e.zh: 门口的警卫全副武装。

e.en: A {fully-armed} unit entered the building at dawn.
e.zh: 一支全副武装的部队在黎明进入大楼。

e.en: The trial project became a {fully-fledged} service.
e.zh: 这个试点项目变成了一项成熟的服务。

e.en: By summer, the chicks were {fully-fledged} and ready to fly.
e.zh: 到夏天，小鸟已经羽翼丰满，准备飞翔。

e.en: A {fully-grown} tree can shade the whole yard.
e.zh: 一棵完全长成的树可以遮住整个院子。

e.en: The shelter found homes for several {fully-grown} dogs.
e.zh: 收容所为几只成年犬找到了新家。

e.en: The old chemistry text described {fulmenite} as dangerously unstable.
e.zh: 那本旧化学书把雷汞矿描述为极不稳定。

e.en: A tiny sample of {fulmenite} was kept behind glass.
e.zh: 一小块雷汞矿样本被保存在玻璃后面。

e.en: The columnist became a public {fulminator} against corruption.
e.zh: 那位专栏作家成了公开猛烈抨击腐败的人。

e.en: The museum displayed an early {fulminator} used in blasting.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一种早期用于爆破的起爆装置。

e.en: The senator issued a {fulminatory} statement after the vote.
e.zh: 投票后，那位参议员发表了措辞激烈的谴责声明。

e.en: The chemist handled the {fulminatory} compound with extreme care.
e.zh: 化学家极其小心地处理这种爆炸性化合物。

fulmine.t: 猛烈斥责；像雷鸣般爆发

e.en: Editors used to {fulmine} against sloppy grammar.
e.zh: 编辑们过去常常猛烈斥责粗疏的语法。

e.en: The preacher would {fulmine} from the pulpit for an hour.
e.zh: 那位传教士会在讲坛上声色俱厉地讲一个小时。

e.en: Mercury fulminate is made from {fulminic} acid derivatives.
e.zh: 雷汞由雷酸衍生物制成。

e.en: The lab note warned that {fulminic} compounds can explode easily.
e.zh: 实验记录警告说，雷酸类化合物很容易爆炸。

e.en: The mineral collection included a dark crystal of {fuloppite}.
e.zh: 矿物收藏中有一块深色的硫锑铅矿晶体。

e.en: Geologists identified {fuloppite} in the ore sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在矿石样本中鉴定出了硫锑铅矿。

e.en: The chemist synthesized {fulvene} for the reaction study.
e.zh: 化学家为反应研究合成了富烯。

e.en: A {fulvene} ring can influence the molecule's color.
e.zh: 富烯环会影响分子的颜色。

e.en: The bird had {fulvescent} feathers along its back.
e.zh: 这只鸟背部的羽毛略带黄褐色。

e.en: A {fulvescent} stain spread across the old paper.
e.zh: 旧纸上扩散开一片淡黄褐色的污迹。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {fulvicin} for the fungal infection.
e.zh: 医生开了灰黄霉素来治疗真菌感染。

e.en: Older manuals list {fulvicin} as an antifungal medicine.
e.zh: 旧版手册把灰黄霉素列为抗真菌药。

e.en: The painter mixed a {fulvine} shade for the autumn leaves.
e.zh: 画家调出一种黄褐色来画秋叶。

e.en: The toxic alkaloid {fulvine} was found in the plant extract.
e.zh: 植物提取物中发现了有毒生物碱富尔文碱。

e.en: The butterfly's wings were edged with {fulvous} markings.
e.zh: 蝴蝶翅膀边缘带有黄褐色斑纹。

e.en: A {fulvous} glow lay over the dry grass at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时，干草上笼着一层茶色的光。

e.en: The market sold {fumade} made from local fish.
e.zh: 市场出售用本地鱼做的烟熏鱼。

e.en: She served thin slices of {fumade} with bread.
e.zh: 她把薄薄的熏制食品片配面包端上桌。

e.en: Several {fumades} hung above the old kitchen hearth.
e.zh: 几条烟熏鱼挂在老厨房的炉边。

e.en: The shop specializes in regional {fumades} and cured meats.
e.zh: 这家店专卖当地熏制食品和腌肉。

e.en: Researchers tested {fumagillin} against the parasite.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了烟曲霉素对这种寄生虫的效果。

e.en: Beekeepers sometimes discuss {fumagillin} as a disease treatment.
e.zh: 养蜂人有时会讨论用烟曲霉素治疗疾病。

e.en: A {fumaginous} film covered the factory windows.
e.zh: 工厂窗户上覆盖着一层烟灰似的薄膜。

e.en: The old ceiling had a {fumaginous} stain near the stove.
e.zh: 旧天花板靠近炉子的地方有一块烟熏似的污渍。

e.en: The mutation reduced {fumarase} activity in the cells.
e.zh: 这种突变降低了细胞中的延胡索酸酶活性。

e.en: Students measured {fumarase} during the biochemistry lab.
e.zh: 学生们在生物化学实验中测量了延胡索酸酶。

e.en: The steroid is supplied as a {furoate} cream.
e.zh: 这种类固醇以糠酸酯乳膏形式供应。

e.en: Chemists measured the stability of the {furoate} salt.
e.zh: 化学家测量了这种糠酸盐的稳定性。

e.en: The paper describes a new {furodiazole} derivative.
e.zh: 这篇论文描述了一种新的呋咱二唑衍生物。

e.en: Researchers tested {furodiazole} compounds against bacteria.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了呋咱二唑类化合物的抗菌效果。

e.en: The trial compared {furofenac} with older painkillers.
e.zh: 这项试验把呋罗芬酸与较老的止痛药作了比较。

e.en: Doctors monitored patients taking {furofenac} daily.
e.zh: 医生监测了每天服用呋罗芬酸的患者。

e.en: The reaction produced yellow crystals of {furoin}.
e.zh: 反应生成了黄色的糠偶姻晶体。

e.en: She used {furoin} as an intermediate in the synthesis.
e.zh: 她在合成中把糠偶姻用作中间体。

e.en: The lab isolated a reactive {furon} compound.
e.zh: 实验室分离出一种活泼的呋喃类化合物。

e.en: This {furon} ring changes under strong acid.
e.zh: 这个呋喃酮环在强酸中会发生变化。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {furosemide} for fluid retention.
e.zh: 医生开了呋塞米来治疗体液潴留。

e.en: Athletes may be tested for {furosemide} misuse.
e.zh: 运动员可能会接受呋塞米滥用检测。

e.en: The molecule contains a {furoyl} group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个糠酰基。

e.en: They prepared several {furoyl} chloride samples.
e.zh: 他们制备了几份糠酰氯样品。

e.en: The metal complex used {furoyltrifluoroacetone} as a ligand.
e.zh: 这种金属配合物使用糠酰三氟丙酮作为配体。

e.en: Analysts added {furoyltrifluoroacetone} during the extraction step.
e.zh: 分析人员在萃取步骤中加入了糠酰三氟丙酮。

e.en: The claim about free tickets was a {furphy}.
e.zh: 关于免费票的说法其实是个谣言。

e.en: He dismissed the story as another political {furphy}.
e.zh: 他把这个故事斥为又一个政治荒唐传闻。

e.en: Her family worked in {furriery} for generations.
e.zh: 她家几代人都从事毛皮业。

e.en: The old {furriery} closed after winter.
e.zh: 那家老皮货店在冬天过后关门了。

e.en: The {furriest} kitten slept by the fire.
e.zh: 毛最浓密的小猫睡在火炉旁。

e.en: That coat is the {furriest} one in the shop.
e.zh: 那件外套是店里毛感最厚的一件。

e.en: He mocked the stranger's {furrin} accent.
e.zh: 他嘲笑那个陌生人的外国口音。

e.en: The villagers distrusted {furrin} customs.
e.zh: 村民们不信任外来的习俗。

e.en: The old farmer called him a {furriner}.
e.zh: 那个老农把他叫作外乡人。

e.en: In the joke, every city guest is a {furriner}.
e.zh: 在这个笑话里，每个城里来的客人都是外来人。

e.en: Children loved the toy's soft {furriness}.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢这个玩具柔软毛茸茸的感觉。

e.en: The dog breed is known for its {furriness}.
e.zh: 这种犬以毛发浓密而出名。

e.en: His {furrowless} face made him look younger.
e.zh: 他没有皱纹的脸让他显得更年轻。

e.en: The field lay smooth and {furrowless} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后田地平整，没有沟痕。

e.en: The old sailor had a {furrowy} brow.
e.zh: 那位老水手额头上皱纹很深。

e.en: Water ran through the {furrowy} soil.
e.zh: 水从沟痕纵横的土壤中流过。

e.en: Older records sometimes spell the drug as {fursemide}.
e.zh: 较早的记录有时把这种药拼作fursemide。

e.en: The pharmacist recognized {fursemide} as an old variant.
e.zh: 药剂师认出fursemide是一个旧式变体。

e.en: The cattle wandered {furth} from the gate.
e.zh: 牛群从大门处向外游荡开去。

e.en: He went {furth} into the cold morning.
e.zh: 他走到外面，进入寒冷的清晨。

e.en: The cabin stood at the {furthermost} edge of the valley.
e.zh: 小屋坐落在山谷最远的边缘。

e.en: She reached the {furthermost} shelf in the archive.
e.zh: 她够到了档案室最深处的架子。

e.en: His advice was practical and {furthersome}.
e.zh: 他的建议既实际又有助益。

e.en: They welcomed any {furthersome} effort toward peace.
e.zh: 他们欢迎任何有助于和平的努力。

e.en: The nurse cleaned the painful {furuncle}.
e.zh: 护士清洁了那个疼痛的疖子。

e.en: A {furuncle} may need medical drainage.
e.zh: 皮肤脓肿可能需要医生引流。

e.en: The doctor noted a {furuncular} infection on his neck.
e.zh: 医生注意到他颈部有疖样感染。

e.en: She was treated for {furuncular} swelling.
e.zh: 她因疖样肿胀接受了治疗。

e.en: Recurrent {furunculosis} can require antibiotic treatment.
e.zh: 反复发作的疖病可能需要抗生素治疗。

e.en: The clinic reported several cases of {furunculosis}.
e.zh: 诊所报告了几例多发性疖。

e.en: The patient had a {furunculous} rash on his back.
e.zh: 患者背上出现了疖状皮疹。

e.en: The report described the skin as {furunculous}.
e.zh: 报告把这片皮肤描述为多疖状态。

e.en: The synthesis yielded a {furylacrylamide} compound.
e.zh: 这次合成得到了一种呋喃丙烯酰胺化合物。

e.en: They tested {furylacrylamide} for biological activity.
e.zh: 他们测试了呋喃丙烯酰胺的生物活性。

e.en: The lab stored {furylcarbinol} in a sealed amber bottle.
e.zh: 实验室把糠醇储存在密封的棕色瓶中。

e.en: Heating {furylcarbinol} can produce irritating vapors.
e.zh: 加热糠醇可能会产生刺激性蒸气。

e.en: Yellow {furze} covered the windy hillside.
e.zh: 黄色荆豆铺满了多风的山坡。

e.en: The path disappeared into thick {furze}.
e.zh: 小路消失在浓密的刺金雀花丛中。

e.en: They crossed a {furzy} stretch of common land.
e.zh: 他们穿过一片长满荆豆的公地。

e.en: The sheep grazed near the {furzy} bank.
e.zh: 羊群在长满荆豆的河岸附近吃草。

e.en: She sketched the figure with {fusain}.
e.zh: 她用木炭画笔勾勒出那个人物。

e.en: The coal seam contained thin layers of {fusain}.
e.zh: 煤层中含有薄薄的化石木炭层。

e.en: The {fusant} metal glowed inside the furnace.
e.zh: 正在熔化的金属在炉内发光。

e.en: Engineers selected a {fusant} alloy for the safety device.
e.zh: 工程师为安全装置选用了一种可熔合金。

e.en: The grain sample tested positive for {fusarenone}.
e.zh: 这份谷物样本检出了镰刀菌烯酮毒素。

e.en: Researchers measured {fusarenone} levels after fungal growth.
e.zh: 研究人员在真菌生长后测量镰刀菌烯酮毒素水平。

e.en: The fungus secretes {fusarinine} to capture iron.
e.zh: 这种真菌分泌镰刀菌素类铁载体来捕获铁。

e.en: Scientists analyzed {fusarinine} in the culture medium.
e.zh: 科学家分析了培养基中的镰刀菌素类铁载体。

e.en: The extract contained traces of {fusarole}.
e.zh: 提取物中含有微量镰刀菌醇类化合物。

e.en: Chemists isolated {fusarole} from the fungal culture.
e.zh: 化学家从真菌培养物中分离出镰刀菌醇类化合物。

e.en: The old tissue showed deposits of {fuscin}.
e.zh: 旧组织中可见褐黑色素沉积。

e.en: Pathologists noted {fuscin} in the damaged cells.
e.zh: 病理学家在受损细胞中发现了暗色素。

e.en: The moth had {fuscous} wings with pale spots.
e.zh: 那只蛾子的翅膀呈暗褐色，并带有浅色斑点。

e.en: A {fuscous} cloud spread across the evening sky.
e.zh: 一片灰黑的云铺过傍晚的天空。

e.en: The electrician replaced the burnt {fuse-wire}.
e.zh: 电工更换了烧断的保险丝。

e.en: Thin {fuse-wire} protects the circuit from overload.
e.zh: 细熔断丝能保护电路免受过载损害。

e.en: The guard lit a {fusee} beside the broken rail.
e.zh: 守卫在断裂的铁轨旁点燃了一支信号火炬。

e.en: The old watch used a {fusee} to regulate power.
e.zh: 那块老怀表用锥形轮来调节动力。

e.en: Poor distillation left too much {fusel} in the spirit.
e.zh: 蒸馏不当使烈酒中残留了过多杂醇。

e.en: The brewer monitored {fusel} alcohols during fermentation.
e.zh: 酿酒师在发酵过程中监测杂醇含量。

e.en: The heater shut down when the {fusestat} opened.
e.zh: 熔断恒温器断开后，加热器便停止工作。

e.en: A faulty {fusestat} can leave the dryer cold.
e.zh: 熔断恒温器故障会让烘干机无法加热。

e.en: The test measured the ash's {fusibility}.
e.zh: 这项测试测量了灰分的可熔性。

e.en: High {fusibility} makes the alloy useful for soldering.
e.zh: 较高的易熔程度使这种合金适合焊接。

e.en: The device contains a {fusible} metal link.
e.zh: 该装置含有一个可熔金属连接片。

e.en: Wax is {fusible} at relatively low temperatures.
e.zh: 蜡在相对较低的温度下就容易熔化。

e.en: Biologists used {fusicoccin} to study stomatal opening.
e.zh: 生物学家用壳梭孢素研究气孔张开。

e.en: The pathogen produces {fusicoccin} that wilts leaves.
e.zh: 这种病原体产生会使叶片萎蔫的壳梭孢素。

e.en: The ointment contains {fusidin} for bacterial skin infections.
e.zh: 这种药膏含有用于细菌性皮肤感染的夫西地酸类抗生素。

e.en: Doctors avoided {fusidin} after resistance was reported.
e.zh: 发现耐药情况后，医生避免使用夫西地酸类抗生素。

e.en: The muscle fibers were long and {fusiform}.
e.zh: 这些肌纤维又长又呈纺锤形。

e.en: A {fusiform} swelling appeared on the artery.
e.zh: 动脉上出现了一个纺锤形肿胀。

e.en: The soldier carried a {fusil} on patrol.
e.zh: 那名士兵巡逻时携带一支轻型火枪。

e.en: A rusty {fusil} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉上方挂着一支生锈的燧发枪。

e.en: The craftsman chose a {fusile} glass for the inlay.
e.zh: 工匠为镶嵌选择了一种可熔玻璃。

e.en: Some ores are more {fusile} than others.
e.zh: 有些矿石比其他矿石更容易熔化。

e.en: The {fusileer} stood guard at the gate.
e.zh: 那名燧发枪兵在门口站岗。

e.en: A young {fusileer} joined the regiment in spring.
e.zh: 一名年轻步枪兵在春天加入了该团。

e.en: She tossed the {fusilli} with pesto and tomatoes.
e.zh: 她把螺旋意面和青酱、番茄拌在一起。

e.en: The soup was thicker with {fusilli} added.
e.zh: 加入螺旋形意大利面后，汤变得更浓稠。

e.en: The study examined {fusimotor} control during movement.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了运动过程中的肌梭运动神经控制。

e.en: Damage may alter {fusimotor} signals to the muscle spindle.
e.zh: 损伤可能改变传向肌梭的肌梭运动神经信号。

fustigation.t: 杖打；严厉斥责；惩罚性抽打

e.en: The pamphlet called for the public {fustigation} of corrupt officials.
e.zh: 那本小册子呼吁公开严厉斥责腐败官员。

e.en: Historical records describe {fustigation} as a brutal form of punishment.
e.zh: 史料把杖打描述为一种残酷的惩罚方式。

e.en: The old curtains smelled {fustily} after years in storage.
e.zh: 旧窗帘存放多年后散发着霉味。

e.en: He spoke {fustily} about manners from another century.
e.zh: 他用一种古板的口气谈论上个世纪的礼仪。

e.en: The room's {fustiness} disappeared once the windows were opened.
e.zh: 窗户一打开，房间里的霉味就散了。

e.en: She disliked the {fustiness} of the old club's rules.
e.zh: 她不喜欢那个老俱乐部规章里的陈腐气。

fusula.t: 小纺锤状器官；小管状突起

e.en: The biologist identified a tiny {fusula} under the microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下辨认出一个微小的纺锤状器官。

e.en: Each {fusula} helps guide silk from the spider's gland.
e.zh: 每个小管状突起都帮助引导蜘蛛腺体中的丝。

e.en: She slid the {fusuma} aside to enter the tatami room.
e.zh: 她拉开日式拉门，走进榻榻米房间。

e.en: The painted {fusuma} divided the hall into smaller rooms.
e.zh: 彩绘襖把大厅隔成了几个小房间。

e.en: The trader marked the contract as {fut} in his notes.
e.zh: 交易员在笔记里把这份合约标为期货。

e.en: In the grammar table, {fut} means the future tense.
e.zh: 在语法表中，fut表示将来时。

e.en: The inscription was written in the older {futhark}.
e.zh: 这段铭文是用较古老的如尼字母表写成的。

e.en: Students compared the {futhark} with the later medieval runes.
e.zh: 学生们把古日耳曼如尼字母表同后来的中世纪如尼文作比较。

futhorc.t: 盎格鲁-撒克逊如尼字母表

e.en: The stone shows several letters from the {futhorc}.
e.zh: 这块石头上有几个盎格鲁-撒克逊如尼字母。

e.en: Scholars use the {futhorc} to study early English inscriptions.
e.zh: 学者用这种如尼字母表研究早期英语铭文。

futilitarian.t: 徒劳主义者；相信努力无用的人

e.en: The essay's {futilitarian} narrator expects every reform to fail.
e.zh: 这篇文章中抱持徒劳主义的叙述者认为每项改革都会失败。

e.en: He joked that only a {futilitarian} would attend another pointless meeting.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说，只有相信努力无用的人才会再参加这种没意义的会议。

e.en: Her novel treats {futilitarianism} as a temptation during political defeat.
e.zh: 她的小说把徒劳主义写成政治失败时的一种诱惑。

e.en: The committee rejected his {futilitarianism} and kept working.
e.zh: 委员会没有接受他那套万事无益论，继续开展工作。

e.en: The carpenter replaced a cracked {futtock} in the wooden ship.
e.zh: 木匠更换了木船上一段开裂的船肋弯材。

e.en: Each {futtock} formed part of the vessel's curved frame.
e.zh: 每段船肋弯材都构成船体弯曲框架的一部分。

futuramic.t: 未来感十足的；超现代的

e.en: The car's {futuramic} dashboard looked daring in 1950.
e.zh: 那辆车未来感十足的仪表盘在1950年显得很大胆。

e.en: Advertisers loved the {futuramic} style of chrome and glass.
e.zh: 广告商喜欢那种由铬和玻璃构成的超现代风格。

e.en: The company upgraded its servers to {future-proof} the platform.
e.zh: 公司升级服务器，以便让平台不易过时。

e.en: A {future-proof} design can adapt to new regulations.
e.zh: 面向未来的设计能够适应新的法规。

e.en: He felt trapped in a {futureless} job.
e.zh: 他觉得自己被困在一份没有前途的工作里。

e.en: The poem describes a {futureless} city after the war.
e.zh: 这首诗描写战后一座看不到未来的城市。

e.en: The exhibition imagines a bright {futureworld} powered by clean energy.
e.zh: 这场展览想象了一个由清洁能源驱动的光明未来世界。

e.en: In that {futureworld}, memories can be bought and sold.
e.zh: 在那个未来社会里，记忆可以买卖。

futuristically.t: 以未来派方式；超现代地

e.en: The airport terminal was designed {futuristically}, with glass walls and silent trains.
e.zh: 这座机场航站楼设计得很有未来感，配有玻璃墙和静音列车。

e.en: She dressed {futuristically} for the science-fiction party.
e.zh: 她为科幻派对穿得非常超现代。

e.en: The studio tried to {futurize} the classic story with drones and robots.
e.zh: 工作室试图用无人机和机器人让这个经典故事更有未来感。

e.en: Managers want to {futurize} the factory before competitors overtake it.
e.zh: 管理层想在竞争对手赶超之前让工厂现代化。

e.en: The report made several {futurological} claims about cities in 2050.
e.zh: 这份报告对2050年的城市提出了几项未来学预测。

e.en: His {futurological} lectures mixed data with bold speculation.
e.zh: 他的未来学讲座把数据和大胆推测结合在一起。

e.en: She studied {futurology} to understand long-term social change.
e.zh: 她研究未来学，以理解长期的社会变化。

e.en: Good {futurology} separates evidence from wishful thinking.
e.zh: 好的未来趋势研究会把证据同一厢情愿区分开来。

e.en: The technician inspected the artillery {fuze} before the test.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前检查了炮弹引信。

e.en: Workers must {fuze} the device only under strict supervision.
e.zh: 工人必须在严格监督下给装置安装引信。

e.en: The old soldier checked the {fuzee} before loading the shell.
e.zh: 老兵在装填炮弹前检查了火信管。

e.en: A damp {fuzee} would not catch in the rain.
e.zh: 受潮的火柴在雨中点不着。

fuzzball.t: 毛茸茸的小东西；傻乎乎的人

e.en: The kitten looked like a tiny {fuzzball} on the blanket.
e.zh: 那只小猫在毯子上像个小毛球。

e.en: He called his sleepy brother a {fuzzball} after breakfast.
e.zh: 早餐后他打趣说犯困的弟弟傻乎乎的。

e.en: The guitarist plugged into a {fuzzbox} for a rougher sound.
e.zh: 吉他手接上失真效果器，让声音更粗粝。

e.en: That old {fuzzbox} shaped the band's garage-rock tone.
e.zh: 那台旧失真效果器塑造了乐队的车库摇滚音色。

e.en: He kept a {fuzzbuster} on the dashboard during long drives.
e.zh: 长途开车时，他把雷达测速探测器放在仪表盘上。

e.en: The officer noticed the driver's {fuzzbuster} near the windshield.
e.zh: 警官注意到司机挡风玻璃旁的测速探测器。

fuzzbuzz.t: 模糊嗡嗡声；编程练习题

e.en: A strange {fuzzbuzz} came from the broken amplifier.
e.zh: 坏掉的功放里传出奇怪的模糊嗡嗡声。

e.en: The interview began with a simple {fuzzbuzz} exercise.
e.zh: 面试从一道简单的 FuzzBuzz 编程题开始。

e.en: His excuse sounded like complete {fuzznuts} to me.
e.zh: 他的借口在我听来完全是胡说八道。

e.en: Come on, {fuzznuts}, you forgot your keys again.
e.zh: 拜托，糊涂蛋，你又忘带钥匙了。

fuzzy-headed.t: 头脑昏沉的；思路不清的

e.en: I felt {fuzzy-headed} after the overnight flight.
e.zh: 坐了一夜飞机后，我觉得头脑昏沉。

e.en: His {fuzzy-headed} plan confused the whole team.
e.zh: 他思路不清的计划把整个团队都弄糊涂了。

e.en: The child hugged a {fuzzy-wuzzy} toy bear.
e.zh: 孩子抱着一只毛茸茸的玩具熊。

e.en: They teased him as {fuzzy-wuzzy} because of his wild curls.
e.zh: 他们因为他乱蓬蓬的卷发而打趣叫他卷毛。

e.en: A noisy {fyce} barked at every passing cart.
e.zh: 一只吵闹的小杂种狗冲每辆经过的马车叫。

e.en: The old farmer kept a sharp little {fyce} by the gate.
e.zh: 老农把一只机灵的小狗养在门边。

e.en: {Fye}, that was a cowardly thing to say.
e.zh: 呸，说那种话真是怯懦。

e.en: She cried {fye} when she saw the spoiled meat.
e.zh: 她看到变质的肉时厌恶地喊了声呸。

e.en: The fisherman set a {fyke} in the shallow stream.
e.zh: 渔夫在浅溪里放下了捕鱼笼网。

e.en: Eels often swim into a {fyke} and cannot turn back.
e.zh: 鳗鱼常游进长袋形鱼网后无法掉头。

e.en: The museum label described the ancient {fylfot} on the vase.
e.zh: 博物馆标签说明了花瓶上的古老卐字形纹样。

e.en: A carved {fylfot} appeared on the medieval stone.
e.zh: 中世纪石头上出现了一个刻出的旋转十字纹。

e.en: The king called the {fyrd} to defend the coast.
e.zh: 国王召集古英格兰民兵保卫海岸。

e.en: Many farmers served in the {fyrd} during wartime.
e.zh: 战时许多农民在征召军中服役。

fytte.t: 诗歌篇章；叙事诗的一节

e.en: The first {fytte} tells how the hero left home.
e.zh: 第一篇章讲述英雄如何离开家乡。

e.en: A singer recited each {fytte} before the feast.
e.zh: 宴会前，歌手朗诵了叙事诗的每一节。

e.en: The coal sample contained visible {fusinite} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这份煤样在显微镜下能看到明显的丝炭。

e.en: Geologists use {fusinite} to infer ancient fire activity.
e.zh: 地质学家利用丝炭来推断古代火灾活动。

e.en: Latin is often described as a {fusional} language.
e.zh: 拉丁语常被描述为屈折语。

e.en: The artist preferred a {fusional} style that mixed jazz and rock.
e.zh: 这位艺术家偏爱融合爵士和摇滚的风格。

e.en: His politics reflected {fusionism} between libertarians and conservatives.
e.zh: 他的政治立场体现了自由意志派与保守派的融合主义。

e.en: The critic saw {fusionism} as a weakness in the movement.
e.zh: 那位评论家认为调和论是这场运动的弱点。

fusionist.t: 融合主义者；融合派艺术家

e.en: The composer was a committed {fusionist} in modern jazz.
e.zh: 这位作曲家是现代爵士中的坚定融合派艺术家。

e.en: A political {fusionist} tried to unite the two factions.
e.zh: 一名政治融合主义者试图团结这两个派别。

e.en: The fungus was identified by its {fusisporous} structure.
e.zh: 这种真菌因其纺锤形孢子结构而被鉴定出来。

e.en: A {fusisporous} species appeared in the damp soil sample.
e.zh: 潮湿土样中出现了一个具纺锤形孢子的物种。

e.en: The traveler carried a {fusit} for lighting tinder.
e.zh: 旅人带着一把旧式火镰用来点燃火绒。

e.en: A rusty {fusit} lay beside the old camping kit.
e.zh: 一把生锈的打火钢放在旧露营工具旁边。

fusospirochete.t: 梭形杆菌与螺旋体复合菌

e.en: The dentist noted a {fusospirochete} infection in the gums.
e.zh: 牙医发现牙龈中有梭形杆菌与螺旋体复合感染。

e.en: Older textbooks link {fusospirochete} bacteria with trench mouth.
e.zh: 较早的教科书把这种复合菌与战壕口炎联系起来。

fuss-budget.t: 大惊小怪的人；吹毛求疵者

e.en: Don't be such a {fuss-budget} about the seating plan.
e.zh: 别对座位安排这么大惊小怪。

e.en: The old {fuss-budget} checked every label twice.
e.zh: 那个爱挑剔的老人把每个标签都检查了两遍。

e.en: Her {fussbudgety} habits made packing take all morning.
e.zh: 她那些爱挑剔的习惯让打包花了整个上午。

e.en: The instructions sounded oddly {fussbudgety} for a simple form.
e.zh: 对一张简单表格来说，这些说明显得出奇地啰嗦挑剔。

e.en: The rude boy called his uncle a {fussock}.
e.zh: 那个没礼貌的男孩叫他叔叔胖邋遢鬼。

e.en: In the old comedy, a lazy {fussock} blocks the doorway.
e.zh: 在那出老喜剧里，一个懒散的胖邋遢人挡住了门口。

fusspot.t: 爱小题大做的人；挑剔鬼

e.en: My aunt is a {fusspot} about clean towels.
e.zh: 我姑妈对干净毛巾特别挑剔。

e.en: Stop being a {fusspot} and choose a restaurant.
e.zh: 别再小题大做了，快选一家餐厅吧。

fusspots.t: 爱小题大做的人们；挑剔鬼们

e.en: The committee was full of {fusspots} arguing over commas.
e.zh: 委员会里全是为逗号争来争去的挑剔鬼。

e.en: Even the {fusspots} admitted the party went well.
e.zh: 连那些爱小题大做的人也承认聚会办得不错。

e.en: The dancer wore a white {fustanella} during the festival.
e.zh: 节日期间，那名舞者穿着白色巴尔干男式褶裙。

e.en: A traditional {fustanella} hung in the museum display.
e.zh: 博物馆展柜里挂着一条传统的巴尔干男式褶裙。

e.en: The pirates used a fast {fuste} along the coast.
e.zh: 海盗沿海使用一艘快速的窄长桨帆船。

e.en: A small {fuste} could move easily in shallow water.
e.zh: 小型窄长桨帆船能在浅水中灵活行驶。

e.en: The dyer made yellow cloth with {fustic}.
e.zh: 染工用黄栌木把布染成黄色。

e.en: Old trade records list {fustic} among imported dye woods.
e.zh: 旧贸易记录把黄色染料木列在进口染料木之中。

e.en: The basement smelled {fustier} after the rain.
e.zh: 下雨后，地下室闻起来更霉旧了。

e.en: His ideas grew {fustier} with every speech.
e.zh: 他每次演讲都让那些观点显得更陈腐。

e.en: We found the {fustiest} books in the attic.
e.zh: 我们在阁楼里找到了最霉旧的书。

e.en: The {fustiest} rules were finally removed from the club.
e.zh: 俱乐部里最陈腐的规矩终于被废除了。

e.en: The old law allowed officials to {fustigate} prisoners.
e.zh: 旧法律允许官员鞭打囚犯。

e.en: Critics continued to {fustigate} the minister's decision.
e.zh: 评论人士继续严厉斥责部长的决定。

fustigated.t: 痛打过的；严厉斥责了的

e.en: The soldier was {fustigated} for disobeying orders.
e.zh: 那名士兵因违抗命令而遭到鞭打。

e.en: The proposal was {fustigated} in every major newspaper.
e.zh: 这项提案在各大报纸上都遭到严厉斥责。

e.en: The pamphlet {fustigates} corruption in the court.
e.zh: 这本小册子严厉抨击宫廷中的腐败。

e.en: In the story, the captain {fustigates} a mutinous sailor.
e.zh: 在故事中，船长鞭打了一名叛乱水手。

e.en: The judge was {fustigating} the company for its fraud.
e.zh: 法官正严厉斥责那家公司欺诈。

e.en: The scene shows guards {fustigating} a captured rebel.
e.zh: 这一幕显示卫兵在鞭打一名被俘叛军。

furmint.t: 富尔民特白葡萄品种；其酒款

e.en: The sommelier recommended a dry {furmint} with the fish.
e.zh: 侍酒师推荐用一款干型富尔民特配这道鱼。

e.en: Hungarian {furmint} can make both crisp and sweet wines.
e.zh: 匈牙利富尔民特既能酿清爽酒，也能酿甜酒。

e.en: The {furnace-man} checked the heat before dawn.
e.zh: 炉工在天亮前检查了炉温。

e.en: A skilled {furnace-man} knew when the metal was ready.
e.zh: 熟练的炉工知道金属什么时候烧好了。

e.en: The {furnaceman} shoveled coal through the long night.
e.zh: 司炉人员整夜往炉里铲煤。

e.en: Every {furnaceman} wore heavy gloves near the blast furnace.
e.zh: 每个炉工靠近高炉时都戴着厚手套。

e.en: The old contract included a fee for {furnage}.
e.zh: 那份旧合同里包含一项炉费。

e.en: Careful {furnage} gave the bricks a harder finish.
e.zh: 细致的炉内烧制让砖块表面更加坚硬。

e.en: The {furnishment} of blankets arrived before winter.
e.zh: 毯子的供应在冬天前送到了。

e.en: Her room had plain but comfortable {furnishment}.
e.zh: 她的房间陈设朴素但很舒服。

e.en: The doctor noticed a {furfuraceous} scaling on her scalp.
e.zh: 医生注意到她头皮上有麸皮样的鳞屑。

e.en: The old specimen had a {furfuraceous} surface under the lens.
e.zh: 在镜头下，那件旧标本表面呈现细碎鳞屑状。

e.en: The factory extracted {furfural} from agricultural waste.
e.zh: 这家工厂从农业废料中提取糠醛。

e.en: A trace of {furfural} gave the sample a sharp odor.
e.zh: 少量糠醛让样品带有刺鼻气味。

e.en: The resin was made with {furfuralcohol} as a key ingredient.
e.zh: 这种树脂以糠醇作为关键成分制成。

e.en: Workers handled {furfuralcohol} under strict ventilation controls.
e.zh: 工人在严格通风条件下处理糠醇。

e.en: Chemists once called the compound {furfuraldehyde}.
e.zh: 化学家过去曾把这种化合物称为糠醛。

e.en: The label listed {furfuraldehyde} among the volatile substances.
e.zh: 标签把糠醛列入挥发性物质之中。

e.en: The paper described a new {furfuramide} derivative.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种新的糠酰胺衍生物。

e.en: She purified the {furfuramide} before running the test.
e.zh: 她在进行测试前先提纯了糠酰胺。

e.en: The molecule contains a {furfuran} ring.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个呋喃环。

e.en: Early chemists used {furfuran} for several related compounds.
e.zh: 早期化学家用呋喃来称呼几种相关化合物。

e.en: The dermatologist recorded slight {furfurescence} around the rash.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生记录到皮疹周围有轻微鳞屑形成。

e.en: Age caused a dry {furfurescence} on the surface of the sample.
e.zh: 老化使样品表面出现干燥的麸皮状变化。

e.en: The reaction produced a small amount of {furfurine}.
e.zh: 该反应生成了少量糠醛衍生含氮化合物。

e.en: Older texts sometimes mention {furfurine} in this synthesis.
e.zh: 较早的文献有时会在这种合成中提到furfurine。

e.en: The experiment yielded crystals of {furfuroin}.
e.zh: 实验得到了糠偶姻晶体。

e.en: They identified {furfuroin} as a product of the condensation.
e.zh: 他们确认糠偶姻是该缩合反应的产物。

e.en: The old bottle was labeled {furfurol}.
e.zh: 那个旧瓶子的标签写着糠醛旧称furfurol。

e.en: In historical papers, {furfurol} often means furfural.
e.zh: 在历史论文中，furfurol通常指糠醛。

e.en: The polymer contains several {furfuryl} groups.
e.zh: 这种聚合物含有多个糠基。

e.en: They tested {furfuryl} alcohol in the resin mixture.
e.zh: 他们在树脂混合物中测试了糠醇。

e.en: Researchers sprayed {furfuryladenine} on the seedlings.
e.zh: 研究人员把糠基腺嘌呤喷洒在幼苗上。

e.en: The culture medium contained {furfuryladenine} to promote growth.
e.zh: 培养基中含有糠基腺嘌呤以促进生长。

e.en: The compound includes a {furfurylidene} side chain.
e.zh: 该化合物包含一个糠叉基侧链。

e.en: They reported a stable {furfurylidene} intermediate.
e.zh: 他们报告了一种稳定的糠叉基中间体。

e.en: The synthesis produced yellow {furil} crystals.
e.zh: 这次合成产生了黄色糠偶酰晶体。

e.en: The team compared {furil} with a similar diketone.
e.zh: 团队把糠偶酰与一种类似的二酮作比较。

e.en: The pianist played the passage {furioso}.
e.zh: 钢琴家以狂暴激烈的方式演奏了这一段。

e.en: The score marks the finale as {furioso}.
e.zh: 乐谱把终曲标为激烈狂暴地演奏。

e.en: The {furless} cat curled up under a blanket.
e.zh: 那只无毛猫蜷在毯子下面。

e.en: A {furless} coat would not keep the animal warm.
e.zh: 没有毛皮的外层无法让这只动物保暖。

e.en: The plant had a soft, {furlike} surface.
e.zh: 这种植物表面柔软，像毛皮一样。

e.en: A {furlike} lining made the boots feel warm.
e.zh: 靴子里似毛皮的衬里让人觉得暖和。

e.en: The inn served hot {furmety} at breakfast.
e.zh: 客栈早餐供应热麦粥。

e.en: In the old recipe, {furmety} was sweetened with honey.
e.zh: 在那份老食谱中，麦粥用蜂蜜调甜。
